154	
155	pub(crate) fn handle_campaign_key(
156	    state: &mut CampaignAttachState,
157	    key: KeyEvent,
158	) -> CampaignAttachKeyAction {
159	    match key.code {
160	        KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => {
161	            state.selected = state.selected.saturating_sub(1);
162	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
163	        }
164	        KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') | KeyCode::Tab => {
165	            let max = state.campaign.sub_goals.len().saturating_sub(1);
166	            state.selected = (state.selected + 1).min(max);
167	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
168	        }
169	        KeyCode::Enter => state
170	            .selected_sub_plan()
171	            .map(|(sub_id, plan_id)| CampaignAttachKeyAction::DrillInto { sub_id, plan_id })
172	            .unwrap_or(CampaignAttachKeyAction::None),
173	        KeyCode::Char('r') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Refresh,
174	        KeyCode::Char('b') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
175	        KeyCode::Backspace | KeyCode::Esc => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
176	        KeyCode::Char('q') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit,
177	        KeyCode::Char('d') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
178	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit
179	        }
180	        _ => CampaignAttachKeyAction::None,
181	    }
182	}

184	pub(crate) fn note_tui_suspended() -> usize {
185	    TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1
186	}
187	
188	pub(crate) fn note_tui_resumed() -> usize {
189	    loop {
190	        let current = TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
191	        if current == 0 {
192	            return 0;
193	        }
194	        if TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH
195	            .compare_exchange(current, current - 1, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)
196	            .is_ok()
197	        {
198	            return current - 1;
199	        }
200	    }
201	}

214	pub(crate) struct AttachNarrativeRefreshState {
215	    pub(crate) kind: NarrativeRefreshKind,
216	    pub(crate) started_at: DateTime<Utc>,
217	    pub(crate) token: CancellationToken,
218	    pub(crate) coalesced_requests: usize,
219	    pub(crate) completed: bool,
220	}
221	
222	impl AttachNarrativeRefreshState {
223	    pub(crate) fn new(
224	        kind: NarrativeRefreshKind,
225	        started_at: DateTime<Utc>,
226	        token: CancellationToken,
227	    ) -> Self {
228	        Self {
229	            kind,
230	            started_at,
231	            token,
232	            coalesced_requests: 0,
233	            completed: false,
234	        }
235	    }
236	
237	    pub(crate) fn start_notice(&self) -> String {
238	        format!(
239	            "{}: refresh running in background; q detaches immediately",
240	            self.kind.label()
241	        )
242	    }
243	
244	    pub(crate) fn coalesce(&mut self, kind: NarrativeRefreshKind, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
245	        self.coalesced_requests = self.coalesced_requests.saturating_add(1);
246	        format!(
247	            "{}: refresh already running in background ({}s); coalesced {}",
248	            self.kind.label(),
249	            (now - self.started_at).num_seconds().max(0),
250	            kind.label()
251	        )
252	    }
253	
254	    pub(crate) fn completion_notice_once(&mut self, notice: String) -> Option<String> {
255	        if self.completed {
256	            return None;
257	        }
258	        self.completed = true;
259	        Some(notice)
260	    }
261	
262	    pub(crate) fn cancel(&self) {
263	        self.token.cancel();
264	    }
265	}

311	pub(crate) fn start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
312	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
313	    request: AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest,
314	    now: DateTime<Utc>,
315	) -> String {
316	    if let Some(active) = job.as_mut() {
317	        return active.state.coalesce(request.kind, now);
318	    }
319	
320	    let token = CancellationToken::new();
321	    let refresh_state = AttachNarrativeRefreshState::new(request.kind, now, token.clone());
322	    let notice = refresh_state.start_notice();
323	    let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
324	        let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest {
325	            paths,
326	            state,
327	            spend,
328	            traces,
329	            events,
330	            live,
331	            tui_state,
332	            config,
333	            kind,
334	        } = request;
335	        refresh_run_narrative_with_provider_for_kind_with_token(
336	            &paths,
337	            &RunNarrativeRenderInput {
338	                state: &state,
339	                spend: &spend,
340	                traces: &traces,
341	                events: &events,
342	                live: &live,
343	                tui_state: &tui_state,
344	            },
345	            &config,
346	            kind,
347	            Some(token),
348	        )
349	        .await
350	        .unwrap_or_else(|err| {
351	            format!(
352	                "provider refresh failed: {}",
353	                one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
354	            )
355	        })
356	    });
357	    *job = Some(AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob {
358	        state: refresh_state,
359	        handle,
360	    });
361	    notice
362	}

418	pub(crate) async fn poll_run_narrative_refresh_job(
419	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
420	) -> Option<String> {
421	    if !job
422	        .as_ref()
423	        .is_some_and(|active| active.handle.is_finished())
424	    {
425	        return None;
426	    }
427	    let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob { mut state, handle } = job.take()?;
428	    match handle.await {
429	        Ok(notice) => state.completion_notice_once(notice),
430	        Err(err) if err.is_cancelled() => None,
431	        Err(err) => Some(format!(
432	            "provider refresh failed: {}",
433	            one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
434	        )),
435	    }
436	}

21	pub(crate) struct ChainAttachTuiState {

23	    events_scroll: u16,
24	    pub(crate) event_status_hint: Option<String>,

26	
27	impl ChainAttachTuiState {
28	    pub(crate) fn clamp(&mut self, chain: &Chain) {
29	        if chain.steps.is_empty() {
30	            self.selected_step = 0;
31	            self.events_scroll = 0;
32	            return;
33	        }
34	        self.selected_step = self.selected_step.min(chain.steps.len() - 1);
35	    }
36	
37	    pub(crate) fn handle_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent, chain: &Chain) {
38	        match key.code {
39	            KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => self.scroll(-1, chain),
40	            KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') | KeyCode::Tab => self.scroll(1, chain),
41	            KeyCode::PageUp => {
42	                self.events_scroll = self.events_scroll.saturating_sub(8);
43	            }
44	            KeyCode::PageDown => {
45	                self.events_scroll = self.events_scroll.saturating_add(8);
46	            }
47	            KeyCode::Home | KeyCode::Char('g') => {
48	                self.selected_step = 0;
49	                self.events_scroll = 0;
50	            }
51	            KeyCode::End | KeyCode::Char('G') => {
52	                self.selected_step = chain.steps.len().saturating_sub(1);
53	            }
54	            _ => {}
55	        }
56	        self.clamp(chain);
57	    }
58	
59	    pub(crate) fn scroll(&mut self, delta: isize, chain: &Chain) {
60	        if chain.steps.is_empty() {
61	            return;
62	        }
63	        let next = (self.selected_step as isize + delta)
64	            .clamp(0, chain.steps.len().saturating_sub(1) as isize);
65	        self.selected_step = next as usize;
66	    }
67	}

69	pub(crate) fn chain_event_read_hint(
70	    event_count: usize,
71	    appended_rows: usize,
72	    partial_bytes: usize,
73	    elapsed: Duration,
74	    budget: AttachTickBudget,
75	    error: Option<&CliError>,
76	) -> Option<String> {
77	    if let Some(error) = error {
78	        return Some(format!(
79	            "activity read delayed: {}",

81	        ));

83	    if elapsed > Duration::from_millis(budget.max_sync_io_ms) {
84	        return Some(format!(
85	            "activity catch-up: {event_count} events, +{appended_rows}, {}ms",
86	            elapsed.as_millis()
87	        ));
88	    }
89	    if partial_bytes > 0 {
90	        return Some(format!(
91	            "activity waiting for complete event line ({partial_bytes} bytes)"
92	        ));
93	    }
94	    None
95	}

167	pub(crate) fn chain_timeline_lines(
168	    chain: &Chain,
169	    tui_state: &ChainAttachTuiState,
170	) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {
171	    chain
172	        .steps
173	        .iter()
174	        .enumerate()
175	        .map(|(index, step)| {
176	            let marker = if index == tui_state.selected_step {
177	                ">"
178	            } else {
179	                " "
180	            };
181	            let run = step
182	                .run_id
183	                .as_deref()
184	                .map(|run_id| format!(" run {}", run_prefix(run_id)))
185	                .unwrap_or_default();
186	            let mut spans = vec![
187	                Span::styled(marker.to_string(), Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)),
188	                Span::raw(format!(
189	                    " {} step {:>2} {:<8} {}{}",
190	                    chain_step_dot(step.status),
191	                    step.index + 1,
192	                    chain_step_status_label(step.status),
193	                    one_line(&step.goal, 54),
194	                    run
195	                )),
196	            ];
197	            if let Some(reason) = step.fail_reason.as_deref() {
198	                spans.push(Span::styled(
199	                    format!("  {}", one_line(reason, 32)),
200	                    Style::default().fg(Color::Red),
201	                ));
202	            }
203	            Line::from(spans)
204	        })
205	        .collect()
206	}

208	pub(crate) fn chain_activity_lines(
209	    events: &[ChainEvent],
210	    tui_state: &ChainAttachTuiState,
211	) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {
212	    let start = usize::from(tui_state.events_scroll).min(events.len());
213	    events
214	        .iter()
215	        .rev()
216	        .skip(start)
217	        .take(240)
218	        .map(|event| {
219	            let step = event
220	                .step_index
221	                .map(|index| format!(" step {}", index + 1))
222	                .unwrap_or_default();
223	            let detail = if event.detail.is_null() {
224	                String::new()
225	            } else {
226	                format!(" {}", one_line(&event.detail.to_string(), 120))
227	            };
228	            Line::from(format!(
229	                "{} {}{}{}",
230	                event.timestamp.format("%H:%M:%S"),
231	                chain_event_label(&event.event),
232	                step,
233	                detail
234	            ))
235	        })
236	        .collect()
237	}

239	pub(crate) fn chain_attach_footer_text(chain: &Chain) -> String {
240	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Paused {
241	        let surface = chain_paused_attach_footer_surface(chain);
242	        let reason = chain.paused_reason.as_deref().unwrap_or("paused");
243	        let evidence = surface
244	            .explanation
245	            .evidence
246	            .iter()
247	            .map(|(key, value)| format!("{key} {value}"))
248	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
249	            .join("; ");
250	        let other = surface
251	            .secondary_actions
252	            .iter()
253	            .map(|action| action.command.clone())
254	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
255	            .join("; ");
256	        format!(
257	            "{} | why {reason} | evidence {evidence} | next {} | other {other} | q detach",
258	            surface.label(),
259	            surface.primary_action.command
260	        )
261	    } else {
262	        "[Enter] drill  [r] redo  [e] extend  [p] pause  [k] kill  [Ctrl-D/q/Esc] detach  j/k move  PgUp/PgDn activity".to_string()
263	    }
264	}

266	fn chain_paused_attach_footer_surface(chain: &Chain) -> VerdictSurface {
267	    let id = run_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
268	    let reason = chain.paused_reason.as_deref().unwrap_or("paused");
269	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
270	        VerdictKind::Paused,
271	        "chain",
272	        Some(&id),
273	        ExplanationPanel::new(
274	            "The chain is paused and no child run is advancing.",
275	            format!("{reason} is recorded as the pause reason."),
276	            [
277	                ("status", format!("{:?}", chain.status)),
278	                ("paused_reason", reason.to_string()),
279	            ],
280	        ),
281	        [("Recommended", format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"))],
282	        [
283	            (
284	                "Inspect",
285	                format!("deadreckon chain show {id} --why-failed"),
286	            ),
287	            (
288	                "Preview",
289	                format!("deadreckon chain resume {id} --apply-mode preview"),
290	            ),
291	            ("Undo", format!("deadreckon chain undo {id}")),
292	        ],
293	    )
294	    .expect("paused chain attach footer verdict surface")
295	}

318	pub(crate) fn render_campaign_attach(frame: &mut ratatui::Frame<'_>, state: &CampaignAttachState) {
319	    let area = frame.area();
320	    let vertical = Layout::default()
321	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
322	        .constraints([
323	            Constraint::Length(6),
324	            Constraint::Min(8),
325	            Constraint::Length(7),
326	            Constraint::Length(2),
327	        ])
328	        .split(area);
329	    frame.render_widget(
330	        Paragraph::new(campaign_attach_header_lines(state))
331	            .block(
332	                Block::default()
333	                    .title("deadreckon campaign")
334	                    .borders(Borders::ALL),
335	            )
336	            .wrap(Wrap { trim: true }),
337	        vertical[0],
338	    );
339	
340	    let panes = campaign_sub_pane_layout(vertical[1], state.campaign.sub_goals.len());
341	    for (index, sub) in state.campaign.sub_goals.iter().enumerate() {
342	        let Some(rect) = panes.get(index).copied() else {
343	            continue;
344	        };
345	        let selected = index == state.selected;
346	        let title = format!(
347	            "{} {} {}",
348	            if selected { ">" } else { " " },
349	            sub.sub_id,
350	            campaign_sub_status_text(sub.status)
351	        );
352	        let lines = campaign_sub_lines(state, index, rect.width.saturating_sub(4) as usize)
353	            .into_iter()
354	            .map(Line::from)
355	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
356	        frame.render_widget(
357	            Paragraph::new(lines)
358	                .block(
359	                    Block::default()
360	                        .title(title)
361	                        .borders(Borders::ALL)
362	                        .border_style(if selected {
363	                            Style::default().fg(ui::TUI_PALETTE.border_focused)
364	                        } else {
365	                            Style::default().fg(ui::TUI_PALETTE.border_idle)
366	                        }),
367	                )
368	                .wrap(Wrap { trim: true }),
369	            rect,
370	        );
371	    }
372	
373	    let feed = campaign_feed_lines(state, vertical[2].height.saturating_sub(2) as usize)
374	        .into_iter()
375	        .map(ListItem::new)
376	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
377	    frame.render_widget(
378	        List::new(feed).block(
379	            Block::default()
380	                .title("campaign feed")
381	                .borders(Borders::ALL),
382	        ),
383	        vertical[2],
384	    );
385	    frame.render_widget(
386	        Paragraph::new(campaign_attach_footer_text(false)),
387	        vertical[3],
388	    );
389	}

457	fn campaign_sub_counts(state: &CampaignAttachState) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
458	    let merged = state
459	        .campaign
460	        .sub_goals
461	        .iter()
462	        .filter(|sub| sub.status == deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoalStatus::Merged)
463	        .count();
464	    let running = state
465	        .campaign
466	        .sub_goals
467	        .iter()
468	        .filter(|sub| sub.status == deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoalStatus::Running)
469	        .count();
470	    let pending = state
471	        .campaign
472	        .sub_goals
473	        .len()
474	        .saturating_sub(merged + running);
475	    (merged, running, pending)
476	}

567	
568	fn campaign_sub_pane_layout(
569	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,
570	    sub_count: usize,
571	) -> Vec<ratatui::layout::Rect> {
572	    if sub_count == 0 {
573	        return Vec::new();
574	    }
575	    let rows = if sub_count <= 3 { 1 } else { 2 };
576	    let row_constraints =
577	        std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, rows as u32), rows).collect::<Vec<_>>();
578	    let row_chunks = Layout::default()
579	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
580	        .constraints(row_constraints)
581	        .split(area);
582	    let mut rects = Vec::new();
583	    for row in 0..rows {
584	        let remaining = sub_count.saturating_sub(rects.len());
585	        let columns = remaining.min(if rows == 1 { sub_count } else { 3 }).max(1);
586	        let col_constraints =
587	            std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, columns as u32), columns).collect::<Vec<_>>();
588	        let cols = Layout::default()
589	            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
590	            .constraints(col_constraints)
591	            .split(row_chunks[row]);
592	        for col in cols.iter().copied().take(remaining) {
593	            rects.push(col);
594	            if rects.len() == sub_count {
595	                break;
596	            }
597	        }
598	    }
599	    rects
600	}

665	    let rows = area.height.saturating_sub(2) as usize;
666	    let projection = run_narrative_projection_for_render(input);
667	    let mut lines = run_narrative_lines_from_projection(&projection, tui_state);
668	    if area.width >= 110 && tui_state.visual != NarrativeVisualMode::None {
669	        let chunks = Layout::default()
670	            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
671	            .constraints([Constraint::Percentage(62), Constraint::Percentage(38)])
672	            .split(area);
673	        let visual_lines = narrative::graph_ascii_lines(&projection.graph, tui_state.visual);
674	        lines.retain(|line| !line.starts_with("Visual:"));
675	        let visible = visible_narrative_items(&lines, tui_state.narrative_scroll, rows);
676	        frame.render_widget(
677	            List::new(visible).block(
678	                Block::default()
679	                    .borders(Borders::ALL)
680	                    .border_style(panel_border_style(
681	                        tui_state.focused_panel,
682	                        AttachPanel::Activity,
683	                    ))
684	                    .title(panel_title(
685	                        "narrative",
686	                        tui_state.focused_panel == AttachPanel::Activity,
687	                        tui_state.narrative_scroll,
688	                        rows,
689	                        lines.len(),
690	                    )),
691	            ),
692	            chunks[0],
693	        );
694	        frame.render_widget(
695	            List::new(visual_lines.into_iter().map(narrative_list_item)).block(
696	                Block::default()
697	                    .title(format!("visual {}", tui_state.visual.label()))
698	                    .borders(Borders::ALL),
699	            ),
700	            chunks[1],
701	        );
702	    } else {
703	        let visible = visible_narrative_items(&lines, tui_state.narrative_scroll, rows);
704	        frame.render_widget(
705	            List::new(visible).block(
706	                Block::default()
707	                    .borders(Borders::ALL)
708	                    .border_style(panel_border_style(
709	                        tui_state.focused_panel,
710	                        AttachPanel::Activity,
711	                    ))
712	                    .title(panel_title(
713	                        &format!("narrative / {}", tui_state.visual.label()),
714	                        tui_state.focused_panel == AttachPanel::Activity,
715	                        tui_state.narrative_scroll,
716	                        rows,
717	                        lines.len(),
718	                    )),
719	            ),
720	            area,
721	        );
722	    }
723	}

794	fn run_narrative_input<'a>(
795	    input: &'a RunNarrativeRenderInput<'a>,
796	) -> narrative::RunNarrativeInput<'a> {
797	    let state = input.state;
798	    let live = input.live;
799	    let tui_state = input.tui_state;
800	    narrative::RunNarrativeInput {
801	        state,
802	        spend: input.spend,
803	        traces: input.traces,
804	        events: input.events,
805	        live_files: live
806	            .files
807	            .iter()
808	            .map(|file| narrative::LiveFileFact {
809	                path: file.path.clone(),
810	                bytes: file.bytes,
811	                modified_at: file.modified_at,
812	            })
813	            .collect(),
814	        file_count: live.file_count,
815	        total_bytes: live.total_bytes,
816	        acceptance_summary: acceptance_narrative_summary(&live.acceptance),
817	        provider_activity: &live.provider_activity,
818	        parent_plan: tui_state
819	            .parent_plan
820	            .as_ref()
821	            .map(|parent| narrative::ParentPlanFact {
822	                plan_id: parent.plan_id.clone(),
823	                task_id: parent.task_id.clone(),
824	            }),
825	    }
826	}

828	pub(crate) fn run_narrative_projection_signature(input: &RunNarrativeRenderInput<'_>) -> u64 {
829	    let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();
830	    input.state.run_id.hash(&mut hasher);
831	    format!("{:?}", input.state.status).hash(&mut hasher);
832	    input.state.turn.hash(&mut hasher);
833	    input
834	        .state
835	        .active_phase()
836	        .map(|phase| &phase.name)
837	        .hash(&mut hasher);
838	    input.spend.len().hash(&mut hasher);
839	    input
840	        .spend
841	        .last()
842	        .map(|record| record.total_cost_usd.to_bits())
843	        .hash(&mut hasher);
844	    input.traces.len().hash(&mut hasher);
845	    input
846	        .traces
847	        .last()
848	        .map(|record| (&record.turn, &record.event))
849	        .hash(&mut hasher);
850	    input.events.len().hash(&mut hasher);
851	    input.live.file_count.hash(&mut hasher);
852	    input.live.total_bytes.hash(&mut hasher);
853	    input
854	        .live
855	        .files
856	        .first()
857	        .map(|file| {
858	            (
859	                &file.path,
860	                file.bytes,
861	                file.modified_at.map(|date| date.timestamp_millis()),
862	            )
863	        })
864	        .hash(&mut hasher);
865	    input.live.provider_activity.len().hash(&mut hasher);
866	    input.live.provider_activity.last().hash(&mut hasher);
867	    format!("{:?}", input.live.acceptance.status).hash(&mut hasher);
868	    input.live.acceptance.completed.hash(&mut hasher);
869	    input.live.acceptance.failed.hash(&mut hasher);
870	    input.live.acceptance.latest_detail.hash(&mut hasher);
871	    input
872	        .tui_state
873	        .parent_plan
874	        .as_ref()
875	        .map(|parent| (&parent.plan_id, &parent.task_id))
876	        .hash(&mut hasher);
877	    hasher.finish()
878	}

880	fn acceptance_narrative_summary(acceptance: &AcceptanceLive) -> String {
881	    match acceptance.status {
882	        AcceptanceUiStatus::DefaultGate => "default gate".to_string(),
883	        AcceptanceUiStatus::Configured => format!("configured {} check(s)", acceptance.total),
884	        AcceptanceUiStatus::Running => {
885	            format!(
886	                "running {}/{} check(s)",
887	                acceptance.completed, acceptance.total
888	            )
889	        }
890	        AcceptanceUiStatus::Passed => {
891	            format!("passed {}/{} check(s)", acceptance.passed, acceptance.total)
892	        }
893	        AcceptanceUiStatus::Failed => format!(
894	            "failed {} required, {} passed of {}",
895	            acceptance.required_failed, acceptance.passed, acceptance.total
896	        ),
897	    }
898	}

931	pub(crate) fn render_plan_attach(
932	    frame: &mut ratatui::Frame<'_>,
933	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
934	    plan: &Plan,
935	    state: &PlanAttachRenderState<'_>,
936	) {
937	    let area = frame.area();
938	    let vertical = Layout::default()
939	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
940	        .constraints([
941	            Constraint::Length(7),
942	            Constraint::Min(10),
943	            Constraint::Length(7),
944	            Constraint::Length(2),
945	        ])
946	        .split(area);
947	    let counts = plan_task_counts(plan);
948	    let campaign_context = state
949	        .campaign_parent
950	        .map(|parent| {
951	            format!(
952	                "campaign {} / {}  |  ",
953	                run_prefix(&parent.campaign_id),
954	                parent.sub_id
955	            )
956	        })
957	        .unwrap_or_default();
958	    let header = vec![
959	        Line::from(vec![
960	            Span::styled(campaign_context, Style::default().fg(Color::Blue)),
961	            Span::styled("plan ", Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)),
962	            Span::styled(
963	                run_prefix(&plan.plan_id),
964	                Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
965	            ),
966	            Span::raw(format!(
967	                "  status {}  mode {:?}  children {}/{}/{}",
968	                plan_status_label(plan.status),
969	                plan.mode,
970	                counts.0,
971	                counts.1,
972	                plan.tasks.len()
973	            )),
974	        ]),
975	        Line::from(one_line(
976	            &plan.root_goal,
977	            area.width.saturating_sub(4) as usize,
978	        )),
979	        Line::from(plan_provider_summary(plan)),
980	        Line::from(commands::plan::orchestration_parallelism_lines(plan).join("  ")),
981	        Line::from(format!(
982	            "capabilities network={:?} deploy={} install={}{}",
983	            plan.capability_preview.network,
984	            plan.capability_preview.deploy,
985	            plan.capability_preview.global_install,
986	            plan_final_gate_line(paths, plan)
987	                .map(|line| format!("  final {line}"))
988	                .unwrap_or_default()
989	        )),
990	    ];
991	    frame.render_widget(
992	        Paragraph::new(header)
993	            .block(
994	                Block::default()
995	                    .title("deadreckon plan")
996	                    .borders(Borders::ALL),
997	            )
998	            .wrap(Wrap { trim: true }),
999	        vertical[0],
1000	    );
1001	
1002	    let task_area = vertical[1];
1003	    let panes = plan_task_pane_layout(task_area, plan.tasks.len());
1004	    for (index, task) in plan.tasks.iter().enumerate() {
1005	        let Some(rect) = panes.get(index).copied() else {
1006	            continue;
1007	        };
1008	        let is_selected = index == state.selected;
1009	        let title = format!(
1010	            "{} {} {}",
1011	            if is_selected { "*" } else { " " },
1012	            task.task_id,
1013	            task_status_label(task.status)
1014	        );
1015	        let lines =
1016	            plan_task_detail_lines(paths, plan, task, rect.width.saturating_sub(4) as usize)
1017	                .into_iter()
1018	                .enumerate()
1019	                .map(|(line_index, line)| {
1020	                    if line_index == 0 {
1021	                        Line::from(vec![
1022	                            Span::styled(
1023	                                line.split_once("  ")
1024	                                    .map(|(role, _)| role.to_string())
1025	                                    .unwrap_or_else(|| line.clone()),
1026	                                Style::default().fg(Color::Magenta),
1027	                            ),
1028	                            Span::raw(
1029	                                line.split_once("  ")
1030	                                    .map(|(_, rest)| format!("  {rest}"))
1031	                                    .unwrap_or_default(),
1032	                            ),
1033	                        ])
1034	                    } else {
1035	                        Line::from(line)
1036	                    }
1037	                })
1038	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1039	        frame.render_widget(
1040	            Paragraph::new(lines)
1041	                .block(
1042	                    Block::default()
1043	                        .title(title)
1044	                        .borders(Borders::ALL)
1045	                        .border_style(if is_selected {
1046	                            Style::default().fg(ui::TUI_PALETTE.border_focused)
1047	                        } else {
1048	                            Style::default().fg(ui::TUI_PALETTE.border_idle)
1049	                        }),
1050	                )
1051	                .wrap(Wrap { trim: true }),
1052	            rect,
1053	        );
1054	    }
1055	
1056	    if state.view.is_narrative() {
1057	        render_plan_narrative_attach(frame, paths, plan, state, vertical[2]);
1058	    } else {
1059	        let activity = plan_activity_lines(
1060	            state.plan_events,
1061	            state.messages,
1062	            state.feed_events,
1063	            vertical[2].height.saturating_sub(2) as usize,
1064	        );
1065	        let activity_title = if !state.feed_events.is_empty() {
1066	            "plan feed"
1067	        } else if state.plan_events.is_empty() {
1068	            "coordinator messages"
1069	        } else {
1070	            "plan events"
1071	        };
1072	        frame.render_widget(
1073	            List::new(activity).block(Block::default().title(activity_title).borders(Borders::ALL)),
1074	            vertical[2],
1075	        );
1076	    }
1077	    let footer = plan_attach_footer(
1078	        paths,
1079	        plan,
1080	        state.selected,
1081	        state.show_hints,
1082	        state.view,
1083	        state.visual,
1084	    );
1085	    frame.render_widget(Paragraph::new(footer), vertical[3]);
1086	}

1088	fn render_plan_narrative_attach(
1089	    frame: &mut ratatui::Frame<'_>,
1090	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1091	    plan: &Plan,
1092	    state: &PlanAttachRenderState<'_>,
1093	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,
1094	) {
1095	    let projection = state.narrative_projection.cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
1096	        narrative::build_plan_projection(&narrative::PlanNarrativeInput {
1097	            paths,
1098	            plan,
1099	            messages: state.messages,
1100	            plan_events: state.plan_events,
1101	            feed_events: state.feed_events,
1102	            selected: state.selected,
1103	        })
1104	    });
1105	    let mut lines = narrative::narrative_plain_lines(&projection, state.visual);
1106	    if let Some(notice) = state.narrative_notice {
1107	        lines.insert(2, format!("[fresh] {notice}"));
1108	    }
1109	    if area.width >= 100 && state.visual != NarrativeVisualMode::None {
1110	        let chunks = Layout::default()
1111	            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
1112	            .constraints([Constraint::Percentage(62), Constraint::Percentage(38)])
1113	            .split(area);
1114	        let visual_lines = narrative::graph_ascii_lines(&projection.graph, state.visual);
1115	        lines.retain(|line| !line.starts_with("Visual:"));
1116	        frame.render_widget(
1117	            List::new(lines.into_iter().map(narrative_list_item)).block(
1118	                Block::default()
1119	                    .title("plan narrative")
1120	                    .borders(Borders::ALL)
1121	                    .border_style(Style::default().fg(ui::TUI_PALETTE.border_focused)),
1122	            ),
1123	            chunks[0],
1124	        );
1125	        frame.render_widget(
1126	            List::new(visual_lines.into_iter().map(narrative_list_item)).block(
1127	                Block::default()
1128	                    .title(format!("visual {}", state.visual.label()))
1129	                    .borders(Borders::ALL),
1130	            ),
1131	            chunks[1],
1132	        );
1133	    } else {
1134	        frame.render_widget(
1135	            List::new(lines.into_iter().map(narrative_list_item)).block(
1136	                Block::default()
1137	                    .title(format!("plan narrative / {}", state.visual.label()))
1138	                    .borders(Borders::ALL),
1139	            ),
1140	            area,
1141	        );
1142	    }
1143	}

1145	pub(crate) fn plan_attach_footer(
1146	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1147	    plan: &Plan,
1148	    selected: usize,
1149	    show_hints: bool,
1150	    view: AttachViewMode,
1151	    visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
1152	) -> String {
1153	    let mut has_primary_footer_action = false;
1154	    let mut footer = if view.is_narrative() {
1155	        format!(
1156	            "n narrative/activity  v visual={}  r refresh  |  arrows/Tab child  Enter child run  q detach",
1157	            visual.label()
1158	        )
1159	    } else {
1160	        "q/Esc/Ctrl-D detach  |  arrows/Tab focus child  |  Enter child run  |  n narrative  b/Backspace back from child"
1161	            .to_string()
1162	    };
1163	    if let Some(task) = plan.tasks.get(selected) {
1164	        match task.child_run_id.as_deref() {
1165	            None => {
1166	                has_primary_footer_action = true;
1167	                let wait_hint = format!(
1168	                    "Enter waits for child run  |  next deadreckon fork {}",
1169	                    run_prefix(&plan.plan_id)
1170	                );
1171	                if view.is_narrative() {
1172	                    footer = format!("{footer}  |  {wait_hint}");
1173	                } else {
1174	                    footer =
1175	                        format!("q/Esc/Ctrl-D detach  |  arrows/Tab focus child  |  {wait_hint}");
1176	                }
1177	            }
1178	            Some(run_id) if load_run(paths, run_id).is_err() => {
1179	                has_primary_footer_action = true;
1180	                let unavailable_hint = "child detail unavailable  |  next deadreckon list --all";
1181	                if view.is_narrative() {
1182	                    footer = format!("{footer}  |  {unavailable_hint}");
1183	                } else {
1184	                    footer = format!(
1185	                        "q/Esc/Ctrl-D detach  |  arrows/Tab focus child  |  {unavailable_hint}"
1186	                    );
1187	                }
1188	            }
1189	            Some(_) => {}
1190	        }
1191	    }
1192	    if show_hints && !has_primary_footer_action {
1193	        footer.push_str("  |  merge after fork");
1194	    }
1195	    footer
1196	}

1198	fn plan_task_counts(plan: &Plan) -> (usize, usize) {
1199	    let completed = plan
1200	        .tasks
1201	        .iter()
1202	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1203	        .count();
1204	    let running = plan
1205	        .tasks
1206	        .iter()
1207	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Running)
1208	        .count();
1209	    (completed, running)
1210	}

1212	pub(crate) fn plan_provider_summary(plan: &Plan) -> String {
1213	    match plan.mode {
1214	        PlanMode::FullPlan => format!(
1215	            "planner {}  default child {}",
1216	            plan.providers.planner.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1217	            plan.providers.default_child.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
1218	        ),
1219	        PlanMode::Review => format!(
1220	            "coder {}  reviewer {}",
1221	            plan.providers.coder.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1222	            plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
1223	        ),
1224	    }
1225	}

1227	pub(crate) fn plan_repair_label(plan: &Plan, no_repair: bool) -> String {
1228	    if no_repair {
1229	        return "disabled (--no-repair)".to_string();
1230	    }
1231	    let provider = plan
1232	        .providers
1233	        .planner
1234	        .as_deref()
1235	        .or(plan.providers.default_child.as_deref())
1236	        .unwrap_or("config default");
1237	    format!("automatic via {provider}")
1238	}
1239	
1240	fn plan_task_pane_layout(
1241	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,
1242	    task_count: usize,
1243	) -> Vec<ratatui::layout::Rect> {
1244	    if task_count == 0 {
1245	        return Vec::new();
1246	    }
1247	    let rows = if task_count <= 3 { 1 } else { 2 };
1248	    let row_constraints =
1249	        std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, rows as u32), rows).collect::<Vec<_>>();
1250	    let row_chunks = Layout::default()
1251	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
1252	        .constraints(row_constraints)
1253	        .split(area);
1254	    let mut rects = Vec::new();
1255	    for row in 0..rows {
1256	        let remaining = task_count.saturating_sub(rects.len());
1257	        let columns = remaining.min(if rows == 1 { task_count } else { 3 }).max(1);
1258	        let col_constraints =
1259	            std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, columns as u32), columns).collect::<Vec<_>>();
1260	        let cols = Layout::default()
1261	            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
1262	            .constraints(col_constraints)
1263	            .split(row_chunks[row]);
1264	        for col in cols.iter().copied().take(remaining) {
1265	            rects.push(col);
1266	            if rects.len() == task_count {
1267	                break;
1268	            }
1269	        }
1270	    }
1271	    rects
1272	}
1273	
1274	fn plan_activity_lines(
1275	    plan_events: &[PlanEvent],
1276	    messages: &[PlanMessage],
1277	    feed_events: &[PlanFeedEvent],
1278	    max: usize,
1279	) -> Vec<ListItem<'static>> {
1280	    let mut lines = if !feed_events.is_empty() {
1281	        feed_events
1282	            .iter()
1283	            .rev()
1284	            .take(max.max(1))
1285	            .map(|event| ListItem::new(Line::from(plan_feed_event_line(event))))
1286	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1287	    } else if plan_events.is_empty() {
1288	        messages
1289	            .iter()
1290	            .rev()
1291	            .take(max.max(1))
1292	            .map(|message| {
1293	                ListItem::new(Line::from(format!(
1294	                    "{} -> {} {:?}: {}",
1295	                    message.from, message.to, message.kind, message.summary
1296	                )))
1297	            })
1298	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1299	    } else {
1300	        plan_events
1301	            .iter()
1302	            .rev()
1303	            .take(max.max(1))
1304	            .map(|event| ListItem::new(Line::from(plan_event_line(event))))
1305	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1306	    };
1307	    if lines.is_empty() {

1511	fn plan_child_accounting_lines(state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState) -> Vec<String> {
1512	    let spend = read_jsonl::<SpendRecord>(&state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl")).unwrap_or_default();
1513	    if spend.is_empty() {
1514	        if !provider_is_metered(state) && state.total_spend_usd == 0.0 {
1515	            return vec!["spend not metered (subscription)  context waiting".to_string()];
1516	        }
1517	        return vec![format!(
1518	            "spend ${:.6}  context waiting",
1519	            state.total_spend_usd
1520	        )];
1521	    }
1522	    let total_tokens = spend
1523	        .iter()
1524	        .map(|record| record.input_tokens + record.output_tokens)
1525	        .sum::<u64>();
1526	    let token_suffix = if total_tokens > 0 {
1527	        format!("  tokens {}", format_count(total_tokens))
1528	    } else {
1529	        String::new()
1530	    };
1531	    vec![format!(
1532	        "spend {}{}",
1533	        run_spend_label(state, false),
1534	        token_suffix
1535	    )]
1536	}
1537	
1538	fn latest_trace_line(state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState) -> Option<String> {

1541	        .into_iter()
1542	        .last()?;
1543	    Some(format!(
1544	        "latest turn {} {} {}",
1545	        trace.turn,
1546	        trace.event,
1547	        one_line(&trace.detail.to_string(), 80)

1558	pub(crate) fn markdown_to_tui_lines(markdown: &str) -> Vec<Line<'static>> {
1559	    let options = MarkdownOptions::ENABLE_TABLES
1560	        | MarkdownOptions::ENABLE_STRIKETHROUGH
1561	        | MarkdownOptions::ENABLE_TASKLISTS;
1562	    let parser = MarkdownParser::new_ext(markdown, options);
1563	    let mut lines = Vec::new();
1564	    let mut current = Vec::new();
1565	    let mut block: Option<MarkdownBlock> = None;
1566	    let mut inline_style = Style::default();
1567	    let mut code_block = false;
1568	
1569	    for event in parser {
1570	        match event {
1571	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::Heading { level, .. }) => {
1572	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1573	                block = Some(MarkdownBlock::Heading(level));
1574	            }
1575	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::Heading(_)) => {
1576	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1577	                lines.push(Line::raw(""));
1578	            }
1579	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::Paragraph) => {
1580	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1581	                block = Some(MarkdownBlock::Paragraph);
1582	            }
1583	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::Paragraph) => {
1584	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1585	                lines.push(Line::raw(""));
1586	            }
1587	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::Item) => {
1588	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1589	                current.push(Span::styled("  - ", Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)));
1590	                block = Some(MarkdownBlock::Item);
1591	            }
1592	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::Item) => {
1593	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1594	            }
1595	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::CodeBlock(kind)) => {
1596	                flush_markdown_line(&mut lines, &mut current, block.take());
1597	                let language = match kind {
1598	                    CodeBlockKind::Fenced(language) if !language.is_empty() => {
1599	                        format!(" {}", language)
1600	                    }
1601	                    _ => String::new(),
1602	                };
1603	                lines.push(Line::styled(
1604	                    format!("```{language}"),
1605	                    Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
1606	                ));
1607	                code_block = true;
1608	            }
1609	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::CodeBlock) => {
1610	                code_block = false;
1611	                lines.push(Line::styled("```", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));
1612	                lines.push(Line::raw(""));
1613	            }
1614	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::Strong) => {
1615	                inline_style = inline_style.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
1616	            }
1617	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::Strong) => {
1618	                inline_style = inline_style.remove_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
1619	            }
1620	            MarkdownEvent::Start(Tag::Emphasis) => {
1621	                inline_style = inline_style.add_modifier(Modifier::ITALIC);
1622	            }
1623	            MarkdownEvent::End(TagEnd::Emphasis) => {
1624	                inline_style = inline_style.remove_modifier(Modifier::ITALIC);
```

160	    pub(crate) fn scroll_focused(
161	        &mut self,
162	        delta: isize,
163	        counts: AttachPanelCounts,
164	        rows: AttachPanelRows,
165	    ) {
166	        let current = self.focused_scroll();
167	        let max = max_panel_scroll(self.focused_panel, counts, rows);
168	        let next = if delta.is_negative() {
169	            current.saturating_sub(delta.unsigned_abs())
170	        } else {
171	            current.saturating_add(delta as usize)
172	        };
173	        self.set_focused_scroll(next.min(max));
174	    }

252	                vec![
253	                    ("action".to_string(), self.action.label().to_string()),
254	                    ("result".to_string(), "failed".to_string()),
255	                ],
256	                vec![("Secondary", "retry the action after fixing the error")],
257	            )
258	        };
259	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
260	            kind,
261	            format!("{} action", self.action.label()),
262	            None,
263	            ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
264	            vec![("Recommended", "q detach")],
265	            secondary,
266	        )
267	        .expect("attach action notice must have one primary action")
268	        .render_plain(false)
269	        .lines()
270	        .map(ToString::to_string)
271	        .collect()
272	    }
273	}

289	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
290	pub(crate) struct AttachPanelLayout {
291	    pub(crate) header: ratatui::layout::Rect,
292	    pub(crate) activity: ratatui::layout::Rect,
293	    pub(crate) files: ratatui::layout::Rect,
294	    pub(crate) processes: ratatui::layout::Rect,
295	    pub(crate) footer: ratatui::layout::Rect,
296	    pub(crate) rows: AttachPanelRows,
297	}
298	
299	impl AttachPanelLayout {
300	    pub(crate) fn panel_at(&self, column: u16, row: u16) -> Option<AttachPanel> {
301	        if rect_contains(self.activity, column, row) {
302	            Some(AttachPanel::Activity)
303	        } else if rect_contains(self.files, column, row) {
304	            Some(AttachPanel::Files)
305	        } else if rect_contains(self.processes, column, row) {
306	            Some(AttachPanel::Processes)
307	        } else {
308	            None
309	        }
310	    }
311	}
312	
313	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_layout(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> AttachPanelLayout {
314	    let vertical = Layout::default()
315	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
316	        .constraints([
317	            Constraint::Length(5),
318	            Constraint::Min(10),
319	            Constraint::Length(4),
320	            Constraint::Length(2),
321	        ])
322	        .split(area);
323	    let center = Layout::default()
324	        .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
325	        .constraints([Constraint::Min(60), Constraint::Length(44)])
326	        .split(vertical[1]);
327	    AttachPanelLayout {
328	        header: vertical[0],
329	        activity: center[0],
330	        files: center[1],
331	        processes: vertical[2],
332	        footer: vertical[3],
333	        rows: AttachPanelRows {
334	            activity: panel_inner_rows(center[0]),
335	            files: panel_inner_rows(center[1]),
336	            processes: panel_inner_rows(vertical[2]),
337	        },
338	    }
339	}
340	
341	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_counts(
342	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
343	    spend: &[SpendRecord],
344	    traces: &[TraceRecord],
345	    events: &[RunEvent],
346	    live: &AttachLive,
347	    tui_state: &AttachTuiState,
348	) -> AttachPanelCounts {
349	    AttachPanelCounts {
350	        activity: if tui_state.docs_open && state.status == RunStatus::Completed {
351	            render_markdown_doc_lines(state).len()
352	        } else if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
353	            run_narrative_lines(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
354	        } else {
355	            attach_activity_lines_for_tui(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
356	        },
357	        files: live_file_lines(live).len(),
358	        processes: process_lines(live).len(),
359	    }
360	}
361	
362	fn panel_inner_rows(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> usize {
363	    area.height.saturating_sub(2) as usize
364	}
365	
366	fn rect_contains(rect: ratatui::layout::Rect, column: u16, row: u16) -> bool {
367	    column >= rect.x
368	        && column < rect.x.saturating_add(rect.width)
369	        && row >= rect.y
370	        && row < rect.y.saturating_add(rect.height)
371	}
372	
373	fn page_delta(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> isize {
374	    let rows = panel_rows(panel, rows).max(1);
375	    rows.saturating_sub(1).max(1) as isize
376	}
377	
378	pub(crate) fn max_panel_scroll(
379	    panel: AttachPanel,
380	    counts: AttachPanelCounts,
381	    rows: AttachPanelRows,
382	) -> usize {
383	    panel_count(panel, counts).saturating_sub(panel_rows(panel, rows))
384	}
385	
386	fn panel_count(panel: AttachPanel, counts: AttachPanelCounts) -> usize {
387	    match panel {
388	        AttachPanel::Activity => counts.activity,
389	        AttachPanel::Files => counts.files,
390	        AttachPanel::Processes => counts.processes,
391	    }
392	}
393	
394	fn panel_rows(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> usize {
395	    match panel {
396	        AttachPanel::Activity => rows.activity,
397	        AttachPanel::Files => rows.files,
398	        AttachPanel::Processes => rows.processes,
399	    }
400	}
401

414	    graph_labels: Vec<ProviderGraphLabel>,
415	}

418	struct ProviderGraphLabel {

420	    label: String,

423	pub(crate) fn ensure_run_projection(
424	    input: &RunNarrativeInput<'_>,
425	) -> crate::Result<NarrativeProjection> {
426	    let narrative_dir = input.state.run_root.join(NARRATIVE_DIR);
427	    let projection = build_run_projection(input);
428	    if let Some(current) = read_current_projection_if_covered(&projection, &narrative_dir) {
429	        persist_projection(&current, &narrative_dir)?;
430	        return Ok(current);
431	    }
432	    persist_projection(&projection, &narrative_dir)?;
433	    Ok(projection)
434	}

436	pub(crate) fn ensure_plan_projection(
437	    input: &PlanNarrativeInput<'_>,
438	) -> crate::Result<NarrativeProjection> {
439	    let plan_dir = input.paths.plan_dir(&input.plan.plan_id);
440	    let narrative_dir = plan_dir.join(NARRATIVE_DIR);
441	    let projection = build_plan_projection(input);
442	    if let Some(current) = read_current_projection_if_covered(&projection, &narrative_dir) {
443	        persist_projection(&current, &narrative_dir)?;
444	        return Ok(current);
445	    }
446	    persist_projection(&projection, &narrative_dir)?;
447	    Ok(projection)
448	}

468	pub(crate) fn build_run_projection(input: &RunNarrativeInput<'_>) -> NarrativeProjection {
469	    let state = input.state;
470	    let flight_events = read_flight_events(state).unwrap_or_default();
471	    let mut files = collect_run_files(input, &flight_events);
472	    files.sort();
473	    files.dedup();
474	    let checkpoints = flight_events
475	        .iter()
476	        .filter_map(|event| event.checkpoint_id.clone())
477	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
478	        .into_iter()
479	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
480	    let run_prefix = short_id(&state.run_id);
481	    let state_evidence = format!("file:{}", state.state_path().display());
482	    let acceptance_evidence =
483	        acceptance_artifact_for_run(state).map(|(kind, path)| (kind, file_evidence_id(&path)));
484	    let latest_run_event = input.events.last();
485	    let latest_trace = input.traces.last();
486	    let latest_flight = flight_events.last();
487	    let latest_run_event_id = latest_run_event
488	        .map(|_| format!("run:{run_prefix}:event:{}", input.events.len()))
489	        .unwrap_or_else(|| state_evidence.clone());
490	    let latest_trace_id = latest_trace
491	        .map(|trace| format!("trace:{run_prefix}:turn-{}:{}", trace.turn, trace.event))
492	        .unwrap_or_else(|| state_evidence.clone());
493	    let latest_flight_id = latest_flight
494	        .map(|event| format!("flight:{run_prefix}:seq:{}", event.seq))
495	        .unwrap_or_else(|| latest_run_event_id.clone());
496	    let provider = state.provider.clone();
497	    let status = run_status_label(state.status).to_string();
498	    let phase = state
499	        .active_phase()
500	        .map(|phase| phase.name.clone())
501	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "phase".to_string());
502	    let headline = match state.status {
503	        RunStatus::Executing => format!(
504	            "Run {} is executing {} with {}.",
505	            run_prefix,
506	            phase,
507	            provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("the configured provider")
508	        ),
509	        RunStatus::Completed => format!("Run {run_prefix} completed and is ready for inspection."),
510	        RunStatus::Failed => format!("Run {run_prefix} failed; inspect risks and evidence."),
511	        RunStatus::Killed => format!("Run {run_prefix} was killed; work state is preserved."),
512	        RunStatus::Pending | RunStatus::Planned => {
513	            format!("Run {run_prefix} is preparing to execute.")
514	        }
515	    };
516	    let mut run_state_evidence = vec![state_evidence.clone()];
517	    if let Some((_, evidence_id)) = acceptance_evidence.as_ref() {
518	        run_state_evidence.push(evidence_id.clone());
519	    }
520	    let mut current_work = vec![claim(
521	        format!(
522	            "[{}] turn {} in {} ({})",
523	            status, state.turn, phase, input.acceptance_summary
524	        ),
525	        run_state_evidence,
526	        "high",
527	    )];
528	    if let Some(event) = latest_run_event {
529	        current_work.push(claim(
530	            format!("Latest run event: {}.", run_event_summary(&event.event)),
531	            vec![latest_run_event_id.clone()],
532	            "high",
533	        ));
534	    }
535	    if let Some(trace) = latest_trace {
536	        current_work.push(claim(
537	            format!("Latest trace: turn {} {}.", trace.turn, trace.event),
538	            vec![latest_trace_id],
539	            "high",
540	        ));
541	    }
542	    if let Some(event) = latest_flight {
543	        current_work.push(claim(
544	            format!(
545	                "Latest provider-native event: {}.",
546	                one_line(&event.summary, 140)
547	            ),
548	            vec![latest_flight_id],
549	            "high",
550	        ));
551	    } else if !input.provider_activity.is_empty() {
552	        current_work.push(claim(
553	            format!(
554	                "Live provider activity is available but has not been converted into durable flight rows yet: {}.",
555	                one_line(input.provider_activity.last().unwrap_or(&String::new()), 140)
556	            ),
557	            vec![state_evidence.clone()],
558	            "medium",
559	        ));
560	    }
561	    current_work.push(claim(
562	        format!(
563	            "Working tree view sees {} file(s), {} bytes, latest file {}.",
564	            input.file_count,
565	            input.total_bytes,
566	            input
567	                .live_files
568	                .first()
569	                .map(|file| {
570	                    let age = file
571	                        .modified_at
572	                        .map(|modified| {
573	                            Utc::now()
574	                                .signed_duration_since(modified)
575	                                .num_seconds()
576	                                .max(0)
577	                        })
578	                        .map(|seconds| format!("{seconds}s ago"))
579	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown age".to_string());
580	                    format!("{} ({} bytes, {age})", file.path, file.bytes)
581	                })
582	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "none yet".to_string())
583	        ),
584	        vec![format!("file:{}", state.working_dir.display())],
585	        "medium",
586	    ));
587	    let mut architecture_notes = Vec::new();
588	    if files.is_empty() {
589	        architecture_notes.push(claim(
590	            "No changed-file evidence is visible yet, so the architecture map remains sparse."
591	                .to_string(),
592	            vec![state_evidence.clone()],
593	            "medium",
594	        ));
595	    } else {
596	        architecture_notes.push(claim(
597	            format!(
598	                "The visible work clusters around {}.",
599	                file_cluster_summary(&files)
600	            ),
601	            file_evidence(&files),
602	            "medium",
603	        ));
604	    }
605	    if let Some(parent) = input.parent_plan.as_ref() {
606	        architecture_notes.push(claim(
607	            format!(
608	                "This run is attached as {} in plan {}.",
609	                parent.task_id,
610	                short_id(&parent.plan_id)
611	            ),
612	            vec![format!(
613	                "plan:{}:task:{}",
614	                short_id(&parent.plan_id),
615	                parent.task_id
616	            )],
617	            "high",
618	        ));
619	    }
620	    let mut risks = Vec::new();
621	    match state.status {
622	        RunStatus::Failed => risks.push(claim(
623	            state
624	                .failure_reason
625	                .clone()
626	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "Run failed; no failure reason was recorded.".to_string()),
627	            vec![state_evidence.clone()],
628	            "high",
629	        )),
630	        RunStatus::Killed => risks.push(claim(
631	            "Run was killed before normal completion.".to_string(),
632	            vec![state_evidence.clone()],
633	            "high",
634	        )),
635	        _ => {}
636	    }
637	    if matches!(input.acceptance_summary.as_str(), s if s.contains("failed")) {
638	        risks.push(claim(
639	            format!(
640	                "Acceptance status needs attention: {}.",
641	                input.acceptance_summary
642	            ),
643	            acceptance_evidence
644	                .as_ref()
645	                .map(|(_, evidence_id)| vec![evidence_id.clone()])
646	                .unwrap_or_else(|| vec![state_evidence.clone()]),
647	            "high",
648	        ));
649	    }
650	    risks.push(claim(
651	        "Provider-backed narration has not run yet; deterministic fallback facts are shown."
652	            .to_string(),
653	        vec![state_evidence],
654	        "high",
655	    ));
656	    let next_likely = vec![claim(
657	        if state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
658	            "Watch for the provider turn to finish, then inspect acceptance and changed files."
659	                .to_string()
660	        } else {
661	            "Use activity, docs, show, or apply/abandon lifecycle actions for the next inspection step."
662	                .to_string()
663	        },
664	        vec![latest_run_event_id.clone()],
665	        "low",
666	    )];
667	    let citations = run_citations(state, input.events, input.traces, &flight_events, &files);
668	    let source_window = NarrativeSourceWindow {
669	        run_events: seq_window(input.events.len() as u64),
670	        traces: index_window(input.traces.len()),
671	        flight_events: flight_events.last().map(|event| SeqWindow {
672	            from_seq: flight_events
673	                .first()
674	                .map(|first| first.seq)
675	                .unwrap_or(event.seq),
676	            to_seq: event.seq,
677	        }),
678	        checkpoints: checkpoints.clone(),
679	        files: files.clone(),
680	        docs_hash: docs_hash(state),
681	        ..NarrativeSourceWindow::default()
682	    };
683	    let graph = build_run_graph(
684	        state,
685	        &source_window,
686	        &files,
687	        &flight_events,
688	        &latest_run_event_id,
689	    );
690	    debug_assert!(validate_graph(&graph));
691	    let graph_hash = graph_content_hash(&graph);
692	    let coverage = NarrativeCoverage {
693	        run_event_seq: Some(input.events.len() as u64),
694	        trace_count: Some(input.traces.len()),
695	        flight_event_seq: latest_flight.map(|event| event.seq),
696	        checkpoint_id: checkpoints.last().cloned(),
697	        doc_inputs_hash: source_window.docs_hash.clone(),
698	        architecture_graph_hash: Some(graph_hash.clone()),
699	        ..NarrativeCoverage::default()
700	    };
701	    let snapshot_id = snapshot_id(&(
702	        NarrativeScope::Run,
703	        &state.run_id,
704	        &headline,
705	        &current_work,
706	        &architecture_notes,
707	        &risks,
708	        &next_likely,
709	        &graph_hash,
710	    ));
711	    let created_at = Utc::now();
712	    let snapshot = NarrativeSnapshot {
713	        version: 1,
714	        snapshot_id: snapshot_id.clone(),
715	        scope: NarrativeScope::Run,
716	        target_id: state.run_id.clone(),
717	        created_at,
718	        status: NarrativeStatus::Deterministic,
719	        source_window,
720	        coverage: NarrativeSnapshotCoverage::default(),
721	        headline,
722	        current_work,
723	        architecture_notes,
724	        risks,
725	        next_likely,
726	        citations,
727	        plan_status: None,
728	        agent_table: Vec::new(),
729	        coordination_notes: Vec::new(),
730	    };
731	    let narrative_state = NarrativeState {
732	        version: 1,
733	        scope: NarrativeScope::Run,
734	        target_id: state.run_id.clone(),
735	        latest_snapshot_id: snapshot_id,
736	        latest_status: NarrativeStatus::Deterministic,
737	        latest_created_at: Some(created_at),
738	        latest_covered: coverage,
739	        cadence: NarrativeCadence::default(),
740	        provider: NarrativeProviderState {
741	            route: provider,
742	            source: "deterministic".to_string(),
743	            model: None,
744	            calls: 0,
745	            cost_usd: input.spend.iter().map(|record| record.cost_usd).sum(),
746	            subscription_seconds: input
747	                .spend
748	                .iter()
749	                .filter_map(|record| record.wall_time_seconds)
750	                .sum(),
751	        },
752	        last_error: None,
753	    };
754	    NarrativeProjection {
755	        state: narrative_state,
756	        snapshot,
757	        graph,
758	    }
759	}

761	pub(crate) fn build_plan_projection(input: &PlanNarrativeInput<'_>) -> NarrativeProjection {
762	    let plan = input.plan;
763	    let plan_prefix = short_id(&plan.plan_id);
764	    let plan_evidence = format!(
765	        "file:{}",
766	        input
767	            .paths
768	            .plan_dir(&plan.plan_id)
769	            .join("plan.json")
770	            .display()
771	    );
772	    let latest_plan_event_id = input
773	        .plan_events
774	        .last()
775	        .map(|_| format!("plan:{plan_prefix}:event:{}", input.plan_events.len()))
776	        .unwrap_or_else(|| plan_evidence.clone());
777	    let completed = plan
778	        .tasks
779	        .iter()
780	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
781	        .count();
782	    let running = plan
783	        .tasks
784	        .iter()
785	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Running)
786	        .count();
787	    let failed = plan
788	        .tasks
789	        .iter()
790	        .filter(|task| matches!(task.status, PlanTaskStatus::Failed | PlanTaskStatus::Killed))
791	        .count();
792	    let headline = format!(
793	        "Plan {} is {} with {completed} done, {running} running, and {failed} blocked or failed.",
794	        plan_prefix,
795	        plan_status_label(plan.status)
796	    );
797	    let mut current_work = vec![claim(
798	        format!(
799	            "The plan is coordinating {} task(s) in {} mode.",
800	            plan.tasks.len(),
801	            plan.mode.as_str()
802	        ),
803	        vec![plan_evidence.clone()],
804	        "high",
805	    )];
806	    if let Some(event) = input.plan_events.last() {
807	        current_work.push(claim(
808	            format!(
809	                "Latest plan event: {}.",
810	                plan_event_summary_for_narrative(&event.event)
811	            ),
812	            vec![latest_plan_event_id.clone()],
813	            "high",
814	        ));
815	    }
816	    let selected_summary = plan
817	        .tasks
818	        .get(input.selected)
819	        .map(|task| {
820	            format!(
821	                "Selected child {} is {} and {}.",
822	                task.task_id,
823	                plan_task_status_label(task.status),
824	                task.child_run_id
825	                    .as_deref()
826	                    .map(|run_id| format!("maps to run {}", short_id(run_id)))
827	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "has no run yet".to_string())
828	            )
829	        })
830	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "No selected child is available.".to_string());
831	    current_work.push(claim(
832	        selected_summary,
833	        vec![latest_plan_event_id.clone()],
834	        "high",
835	    ));
836	    let agent_table = plan
837	        .tasks
838	        .iter()
839	        .map(|task| NarrativeAgentRow {
840	            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
841	            role: format!("{:?}", task.role).to_ascii_lowercase(),
842	            provider: task.provider.clone(),
843	            status: plan_task_status_label(task.status).to_string(),
844	            summary: task_summary(input.paths, task),
845	            evidence: task_evidence(input.paths, task),
846	        })
847	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
848	    let mut coordination_notes = Vec::new();
849	    let dep_notes = plan
850	        .tasks
851	        .iter()
852	        .filter(|task| !task.depends_on.is_empty())
853	        .map(|task| format!("{} waits on {}", task.task_id, task.depends_on.join(",")))
854	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
855	    if dep_notes.is_empty() {
856	        coordination_notes.push(claim(
857	            "No explicit task dependencies are blocking ready work.".to_string(),
858	            vec![plan_evidence.clone()],
859	            "medium",
860	        ));
861	    } else {
862	        coordination_notes.push(claim(
863	            dep_notes.join("; "),
864	            dep_notes
865	                .iter()
866	                .filter_map(|note| note.split_whitespace().next())
867	                .map(|task_id| format!("task:{task_id}:deps"))
868	                .collect(),
869	            "high",
870	        ));
871	    }
872	    let architecture_notes = vec![claim(
873	        "The visual map is derived from task roles, dependencies, provider routes, child runs, and repair/final-gate evidence."
874	            .to_string(),
875	        vec![plan_evidence.clone()],
876	        "high",
877	    )];
878	    let mut risks = Vec::new();
879	    for message in input
880	        .messages
881	        .iter()
882	        .rev()
883	        .filter(|message| message.kind == PlanMessageKind::Blocker)
884	        .take(3)
885	    {
886	        risks.push(claim(
887	            format!("Coordinator blocker: {}.", message.summary),
888	            vec![format!(
889	                "plan-message:{}:{}",
890	                plan_prefix,
891	                message.ts.timestamp()
892	            )],
893	            "high",
894	        ));
895	    }
896	    if failed > 0 {
897	        risks.push(claim(
898	            format!("{failed} child task(s) are failed or killed."),
899	            vec![latest_plan_event_id.clone()],
900	            "high",
901	        ));
902	    }
903	    risks.push(claim(
904	        "Provider-backed narration has not run yet; deterministic fallback facts are shown."
905	            .to_string(),
906	        vec![plan_evidence],
907	        "high",
908	    ));
909	    let next_likely = vec![claim(
910	        if plan.status == PlanStatus::Forked {
911	            "Expect running children to finish before merge/final gate work continues.".to_string()
912	        } else {
913	            "Use Enter on a child run for detail or inspect the plan feed for coordination events."
914	                .to_string()
915	        },
916	        vec![latest_plan_event_id],
917	        "low",
918	    )];
919	    let child_runs = child_coverage(input.paths, plan);
920	    let coverage = NarrativeCoverage {
921	        plan_event_seq: Some(input.plan_events.len() as u64),
922	        child_runs,
923	        repair_run_id: repair_run_id_from_feed(input.feed_events),
924	        ..NarrativeCoverage::default()
925	    };
926	    let mut source_files = plan
927	        .tasks
928	        .iter()
929	        .filter_map(|task| task.summary_path.as_ref())
930	        .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
931	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
932	    source_files.extend(plan_child_graph_files(input.paths, plan));
933	    source_files.sort();
934	    source_files.dedup();
935	    let source_window = NarrativeSourceWindow {
936	        plan_events: seq_window(input.plan_events.len() as u64),
937	        files: source_files,
938	        ..NarrativeSourceWindow::default()
939	    };
940	    let graph = build_plan_graph(input.paths, plan, &source_window);
941	    debug_assert!(validate_graph(&graph));
942	    let graph_hash = graph_content_hash(&graph);
943	    let snapshot_id = snapshot_id(&(
944	        NarrativeScope::Plan,
945	        &plan.plan_id,
946	        &headline,
947	        &current_work,
948	        &architecture_notes,
949	        &risks,
950	        &next_likely,
951	        &graph_hash,
952	    ));
953	    let created_at = Utc::now();
954	    let snapshot = NarrativeSnapshot {
955	        version: 1,
956	        snapshot_id: snapshot_id.clone(),
957	        scope: NarrativeScope::Plan,
958	        target_id: plan.plan_id.clone(),
959	        created_at,
960	        status: NarrativeStatus::Deterministic,
961	        source_window,
962	        coverage: NarrativeSnapshotCoverage::default(),
963	        headline,
964	        current_work,
965	        architecture_notes,
966	        risks,
967	        next_likely,
968	        citations: plan_citations(input.paths, plan, input.plan_events),
969	        plan_status: Some(plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string()),
970	        agent_table,
971	        coordination_notes,
972	    };
973	    let mut latest_covered = coverage;
974	    latest_covered.architecture_graph_hash = Some(graph_hash);
975	    let narrative_state = NarrativeState {
976	        version: 1,
977	        scope: NarrativeScope::Plan,
978	        target_id: plan.plan_id.clone(),
979	        latest_snapshot_id: snapshot_id,
980	        latest_status: NarrativeStatus::Deterministic,
981	        latest_created_at: Some(created_at),
982	        latest_covered,
983	        cadence: NarrativeCadence::default(),
984	        provider: NarrativeProviderState {
985	            route: plan
986	                .providers
987	                .planner
988	                .clone()
989	                .or_else(|| plan.providers.default_child.clone())
990	                .or_else(|| plan.providers.coder.clone()),
991	            source: "deterministic".to_string(),
992	            model: None,
993	            calls: 0,
994	            cost_usd: 0.0,
995	            subscription_seconds: 0.0,
996	        },
997	        last_error: None,
998	    };
999	    NarrativeProjection {
1000	        state: narrative_state,
1001	        snapshot,
1002	        graph,
1003	    }
1004	}

1006	pub(crate) fn narrative_plain_lines(
1007	    projection: &NarrativeProjection,
1008	    visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
1009	) -> Vec<String> {
1010	    let snapshot = &projection.snapshot;
1011	    let mut lines = vec![
1012	        format!(
1013	            "Narrated {}  status {:?}  visual {}",
1014	            snapshot.snapshot_id,
1015	            projection.state.latest_status,
1016	            visual.label()
1017	        ),
1018	        format!(
1019	            "freshness: {} via {}  covered: {}{}",
1020	            narrative_status_label(&projection.state.latest_status),
1021	            projection.state.provider.source,
1022	            coverage_label(&projection.state.latest_covered),
1023	            projection
1024	                .state
1025	                .last_error
1026	                .as_ref()
1027	                .map(|error| format!("  error: {}", one_line(error, 120)))
1028	                .unwrap_or_default()
1029	        ),
1030	        String::new(),

1112	pub(crate) fn redact_for_provider(raw: &str) -> NarrativeRedactionReport {
1113	    let mut findings = Vec::new();
1114	    let mut text = strip_terminal_controls(raw, &mut findings);
1115	    let rules = [
1116	        (
1117	            r#"(?i)(authorization|cookie|password|passwd|api[_-]?key|secret|token|access[_-]?token)\s*[:=]\s*['"]?[^'"\s,;]+"#,
1118	            "<redacted-secret>",
1119	            "secret-like assignment redacted",
1120	        ),
1121	        (
1122	            r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----",
1123	            "<redacted-private-key>",
1124	            "private key block redacted",
1125	        ),
1126	        (
1127	            r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{12,}\b",
1128	            "<redacted-github-token>",
1129	            "github token redacted",
1130	        ),
1131	        (
1132	            r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}\b",
1133	            "<redacted-api-token>",
1134	            "api token redacted",
1135	        ),
1136	        (
1137	            r"(?i)\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b",
1138	            "<redacted-email>",
1139	            "email redacted",
1140	        ),
1141	    ];
1142	    for (pattern, replacement, finding) in rules {
1143	        let Ok(regex) = Regex::new(pattern) else {
1144	            continue;
1145	        };
1146	        if regex.is_match(&text) {
1147	            text = regex.replace_all(&text, replacement).to_string();
1148	            findings.push(finding.to_string());
1149	        }
1150	    }
1151	    findings.sort();
1152	    findings.dedup();
1153	    NarrativeRedactionReport { text, findings }
1154	}

1196	pub(crate) fn provider_refresh_decision(
1197	    state: &NarrativeState,
1198	    policy: &NarrativeRefreshPolicy,
1199	) -> NarrativeRefreshDecision {
1200	    if policy.provider_route.as_deref().is_none_or(str::is_empty) {
1201	        return NarrativeRefreshDecision::NoProvider;
1202	    }
1203	    if state.provider.calls >= state.cadence.max_provider_calls_per_attach {
1204	        return NarrativeRefreshDecision::CallLimitReached;
1205	    }
1206	    if let Some(max_spend) = policy.max_spend_usd
1207	        && state.provider.cost_usd >= max_spend
1208	    {
1209	        return NarrativeRefreshDecision::OverBudget;
1210	    }
1211	    if state.provider.calls > 0
1212	        && !policy.manual
1213	        && !policy.meaningful_delta
1214	        && let Some(last) = state.latest_created_at
1215	    {
1216	        let elapsed = (policy.now - last).num_seconds().max(0) as u64;
1217	        if elapsed < state.cadence.min_seconds_between_provider_calls {
1218	            return NarrativeRefreshDecision::TooSoon;
1219	        }
1220	    }
1221	    NarrativeRefreshDecision::Eligible
1222	}

1224	pub(crate) fn apply_provider_response(
1225	    projection: &NarrativeProjection,
1226	    raw_content: &str,
1227	    provider: NarrativeProviderRefresh,
1228	) -> crate::Result<NarrativeProjection> {
1229	    let redacted_output = redact_for_provider(raw_content);
1230	    if !redacted_output.findings.is_empty() {
1231	        return Err(crate::CliError::Exit {
1232	            code: 1,
1233	            message: "narrative provider output contained sensitive or unsafe text".to_string(),
1234	            hint: "inspect provider output and rely on deterministic narrative fallback"
1235	                .to_string(),
1236	        });
1237	    }
1238	    let output = parse_provider_narrative_output(raw_content)?;
1239	    let allowed_evidence = evidence_ids_for_projection(projection);
1240	    validate_provider_claims(&output, &allowed_evidence)?;
1241	    let allowed_graph_ids = graph_ids_for_projection(projection);
1242	    validate_provider_graph_labels(&output.graph_labels, &allowed_graph_ids)?;
1243	
1244	    let mut next = projection.clone();
1245	    if let Some(headline) = non_empty_redacted_line(output.headline.as_deref()) {
1246	        next.snapshot.headline = headline;
1247	    }
1248	    if !output.current_work.is_empty() {
1249	        next.snapshot.current_work = output.current_work;
1250	    }
1251	    if !output.architecture_notes.is_empty() {
1252	        next.snapshot.architecture_notes = output.architecture_notes;
1253	    }
1254	    if !output.risks.is_empty() {
1255	        next.snapshot.risks = output.risks;
1256	    }
1257	    if !output.next_likely.is_empty() {
1258	        next.snapshot.next_likely = output.next_likely;
1259	    }
1260	    apply_graph_label_suggestions(&mut next.graph, &output.graph_labels);
1261	    let graph_hash = graph_content_hash(&next.graph);
1262	    next.state.latest_covered.architecture_graph_hash = Some(graph_hash.clone());
1263	    next.snapshot.source_window = next.graph.source_window.clone();
1264	    next.snapshot.status = NarrativeStatus::Fresh;
1265	    next.state.latest_status = NarrativeStatus::Fresh;
1266	    let created_at = Utc::now();
1267	    next.snapshot.created_at = created_at;
1268	    next.state.latest_created_at = Some(created_at);
1269	    next.state.provider.route = Some(provider.route);
1270	    next.state.provider.model = Some(provider.model);

1272	    next.state.provider.calls = next.state.provider.calls.saturating_add(1);
1273	    next.state.provider.cost_usd += provider.cost_usd;
1274	    next.state.provider.subscription_seconds += provider.subscription_seconds.unwrap_or_default();

1279	        &next.snapshot.headline,

1282	        &next.snapshot.risks,
1283	        &next.snapshot.next_likely,
1284	        &graph_hash,
1285	        &next.state.provider.route,
1286	        next.state.provider.calls,
1287	    ));
1288	    next.snapshot.snapshot_id = snapshot_id.clone();
1289	    next.state.latest_snapshot_id = snapshot_id;

1337	fn read_current_projection_if_covered(
1338	    candidate: &NarrativeProjection,
1339	    narrative_dir: &Path,
1340	) -> Option<NarrativeProjection> {
1341	    let state = read_json::<NarrativeState>(&narrative_dir.join(NARRATIVE_STATE_JSON))?;

1350	                state,

1352	                graph: read_json::<ArchitectureGraph>(&narrative_dir.join(ARCHITECTURE_GRAPH_JSON))
1353	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| candidate.graph.clone()),
1354	            },
1355	        );
1356	    }
1357	    let graph = read_json::<ArchitectureGraph>(&narrative_dir.join(ARCHITECTURE_GRAPH_JSON))
1358	        .unwrap_or_else(|| candidate.graph.clone());

1360	        state,

1362	        graph,
1363	    })
