1366	fn provider_projection_for_newer_coverage(
1367	    candidate: &NarrativeProjection,
1368	    current: NarrativeProjection,
1369	) -> Option<NarrativeProjection> {
1370	    if current.state.provider.source != "provider"
1371	        || !matches!(
1372	            current.state.latest_status,
1373	            NarrativeStatus::Fresh | NarrativeStatus::Stale
1374	        )
1375	    {
1376	        return None;
1377	    }
1378	
1379	    let mut next = current;
1380	    next.state.latest_status = NarrativeStatus::Stale;
1381	    next.state.latest_covered = candidate.state.latest_covered.clone();
1382	    next.graph = candidate.graph.clone();
1383	    if next.snapshot.snapshot_id != next.state.latest_snapshot_id {
1384	        return None;
1385	    }
1386	    Some(next)
1387	}

1397	fn strip_terminal_controls(raw: &str, findings: &mut Vec<String>) -> String {
1398	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len());
1399	    let mut chars = raw.chars().peekable();
1400	    let mut stripped = false;
1401	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
1402	        if ch == '\u{1b}' {
1403	            stripped = true;
1404	            if matches!(chars.peek(), Some('[')) {
1405	                chars.next();
1406	                for next in chars.by_ref() {
1407	                    if ('@'..='~').contains(&next) {
1408	                        break;
1409	                    }
1410	                }
1411	            }
1412	            continue;
1413	        }
1414	        if ch.is_control() && !matches!(ch, '\n' | '\r' | '\t') {
1415	            stripped = true;
1416	            continue;
1417	        }
1418	        out.push(ch);
1419	    }
1420	    if stripped {
1421	        findings.push("terminal control sequence redacted".to_string());
1422	    }
1423	    out
1424	}

1426	fn parse_provider_narrative_output(raw_content: &str) -> crate::Result<ProviderNarrativeOutput> {
1427	    let mut last_error = None;
1428	    for candidate in provider_json_candidates(raw_content) {
1429	        match serde_json::from_str::<ProviderNarrativeOutput>(&candidate) {
1430	            Ok(output) if provider_output_has_narrative_fields(&output) => return Ok(output),
1431	            Ok(_) => {
1432	                last_error = Some(
1433	                    "provider JSON did not include headline, claim sections, or graph labels"
1434	                        .to_string(),
1435	                );
1436	            }
1437	            Err(err) => last_error = Some(err.to_string()),
1438	        }
1439	    }
1440	    Err(crate::CliError::Exit {
1441	        code: 1,
1442	        message: format!(
1443	            "narrative provider returned invalid JSON: {}",
1444	            last_error.unwrap_or_else(|| "no JSON object found".to_string())
1445	        ),
1446	        hint: "press r later or use --no-narrative-provider for deterministic fallback".to_string(),
1447	    })
1448	}
1449	
1450	fn provider_json_candidates(raw_content: &str) -> Vec<String> {
1451	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
1452	    push_unique_candidate(&mut candidates, raw_content.trim());
1453	    for candidate in fenced_json_candidates(raw_content) {
1454	        push_unique_candidate(&mut candidates, candidate.trim());
1455	    }
1456	    if let Some(candidate) = embedded_json_candidate(raw_content) {
1457	        push_unique_candidate(&mut candidates, candidate.trim());
1458	    }
1459	    candidates
1460	}
1461	
1462	fn fenced_json_candidates(raw_content: &str) -> Vec<String> {
1463	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
1464	    let mut in_fence = false;
1465	    let mut current = Vec::new();
1466	    for line in raw_content.lines() {
1467	        if line.trim_start().starts_with("```") {
1468	            if in_fence {
1469	                candidates.push(current.join("\n"));
1470	                current.clear();
1471	                in_fence = false;
1472	            } else {
1473	                in_fence = true;
1474	            }
1475	            continue;
1476	        }
1477	        if in_fence {
1478	            current.push(line);
1479	        }
1480	    }
1481	    candidates
1482	}
1483	
1484	fn embedded_json_candidate(raw_content: &str) -> Option<String> {
1485	    for (index, ch) in raw_content.char_indices() {
1486	        if ch != '{' {
1487	            continue;
1488	        }
1489	        let mut deserializer = serde_json::Deserializer::from_str(&raw_content[index..]);
1490	        if let Ok(value) = Value::deserialize(&mut deserializer)
1491	            && value.is_object()
1492	            && let Ok(candidate) = serde_json::to_string(&value)
1493	        {
1494	            return Some(candidate);
1495	        }
1496	    }
1497	    None
1498	}
1499	
1500	fn push_unique_candidate(candidates: &mut Vec<String>, candidate: &str) {
1501	    if candidate.is_empty() {
1502	        return;
1503	    }
1504	    if !candidates.iter().any(|existing| existing == candidate) {
1505	        candidates.push(candidate.to_string());
1506	    }
1507	}
1508	
1509	fn provider_output_has_narrative_fields(output: &ProviderNarrativeOutput) -> bool {
1510	    output
1511	        .headline
1512	        .as_deref()
1513	        .is_some_and(|headline| !headline.trim().is_empty())
1514	        || !output.current_work.is_empty()
1515	        || !output.architecture_notes.is_empty()
1516	        || !output.risks.is_empty()
1517	        || !output.next_likely.is_empty()
1518	        || !output.graph_labels.is_empty()
1519	}

24	impl TuiEventFeed {
25	    #[cfg(test)]
26	    pub(crate) fn from_broadcast(
27	        receiver: broadcast::Receiver<RunEvent>,
28	        replay_path: impl Into<PathBuf>,
29	    ) -> Self {
30	        Self {
31	            source: TuiEventSource::Broadcast {
32	                receiver,
33	                replay: JsonlTail::new(replay_path.into()),
34	            },
35	            seen: BTreeSet::new(),
36	        }

39	    pub(crate) fn file_tail(path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
40	        Self {
41	            source: TuiEventSource::FileTail(JsonlTail::new(path.into())),
42	            seen: BTreeSet::new(),
43	        }
44	    }

46	    pub(crate) async fn refresh(&mut self, wait: Duration) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
47	        let mut events = Vec::new();
48	        match &mut self.source {
49	            TuiEventSource::Broadcast { receiver, replay } => {
50	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
51	                if events.is_empty() && !wait.is_zero() {
52	                    match tokio::time::timeout(wait, receiver.recv()).await {
53	                        Ok(Ok(event)) => events.push(event),
54	                        Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)))
55	                        | Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed)) => {
56	                            events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
57	                        }
58	                        Err(_) => {}
59	                    }
60	                }
61	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
62	                if events.is_empty() {
63	                    events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
64	                } else {
65	                    replay.skip_to_end();
66	                }
67	            }
68	            TuiEventSource::FileTail(replay) => {
69	                events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
70	            }
71	        }
72	        Ok(self.dedupe(events))
73	    }
74	
75	    #[cfg(test)]
76	    fn is_broadcast(&self) -> bool {
77	        matches!(self.source, TuiEventSource::Broadcast { .. })
78	    }
79	}

81	fn drain_receiver(receiver: &mut broadcast::Receiver<RunEvent>, events: &mut Vec<RunEvent>) {
82	    loop {
83	        match receiver.try_recv() {
84	            Ok(event) => events.push(event),
85	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Lagged(_)) => continue,
86	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Empty)
87	            | Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Closed) => break,
88	        }
89	    }
90	}

92	impl TuiEventFeed {
93	    fn dedupe(&mut self, events: Vec<RunEvent>) -> Vec<RunEvent> {
94	        events
95	            .into_iter()
96	            .filter(|event| {
97	                let key = serde_json::to_string(event).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
98	                    format!("{}:{}", event.timestamp.to_rfc3339(), event.run_id)
99	                });
100	                self.seen.insert(key)
101	            })
102	            .collect()
103	    }
104	}
105	
106	struct JsonlTail {
107	    path: PathBuf,
108	    offset: u64,
109	    partial: String,
110	}
111	
112	impl JsonlTail {
113	    fn new(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
114	        Self {
115	            path,
116	            offset: 0,
117	            partial: String::new(),
118	        }
119	    }
120	
121	    fn read_new(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
122	        let Some(mut file) = self.open_at_offset()? else {
123	            return Ok(Vec::new());
124	        };
125	        let mut raw = String::new();
126	        file.read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
127	        self.offset = file.stream_position()?;
128	        if raw.is_empty() {
129	            return Ok(Vec::new());
130	        }
131	        let mut buffer = String::new();
132	        std::mem::swap(&mut buffer, &mut self.partial);
133	        buffer.push_str(&raw);
134	        let complete = buffer.ends_with('\n');
135	        let mut lines = buffer.lines().map(str::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>();
136	        if !complete {
137	            self.partial = lines.pop().unwrap_or_default();
138	        }
139	        Ok(lines
140	            .into_iter()
141	            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
142	            .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<RunEvent>(&line).ok())
143	            .collect())
144	    }
145	
146	    fn skip_to_end(&mut self) {
147	        self.offset = fs::metadata(&self.path)
148	            .map(|metadata| metadata.len())
149	            .unwrap_or(0);
150	        self.partial.clear();
151	    }
152	
153	    fn open_at_offset(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Option<fs::File>> {
154	        if !self.path.exists() {
155	            self.offset = 0;
156	            self.partial.clear();
157	            return Ok(None);
158	        }
159	        let metadata = fs::metadata(&self.path)?;
160	        if metadata.len() < self.offset {
161	            self.offset = 0;
162	            self.partial.clear();
163	        }
164	        let mut file = fs::File::open(&self.path)?;
165	        file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(self.offset))?;
166	        Ok(Some(file))
167	    }
168	}

90	fn init_completion_surface(
91	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
92	    provider: &str,
93	    sandbox: &str,
94	    completion_status: &str,
95	    doctor_summary: &super::doctor::DoctorSetupSummary,
96	) -> VerdictSurface {
97	    let (kind, why, primary, secondary) = if doctor_summary.has_blocking_issues() {
98	        (
99	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
100	            "Initialization wrote the config, but setup verification found blocking issues; run doctor before starting managed work.",
101	            "deadreckon doctor",
102	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon run \"describe the coding goal\"")],
103	        )
104	    } else {
105	        (
106	            VerdictKind::Completed,
107	            "Initialization completed; the next step is to start a managed run from this workspace.",
108	            "deadreckon run \"describe the coding goal\"",
109	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon doctor")],
110	        )
111	    };
112	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
113	        kind,
114	        "init",
115	        None,
116	        ExplanationPanel::new(
117	            "DeadReckon wrote the local configuration and checked the provider setup.",
118	            why,
119	            vec![
120	                ("config", paths.config_path().display().to_string()),
121	                ("provider", provider.to_string()),
122	                ("sandbox", sandbox.to_string()),
123	                ("doctor", doctor_summary.evidence_detail()),
124	                ("completion", completion_status.to_string()),
125	            ],
126	        ),
127	        vec![("Recommended", primary)],
128	        secondary,
129	    )
130	    .expect("init verdict surface must be valid")
131	}

133	fn preferred_init_subscription_cli_provider(registry: &ProviderRegistry) -> Option<String> {
134	    registry
135	        .iter()
136	        .filter(|descriptor| {
137	            descriptor.kind == DescriptorKind::Cli
138	                && descriptor.subscription
139	                && descriptor
140	                    .default_binary
141	                    .as_deref()
142	                    .is_some_and(command_exists)
143	        })
144	        .map(|descriptor| descriptor.id.clone())
145	        .next()
146	}

109	pub(crate) fn strip_ansi(text: &str) -> String {
110	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());
111	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
112	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
113	        if read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars).is_some() {
114	            continue;
115	        }
116	        out.push(ch);
117	    }
118	    out

121	#[allow(dead_code)]
122	pub(crate) fn read_ansi_sequence<I>(first: char, chars: &mut Peekable<I>) -> Option<(String, bool)>
123	where
124	    I: Iterator<Item = char>,
125	{
126	    if first != ANSI_ESC || chars.peek() != Some(&'[') {
127	        return None;
128	    }
129	    let mut sequence = String::from(first);
130	    if let Some(bracket) = chars.next() {
131	        sequence.push(bracket);
132	    }
133	    for code in chars.by_ref() {
134	        sequence.push(code);
135	        if code.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
136	            let active = sequence != ANSI_RESET;
137	            return Some((sequence, active));
138	        }
139	    }
140	    Some((sequence, false))
141	}

143	pub(crate) fn status_tone(status: impl AsRef<str>) -> Tone {
144	    let status = status.as_ref().trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
145	    if status.contains("failed")
146	        || status.contains("killed")
147	        || status.contains("error")
148	        || status.contains("missing")
149	        || status.contains("refused")
150	    {
151	        return Tone::Negative;
152	    }
153	    if status.contains("paused") {
154	        return Tone::Paused;
155	    }
156	    if status.contains("warning") || status.contains("warn") {
157	        return Tone::Warn;
158	    }
159	    match status.as_str() {
160	        "ok" | "ready" | "set" | "wrote" | "updated" | "installed" | "completed" | "passed"
161	        | "polished" | "applied" | "cleaned" | "exported" => Tone::Ok,
162	        "running" => Tone::Heading,
163	        "pending" | "planned" | "skipped" | "undone" | "recorded" | "note" => Tone::Note,
164	        _ => Tone::Note,
165	    }
166	}

267	fn current_terminal_width() -> usize {
268	    crossterm::terminal::size()
269	        .ok()
270	        .map(|(columns, _)| usize::from(columns))
271	        .or_else(|| {
272	            std::env::var("COLUMNS")
273	                .ok()
274	                .and_then(|columns| columns.parse::<usize>().ok())
275	        })
276	        .filter(|columns| *columns > 0)
277	        .unwrap_or(120)
278	}

280	fn replacement_line_text(text: &str, terminal_width: usize) -> String {
281	    let visible_limit = terminal_width.saturating_sub(1);
282	    truncate_visible_single_line(text, visible_limit)
283	}
284	
285	fn truncate_visible_single_line(text: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
286	    if max_visible == 0 {
287	        return String::new();
288	    }
289	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len().min(max_visible));
290	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
291	    let mut visible = 0usize;
292	    let mut style_active = false;
293	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
294	        if let Some((sequence, active)) = read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars) {
295	            style_active = active;
296	            out.push_str(&sequence);
297	            continue;
298	        }
299	        if visible >= max_visible {
300	            break;
301	        }
302	        match ch {
303	            '\n' | '\r' => out.push(' '),
304	            _ => out.push(ch),
305	        }
306	        visible += 1;
307	    }
308	    if style_active {
309	        out.push_str(ANSI_RESET);
310	    }
311	    out
312	}

78	pub fn render_card(card: &Card, opts: &CardOptions) -> String {
79	    let plain = opts.plain || opts.no_color_env;
80	    let color = opts.color && !plain && !opts.no_color_env;
81	    let mut lines = body_lines(card, plain, color);
82	    let terminal_width = opts.terminal_columns.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH);
83	    if terminal_width < NARROW_FALLBACK_WIDTH {
84	        return render_narrow(&lines, plain);
85	    }
86	
87	    let content_width = lines
88	        .iter()
89	        .map(|line| visible_length(line))
90	        .max()
91	        .unwrap_or(0);
92	    let desired_width = (content_width + 4).max(MIN_CARD_WIDTH);
93	    let card_width = desired_width.min(terminal_width.max(4));
94	    let inner_width = card_width.saturating_sub(4);
95	    let mut rendered = Vec::with_capacity(lines.len() + 2);
96	    rendered.push(border("top", card_width, plain, color));
97	    for line in lines.drain(..) {
98	        let content = truncate_visible_for_mode(&line, inner_width, plain);
99	        rendered.push(format!(
100	            "{}{}{}",
101	            style_border(if plain { "| " } else { "│ " }, color),
102	            pad_visible(&content, inner_width),
103	            style_border(if plain { " |" } else { " │" }, color)
104	        ));
105	    }
106	    rendered.push(border("bottom", card_width, plain, color));
107	    let mut text = rendered.join("\n");
108	    text.push('\n');
109	    text
110	}

293	fn truncate_visible_for_mode(text: &str, width: usize, plain: bool) -> String {
294	    if plain {
295	        truncate_visible_inner(&strip_ansi(text), width, "...")
296	    } else {
297	        truncate_visible(text, width)
298	    }
299	}
300	
301	fn truncate_visible_inner(text: &str, width: usize, ellipsis: &str) -> String {
302	    if visible_length(text) <= width {
303	        return text.to_string();
304	    }
305	    if width == 0 {
306	        return String::new();
307	    }
308	    let ellipsis_width = ellipsis.chars().count();
309	    if width <= ellipsis_width {
310	        return ellipsis.chars().take(width).collect();
311	    }
312	
313	    let target_width = width - ellipsis_width;
314	    let mut out = String::new();
315	    let mut visible = 0usize;
316	    let mut active_style = false;
317	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
318	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
319	        if let Some((sequence, active)) = crate::ui::read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars) {
320	            active_style = active;
321	            out.push_str(&sequence);
322	            continue;
323	        }
324	        if visible >= target_width {
325	            break;
326	        }
327	        out.push(ch);
328	        visible += 1;
329	    }
330	    out.push_str(ellipsis);
331	    if active_style {
332	        out.push_str(crate::ui::ansi_reset());
333	    }
334	    out
335	}
336

423	fn run_confirmation_refusal_error(goal: &str, run_id: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
424	    let primary = format!("deadreckon run {} --yes", run_goal_argument(goal));
425	    CliError::Surface {
426	        code: 1,
427	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
428	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
429	            "run",
430	            None,
431	            ExplanationPanel::new(
432	                "non-interactive without --yes",
433	                "DeadReckon printed the launch preview, then refused to create run state because this shell cannot answer the confirmation prompt.",
434	                [
435	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
436	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
437	                    ("preview run".to_string(), run_id.to_string()),
438	                ],
439	            ),
440	            [("Recommended", primary)],
441	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
442	        )
443	        .expect("run confirmation refusal verdict surface must be valid")
444	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
445	    }
446	}
447	
448	fn run_codebase_refusal_error(err: DeadreckonError, goal: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
449	    let DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message) = err else {
450	        return CliError::Core(err);
451	    };
452	    let Some((primary, why)) = run_codebase_refusal_primary(&message, goal) else {
453	        return CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message));
454	    };
455	    let first_reason_line = message.lines().next().unwrap_or(message.as_str());
456	    let evidence_reason = run_codebase_refusal_reason(&message);
457	    CliError::Surface {
458	        code: 1,
459	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
460	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
461	            "run",
462	            None,
463	            ExplanationPanel::new(
464	                first_reason_line.to_string(),
465	                why.to_string(),
466	                [
467	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
468	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
469	                    ("reason".to_string(), evidence_reason),
470	                ],
471	            ),
472	            [("Recommended", primary)],
473	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
474	        )
475	        .expect("run codebase refusal verdict surface must be valid")
476	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
477	    }
478	}
479	
480	fn run_codebase_refusal_primary(message: &str, goal: &str) -> Option<(String, &'static str)> {
481	    let quoted_goal = run_goal_argument(goal);
482	    if message.contains("working tree has uncommitted changes") {
483	        return Some((
484	            format!("git stash && deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --yes"),
485	            "DeadReckon refused to create a worktree from a dirty source because the run would not have a clean base to apply or clean up from.",
486	        ));
487	    }
488	    if message.contains("git repo has no commits") {
489	        return Some((
490	            "git commit -m initial".to_string(),
491	            "DeadReckon needs a committed Git base before it can create an isolated worktree branch.",
492	        ));
493	    }
494	    if message.contains("HEAD is detached") {
495	        return Some((
496	            "git switch -c <branch>".to_string(),
497	            "DeadReckon needs a named source branch so the run branch has an unambiguous base.",
498	        ));
499	    }
500	    if message.contains("git is in the middle of a merge") {
501	        return Some((
502	            "git merge --abort".to_string(),

513	        return Some((

515	            "DeadReckon refused to reuse an existing branch name because that would blur this run's provenance.",
516	        ));
517	    }
518	    if message.contains("non-interactive without a mode flag") {
519	        return Some((

521	            "DeadReckon cannot ask for a source-mode choice in non-interactive output, so one explicit source mode is required.",
522	        ));
523	    }
524	    if message.contains("--in-place requires --i-know-its-a-lot") {
525	        return Some((

527	            "In-place runs can mutate the current checkout, so DeadReckon requires the stronger acknowledgement before launching.",
528	        ));
529	    }

531	        return Some((
532	            "git init".to_string(),
533	            "Worktree mode requires a Git repository; initialize Git or choose an explicit copy/fresh source mode.",
534	        ));
535	    }
536	    None

547	        .collect::<Vec<_>>()

551	fn run_cancelled_before_turn_loop(
552	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
553	    state: &mut deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
554	) -> Result<bool> {
555	    if !cancel_marker_present(state) {
556	        return Ok(false);
557	    }
558	    if let Ok(latest) = load_run(paths, &state.run_id)
559	        && latest.status == RunStatus::Killed
560	    {
561	        *state = latest;
562	        return Ok(true);
563	    }
564	    state.status = RunStatus::Killed;
565	    state.failure_reason = Some("run cancelled before provider turn".to_string());
566	    state.killed_at = Some(Utc::now());
567	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
568	    save_state(state)?;
569	    emit_event(
570	        state,
571	        None,
572	        deadreckon_core::RunEventKind::RunCompleted {
573	            status: "killed".to_string(),
574	        },
575	    )?;
576	    Ok(true)
577	}

264	pub(crate) fn recommend_orchestration_mode(goal: &str) -> CliPlanMode {
265	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
266	    let broad_product = [
267	        "make a full",
268	        "build a full",
269	        "create a full",
270	        "fully",
271	        "from scratch",
272	        "app",
273	        "game",
274	        "site",
275	        "multiplayer",
276	        "realtime",
277	        "real-time",
278	        "live",
279	        "server",
280	        "client",
281	    ]
282	    .iter()
283	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
284	    let focused_change = [
285	        "fix ", "bug", "change ", "refactor", "review", "audit", "explain", "docs", "rename",
286	    ]
287	    .iter()
288	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
289	    if broad_product && !focused_change {
290	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan
291	    } else {
292	        CliPlanMode::Review
293	    }
294	}

296	fn orchestration_mode_recommendation_reason(goal: &str, mode: CliPlanMode) -> &'static str {
297	    match mode {
298	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => {
299	            if goal.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("multiplayer") {
300	                "goal looks like broad product work with separable implementation slices"
301	            } else {
302	                "goal looks broad enough to decompose before execution"
303	            }
304	        }
305	        CliPlanMode::Review => "goal looks focused enough for coder plus reviewer",
306	    }
307	}

309	pub(crate) fn recommend_child_count_for_goal(goal: &str, mode: CliPlanMode) -> u8 {
310	    if mode == CliPlanMode::Review {
311	        return 2;
312	    }
313	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
314	    let complexity = [
315	        "multiplayer",
316	        "realtime",
317	        "real-time",
318	        "live",
319	        "physics",
320	        "terrain",
321	        "server",
322	        "database",
323	        "auth",
324	        "deploy",
325	        "mobile",
326	        "game",
327	    ]
328	    .iter()
329	    .filter(|needle| lower.contains(*needle))
330	    .count();
331	    match complexity {
332	        0 | 1 => 3,
333	        2 | 3 => 4,
334	        _ => 5,
335	    }
336	}

338	fn prompt_orchestration_mode(default: CliPlanMode) -> Result<CliPlanMode> {
339	    let default_label = match default {
340	        CliPlanMode::Review => "review",
341	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => "full-plan",
342	    };
343	    let answer = prompt::open(&format!("mode [{default_label}]: "), None)?;
344	    match answer.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
345	        "" => Ok(default),
346	        "r" | "review" => Ok(CliPlanMode::Review),
347	        "f" | "full" | "full-plan" | "full_plan" | "plan" => Ok(CliPlanMode::FullPlan),
348	        other => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
349	            &format!("unknown orchestration mode {other}"),
350	            "choose review or full-plan",
351	        ))),
352	    }
353	}

**Crossterm Version Dependency:**

The dependency versions of crossterm crate differ between ratatui and tui-rs, and you must use the same version that matches the package you are using. This is important for ensuring compatibility.

**General Compatibility Guidance:**

You need to install crossterm or termion or termwiz to initialize your application and receive key inputs, and the dependency versions of these crates differ between ratatui and tui-rs, so you must use the same version that matches the package you are using.

111	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
112	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
113	        if read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars).is_some() {

115	        }
116	        out.push(ch);
117	    }

122	pub(crate) fn read_ansi_sequence<I>(first: char, chars: &mut Peekable<I>) -> Option<(String, bool)>
123	where
124	    I: Iterator<Item = char>,
125	{
126	    if first != ANSI_ESC || chars.peek() != Some(&'[') {
127	        return None;
128	    }
129	    let mut sequence = String::from(first);
130	    if let Some(bracket) = chars.next() {
131	        sequence.push(bracket);
132	    }
133	    for code in chars.by_ref() {
134	        sequence.push(code);
135	        if code.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
136	            let active = sequence != ANSI_RESET;
137	            return Some((sequence, active));
138	        }
139	    }
140	    Some((sequence, false))
141	}

145	    if status.contains("failed")
146	        || status.contains("killed")
147	        || status.contains("error")
148	        || status.contains("missing")
149	        || status.contains("refused")

156	    if status.contains("warning") || status.contains("warn") {
157	        return Tone::Warn;
158	    }
159	    match status.as_str() {
160	        "ok" | "ready" | "set" | "wrote" | "updated" | "installed" | "completed" | "passed"
161	        | "polished" | "applied" | "cleaned" | "exported" => Tone::Ok,
162	        "running" => Tone::Heading,
163	        "pending" | "planned" | "skipped" | "undone" | "recorded" | "note" => Tone::Note,
164	        _ => Tone::Note,
165	    }
166	}

280	fn replacement_line_text(text: &str, terminal_width: usize) -> String {
281	    let visible_limit = terminal_width.saturating_sub(1);
282	    truncate_visible_single_line(text, visible_limit)
283	}
284	
285	fn truncate_visible_single_line(text: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
286	    if max_visible == 0 {
287	        return String::new();
288	    }
289	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len().min(max_visible));
290	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
291	    let mut visible = 0usize;
292	    let mut style_active = false;
293	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
294	        if let Some((sequence, active)) = read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars) {
295	            style_active = active;
296	            out.push_str(&sequence);
297	            continue;
298	        }
299	        if visible >= max_visible {
300	            break;
301	        }
302	        match ch {
303	            '\n' | '\r' => out.push(' '),
304	            _ => out.push(ch),
305	        }
306	        visible += 1;
307	    }
308	    if style_active {
309	        out.push_str(ANSI_RESET);
310	    }
311	    out
312	}

316	        Tone::Plain => None,
317	        Tone::Heading => Some("1;36"),
318	        Tone::Muted => Some("2"),
319	        Tone::Id => Some("1;35"),
320	        Tone::Command => Some("1;34"),
321	        Tone::Ok => Some("1;32"),
322	        Tone::Warn => Some("1;33"),
323	        Tone::Paused => Some("1;33"),
324	        Tone::Note => Some("2"),
325	        Tone::Negative => Some("1;31"),
326	        Tone::Prompt => Some("1;36"),
327	        Tone::Hint => Some("1;34"),
328	    }
329	}

## throbber-widgets-tui

throbber-widgets-tui is a ratatui widget that displays throbber (also known as a loading indicator or spinner). If you want to use tui-rs instead of ratatui, you should use 0.4.1 or older version. The minimum Rust version (MSRV) required is rustc 1.86.0 or newer.

## tui-popup

The tui-popup widget is a simple widget that renders a popup in the center of the screen. The widget supports storing the position of the popup in PopupState.

## Ratatui 0.29

Ratatui 0.29.0 is a library for building terminal user interfaces. This version is used as a dependency in several widget crates, including tui-widgets.

All of these crates are available on crates.io as standalone Rust packages for building terminal user interfaces.

105	fn select_one_menu(prompt: &SelectPrompt) -> Result<SelectChoice> {
106	    println!("{}", prompt.title);
107	    if let Some(help) = prompt
108	        .help
109	        .as_deref()
110	        .filter(|help| !help.trim().is_empty())
111	    {
112	        println!("  {help}");
113	    }
114	    let mut selected = prompt
115	        .default_index
116	        .min(prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1));
117	    let _raw_mode = RawModeGuard::enable()?;
118	    render_select_menu(prompt, selected, false)?;
119	    loop {
120	        let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? else {
121	            continue;
122	        };
123	        if matches!(key.kind, KeyEventKind::Release) {
124	            continue;
125	        }
126	        match key.code {
127	            KeyCode::Char('c') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
128	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
129	                return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Interrupted, "prompt cancelled").into());
130	            }
131	            KeyCode::Enter => {
132	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
133	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
134	            }
135	            KeyCode::Char('j' | 'm') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
136	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
137	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
138	            }
139	            KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
140	                selected = selected.saturating_sub(1);
141	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
142	            }
143	            KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
144	                if selected + 1 < prompt.choices.len() {
145	                    selected += 1;
146	                }
147	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
148	            }
149	            KeyCode::Home => {
150	                selected = 0;
151	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
152	            }
153	            KeyCode::End => {
154	                selected = prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1);
155	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
156	            }
157	            KeyCode::Char(value) if key.modifiers.is_empty() && value.is_ascii_digit() => {
158	                if let Some(index) = select_index_from_digit(value, prompt.choices.len()) {
159	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
160	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
161	                }
162	            }
163	            KeyCode::Esc => {
164	                if let Some(index) = prompt
165	                    .choices
166	                    .iter()
167	                    .position(|choice| choice.id == "cancel")
168	                {
169	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
170	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
171	                }
172	            }
173	            _ => {}
174	        }
175	    }
176	}

185	        let ordinal = index + 1;

190	                format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {} - {detail}", choice.label)
191	            }
192	            _ => format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {}", choice.label),
193	        };
194	        write_select_menu_line(&mut stdout, &truncate_menu_line(&line, width))?;
195	    }
196	    execute!(stdout, Clear(ClearType::CurrentLine))?;

199	        .min(prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1))
200	        + 1;
201	    write!(stdout, "? choose [{default}]: arrows/Enter or number ")?;
202	    stdout.flush()?;
203	    Ok(())
204	}

224	fn truncate_menu_line(line: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
225	    let normalized = normalize_menu_line(line);
226	    if normalized.chars().count() <= max_visible {
227	        return normalized;
228	    }
229	    if max_visible == 0 {
230	        return String::new();
231	    }
232	    if max_visible <= 3 {
233	        return normalized.chars().take(max_visible).collect();
234	    }
235	    let keep = max_visible.saturating_sub(3);
236	    let mut out = normalized.chars().take(keep).collect::<String>();
237	    out.push_str("...");
238	    out

241	fn normalize_menu_line(line: &str) -> String {
242	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
243	    let mut previous_was_space = false;
244	    for ch in line.chars() {
245	        if ch.is_whitespace() {
246	            if !previous_was_space {
247	                out.push(' ');
248	                previous_was_space = true;
249	            }
250	        } else {
251	            out.push(ch);
252	            previous_was_space = false;
253	        }
254	    }
255	    out.trim_end().to_string()
256	}

288	pub(crate) fn confirm(question: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Result<bool> {
289	    let marker = if default_yes { "[Y/n]" } else { "[y/N]" };
290	    loop {
291	        let answer = open(&format!("{question} {marker}: "), None)?;
292	        if let Some(value) = parse_confirm_answer(&answer, default_yes) {

299	fn parse_select_answer(answer: &str, default: usize, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
300	    if len == 0 {
301	        return None;
302	    }
303	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
304	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
305	        return Some(default.saturating_sub(1).min(len - 1));
306	    }
307	    let value = trimmed.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
308	    if (1..=len).contains(&value) {
309	        Some(value - 1)
310	    } else {
311	        None
312	    }
313	}

315	fn parse_confirm_answer(answer: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Option<bool> {
316	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
317	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
318	        return Some(default_yes);
319	    }
320	    match trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
321	        "y" | "yes" => Some(true),
322	        "n" | "no" => Some(false),
323	        _ => None,
324	    }

Based on the web search results, here's what I found about the comfy-table Rust crate:

## Unicode Width and Recent Updates

The comfy-table project introduced the unicode-segmentation library to improve UTF-8 handling. Recent changes include handling UTF-8 graphemes when truncating cells and respecting UTF-8 zero-width joiner and variation selection characters when splitting words.

The library also fixed string width calculation with ANSI escape sequences by switching to the ansi-str crate, as the previous implementation didn't respect OSC 8 hyperlink style ANSI sequences.

## Performance Impact

The new changes for correct UTF-8 handling have a performance hit of up to ~67%, though this will most likely be unnoticeable for most people, with benchmark tables showing a slowdown from 15ms to 25ms.

## Recent Version Updates

Recent updates include switching to the Rust 2024 edition, bumping the MSRV to 1.85 (no longer supporting the wasm32-wasi target), and updating the crossterm dependency to 0.29 for Windows.

156	        explanation: ExplanationPanel,
157	        primary_actions: impl IntoIterator<Item = (L, C)>,

159	    ) -> Result<Self, VerdictSurfaceError>
160	    where
161	        L: Into<String>,
162	        C: Into<String>,
163	        SL: Into<String>,
164	        SC: Into<String>,
165	    {
166	        let subject_kind = subject_kind.into();
167	        if subject_kind.trim().is_empty() {
168	            return Err(VerdictSurfaceError::MissingSubjectKind);
169	        }
170	        explanation.validate()?;

172	        let primary = primary_actions
173	            .into_iter()

177	            })
178	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
179	        if primary.len() != 1 {
180	            return Err(VerdictSurfaceError::ExpectedOnePrimaryAction {
181	                actual: primary.len(),
182	            });
183	        }
184	        let mut primary = primary;
185	        let primary_action = primary.remove(0);
186	        if primary_action.command.trim().is_empty() {
187	            return Err(VerdictSurfaceError::MissingPrimaryCommand);
188	        }
189	
190	        let primary_command = primary_action.command.clone();
191	        let secondary_actions = secondary_actions
192	            .into_iter()
193	            .map(|(label, command)| HintLine {
194	                label: label.into(),
195	                command: command.into(),
196	            })
197	            .filter(|action| action.command != primary_command)
198	            .collect();
199

201	            kind,
202	            subject_kind,
203	            subject: subject.map(str::to_string),
204	            explanation,
205	            primary_action,
206	            secondary_actions,
207	        })
208	    }

214	            }

pub(crate) fn set_plain_output(plain: bool) {
    PLAIN_OUTPUT.store(plain, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub(crate) fn enabled(stream: Stream) -> bool {
    if PLAIN_OUTPUT.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return false;
    }
    if std::env::var_os("NO_COLOR").is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    if std::env::var("TERM").is_ok_and(|term| term == "dumb") {
        return false;
    }
    stream_is_terminal(stream)
}

pub(crate) fn render(stream: Stream, tone: Tone, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    let text = text.as_ref();
    let Some(code) = tone_code(tone) else {
        return text.to_string();
    };
    if enabled(stream) {
        ansi_wrap(code, text)
    } else {
        text.to_string()
    }
}

pub(crate) fn ansi_wrap(code: &str, text: &str) -> String {
    format!("\x1b[{code}m{text}{ANSI_RESET}")
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn ansi_reset() -> &'static str {
    ANSI_RESET
}

pub(crate) fn strip_ansi(text: &str) -> String {

380	fn parse_merge_strategy(
381	    plan: &Plan,

386	    match strategy {

388	        "dag-aware" => Ok(PlanMergeStrategy::DagAware),
389	        "prefer-child" => prefer_child
390	            .map(PlanMergeStrategy::PreferChild)
391	            .ok_or_else(|| {
392	                let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
393	                merge_argument_surface_error(

395	                    no_hints,

397	                    "The prefer-child strategy requires a concrete child index so DeadReckon knows which completed child result to keep for conflicting files.",
398	                    vec![

400	                        ("strategy".to_string(), "prefer-child".to_string()),
401	                    ],
402	                    format!("deadreckon merge {id} --strategy prefer-child --prefer-child 1"),
403	                )
404	            }),

414	                    ("value".to_string(), other.to_string()),
415	                ],
416	                format!("deadreckon merge {id} --strategy dag-aware"),
417	            )
418	        }),
419	    }
420	}

130	            }
131	            KeyCode::Enter => {
132	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
133	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
134	            }
135	            KeyCode::Char('j' | 'm') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
136	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
137	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
138	            }
139	            KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
140	                selected = selected.saturating_sub(1);
141	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
142	            }
143	            KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
144	                if selected + 1 < prompt.choices.len() {
145	                    selected += 1;
146	                }
147	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
148	            }
149	            KeyCode::Home => {
150	                selected = 0;
151	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
152	            }
153	            KeyCode::End => {
154	                selected = prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1);
155	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
156	            }
157	            KeyCode::Char(value) if key.modifiers.is_empty() && value.is_ascii_digit() => {
158	                if let Some(index) = select_index_from_digit(value, prompt.choices.len()) {
159	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
160	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
161	                }
162	            }
163	            KeyCode::Esc => {
164	                if let Some(index) = prompt
165	                    .choices
166	                    .iter()
167	                    .position(|choice| choice.id == "cancel")

169	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
170	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
171	                }
172	            }
173	            _ => {}
174	        }
175	    }

177	
178	fn render_select_menu(prompt: &SelectPrompt, selected: usize, redraw: bool) -> Result<()> {
179	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
180	    if redraw {
181	        execute!(stdout, MoveUp(prompt.choices.len() as u16), MoveToColumn(0))?;
182	    }
183	    let width = selectable_menu_width();
184	    for (index, choice) in prompt.choices.iter().enumerate() {
185	        let ordinal = index + 1;
186	        let marker = if index == selected { ">" } else { " " };
187	        execute!(stdout, Clear(ClearType::CurrentLine))?;
188	        let line = match choice.detail.as_deref() {
189	            Some(detail) if !detail.trim().is_empty() => {
190	                format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {} - {detail}", choice.label)
191	            }
192	            _ => format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {}", choice.label),
193	        };
194	        write_select_menu_line(&mut stdout, &truncate_menu_line(&line, width))?;
195	    }
196	    execute!(stdout, Clear(ClearType::CurrentLine))?;
197	    let default = prompt
198	        .default_index
199	        .min(prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1))
200	        + 1;
201	    write!(stdout, "? choose [{default}]: arrows/Enter or number ")?;
202	    stdout.flush()?;
203	    Ok(())
204	}
205	
206	fn write_select_menu_line(stdout: &mut impl io::Write, line: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
207	    write!(stdout, "{line}\r\n")
208	}
209	
210	fn selectable_menu_width() -> usize {
211	    crossterm::terminal::size()
212	        .ok()
213	        .map(|(columns, _)| usize::from(columns))
214	        .or_else(|| {
215	            std::env::var("COLUMNS")
216	                .ok()
217	                .and_then(|columns| columns.parse::<usize>().ok())
218	        })
219	        .filter(|columns| *columns > 1)
220	        .map(|columns| columns.saturating_sub(1))
221	        .unwrap_or(119)
222	}
223	
224	fn truncate_menu_line(line: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
225	    let normalized = normalize_menu_line(line);
226	    if normalized.chars().count() <= max_visible {
227	        return normalized;
228	    }
229	    if max_visible == 0 {
230	        return String::new();
231	    }
232	    if max_visible <= 3 {
233	        return normalized.chars().take(max_visible).collect();
234	    }
235	    let keep = max_visible.saturating_sub(3);
236	    let mut out = normalized.chars().take(keep).collect::<String>();
237	    out.push_str("...");
238	    out
239	}
240	
241	fn normalize_menu_line(line: &str) -> String {
242	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
243	    let mut previous_was_space = false;
244	    for ch in line.chars() {
245	        if ch.is_whitespace() {
246	            if !previous_was_space {
247	                out.push(' ');
248	                previous_was_space = true;
249	            }
250	        } else {
251	            out.push(ch);
252	            previous_was_space = false;
253	        }
254	    }
255	    out.trim_end().to_string()
256	}
257	
258	fn finish_select_menu_line() -> io::Result<()> {
259	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
260	    write!(stdout, "\r\n")?;
261	    stdout.flush()
262	}
263	
264	fn select_index_from_digit(value: char, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
265	    let digit = value.to_digit(10)? as usize;
266	    if (1..=len).contains(&digit) {
267	        Some(digit - 1)
268	    } else {
269	        None
270	    }
271	}

273	struct RawModeGuard;
274	
275	impl RawModeGuard {
276	    fn enable() -> Result<Self> {
277	        terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
278	        Ok(Self)
279	    }
280	}
281	
282	impl Drop for RawModeGuard {
283	    fn drop(&mut self) {
284	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
285	    }
286	}

288	pub(crate) fn confirm(question: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Result<bool> {
289	    let marker = if default_yes { "[Y/n]" } else { "[y/N]" };
290	    loop {
291	        let answer = open(&format!("{question} {marker}: "), None)?;
292	        if let Some(value) = parse_confirm_answer(&answer, default_yes) {
293	            return Ok(value);
294	        }
295	        println!("Please answer y or n.");
296	    }
297	}
298	
299	fn parse_select_answer(answer: &str, default: usize, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
300	    if len == 0 {
301	        return None;
302	    }
303	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
304	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
305	        return Some(default.saturating_sub(1).min(len - 1));
306	    }
307	    let value = trimmed.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
308	    if (1..=len).contains(&value) {
309	        Some(value - 1)
310	    } else {
311	        None
312	    }
313	}
314	
315	fn parse_confirm_answer(answer: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Option<bool> {
316	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
317	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
318	        return Some(default_yes);
319	    }
320	    match trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
321	        "y" | "yes" => Some(true),
322	        "n" | "no" => Some(false),
323	        _ => None,
324	    }
325	}

Based on the search results, here's what I found about anstyle, anstream, clap, color, NO_COLOR, and Windows support:

## Overview

anstream is a new take on terminal styling for Rust and will be used in the upcoming clap 4.2 release. anstyle provides core types describing ANSI styling escape codes for interoperability between crates.

## NO_COLOR Support

The AnStyle ecosystem respects several environment variables for configuration, including colorchoice which provides global control over color output, respecting environment variables like NO_COLOR.

## Windows Support

The anstyle-wincon crate bridges this gap by translating ANSI escape codes to Windows Console API calls and providing a WinconStream implementation for Windows terminals. Additionally, anstream provides the same feature set as termcolor (including legacy windows support) but with a less awkward API to work with.

The anstream crate provides the ability to write styled text to terminals across different platforms and automatically adapts to terminal capabilities, handling platform-specific differences (especially Windows) and respecting environment variables.

The ecosystem appears to handle Windows console support through the anstyle-wincon component, which allows ANSI styling to work on Windows systems by converting ANSI codes to native Windows Console API calls.

222	}
223	
224	fn truncate_menu_line(line: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
225	    let normalized = normalize_menu_line(line);
226	    if normalized.chars().count() <= max_visible {
227	        return normalized;
228	    }
229	    if max_visible == 0 {
230	        return String::new();
231	    }
232	    if max_visible <= 3 {
233	        return normalized.chars().take(max_visible).collect();
234	    }
235	    let keep = max_visible.saturating_sub(3);
236	    let mut out = normalized.chars().take(keep).collect::<String>();
237	    out.push_str("...");
238	    out
239	}
240	
241	fn normalize_menu_line(line: &str) -> String {
242	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
243	    let mut previous_was_space = false;
244	    for ch in line.chars() {
245	        if ch.is_whitespace() {
246	            if !previous_was_space {
247	                out.push(' ');
248	                previous_was_space = true;
249	            }
250	        } else {
251	            out.push(ch);
252	            previous_was_space = false;
253	        }
254	    }
255	    out.trim_end().to_string()
256	}
257	
258	fn finish_select_menu_line() -> io::Result<()> {
259	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
260	    write!(stdout, "\r\n")?;
261	    stdout.flush()
262	}
263	
264	fn select_index_from_digit(value: char, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
265	    let digit = value.to_digit(10)? as usize;
266	    if (1..=len).contains(&digit) {
267	        Some(digit - 1)
268	    } else {
269	        None
270	    }
271	}

273	struct RawModeGuard;
274	
275	impl RawModeGuard {
276	    fn enable() -> Result<Self> {
277	        terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
278	        Ok(Self)
279	    }
280	}
281	
282	impl Drop for RawModeGuard {
283	    fn drop(&mut self) {
284	        let _ = terminal::disable_raw_mode();
285	    }
286	}

288	pub(crate) fn confirm(question: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Result<bool> {
289	    let marker = if default_yes { "[Y/n]" } else { "[y/N]" };
290	    loop {
291	        let answer = open(&format!("{question} {marker}: "), None)?;
292	        if let Some(value) = parse_confirm_answer(&answer, default_yes) {
293	            return Ok(value);
294	        }
295	        println!("Please answer y or n.");
296	    }
297	}
298	
299	fn parse_select_answer(answer: &str, default: usize, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
300	    if len == 0 {
301	        return None;
302	    }
303	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
304	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
305	        return Some(default.saturating_sub(1).min(len - 1));
306	    }
307	    let value = trimmed.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
308	    if (1..=len).contains(&value) {
309	        Some(value - 1)
310	    } else {
311	        None
312	    }
313	}
314	
315	fn parse_confirm_answer(answer: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Option<bool> {
316	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
317	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
318	        return Some(default_yes);
319	    }
320	    match trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
321	        "y" | "yes" => Some(true),
322	        "n" | "no" => Some(false),
323	        _ => None,
324	    }
325	}

186	fn exit_summary_explanation(input: &ExitSummaryInput) -> ExplanationPanel {
187	    let (what_happened, why_this_verdict) = match input.outcome {
188	        OutcomeKind::Completed => (
189	            "The provider finished and acceptance checks passed.",
190	            "DeadReckon has a verified result; the recommended command lands or exports the produced changes.",
191	        ),
192	        OutcomeKind::Paused => (
193	            "The run stopped before the provider produced a final result.",
194	            "No final acceptance verdict exists yet, but the run is still resumable.",
195	        ),
196	        OutcomeKind::Killed => (
197	            "The run was stopped by operator or supervisor control.",
198	            "DeadReckon cannot treat a killed run as complete; inspect it before resuming or cleaning up.",
199	        ),
200	        OutcomeKind::Failed => (
201	            "The run ended before producing a verified result.",
202	            "DeadReckon needs failure inspection before the work can be continued or applied.",
203	        ),
204	    };
205	    let mut evidence = vec![
206	        ("run".to_string(), input.run_id.chars().take(8).collect()),
207	        ("provider".to_string(), input.provider.clone()),
208	        ("gate".to_string(), input.gate.clone()),
209	        (
210	            "working".to_string(),
211	            input.working_dir.display().to_string(),
212	        ),
213	    ];
214	    if let Some(diff) = input.diff.as_ref() {
215	        evidence.push((
216	            "changed files".to_string(),
217	            (diff.files_added + diff.files_updated + diff.files_deleted).to_string(),
218	        ));
219	    }
220	    if input.proof_block.is_none() {
221	        evidence.push(("proof".to_string(), input.proof_path.display().to_string()));
222	    }
223	    ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, evidence)
224	}

226	fn exit_summary_subtitle(input: &ExitSummaryInput) -> String {
227	    let target = input
228	        .branch
229	        .as_deref()
230	        .map(|branch| format!("branch {branch}"))
231	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "this run".to_string());
232	    if input.outcome == OutcomeKind::Completed {
233	        return format!(
234	            "{NOUN_VERIFIED_RUN}, {PHRASE_VERIFIED_BY_DR_GATE}; completed run by {} on {target}",
235	            input.provider
236	        );
237	    }
238	    format!("{} worked on {target}", input.provider)
239	}
240	
241	fn exit_summary_primary_action(input: &ExitSummaryInput) -> Option<HintLine> {
242	    let priorities: &[&str] = match input.outcome {
243	        OutcomeKind::Completed => &["finish", "apply", "export", "undo"],
244	        OutcomeKind::Paused => &["resume"],
245	        OutcomeKind::Failed | OutcomeKind::Killed => &["why", "logs"],
246	    };
247	    let selected = input
248	        .hints
249	        .iter()
250	        .find(|(label, command)| {
251	            priorities.iter().any(|priority| priority == label)
252	                || (matches!(input.outcome, OutcomeKind::Failed | OutcomeKind::Killed)
253	                    && command.contains("--why-failed"))
254	                || (matches!(input.outcome, OutcomeKind::Paused) && command.contains(" resume "))
255	        })
256	        .or_else(|| input.hints.first())?;
257	    Some(HintLine {
258	        label: "recommended".to_string(),
259	        command: selected.1.clone(),
260	    })
261	}

1975	        )

1993	    match footer.split_once("  |  ") {
1994	        Some((lead, rest)) => format!("{lead}  |  {parent_label}  |  {rest}"),
1995	        None => format!("{footer}  |  {parent_label}"),

105	fn select_one_menu(prompt: &SelectPrompt) -> Result<SelectChoice> {
106	    println!("{}", prompt.title);
107	    if let Some(help) = prompt
108	        .help
109	        .as_deref()
110	        .filter(|help| !help.trim().is_empty())
111	    {
112	        println!("  {help}");
113	    }
114	    let mut selected = prompt
115	        .default_index
116	        .min(prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1));
117	    let _raw_mode = RawModeGuard::enable()?;
118	    render_select_menu(prompt, selected, false)?;
119	    loop {
120	        let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? else {
121	            continue;
122	        };
123	        if matches!(key.kind, KeyEventKind::Release) {
124	            continue;
125	        }
126	        match key.code {
127	            KeyCode::Char('c') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
128	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
129	                return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Interrupted, "prompt cancelled").into());
130	            }
131	            KeyCode::Enter => {
132	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
133	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
134	            }
135	            KeyCode::Char('j' | 'm') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
136	                finish_select_menu_line()?;
137	                return Ok(prompt.choices[selected].clone());
138	            }
139	            KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
140	                selected = selected.saturating_sub(1);
141	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
142	            }
143	            KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
144	                if selected + 1 < prompt.choices.len() {
145	                    selected += 1;
146	                }
147	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
148	            }
149	            KeyCode::Home => {
150	                selected = 0;
151	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
152	            }
153	            KeyCode::End => {
154	                selected = prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1);
155	                render_select_menu(prompt, selected, true)?;
156	            }
157	            KeyCode::Char(value) if key.modifiers.is_empty() && value.is_ascii_digit() => {
158	                if let Some(index) = select_index_from_digit(value, prompt.choices.len()) {
159	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
160	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
161	                }
162	            }
163	            KeyCode::Esc => {
164	                if let Some(index) = prompt
165	                    .choices
166	                    .iter()
167	                    .position(|choice| choice.id == "cancel")
168	                {
169	                    finish_select_menu_line()?;
170	                    return Ok(prompt.choices[index].clone());
171	                }
172	            }
173	            _ => {}
174	        }
175	    }
176	}

178	fn render_select_menu(prompt: &SelectPrompt, selected: usize, redraw: bool) -> Result<()> {
179	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
180	    if redraw {
181	        execute!(stdout, MoveUp(prompt.choices.len() as u16), MoveToColumn(0))?;
182	    }
183	    let width = selectable_menu_width();
184	    for (index, choice) in prompt.choices.iter().enumerate() {
185	        let ordinal = index + 1;
186	        let marker = if index == selected { ">" } else { " " };
187	        execute!(stdout, Clear(ClearType::CurrentLine))?;
188	        let line = match choice.detail.as_deref() {
189	            Some(detail) if !detail.trim().is_empty() => {
190	                format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {} - {detail}", choice.label)
191	            }
192	            _ => format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {}", choice.label),
193	        };
194	        write_select_menu_line(&mut stdout, &truncate_menu_line(&line, width))?;
195	    }
196	    execute!(stdout, Clear(ClearType::CurrentLine))?;
197	    let default = prompt
198	        .default_index
199	        .min(prompt.choices.len().saturating_sub(1))
200	        + 1;
201	    write!(stdout, "? choose [{default}]: arrows/Enter or number ")?;
202	    stdout.flush()?;
203	    Ok(())
204	}
205	
206	fn write_select_menu_line(stdout: &mut impl io::Write, line: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
207	    write!(stdout, "{line}\r\n")
208	}

210	fn selectable_menu_width() -> usize {
211	    crossterm::terminal::size()
212	        .ok()
213	        .map(|(columns, _)| usize::from(columns))
214	        .or_else(|| {
215	            std::env::var("COLUMNS")
216	                .ok()
217	                .and_then(|columns| columns.parse::<usize>().ok())
218	        })
219	        .filter(|columns| *columns > 1)
220	        .map(|columns| columns.saturating_sub(1))
221	        .unwrap_or(119)
222	}

224	fn truncate_menu_line(line: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
225	    let normalized = normalize_menu_line(line);
226	    if normalized.chars().count() <= max_visible {
227	        return normalized;
228	    }
229	    if max_visible == 0 {
230	        return String::new();
231	    }
232	    if max_visible <= 3 {
233	        return normalized.chars().take(max_visible).collect();
234	    }
235	    let keep = max_visible.saturating_sub(3);
236	    let mut out = normalized.chars().take(keep).collect::<String>();
237	    out.push_str("...");
238	    out
239	}
240	
241	fn normalize_menu_line(line: &str) -> String {
242	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
243	    let mut previous_was_space = false;
244	    for ch in line.chars() {
245	        if ch.is_whitespace() {
246	            if !previous_was_space {
247	                out.push(' ');
248	                previous_was_space = true;
249	            }
250	        } else {
251	            out.push(ch);
252	            previous_was_space = false;
253	        }
254	    }
255	    out.trim_end().to_string()
256	}
257	
258	fn finish_select_menu_line() -> io::Result<()> {
259	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
260	    write!(stdout, "\r\n")?;
261	    stdout.flush()
262	}

268	    } else {

270	    }

288	pub(crate) fn confirm(question: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Result<bool> {
289	    let marker = if default_yes { "[Y/n]" } else { "[y/N]" };
290	    loop {
291	        let answer = open(&format!("{question} {marker}: "), None)?;
292	        if let Some(value) = parse_confirm_answer(&answer, default_yes) {
293	            return Ok(value);
294	        }
295	        println!("Please answer y or n.");
296	    }
297	}
298	
299	fn parse_select_answer(answer: &str, default: usize, len: usize) -> Option<usize> {
300	    if len == 0 {
301	        return None;
302	    }
303	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
304	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
305	        return Some(default.saturating_sub(1).min(len - 1));
306	    }
307	    let value = trimmed.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
308	    if (1..=len).contains(&value) {
309	        Some(value - 1)
310	    } else {
311	        None
312	    }
313	}
314	
315	fn parse_confirm_answer(answer: &str, default_yes: bool) -> Option<bool> {
316	    let trimmed = answer.trim();
317	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
318	        return Some(default_yes);
319	    }
320	    match trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
321	        "y" | "yes" => Some(true),
322	        "n" | "no" => Some(false),
323	        _ => None,
324	    }
325	}

249	            route
250	                .as_ref()
251	                .and_then(|route| registry.get(route.name.as_str()))
252	        });
253	    let mut selection = ProviderSetupSelection {
254	        role,
255	        provider: Some(
256	            route
257	                .as_ref()
258	                .map(|route| route.name.clone())
259	                .or_else(|| provider.map(ToString::to_string))
260	                .unwrap_or_default(),
261	        ),
262	        model: route
263	            .as_ref()
264	            .map(|route| route.model.clone())
265	            .or_else(|| model.map(ToString::to_string)),
266	        source,
267	        kind: descriptor
268	            .map(|descriptor| descriptor_kind_label(&descriptor.kind).to_string())
269	            .or_else(|| route.as_ref().map(|route| provider_kind_label(&route.kind))),
270	        credential: Some(provider_credential_label(descriptor, route.as_ref())),
271	        install_hint: descriptor.and_then(first_install_hint),
272	        warnings: Vec::new(),
273	        try_lines: Vec::new(),
274	    };
275	    if route.as_ref().is_some_and(|route| !route.has_credential) {
276	        if let Some(provider) = selection.provider.as_deref() {
277	            selection.warnings.push(format!(
278	                "provider {provider} needs credentials or an installed binary"
279	            ));
280	        }
281	        if let Some(hint) = selection.install_hint.clone() {
282	            selection.try_lines.push(hint);
283	        } else if let Some(provider) = selection.provider.as_deref() {
284	            selection.try_lines.push(format!(
285	                "deadreckon config set providers.{provider}.api_key <KEY>"
286	            ));
287	        }
288	        if require_usable_route {
289	            let provider_label = selection
290	                .provider
291	                .as_deref()
292	                .or(provider)
293	                .unwrap_or("provider");
294	            return Err(SetupRefusal {
295	                message: selection
296	                    .warnings
297	                    .first()
298	                    .cloned()
299	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("provider {provider_label} is not usable")),
300	                try_line: selection
301	                    .try_lines
302	                    .first()
303	                    .cloned()
304	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()),
305	            });
306	        }
307	    }
308	    Ok(selection)
309	}
310	
311	fn provider_candidate<'a>(
312	    request: &ProviderSetupRequest<'a>,
313	) -> (Option<&'a str>, SetupProviderSource) {
314	    if let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.explicit_provider) {
315	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::Flag);
316	    }
317	    if matches!(request.role, SetupProviderRoleRef::DocPolish)
318	        && let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.config_doc_provider)
319	    {
320	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::Config);
321	    }
322	    if !matches!(request.role, SetupProviderRoleRef::DocPolish)
323	        && let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.config_default_provider)
324	    {
325	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::Config);
326	    }
327	    if request.allow_auto_subscription
328	        && let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.auto_subscription_provider)
329	    {
330	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::AutoSubscription);
331	    }
332	    if let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.run_provider) {
333	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::RunProvider);
334	    }
335	    if let Some(provider) = non_empty(request.built_in_default_provider) {
336	        return (Some(provider), SetupProviderSource::BuiltInDefault);
337	    }
338	    (None, SetupProviderSource::None)
339	}
340	
341	fn non_empty(value: Option<&str>) -> Option<&str> {
342	    value.map(str::trim).filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
343	}
344	
345	fn provider_route_exists(config_path: &Path, registry: &ProviderRegistry, provider: &str) -> bool {
346	    registry.get(provider).is_some()
347	        || read_config(config_path)
348	            .ok()
349	            .is_some_and(|config| config.providers.contains_key(provider))
350	}

352	fn route_info_for_provider(
353	    config_path: &Path,
354	    provider: Option<&str>,
355	    model: Option<&str>,
356	) -> Result<Option<ProviderRouteInfo>, ProviderError> {
357	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path_with_model(config_path, provider, model)?;
358	    Ok(router.selected_route_info())
359	}
360	
361	fn setup_refusal_for_provider_error(provider: Option<&str>, error: ProviderError) -> SetupRefusal {
362	    match error {
363	        ProviderError::InvalidConfig(message) if message.contains("unknown provider route") => {
364	            match provider {
365	                Some(provider) => SetupRefusal::unknown_provider(provider),
366	                None => SetupRefusal {
367	                    message,
368	                    try_line: "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string(),
369	                },
370	            }
371	        }
372	        other => SetupRefusal {
373	            message: other.to_string(),
374	            try_line: "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string(),
375	        },
376	    }
377	}
378	
379	fn provider_credential_label(
380	    descriptor: Option<&ProviderDescriptor>,
381	    route: Option<&ProviderRouteInfo>,
382	) -> String {
383	    let has_credential = route.is_some_and(|route| route.has_credential);
384	    match descriptor {
385	        Some(descriptor) if descriptor.subscription && has_credential => "subscription",
386	        Some(descriptor) if descriptor.subscription => "missing",
387	        Some(descriptor) if descriptor.auth.kind == AuthKind::None && has_credential => "none",
388	        Some(_) if has_credential => "ready",
389	        Some(_) => "missing",
390	        None if has_credential => "ready",
391	        None => "missing",
392	    }
393	    .to_string()
394	}
395	
396	fn first_install_hint(descriptor: &ProviderDescriptor) -> Option<String> {
397	    descriptor.install_hint.try_lines.first().cloned()
398	}

401	    match kind {
402	        DescriptorKind::Http => "http",
403	        DescriptorKind::Cli => "cli",
404	        DescriptorKind::LocalHttp => "local-http",
405	        DescriptorKind::Scripted => "scripted",
406	    }
407	}

409	fn provider_kind_label(kind: &ProviderKind) -> String {
410	    match kind {
411	        ProviderKind::Anthropic => "anthropic".to_string(),
412	        ProviderKind::OpenAi => "openai".to_string(),
413	        ProviderKind::OpenAiCompatible => "openai-compatible".to_string(),
414	        ProviderKind::CliClaudeCode => "cli".to_string(),
415	        ProviderKind::CliCodex => "cli".to_string(),
416	        ProviderKind::ScriptedSmoke => "scripted".to_string(),
417	        ProviderKind::Generic(id) => id.clone(),
418	    }
419	}

441	pub(crate) struct DoneCriteriaSelection {
442	    pub source: DoneCriteriaSource,
443	    pub path: Option<PathBuf>,
444	    pub companion_doc: Option<PathBuf>,
445	    pub checks: Option<usize>,
446	    pub label: String,

451	impl DoneCriteriaSelection {
452	    pub(crate) fn explicit(
453	        path: PathBuf,
454	        companion_doc: Option<PathBuf>,
455	        checks: Option<usize>,
456	    ) -> Self {
457	        Self::with_path(

461	            checks,
462	        )
463	    }
464	
465	    pub(crate) fn project(
466	        path: PathBuf,
467	        companion_doc: Option<PathBuf>,

469	    ) -> Self {

471	    }
472	
473	    pub(crate) fn generated(
474	        path: PathBuf,
475	        companion_doc: Option<PathBuf>,
476	        checks: Option<usize>,
477	    ) -> Self {
478	        Self::with_path(DoneCriteriaSource::Generated, path, companion_doc, checks)
479	    }

481	    pub(crate) fn default_gate() -> Self {
482	        Self {
483	            source: DoneCriteriaSource::DefaultGate,
484	            path: None,
485	            companion_doc: None,
486	            checks: None,

488	            technical_label: "default dr-gate behavior".to_string(),
489	            try_lines: vec!["deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"".to_string()],
490	        }
491	    }
492	
493	    pub(crate) fn full_label(&self) -> String {
494	        let mut label = self.label.clone();
495	        if let Some(path) = self.path.as_ref() {
496	            label.push_str(&format!(" from {}", path.display()));
497	        }
498	        label
499	    }
500	
501	    pub(crate) fn brief_label(&self) -> String {
502	        match self.checks {
503	            Some(checks) => format!("{}:{checks}", self.source.as_str()),
504	            None => self.source.as_str().to_string(),
505	        }
506	    }
507	
508	    fn with_path(
509	        source: DoneCriteriaSource,
510	        path: PathBuf,
511	        companion_doc: Option<PathBuf>,
512	        checks: Option<usize>,
513	    ) -> Self {
514	        let label = match checks {
515	            Some(checks) => format!("{} ({checks} checks)", source.as_str()),
516	            None => source.as_str().to_string(),
517	        };
518	        Self {
519	            source,
520	            path: Some(path),
521	            companion_doc,
522	            checks,
523	            label,
524	            technical_label: ".deadreckon/acceptance.yaml".to_string(),
525	            try_lines: vec!["deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"".to_string()],
526	        }
527	    }
528	}

2524	        || line.starts_with("Architecture")
2525	        || line.starts_with("Agents")
2526	        || line.starts_with("Coordination")
2527	        || line.starts_with("Risks")
2528	        || line.starts_with("Next likely")
2529	        || line.starts_with("Visual:")
2530	        || line.starts_with("Evidence")
2531	    {
2532	        Style::default()
2533	            .fg(Color::Cyan)
2534	            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
2535	    } else if line.starts_with("  ->") || line.contains(" -> ") {
2536	        Style::default().fg(Color::LightCyan)
2537	    } else if line.starts_with("- ") {
2538	        Style::default().fg(Color::White)
2539	    } else {
2540	        Style::default()
2541	    };
2542	    ListItem::new(Line::styled(line, style))

264	fn doctor_verdict_surface(report: &DoctorReport) -> VerdictSurface {
265	    let failed_count = report
266	        .findings
267	        .iter()
268	        .filter(|finding| finding.is_failed())
269	        .count();
270	    let warning_count = report
271	        .findings
272	        .iter()
273	        .filter(|finding| finding.status == "warning")
274	        .count();
275	    let kind = if failed_count == 0 {
276	        VerdictKind::Verified
277	    } else {
278	        VerdictKind::Blocked
279	    };
280	    let primary = doctor_primary_action(report);
281	    let secondary = doctor_secondary_actions(report, &primary)
282	        .into_iter()
283	        .map(|action| ("Secondary", action))
284	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
285	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
286	        kind,
287	        "doctor",
288	        None,
289	        doctor_explanation(report, failed_count, warning_count),
290	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
291	        secondary,
292	    )
293	    .expect("doctor verdict surface must be valid")
294	}
295	
296	fn doctor_explanation(
297	    report: &DoctorReport,
298	    failed_count: usize,
299	    warning_count: usize,
300	) -> ExplanationPanel {
301	    let what = if failed_count == 0 {
302	        format!(
303	            "Doctor checked {} setup areas and found no blocking setup failures.",
304	            report.findings.len()
305	        )
306	    } else {
307	        format!(
308	            "Doctor checked {} setup areas and found {failed_count} blocking setup issue(s).",
309	            report.findings.len()
310	        )
311	    };
312	    let why = if failed_count == 0 {
313	        "All required checks passed; warnings, if any, are optional capabilities or local environment notes."
314	            .to_string()
315	    } else {
316	        format!(
317	            "The verdict is blocked because required setup checks failed; {warning_count} optional warning(s) were also recorded."
318	        )
319	    };
320	    let evidence = report
321	        .findings
322	        .iter()
323	        .map(|finding| {
324	            (
325	                finding.subject.clone(),
326	                format!("{} - {}", finding.status, finding.detail),
327	            )
328	        })
329	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
330	    ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence)
331	}

333	fn doctor_primary_action(report: &DoctorReport) -> String {
334	    report

336	        .iter()
337	        .filter(|finding| finding.is_failed())
338	        .filter_map(|finding| finding.action.as_deref())
339	        .find(|action| action.starts_with("deadreckon "))
340	        .map(str::to_string)
341	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "deadreckon run \"goal\" --preview".to_string())
342	}

344	fn doctor_secondary_actions(report: &DoctorReport, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
345	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
346	    for action in report
347	        .findings
348	        .iter()
349	        .filter_map(|finding| finding.action.as_deref())
350	    {
351	        if action != primary && !actions.iter().any(|existing| existing == action) {
352	            actions.push(action.to_string());
353	        }
354	    }
