369	// SAFETY: Acceptance check paths are owned clap values at the command boundary.
370	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
371	fn acceptance_check_command(spec: Option<PathBuf>, against: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
372	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
373	    let working_dir = against.unwrap_or(cwd.clone());
374	    let spec_path = resolve_acceptance_path_for_command(&cwd, spec.as_deref())?;
375	    let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
376	        "deadreckon-acceptance-check-{}",
377	        Uuid::new_v4().simple()
378	    ));
379	    fs::create_dir_all(&temp_root)?;
380	    if let Some(spec_path) = spec_path.as_ref() {
381	        let raw = fs::read_to_string(spec_path)?;
382	        validate_acceptance_yaml_integrity(&raw)?;
383	        fs::copy(spec_path, acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&temp_root))?;
384	    }
385	    let result = evaluate_acceptance_checks(&temp_root, &working_dir);
386	    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&temp_root);
387	    match result {
388	        Ok(results) => {
389	            let failed_required = results
390	                .iter()
391	                .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed);
392	            if failed_required {
393	                println!("working {}", working_dir.display());
394	                if let Some(spec_path) = spec_path.as_ref() {
395	                    println!("spec    {}", spec_path.display());
396	                } else {
397	                    println!("spec    default dr-gate behavior");
398	                }
399	                print_acceptance_results(&results);
400	                if let Some(failed) = results
401	                    .iter()
402	                    .find(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed)
403	                {
404	                    return Err(CliError::Surface {
405	                        code: 1,
406	                        surface: acceptance_check_failure_surface(
407	                            &working_dir,
408	                            spec_path.as_ref(),
409	                            failed,
410	                        )
411	                        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
412	                    });
413	                }
414	            } else {
415	                print!(
416	                    "{}",
417	                    acceptance_check_success_surface(&working_dir, spec_path.as_ref(), &results)
418	                        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
419	                );
420	            }
421	            Ok(())
422	        }
423	        Err(err) => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
424	            &format!("done criteria check failed: {err}"),
425	            "fix the project or edit .deadreckon/acceptance.yaml, then rerun `deadreckon def-done check`",
426	        ))),
427	    }
428	}
429	
430	fn acceptance_check_success_surface(
431	    working_dir: &Path,
432	    spec_path: Option<&PathBuf>,
433	    results: &[deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult],
434	) -> VerdictSurface {
435	    let required = results.iter().filter(|result| result.must_pass).count();
436	    let passed = results.iter().filter(|result| result.passed).count();
437	    let failed_optional = results
438	        .iter()
439	        .filter(|result| !result.must_pass && !result.passed)
440	        .count();
441	    let mut evidence = vec![
442	        ("working", working_dir.display().to_string()),
443	        (
444	            "spec",
445	            spec_path
446	                .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
447	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "default dr-gate behavior".to_string()),
448	        ),
449	        ("checks", results.len().to_string()),
450	        ("required", required.to_string()),
451	        ("passed", passed.to_string()),
452	    ];
453	    if failed_optional > 0 {
454	        evidence.push(("optional failed", failed_optional.to_string()));
455	    }
456	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
457	        VerdictKind::Verified,
458	        "def-done",
459	        Some("check"),
460	        ExplanationPanel::new(
461	            "DeadReckon dry-ran the done criteria successfully.",
462	            "All required checks passed, so the done contract is ready to gate a run.",
463	            evidence,
464	        ),
465	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon run \"goal\"")],
466	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon def-done show")],
467	    )
468	    .expect("acceptance check success surface must be valid")
469	}
470	
471	fn acceptance_check_failure_surface(
472	    working_dir: &Path,
473	    spec_path: Option<&PathBuf>,
474	    failed: &deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult,
475	) -> VerdictSurface {
476	    let mut evidence = vec![
477	        ("working", working_dir.display().to_string()),
478	        (
479	            "spec",
480	            spec_path
481	                .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
482	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "default dr-gate behavior".to_string()),
483	        ),
484	        ("check", failed.kind.clone()),
485	        ("detail", one_line(&failed.detail, 140)),
486	    ];
487	    if let Some(command) = failed.command.as_ref() {
488	        evidence.push(("command", command.clone()));
489	    }
490	    if let Some(stderr) = failed.stderr.as_ref() {
491	        evidence.push(("stderr", one_line(stderr, 140)));
492	    }
493	    if let Some(stdout) = failed.stdout.as_ref() {
494	        evidence.push(("stdout", one_line(stdout, 140)));
495	    }
496	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
497	        VerdictKind::Failed,
498	        "def-done",
499	        Some("check"),
500	        ExplanationPanel::new(
501	            "A required done criterion failed during a dry-run check.",
502	            "DeadReckon cannot treat the done contract as verified until the project passes the required check or the criteria are corrected.",
503	            evidence,
504	        ),
505	        vec![(
506	            "Recommended",
507	            "deadreckon def-done edit \"tighten or correct the checks\"",
508	        )],
509	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon def-done check")],
510	    )
511	    .expect("acceptance check failure surface must be valid")
512	}

514	pub(crate) fn print_acceptance_results(results: &[deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult]) {
515	    for result in results {
516	        let mark = if result.passed {
517	            ui_ok("✓")
518	        } else if result.must_pass {
519	            ui::render(ui::Stream::Stdout, ui::Tone::Negative, "✗")
520	        } else {
521	            ui_warn("!")
522	        };
523	        let requirement = if result.must_pass {
524	            "required"
525	        } else {
526	            "optional"
527	        };
528	        let elapsed = result
529	            .duration_ms
530	            .map(|ms| format!(" ({:.1}s)", ms as f64 / 1000.0))
531	            .unwrap_or_default();
532	        println!(
533	            "  {mark} {:<13} {:<8} {}{}",
534	            result.kind, requirement, result.detail, elapsed
535	        );
536	        if !result.passed {
537	            if let Some(command) = result.command.as_deref() {
538	                println!("      command: {}", ui_command(command));
539	            }
540	            if let Some(stderr) = result.stderr.as_deref() {
541	                println!("      stderr:  {}", one_line(stderr, 140));
542	            }
543	            if let Some(stdout) = result.stdout.as_deref() {
544	                println!("      stdout:  {}", one_line(stdout, 140));
545	            }
546	        }
547	    }
548	}

550	fn acceptance_request_text(request: &[String], mode: AcceptanceAgentMode) -> Result<String> {
551	    let joined = request.join(" ").trim().to_string();
552	    if !joined.is_empty() {
553	        return Ok(joined);
554	    }
555	    if io::stdin().is_terminal() {
556	        let prompt_text = match mode {
557	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => "what should count as done? ",
558	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => "how should done criteria change? ",
559	        };
560	        let answer = prompt::open(prompt_text, None)?;
561	        if !answer.trim().is_empty() {
562	            return Ok(answer.trim().to_string());
563	        }
564	    }
565	    match mode {
566	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => Ok(
567	            "Draft practical acceptance criteria for this project and its likely build/test flow."
568	                .to_string(),
569	        ),
570	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
571	            "refine needs a requested change",
572	            "deadreckon def-done add \"also require tests for the gallery\"",
573	        ))),
574	    }
575	}

590	        "\
591	You are helping configure deadreckon acceptance criteria for an unattended coding run.
592	The user writes acceptance in plain English. Convert it into executable checks that dr-gate can run.
593	
594	Return JSON only, with exactly these keys:
595	{{\"acceptance_yaml\":\"...\",\"acceptance_md\":\"...\",\"files\":{{}}}}
596	
597	The YAML must be valid deadreckon acceptance.yaml. Use only these check kinds:
598	- file_exists with path
599	- content_match with path and pattern
600	- shell with command and optional cwd
601	- cargo_test
602	
603	Use {{working_dir}} for paths inside the run. Prefer stable, automatable checks over subjective claims.
604	Do not include self-attestation checks, provider-output checks, or instructions that the agent can satisfy by writing a marker.
605	For Node projects, prefer `npm run build --if-present` and `npm test --if-present` shell checks.
606	For static apps, require the main HTML/CSS/JS files and one or two content_match checks for requested behavior.
607	If a criterion needs a helper script, include it in files under `.deadreckon/acceptance/` and call it from a shell check.
608	The acceptance_md must restate the user's criteria in readable English before listing the executable checks.
609	Keep the YAML concise and include at least one required check.
610	
611	Mode: {mode_label}
612	User request: {request}
613	
614	Project summary:
615	{project}
616	
617	Existing acceptance.yaml:
618	{existing_yaml}
619	
620	Existing acceptance.md:
621	{existing_md}
622	",
623	        existing_yaml = existing_yaml.unwrap_or("(none)"),
624	        existing_md = existing_md.unwrap_or("(none)")
625	    ))
626	}
627	
628	fn acceptance_project_summary(cwd: &Path) -> Result<String> {
629	    let mut lines = vec![format!("root: {}", cwd.display())];
630	    if cwd.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
631	        lines.push("stack: rust".to_string());
632	    }
633	    if cwd.join("package.json").exists() {
634	        lines.push("stack: node".to_string());
635	        if let Ok(package) = fs::read_to_string(cwd.join("package.json"))
636	            && let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&package)
637	            && let Some(scripts) = value.get("scripts").and_then(Value::as_object)
638	        {
639	            let mut script_names = scripts.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
640	            script_names.sort();
641	            lines.push(format!("package scripts: {}", script_names.join(", ")));
642	        }
643	    }
644	    let files = project_file_sample(cwd, 80)?;
645	    lines.push("files:".to_string());
646	    for file in files {
647	        lines.push(format!("  - {}", file.display()));
648	    }
649	    Ok(lines.join("\n"))
650	}
651	
652	fn project_file_sample(cwd: &Path, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {
653	    fn walk(
654	        root: &Path,
655	        current: &Path,
656	        depth: usize,
657	        out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
658	        limit: usize,
659	    ) -> io::Result<()> {
660	        if depth > 3 || out.len() >= limit {
661	            return Ok(());
662	        }
663	        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)?.collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
664	        entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
665	        for entry in entries {
666	            if out.len() >= limit {
667	                break;
668	            }
669	            let path = entry.path();
670	            let name = entry.file_name();
671	            let name = name.to_string_lossy();
672	            if matches!(
673	                name.as_ref(),
674	                ".git" | "target" | "node_modules" | ".deadreckon" | "dist" | "build"
675	            ) {
676	                continue;
677	            }
678	            if path.is_dir() {
679	                walk(root, &path, depth + 1, out, limit)?;
680	            } else if let Ok(relative) = path.strip_prefix(root) {
681	                out.push(relative.to_path_buf());
682	            }
683	        }
684	        Ok(())
685	    }
686	    let mut files = Vec::new();
687	    walk(cwd, cwd, 0, &mut files, limit)?;
688	    Ok(files)
689	}
690	
691	fn parse_acceptance_agent_response(content: &str) -> Result<AcceptanceDraft> {
692	    let cleaned = strip_code_fence(content.trim());
693	    if let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&cleaned)
694	        && let Some(parsed) = acceptance_json_payload(&value)?
695	    {
696	        return Ok(parsed);
697	    }
698	    if let Some(json) = extract_json_object(&cleaned)
699	        && let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&json)
700	        && let Some(parsed) = acceptance_json_payload(&value)?
701	    {
702	        return Ok(parsed);
703	    }
704	    if let Some(yaml) = extract_fenced_block(&cleaned, &["yaml", "yml"]).or_else(|| {
705	        if cleaned.contains("checks:") {
706	            Some(cleaned.clone())
707	        } else {
708	            None
709	        }
710	    }) {
711	        let markdown = extract_fenced_block(&cleaned, &["markdown", "md"])
712	            .unwrap_or_else(|| acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(&yaml));
713	        acceptance_check_count(&yaml)?;
714	        return Ok(AcceptanceDraft {
715	            yaml,
716	            markdown,
717	            files: BTreeMap::new(),
718	        });
719	    }
720	    Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
721	        "provider did not return acceptance JSON or YAML",
722	        "rerun `deadreckon def-done ...` or use `deadreckon def-done check` after editing criteria",
723	    )))
724	}
725	
726	fn acceptance_json_payload(value: &Value) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceDraft>> {
727	    let Some(object) = value.as_object() else {
728	        return Ok(None);
729	    };
730	    let yaml = object
731	        .get("acceptance_yaml")
732	        .or_else(|| object.get("yaml"))
733	        .and_then(Value::as_str);
734	    let Some(yaml) = yaml else {
735	        return Ok(None);
736	    };
737	    let markdown = object
738	        .get("acceptance_md")
739	        .or_else(|| object.get("markdown"))
740	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
741	        .map(ToString::to_string)
742	        .unwrap_or_else(|| acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(yaml));
743	    acceptance_check_count(yaml)?;
744	    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
745	    if let Some(file_map) = object.get("files").and_then(Value::as_object) {
746	        for (path, body) in file_map {
747	            let Some(body) = body.as_str() else {
748	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
749	                    &format!("acceptance helper {path} must be a string"),
750	                    "return files as {\".deadreckon/acceptance/name\": \"contents\"}",
751	                )));
752	            };
753	            let path = PathBuf::from(path);
754	            validate_acceptance_helper_path(&path)?;
755	            files.insert(path, body.to_string());
756	        }
757	    }
758	    Ok(Some(AcceptanceDraft {
759	        yaml: yaml.to_string(),
760	        markdown,
761	        files,
762	    }))
763	}
764	
765	fn strip_code_fence(value: &str) -> String {
766	    let trimmed = value.trim();
767	    if !trimmed.starts_with("```") {
768	        return trimmed.to_string();
769	    }
770	    let mut lines = trimmed.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
771	    if lines.len() >= 2 && lines.last().is_some_and(|line| line.trim() == "```") {
772	        lines.remove(0);
773	        lines.pop();
774	        return lines.join("\n");
775	    }
776	    trimmed.to_string()
777	}
778	
779	fn extract_json_object(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
780	    let start = value.find('{')?;
781	    let end = value.rfind('}')?;
782	    if end <= start {
783	        return None;
784	    }
785	    Some(value[start..=end].to_string())
786	}
787	
788	fn extract_fenced_block(value: &str, languages: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
789	    let mut in_block = false;
790	    let mut capture = false;
791	    let mut lines = Vec::new();
792	    for line in value.lines() {
793	        let trimmed = line.trim();
794	        if let Some(rest) = trimmed.strip_prefix("```") {
795	            if in_block {
796	                if capture {
797	                    return Some(lines.join("\n"));
798	                }
799	                in_block = false;
800	                continue;
801	            }
802	            in_block = true;
803	            capture = languages
804	                .iter()
805	                .any(|language| rest.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(language));
806	            lines.clear();
807	            continue;
808	        }
809	        if in_block && capture {
810	            lines.push(line);
811	        }
812	    }
813	    None
814	}

816	pub(crate) async fn ensure_acceptance_before_start(
817	    cwd: &Path,
818	    override_path: Option<&Path>,
819	    goal: &str,
820	    provider: Option<String>,
821	    model: Option<String>,
822	    skip_prompt: bool,
823	    noun: &str,
824	) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceSource>> {
825	    let existing = resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, override_path)?;
826	    if existing.is_some() || override_path.is_some() || skip_prompt || !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
827	        return Ok(existing);
828	    }
829	    println!("{}", ui_heading("done criteria"));
830	    println!("No done criteria found.");
831	    println!("Write the definition of done in English; deadreckon will compile it for dr-gate.");
832	    if !prompt::confirm(&format!("write done criteria before this {noun}?"), true)? {
833	        println!("using default gate: working directory exists, or cargo test for Rust projects");
834	        return Ok(existing);
835	    }
836	    let request = prompt::open("definition of done (Enter for a practical default): ", None)?;
837	    let request = if request.trim().is_empty() {
838	        format!("For this {noun}, define practical acceptance checks for: {goal}")
839	    } else {
840	        request.trim().to_string()
841	    };
842	    match acceptance_agent_command_in_dir(
843	        cwd,
844	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft,
845	        vec![request],
846	        provider,
847	        model,
848	        false,
849	    )
850	    .await
851	    {
852	        Ok(()) => resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, None).map(mark_generated_done_criteria),
853	        Err(err) => {
854	            println!("{}", ui_status("done criteria draft failed"));
855	            println!("  {err}");
856	            if !prompt::confirm("use a detected local check template instead?", true)? {
857	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
858	                    "done criteria were requested but not configured",
859	                    "rerun `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"` or answer yes to the detected template fallback",
860	                )));
861	            }
862	            let preset = detect_acceptance_preset(cwd);
863	            let draft = acceptance_template_for_preset(preset, cwd);
864	            write_project_acceptance(cwd, &draft, false, false)?;
865	            print_acceptance_written(
866	                cwd,
867	                "detected template",
868	                acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?,
869	            );
870	            resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, None).map(mark_generated_done_criteria)
871	        }
872	    }
873	}

875	pub(crate) fn resolve_acceptance_source(
876	    cwd: &Path,
877	    override_path: Option<&Path>,
878	) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceSource>> {
879	    if let Some(path) = override_path {
880	        let path = absolute_from(cwd, path);
881	        if !path.is_file() {
882	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
883	                &format!("done criteria file not found: {}", path.display()),
884	                "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"",
885	            )));
886	        }
887	        return Ok(Some(AcceptanceSource {
888	            path,
889	            source: setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ExplicitPath,
890	            companion_doc: None,
891	        }));
892	    }
893	    let project_yaml = project_acceptance_yaml(cwd);
894	    if project_yaml.is_file() {
895	        let project_md = project_acceptance_md(cwd);
896	        return Ok(Some(AcceptanceSource {
897	            path: project_yaml,
898	            source: setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ProjectFile,
899	            companion_doc: project_md.is_file().then_some(project_md),
900	        }));
901	    }
902	    Ok(None)
903	}

914	pub(crate) fn done_criteria_selection(
915	    source: &Option<AcceptanceSource>,
916	) -> Result<setup::DoneCriteriaSelection> {
917	    match source {
918	        Some(source) => {
919	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(&source.path)?;
920	            let checks = Some(acceptance_check_count(&raw)?);
921	            Ok(match source.source {
922	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ExplicitPath => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::explicit(
923	                    source.path.clone(),
924	                    source.companion_doc.clone(),
925	                    checks,
926	                ),
927	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ProjectFile => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::project(
928	                    source.path.clone(),
929	                    source.companion_doc.clone(),
930	                    checks,
931	                ),
932	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::Generated => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::generated(
933	                    source.path.clone(),
934	                    source.companion_doc.clone(),
935	                    checks,
936	                ),
937	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::DefaultGate => {
938	                    setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::default_gate()
939	                }
940	            })
941	        }
942	        None => Ok(setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::default_gate()),
943	    }
944	}

946	pub(crate) fn copy_acceptance_into_run(
947	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
948	    source: &Option<AcceptanceSource>,
949	) -> Result<()> {
950	    let Some(source) = source else {
951	        return Ok(());
952	    };
953	    fs::copy(
954	        &source.path,
955	        acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&state.run_root),
956	    )?;
957	    if let Some(doc) = source.companion_doc.as_ref() {
958	        fs::copy(doc, state.run_root.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_MD))?;
959	    }
960	    let Some(project_dir) = source.path.parent() else {
961	        return Ok(());
962	    };
963	    let helper_source = project_dir.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
964	    if helper_source.is_dir() {
965	        let helper_dest = state
966	            .working_dir
967	            .join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR)
968	            .join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
969	        if !same_path_best_effort(&helper_source, &helper_dest) {
970	            copy_tree(&helper_source, &helper_dest)?;
971	        }
972	    }
973	    Ok(())
974	}

995	fn same_path_best_effort(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> bool {
996	    if left == right {
997	        return true;
998	    }
999	    match (left.canonicalize(), right.canonicalize()) {
1000	        (Ok(left), Ok(right)) => left == right,
1001	        _ => false,
1002	    }
1003	}

1011	                "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"",

1037	pub(crate) fn write_project_acceptance(
1038	    cwd: &Path,
1039	    draft: &AcceptanceDraft,
1040	    force: bool,
1041	    allow_existing: bool,
1042	) -> Result<()> {
1043	    acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?;
1044	    validate_acceptance_yaml_integrity(&draft.yaml)?;
1045	    let dir = cwd.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR);
1046	    let yaml_path = project_acceptance_yaml(cwd);
1047	    let md_path = project_acceptance_md(cwd);
1048	    if !allow_existing && !force && (yaml_path.exists() || md_path.exists()) {
1049	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1050	            ".deadreckon/acceptance files already exist",
1051	            "deadreckon def-done add \"one more criterion\" or rerun with --overwrite",
1052	        )));
1053	    }
1054	    fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
1055	    fs::write(&yaml_path, ensure_trailing_newline(&draft.yaml))?;
1056	    fs::write(&md_path, ensure_trailing_newline(&draft.markdown))?;
1057	    for (relative_path, body) in &draft.files {
1058	        let path = validate_acceptance_helper_path(relative_path)?;
1059	        let absolute = cwd.join(path);
1060	        if !force && absolute.exists() {
1061	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1062	                &format!("acceptance helper already exists: {}", absolute.display()),
1063	                "rerun with --overwrite or edit the helper manually",
1064	            )));
1065	        }
1066	        if let Some(parent) = absolute.parent() {
1067	            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
1068	        }
1069	        fs::write(absolute, ensure_trailing_newline(body))?;
1070	    }
1071	    Ok(())
1072	}
1073	
1074	fn validate_acceptance_helper_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
1075	    if path.is_absolute()
1076	        || path
1077	            .components()
1078	            .any(|component| matches!(component, std::path::Component::ParentDir))
1079	    {
1080	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1081	            &format!("invalid acceptance helper path: {}", path.display()),
1082	            "helper files must live under .deadreckon/acceptance/",
1083	        )));
1084	    }
1085	    let required_prefix = Path::new(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR).join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
1086	    if !path.starts_with(&required_prefix) {
1087	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1088	            &format!("invalid acceptance helper path: {}", path.display()),
1089	            "helper files must live under .deadreckon/acceptance/",
1090	        )));
1091	    }
1092	    Ok(path.to_path_buf())
1093	}

1098	    let primary = "deadreckon def-done check";

1107	                "The criteria are configured; check them once before launching a long run.",
1108	                vec![
1109	                    ("source", source.to_string()),
1110	                    ("checks", checks.to_string()),
1111	                    ("yaml", yaml_path.display().to_string()),
1112	                    ("notes", notes_path.display().to_string()),
1113	                ],
1114	            ),
1115	            vec![("Recommended", primary)],
1116	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon run \"goal\"")],

1118	        .expect("acceptance written verdict surface must be valid")
1119	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))

1123	fn detect_acceptance_preset(cwd: &Path) -> AcceptancePreset {
1124	    if cwd.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
1125	        AcceptancePreset::Rust
1126	    } else if cwd.join("package.json").exists() {
1127	        AcceptancePreset::Node
1128	    } else if cwd.join("index.html").exists() || cwd.join("public/index.html").exists() {
1129	        AcceptancePreset::StaticSite
1130	    } else {
1131	        AcceptancePreset::Basic
1132	    }
1133	}
1134	
1135	pub(crate) fn acceptance_template_for_preset(
1136	    preset: AcceptancePreset,
1137	    cwd: &Path,
1138	) -> AcceptanceDraft {
1139	    let yaml = match preset {
1140	        AcceptancePreset::Auto => unreachable!("auto is resolved before template generation"),
1141	        AcceptancePreset::Rust => {
1142	            "\
1143	name: rust project acceptance
1144	checks:
1145	  - kind: file_exists
1146	    path: \"{working_dir}/Cargo.toml\"
1147	  - kind: cargo_test
1148	"
1149	        }
1150	        AcceptancePreset::Node => {
1151	            "\
1152	name: node project acceptance
1153	checks:
1154	  - kind: file_exists
1155	    path: \"{working_dir}/package.json\"
1156	  - kind: shell
1157	    command: \"npm run build --if-present\"
1158	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1159	  - kind: shell
1160	    command: \"npm test --if-present\"
1161	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1162	    must_pass: false
1163	"
1164	        }
1165	        AcceptancePreset::StaticSite => {
1166	            if cwd.join("public/index.html").exists() && !cwd.join("index.html").exists() {
1167	                "\
1168	name: static site acceptance
1169	checks:
1170	  - kind: file_exists
1171	    path: \"{working_dir}/public/index.html\"
1172	  - kind: shell
1173	    command: \"test -s public/index.html\"
1174	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1175	"
1176	            } else {
1177	                "\
1178	name: static site acceptance
1179	checks:
1180	  - kind: file_exists
1181	    path: \"{working_dir}/index.html\"

1309	fn append_acceptance_checks(existing_raw: &str, addition_raw: &str) -> Result<String> {
1310	    let mut existing = acceptance_yaml_value(existing_raw)?;
1311	    let addition = acceptance_yaml_value(addition_raw)?;
1312	    let mut checks = yaml_mapping_get(&addition, "checks")
1313	        .map(yaml_items)
1314	        .unwrap_or_default()
1315	        .into_iter()
1316	        .cloned()
1317	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1318	    if checks.is_empty() {
1319	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1320	            "acceptance pack did not contain checks",
1321	            "try `deadreckon def-done add browser` or `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"`",
1322	        )));
1323	    }
1324	    let mapping = existing.as_mapping_mut().ok_or_else(|| {
1325	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1326	            "acceptance.yaml must be a mapping",
1327	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" --overwrite`",
1328	        ))
1329	    })?;
1330	    let key = serde_yaml::Value::String("checks".to_string());
1331	    let entry = mapping
1332	        .entry(key)
1333	        .or_insert_with(|| serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(Vec::new()));
1334	    match entry {
1335	        serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(existing_checks) => existing_checks.append(&mut checks),
1336	        other => {
1337	            let mut merged = yaml_items(other).into_iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1338	            merged.append(&mut checks);
1339	            *other = serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(merged);
1340	        }
1341	    }
1342	    serde_yaml::to_string(&existing).map_err(|source| {
1343	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1344	            &format!("failed to write acceptance.yaml: {source}"),
1345	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" --overwrite`",
1346	        ))
1347	    })
1348	}

1350	fn browser_smoke_script() -> &'static str {
1351	    r#"#!/usr/bin/env node
1352	const fs = require('fs');
1353	const http = require('http');
1354	const path = require('path');
1355	
1356	const requestedRoot = process.argv[2];
1357	const candidates = [requestedRoot, 'dist', 'build', 'public', '.'].filter(Boolean);
1358	const root = candidates.find((candidate) => fs.existsSync(path.join(candidate, 'index.html')));
1359	if (!root) {
1360	  console.error('No index.html found in dist, build, public, or project root.');
1361	  process.exit(1);
1362	}
1363	
1364	const mime = new Map([
1365	  ['.html', 'text/html'],
1366	  ['.js', 'text/javascript'],
1367	  ['.css', 'text/css'],
1368	  ['.json', 'application/json'],
1369	  ['.svg', 'image/svg+xml'],
1370	]);
1371	
1372	const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
1373	  const urlPath = decodeURIComponent((req.url || '/').split('?')[0]);
1374	  const safePath = path.normalize(urlPath === '/' ? '/index.html' : urlPath).replace(/^(\.\.[/\\])+/, '');
1375	  const file = path.join(root, safePath);
1376	  if (!file.startsWith(path.resolve(root)) && path.isAbsolute(file)) {
1377	    res.writeHead(403);
1378	    res.end('forbidden');
1379	    return;
1380	  }
1381	  fs.readFile(file, (err, body) => {
1382	    if (err) {
1383	      res.writeHead(404);
1384	      res.end('missing');
1385	      return;
1386	    }
1387	    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': mime.get(path.extname(file)) || 'application/octet-stream' });
1388	    res.end(body);
1389	  });
1390	});
1391	
1392	server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', async () => {
1393	  const { port } = server.address();
1394	  try {
1395	    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
1396	    const body = await response.text();
1397	    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
1398	    if (!/<html[\s>]/i.test(body)) throw new Error('index response did not look like HTML');
1399	    console.log(`loaded ${root}/index.html over HTTP`);
1400	  } catch (error) {
1401	    console.error(error.message || String(error));
1402	    process.exitCode = 1;
1403	  } finally {
1404	    server.close();
1405	  }
1406	});
1407	"#
1408	}

1414	  const errors = [];
1415	  page.on('console', (message) => {

1469	fn describe_acceptance_item(group: &str, item: &serde_yaml::Value) -> String {
1470	    if let Some(command) = item.as_str() {
1471	        return format!("{group}: shell {}", one_line(command, 96));
1472	    }
1473	    let Some(mapping) = item.as_mapping() else {
1474	        return format!("{group}: {}", one_line(&format!("{item:?}"), 120));
1475	    };
1476	    let kind = yaml_mapping_get(item, "kind")
1477	        .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1478	        .map(ToString::to_string)
1479	        .or_else(|| {
1480	            if mapping.len() == 1 {
1481	                mapping
1482	                    .keys()
1483	                    .next()
1484	                    .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1485	                    .map(ToString::to_string)
1486	            } else {
1487	                None
1488	            }
1489	        })
1490	        .unwrap_or_else(|| group.to_string());
1491	    let path = yaml_mapping_get(item, "path")
1492	        .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1493	        .or_else(|| yaml_mapping_get(item, "cwd").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str));
1494	    let command = yaml_mapping_get(item, "command").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str);
1495	    let pattern = yaml_mapping_get(item, "pattern").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str);
1496	    let detail = command
1497	        .or(path)
1498	        .or(pattern)
1499	        .map(|value| one_line(value, 96))
1500	        .unwrap_or_else(|| one_line(&format!("{item:?}"), 96));
1501	    format!("{group}: {kind} {detail}")
1502	}

1504	pub(crate) fn acceptance_check_count(raw: &str) -> Result<usize> {
1505	    let root = acceptance_yaml_value(raw)?;
1506	    let mut count = 0;
1507	    for key in [
1508	        "checks",
1509	        "required",
1510	        "optional",
1511	        "tests",
1512	        "file-exists",
1513	        "content-match",
1514	        "build-success",
1515	    ] {
1516	        if let Some(value) = yaml_mapping_get(&root, key) {
1517	            count += yaml_items(value).len();
1518	        }
1519	    }
1520	    if count == 0 {
1521	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1522	            "acceptance.yaml does not contain any recognized checks",
1523	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"`",
1524	        )));
1525	    }
1526	    Ok(count)
1527	}

1553	fn yaml_mapping_get<'a>(value: &'a serde_yaml::Value, key: &str) -> Option<&'a serde_yaml::Value> {

109	    match mode {
110	        CodebaseMode::Worktree => apply_command(
111	            state.run_id,
112	            strategy,
113	            branch,
114	            no_confirm,
115	            autostash,
116	            cleanup,
117	            message,
118	            false,
119	        ),
120	        CodebaseMode::Copy | CodebaseMode::Fresh => {
121	            materialize_completed_run(&paths, &state, dest, force, include_manifest)
122	                .map(|materialized| print_materialized(&materialized))
123	        }
124	        CodebaseMode::InPlace => {
125	            let prefix = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
126	            println!(
127	                "{} {}",
128	                ui_ok("finished in-place run"),
129	                ui_id(&state.run_id)
130	            );
131	            println!("  working: {}", state.working_dir.display());
132	            println!(
133	                "{}",
134	                VerdictSurface::try_new(
135	                    VerdictKind::Completed,
136	                    "run",
137	                    Some(&prefix),
138	                    ExplanationPanel::new(
139	                        "DeadReckon finished the in-place run and left the checkout as the result.",
140	                        "The safest next command is inspection because the changes already live in the working tree.",
141	                        vec![
142	                            ("run".to_string(), prefix.clone()),
143	                            ("status".to_string(), run_status_label(state.status).to_string()),
144	                            ("working".to_string(), state.working_dir.display().to_string()),
145	                        ],
146	                    ),
147	                    vec![("Recommended", format!("deadreckon show {prefix}"))],
148	                    vec![
149	                        (
150	                            "Secondary",
151	                            format!("deadreckon doc {prefix} --kind decisions"),
152	                        ),
153	                        ("Secondary", format!("deadreckon undo --run {prefix}")),
154	                    ],
155	                )
156	                .expect("in-place finish verdict surface must have one primary action")
157	                .render_plain(false)
158	            );
159	            Ok(())
160	        }
161	    }
162	}

171	pub(crate) struct MaterializedRun {
172	    run_id: String,
173	    source: PathBuf,
174	    dest: PathBuf,
175	}
176	
177	pub(crate) fn materialize_completed_run(
178	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
179	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
180	    dest: Option<PathBuf>,
181	    force: bool,
182	    include_manifest: bool,
183	) -> Result<MaterializedRun> {
184	    ensure_completed_run(state, "materialize")?;
185	    if let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) {
186	        match record.mode {
187	            CodebaseMode::Worktree => {
188	                return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
189	                    "materialize",
190	                    state,
191	                    record.mode,
192	                    "export is for copy/fresh runs; run was worktree",
193	                    format!("deadreckon apply {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
194	                    "Materialize exports copy/fresh artifacts, while this run already has a worktree branch that should be applied instead.",
195	                ));
196	            }
197	            CodebaseMode::InPlace => {
198	                return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
199	                    "materialize",
200	                    state,
201	                    record.mode,
202	                    "export is not needed; run edited the source in-place",
203	                    format!("deadreckon undo --run {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
204	                    "Materialize would duplicate work already written in place; use undo only if those edits need to be reverted.",
205	                ));
206	            }
207	            CodebaseMode::Copy | CodebaseMode::Fresh => {}
208	        }
209	    }
210	    let library_dir = paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id);
211	    if !library_dir.is_dir() {
212	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!(
213	            "library missing for run {}; was promotion successful?",
214	            state.run_id
215	        ))));
216	    }
217	
218	    let dest = absolute_dest(dest.unwrap_or_else(|| {
219	        std::env::current_dir()
220	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."))
221	            .join(run_prefix(&state.run_id))
222	    }))?;
223	    refuse_dest_inside_home(paths, &dest, "export")?;
224	    prepare_empty_dest(&dest, force)?;
225	
226	    copy_tree(&library_dir, &dest)?;
227	    if !include_manifest {
228	        remove_if_exists(&dest.join("manifest.json"))?;
229	    }
230	    remove_if_exists(&dest.join(".materialized-to"))?;
231	    write_parent_marker(
232	        &dest.join(".deadreckon").join("parent.json"),
233	        &materialized_parent_marker(state),
234	    )?;
235	    normalize_permissions(&dest)?;
236	    append_materialized_marker(&library_dir, &dest)?;
237	
238	    Ok(MaterializedRun {
239	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
240	        source: library_dir,
241	        dest,
242	    })
243	}

245	pub(crate) fn print_materialized(materialized: &MaterializedRun) {
246	    println!(
247	        "{}",
248	        materialized_surface(materialized).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
249	    );
250	}

252	fn materialized_surface(materialized: &MaterializedRun) -> VerdictSurface {
253	    let id = run_prefix(&materialized.run_id);
254	    let primary = format!("deadreckon show {id}");
255	    let secondary = "deadreckon status".to_string();
256	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
257	        VerdictKind::Completed,
258	        "materialize",
259	        Some(&id),
260	        ExplanationPanel::new(
261	            "DeadReckon exported run output into the requested destination.",
262	            "Materialize completed because the run was already completed, the destination was safe to write, and the library artifact was copied.",
263	            vec![
264	                ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
265	                ("source".to_string(), materialized.source.display().to_string()),
266	                ("dest".to_string(), materialized.dest.display().to_string()),
267	            ],
268	        ),
269	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
270	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
271	    )
272	    .expect("materialize verdict surface must be valid")
273	}

321	// SAFETY: Apply arguments are owned clap values at the command boundary.
322	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
323	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
324	fn apply_command_inner(
325	    run_id: String,
326	    strategy: String,
327	    target_branch: Option<String>,
328	    no_confirm: bool,
329	    autostash: bool,
330	    cleanup: bool,
331	    message: Option<String>,
332	    quiet: bool,
333	    _plain: bool,
334	) -> Result<()> {
335	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
336	    let mut state = match load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id) {
337	        Ok(state) => state,
338	        Err(run_error) => match resolve_plan_result_run(&paths, &run_id, "apply")? {
339	            Some(result) => {
340	                if !quiet {
341	                    print_plan_result_context(&result.plan, &result.state);
342	                }
343	                prepare_plan_result_apply_state(&paths, &result.plan, &result.state)?
344	            }
345	            None => return Err(run_error),
346	        },
347	    };
348	    ensure_completed_run(&state, "apply")?;
349	    let record = match read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) {
350	        Ok(record) => record,
351	        Err(source) => match prepare_result_run_apply_state(&paths, &state, quiet)? {
352	            Some(prepared) => {
353	                state = prepared;
354	                read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir)?
355	            }
356	            None => return Err(apply_missing_codebase_error(&paths, &state, source)),
357	        },
358	    };
359	    if record.mode != CodebaseMode::Worktree {
360	        return Err(apply_mode_error(&state, record.mode));
361	    }
362	    let git_root = record.source_git_root.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
363	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
364	            "missing source_git_root".to_string(),
365	        ))
366	    })?;
367	    let branch = record.branch_name.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
368	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
369	            "missing branch_name".to_string(),
370	        ))
371	    })?;
372	    let target =
373	        target_branch.unwrap_or(git_stdout(git_root, &["symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD"])?);
374	    let diff_stat = git_stdout(
375	        git_root,
376	        &["diff", "--stat", &format!("{target}..{branch}")],
377	    )
378	    .unwrap_or_default();
379	    if diff_stat.trim().is_empty() {
380	        if !quiet {
381	            print_already_applied(&state, branch, &target);
382	        }
383	        let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
384	        if !quiet {
385	            print!(
386	                "{}",
387	                apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
388	                    .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
389	            );
390	        }
391	        return Ok(());
392	    }
393	    if !quiet {
394	        eprintln!(
395	            "{}",
396	            ui::render(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Heading, "changes to apply:")
397	        );
398	        eprintln!("{diff_stat}");
399	    }
400	
401	    if !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
402	        if !prompt::confirm("apply these changes?", true)? {
403	            println!("cancelled");
404	            return Ok(());
405	        }
406	    } else if !no_confirm && !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
407	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
408	            "non-interactive apply requires --no-confirm",
409	            &format!("deadreckon apply {} --no-confirm", state.run_id),
410	        )));
411	    }
412	
413	    let autostash = prepare_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, autostash, no_confirm)?;
414	
415	    let (commit_subject, commit_body) = match message {
416	        Some(message) => (message, None),
417	        None => (
418	            format!(
419	                "{} (deadreckon run {})",
420	                state.goal.lines().next().unwrap_or("deadreckon run"),
421	                state.run_id.chars().take(8).collect::<String>()
422	            ),
423	            Some(apply_commit_body(&state)),
424	        ),
425	    };
426	    let full_merge_message = commit_body
427	        .as_ref()
428	        .map(|body| format!("{commit_subject}\n\n{body}"))
429	        .unwrap_or_else(|| commit_subject.clone());
430	    match strategy.as_str() {
431	        "merge" => git_status(
432	            git_root,
433	            &["merge", "--no-ff", branch, "-m", &full_merge_message],
434	        )
435	        .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?,
436	        "squash" => {
437	            git_status(git_root, &["merge", "--squash", branch])
438	                .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?;
439	            let staged_stat = git_stdout(git_root, &["diff", "--cached", "--stat"])?;
440	            if staged_stat.trim().is_empty() {
441	                if let Some(stash) = autostash.as_ref() {
442	                    restore_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, stash)?;
443	                }
444	                if !quiet {
445	                    print_already_applied(&state, branch, &target);
446	                }
447	                let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
448	                if !quiet {
449	                    print!(
450	                        "{}",
451	                        apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
452	                            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
453	                    );
454	                }
455	                return Ok(());
456	            }
457	            if let Some(body) = commit_body.as_deref() {
458	                git_status(git_root, &["commit", "-m", &commit_subject, "-m", body])?;
459	            } else {
460	                git_status(git_root, &["commit", "-m", &commit_subject])?;
461	            }
462	        }
463	        "cherry-pick" => {
464	            let base = record.base_sha.as_deref().unwrap_or("HEAD");
465	            git_status(git_root, &["cherry-pick", &format!("{base}..{branch}")])
466	                .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?;
467	        }
468	        other => {
469	            return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
470	                "unknown git apply strategy {other}"
471	            ))));
472	        }
473	    }
474	    if let Some(stash) = autostash.as_ref() {
475	        restore_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, stash)?;
476	    }
477	    if !quiet {
478	        println!(
479	            "{} {} into {}",
480	            ui_ok("applied"),
481	            ui_id(&state.run_id),
482	            target
483	        );
484	        println!("{}", git_stdout(git_root, &["log", "-1", "--stat"])?);
485	    }
486	    let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
487	    if !quiet {
488	        print!(
489	            "{}",
490	            apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
491	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
492	        );
493	    }
494	    Ok(())
495	}
496	
497	fn prepare_result_run_apply_state(
498	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
499	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
500	    quiet: bool,
501	) -> Result<Option<deadreckon_core::PipelineState>> {
502	    let Some(plan_id) = result_plan_id(paths, state)? else {
503	        return Ok(None);
504	    };
505	    if let Ok(plan) = load_plan(paths, &plan_id) {
506	        if !quiet {
507	            print_plan_result_context(&plan, state);
508	        }
509	        return prepare_plan_result_apply_state(paths, &plan, state).map(Some);
510	    }
511	    if let Some((campaign_dir, campaign)) =
512	        crate::commands::campaign::resolve_campaign(paths, &plan_id)?
513	    {
514	        let plan = crate::commands::campaign::campaign_as_apply_plan(
515	            paths,
516	            &campaign_dir,
517	            &campaign,
518	            &state.cwd,
519	        )?;
520	        if plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() != Some(state.run_id.as_str()) {
521	            return Ok(None);
522	        }
523	        if !quiet {
524	            print_plan_result_context(&plan, state);
525	        }
526	        return prepare_plan_result_apply_state(paths, &plan, state).map(Some);
527	    }
528	    Ok(None)
529	}

531	fn result_plan_id(
532	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
533	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
534	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
535	    let library = paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id);
536	    if let Some(plan_id) =
537	        result_manifest_id(&library.join("deadreckon-plan-manifest.json"), "plan_id")?
538	    {
539	        return Ok(Some(plan_id));
540	    }
541	    result_manifest_id(
542	        &library.join("deadreckon-campaign-manifest.json"),
543	        "campaign_id",
544	    )
545	}
546	
547	fn result_manifest_id(path: &Path, key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
548	    match fs::read(&path) {
549	        Ok(bytes) => {
550	            let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
551	            Ok(value.get(key).and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_string))
552	        }
553	        Err(source) if source.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
554	        Err(source) => Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::Io {
555	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
556	            source,
557	        })),
558	    }
559	}

561	fn apply_missing_codebase_error(
562	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
563	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
564	    source: DeadreckonError,
565	) -> CliError {
566	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
567	    let library = paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id);
568	    CliError::Surface {
569	        code: 1,
570	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
571	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
572	            "apply",
573	            Some(&id),
574	            ExplanationPanel::new(
575	                "DeadReckon could not find a worktree record for this completed run.",
576	                "Apply only merges worktree-backed runs or completed plan/campaign results with recoverable source metadata; use finish/export to copy this library result.",
577	                [
578	                    ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
579	                    ("status".to_string(), run_status_label(state.status).to_string()),
580	                    ("library".to_string(), library.display().to_string()),
581	                    ("missing".to_string(), source.to_string()),
582	                ],
583	            ),
584	            vec![("Recommended", format!("deadreckon finish {id}"))],
585	            vec![("Secondary", format!("deadreckon export {id} --dest <path>"))],
586	        )
587	        .expect("apply missing-codebase refusal surface must be valid")
588	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
589	    }
590	}

603	
604	fn apply_completed_surface(
605	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
606	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
607	    target: &str,
608	    cleaned: bool,
609	) -> VerdictSurface {
610	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
611	    let primary = if cleaned {
612	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
613	    } else {
614	        format!("deadreckon cleanup {id}")
615	    };
616	    let secondary = if cleaned {
617	        "deadreckon status".to_string()
618	    } else {
619	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
620	    };
621	    let mut evidence = vec![
622	        ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
623	        ("target branch".to_string(), target.to_string()),
624	        (
625	            "run branch".to_string(),
626	            record
627	                .branch_name
628	                .clone()
629	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string()),
630	        ),
631	        ("mode".to_string(), record.mode.to_string()),
632	        (
633	            "cleanup".to_string(),
634	            if cleaned {
635	                "completed".to_string()
636	            } else {
637	                "pending".to_string()
638	            },
639	        ),
640	    ];
641	    if let Some(worktree) = record.worktree_path.as_ref() {
642	        evidence.push(("worktree".to_string(), worktree.display().to_string()));
643	    }
644	    if let Some(source) = record.source_git_root.as_ref() {
645	        evidence.push(("source git root".to_string(), source.display().to_string()));
646	    }
647	    let why = if cleaned {
648	        "The apply transition is complete and temporary resources were removed; inspect the run record before further cleanup or recovery."
649	    } else {
650	        "The apply transition is complete, but the temporary worktree resources remain; cleanup is the safest next command."
651	    };
652	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
653	        VerdictKind::Completed,
654	        "apply",
655	        Some(&id),
656	        ExplanationPanel::new(
657	            "DeadReckon applied or confirmed the run branch in the target checkout.",
658	            why,
659	            evidence,
660	        ),
661	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
662	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
663	    )
664	    .expect("apply completion verdict surface must be valid")
665	}

667	fn finish_apply_cleanup(
668	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
669	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
670	    cleanup: bool,
671	    no_confirm: bool,
672	) -> Result<bool> {
673	    let cleanup_now = cleanup || should_prompt_cleanup(no_confirm)?;
674	    if cleanup_now {
675	        cleanup_worktree_run(state, record, false, false, CleanupReason::Applied)?;
676	    }
677	    Ok(cleanup_now)
678	}

680	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
681	struct ApplyAutoStash {
682	    refname: String,
683	}
684	
685	fn prepare_apply_autostash(
686	    git_root: &Path,
687	    run_id: &str,
688	    requested: bool,
689	    no_confirm: bool,
690	) -> Result<Option<ApplyAutoStash>> {
691	    let dirty = git_stdout(git_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?;
692	    if dirty.trim().is_empty() {
693	        return Ok(None);
694	    }
695	
696	    eprintln!(
697	        "{}",
698	        ui::render(
699	            ui::Stream::Stderr,
700	            ui::Tone::Warn,
701	            "working tree has uncommitted changes:",
702	        )
703	    );
704	    for line in dirty.lines().take(30) {
705	        eprintln!("  {line}");
706	    }
707	    if dirty.lines().count() > 30 {
708	        eprintln!("  ...");
709	    }
710	
711	    let mut should_stash = requested;
712	    if !should_stash && !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
713	        should_stash =
714	            prompt::confirm("stash these changes during apply and restore after?", true)?;
715	    }
716	
717	    if !should_stash {
718	        return Err(apply_dirty_error(
719	            git_root,
720	            run_id,
721	            no_confirm,
722	            dirty.as_str(),
723	        ));
724	    }
725	
726	    let marker = format!(
727	        "deadreckon apply {} autostash {}",
728	        run_prefix(run_id),
729	        Utc::now().timestamp_millis()
730	    );
731	    git_status(git_root, &["stash", "push", "-u", "-m", &marker])?;
732	    let refname = find_stash_by_marker(git_root, &marker)?.ok_or_else(|| {
733	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
734	            "git stash succeeded but the new stash could not be found".to_string(),
735	        ))
736	    })?;
737	    eprintln!("stashed local changes as {refname}");
738	    Ok(Some(ApplyAutoStash { refname }))
739	}

776	fn find_stash_by_marker(git_root: &Path, marker: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
777	    let output = git_stdout(git_root, &["stash", "list", "--format=%gd%x00%s"])?;
778	    for line in output.lines() {
779	        if let Some((refname, subject)) = line.split_once('\0')
780	            && subject.contains(marker)
781	        {
782	            return Ok(Some(refname.to_string()));
783	        }
784	    }
785	    Ok(None)
786	}

802	    let cleanup = format!("deadreckon cleanup {id}");

804	    let stash_hint;

818	                [

820	                    ("primary evidence".to_string(), "git merge failed".to_string()),
821	                    (
822	                        "autostash".to_string(),
823	                        autostash
824	                            .as_ref()
825	                            .map(|stash| stash.refname.clone())
826	                            .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string()),
827	                    ),
828	                ],
829	            ),
830	            vec![("Recommended", "git status")],

845	// SAFETY: Abandon arguments are owned clap values at the command boundary.
846	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
847	pub(crate) fn abandon_command(run_id: String, keep_branch: bool, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
848	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
849	    let mut state = load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id)?;
850	    let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) else {
851	        print!(
852	            "{}",
853	            cleanup_noop_surface(
854	                "abandon",
855	                Some(&run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
856	                "DeadReckon did not find a temporary worktree record for this run.",
857	                "There is no worktree or temporary branch for abandon to remove; inspect the run before choosing another cleanup command.",
858	                vec![
859	                    ("run".to_string(), run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
860	                    ("status".to_string(), run_status_label(state.status).to_string()),
861	                    (
862	                        "workspace".to_string(),
863	                        state.working_dir.display().to_string(),
864	                    ),
865	                ],
866	                format!("deadreckon show {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
867	                Vec::<String>::new(),
868	            )
869	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
870	        );
871	        return Ok(());
872	    };
873	    if record.mode == CodebaseMode::InPlace {
874	        return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
875	            "abandon",
876	            &state,
877	            record.mode,
878	            "cannot abandon in-place edits",
879	            format!("deadreckon undo --run {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
880	            "Abandon removes temporary worktrees; this run changed the source checkout directly, so undo is the safe recovery command.",
881	        ));
882	    }
883	    if state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
884	        if !force {
885	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
886	                &format!("run {} is {}", state.run_id, run_status_label(state.status)),
887	                &format!("deadreckon kill {} --escalate", state.run_id),
888	            )));
889	        }
890	        let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut state, true);
891	    }
892	    let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
893	        &state,
894	        &record,
895	        keep_branch,
896	        force,
897	        CleanupReason::Abandoned,
898	    )?;
899	    print_cleanup_results(&[result]);
900	    Ok(())
901	}

903	pub(crate) struct CleanupCommandRequest {
904	    pub(crate) run_id: Option<String>,
905	    pub(crate) all: bool,
906	    pub(crate) completed: bool,
907	    pub(crate) stale: bool,
908	    pub(crate) no_confirm: bool,
909	    pub(crate) escalate: bool,
910	    pub(crate) overwrite: bool,
911	    pub(crate) keep_branch: bool,
912	}
913	
914	pub(crate) fn cleanup_command(args: CleanupCommandRequest) -> Result<()> {
915	    let CleanupCommandRequest {
916	        run_id,
917	        all,
918	        completed,
919	        stale,
920	        no_confirm,
921	        escalate,
922	        overwrite,
923	        keep_branch,
924	    } = args;
925	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
926	    if let Some(run_id) = run_id {
927	        let mut state = load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id)?;
928	        if state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
929	            if !escalate {
930	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
931	                    &format!("run {} is {}", state.run_id, run_status_label(state.status)),
932	                    &format!("deadreckon cleanup {} --escalate", state.run_id),
933	                )));
934	            }
935	            let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut state, escalate);
936	        }
937	        let record = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir)?;
938	        let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
939	            &state,
940	            &record,
941	            keep_branch,
942	            overwrite,
943	            CleanupReason::Cleaned,
944	        )?;
945	        print_cleanup_results(&[result]);
946	        return Ok(());
947	    }
948	
949	    let candidates = cleanup_candidates(&paths, all, completed, stale)?;
950	    if candidates.is_empty() {
951	        print!(
952	            "{}",
953	            cleanup_no_candidates_surface(completed, all)
954	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
955	        );
956	        return Ok(());
957	    }
958	
959	    println!("cleanup candidates:");
960	    for candidate in &candidates {
961	        println!(
962	            "  {:<8} {:<10} {:<16} {}",
963	            run_prefix(&candidate.state.run_id),
964	            candidate.state.status,
965	            candidate.reason,
966	            one_line(&candidate.state.goal, 72)
967	        );
968	    }
969	    if !no_confirm {
970	        if !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
971	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
972	                "non-interactive cleanup requires --no-confirm",
973	                "deadreckon cleanup --no-confirm",
974	            )));
975	        }
976	        if !prompt::confirm("clean these runs?", false)? {
977	            println!("cancelled");
978	            return Ok(());
979	        }
980	    }
981	
982	    let mut results = Vec::new();
983	    for mut candidate in candidates {
984	        if candidate.state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
985	            let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut candidate.state, escalate);
986	        }
987	        let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
988	            &candidate.state,
989	            &candidate.record,
990	            keep_branch,
991	            overwrite,
992	            CleanupReason::Cleaned,
993	        )?;
994	        results.push(result);
995	    }
996	    print_cleanup_results(&results);
997	    Ok(())
998	}

1000	#[derive(Debug)]
1001	struct CleanupCandidate {
1002	    state: deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1003	    record: CodebaseRecord,
1004	    reason: String,
1005	}
1006	
1007	fn cleanup_candidates(
1008	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1009	    all: bool,
1010	    include_completed: bool,
1011	    include_stale: bool,
1012	) -> Result<Vec<CleanupCandidate>> {
1013	    let scope = if all { None } else { Some(current_scope()?) };
1014	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
1015	    for run in list_runs(paths, scope.as_deref())? {
1016	        let Ok(state) = load_run(paths, &run.run_id) else {
1017	            continue;
1018	        };
1019	        let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) else {
1020	            continue;
1021	        };
1022	        if record.mode != CodebaseMode::Worktree {
1023	            continue;
1024	        }
1025	        let abandoned = state.run_root.join("abandoned.json").exists();
1026	        let stale = include_stale && is_stale_executing(&state);
1027	        let completed = include_completed && state.status == RunStatus::Completed && !abandoned;
1028	        if abandoned || stale || completed {
1029	            let reason = if abandoned {
1030	                "cleaned".to_string()
1031	            } else if stale {
1032	                "stale".to_string()
1033	            } else {
1034	                "completed".to_string()
1035	            };
1036	            candidates.push(CleanupCandidate {
1037	                state,
1038	                record,
1039	                reason,
1040	            });
1041	        }
1042	    }
1043	    Ok(candidates)
1044	}

1046	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
1047	enum CleanupReason {
1048	    Abandoned,
1049	    Applied,
1050	    Cleaned,
1051	}
1052	
1053	impl CleanupReason {
1054	    fn marker(self) -> &'static str {
1055	        match self {
1056	            Self::Abandoned => "abandoned",
1057	            Self::Applied => "applied",
1058	            Self::Cleaned => "cleaned",
1059	        }
1060	    }
1061	
1062	    fn subject(self) -> &'static str {
1063	        match self {
1064	            Self::Abandoned => "abandon",
1065	            Self::Applied | Self::Cleaned => "cleanup",
1066	        }
1067	    }
1068	}

1070	#[derive(Debug)]
1071	struct CleanupRunResult {
1072	    run_id: String,
1073	    status: RunStatus,
1074	    mode: CodebaseMode,
1075	    removed: Vec<String>,
1076	    keep_branch: bool,
1077	    force: bool,
1078	    reason: CleanupReason,
1079	}
1080	
1081	fn cleanup_worktree_run(
1082	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1083	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
1084	    keep_branch: bool,
1085	    force: bool,
1086	    reason: CleanupReason,
1087	) -> Result<CleanupRunResult> {
1088	    let mut removed = Vec::new();
1089	    if record.mode == CodebaseMode::Worktree
1090	        && let (Some(git_root), Some(worktree)) = (
1091	            record.source_git_root.as_ref(),
1092	            record.worktree_path.as_ref(),
1093	        )
1094	    {
1095	        if worktree.exists() {
1096	            let mut args = vec!["worktree", "remove"];
1097	            if force {
1098	                args.push("--force");
1099	            }
1100	            args.push(path_to_str(worktree)?);
1101	            let _ = git_status(git_root, &args);
1102	            removed.push(worktree.display().to_string());
1103	        }
1104	        if !keep_branch
1105	            && let Some(branch) = record.branch_name.as_deref()
1106	            && git_stdout(git_root, &["rev-parse", "--verify", branch]).is_ok()
1107	        {
1108	            let _ = git_status(git_root, &["branch", "-D", branch]);
1109	            removed.push(format!("branch {branch}"));
1110	        }
1111	    }
1112	    write_abandoned_marker(state, reason)?;
1113	    Ok(CleanupRunResult {
1114	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
1115	        status: state.status,
1116	        mode: record.mode,
1117	        removed,
1118	        keep_branch,
1119	        force,
1120	        reason,
1121	    })
1122	}
1123	
1124	fn print_cleanup_results(results: &[CleanupRunResult]) {
1125	    if results.len() == 1 {
1126	        print!(
1127	            "{}",
1128	            cleanup_result_surface(&results[0]).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1129	        );
1130	        return;
1131	    }
1132	    let removed_count = results
1133	        .iter()
1134	        .map(|result| result.removed.len())
1135	        .sum::<usize>();
1136	    let subject = format!("{} runs", results.len());
1137	    let primary = "deadreckon status".to_string();
1138	    let secondary = "deadreckon list --all".to_string();
1139	    let mut evidence = vec![
1140	        ("runs".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
1141	        ("removed entries".to_string(), removed_count.to_string()),
1142	    ];
1143	    for result in results.iter().take(5) {
1144	        evidence.push((
1145	            format!("run {}", run_prefix(&result.run_id)),
1146	            format!("{} removed", result.removed.len()),
1147	        ));
1148	    }
1149	    print!(
1150	        "{}",
1151	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
1152	            VerdictKind::Completed,
1153	            "cleanup",
1154	            Some(&subject),
1155	            ExplanationPanel::new(
1156	                "DeadReckon removed the selected temporary run worktrees and branches.",
1157	                "Cleanup completed across multiple runs; inspect status before starting another destructive cleanup.",
1158	                evidence,
1159	            ),
1160	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1161	            vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
1162	        )
1163	        .expect("aggregate cleanup verdict surface must be valid")
1164	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1165	    );
1166	}
1167	
1168	fn cleanup_result_surface(result: &CleanupRunResult) -> VerdictSurface {
1169	    let id = run_prefix(&result.run_id);
1170	    let primary = format!("deadreckon show {id}");
1171	    let secondary = "deadreckon status".to_string();
1172	    let mut evidence = vec![
1173	        ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
1174	        (
1175	            "status".to_string(),
1176	            run_status_label(result.status).to_string(),
1177	        ),
1178	        ("mode".to_string(), result.mode.to_string()),
1179	        (
1180	            "removed entries".to_string(),
1181	            result.removed.len().to_string(),
1182	        ),
1183	        (
1184	            "branch".to_string(),
1185	            if result.keep_branch {
1186	                "kept".to_string()
1187	            } else {
1188	                "removed when present".to_string()
1189	            },
1190	        ),
1191	    ];
1192	    if result.force {
1193	        evidence.push(("force".to_string(), "true".to_string()));
1194	    }
1195	    for (index, item) in result.removed.iter().take(5).enumerate() {
1196	        evidence.push((format!("removed {}", index + 1), item.clone()));
1197	    }
1198	    if result.removed.len() > 5 {
1199	        evidence.push((
1200	            "additional removed entries".to_string(),
1201	            (result.removed.len() - 5).to_string(),
1202	        ));
1203	    }
1204	    let what = match result.reason {
1205	        CleanupReason::Abandoned => {
1206	            "DeadReckon marked the run abandoned and removed its temporary worktree resources."
1207	        }
1208	        CleanupReason::Applied => {
1209	            "DeadReckon removed temporary worktree resources after applying the run."
1210	        }
1211	        CleanupReason::Cleaned => {
1212	            "DeadReckon removed the selected temporary run worktree resources."
1213	        }
1214	    };
1215	    let why = match result.reason {
1216	        CleanupReason::Abandoned => {
1217	            "This is completed abandon cleanup; inspect the run record if you need provenance or docs."
1218	        }
1219	        CleanupReason::Applied | CleanupReason::Cleaned => {
1220	            "This is completed cleanup; inspect the run record before further recovery or deletion."
1221	        }
1222	    };
1223	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1224	        VerdictKind::Completed,
1225	        result.reason.subject(),
1226	        Some(&id),
1227	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1228	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1229	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
1230	    )
1231	    .expect("cleanup verdict surface must be valid")
1232	}

1234	fn cleanup_no_candidates_surface(completed: bool, all: bool) -> VerdictSurface {
1235	    let mut secondary = Vec::new();
1236	    let primary = if !completed {
1237	        if !all {
1238	            secondary.push("deadreckon cleanup --all-scopes".to_string());
1239	        }
1240	        "deadreckon cleanup --completed".to_string()
1241	    } else if !all {
1242	        "deadreckon cleanup --all-scopes".to_string()
1243	    } else {
1244	        "deadreckon status".to_string()
1245	    };
1246	    cleanup_noop_surface(
1247	        "cleanup",
1248	        None,
1249	        "DeadReckon did not find any temporary run worktrees or branches matching this cleanup filter.",
1250	        "No cleanup mutation was made; broaden the safe filter if you expected completed or cross-scope candidates.",
1251	        vec![
1252	            ("completed filter".to_string(), completed.to_string()),
1253	            ("all scopes".to_string(), all.to_string()),
1254	        ],
1255	        primary,
1256	        secondary,
1257	    )
1258	}
1259	
1260	fn cleanup_noop_surface(
1261	    subject_kind: &str,
1262	    subject: Option<&str>,
1263	    what: impl Into<String>,
1264	    why: impl Into<String>,
1265	    evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
1266	    primary: String,
1267	    secondary: Vec<String>,
1268	) -> VerdictSurface {
1269	    let secondary = secondary
1270	        .iter()
1271	        .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1272	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1273	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1274	        VerdictKind::Noop,
1275	        subject_kind,
1276	        subject,
1277	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1278	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1279	        secondary,
1280	    )
1281	    .expect("cleanup no-op verdict surface must be valid")
1282	}

1323	fn apply_mode_error(state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState, mode: CodebaseMode) -> CliError {
1324	    let run_id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
1325	    let primary = match mode {
1326	        CodebaseMode::Copy | CodebaseMode::Fresh => {
1327	            format!("deadreckon export {run_id} --dest <path>")
1328	        }
1329	        CodebaseMode::InPlace => format!("deadreckon undo --run {run_id}"),
1330	        CodebaseMode::Worktree => format!("deadreckon apply {run_id}"),
1331	    };
1332	    codebase_mode_refusal_error(
1333	        "apply",
1334	        state,
1335	        mode,
1336	        &format!("apply requires worktree mode; run was {mode}"),
1337	        primary,
1338	        "Apply only lands isolated worktree branches; choose the recovery command that matches this run's source mode.",
1339	    )

305	fn pad_rendered(value: &str, width: usize, render: Option<fn(String) -> String>) -> String {

315	        return vec![String::new()];
316	    }
317	    let mut lines = wrap_words(&compact, width.max(8));
318	    let truncated = lines.len() > LIST_GOAL_MAX_LINES;
319	    if truncated {
320	        lines.truncate(LIST_GOAL_MAX_LINES);
321	        if let Some(last) = lines.last_mut() {
322	            *last = ellipsize_goal_line(last, width);
323	        }
324	    }
325	    lines
326	}
327	
328	fn ellipsize_goal_line(value: &str, width: usize) -> String {
329	    if width <= 3 {
330	        return ".".repeat(width);
331	    }
332	    let prefix = width - 3;
333	    format!("{}...", value.chars().take(prefix).collect::<String>())
334	}
335	
336	fn wrap_words(value: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
337	    crate::ui::wrap_words(value, width)
338	}
