356	pub(crate) struct PlanListEntry {
357	    pub(crate) plan_id: String,
358	    pub(crate) merged_run_id: Option<String>,
359	    pub(crate) scope: String,
360	    pub(crate) goal: String,
361	    pub(crate) status: PlanStatus,
362	    pub(crate) mode: PlanMode,
363	    pub(crate) updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
364	    pub(crate) plan_path: PathBuf,
365	    pub(crate) completed_children: usize,
366	    pub(crate) total_children: usize,
367	}
368	
369	pub(crate) fn list_plan_entries(
370	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
371	    scope_filter: Option<&str>,
372	) -> Result<Vec<PlanListEntry>> {
373	    let root = paths.plans_dir();
374	    if !root.exists() {
375	        return Ok(Vec::new());
376	    }
377	    let mut plans = Vec::new();
378	    for entry in fs::read_dir(&root).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
379	        path: root.clone(),
380	        source,
381	    })? {
382	        let entry = entry?;
383	        let plan_path = entry.path().join("plan.json");
384	        if !plan_path.is_file() {
385	            continue;
386	        }
387	        let Some(plan_id) = entry.file_name().to_str().map(str::to_string) else {
388	            continue;
389	        };
390	        let plan = load_plan(paths, &plan_id)?;
391	        if scope_filter.is_some_and(|scope| plan.parent_scope.as_deref() != Some(scope)) {
392	            continue;
393	        }
394	        let updated_at = fs::metadata(&plan_path)
395	            .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified())
396	            .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
397	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| plan.merged_at.or(plan.forked_at).unwrap_or(plan.created_at));
398	        let completed_children = plan
399	            .tasks
400	            .iter()
401	            .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
402	            .count();
403	        let total_children = plan.tasks.len();
404	        plans.push(PlanListEntry {
405	            plan_id: plan.plan_id,
406	            merged_run_id: plan.merged_run_id,
407	            scope: plan.parent_scope.unwrap_or_else(|| "global".to_string()),
408	            goal: plan.root_goal,
409	            status: plan.status,
410	            mode: plan.mode,
411	            updated_at,
412	            plan_path,
413	            completed_children,
414	            total_children,
415	        });
416	    }
417	    plans.sort_by_key(|plan| Reverse(plan.updated_at));
418	    Ok(plans)
419	}
420	
421	fn plan_action_label(plan: &PlanListEntry) -> String {
422	    match plan.status {
423	        PlanStatus::Pending => "fork".to_string(),
424	        PlanStatus::Forked if plan.completed_children == plan.total_children => {
425	            format!("merge {}/{}", plan.completed_children, plan.total_children)
426	        }
427	        PlanStatus::Forked => format!("attach {}/{}", plan.completed_children, plan.total_children),
428	        PlanStatus::Merged if plan.merged_run_id.is_some() => "finish".to_string(),
429	        PlanStatus::Merged => "show".to_string(),
430	        PlanStatus::Failed => "show failure".to_string(),
431	    }
432	}

434	enum HistoryMatcher {
435	    Substring(String),
436	    Regex(Regex),
437	}
438	
439	impl HistoryMatcher {
440	    fn new(pattern: String, regex: bool) -> Result<Self> {
441	        if regex {
442	            let compiled = Regex::new(&pattern)
443	                .map_err(|err| invalid_history_regex_error(&pattern, &err.to_string()))?;
444	            Ok(Self::Regex(compiled))
445	        } else {
446	            Ok(Self::Substring(pattern))
447	        }
448	    }
449	
450	    fn is_match(&self, line: &str) -> bool {
451	        match self {
452	            Self::Substring(pattern) => line.contains(pattern),
453	            Self::Regex(pattern) => pattern.is_match(line),
454	        }
455	    }
456	}

458	fn invalid_history_regex_error(pattern: &str, parser_error: &str) -> CliError {
459	    let primary = format!(
460	        "deadreckon history grep {} --regex",
461	        command_literal(pattern)
462	    );
463	    let secondary = format!("deadreckon history grep {}", command_literal(pattern));
464	    CliError::Surface {
465	        code: 2,
466	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
467	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
468	            "history grep",
469	            Some("--regex"),
470	            ExplanationPanel::new(
471	                format!("History grep could not compile regex pattern {pattern:?}."),
472	                "The command stopped before scanning history because --regex requires a valid Rust regular expression.",
473	                vec![
474	                    ("pattern".to_string(), pattern.to_string()),
475	                    ("parser error".to_string(), parser_error.to_string()),
476	                    ("mode".to_string(), "regex".to_string()),
477	                ],
478	            ),
479	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
480	            vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
481	        )
482	        .expect("invalid history regex verdict surface must be valid")
483	        .render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false)),
484	    }
485	}

516	pub(crate) fn history_command(command: HistoryCommand) -> Result<()> {
517	    match command {
518	        HistoryCommand::Grep {
519	            pattern,
520	            plan,
521	            scope,
522	            all,
523	            since,
524	            kind,
525	            limit,
526	            regex,
527	        } => history_grep_command(HistoryGrepRequest {
528	            pattern,
529	            plan,
530	            scope,
531	            all,
532	            since,
533	            kind,
534	            limit,
535	            regex,
536	        }),
537	    }

539	
540	struct HistoryGrepRequest {
541	    pattern: String,
542	    plan: Option<String>,
543	    scope: Option<String>,
544	    all: bool,
545	    since: Option<String>,
546	    kind: HistoryKind,
547	    limit: usize,
548	    regex: bool,
549	}
550	
551	fn history_grep_command(args: HistoryGrepRequest) -> Result<()> {
552	    let HistoryGrepRequest {
553	        pattern,
554	        plan,
555	        scope,
556	        all,
557	        since,
558	        kind,
559	        limit,
560	        regex,
561	    } = args;
562	    if limit == 0 {
563	        return Err(invalid_history_limit_error(&pattern, limit));
564	    }
565	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
566	    let matcher = HistoryMatcher::new(pattern.clone(), regex)?;
567	    let cutoff = parse_history_since(&pattern, since)?;
568	    let plan_children = plan
569	        .as_deref()
570	        .map(|plan_id| history_plan_children(&paths, plan_id))
571	        .transpose()?;
572	    let effective_scope = if plan_children.is_some() || all {
573	        scope
574	    } else {
575	        Some(scope.unwrap_or(current_scope()?))
576	    };
577	    let runs = list_runs(&paths, effective_scope.as_deref())?;
578	    let mut printed = 0usize;
579	    let mut total_matches = 0usize;
580	    println!(
581	        "{} {} {}",
582	        ui_heading("history grep"),
583	        ui_muted(history_kind_label(kind)),
584	        ui_muted(if regex { "regex" } else { "substring" })
585	    );
586	    if let Some(plan_id) = plan.as_deref() {
587	        let plan_id = resolve_plan_id(&paths, plan_id)?;
588	        for event in read_plan_events_lossy(&paths, &plan_id) {
589	            if let Some(cutoff) = cutoff
590	                && event.timestamp < cutoff
591	            {
592	                continue;
593	            }
594	            let line = plan_event_line(&event);
595	            if !matcher.is_match(&line) {
596	                continue;
597	            }
598	            total_matches += 1;
599	            if printed >= limit {
600	                continue;
601	            }
602	            println!(
603	                "{} {} plan-events | {}",
604	                ui_id(run_prefix(&plan_id)),
605	                event.timestamp.to_rfc3339(),
606	                one_line(&line, 220)
607	            );
608	            printed += 1;
609	        }
610	    }
611	    for run in runs {
612	        if let Some(children) = plan_children.as_ref()
613	            && !children.contains(&run.run_id)
614	        {
615	            continue;
616	        }
617	        let state = load_run(&paths, &run.run_id)?;
618	        let path = state.run_root.join(history_kind_file(kind));
619	        if !path.exists() || !history_file_within_cutoff(&path, cutoff)? {
620	            continue;
621	        }
622	        let fallback_timestamp = history_file_timestamp(&path)?;
623	        for line in fs::read_to_string(&path)?.lines() {
624	            if !matcher.is_match(line) {
625	                continue;
626	            }
627	            total_matches += 1;
628	            if printed >= limit {
629	                continue;
630	            }
631	            let timestamp = history_line_timestamp(kind, line).unwrap_or(fallback_timestamp);
632	            println!(
633	                "{} {} {} | {}",
634	                ui_id(run_prefix(&run.run_id)),
635	                timestamp.to_rfc3339(),
636	                run.scope,
637	                one_line(line.trim(), 220)
638	            );
639	            printed += 1;
640	        }
641	    }
642	    if total_matches == 0 {
643	        print_history_grep_no_matches_surface(
644	            &pattern,
645	            kind,
646	            regex,
647	            plan.as_deref(),
648	            effective_scope.as_deref(),
649	            all,
650	        );
651	    } else if total_matches > printed {
652	        println!("... ({} more)", total_matches - printed);
653	    }
654	    Ok(())
655	}
656	
657	fn print_history_grep_no_matches_surface(
658	    pattern: &str,
659	    kind: HistoryKind,
660	    regex: bool,
661	    plan: Option<&str>,
662	    scope: Option<&str>,
663	    all: bool,
664	) {
665	    let primary = format!("deadreckon history grep {} --all", command_literal(pattern));
666	    let search_scope = if let Some(plan) = plan {
667	        format!("plan {plan}")
668	    } else if all {
669	        "all scopes".to_string()
670	    } else if let Some(scope) = scope {
671	        format!("scope {scope}")
672	    } else {
673	        "current scope".to_string()
674	    };
675	    let surface = VerdictSurface::try_new(
676	        VerdictKind::Noop,
677	        "history grep",
678	        Some(pattern),
679	        ExplanationPanel::new(
680	            format!("History grep scanned {search_scope} and found no matches for {pattern:?}."),
681	            "This is a no-op because no trace/provenance lines matched; broadening the search to all scopes is the safest next check.",
682	            vec![
683	                ("pattern".to_string(), pattern.to_string()),
684	                ("scope".to_string(), search_scope),
685	                ("kind".to_string(), history_kind_label(kind).to_string()),
686	                (
687	                    "matcher".to_string(),
688	                    if regex { "regex" } else { "substring" }.to_string(),
689	                ),
690	            ],
691	        ),
692	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
693	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon show <run-id>")],
694	    )
695	    .expect("history grep no-match verdict surface must be valid");
696	    print!(
697	        "{}",
698	        surface.render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false))
699	    );
700	}

719	fn history_kind_label(kind: HistoryKind) -> &'static str {

725	
726	fn parse_history_since(pattern: &str, value: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {
727	    let Some(value) = value else {
728	        return Ok(None);
729	    };
730	    let value = value.trim();
731	    if value.len() < 2 {
732	        return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value));
733	    }
734	    let (amount, unit) = value.split_at(value.len() - 1);
735	    let amount = amount
736	        .parse::<i64>()
737	        .map_err(|_| invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value))?;
738	    if amount < 0 {
739	        return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value));
740	    }
741	    let duration = match unit {
742	        "d" => ChronoDuration::days(amount),
743	        "h" => ChronoDuration::hours(amount),
744	        "m" => ChronoDuration::minutes(amount),
745	        _ => return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value)),
746	    };
747	    Ok(Some(Utc::now() - duration))
748	}
749	
750	fn invalid_history_since_error(pattern: &str, value: &str) -> CliError {
751	    let primary = format!(
752	        "deadreckon history grep {} --since 7d",
753	        command_literal(pattern)
754	    );
755	    let secondary = format!("deadreckon history grep {} --all", command_literal(pattern));
756	    CliError::Surface {
757	        code: 2,
758	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
759	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
760	            "history grep",
761	            Some("--since"),
762	            ExplanationPanel::new(
763	                format!("History grep could not parse --since duration {value:?}."),
764	                "The command stopped before scanning history because --since must be a positive duration ending in d, h, or m.",
765	                vec![
766	                    ("filter".to_string(), "--since".to_string()),
767	                    ("value".to_string(), value.to_string()),
768	                    ("accepted duration".to_string(), "7d, 24h, or 30m".to_string()),
769	                ],
770	            ),
771	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
772	            vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
773	        )
774	        .expect("invalid history since verdict surface must be valid")
775	        .render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false)),
776	    }
777	}

779	fn history_file_within_cutoff(path: &Path, cutoff: Option<DateTime<Utc>>) -> Result<bool> {
780	    let Some(cutoff) = cutoff else {
781	        return Ok(true);
782	    };
783	    Ok(history_file_timestamp(path)? >= cutoff)
784	}

789	}

791	fn history_line_timestamp(kind: HistoryKind, line: &str) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
792	    match kind {
793	        HistoryKind::Trace => serde_json::from_str::<TraceRecord>(line)
794	            .ok()
795	            .map(|record| record.timestamp),
796	        HistoryKind::Provenance => serde_json::from_str::<ProvenanceRecord>(line)
797	            .ok()
798	            .map(|record| record.timestamp),
799	    }
800	}

809	pub(crate) fn library_command(command: LibraryCommand) -> Result<()> {

811	    match command {

815	            goal,
816	            since,
817	            until,

819	            json,
820	        } => {
821	            let filter = LibraryFilter::new(goal, since, until)?;
822	            let entries =

827	                    .map(|entry| {

832	                        })
833	                    })
834	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
835	                println!(
836	                    "{}",
837	                    serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json!({
838	                        "kind": "library_list",
839	                        "id": scope.as_deref().unwrap_or(if all { "all-scopes" } else { "current-scope" }),
840	                        "status": "ok",
841	                        "next_actions": ["deadreckon finish <id>", "deadreckon export <id>"],
842	                        "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
843	                        "paths": {
844	                            "home": paths.home(),
845	                        },
846	                        "artifacts": artifacts,
847	                    }))?
848	                );
849	                return Ok(());
850	            }
851	            if entries.is_empty() {

867	                .into_iter()
868	                .filter(|entry| library_entry_matches_query(entry, &needle))
869	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();

878	            print_library_entry(&entry);

914	fn command_literal(value: &str) -> String {
915	    if !value.is_empty()
916	        && value.chars().all(|ch| {
917	            ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
918	                || matches!(
919	                    ch,
920	                    '_' | '-' | '.' | '/' | ':' | '@' | '%' | '+' | '=' | ','
921	                )
922	        })
923	    {
924	        return value.to_string();
925	    }
926	    format!("'{}'", value.replace('\'', "'\\''"))
927	}

929	struct LibraryFilter {
930	    goal: Option<String>,
931	    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
932	    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
933	}
934	
935	impl LibraryFilter {
936	    fn new(goal: Option<String>, since: Option<String>, until: Option<String>) -> Result<Self> {
937	        Ok(Self {
938	            goal: goal.map(|goal| goal.to_lowercase()),
939	            since: parse_library_date_filter("--since", since)?,
940	            until: parse_library_date_filter("--until", until)?,
941	        })
942	    }
943	}
944	
945	fn filter_library_entries(entries: Vec<LibraryEntry>, filter: &LibraryFilter) -> Vec<LibraryEntry> {
946	    entries
947	        .into_iter()
948	        .filter(|entry| {
949	            let manifest = &entry.manifest;
950	            filter
951	                .goal
952	                .as_ref()
953	                .is_none_or(|goal| manifest.goal.to_lowercase().contains(goal))
954	                && filter
955	                    .since
956	                    .is_none_or(|since| manifest.promoted_at >= since)
957	                && filter
958	                    .until
959	                    .is_none_or(|until| manifest.promoted_at <= until)
960	        })

972	fn library_docs_contain(path: &Path, needle: &str) -> bool {
973	    inventory_files(path)

975	        .into_iter()
976	        .filter(|file| {

978	                file.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()),
979	                Some("md" | "txt" | "json" | "jsonl" | "toml")
980	            )
981	        })

989	fn parse_library_date_filter(label: &str, value: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {
990	    let Some(value) = value else {
991	        return Ok(None);
992	    };
993	    if let Ok(date_time) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&value) {
994	        return Ok(Some(date_time.with_timezone(&Utc)));
995	    }
996	    if let Ok(date) = chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&value, "%Y-%m-%d") {
997	        let date_time = if label == "--until" {
998	            date.and_hms_nano_opt(23, 59, 59, 999_999_999)
999	        } else {
1000	            date.and_hms_opt(0, 0, 0)
1001	        };
1002	        let Some(date_time) = date_time else {
1003	            return Err(invalid_library_date_error(label, &value));
1004	        };
1005	        return Ok(Some(date_time.and_utc()));
1006	    }
1007	    Err(invalid_library_date_error(label, &value))
1008	}

1035	pub(crate) fn library_entries(
1036	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1037	    scope: Option<String>,
1038	    all: bool,
1039	) -> Result<Vec<LibraryEntry>> {
1040	    let mut entries = Vec::new();
1041	    let library_root = paths.home().join("library");
1042	    if let Some(scope) = scope {
1043	        scan_library_scope(paths, &scope, &mut entries)?;
1044	    } else if all {
1045	        if library_root.exists() {
1046	            for scope_entry in fs::read_dir(&library_root)? {
1047	                let scope_entry = scope_entry?;
1048	                if !scope_entry.file_type()?.is_dir() {
1049	                    continue;
1050	                }
1051	                let scope_name = scope_entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
1052	                if scope_name.starts_with('.') {
1053	                    continue;
1054	                }
1055	                scan_library_scope(paths, &scope_name, &mut entries)?;
1056	            }
1057	        }
1058	    } else {
1059	        scan_library_scope(paths, &current_scope()?, &mut entries)?;
1060	    }
1061	    entries.sort_by(|left, right| {
1062	        right
1063	            .manifest
1064	            .promoted_at
1065	            .cmp(&left.manifest.promoted_at)
1066	            .then_with(|| left.manifest.run_id.cmp(&right.manifest.run_id))
1067	    });
1068	    Ok(entries)
1069	}
1070	
1071	fn scan_library_scope(
1072	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1073	    scope: &str,
1074	    entries: &mut Vec<LibraryEntry>,
1075	) -> Result<()> {
1076	    let scope_dir = paths.home().join("library").join(scope);
1077	    if !scope_dir.exists() {
1078	        return Ok(());
1079	    }
1080	    for run_entry in fs::read_dir(scope_dir)? {
1081	        let run_entry = run_entry?;
1082	        if !run_entry.file_type()?.is_dir() {
1083	            continue;
1084	        }
1085	        let path = run_entry.path();
1086	        let manifest_path = path.join("manifest.json");
1087	        if !manifest_path.exists() {
1088	            continue;
1089	        }
1090	        let manifest: PromotionManifest = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&manifest_path)?)?;
1091	        entries.push(LibraryEntry {
1092	            materialized_count: materialized_marker_count(&path),
1093	            manifest,
1094	            path,
1095	        });
1096	    }
1097	    Ok(())
1098	}

1104	        .unwrap_or(0)
1105	}

260	fn unique_shell_backup_dir(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
261	    let stamp = Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%3f").to_string();
262	    let mut candidate = root.join(&stamp);
263	    let mut suffix = 1_u32;
264	    while candidate.exists() {
265	        candidate = root.join(format!("{stamp}-{suffix}"));
266	        suffix += 1;
267	    }
268	    candidate
269	}

271	async fn run_shell_swap(
272	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
273	    force: bool,
274	    allow_prerelease: bool,
275	    quiet: bool,
276	) -> std::result::Result<(), String> {

279	    }

287	#[cfg(feature = "selfupdate")]
288	async fn run_axoupdater_shell_update(
289	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
290	    force: bool,
291	    allow_prerelease: bool,
292	    quiet: bool,
293	) -> std::result::Result<(), String> {
294	    let mut updater = axoupdater::AxoUpdater::new_for("deadreckon");
295	    updater.set_release_source(axoupdater::ReleaseSource {
296	        release_type: axoupdater::ReleaseSourceType::GitHub,
297	        owner: "gdc".to_string(),
298	        name: "deadreckon".to_string(),
299	        app_name: "deadreckon".to_string(),
300	    });
301	    let version = update_current_version(receipt)
302	        .parse::<axoupdater::Version>()
303	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
304	    updater
305	        .set_current_version(version)
306	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
307	    if let Some(parent) = receipt.binary_path.parent() {
308	        updater.set_install_dir(parent.to_string_lossy().to_string());
309	    }
310	    if allow_prerelease {
311	        updater.configure_version_specifier(axoupdater::UpdateRequest::LatestMaybePrerelease);
312	    }
313	    if force {
314	        updater.always_update(true);
315	    }
316	    if quiet {
317	        updater.disable_installer_output();
318	    }
319	    updater.run().await.map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
320	    Ok(())
321	}

333	fn prune_shell_backups(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<()> {
334	    let root = shell_backup_root(paths);
335	    let mut backups = fs::read_dir(&root)?
336	        .filter_map(|entry| {
337	            let entry = entry.ok()?;
338	            entry.path().is_dir().then_some(entry.path())
339	        })
340	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
341	    backups.sort();
342	    let remove_count = backups.len().saturating_sub(3);
343	    for backup in backups.into_iter().take(remove_count) {
344	        fs::remove_dir_all(backup)?;
345	    }
346	    Ok(())
347	}

349	fn shell_update_failure(
350	    receipt: &deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt,
351	    backup_dir: &Path,
352	    source: &str,
353	) -> CliError {
354	    let primary = format!(
355	        "cp {} {}",
356	        backup_dir.join("deadreckon").display(),
357	        receipt.binary_path.display()
358	    );
359	    CliError::Surface {
360	        code: 2,
361	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
362	            VerdictKind::Failed,
363	            "update",
364	            Some("shell"),
365	            ExplanationPanel::new(
366	                "DeadReckon could not replace the shell-installed binary.",
367	                "The update failed after creating a rollback backup, so restoring the preserved binary is the safest next step.",
368	                vec![
369	                    ("channel".to_string(), "shell".to_string()),
370	                    ("source".to_string(), source.to_string()),
371	                    ("backup".to_string(), backup_dir.display().to_string()),
372	                    ("updated".to_string(), receipt.binary_path.display().to_string()),
373	                ],
374	            ),
375	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
376	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon update --check")],
377	        )
378	        .expect("shell update failure verdict surface must be valid")
379	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
380	    }
381	}

384	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
385	    persist_detected: bool,
386	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt> {
387	    if let Some(receipt) = read_receipt(paths)? {
388	        return Ok(receipt);
389	    }

416	fn update_check_surface(channel: Channel, current: &str, latest: &LatestUpdate) -> VerdictSurface {
417	    let evidence = vec![
418	        ("channel", channel.as_str().to_string()),
419	        ("current", current.to_string()),
420	        ("latest", latest.version.clone()),
421	        ("release", latest.release_url.clone()),
422	    ];
423	    if latest.update_available {
424	        return VerdictSurface::try_new(
425	            VerdictKind::Preview,
426	            "update",
427	            Some(channel.as_str()),
428	            ExplanationPanel::new(
429	                "DeadReckon found a newer release for this install channel.",
430	                "The check is read-only; run the channel update command to apply the available release.",
431	                evidence,
432	            ),
433	            vec![("Recommended", channel_native_update_command(channel))],
434	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon doctor")],
435	        )
436	        .expect("update-check preview verdict surface must be valid");
437	    }
438	
439	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
440	        VerdictKind::Noop,
441	        "update",
442	        Some(channel.as_str()),
443	        ExplanationPanel::new(
444	            "DeadReckon did not find a newer release for this install channel.",
445	            "The installed version is already current, or the check fell back to cached/current release metadata.",
446	            evidence,
447	        ),
448	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon doctor")],
449	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
450	    )
451	    .expect("update-check no-op verdict surface must be valid")
452	}

454	fn update_source_surface(current: &str) -> VerdictSurface {
455	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
456	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
457	        "update",
458	        Some("source"),
459	        ExplanationPanel::new(
460	            "DeadReckon cannot replace a source-built binary in place.",
461	            "Source installs do not have a managed package channel for self-update; reinstall from the checkout so Cargo rebuilds the binary.",
462	            vec![
463	                ("channel".to_string(), "source".to_string()),
464	                ("current".to_string(), current.to_string()),
465	                ("managed swap".to_string(), "unsupported".to_string()),
466	            ],
467	        ),
468	        vec![("Recommended", "cargo install --path crates/deadreckon")],
469	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon update --check")],
470	    )
471	    .expect("source update verdict surface must be valid")
472	}

508	pub(crate) async fn resolve_latest_update(
509	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
510	    current: &str,
511	    allow_prerelease: bool,
512	) -> Result<LatestUpdate> {
513	    let now = Utc::now();
514	    let cache = read_cache(paths)?;
515	    if let Some(cache) = cache.as_ref()
516	        && !cache.is_stale(now)
517	    {
518	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
519	            version: cache.latest_version.clone(),
520	            release_url: cache.release_url.clone(),
521	            archive_url: None,
522	            sha256: None,
523	            update_available: cache.update_available,
524	        });
525	    }
526	
527	    match fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease).await {
528	        Ok(mut latest) => {
529	            latest.update_available = version_is_newer(current, &latest.version);
530	            write_cache(
531	                paths,
532	                &deadreckon_core::update_cache::Cache {
533	                    checked_at: now,
534	                    latest_version: latest.version.clone(),
535	                    current_version: current.to_string(),
536	                    release_url: latest.release_url.clone(),
537	                    update_available: latest.update_available,
538	                },
539	            )?;
540	            Ok(latest)
541	        }
542	        Err(_) => Ok(cache.map_or_else(
543	            || LatestUpdate {
544	                version: current.to_string(),
545	                release_url: "https://github.com/gdc/deadreckon/releases".to_string(),
546	                archive_url: None,
547	                sha256: None,
548	                update_available: false,
549	            },
550	            |cache| LatestUpdate {
551	                version: cache.latest_version,
552	                release_url: cache.release_url,
553	                archive_url: None,
554	                sha256: None,
555	                update_available: cache.update_available,
556	            },
557	        )),
558	    }
559	}
560	
561	async fn fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease: bool) -> std::result::Result<LatestUpdate, String> {
562	    if let Ok(delay_ms) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_FETCH_DELAY_MS")
563	        && let Ok(delay_ms) = delay_ms.parse::<u64>()
564	    {
565	        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay_ms)).await;
566	    }
567	    if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_OFFLINE").is_some() {
568	        return Err("offline test mode".to_string());
569	    }
570	    if let Ok(version) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_LATEST_VERSION") {
571	        let release_url =
572	            std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_RELEASE_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
573	                format!("https://github.com/gdc/deadreckon/releases/tag/v{version}")
574	            });
575	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
576	            version,
577	            release_url,
578	            archive_url: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_ARCHIVE_URL").ok(),
579	            sha256: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHA256").ok(),
580	            update_available: false,
581	        });
582	    }
583	
584	    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
585	        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3))
586	        .build()
587	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
588	    if allow_prerelease {
589	        let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL")
590	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://api.github.com/repos/gdc/deadreckon/releases".to_string());
591	        let releases = client
592	            .get(url)
593	            .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
594	            .send()
595	            .await
596	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
597	            .error_for_status()
598	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
599	            .json::<Vec<GithubRelease>>()
600	            .await
601	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
602	        let Some(release) = releases.into_iter().next() else {
603	            return Err("no releases found".to_string());
604	        };
605	        return Ok(release.into_latest_update());
606	    }
607	
608	    let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
609	        "https://api.github.com/repos/gdc/deadreckon/releases/latest".to_string()
610	    });
611	    client
612	        .get(url)
613	        .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
614	        .send()
615	        .await
616	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
617	        .error_for_status()
618	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
619	        .json::<GithubRelease>()
620	        .await
621	        .map(GithubRelease::into_latest_update)
622	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())
623	}

643	fn version_is_newer(current: &str, latest: &str) -> bool {
644	    let current = current.trim_start_matches('v');
645	    let latest = latest.trim_start_matches('v');
646	    match (
647	        semver::Version::parse(current),
648	        semver::Version::parse(latest),
649	    ) {
650	        (Ok(current), Ok(latest)) => latest > current,
651	        _ => latest != current,
652	    }
653	}

655	async fn providers_list_command(
656	    models: bool,
657	    all: bool,
658	    full: bool,
659	    json_output: bool,
660	) -> Result<()> {
661	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
662	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
663	    let active = read_config(&paths.config_path())?.default_provider;
664	    let ids = if all {
665	        registry.ids()
666	    } else {
667	        configured_provider_ids(&paths)?
668	    };
669	    let mut results = Vec::new();
670	    let mut missing = Vec::new();
671	    for id in ids {
672	        if let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&id) {
673	            results.push(descriptor.probe(ProviderProbeOptions { ping: false }).await);
674	        } else {
675	            missing.push(id);
676	        }
677	    }
678	    let surface = providers_list_verdict_surface(&results, &missing, all);
679	    if json_output {
680	        let primary_action = surface.primary_action.command.clone();
681	        println!(
682	            "{}",
683	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
684	                "kind": "providers",
685	                "id": if all { "all" } else { "configured" },
686	                "status": "ok",
687	                "next_actions": [primary_action],
688	                "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
689	                "paths": {
690	                    "home": paths.home(),
691	                    "config": paths.config_path(),
692	                },
693	                "providers": results,
694	                "missing_providers": missing,
695	                "active": active,
696	            })))?
697	        );
698	        return Ok(());
699	    }
700	    println!("{}", ui_heading("provider registry"));
701	    if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
702	        println!("{} no configured providers", ui_muted("-"));
703	        println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
704	        return Ok(());
705	    }
706	    for id in &missing {
707	        let marker = if active.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str()) {
708	            "*"
709	        } else {
710	            " "
711	        };
712	        println!(
713	            "{marker} {} {} not registered | {}",
714	            ui_warn("✗"),
715	            ui_id(id),
716	            ui_command("deadreckon providers list --all")
717	        );
718	    }
719	    for result in &results {
720	        let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&result.id) else {
721	            continue;
722	        };
723	        print_provider_list_row(&result, descriptor, active.as_deref(), full);
724	        if models {
725	            print_provider_models(descriptor);
726	        }
727	    }
728	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
729	    Ok(())
730	}
731	
732	fn providers_list_verdict_surface(
733	    results: &[ProviderProbeResult],
734	    missing: &[String],
735	    all: bool,
736	) -> VerdictSurface {
737	    let failed = results
738	        .iter()
739	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Failed)
740	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
741	    let ok = results
742	        .iter()
743	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Ok)
744	        .count();
745	    let skipped = results
746	        .iter()
747	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Skipped)
748	        .count();
749	    let subject = if all { "all" } else { "configured" };
750	    let kind = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
751	        VerdictKind::Noop
752	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
753	        VerdictKind::Verified
754	    } else {
755	        VerdictKind::Blocked
756	    };
757	    let primary = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
758	        format!("deadreckon detect {}", first.id)
759	    } else if !missing.is_empty() || results.is_empty() {
760	        "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
761	    } else {
762	        "deadreckon detect".to_string()
763	    };
764	    let what = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
765	        "DeadReckon found no configured provider routes.".to_string()
766	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
767	        format!("DeadReckon listed {ok} usable provider route(s).")
768	    } else {
769	        format!(
770	            "DeadReckon listed provider routes and found {} issue(s).",
771	            failed.len() + missing.len()
772	        )
773	    };
774	    let why = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
775	        format!(
776	            "{} is not ready; inspect that provider before using it for a run.",
777	            first.id
778	        )
779	    } else if !missing.is_empty() {
780	        "At least one configured provider is not registered; list all routes or change the configured provider."
781	            .to_string()
782	    } else if results.is_empty() {
783	        "There is no configured provider inventory yet; listing all routes is the safest discovery step."
784	            .to_string()
785	    } else {
786	        "The configured provider inventory is readable; a detect pass can refresh setup diagnostics."
787	            .to_string()
788	    };
789	    let mut evidence = vec![
790	        ("scope".to_string(), subject.to_string()),
791	        ("providers".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
792	        ("ok".to_string(), ok.to_string()),
793	        ("failed".to_string(), failed.len().to_string()),
794	        ("skipped".to_string(), skipped.to_string()),
795	        ("missing".to_string(), missing.len().to_string()),
796	    ];
797	    if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
798	        evidence.push(("first failed".to_string(), first.id.clone()));
799	        if let Some(message) = &first.message {
800	            evidence.push(("reason".to_string(), message.clone()));
801	        }
802	    }
803	    if let Some(first) = missing.first() {
804	        evidence.push(("first missing".to_string(), first.clone()));
805	    }
806	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
807	        kind,
808	        "providers",
809	        Some(subject),
810	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
811	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
812	        vec![
813	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon detect"),
814	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon providers list --all"),
815	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon config provider cli:codex"),
816	        ],
817	    )
818	    .expect("providers list verdict surface must be valid")
819	}

821	fn print_provider_list_row(
822	    result: &ProviderProbeResult,
823	    descriptor: &deadreckon_providers::registry::ProviderDescriptor,
824	    active: Option<&str>,
825	    full: bool,
826	) {
827	    let symbol = match result.status {
828	        ProbeStatus::Ok => ui_ok("✓"),
829	        ProbeStatus::Failed => ui::render(ui::Stream::Stdout, ui::Tone::Negative, "✗"),
830	        ProbeStatus::Skipped => ui_muted("-"),
831	    };
832	    let marker = if active == Some(result.id.as_str()) {
833	        "*"
834	    } else {
835	        " "
836	    };
837	    let location = result.location.as_deref().unwrap_or("-");
838	    let version = result.version.as_deref().unwrap_or("-");
839	    let model = descriptor.default_model.as_deref().unwrap_or("-");
840	    if full {
841	        println!(
842	            "{marker} {} {} kind={} credential={} model={} metering={} location={} version={}",
843	            ui_id(&result.id),

845	            descriptor_kind_label(&descriptor.kind),
846	            result.credential,
847	            model,
848	            result.metering,
849	            location,
850	            version
851	        );
852	    } else {
853	        println!(
854	            "{marker} {} {}  kind={:<10} credential={:<8} model={} metering={} location={} version={}",
855	            crate::ui::pad_visible(&ui_id(&result.id), 20),
856	            symbol,
857	            descriptor_kind_label(&descriptor.kind),
858	            result.credential,
859	            model,
860	            result.metering,
861	            location,
862	            version
863	        );
864	    }

867	fn print_provider_models(descriptor: &deadreckon_providers::registry::ProviderDescriptor) {

924	fn detect_verdict_surface(
925	    results: &[ProviderProbeResult],
926	    requested_id: Option<&str>,
927	) -> VerdictSurface {
928	    let failed = results
929	        .iter()
930	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Failed)
931	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
932	    let skipped = results
933	        .iter()
934	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Skipped)
935	        .count();
936	    let ok = results
937	        .iter()
938	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Ok)
939	        .count();
940	    let subject = requested_id.unwrap_or("all");
941	    let kind = if failed.is_empty() {
942	        VerdictKind::Verified
943	    } else {
944	        VerdictKind::Blocked
945	    };
946	    let primary = failed
947	        .first()
948	        .and_then(|result| result.try_lines.first())
949	        .cloned()
950	        .or_else(|| {
951	            requested_id.map(|id| {
952	                if failed.is_empty() {
953	                    format!("deadreckon config provider {id}")
954	                } else {
955	                    "deadreckon providers list".to_string()
956	                }
957	            })
958	        })
959	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
960	            if failed.is_empty() {
961	                "deadreckon providers list".to_string()
962	            } else {
963	                "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
964	            }
965	        });
966	    let what = if failed.is_empty() {
967	        match requested_id {
968	            Some(id) => format!("DeadReckon verified provider probe {id}."),
969	            None => "DeadReckon completed provider detection without failed probes.".to_string(),
970	        }
971	    } else if failed.len() == 1 {
972	        format!("DeadReckon found provider {} is not ready.", failed[0].id)
973	    } else {
974	        format!(
975	            "DeadReckon found {} provider probes are not ready.",
976	            failed.len()
977	        )
978	    };
979	    let why = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
980	        first.message.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
981	            "A provider probe failed, so setup must be repaired before it can run work.".to_string()
982	        })
983	    } else {
984	        "All failed-provider checks passed; the selected provider catalog is ready for the next setup or run command.".to_string()
985	    };
986	    let mut evidence = vec![
987	        ("providers".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
988	        ("ok".to_string(), ok.to_string()),
989	        ("failed".to_string(), failed.len().to_string()),
990	        ("skipped".to_string(), skipped.to_string()),
991	    ];
992	    if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
993	        evidence.push(("first failed".to_string(), first.id.clone()));
994	        evidence.push(("credential".to_string(), first.credential.clone()));
995	        if let Some(kind) = &first.error_kind {
996	            evidence.push(("error kind".to_string(), format!("{kind:?}")));
997	        }
998	    }
999	    let mut secondary = vec![
1000	        (
1001	            "Secondary".to_string(),
1002	            "deadreckon providers list".to_string(),
1003	        ),
1004	        ("Secondary".to_string(), "deadreckon doctor".to_string()),
1005	    ];
1006	    for line in failed
1007	        .iter()
1008	        .flat_map(|result| result.try_lines.iter())
1009	        .filter(|line| line.as_str() != primary)
1010	    {
1011	        secondary.push(("Secondary".to_string(), line.clone()));
1012	    }
1013	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1014	        kind,
1015	        "detect",
1016	        Some(subject),
1017	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1018	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1019	        secondary
1020	            .iter()
1021	            .map(|(label, command)| (label.as_str(), command.as_str()))
1022	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1023	    )
1024	    .expect("detect verdict surface must be valid")
1025	}

330	fn start_auto_mode_decision(
331	    goal: &str,
332	    stdin_is_tty: bool,
333	) -> (StartSelectedMode, StartSelectionSource, String) {
334	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
335	    if start_goal_recommends_review(&lower) {
336	        return (
337	            StartSelectedMode::Review,
338	            StartSelectionSource::Heuristic,
339	            "goal asks for review, hardening, validation, or a second pass".to_string(),
340	        );
341	    }
342	    if start_goal_recommends_full_plan(&lower) {
343	        return (
344	            StartSelectedMode::FullPlan,
345	            StartSelectionSource::Heuristic,
346	            "goal names parallel or separable workstreams that fit full-plan orchestration"
347	                .to_string(),
348	        );
349	    }
350	    if !stdin_is_tty {
351	        return (
352	            StartSelectedMode::Run,
353	            StartSelectionSource::Default,
354	            "non-interactive auto mode uses the conservative single supervised run".to_string(),
355	        );
356	    }
357	    (
358	        StartSelectedMode::Run,
359	        StartSelectionSource::Default,
360	        "goal looks focused enough for a single supervised run".to_string(),
361	    )
362	}

423	) -> GoalShapeRecommendation {
424	    if let Some(provider) = provider
425	        && provider != "smoke"
426	        && !provider.starts_with("smoke:")
427	        && let Some(recommendation) =
428	            provider_goal_shape_recommendation(paths, cwd, goal, provider, plain).await
429	    {
430	        return recommendation;
431	    }
432	    fallback_goal_shape_recommendation(goal)
433	}
434	
435	async fn provider_goal_shape_recommendation(
436	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
437	    cwd: &Path,
438	    goal: &str,
439	    provider: &str,
440	    plain: bool,
441	) -> Option<GoalShapeRecommendation> {
442	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), Some(provider)).ok()?;
443	    let request = ProviderRequest {
444	        prompt: goal_shape_prompt(goal),
445	        max_output_tokens: 512,
446	        cwd: Some(cwd.to_path_buf()),
447	        output_path: None,
448	        sandbox_backend: None,
449	        pid_file: None,
450	        cancellation_token: None,
451	    };
452	    let response = tokio::time::timeout(
453	        Duration::from_secs(5),
454	        maybe_with_cli_wait_status(!plain, "classifying goal shape", router.complete(&request)),
455	    )
456	    .await
457	    .ok()?
458	    .ok()?;
459	    parse_provider_goal_shape(goal, &response.provider, &response.content)
460	}
461	
462	fn goal_shape_prompt(goal: &str) -> String {
463	    format!(
464	        "You are a read-only goal-shape classifier for deadreckon. Do not write files, create temporary files, install packages, commit, delete, move, or mutate state.\n\nReturn JSON only: {{\"shape\":\"single|orchestrate|campaign\",\"n\":2,\"rationale\":\"one short line\"}}.\n\nRubric:\n- single: one cohesive change a single supervised run handles.\n- orchestrate: one project with parallelizable subtasks.\n- campaign: several independent projects, each warranting its own coordination.\n\nIf shape is orchestrate or campaign, include n from 2 through 6. Keep rationale short. Goal: {goal}"
465	    )
466	}
467	
468	pub(crate) fn parse_provider_goal_shape(
469	    goal: &str,
470	    provider: &str,
471	    content: &str,
472	) -> Option<GoalShapeRecommendation> {
473	    let parsed = serde_json::from_str::<ProviderGoalShapeDraft>(content)
474	        .ok()
475	        .or_else(|| {
476	            commands::plan::json_slice(content, '{', '}')
477	                .and_then(|slice| serde_json::from_str::<ProviderGoalShapeDraft>(slice).ok())
478	        })?;
479	    let shape = parse_goal_shape(&parsed.shape)?;
480	    let rationale = parsed.rationale.unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
481	    if rationale.is_empty() {
482	        return None;
483	    }
484	    let n = goal_shape_count(shape, parsed.n);
485	    Some(GoalShapeRecommendation {
486	        schema_version: 1,
487	        goal: goal.to_string(),
488	        shape,
489	        n,
490	        rationale,
491	        source: GoalShapeSource::Provider,
492	        provider: Some(provider.to_string()),
493	    })
494	}
495	
496	fn parse_goal_shape(value: &str) -> Option<GoalShape> {
497	    match value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
498	        "single" | "run" => Some(GoalShape::Single),
499	        "orchestrate" | "orchestration" | "full-plan" | "full_plan" => Some(GoalShape::Orchestrate),
500	        "campaign" => Some(GoalShape::Campaign),
501	        _ => None,
502	    }
503	}
504	
505	fn goal_shape_count(shape: GoalShape, n: Option<u8>) -> Option<u8> {
506	    match shape {
507	        GoalShape::Single => None,
508	        GoalShape::Orchestrate | GoalShape::Campaign => Some(n.unwrap_or(3).clamp(2, 6)),
509	    }
510	}
511	
512	pub(crate) fn fallback_goal_shape_recommendation(goal: &str) -> GoalShapeRecommendation {
513	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
514	    let (shape, n, rationale) = if start_goal_recommends_full_plan(&lower) {
515	        (
516	            GoalShape::Orchestrate,
517	            Some(commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
518	                goal,
519	                CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
520	            )),
521	            "goal names parallel or separable workstreams".to_string(),
522	        )
523	    } else {
524	        let clauses = deterministic_campaign_clause_count(goal);
525	        if clauses >= 2 {
526	            (
527	                GoalShape::Campaign,
528	                Some((clauses as u8).clamp(2, 6)),
529	                format!("goal reads as {clauses} independent clauses"),
530	            )
531	        } else {
532	            (
533	                GoalShape::Single,
534	                None,
535	                format!("goal looks focused enough for one {NOUN_VERIFIED_RUN}"),
536	            )
537	        }
538	    };
539	    GoalShapeRecommendation {
540	        schema_version: 1,
541	        goal: goal.to_string(),
542	        shape,
543	        n,
544	        rationale,
545	        source: GoalShapeSource::Fallback,
546	        provider: None,
547	    }
548	}
549	
550	fn deterministic_campaign_clause_count(goal: &str) -> usize {
551	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
552	    let normalized = lower
553	        .replace(", and ", "|")
554	        .replace(" and ", "|")
555	        .replace(" then ", "|")
556	        .replace([';', ','], "|");
557	    normalized
558	        .split('|')
559	        .map(str::trim)
560	        .filter(|clause| goal_shape_clause_is_nounish(clause))
561	        .count()
562	}
563	
564	fn goal_shape_clause_is_nounish(clause: &str) -> bool {
565	    const STOP: &[&str] = &[
566	        "a", "an", "and", "as", "build", "create", "do", "fix", "for", "make", "the", "then", "to",
567	        "with",
568	    ];
569	    clause
570	        .split(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
571	        .filter(|word| word.len() >= 3)
572	        .any(|word| !STOP.contains(&word))
573	}
574	
575	fn goal_shape_to_start_mode(shape: GoalShape) -> StartSelectedMode {
576	    match shape {
577	        GoalShape::Single => StartSelectedMode::Run,
578	        GoalShape::Orchestrate => StartSelectedMode::FullPlan,
579	        GoalShape::Campaign => StartSelectedMode::Campaign,
580	    }
581	}
582	
583	pub(crate) fn apply_goal_shape_recommendation(
584	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
585	    recommendation: GoalShapeRecommendation,
586	) {
587	    if matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::Review) {
588	        decision.goal_shape = Some(recommendation);
589	        return;
590	    }
591	    decision.selected_mode = goal_shape_to_start_mode(recommendation.shape);
592	    decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::GoalShape;
593	    decision.reason = format!(
594	        "{} suggested {}: {}",
595	        recommendation.source.label(),
596	        recommendation.shape.label(),
597	        recommendation.rationale
598	    );
599	    if matches!(
600	        recommendation.shape,
601	        GoalShape::Orchestrate | GoalShape::Campaign
602	    ) {
603	        decision.child_count = recommendation.n;
604	    }
605	    decision.goal_shape = Some(recommendation);
606	}

633	
634	fn start_goal_recommends_review(lower_goal: &str) -> bool {
635	    let words = [
636	        "review",
637	        "audit",
638	        "critique",
639	        "validate",
640	        "validation",
641	        "verify",
642	        "verification",
643	        "hardening",
644	        "harden",
645	        "cleanup",
646	    ];
647	    let phrases = ["second pass", "second-pass", "clean up"];
648	    words
649	        .iter()
650	        .any(|word| start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal, word))
651	        || phrases.iter().any(|phrase| lower_goal.contains(phrase))
652	}
653	
654	fn start_goal_recommends_full_plan(lower_goal: &str) -> bool {
655	    let words = [
656	        "parallel",
657	        "parallelize",
658	        "workstream",
659	        "workstreams",
660	        "separable",
661	    ];
662	    let phrases = [
663	        "multiple independent",
664	        "many modules",
665	        "several modules",
666	        "frontend, docs",
667	        "api, frontend",
668	    ];
669	    words
670	        .iter()
671	        .any(|word| start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal, word))
672	        || phrases.iter().any(|phrase| lower_goal.contains(phrase))
673	}
674	
675	fn start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal: &str, needle: &str) -> bool {
676	    lower_goal
677	        .split(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
678	        .any(|word| word == needle)
679	}

681	pub(crate) fn maybe_prompt_start_mode(
682	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
683	    args: &StartCommandArgs,
684	    latest_completed_run: Option<&RunListEntry>,
685	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
686	) -> Result<()> {
687	    if !matches!(args.mode, crate::cli::CliStartMode::Auto) || decision.recovery.is_some() {
688	        return Ok(());
689	    }
690	    let recommended = decision.selected_mode;
691	    let mut choices = vec![
692	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
693	            "recommended",
694	            format!("Recommended: {}", recommended.path_label()),
695	            decision.reason.clone(),
696	        ),
697	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
698	            "run",
699	            "New single supervised run",
700	            "equivalent to --mode run",
701	        ),
702	    ];
703	    if let Some(run) = latest_completed_run {
704	        choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
705	            format!("extend:{}", run.run_id),
706	            format!("Follow up from {}", run_prefix(&run.run_id)),
707	            format!("extends completed run: {}", run.goal),
708	        ));
709	    }
710	    choices.extend([
711	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
712	            "review",
713	            "New coder/reviewer pass",
714	            "equivalent to --mode review",
715	        ),
716	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
717	            "full-plan",
718	            "New full-plan pass",
719	            "equivalent to --mode full-plan",
720	        ),
721	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
722	            "campaign",
723	            "New campaign pass",
724	            "split independent projects into sub-orchestrators",
725	        ),
726	        prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"),
727	    ]);
728	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
729	        title: "Choose launch path".to_string(),
730	        help: Some("Pick how DeadReckon should shape this goal.".to_string()),
731	        choices,
732	        default_index: 0,
733	    })?;
734	    match choice.id.as_str() {
735	        "recommended" => {
736	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
737	        }
738	        "run" => {
739	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Run;
740	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
741	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected one supervised coding run".to_string();
742	        }
743	        choice if choice.starts_with("extend:") => {
744	            let run_id = choice["extend:".len()..].to_string();
745	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Extend;
746	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
747	            decision.reason =
748	                "interactive picker selected a follow-up from prior history".to_string();
749	            decision.base_run_label = Some(format!("run {}", run_prefix(&run_id)));
750	            decision.base_run_id = Some(run_id);
751	            decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::ParentArtifact;
752	            decision.source_mode_label = "parent artifact".to_string();
753	        }
754	        "review" => {
755	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Review;
756	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
757	            decision.reason =
758	                "interactive picker selected coder/reviewer orchestration".to_string();
759	        }
760	        "full-plan" => {
761	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::FullPlan;
762	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
763	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected full-plan orchestration".to_string();
764	        }
765	        "campaign" => {
766	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Campaign;
767	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
768	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected campaign orchestration".to_string();
769	        }
770	        _ => set_start_recovery(
771	            decision,
772	            "guided start cancelled before choosing a launch path",
773	            vec![format!(
774	                "deadreckon start \"{}\"",
775	                shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
776	            )],
777	        ),
778	    }
779	    Ok(())
780	}

782	fn start_detected_cli_provider_ids(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
783	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
784	    let mut ids = Vec::new();
785	    for descriptor in registry.iter() {
786	        if descriptor.kind == DescriptorKind::Cli
787	            && descriptor.subscription
788	            && descriptor
789	                .default_binary
790	                .as_deref()
791	                .is_some_and(command_exists)
792	        {
793	            push_unique(&mut ids, descriptor.id.clone());
794	        }
795	    }
796	    Ok(ids)
797	}
798	
799	fn start_configured_provider_ids(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Vec<String> {
800	    let Ok(config) = read_config(&paths.config_path()) else {
801	        return Vec::new();
802	    };
803	    let mut ids = Vec::new();
804	    if let Some(default_provider) = config.default_provider {
805	        push_unique(&mut ids, default_provider);
806	    }
807	    if let Some(fallback) = config.fallback {
808	        for provider in fallback {
809	            push_unique(&mut ids, provider);
810	        }
811	    }
812	    for provider in config.providers.into_keys() {
813	        push_unique(&mut ids, provider);
814	    }
815	    ids
816	}

818	fn start_latest_extendable_run(
819	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
820	    cwd: &Path,
821	) -> Result<Option<RunListEntry>> {
822	    let scope = workspace_scope(cwd).map_err(CliError::from)?;
823	    let mut runs = list_runs(paths, Some(scope.as_str()))?
824	        .into_iter()
825	        .filter(|run| run.status == RunStatus::Completed)
826	        .filter(|run| start_run_is_extendable(paths, run))
827	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
828	    runs.sort_by_key(|run| run.updated_at);
829	    Ok(runs.pop())
830	}

832	fn start_run_is_extendable(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run: &RunListEntry) -> bool {
833	    let Ok(state) = load_run(paths, &run.run_id) else {
834	        return false;
835	    };
836	    if !paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id).is_dir() {
837	        return false;
838	    }
839	    !read_run_codebase_record(paths, &state)
840	        .ok()
841	        .is_some_and(|record| record.mode == CodebaseMode::InPlace)
842	}

844	pub(crate) fn add_start_history_actions(
845	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
846	    run: Option<&RunListEntry>,
847	) {
848	    let Some(run) = run else {
849	        return;
850	    };
851	    let prefix = run_prefix(&run.run_id);
852	    let goal = shell_display_quote(&decision.goal);
853	    let actions = vec![
854	        format!("deadreckon extend {prefix} \"{goal}\""),
855	        format!("deadreckon start \"{goal}\" --mode review --yes"),
856	        format!("deadreckon start \"{goal}\" --mode full-plan --yes"),
857	    ];
858	    decision.history_action_label = Some(format!("follow-up available from {prefix}"));
859	    decision.history_next_actions = actions;
860	}

862	fn start_provider_picker_choices(
863	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
864	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
865	    current: Option<&str>,
866	) -> Result<Vec<prompt::SelectChoice>> {
867	    let mut choices = Vec::new();
868	    let mut seen = Vec::new();
869	    if let Some(provider) = current {
870	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.to_string());
871	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
872	            format!("route:{provider}"),
873	            format!("Use current route {provider}"),
874	            "selected for this guided start",
875	        ));
876	    }
877	    if let Some(provider) = defaults.provider.as_deref() {
878	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == provider) {
879	            // The current route row is more specific than the config row.
880	        } else {
881	            push_unique(&mut seen, provider.to_string());
882	            choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
883	                format!("route:{provider}"),
884	                format!("Use configured default {provider}"),
885	                "current DeadReckon default provider",
886	            ));
887	        }
888	    }
889	    for provider in start_detected_cli_provider_ids(paths)? {
890	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == &provider) {
891	            continue;
892	        }
893	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.clone());
894	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
895	            format!("route:{provider}"),
896	            format!("Use detected CLI {provider}"),
897	            "ephemeral for this launch; config is not changed",
898	        ));
899	    }
900	    for provider in start_configured_provider_ids(paths) {
901	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == &provider) {
902	            continue;
903	        }
904	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.clone());
905	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
906	            format!("route:{provider}"),
907	            format!("Use configured route {provider}"),
908	            "ephemeral for this launch",
909	        ));
910	    }
911	    choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
912	        "typed",
913	        "Type another provider route",
914	        "advanced escape hatch",
915	    ));
916	    choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::new(
917	        "cancel",
918	        "Cancel and show setup commands",
919	    ));
920	    Ok(choices)
921	}

923	fn prompt_start_provider(
924	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
925	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
926	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
927	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
928	) -> Result<()> {
929	    let previous_route = decision.provider_route.clone();
930	    let previous_source = decision.provider_source;
931	    let Some(provider) = prompt_start_provider_route(
932	        decision,
933	        paths,
934	        defaults,
935	        setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::PrimaryRun,
936	        "Choose provider",
937	        "Pick the provider route for this launch. Defaults are not changed.",
938	        prompter,
939	    )?
940	    else {
941	        return Ok(());
942	    };
943	
944	    decision.provider_source = if previous_route.as_deref() == Some(provider.as_str())
945	        && !matches!(previous_source, StartProviderSource::Detected)
946	    {
947	        previous_source
948	    } else {
949	        StartProviderSource::Interactive
950	    };
951	    decision.provider_route = Some(provider.clone());
952	    decision.provider_label = format!("{provider} ({})", decision.provider_source.label());
953	    Ok(())
954	}
955	
956	fn prompt_start_provider_route(
957	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
958	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
959	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
960	    role: setup::SetupProviderRoleRef,
961	    title: &str,
962	    help: &str,
963	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
964	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
965	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
966	        title: title.to_string(),
967	        help: Some(help.to_string()),
968	        choices: start_provider_picker_choices(
969	            paths,
970	            defaults,
971	            decision.provider_route.as_deref(),
972	        )?,
973	        default_index: 0,
974	    })?;
975	    let route = if let Some(route) = choice.id.strip_prefix("route:") {
976	        route.to_string()
977	    } else if choice.id == "typed" {
978	        let route = prompter.input("provider route: ", None)?;
979	        if route.trim().is_empty() {
980	            set_start_recovery(
981	                decision,
982	                "no provider route selected",
983	                vec!["deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()],
984	            );
985	            return Ok(None);
986	        }
987	        route.trim().to_string()
988	    } else {
989	        set_start_recovery(
990	            decision,
991	            "provider setup is incomplete",
992	            vec![
993	                "deadreckon init".to_string(),
994	                "deadreckon detect".to_string(),
995	                "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string(),
996	            ],
997	        );
998	        return Ok(None);
999	    };
1000	
1001	    let selection = provider_setup_selection(
1002	        paths,
1003	        setup::ProviderSetupRequest {
1004	            role,
1005	            explicit_provider: Some(&route),
1006	            explicit_model: None,
1007	            config_default_provider: defaults.provider.as_deref(),
1008	            config_doc_provider: defaults.doc_provider.as_deref(),
1009	            run_provider: None,
1010	            auto_subscription_provider: None,
1011	            built_in_default_provider: None,
1012	            use_router_default: false,
1013	            allow_auto_subscription: false,
1014	            require_usable_route: true,
1015	        },
1016	    )?;
1017	    Ok(Some(selection.provider.unwrap_or(route)))
1018	}

1059	fn prompt_start_child_count(
1060	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1061	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
1062	) -> Result<()> {

1066	    );

1084	                .to_string(),

1086	        choices,
1087	        default_index: 0,
1088	    })?;
1089	    let Some(raw) = choice.id.strip_prefix("n:") else {
1090	        set_start_recovery(
1091	            decision,
1092	            "guided start cancelled before choosing child count",

1094	                "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode full-plan --children {recommended}",

1100	    let n = raw.parse::<u8>().map_err(|_| {

1103	            "enter a value from 2 through 6",

1466	fn check_start_done_criteria(cwd: &Path, selection: &setup::DoneCriteriaSelection) -> Result<()> {
1467	    let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
1468	        "deadreckon-start-done-check-{}",
1469	        Uuid::new_v4().simple()
1470	    ));
1471	    fs::create_dir_all(&temp_root)?;
1472	    if let Some(path) = selection.path.as_ref() {
1473	        fs::copy(path, acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&temp_root))?;
1474	    }
1475	    let result = evaluate_acceptance_checks(&temp_root, cwd);
1476	    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&temp_root);
1477	    println!("{}", ui_heading(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} check")));
1478	    match result {
1479	        Ok(results) => {
1480	            let failed_required = results
1481	                .iter()
1482	                .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed);
1483	            if failed_required {
1484	                println!("{}", ui_status(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} failed")));
1485	            } else {
1486	                println!("{}", ui_ok(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} passed")));
1487	            }
1488	            commands::acceptance::print_acceptance_results(&results);
1489	        }
1490	        Err(err) => {
1491	            println!(
1492	                "{}",
1493	                ui_warn(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} check could not run: {err}"))
1494	            );
1495	        }
1496	    }
1497	    Ok(())
1498	}

15	        LearnCommand::Report { scope, limit, json } => {
16	            learn_report_command(scope.as_deref(), limit, json)
17	        }
18	        LearnCommand::Export {
19	            source,
20	            output,
21	            redacted,
22	            json,
23	        } => learn_export_command(&source, output, redacted, json),
24	        LearnCommand::ImportBundle {
25	            path,
26	            preview,
27	            yes,
28	            json,
29	        } => learn_import_bundle_command(&path, preview, yes, json),
30	        LearnCommand::Propose {
31	            scope,
32	            all,
33	            from_local,
34	            bundle,
35	            limit,
36	            json,
37	        } => learn_propose_command(scope, all, from_local, bundle, limit, json).await,
38	    }
39	}

302	async fn learn_propose_command(
303	    scope: Option<String>,
304	    all: bool,
305	    from_local: bool,
306	    bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
307	    limit: usize,
308	    json_output: bool,
309	) -> Result<()> {
310	    if limit == 0 {
311	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
312	            "--limit must be at least 1",
313	            "deadreckon learn propose --limit 1",
314	        )));
315	    }
316	    if from_local && (scope.is_some() || all) {
317	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
318	            "`--from-local` is implicit; do not combine it with scope flags",
319	            "deadreckon learn propose --scope <scope>",
320	        )));
321	    }
322	    if bundle.is_some() && (scope.is_some() || all || from_local) {
323	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
324	            "`--bundle` cannot be combined with local evidence flags",
325	            "deadreckon learn propose --bundle <path>",
326	        )));
327	    }
328	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
329	    let prompt = if let Some(bundle_path) = bundle.as_deref() {
330	        let bundle = read_learning_bundle(bundle_path)?;
331	        import_learning_bundle(&paths, bundle_path, true)?;
332	        build_reflection_prompt_from_bundle(&paths, &bundle, limit)?
333	    } else {
334	        let scope = resolve_learning_scope(scope, all)?;
335	        build_reflection_prompt(&paths, scope.as_deref(), limit)?
336	    };
337	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), None)?;
338	    let route = router.selected_route_info().ok_or_else(|| {
339	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
340	            "no provider route resolves for learning reflection",
341	            "deadreckon config provider",
342	        ))
343	    })?;
344	    let response = router
345	        .complete(&ProviderRequest {
346	            prompt,
347	            max_output_tokens: 8_000,
348	            cwd: Some(std::env::current_dir()?),
349	            output_path: Some(paths.learning_dir().join("reflection.out")),
350	            sandbox_backend: None,
351	            pid_file: None,
352	            cancellation_token: None,
353	        })
354	        .await?;
355	    let reflection_provider = LearningInsightProvider {
356	        route: response.provider,
357	        model: response.model,
358	    };
359	    let report = persist_reflection(&paths, &reflection_provider, &response.content, limit)?;
360	    let surface = learn_propose_surface(&route.name, &report);
361	    if json_output {
362	        println!(
363	            "{}",
364	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(serde_json::to_value(&report)?))?
365	        );
366	        return Ok(());
367	    }
368	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
369	    Ok(())
370	}
371	
372	fn learn_propose_surface(
373	    provider_route: &str,
374	    report: &ProposalGenerationReport,
375	) -> VerdictSurface {
376	    let (kind, primary, why) = if let Some(proposal) = report.proposals.first() {
377	        (
378	            VerdictKind::Completed,
379	            format!("deadreckon improve self {} --preview", proposal.proposal_id),
380	            "The provider returned valid reflection JSON and at least one proposal was persisted; previewing the first proposal is the safest next command."
381	                .to_string(),
382	        )
383	    } else {
384	        (
385	            VerdictKind::Noop,
386	            "deadreckon learn report".to_string(),
387	            "No proposals were persisted, so the next useful command is to inspect the learning report before trying reflection again."
388	                .to_string(),
389	        )
390	    };
391	    let first_proposal = report
392	        .proposals
393	        .first()
394	        .map(|proposal| proposal.proposal_id.clone())
395	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
396	    let first_title = report
397	        .proposals
398	        .first()
399	        .map(|proposal| one_line(&proposal.title, 100))
400	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
401	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
402	        kind,
403	        "learn",
404	        Some("propose"),
405	        ExplanationPanel::new(
406	            "DeadReckon converted learning signals into provider-backed proposals.",
407	            why,
408	            vec![
409	                ("provider route", provider_route.to_string()),
410	                ("insights written", report.insights_written.to_string()),
411	                ("proposals written", report.proposals_written.to_string()),
412	                ("first proposal", first_proposal),
413	                ("first title", first_title),
414	            ],
415	        ),
416	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
417	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon learn report")],
418	    )
419	    .expect("learn propose verdict surface must be valid")
420	}

422	fn resolve_learning_scope(scope: Option<String>, all: bool) -> Result<Option<String>> {
423	    if all && scope.is_some() {
424	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
425	            "use either --all or --scope, not both",
426	            "deadreckon learn index --all",
427	        )));
428	    }
429	    if all {
430	        return Ok(None);
431	    }
432	    scope.map_or_else(|| current_scope().map(Some), |scope| Ok(Some(scope)))
433	}
