435	async fn improve_self_command(
436	    target: String,
437	    preview: bool,
438	    yes: bool,
439	    pr_dry_run: bool,
440	    open_pr: bool,
441	    json_output: bool,
442	) -> Result<()> {
443	    if [preview, yes, pr_dry_run, open_pr]
444	        .iter()
445	        .filter(|value| **value)
446	        .count()
447	        != 1
448	    {
449	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
450	            "choose exactly one of --preview, --yes, --pr-dry-run, or --open-pr",
451	            "deadreckon improve self <proposal-id> --preview",
452	        )));
453	    }
454	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
455	    let proposal = load_self_improve_proposal(&paths, &target)?;
456	    if preview {
457	        return improve_self_preview(&proposal, json_output);
458	    }
459	    if pr_dry_run || open_pr {
460	        let candidate = latest_candidate_for_proposal(&paths, &proposal.proposal_id)?;
461	        let eval = read_candidate_eval(&paths, &candidate.candidate_id)?;
462	        let policy = load_learning_policy(&paths)?;
463	        let dry_run = prepare_pr_dry_run(
464	            &paths,
465	            &proposal,
466	            &candidate,
467	            &eval,
468	            &policy,
469	            pr_dry_run || open_pr,
470	        )?;
471	        if open_pr {
472	            let adapter = GhSelfImprovePrAdapter;
473	            let pr_url = open_self_improve_pr_if_eligible(
474	                &paths,
475	                &proposal.proposal_id,
476	                &candidate,
477	                &dry_run,
478	                &adapter,
479	            )?;
480	            let surface = improve_self_open_pr_surface(&proposal, &candidate, &dry_run, &pr_url);
481	            if json_output {
482	                let payload = json!({
483	                    "proposal_id": proposal.proposal_id,
484	                    "candidate_id": candidate.candidate_id,
485	                    "branch": candidate.branch,
486	                    "pr_url": pr_url,
487	                    "body_path": dry_run.body_path,
488	                });
489	                println!(
490	                    "{}",
491	                    serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(payload))?
492	                );
493	            } else {
494	                println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
495	            }
496	            return Ok(());
497	        }
498	        let surface = improve_self_pr_dry_run_surface(&proposal, &candidate, &dry_run);
499	        if json_output {
500	            println!(
501	                "{}",
502	                serde_json::to_string_pretty(
503	                    &surface.add_to_json(serde_json::to_value(&dry_run)?)
504	                )?
505	            );
506	        } else {
507	            println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
508	        }
509	        return Ok(());
510	    }
511	    run_self_improve_candidate(&paths, &proposal, json_output).await
512	}
513	
514	fn improve_self_pr_dry_run_surface(
515	    proposal: &LearningProposal,
516	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
517	    dry_run: &PrDryRun,
518	) -> VerdictSurface {
519	    let eligible = dry_run.decision.eligible;
520	    let kind = if eligible {
521	        VerdictKind::Completed
522	    } else {
523	        VerdictKind::Blocked
524	    };
525	    let primary = if eligible {
526	        format!("deadreckon improve self {} --open-pr", proposal.proposal_id)
527	    } else if candidate.status == "verified" {
528	        format!("deadreckon improve self {} --yes", proposal.proposal_id)
529	    } else {
530	        format!("deadreckon show {} --why-failed", candidate.run_id)
531	    };
532	    let why = if eligible {
533	        "The evidence gate passed in dry-run mode; opening the PR remains an explicit opt-in command."
534	    } else {
535	        "The PR gate blocked live opening; the recommended command is the safest recovery path for the current candidate state."
536	    };
537	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
538	        kind,
539	        "improve",
540	        Some("self"),
541	        ExplanationPanel::new(
542	            "DeadReckon prepared the self-improvement PR body without pushing or opening a PR.",
543	            why,
544	            vec![
545	                ("proposal", proposal.proposal_id.clone()),
546	                ("candidate", candidate.candidate_id.clone()),
547	                ("branch", dry_run.branch.clone()),
548	                ("body", dry_run.body_path.display().to_string()),
549	                ("eligible", if eligible { "yes" } else { "no" }.to_string()),
550	                ("gate reasons", dry_run.decision.reasons.len().to_string()),
551	            ],
552	        ),
553	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
554	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon status")],
555	    )
556	    .expect("improve self PR dry-run verdict surface must be valid")
557	}

890	fn latest_candidate_for_proposal(
891	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
892	    proposal_id: &str,
893	) -> Result<LearningCandidate> {
894	    let dir = paths.learning_candidates_dir();
895	    if !dir.exists() {

897	            paths,

904	        let entry = entry?;

908	        }

912	            candidates.push((updated, candidate));
913	        }
914	    }
915	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| right.0.cmp(&left.0));
916	    candidates
917	        .into_iter()
918	        .map(|(_, candidate)| candidate)
919	        .next()
920	        .ok_or_else(|| {

980	fn diff_summary(worktree: &Path, range: &str) -> Result<(u32, u32)> {
981	    let raw = git_stdout(worktree, &["diff", "--numstat", range])?;
982	    let mut insertions = 0u32;
983	    let mut deletions = 0u32;
984	    for line in raw.lines() {
985	        let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
986	        let added = parts.next().and_then(|value| value.parse::<u32>().ok());
987	        let removed = parts.next().and_then(|value| value.parse::<u32>().ok());
988	        insertions = insertions.saturating_add(added.unwrap_or(0));
989	        deletions = deletions.saturating_add(removed.unwrap_or(0));
990	    }
991	    Ok((insertions, deletions))
992	}

994	fn learning_text_has_sensitive(value: &str, paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> bool {
995	    let lower = value.to_ascii_lowercase();
996	    lower.contains("ghp_")
997	        || lower.contains("github_pat_")
998	        || lower.contains("sk-")
999	        || lower.contains("api_key")
1000	        || lower.contains("api-key")
1001	        || lower.contains("begin openssh private key")
1002	        || lower.contains("begin private key")
1003	        || value.contains(paths.home().to_string_lossy().as_ref())
1004	        || std::env::var("HOME").is_ok_and(|home| !home.is_empty() && value.contains(&home))
1005	}

190	fn ensure_zsh_completion_rc(completion_path: &Path) -> Result<CompletionRcStatus> {
191	    let Some(completion_dir) = completion_path.parent() else {
192	        return Ok(CompletionRcStatus::Skipped);
193	    };
194	    let home = std::env::var_os("HOME")
195	        .map(PathBuf::from)
196	        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
197	    let zshrc = home.join(".zshrc");
198	    let existing = fs::read_to_string(&zshrc).unwrap_or_default();
199	    let completion_dir = completion_dir.display();
200	    let block = format!(
201	        "\n# >>> deadreckon completion >>>\nfpath=({completion_dir} $fpath)\nautoload -Uz compinit\ncompinit\n# <<< deadreckon completion <<<\n"
202	    );
203	    if existing.contains("# >>> deadreckon completion >>>")
204	        || existing.contains(&format!("fpath=({completion_dir} $fpath)"))
205	    {
206	        return Ok(CompletionRcStatus::Ready(zshrc));
207	    }
208	    let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new()
209	        .create(true)
210	        .append(true)
211	        .open(&zshrc)?;
212	    file.write_all(block.as_bytes())?;
213	    Ok(CompletionRcStatus::Updated(zshrc))
214	}

253	pub(crate) fn parse_child_provider_overrides(
254	    values: &[String],
255	    n: u8,
256	) -> Result<BTreeMap<u32, String>> {
257	    let mut overrides = BTreeMap::new();
258	    for value in values {
259	        let Some((idx, provider)) = value.split_once('=') else {
260	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
261	                &format!("child provider override must be IDX=PROVIDER: {value}"),
262	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
263	            )));
264	        };
265	        let index = idx.trim().parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| {
266	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
267	                &format!("child provider index is not a number: {idx}"),
268	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
269	            ))
270	        })?;
271	        if index >= u32::from(n) {
272	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
273	                &format!("child provider index {index} outside 0..{n}"),
274	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
275	            )));
276	        }
277	        let provider = provider.trim();
278	        if provider.is_empty() {
279	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
280	                "child provider must be non-empty",
281	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
282	            )));
283	        }
284	        overrides.insert(index, provider.to_string());
285	    }
286	    Ok(overrides)
287	}

379	fn plan_refusal_error(
380	    message: impl Into<String>,
381	    what_happened: impl Into<String>,
382	    why_this_verdict: impl Into<String>,
383	    evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
384	    primary: String,
385	    secondary: Vec<String>,
386	    no_hints: bool,
387	    json_output: bool,
388	) -> CliError {
389	    let message = message.into();
390	    let mut all_evidence = vec![("reason".to_string(), message)];
391	    all_evidence.extend(evidence);
392	    let secondary = secondary
393	        .iter()
394	        .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
395	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
396	    let surface = VerdictSurface::try_new(
397	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
398	        "plan",
399	        None,
400	        ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, all_evidence),
401	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
402	        secondary,
403	    )
404	    .expect("plan refusal verdict surface must be valid");
405	    let rendered = if json_output {
406	        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
407	            "kind": "plan_refusal",
408	            "error": surface.explanation.evidence[0].1.clone(),
409	            "next_actions": [surface.primary_action.command.clone()],
410	        })))
411	        .expect("plan refusal verdict json must serialize")
412	    } else {
413	        surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints))
414	    };
415	    CliError::Surface {
416	        code: 1,
417	        surface: rendered,
418	    }
419	}

488	fn planner_prompt(goal: &str, n: u8) -> String {
489	    format!(
490	        "You are a read-only planning agent for deadreckon. Do not write files, create temporary files, install packages, commit, delete, move, or mutate state. Inspect only if your provider supports read-only tools.\n\nReturn JSON only. Shape: {{\"tasks\":[{{\"subject\":\"imperative label\",\"goal\":\"self-contained child goal\",\"active_form\":\"present-progress text\",\"depends_on\":[\"task-0\"]}}]}}. Return exactly {n} child entries in the tasks array. Dependencies must refer to earlier child ids task-0..task-{} and form a DAG.\n\nChild hygiene:\n- Prefer child ids in execution order; earlier children should unblock later children.\n- For build/product goals, child goals must be implementation or verification slices that create or edit project files and move toward runnable behavior.\n- Do not return research-only, sourcing-only, architecture-only, or roadmap-only children unless the user explicitly asked for planning or research documentation.\n- Split independent implementation work into separate children; use research only as a dependency that directly unblocks concrete implementation.\n- Give each child enough context to run without seeing the user conversation, including likely files/modules/features and acceptance checks.\n- Never write \"based on the other worker\"; include the concrete dependency output the child will need.\n\nGoal: {goal}",
491	        n.saturating_sub(1)
492	    )

495	fn parse_planner_response(content: &str) -> Result<Vec<PlannerDraft>> {
496	    if let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(content) {
497	        return Ok(object.tasks);
498	    }
499	    if let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(content) {
500	        return Ok(tasks);
501	    }
502	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '{', '}')
503	        && let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(slice)
504	    {
505	        return Ok(object.tasks);
506	    }
507	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '[', ']')
508	        && let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(slice)
509	    {
510	        return Ok(tasks);
511	    }
512	    Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
513	        "planner provider did not return a valid child JSON object",
514	        "deadreckon plan ... --planner-provider <other>",
515	    )))
516	}

518	pub(crate) fn json_slice(content: &str, open: char, close: char) -> Option<&str> {
519	    let start = content.find(open)?;
520	    let end = content.rfind(close)?;
521	    (end >= start).then_some(&content[start..=end])
522	}

530	                _ => format!("Complete slice {}", index + 1),
531	            },
532	            goal: format!("{goal} (child {} of {n})", index + 1),
533	            active_form: Some(match index {
534	                0 => "Creating foundation".to_string(),
535	                1 => "Adding behavior".to_string(),
536	                _ => format!("Completing slice {}", index + 1),
537	            }),
538	            depends_on: Vec::new(),
539	        })
540	        .collect()
541	}
542	
543	fn infer_capability_preview(goal: &str) -> deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
544	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
545	    let deploy = ["deploy", "vercel", "netlify", "production"]
546	        .iter()
547	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
548	    let global_install = ["install globally", "global install", "npm -g"]
549	        .iter()
550	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
551	    let networked = [
552	        "api",
553	        "websocket",
554	        "web socket",
555	        "multiplayer",
556	        "online",
557	        "networked",
558	        "real-time",
559	        "real time",
560	        "realtime",
561	        "live",
562	        "server",
563	        "client/server",
564	        "asset source",
565	        "asset sourcing",
566	        "terrain data",
567	        "mapbox",
568	        "cesium",
569	    ]
570	    .iter()
571	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
572	    let network = if deploy || networked {
573	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Allowlist
574	    } else {
575	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Deny
576	    };
577	    let mut notes = Vec::new();
578	    if deploy {
579	        notes.push(
580	            "goal mentions deployment; require explicit capability before deploy".to_string(),
581	        );
582	    }
583	    if global_install {
584	        notes.push("goal mentions global install; require explicit capability".to_string());
585	    }
586	    deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
587	        network,
588	        deploy,
589	        global_install,
590	        filesystem: vec!["working directory".to_string()],
591	        notes,
592	    }
593	}

595	fn render_worker_spec(plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
596	    let dependencies = if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
597	        "none".to_string()
598	    } else {
599	        task.depends_on.join(", ")
600	    };
601	    let acceptance_line = plan
602	        .acceptance_path
603	        .as_ref()
604	        .map(|path| {
605	            format!(
606	                "- dr-gate will enforce configured done criteria from {}.",
607	                path.display()
608	            )
609	        })
610	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
611	            "- dr-gate will use the default local gate if no project done criteria exist."
612	                .to_string()
613	        });
614	    format!(
615	        "# deadreckon worker spec: {}\n\nRoot goal: {}\nChild id: {}\nRole: {:?}\nProvider: {}\nDependencies satisfied before start: {}\n\n## Scope\n{}\n\n## Capability constraints\n- network: {:?}\n- deploy: {}\n- global install: {}\n- filesystem: {}\n\n## Coordination rules\n- Treat this file as the complete brief; do not assume access to the parent conversation.\n- Do not inspect, tail, or summarize sibling child transcripts; wait for dependency summaries included below.\n- If correcting your own failed check, keep the same context and fix the root cause.\n- If acting as reviewer, approach the artifact with fresh assumptions and verify independently.\n- Report blockers as concrete file paths, command output, or acceptance failures.\n\n## Done criteria\n{}\n- Stay within this child's scope.\n- Verify relevant behavior before reporting done.\n- Do not spawn subagents or orchestrate more children.\n- Do not editorialize between tool calls.\n- Report scope, result, key files, files changed, and issues.\n",
616	        task.subject,
617	        plan.root_goal,
618	        task.task_id,
619	        task.role,
620	        task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("config default"),
621	        dependencies,
622	        task.goal,
623	        plan.capability_preview.network,
624	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
625	        plan.capability_preview.global_install,
626	        plan.capability_preview.filesystem.join(", "),
627	        acceptance_line
628	    )
629	}
630	
631	fn render_launch_worker_spec(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
632	    let mut spec = render_worker_spec(plan, task);
633	    let dependency_summaries = task
634	        .depends_on
635	        .iter()
636	        .filter_map(|dependency| plan.task_by_id(dependency))
637	        .filter_map(|dependency| {
638	            let summary_path = dependency.summary_path.as_ref()?;
639	            let absolute = paths.plan_dir(&plan.plan_id).join(summary_path);
640	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(&absolute).ok()?;
641	            Some((dependency, absolute, truncate_for_worker_spec(&raw)))
642	        })
643	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
644	    if dependency_summaries.is_empty() {
645	        return spec;
646	    }
647	    spec.push_str("\n## Dependency summaries\n");
648	    for (dependency, absolute, summary) in dependency_summaries {
649	        spec.push_str(&format!(
650	            "\n### {} - {}\n\nSummary path: {}\n\n{}\n",
651	            dependency.task_id,
652	            dependency.subject,
653	            absolute.display(),
654	            summary.trim()
655	        ));
656	    }
657	    spec
658	}
659	
660	fn truncate_for_worker_spec(raw: &str) -> String {
661	    const MAX_CHARS: usize = 4_000;
662	    let mut chars = raw.chars();
663	    let truncated = chars.by_ref().take(MAX_CHARS).collect::<String>();
664	    if chars.next().is_some() {
665	        format!("{truncated}\n\n... truncated ...")
666	    } else {
667	        truncated
668	    }
669	}

671	fn plan_source_label(plan: &Plan) -> String {
672	    let Some(cwd) = plan.parent_cwd.as_ref() else {
673	        return "current directory at fork time".to_string();
674	    };
675	    let git_label = match preview_git_state(cwd) {
676	        Ok(Some(git)) => format!("git branch={} @ {}", git.branch, git.head_sha),
677	        _ => "not git; child runs use copy mode".to_string(),
678	    };
679	    format!("{} ({git_label})", cwd.display())
680	}

682	fn plan_acceptance_label(plan: &Plan) -> String {
683	    let Some(path) = plan.acceptance_path.as_ref() else {
684	        return setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::default_gate().full_label();
685	    };
686	    let checks = fs::read_to_string(path)
687	        .ok()
688	        .and_then(|raw| commands::acceptance::acceptance_check_count(&raw).ok());
689	    setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::project(path.clone(), None, checks).full_label()
690	}

692	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
693	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
694	    match plan.status {
695	        PlanStatus::Pending => vec![format!("deadreckon fork {id}")],
696	        PlanStatus::Forked => {
697	            if plan
698	                .tasks
699	                .iter()
700	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
701	            {
702	                vec![format!("deadreckon merge {id}")]
703	            } else {
704	                vec![format!("deadreckon attach {id}")]
705	            }
706	        }
707	        PlanStatus::Merged => vec![format!("deadreckon finish {id}")],
708	        PlanStatus::Failed => vec![format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")],
709	    }
710	}
711	
712	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions_with_context(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
713	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
714	    match plan.status {
715	        PlanStatus::Failed if plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan) => vec![
716	            format!("deadreckon merge {id}"),
717	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed"),
718	        ],
719	        _ => plan_next_actions(plan),
720	    }
721	}

723	pub(crate) fn plan_verdict_surface(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> VerdictSurface {
724	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
725	    let completed = plan
726	        .tasks
727	        .iter()
728	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
729	        .count();
730	    let total = plan.tasks.len();
731	    let repairable = plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan);
732	    let (kind, what, why) = match plan.status {
733	        PlanStatus::Pending => (
734	            VerdictKind::Preview,
735	            "DeadReckon wrote the plan graph, but no child run has started yet.",
736	            "This is a pre-fork plan state; forking is the one command that advances it.",
737	        ),
738	        PlanStatus::Forked
739	            if plan
740	                .tasks
741	                .iter()
742	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed) =>
743	        {
744	            (
745	                VerdictKind::Completed,
746	                "All child runs completed and the plan is ready to merge.",
747	                "The next state-changing command composes the child artifacts into one result.",
748	            )
749	        }
750	        PlanStatus::Forked => (
751	            VerdictKind::Paused,
752	            "The plan has launched child work and is not merged yet.",
753	            "Attaching is the safest next command because the plan still has active or pending child state.",
754	        ),
755	        PlanStatus::Merged => (
756	            VerdictKind::Completed,
757	            "The plan merged its child results into a promoted result run.",
758	            "DeadReckon has a merged artifact; the recommended command lands or exports that result.",
759	        ),
760	        PlanStatus::Failed if repairable => (
761	            VerdictKind::Failed,
762	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
763	            "Merge-repair evidence exists, so rerunning merge is the safest recovery path before inspection-only commands.",
764	        ),
765	        PlanStatus::Failed => (
766	            VerdictKind::Failed,
767	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
768	            "No repair evidence is available, so the why-failed view is the safest next inspection command.",
769	        ),
770	    };
771	    let mut evidence = vec![
772	        ("plan".to_string(), id.clone()),
773	        (
774	            "status".to_string(),
775	            plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string(),
776	        ),
777	        (
778	            "tasks".to_string(),
779	            format!("{completed}/{total} completed"),
780	        ),
781	        (
782	            "events".to_string(),
783	            paths.plan_events(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
784	        ),
785	    ];
786	    if let Some(merged_run_id) = plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
787	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(merged_run_id)));
788	    }
789	    if repairable {
790	        evidence.push((
791	            "repair evidence".to_string(),
792	            paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
793	        ));
794	    }
795	    let primary = plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan)
796	        .into_iter()
797	        .next()
798	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}"));
799	    let secondary = plan_secondary_actions(paths, plan, &primary);
800	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
801	        kind,
802	        "plan",
803	        Some(&id),
804	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
805	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
806	        secondary
807	            .iter()
808	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
809	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
810	    )
811	    .expect("plan verdict surface must have one primary action")
812	}
813	
814	fn plan_secondary_actions(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
815	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
816	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
817	    for command in plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan) {
818	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
819	            actions.push(command);
820	        }
821	    }
822	    let inspection = if plan.status == PlanStatus::Failed {
823	        format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
824	    } else {
825	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
826	    };
827	    for command in [format!("deadreckon attach {id}"), inspection] {
828	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
829	            actions.push(command);
830	        }
831	    }
832	    actions
833	}

835	fn plan_has_repair_evidence(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> bool {
836	    let proofs = paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id);
837	    [
838	        "conflicts.json",
839	        "repair-request.json",
840	        "repair-plan.json",
841	        "repair-run.json",
842	    ]
843	    .iter()
844	    .any(|name| proofs.join(name).is_file())
845	}

889	pub(crate) fn orchestration_provider_role_rows(
890	    plan: &Plan,
891	    repair_enabled: bool,
892	    repair_provider: Option<&str>,
893	) -> Vec<OrchestrationRoleRow> {
894	    let mut rows = Vec::new();
895	    match plan.mode {
896	        PlanMode::FullPlan => {
897	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
898	                "planner",
899	                plan.providers.planner.as_deref(),
900	                "plan",
901	                "writes child graph",
902	            ));
903	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
904	                "default child",
905	                plan.providers.default_child.as_deref(),
906	                "plan",
907	                "runs ready children",
908	            ));
909	            let mut seen_overrides = BTreeSet::new();
910	            for (index, route) in &plan.providers.children {
911	                seen_overrides.insert(*index);
912	                rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
913	                    format!("child task-{index}"),
914	                    Some(route.as_str()),
915	                    "override",
916	                    "per-child route",
917	                ));
918	            }
919	            for task in &plan.tasks {
920	                let default_route = plan.providers.default_child.as_deref();
921	                if task.provider.as_deref().is_some()
922	                    && task.provider.as_deref() != default_route
923	                    && !seen_overrides.contains(&task.index)
924	                {
925	                    rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
926	                        format!("child {}", task.task_id),
927	                        task.provider.as_deref(),
928	                        "task",
929	                        one_line(&task.subject, 30),
930	                    ));
931	                }
932	            }
933	        }
934	        PlanMode::Review => {
935	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
936	                "coder",
937	                plan.providers.coder.as_deref(),
938	                "plan",
939	                "implementation pass",
940	            ));
941	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
942	                "reviewer",
943	                plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref(),
944	                "plan",
945	                "independent review",
946	            ));
947	        }
948	    }
949	    if repair_enabled {
950	        let derived = repair_provider
951	            .or(plan.providers.planner.as_deref())
952	            .or(plan.providers.default_child.as_deref())
953	            .or(plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref())
954	            .or(plan.providers.coder.as_deref());
955	        rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
956	            "repair",
957	            derived,
958	            if repair_provider.is_some() {
959	                "flag"
960	            } else {
961	                "derived"
962	            },
963	            "merge repair planning",
964	        ));
965	    } else {
966	        rows.push(OrchestrationRoleRow {
967	            role: "repair".to_string(),
968	            route: "disabled".to_string(),
969	            model: "-".to_string(),
970	            source: "--no-repair".to_string(),
971	            notes: "raw conflict refusal".to_string(),
972	        });
973	    }
974	    rows
975	}

1025	pub(crate) fn orchestration_dependency_rows(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<OrchestrationDependencyRow> {
1026	    let completed = plan
1027	        .tasks
1028	        .iter()
1029	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1030	        .map(|task| task.task_id.as_str())
1031	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1032	    plan.tasks
1033	        .iter()
1034	        .map(|task| {
1035	            let blockers = task
1036	                .depends_on
1037	                .iter()
1038	                .filter(|dependency| !completed.contains(dependency.as_str()))
1039	                .cloned()
1040	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1041	            let starts = match task.status {
1042	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending if blockers.is_empty() => "now".to_string(),
1043	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending => format!("after {}", blockers.join(",")),
1044	                PlanTaskStatus::Running => "already running".to_string(),
1045	                PlanTaskStatus::Completed => "done".to_string(),
1046	                PlanTaskStatus::Failed => "failed".to_string(),
1047	                PlanTaskStatus::Killed => "killed".to_string(),
1048	            };
1049	            let unblocks = plan
1050	                .tasks
1051	                .iter()
1052	                .filter(|candidate| candidate.depends_on.iter().any(|dep| dep == &task.task_id))
1053	                .map(|candidate| candidate.task_id.clone())
1054	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1055	            OrchestrationDependencyRow {
1056	                child: task.task_id.clone(),
1057	                status: task_status_label(task.status).to_string(),
1058	                starts,
1059	                waits_for: if blockers.is_empty() {
1060	                    "-".to_string()
1061	                } else {
1062	                    blockers.join(",")
1063	                },
1064	                unblocks: if unblocks.is_empty() {
1065	                    "-".to_string()
1066	                } else {
1067	                    unblocks.join(",")
1068	                },
1069	            }
1070	        })
1071	        .collect()
1072	}
1073	
1074	pub(crate) fn orchestration_parallelism_lines(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
1075	    let rows = orchestration_dependency_rows(plan);
1076	    let starts_now = rows
1077	        .iter()
1078	        .filter(|row| row.starts == "now")
1079	        .map(|row| row.child.clone())
1080	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1081	    let waits = rows
1082	        .iter()
1083	        .filter(|row| row.waits_for != "-")
1084	        .map(|row| format!("{} after {}", row.child, row.waits_for))
1085	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1086	    vec![
1087	        format!(
1088	            "starts now: {}",
1089	            if starts_now.is_empty() {
1090	                "-".to_string()
1091	            } else {
1092	                starts_now.join(", ")
1093	            }
1094	        ),
1095	        format!(
1096	            "waits: {}",
1097	            if waits.is_empty() {
1098	                "-".to_string()
1099	            } else {
1100	                waits.join("; ")
1101	            }
1102	        ),
1103	    ]
1104	}

1110	    }
1111	    println!("dependencies");
1112	    println!(
1113	        "  {:<10} {:<10} {:<18} {:<18} unblocks",
1114	        "child", "status", "starts", "waits_for"
1115	    );
1116	    for row in orchestration_dependency_rows(plan) {
1117	        println!(
1118	            "  {:<10} {:<10} {:<18} {:<18} {}",

1120	        );

1124	fn print_plan_created(plan: &Plan, no_hints: bool) {
1125	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
1126	    println!(
1127	        "{}",
1128	        plan_verdict_surface(&paths, plan).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints))
1129	    );
1130	    let ready = plan.ready_pending_task_indices().len();
1131	    let pending = plan
1132	        .tasks

1371	pub(crate) fn implementation_plan_warnings(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
1372	    if plan.mode != PlanMode::FullPlan || user_requested_planning(&plan.root_goal) {
1373	        return Vec::new();
1374	    }
1375	    let weak_tasks = plan
1376	        .tasks
1377	        .iter()
1378	        .filter(|task| task_looks_non_implementation(task))
1379	        .map(|task| task.task_id.clone())
1380	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1381	    if weak_tasks.is_empty() {
1382	        return Vec::new();
1383	    }
1384	    vec![format!(
1385	        "{} task(s) look research/design/roadmap-only for a build goal: {}. Preview/edit/re-plan before starting if these should build working software.",
1386	        weak_tasks.len(),
1387	        weak_tasks.join(", ")
1388	    )]
1389	}

1394	        .iter()

1398	fn task_looks_non_implementation(task: &PlanTask) -> bool {
1399	    let text = format!("{} {}", task.subject, task.goal).to_ascii_lowercase();
1400	    let planning_terms = [
1401	        "research",
1402	        "source ",
1403	        "sourcing",
1404	        "architecture",
1405	        "design ",
1406	        "roadmap",
1407	        "document",
1408	        "decision record",
1409	    ]
1410	    .iter()
1411	    .any(|needle| text.contains(needle));
1412	    let implementation_terms = [
1413	        "implement ",
1414	        "build",
1415	        "create",
1416	        "add",
1417	        "wire",
1418	        "test",
1419	        "verify",
1420	        "fix",
1421	        "scaffold",
1422	    ]
1423	    .iter()
1424	    .any(|needle| text.contains(needle));
1425	    planning_terms && !implementation_terms
1426	}

1435	pub(crate) fn confirm_orchestration_start(plan: &Plan, yes: bool, no_hints: bool) -> Result<()> {
1436	    if yes {
1437	        return Ok(());
1438	    }
1439	    if !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
1440	        return Err(orchestrate_confirmation_refusal_error(plan, no_hints));
1441	    }
1442	    if !prompt::confirm("start this orchestration?", true)? {
1443	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1444	            "orchestration cancelled by user".to_string(),
1445	        )));
1446	    }

1450	fn orchestrate_confirmation_refusal_error(plan: &Plan, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
1451	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
1452	    let primary = format!("deadreckon fork {id}");
1453	    let secondary = [
1454	        format!("deadreckon show {id}"),
1455	        format!("deadreckon kill {id}"),
1456	    ];
1457	    CliError::Surface {
1458	        code: 1,
1459	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
1460	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
1461	            "orchestrate",
1462	            Some(&id),
1463	            ExplanationPanel::new(
1464	                "DeadReckon wrote the orchestration preflight plan but did not launch child work because this shell cannot confirm the launch.",
1465	                "Starting child agents mutates plan and run state; without an interactive confirmation or --yes, the saved pending plan must be advanced explicitly.",
1466	                vec![
1467	                    (
1468	                        "reason".to_string(),
1469	                        "non-interactive orchestrate requires --yes after reviewing preflight"
1470	                            .to_string(),
1471	                    ),
1472	                    ("plan".to_string(), id.clone()),
1473	                    ("status".to_string(), plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string()),
1474	                    ("mode".to_string(), plan_mode_label(plan.mode).to_string()),
1475	                    ("children".to_string(), plan.tasks.len().to_string()),
1476	                ],
1477	            ),
1478	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1479	            secondary
1480	                .iter()
1481	                .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1482	                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1483	        )
1484	        .expect("orchestrate confirmation refusal verdict surface must be valid")
1485	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
1486	    }
1487	}

91	
92	impl DoctorSetupSummary {
93	    pub(crate) fn has_blocking_issues(&self) -> bool {
94	        self.failed_count > 0
95	    }
96	
97	    pub(crate) fn evidence_detail(&self) -> String {
98	        format!(
99	            "{} setup checks; {} blocking issue(s); {} optional warning(s)",
100	            self.checked_count, self.failed_count, self.warning_count
101	        )
102	    }
103	}
104	
105	impl From<&DoctorReport> for DoctorSetupSummary {
106	    fn from(report: &DoctorReport) -> Self {
107	        Self {
108	            checked_count: report.findings.len(),
109	            failed_count: report
110	                .findings
111	                .iter()
112	                .filter(|finding| finding.is_failed())
113	                .count(),
114	            warning_count: report
115	                .findings
116	                .iter()
117	                .filter(|finding| finding.status == "warning")
118	                .count(),
119	        }
120	    }
121	}

123	pub(crate) async fn doctor_setup_summary() -> Result<DoctorSetupSummary> {
124	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
125	    let source = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."));
126	    let report = build_doctor_report(&paths, source).await?;
127	    Ok(DoctorSetupSummary::from(&report))
128	}
129	
130	async fn build_doctor_report(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, source: PathBuf) -> Result<DoctorReport> {
131	    let mut findings = vec![
132	        DoctorFinding::passed("source", source.display().to_string(), None),
133	        DoctorFinding::passed("home", paths.home().display().to_string(), None),
134	    ];
135	
136	    let mut sandboxes = Vec::new();
137	    for backend in deadreckon_sandbox::doctor() {
138	        let path = backend.path.as_ref().map(|path| path.display().to_string());
139	        let version = backend.path.as_ref().and_then(|path| command_version(path));
140	        if backend.available {
141	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
142	                format!("sandbox {}", backend.backend),
143	                format!(
144	                    "found{}{}",
145	                    path.as_ref()
146	                        .map(|path| format!(" at {path}"))
147	                        .unwrap_or_default(),
148	                    version
149	                        .as_ref()
150	                        .map(|version| format!(" ({version})"))
151	                        .unwrap_or_default()
152	                ),
153	                Some(format!(
154	                    "deadreckon run \"goal\" --sandbox {} --preview",
155	                    backend.backend
156	                )),
157	            ));
158	        } else {
159	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::warning(
160	                format!("sandbox {}", backend.backend),
161	                format!("missing: {}", backend.note),
162	                None,
163	            ));
164	        }
165	        sandboxes.push(json!({
166	            "backend": backend.backend,
167	            "available": backend.available,
168	            "path": backend.path,
169	            "note": backend.note,
170	        }));
171	    }
172	
173	    let mut config_root = None;
174	    let config_present = paths.config_path().exists();
175	    if config_present {
176	        match load_config_value(paths) {
177	            Ok(root) => {
178	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
179	                    "config",
180	                    format!("{} present and parseable", paths.config_path().display()),
181	                    Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
182	                ));
183	                config_root = Some(root);
184	            }
185	            Err(err) => findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
186	                "config",
187	                format!("{} is not parseable: {err}", paths.config_path().display()),
188	                Some("deadreckon init".to_string()),
189	            )),
190	        }
191	    } else {
192	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
193	            "config",
194	            format!("{} missing", paths.config_path().display()),
195	            Some("deadreckon init".to_string()),
196	        ));
197	    }
198	
199	    if let Some(root) = &config_root {
200	        findings.extend(collect_doctor_provider_findings(paths, root).await?);
201	    }
202	
203	    let defaults = config_defaults(paths).unwrap_or_default();
204	    if defaults.provider.is_some() || config_present {
205	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
206	            "provider defaults",
207	            "provider defaults configured",
208	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
209	        ));
210	    } else if command_exists("claude") || command_exists("codex") {
211	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
212	            "provider defaults",
213	            "CLI subscription provider available",
214	            Some("deadreckon init --no-confirm".to_string()),
215	        ));
216	    } else {
217	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
218	            "provider defaults",
219	            "no provider configured",
220	            Some("deadreckon init".to_string()),
221	        ));
222	    }
223	
224	    let seams = match doctor_seam_resolution(paths, false) {
225	        Ok(lines) => {
226	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
227	                "seams",
228	                format!("resolved: {}", lines.join("; ")),
229	                Some("deadreckon run \"goal\" --no-seams".to_string()),
230	            ));
231	            json!({
232	                "status": "ok",
233	                "resolution": lines,
234	            })
235	        }
236	        Err(err) => {
237	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
238	                "seams",
239	                format!("config invalid: {err}"),
240	                Some("deadreckon doctor".to_string()),
241	            ));
242	            json!({
243	                "status": "invalid",
244	                "error": err.to_string(),
245	            })
246	        }
247	    };
248	
249	    collect_doctor_disk_and_permission_findings(paths, &mut findings);
250	    collect_doctor_os_finding(&mut findings);
251	    collect_doctor_sleep_finding(&mut findings);
252	    collect_doctor_subscription_binary_finding("claude", &mut findings);
253	    collect_doctor_subscription_binary_finding("codex", &mut findings);
254	
255	    Ok(DoctorReport {
256	        source,
257	        config_present,
258	        sandboxes,
259	        seams,
260	        findings,
261	    })
262	}
263	
264	fn doctor_verdict_surface(report: &DoctorReport) -> VerdictSurface {
265	    let failed_count = report
266	        .findings
267	        .iter()
268	        .filter(|finding| finding.is_failed())
269	        .count();
270	    let warning_count = report
271	        .findings
272	        .iter()
273	        .filter(|finding| finding.status == "warning")
274	        .count();
275	    let kind = if failed_count == 0 {
276	        VerdictKind::Verified
277	    } else {
278	        VerdictKind::Blocked
279	    };
280	    let primary = doctor_primary_action(report);
281	    let secondary = doctor_secondary_actions(report, &primary)
282	        .into_iter()
283	        .map(|action| ("Secondary", action))
284	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
285	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
286	        kind,
287	        "doctor",
288	        None,
289	        doctor_explanation(report, failed_count, warning_count),
290	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
291	        secondary,
292	    )
293	    .expect("doctor verdict surface must be valid")
294	}
295	
296	fn doctor_explanation(
297	    report: &DoctorReport,
298	    failed_count: usize,
299	    warning_count: usize,
300	) -> ExplanationPanel {
301	    let what = if failed_count == 0 {
302	        format!(
303	            "Doctor checked {} setup areas and found no blocking setup failures.",
304	            report.findings.len()
305	        )
306	    } else {
307	        format!(
308	            "Doctor checked {} setup areas and found {failed_count} blocking setup issue(s).",
309	            report.findings.len()
310	        )
311	    };
312	    let why = if failed_count == 0 {
313	        "All required checks passed; warnings, if any, are optional capabilities or local environment notes."
314	            .to_string()
315	    } else {
316	        format!(
317	            "The verdict is blocked because required setup checks failed; {warning_count} optional warning(s) were also recorded."
318	        )
319	    };
320	    let evidence = report
321	        .findings
322	        .iter()
323	        .map(|finding| {
324	            (
325	                finding.subject.clone(),
326	                format!("{} - {}", finding.status, finding.detail),
327	            )
328	        })
329	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
330	    ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence)
331	}
332	
333	fn doctor_primary_action(report: &DoctorReport) -> String {
334	    report
335	        .findings
336	        .iter()
337	        .filter(|finding| finding.is_failed())
338	        .filter_map(|finding| finding.action.as_deref())
339	        .find(|action| action.starts_with("deadreckon "))
340	        .map(str::to_string)
341	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "deadreckon run \"goal\" --preview".to_string())
342	}
343	
344	fn doctor_secondary_actions(report: &DoctorReport, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
345	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
346	    for action in report
347	        .findings
348	        .iter()
349	        .filter_map(|finding| finding.action.as_deref())
350	    {
351	        if action != primary && !actions.iter().any(|existing| existing == action) {
352	            actions.push(action.to_string());
353	        }
354	    }
355	    actions
356	}

358	fn doctor_json_payload(
359	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
360	    report: &DoctorReport,
361	    surface: &VerdictSurface,
362	) -> Value {
363	    let mut next_actions = vec![surface.primary_action.command.clone()];
364	    next_actions.extend(doctor_secondary_actions(
365	        report,
366	        &surface.primary_action.command,
367	    ));
368	    json!({
369	        "kind": "doctor",
370	        "id": &report.source,
371	        "status": surface.kind.as_str(),
372	        "next_actions": next_actions,
373	        "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
374	        "paths": {
375	            "home": paths.home(),
376	            "config": paths.config_path(),
377	        },
378	        "source": &report.source,
379	        "home": paths.home(),
380	        "config_path": paths.config_path(),
381	        "config_present": report.config_present,
382	        "sandboxes": report.sandboxes,
383	        "seams": report.seams,
384	        "findings": report.findings,
385	    })
386	}

388	async fn collect_doctor_provider_findings(
389	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
390	    root: &toml::Value,
391	) -> Result<Vec<DoctorFinding>> {
392	    let Some(providers) = root.get("providers").and_then(toml::Value::as_table) else {
393	        return Ok(vec![DoctorFinding::failed(
394	            "providers",
395	            "providers table missing",
396	            Some("deadreckon init".to_string()),
397	        )]);
398	    };
399	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
400	    let mut findings = Vec::new();
401	    for (name, entry) in providers {
402	        let kind = entry
403	            .get("kind")
404	            .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
405	            .unwrap_or(name);
406	        let kind_label = registry
407	            .get(name)
408	            .map(|descriptor| descriptor_kind_label(&descriptor.kind).to_string())
409	            .unwrap_or_else(|| config_provider_kind_label(kind).to_string());
410	        let subject = format!("provider {name} kind={kind_label}");
411	        if kind.contains("cli") || name.starts_with("cli:") {
412	            let binary = entry
413	                .get("binary")
414	                .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
415	                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
416	                    if name.contains("claude") {
417	                        "claude"
418	                    } else {
419	                        "codex"
420	                    }
421	                });
422	            if command_exists(binary) || PathBuf::from(binary).exists() {
423	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
424	                    subject,
425	                    format!("CLI binary {binary} found"),
426	                    Some(format!(
427	                        "deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider {name} --preview"
428	                    )),
429	                ));
430	            } else {
431	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
432	                    subject,
433	                    format!("CLI binary {binary} missing"),
434	                    Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
435	                ));
436	            }
437	        } else if provider_has_key(entry) {
438	            if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_DOCTOR_PING").is_some() {
439	                findings.push(collect_doctor_provider_ping(paths, name, &kind_label).await?);
440	            } else {
441	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
442	                    subject,
443	                    "credential present; ping skipped",
444	                    Some("DEADRECKON_DOCTOR_PING=1 deadreckon doctor".to_string()),
445	                ));
446	            }
447	        } else {
448	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
449	                subject,
450	                "credential missing",
451	                Some(format!(
452	                    "deadreckon config set providers.{name}.api_key <KEY>"
453	                )),
454	            ));
455	        }
456	    }
457	    Ok(findings)
458	}
459	
460	async fn collect_doctor_provider_ping(
461	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
462	    name: &str,
463	    kind_label: &str,
464	) -> Result<DoctorFinding> {
465	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), Some(name))?;
466	    let request = ProviderRequest {
467	        prompt: "Reply with OK only.".to_string(),
468	        max_output_tokens: 8,
469	        cwd: None,
470	        output_path: None,
471	        sandbox_backend: None,
472	        pid_file: None,
473	        cancellation_token: None,
474	    };
475	    let subject = format!("provider {name} kind={kind_label}");
476	    match tokio::time::timeout(
477	        std::time::Duration::from_secs(20),
478	        router.complete(&request),
479	    )
480	    .await
481	    {
482	        Ok(Ok(response)) => Ok(DoctorFinding::passed(
483	            subject,
484	            format!("ping ok model {}", response.model),
485	            Some(format!(
486	                "deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider {name} --preview"
487	            )),
488	        )),
489	        Ok(Err(err)) => Ok(DoctorFinding::failed(
490	            subject,
491	            format!("ping failed: {err}"),
492	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
493	        )),
494	        Err(_) => Ok(DoctorFinding::failed(
495	            subject,
496	            "ping timed out",
497	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
498	        )),
499	    }
500	}
501	
502	fn collect_doctor_disk_and_permission_findings(
503	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
504	    findings: &mut Vec<DoctorFinding>,
505	) {
506	    if let Err(err) = fs::create_dir_all(paths.runstate_dir()) {
507	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
508	            "runstate dir",
509	            format!("{} not writable: {err}", paths.runstate_dir().display()),
510	            None,
511	        ));
512	    } else {
513	        let probe = paths.runstate_dir().join(".doctor-write-test");
514	        match fs::write(&probe, b"ok").and_then(|_| fs::remove_file(&probe)) {
515	            Ok(()) => findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
516	                "runstate dir",
517	                format!("{} writable", paths.runstate_dir().display()),
518	                Some("deadreckon run \"goal\" --preview".to_string()),
519	            )),
520	            Err(err) => findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
521	                "runstate dir",
522	                format!("{} not writable: {err}", paths.runstate_dir().display()),
523	                None,
524	            )),
525	        }
526	    }
527	
528	    match free_kb(paths.home()) {
529	        Some(kb) if kb < 1_048_576 => findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
530	            "disk space",
531	            format!("{} MB free in {}", kb / 1024, paths.home().display()),
532	            None,
533	        )),
534	        Some(kb) => findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
535	            "disk space",
536	            format!("{} MB free in {}", kb / 1024, paths.home().display()),
537	            Some("deadreckon status".to_string()),
538	        )),
539	        None => findings.push(DoctorFinding::warning(
540	            "disk space",
541	            format!("check unavailable for {}", paths.home().display()),
542	            None,
543	        )),
544	    }
545	}
546	
547	fn collect_doctor_os_finding(findings: &mut Vec<DoctorFinding>) {
548	    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
549	    {
550	        let version = std::process::Command::new("sw_vers")
551	            .arg("-productVersion")
552	            .output()
553	            .ok()
554	            .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
555	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
556	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
557	            "os",
558	            format!("macOS {version}"),
559	            None,
560	        ));
561	    }
562	    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
563	    {
564	        let version = std::process::Command::new("uname")
565	            .arg("-r")
566	            .output()
567	            .ok()
568	            .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
569	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
570	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
571	            "os",
572	            format!("Linux kernel {version}"),
573	            None,
574	        ));
575	    }
576	}
577	
578	fn collect_doctor_sleep_finding(findings: &mut Vec<DoctorFinding>) {
579	    let preview = sleep::preview(SleepPrefs::On, true);
580	    match preview.mode {
581	        sleep::SleepMode::Caffeinate | sleep::SleepMode::SystemdInhibit => {
582	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
583	                "sleep prevention",
584	                preview.label(),
585	                Some("deadreckon run \"goal\" --prevent-sleep auto".to_string()),
586	            ));
587	        }
588	        sleep::SleepMode::None => findings.push(DoctorFinding::warning(
589	            "sleep prevention",
590	            "disabled",
591	            Some("deadreckon run \"goal\" --prevent-sleep on".to_string()),
592	        )),
593	        sleep::SleepMode::Unsupported => findings.push(DoctorFinding::warning(
594	            "sleep prevention",
595	            "unsupported",
596	            Some("deadreckon run \"goal\" --prevent-sleep off".to_string()),
597	        )),
598	    }
599	}
600	
601	fn collect_doctor_subscription_binary_finding(binary: &str, findings: &mut Vec<DoctorFinding>) {
602	    if command_exists(binary) {
603	        let provider = if binary == "claude" {
604	            "cli:claude-code"
605	        } else {
606	            "cli:codex"
607	        };
608	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
609	            format!("subscription binary {binary}"),
610	            command_version(std::path::Path::new(binary))
611	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "version unknown".to_string()),
612	            Some(format!("deadreckon config provider {provider}")),
613	        ));
614	    } else {
615	        findings.push(DoctorFinding::warning(
616	            format!("subscription binary {binary}"),
617	            "missing",
618	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
619	        ));
620	    }
621	}
622	
623	fn doctor_seam_resolution(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, no_seams: bool) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
624	    let seams = read_seams_config(&paths.config_path(), no_seams)?;
625	    Ok(SeamKind::all()
626	        .into_iter()
627	        .map(|kind| {
628	            let fail = seam_fail_policy_label(kind);
629	            match seams.command_for(kind) {
630	                Some(command) => format!(
631	                    "{}: external command={} timeout_ms={} fail={fail}",
632	                    kind.config_key(),
633	                    seam_command_basename(&command.command),
634	                    command.timeout_ms
635	                ),
636	                None => format!("{}: builtin fail={fail}", kind.config_key()),
637	            }
638	        })
639	        .collect())
640	}
641	
642	fn seam_command_basename(command: &[String]) -> String {
643	    command
644	        .first()
645	        .and_then(|argv0| Path::new(argv0).file_name())
646	        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
647	        .unwrap_or("-")
648	        .to_string()
649	}
650	
651	fn config_provider_kind_label(kind: &str) -> &'static str {
652	    let kind = kind.to_ascii_lowercase();
653	    if kind.contains("cli") {
654	        "cli"
655	    } else if kind.contains("compatible") || kind.contains("local") {
656	        "local-http"
657	    } else if kind.contains("smoke") || kind.contains("script") {
658	        "scripted"
659	    } else if kind.contains("anthropic") || kind.contains("open-ai") || kind.contains("openai") {
660	        "http"
661	    } else {
662	        "custom"
663	    }
664	}
665	
666	fn provider_has_key(entry: &toml::Value) -> bool {
667	    entry
668	        .get("api_key")
669	        .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
670	        .is_some_and(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
671	        || entry
672	            .get("api_key_env")
673	            .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
674	            .and_then(std::env::var_os)
675	            .is_some()
676	}
677	
678	fn command_version(path: &std::path::Path) -> Option<String> {
679	    std::process::Command::new(path)
680	        .arg("--version")
681	        .output()
682	        .ok()
683	        .filter(|output| output.status.success())
684	        .map(|output| {
685	            let text = if output.stdout.is_empty() {
686	                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string()
687	            } else {
688	                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string()
689	            };
690	            text.lines().next().unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string()
691	        })
692	        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
693	}

414	async fn attach_plan_tui(
415	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
416	    plan_id: &str,
417	    show_hints: bool,
418	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
419	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
420	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,

423	    enable_raw_mode()?;
424	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
425	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
426	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
427	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
428	    let mut selected = 0_usize;
429	    let mut plan = load_plan(paths, plan_id)?;
430	    let mut messages: Vec<PlanMessage>;
431	    let mut plan_events = Vec::<PlanEvent>::new();
432	    let mut feed_events = Vec::<PlanFeedEvent>::new();

434	    let mut view = initial_view;

439	    let mut narrative_projection_cache = AttachNarrativeProjectionCache::default();
440	
441	    let result = loop {
442	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Plan, AttachTickBudget::default());
443	        let now = Utc::now();
444	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
445	        let new_feed_events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
446	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
447	        let event_refresh = plan_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_feed_events);
448	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
449	        for event in new_feed_events {
450	            match event {
451	                PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event } => {
452	                    plan_events.push(event.clone());
453	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event });
454	                }
455	                PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot } => {
456	                    plan = (*snapshot).clone();
457	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot });
458	                }
459	                other => feed_events.push(other),
460	            }
461	        }
462	        if plan_events.len() > 1_000 {
463	            let drain = plan_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
464	            plan_events.drain(0..drain);
465	        }
466	        if feed_events.len() > 1_000 {
467	            let drain = feed_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
468	            feed_events.drain(0..drain);
469	        }
470	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
471	        messages = read_plan_messages(paths, plan_id).unwrap_or_default();
472	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::PlanMessages, stage_started);
473	        if let Some(notice) = poll_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job).await {
474	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();
475	            narrative_notice = Some(notice);
476	        }
477	        if selected >= plan.tasks.len() {
478	            selected = plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1);
479	        }
480	        let auto_refresh = event_refresh.or_else(|| {
481	            if view.is_narrative() {
482	                quiet_tracker.maybe_trigger(
483	                    plan.status == PlanStatus::Forked,
484	                    narrative::NarrativeCadence::default().quiet_seconds,
485	                    now,
486	                )
487	            } else {
488	                None
489	            }
490	        });
491	        if let Some(kind) = auto_refresh
492	            && view.is_narrative()
493	        {
494	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
495	            let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
496	                paths,
497	                plan: &plan,
498	                messages: &messages,
499	                plan_events: &plan_events,
500	                feed_events: &feed_events,
501	                selected,
502	                config: &narrative_config,
503	            };
504	            narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
505	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
506	                plan_narrative_refresh_request(&refresh_input, kind),
507	                now,
508	            ));
509	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
510	        }
511	        let narrative_projection = if view.is_narrative() {
512	            let input = narrative::PlanNarrativeInput {
513	                paths,
514	                plan: &plan,
515	                messages: &messages,
516	                plan_events: &plan_events,
517	                feed_events: &feed_events,
518	                selected,
519	            };
520	            narrative_projection_cache
521	                .refresh_plan(&input)
522	                .or_else(|_| Ok::<_, CliError>(narrative::build_plan_projection(&input)))
523	                .ok()
524	        } else {
525	            None
526	        };
527	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
528	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
529	            render_plan_attach(
530	                frame,
531	                paths,
532	                &plan,
533	                &PlanAttachRenderState {
534	                    messages: &messages,
535	                    plan_events: &plan_events,
536	                    feed_events: &feed_events,
537	                    selected,
538	                    show_hints,

610	                    ) =>

612	                    selected = (selected + 1).min(plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1));
613	                }
614	                Event::Key(key)

618	                }

620	                    if let Some(run_id) = plan

627	                        }

639	                        let child_result = attach_tui_with_parent(
640	                            paths,

661	    cancel_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job);
662	    disable_raw_mode()?;
663	    execute!(
664	        terminal.backend_mut(),
665	        DisableMouseCapture,
666	        LeaveAlternateScreen
667	    )?;

669	    result
670	}

752	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();

754	        }
755	        tui_state.narrative_projection = if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
756	            let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
757	                state: &state,

769	            None

836	                    let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
837	                        state: &state,
838	                        spend,
839	                        traces,

844	                    let notice = start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(

862	                    })?;
863	                    tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
864	                }
865	                Event::Key(key)
866	                    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('c')
867	                        && key.modifiers.is_empty()
868	                        && read_chain_step_marker(&state.working_dir)?.is_some() =>
869	                {
870	                    if let Some(marker) = read_chain_step_marker(&state.working_dir)? {
871	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;

873	                            commands::chain::chain_attach_command(paths, &marker.chain_id, false);

925	async fn handle_tui_completion_key(
926	    terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,
927	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
928	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
929	    key: KeyEvent,
930	) -> Result<Option<AttachActionNotice>> {
931	    let action = match key.code {
932	        KeyCode::Char('m') => CompletionAction::Materialize,
933	        KeyCode::Char('e') => CompletionAction::Extend,
934	        KeyCode::Char('a') => CompletionAction::Apply,
935	        KeyCode::Char('b') => CompletionAction::Abandon,
936	        KeyCode::Char('d') => CompletionAction::Docs,
937	        KeyCode::Char('s') => CompletionAction::Show,
938	        _ => return Ok(None),
939	    };
940	
941	    suspend_tui(terminal)?;
942	    let action_result = match action {
943	        CompletionAction::Materialize => prompt_materialize_action(paths, state),
944	        CompletionAction::Extend => prompt_extend_action(state).await,
945	        CompletionAction::Apply => super::lifecycle::apply_command(
946	            state.run_id.clone(),
947	            "squash".to_string(),
948	            None,
949	            false,
950	            false,
951	            false,
952	            None,
953	            false,
954	        ),
955	        CompletionAction::Abandon => {
956	            super::lifecycle::abandon_command(state.run_id.clone(), false, false)
957	        }
958	        CompletionAction::Docs => {
959	            Box::pin(super::doc::doc_command(super::doc::DocCommandArgs {
960	                run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
961	                kind: CliDocKind::Narrative,
962	                export: None,
963	                polish: false,
964	                no_confirm: true,
965	                force: false,
966	                doc_skill: None,
967	                doc_provider: None,
968	                budget_cap: None,
969	            }))
970	            .await
971	        }
972	        CompletionAction::Show => {
973	            show_command(&state.run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None)
974	        }
975	        CompletionAction::Quit => Ok(()),
976	    };
977	    if let Err(err) = &action_result {
978	        print_error(err);
979	        print_error_hint(err);
980	    }
981	    let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to attach...", None);
982	    resume_tui(terminal)?;
983	    Ok(Some(AttachActionNotice {
984	        action,
985	        success: action_result.is_ok(),
986	    }))
987	}

989	pub(crate) fn suspend_tui(terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> Result<()> {
990	    disable_raw_mode()?;
991	    execute!(
992	        terminal.backend_mut(),
993	        DisableMouseCapture,
994	        LeaveAlternateScreen
995	    )?;
996	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
997	    note_tui_suspended();
998	    Ok(())
999	}
1000	
1001	pub(crate) fn resume_tui(terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> Result<()> {
1002	    enable_raw_mode()?;
1003	    execute!(
1004	        terminal.backend_mut(),
1005	        EnterAlternateScreen,
1006	        EnableMouseCapture
1007	    )?;
1008	    note_tui_resumed();
1009	    Ok(())
1010	}

1021	pub(crate) fn attach_should_quit(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1022	    matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc)
1023	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL))
1024	}
1025	
1026	pub(crate) fn attach_should_return_to_plan(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1027	    attach_should_quit(key)
1028	        || matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Backspace)
1029	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('b') && key.modifiers.is_empty())
1030	}

429	fn run_confirmation_refusal_error(goal: &str, run_id: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
430	    let primary = format!("deadreckon run {} --yes", run_goal_argument(goal));
431	    CliError::Surface {
432	        code: 1,
433	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
434	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
435	            "run",
436	            None,
437	            ExplanationPanel::new(
438	                "non-interactive without --yes",
439	                "DeadReckon printed the launch preview, then refused to create run state because this shell cannot answer the confirmation prompt.",
440	                [
441	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
442	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
443	                    ("preview run".to_string(), run_id.to_string()),
444	                ],
445	            ),
446	            [("Recommended", primary)],
447	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
448	        )
449	        .expect("run confirmation refusal verdict surface must be valid")
450	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
451	    }
452	}
453	
454	fn run_codebase_refusal_error(err: DeadreckonError, goal: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
455	    let DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message) = err else {
456	        return CliError::Core(err);
457	    };
458	    let Some((primary, why)) = run_codebase_refusal_primary(&message, goal) else {
459	        return CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message));
460	    };
461	    let first_reason_line = message.lines().next().unwrap_or(message.as_str());
462	    let evidence_reason = run_codebase_refusal_reason(&message);
463	    CliError::Surface {
464	        code: 1,
465	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
466	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
467	            "run",
468	            None,
469	            ExplanationPanel::new(
470	                first_reason_line.to_string(),
471	                why.to_string(),
472	                [
473	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
474	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
475	                    ("reason".to_string(), evidence_reason),
476	                ],
477	            ),
478	            [("Recommended", primary)],
479	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
480	        )
481	        .expect("run codebase refusal verdict surface must be valid")
482	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
483	    }
484	}
485	
486	fn run_codebase_refusal_primary(message: &str, goal: &str) -> Option<(String, &'static str)> {
487	    let quoted_goal = run_goal_argument(goal);
488	    if message.contains("working tree has uncommitted changes") {
489	        return Some((
490	            format!("git stash && deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --yes"),
491	            "DeadReckon refused to create a worktree from a dirty source because the run would not have a clean base to apply or clean up from.",
492	        ));
493	    }
494	    if message.contains("git repo has no commits") {
495	        return Some((
496	            "git commit -m initial".to_string(),
497	            "DeadReckon needs a committed Git base before it can create an isolated worktree branch.",
498	        ));
499	    }
500	    if message.contains("HEAD is detached") {
501	        return Some((
502	            "git switch -c <branch>".to_string(),
503	            "DeadReckon needs a named source branch so the run branch has an unambiguous base.",
504	        ));
505	    }
506	    if message.contains("git is in the middle of a merge") {
507	        return Some((
508	            "git merge --abort".to_string(),
509	            "DeadReckon will not start a run while Git has an unresolved merge state.",
510	        ));
511	    }
512	    if message.contains("git is in the middle of a rebase") {
513	        return Some((
514	            "git rebase --abort".to_string(),
515	            "DeadReckon will not start a run while Git has an unresolved rebase state.",
516	        ));
517	    }
518	    if message.contains("branch ") && message.contains(" already exists") {
519	        return Some((
520	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --branch-name <other-name> --yes"),
521	            "DeadReckon refused to reuse an existing branch name because that would blur this run's provenance.",
522	        ));
523	    }
524	    if message.contains("non-interactive without a mode flag") {
525	        return Some((
526	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --from . --yes"),
527	            "DeadReckon cannot ask for a source-mode choice in non-interactive output, so one explicit source mode is required.",
528	        ));
529	    }
530	    if message.contains("--in-place requires --i-know-its-a-lot") {
531	        return Some((
532	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --in-place --i-know-its-a-lot --yes"),
533	            "In-place runs can mutate the current checkout, so DeadReckon requires the stronger acknowledgement before launching.",
534	        ));
535	    }
536	    if message.contains(" is not a git repo") {
537	        return Some((
538	            "git init".to_string(),
539	            "Worktree mode requires a Git repository; initialize Git or choose an explicit copy/fresh source mode.",
540	        ));
541	    }
542	    None
543	}
544	
545	fn run_goal_argument(goal: &str) -> String {
546	    format!("\"{}\"", shell_display_quote(goal))
547	}
548	
549	fn run_codebase_refusal_reason(message: &str) -> String {
550	    message
551	        .lines()
552	        .filter(|line| !line.trim_start().starts_with("try:"))
553	        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
554	        .join("\n")
555	}
556	
557	fn run_cancelled_before_turn_loop(
558	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
559	    state: &mut deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
560	) -> Result<bool> {
561	    if !cancel_marker_present(state) {
562	        return Ok(false);
563	    }
564	    if let Ok(latest) = load_run(paths, &state.run_id)
565	        && latest.status == RunStatus::Killed
566	    {
567	        *state = latest;
568	        return Ok(true);
569	    }
570	    state.status = RunStatus::Killed;
571	    state.failure_reason = Some("run cancelled before provider turn".to_string());
572	    state.killed_at = Some(Utc::now());
573	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
574	    save_state(state)?;
575	    emit_event(
576	        state,
577	        None,
578	        deadreckon_core::RunEventKind::RunCompleted {
579	            status: "killed".to_string(),
580	        },
581	    )?;
582	    Ok(true)
583	}

585	/// A cancel outcome rendered through the shared verdict surface (one verdict,
586	/// one Recommended next step) instead of a bare `println!("cancelled")`.
587	fn cancelled_run_surface() -> VerdictSurface {
588	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
589	        VerdictKind::Noop,
590	        "run",
591	        Some("cancelled"),
592	        ExplanationPanel::new(
593	            "Run cancelled before launch.",
594	            "This is a no-op because you declined to continue; no run state was created.",
595	            [("state".to_string(), "no run started".to_string())],
596	        ),
597	        [("Recommended", "deadreckon run \"<goal>\"")],
598	        [("Secondary", "deadreckon start \"<goal>\"")],
599	    )
600	    .expect("cancelled run verdict surface must be valid")
601	}

603	#[cfg(test)]
604	mod cancel_tests {
605	    use super::cancelled_run_surface;
606	
607	    #[test]
608	    fn cancelled_run_renders_surface_with_next_step() {
609	        let rendered = cancelled_run_surface().render_plain(true);
610	        assert!(rendered.contains("cancelled"), "{rendered}");
611	        assert!(rendered.contains("Recommended"), "{rendered}");
612	        assert!(rendered.contains("deadreckon run"), "{rendered}");
613	        // It is a full surface, not a bare "cancelled" line.
614	        assert!(rendered.contains("Explanation"), "{rendered}");
615	    }
