147	pub(crate) enum CampaignAttachKeyAction {
148	    None,
149	    Refresh,
150	    Back,
151	    Quit,
152	    DrillInto { sub_id: String, plan_id: String },
153	}
154	
155	pub(crate) fn handle_campaign_key(
156	    state: &mut CampaignAttachState,
157	    key: KeyEvent,
158	) -> CampaignAttachKeyAction {
159	    match key.code {
160	        KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => {
161	            state.selected = state.selected.saturating_sub(1);
162	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
163	        }
164	        KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') | KeyCode::Tab => {
165	            let max = state.campaign.sub_goals.len().saturating_sub(1);
166	            state.selected = (state.selected + 1).min(max);
167	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
168	        }
169	        KeyCode::Enter => state
170	            .selected_sub_plan()
171	            .map(|(sub_id, plan_id)| CampaignAttachKeyAction::DrillInto { sub_id, plan_id })
172	            .unwrap_or(CampaignAttachKeyAction::None),
173	        KeyCode::Char('r') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Refresh,
174	        KeyCode::Char('b') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
175	        KeyCode::Backspace | KeyCode::Esc => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
176	        KeyCode::Char('q') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit,
177	        KeyCode::Char('d') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
178	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit
179	        }
180	        _ => CampaignAttachKeyAction::None,
181	    }
182	}

184	pub(crate) fn note_tui_suspended() -> usize {
185	    TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1
186	}
187	
188	pub(crate) fn note_tui_resumed() -> usize {
189	    loop {
190	        let current = TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
191	        if current == 0 {
192	            return 0;
193	        }
194	        if TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH
195	            .compare_exchange(current, current - 1, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)
196	            .is_ok()
197	        {
198	            return current - 1;
199	        }
200	    }
201	}

244	    pub(crate) fn coalesce(&mut self, kind: NarrativeRefreshKind, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {

246	        format!(

248	            self.kind.label(),

250	            kind.label()

252	    }

259	        Some(notice)
260	    }

311	pub(crate) fn start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
312	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
313	    request: AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest,
314	    now: DateTime<Utc>,
315	) -> String {
316	    if let Some(active) = job.as_mut() {
317	        return active.state.coalesce(request.kind, now);
318	    }
319	
320	    let token = CancellationToken::new();
321	    let refresh_state = AttachNarrativeRefreshState::new(request.kind, now, token.clone());
322	    let notice = refresh_state.start_notice();
323	    let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
324	        let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest {
325	            paths,
326	            state,
327	            spend,
328	            traces,
329	            events,
330	            live,
331	            tui_state,
332	            config,
333	            kind,
334	        } = request;
335	        refresh_run_narrative_with_provider_for_kind_with_token(
336	            &paths,
337	            &RunNarrativeRenderInput {
338	                state: &state,
339	                spend: &spend,
340	                traces: &traces,
341	                events: &events,
342	                live: &live,
343	                tui_state: &tui_state,
344	            },
345	            &config,
346	            kind,
347	            Some(token),
348	        )
349	        .await
350	        .unwrap_or_else(|err| {
351	            format!(
352	                "provider refresh failed: {}",
353	                one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
354	            )
355	        })
356	    });
357	    *job = Some(AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob {
358	        state: refresh_state,
359	        handle,
360	    });
361	    notice
362	}

418	pub(crate) async fn poll_run_narrative_refresh_job(
419	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
420	) -> Option<String> {
421	    if !job
422	        .as_ref()
423	        .is_some_and(|active| active.handle.is_finished())
424	    {
425	        return None;
426	    }
427	    let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob { mut state, handle } = job.take()?;
428	    match handle.await {
429	        Ok(notice) => state.completion_notice_once(notice),
430	        Err(err) if err.is_cancelled() => None,
431	        Err(err) => Some(format!(
432	            "provider refresh failed: {}",
433	            one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
434	        )),
435	    }
436	}

35	pub(crate) fn build_sub_orchestrator_command(
36	    launch: &CampaignSubLaunch<'_>,
37	) -> Result<std::process::Command> {
38	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
39	    let mut command = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe()?);
40	    command
41	        .current_dir(launch.source_dir)
42	        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", launch.home)
43	        .env("DEADRECKON_HINTS", "0")
44	        .env("DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT", launch.launch_dir)
45	        .env(campaign::ENV_DEPTH, "1")
46	        .env(campaign::ENV_ROOT, launch.campaign_id)
47	        .env(campaign::ENV_SUB_RESULT, launch.launch_dir);
48	    if !launch.ancestor_task_keys.is_empty() {
49	        command.env(
50	            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS,
51	            launch.ancestor_task_keys.join(","),
52	        );
53	    }
54	    if !launch.ancestor_scopes.is_empty() {
55	        command.env(
56	            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES,
57	            launch.ancestor_scopes.join(","),
58	        );
59	    }
60	    command
61	        .arg("orchestrate")
62	        .arg("full-plan")
63	        .arg(launch.sub_goal)
64	        .arg("--n")
65	        .arg(launch.sub_n.to_string())
66	        .arg("--yes")
67	        .arg("--no-hints")
68	        .arg("--sandbox")
69	        .arg(launch.sandbox);
70	    if launch.plain {
71	        command.arg("--plain");
72	    }
73	    if let Some(max_spend) = launch.max_spend {
74	        command.arg("--max-spend").arg(format!("{max_spend:.6}"));
75	    }
76	    if let Some(planner) = launch.planner_provider {
77	        command.arg("--planner-provider").arg(planner);
78	    }
79	    if let Some(provider) = launch.child_provider {
80	        command.arg("--provider").arg(provider);
81	    }
82	    Ok(command)
83	}

92	/// Write a sub-orchestrator's result sidecar. Called at the end of
93	/// `orchestrate full-plan` when launched by a campaign (DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_SUB_RESULT
94	/// is set): records the plan id and its merged result run for the meta-coordinator.
95	pub(crate) fn record_sub_orchestrator_result(plan_id: &str, launch_dir: &Path, ok: bool) {
96	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
97	    let result_run_id = deadreckon_core::plan::load_plan(&paths, plan_id)
98	        .ok()
99	        .and_then(|plan| plan.merged_run_id);
100	    let sub_id = launch_dir
101	        .file_name()
102	        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
103	        .unwrap_or("sub")
104	        .to_string();
105	    let result = deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult {
106	        schema_version: 1,
107	        sub_id,
108	        plan_id: Some(plan_id.to_string()),
109	        result_run_id,
110	        ok,
111	    };
112	    let _ = deadreckon_core::campaign::write_sub_result(launch_dir, &result);
113	}

165	    if let Some(planner) = campaign.providers.planner.as_deref() {
166	        print_campaign_fact("planner", planner);
167	    }
168	    if let Some(child) = campaign.providers.default_child.as_deref() {
169	        print_campaign_fact("workers", child);
170	    }
171	    match (
172	        campaign.tree_budget_usd,
173	        per_sub.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.first()),
174	    ) {
175	        (Some(total), Some(share)) => {
176	            print_campaign_fact(
177	                "budget",
178	                &format!("${total:.2} total (~${share:.2} per sub)"),
179	            );
180	        }
181	        _ => {
182	            print_campaign_fact("budget", "unbounded");
183	            print_campaign_wrapped(
184	                "             ",
185	                "Add --max-spend <usd> to cap the whole campaign tree.",
186	                CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH,
187	            );
188	        }
189	    }
190	    if let Some(seconds) = campaign.tree_wall_seconds {
191	        print_campaign_fact("wall cap", &format_wall_cap(Some(seconds)));
192	    }
193	
194	    println!();
195	    println!("Next");
196	    println!("  Press Enter or choose [1] to launch. Edit the split first if it looks wrong.");
197	    println!("  Launch without prompting:");
198	    print_campaign_wrapped("    ", &primary, CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH);
199	
200	    println!("Sub-goals");
201	    for sub in &campaign.sub_goals {
202	        print_campaign_sub_goal(sub);
203	    }
204	}
205	
206	const CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH: usize = 88;
207	
208	fn print_campaign_fact(label: &str, value: &str) {
209	    println!("  {label:<9} {value}");
210	}
211	
212	fn print_campaign_sub_goal(sub: &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal) {
213	    println!("  {}", sub.sub_id);
214	    if let Some((body, acceptance)) = split_acceptance_clause(&sub.goal) {
215	        print_campaign_wrapped("    ", body, CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH);
216	        println!("    Acceptance");
217	        print_campaign_wrapped("      ", acceptance, CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH);
218	    } else {
219	        print_campaign_wrapped("    ", &sub.goal, CAMPAIGN_WRAP_WIDTH);
220	    }
221	}
222	
223	fn split_acceptance_clause(goal: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
224	    let (body, acceptance) = goal.split_once("Acceptance:")?;
225	    Some((body.trim(), acceptance.trim()))
226	}
227	
228	fn print_campaign_wrapped(indent: &str, value: &str, width: usize) {
229	    for line in wrap_campaign_words(value, width.saturating_sub(indent.chars().count())) {
230	        println!("{indent}{line}");
231	    }
232	}
233	
234	fn wrap_campaign_words(value: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
235	    if value.split_whitespace().next().is_none() {
236	        return vec!["-".to_string()];
237	    }
238	    crate::ui::wrap_words(value, width.max(16))
239	}
240	
241	fn campaign_choice_detail(goal: &str) -> String {
242	    wrap_campaign_words(goal, 72)
243	        .into_iter()
244	        .next()
245	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string())
246	}

248	fn confirm_campaign_start(campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign, yes: bool) -> Result<()> {
249	    if yes {
250	        return Ok(());
251	    }
252	    let prompt = format!(
253	        "launch {} sub-orchestrators for \"{}\"?",
254	        campaign.n, campaign.root_goal
255	    );
256	    if prompt::confirm(&prompt, false)? {
257	        Ok(())
258	    } else {
259	        Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
260	            "campaign preflight cancelled",
261	            &format!(
262	                "deadreckon campaign \"{}\" --n {} --preview",
263	                shell_display_quote(&campaign.root_goal),
264	                campaign.n.clamp(2, 6)
265	            ),
266	        )))
267	    }
268	}

270	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
271	enum CampaignPreflightAction {
272	    Launch,
273	    NeedsConfirmation,
274	    ChangeCount(u8),
275	}
276	
277	fn prompt_campaign_preflight_actions(
278	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
279	    sandbox: Option<&str>,
280	    yes: bool,
281	    quiet: bool,
282	) -> Result<CampaignPreflightAction> {
283	    if yes {
284	        return Ok(CampaignPreflightAction::Launch);
285	    }
286	    if quiet || !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
287	        return Ok(CampaignPreflightAction::NeedsConfirmation);
288	    }
289	    loop {
290	        let mut choices = vec![start_prompt_choice(
291	            "launch",
292	            "Launch now",
293	            format!("start {} sub-orchestrators", campaign.n),
294	        )];
295	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
296	            "edit",
297	            "Edit a sub-goal",
298	            "fix one item before launch",
299	        ));
300	        if campaign.sub_goals.len() > 2 {
301	            choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
302	                "drop",
303	                "Drop a sub-goal",
304	                "remove one item before launch",
305	            ));
306	        }
307	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
308	            "count",
309	            "Regenerate count",
310	            "ask the planner for a different split",
311	        ));
312	        choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"));
313	        let choice = prompt::select_one(&prompt::SelectPrompt {
314	            title: "Next step".to_string(),
315	            help: Some(
316	                "Enter launches this campaign. Edit first if the split is wrong.".to_string(),
317	            ),
318	            choices,
319	            default_index: 0,
320	        })?;
321	        match choice.id.as_str() {
322	            "launch" => return Ok(CampaignPreflightAction::Launch),
323	            "edit" => {
324	                let edit_choices = campaign
325	                    .sub_goals
326	                    .iter()
327	                    .map(|sub| {
328	                        start_prompt_choice(
329	                            sub.sub_id.clone(),
330	                            sub.sub_id.clone(),
331	                            campaign_choice_detail(&sub.goal),
332	                        )
333	                    })
334	                    .chain(std::iter::once(prompt::SelectChoice::new(
335	                        "cancel", "Cancel",
336	                    )))
337	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
338	                let edit = prompt::select_one(&prompt::SelectPrompt {
339	                    title: "Edit sub-goal".to_string(),
340	                    help: Some("Choose the sub-goal to update before launch.".to_string()),
341	                    choices: edit_choices,
342	                    default_index: 0,
343	                })?;
344	                if edit.id == "cancel" {
345	                    continue;
346	                }
347	                let current = campaign
348	                    .sub_goals
349	                    .iter()
350	                    .find(|sub| sub.sub_id == edit.id)
351	                    .map(|sub| sub.goal.clone())
352	                    .unwrap_or_default();
353	                let updated = prompt::open("sub-goal: ", Some(&current))?;
354	                campaign_edit_subgoal_before_launch(campaign, &edit.id, &updated)?;
355	                print_campaign_preflight(campaign, sandbox);
356	            }
357	            "drop" => {
358	                let drop_choices = campaign
359	                    .sub_goals
360	                    .iter()
361	                    .map(|sub| {
362	                        start_prompt_choice(
363	                            sub.sub_id.clone(),
364	                            sub.sub_id.clone(),
365	                            campaign_choice_detail(&sub.goal),
366	                        )
367	                    })
368	                    .chain(std::iter::once(prompt::SelectChoice::new(
369	                        "cancel", "Cancel",
370	                    )))
371	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
372	                let drop = prompt::select_one(&prompt::SelectPrompt {
373	                    title: "Drop sub-goal".to_string(),
374	                    help: Some("Choose the sub-goal to remove before launch.".to_string()),
375	                    choices: drop_choices,
376	                    default_index: 0,
377	                })?;
378	                if drop.id == "cancel" {
379	                    continue;
380	                }
381	                campaign_drop_subgoal_before_launch(campaign, &drop.id)?;
382	                print_campaign_preflight(campaign, sandbox);
383	            }
384	            "count" => {
385	                // Re-prompt on bad input instead of aborting the preflight.
386	                let count =
387	                    prompt::ask_number("sub-orchestrator count", 2..=6, campaign.n as usize)? as u8;
388	                return Ok(CampaignPreflightAction::ChangeCount(count));
389	            }
390	            _ => {
391	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
392	                    "campaign preflight cancelled",
393	                    &format!(
394	                        "deadreckon campaign \"{}\" --n {} --preview",
395	                        shell_display_quote(&campaign.root_goal),
396	                        campaign.n.clamp(2, 6)
397	                    ),
398	                )));
399	            }
400	        }
401	    }
402	}

404	pub(crate) fn campaign_replace_sub_goals_before_launch(
405	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
406	    sub_goals: Vec<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal>,
407	) -> Result<()> {
408	    if campaign.status != deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Pending {
409	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
410	            "campaign sub-goals can only be edited before launch",
411	            "deadreckon campaign <goal> --preview",
412	        )));
413	    }
414	    validate_task_count(sub_goals.len()).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
415	    campaign.n = sub_goals.len() as u32;
416	    campaign.sub_goals = sub_goals;
417	    Ok(())
418	}

420	pub(crate) fn campaign_edit_subgoal_before_launch(
421	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
422	    sub_id: &str,
423	    updated_goal: &str,
424	) -> Result<()> {
425	    let Some(index) = campaign
426	        .sub_goals
427	        .iter()
428	        .position(|sub| sub.sub_id == sub_id)
429	    else {
430	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
431	            &format!("unknown campaign sub-goal {sub_id}"),
432	            "choose one of the sub ids shown in the campaign preflight",
433	        )));
434	    };
435	    let mut goals = campaign
436	        .sub_goals
437	        .iter()
438	        .map(|sub| sub.goal.clone())
439	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
440	    goals[index] = updated_goal.trim().to_string();
441	    let sub_goals = deadreckon_core::campaign::build_sub_goals(goals, campaign.sub_goals.len())
442	        .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
443	    campaign_replace_sub_goals_before_launch(campaign, sub_goals)
444	}
445	
446	pub(crate) fn campaign_drop_subgoal_before_launch(
447	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
448	    sub_id: &str,
449	) -> Result<()> {
450	    if campaign.status != deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Pending {
451	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
452	            "campaign sub-goals can only be dropped before launch",
453	            "deadreckon campaign <goal> --preview",
454	        )));
455	    }
456	    if campaign.sub_goals.len() <= 2 {
457	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
458	            "campaign must keep at least 2 sub-goals",
459	            "drop a different sub-goal or cancel",
460	        )));
461	    }
462	    let Some(index) = campaign
463	        .sub_goals
464	        .iter()
465	        .position(|sub| sub.sub_id == sub_id)
466	    else {
467	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
468	            &format!("unknown campaign sub-goal {sub_id}"),
469	            "choose one of the sub ids shown in the campaign preflight",
470	        )));
471	    };
472	    let mut goals = campaign
473	        .sub_goals
474	        .iter()
475	        .map(|sub| sub.goal.clone())
476	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
477	    goals.remove(index);
478	    let sub_goals = deadreckon_core::campaign::build_sub_goals(goals, campaign.sub_goals.len() - 1)
479	        .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
480	    campaign_replace_sub_goals_before_launch(campaign, sub_goals)
481	}

483	/// Create a promoted result run from the composed campaign tree, binding the
484	/// roll-up into the marker signature. Mirrors `create_merged_plan_run`.
485	fn promote_campaign_result(
486	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
487	    campaign_id: &str,
488	    merge_dir: &Path,
489	    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
490	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::PipelineState> {
491	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
492	    let mut state = create_run(
493	        paths,
494	        RunOptions {
495	            goal: format!("campaign {}", run_prefix(campaign_id)),
496	            cwd,
497	            sandbox: "none".to_string(),
498	            provider: Some("deadreckon:campaign".to_string()),
499	            skill_name: "default-coding".to_string(),
500	            max_spend_usd: None,
501	            max_wall_seconds: None,
502	            run_id: None,
503	            codebase: None,
504	        },
505	    )?;
506	    remove_if_exists(&state.working_dir)?;
507	    copy_tree(merge_dir, &state.working_dir)?;
508	    deadreckon_core::campaign::write_campaign_rollup_at_run_root(&state.run_root, rollup)?;
509	    write_acceptance_marker(
510	        &state.run_root,
511	        state.run_id.clone(),
512	        state.working_dir.clone(),
513	        1,
514	    )?;
515	    state.set_phase_status(PhaseId(60), PhaseStatus::Completed)?;
516	    save_state(&state)?;
517	    promote_completed_run(paths, &mut state)?;
518	    Ok(state)
519	}

521	fn write_campaign_manifest(
522	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
523	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
524	    result_state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
525	    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
526	) -> Result<()> {
527	    let library_dir = paths.library_dir(&result_state.scope, &result_state.run_id);
528	    let manifest = serde_json::json!({
529	        "schema_version": 1,
530	        "campaign_id": campaign.campaign_id,
531	        "root_goal": campaign.root_goal,
532	        "n": campaign.n,
533	        "depth": campaign.depth,
534	        "subs": campaign.sub_goals.iter().map(|sub| serde_json::json!({
535	            "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
536	            "goal": sub.goal,
537	            "sub_plan_id": sub.sub_plan_id,
538	            "result_run_id": sub.result_run_id,
539	        })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
540	        "result_run_id": result_state.run_id,
541	        "rollup_verdict": rollup.rollup_verdict,
542	        "refused_subs": rollup.refused_subs,
543	        "caveat_subs": rollup.caveat_subs,
544	    });
545	    let path = library_dir.join("deadreckon-campaign-manifest.json");
546	    fs::create_dir_all(&library_dir)?;
547	    fs::write(
548	        &path,
549	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
550	            path: path.clone(),
551	            source,
552	        })?,
553	    )?;
554	    Ok(())
555	}

561	) -> PathBuf {

573	fn campaign_sub_summary_path(
574	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
575	    sub: &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal,
576	) -> Option<PathBuf> {
577	    let plan_id = sub.sub_plan_id.as_deref()?;
578	    let docs = paths
579	        .plan_dir(plan_id)
580	        .join(deadreckon_core::plan::PLAN_DOCS_DIR)
581	        .join(deadreckon_core::plan::PLAN_NARRATIVE);

589	fn campaign_as_merge_repair_plan(
590	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
591	    campaign_dir: &Path,
592	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
593	    parent_cwd: &Path,
594	) -> Result<Plan> {
595	    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
596	    for (index, sub) in campaign.sub_goals.iter().enumerate() {
597	        let Some(run_id) = sub.result_run_id.clone() else {
598	            continue;
599	        };
600	        let mut task = PlanTask::new(
601	            index as u32,
602	            format!("{} {}", sub.sub_id, sub.goal),
603	            sub.goal.clone(),
604	            PlanRole::Child,
605	            campaign.providers.default_child.clone(),
606	        );
607	        task.task_id = sub.sub_id.clone();
608	        task.active_form = sub.goal.clone();
609	        task.worker_spec = campaign_sub_context_path(paths, campaign_dir, sub);
610	        task.summary_path = campaign_sub_summary_path(paths, sub);
611	        task.child_run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
612	        task.child_scope = sub
613	            .scope
614	            .clone()
615	            .or_else(|| load_run(paths, &run_id).ok().map(|state| state.scope));
616	        task.status = PlanTaskStatus::Completed;
617	        tasks.push(task);
618	    }
619	    let mut plan = Plan::new(
620	        campaign.root_goal.clone(),
621	        PlanMode::FullPlan,
622	        tasks,
623	        campaign.providers.clone(),
624	        None,
625	        campaign.deadreckon_version.clone(),
626	    )
627	    .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
628	    plan.plan_id = campaign.campaign_id.clone();
629	    plan.status = PlanStatus::Forked;
630	    plan.forked_at = campaign.forked_at;
631	    plan.parent_cwd = Some(parent_cwd.to_path_buf());
632	    Ok(plan)
633	}

635	pub(crate) fn campaign_as_apply_plan(
636	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
637	    campaign_dir: &Path,
638	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
639	    parent_cwd: &Path,
640	) -> Result<Plan> {
641	    let mut plan = campaign_as_merge_repair_plan(paths, campaign_dir, campaign, parent_cwd)?;
642	    plan.status = PlanStatus::Merged;
643	    plan.merged_at = campaign.merged_at;
644	    plan.merged_run_id = campaign.merged_run_id.clone();
645	    Ok(plan)
646	}

648	fn parse_campaign_repair_mode(mode: &str) -> Result<MergeRepairMode> {
649	    match mode {
650	        "auto" => Ok(MergeRepairMode::Auto),
651	        "prefer" => Ok(MergeRepairMode::Prefer),
652	        "synthesize" => Ok(MergeRepairMode::Synthesize),
653	        "child" => Ok(MergeRepairMode::Child),
654	        other => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
655	            &format!("unknown repair mode {other}"),
656	            "use --repair-mode auto|prefer|synthesize|child",
657	        ))),
658	    }

661	fn campaign_rollup_refusal_message(rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup) -> String {
662	    if rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
663	        "campaign failed: one or more sub-orchestrators did not merge".to_string()
664	    } else {
665	        format!(
666	            "campaign failed: refused sub(s) {}",
667	            rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")
668	        )
669	    }
670	}
671	
672	struct CampaignRepairExecution<'a> {
673	    paths: &'a DeadreckonPaths,
674	    campaign_dir: &'a Path,
675	    campaign_obj: &'a mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
676	    rollup: &'a deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
677	    parent_cwd: &'a Path,
678	    repair_provider: Option<&'a str>,
679	    repair_mode: MergeRepairMode,
680	    repair_attempts: u32,
681	    quiet: bool,
682	}
683	
684	async fn repair_and_promote_campaign_result(
685	    request: CampaignRepairExecution<'_>,
686	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::PipelineState> {
687	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
688	
689	    let CampaignRepairExecution {
690	        paths,
691	        campaign_dir,
692	        campaign_obj,
693	        rollup,
694	        parent_cwd,
695	        repair_provider,
696	        repair_mode,
697	        repair_attempts,
698	        quiet,
699	    } = request;
700	
701	    if !campaign::campaign_can_complete(campaign_obj, rollup) {
702	        campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
703	        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
704	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
705	            campaign_dir,
706	            "rollup_refused",
707	            serde_json::json!({ "refused_subs": rollup.refused_subs }),
708	        )?;
709	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
710	            &campaign_rollup_refusal_message(rollup),
711	            "deadreckon show <campaign-id> --why-failed",
712	        )));
713	    }
714	
715	    let campaign_id = campaign_obj.campaign_id.clone();
716	    let merge_plan = campaign_as_merge_repair_plan(paths, campaign_dir, campaign_obj, parent_cwd)?;
717	    let mut merge = compose_plan_merge_working(paths, &merge_plan, PlanMergeStrategy::DagAware)?;
718	    let unresolved_conflicts = merge.unresolved_conflicts();
719	    if !unresolved_conflicts.is_empty() {
720	        let repair_context = MergeRepairContext::final_merge(paths, &merge_plan);
721	        let provider = resolve_merge_repair_provider(paths, &merge_plan, repair_provider)?;
722	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
723	            campaign_dir,
724	            "campaign_merge_conflict",
725	            serde_json::json!({
726	                "conflicts": unresolved_conflicts.len(),
727	                "provider": provider,
728	            }),
729	        )?;
730	        write_merge_repair_request(
731	            paths,
732	            &merge_plan,
733	            &repair_context,
734	            provider.as_deref(),
735	            &unresolved_conflicts,
736	        )?;
737	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
738	            campaign_dir,
739	            "campaign_repair_planned",
740	            serde_json::json!({
741	                "conflicts": unresolved_conflicts.len(),
742	                "provider": provider,
743	            }),
744	        )?;
745	        let Some(provider) = provider else {
746	            campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
747	            campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
748	            campaign::append_campaign_event(
749	                campaign_dir,
750	                "campaign_repair_failed",
751	                serde_json::json!({ "reason": "campaign merge repair needs a configured provider" }),
752	            )?;
753	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
754	                "campaign failed: cross-sub file conflict; repair needs a configured provider",
755	                "deadreckon providers list --all",
756	            )));
757	        };
758	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
759	            campaign_dir,
760	            "campaign_repair_started",
761	            serde_json::json!({ "mode": repair_mode.as_str(), "provider": provider }),
762	        )?;
763	        match run_merge_repair(
764	            paths,
765	            &merge_plan,
766	            &repair_context,
767	            &MergeRepairOptions {
768	                provider: &provider,
769	                mode: repair_mode,
770	                attempts: repair_attempts,
771	                quiet,
772	            },
773	            &mut merge,
774	        )
775	        .await
776	        {
777	            Ok(repaired) => {
778	                campaign::append_campaign_event(
779	                    campaign_dir,
780	                    "campaign_repaired",
781	                    serde_json::json!({
782	                        "strategy": repaired.strategy,
783	                        "repair_run_id": repaired.repair_run_id,
784	                    }),
785	                )?;
786	                write_plan_merge_conflicts(
787	                    paths,
788	                    &merge_plan,
789	                    PlanMergeStrategy::DagAware,
790	                    &merge.conflicts,
791	                )?;
792	            }
793	            Err(error) => {
794	                let reason = error.to_string();
795	                campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
796	                campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
797	                campaign::append_campaign_event(
798	                    campaign_dir,
799	                    "campaign_repair_failed",
800	                    serde_json::json!({ "reason": reason }),
801	                )?;
802	                return Err(error);
803	            }
804	        }
805	    }
806	
807	    let merge_dir = paths.merge_working(&campaign_id);
808	    let result_state = promote_campaign_result(paths, &campaign_id, &merge_dir, rollup)?;
809	    campaign_obj.merged_run_id = Some(result_state.run_id.clone());
810	    campaign_obj.merged_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
811	    campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Merged;
812	    campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
813	    write_campaign_manifest(paths, campaign_obj, &result_state, rollup)?;
814	    campaign::append_campaign_event(
815	        campaign_dir,
816	        "campaign_completed",
817	        serde_json::json!({ "merged_run_id": result_state.run_id }),
818	    )?;
819	    Ok(result_state)
820	}

822	fn print_campaign_completion(

824	    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
825	    result_state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,

827	) {

829	    if campaign_for_surface.merged_run_id.is_none() {

839	pub(crate) fn campaign_verdict_surface(
840	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
841	    rollup: Option<&deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup>,
842	) -> VerdictSurface {
843	    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{CampaignStatus, RollupVerdict, SubGoalStatus};
844	
845	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
846	    let merged_subs = campaign
847	        .sub_goals
848	        .iter()
849	        .filter(|sub| sub.status == SubGoalStatus::Merged)
850	        .count();
851	    let repairable = campaign.status == CampaignStatus::Failed
852	        && rollup.is_some_and(|rollup| rollup.rollup_verdict != RollupVerdict::Clean);
853	    let (kind, what, why) = match campaign.status {
854	        CampaignStatus::Merged => (
855	            VerdictKind::Completed,
856	            "The campaign assembled its sub-orchestrator results into one result run.",
857	            "DeadReckon has a campaign artifact; the recommended command lands or inspects that result.",
858	        ),
859	        CampaignStatus::Failed if repairable => (
860	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
861	            "The campaign stopped after sub-orchestrator work produced a refused roll-up.",
862	            "This is a deterministic campaign-level refusal, not a provider crash; repair can inspect the sub-results and produce a consolidated artifact.",
863	        ),
864	        CampaignStatus::Failed => (
865	            VerdictKind::Failed,
866	            "The campaign stopped before producing a merged result.",
867	            "No repairable roll-up evidence is available, so failure inspection is the safest next command.",
868	        ),
869	        CampaignStatus::Killed => (
870	            VerdictKind::Killed,
871	            "The campaign was stopped before all sub-orchestrators could finish.",
872	            "Killed campaign state should be inspected before cleanup or relaunch.",
873	        ),
874	        CampaignStatus::Forked => (
875	            VerdictKind::Paused,
876	            "The campaign has launched sub-orchestrators and is not merged yet.",
877	            "Attach is the safest next command because sub-plan state may still be active.",
878	        ),
879	        CampaignStatus::Pending => (
880	            VerdictKind::Preview,
881	            "The campaign record exists, but no sub-orchestrator has started yet.",
882	            "Attaching or launching the stored campaign state is the next non-destructive step.",
883	        ),
884	    };
885	    let primary = campaign_primary_action(campaign, repairable);
886	    let mut evidence = vec![
887	        ("campaign".to_string(), id.clone()),
888	        (
889	            "status".to_string(),
890	            campaign_status_text(campaign.status).to_string(),
891	        ),
892	        (
893	            "subs".to_string(),
894	            format!("{merged_subs}/{} merged", campaign.n),
895	        ),
896	    ];
897	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
898	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(result_run_id)));
899	    }
900	    if let Some(rollup) = rollup {
901	        evidence.push((
902	            "roll-up".to_string(),
903	            rollup_verdict_text(rollup.rollup_verdict).to_string(),
904	        ));
905	        if !rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
906	            evidence.push(("refused subs".to_string(), rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")));
907	        }
908	        if !rollup.caveat_subs.is_empty() {
909	            evidence.push(("caveat subs".to_string(), rollup.caveat_subs.join(", ")));
910	        }
911	    }
912	    let secondary = campaign_secondary_actions(campaign, &primary);
913	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
914	        kind,
915	        "campaign",
916	        Some(&id),
917	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
918	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
919	        secondary
920	            .iter()
921	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
922	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
923	    )
924	    .expect("campaign verdict surface must have one primary action")
925	}
926	
927	fn campaign_primary_action(
928	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
929	    repairable: bool,
930	) -> String {
931	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
932	    if repairable {
933	        return format!("deadreckon campaign repair {id}");
934	    }
935	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
936	        return format!("deadreckon apply {}", run_prefix(result_run_id));
937	    }
938	    match campaign.status {
939	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed => {
940	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
941	        }
942	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Killed => {
943	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
944	        }
945	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Forked
946	        | deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Pending => format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
947	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Merged => format!("deadreckon show {id}"),
948	    }
949	}
950	
951	fn campaign_secondary_actions(
952	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
953	    primary: &str,
954	) -> Vec<String> {
955	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
956	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
957	    for command in [
958	        format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
959	        format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed"),
960	        campaign
961	            .merged_run_id
962	            .as_deref()
963	            .map(|run_id| format!("deadreckon show {}", run_prefix(run_id)))
964	            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}")),
965	    ] {
966	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
967	            actions.push(command);
968	        }
969	    }
970	    actions
971	}

973	pub(crate) async fn campaign_command(args: CampaignArgs) -> Result<()> {
974	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
975	
976	    let goal = args.goal.trim().to_string();
977	    if goal.is_empty() {
978	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
979	            "campaign goal must be non-empty",
980	            "deadreckon campaign \"your goal\"",
981	        )));
982	    }
983	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
984	    let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
985	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
986	    let scope = workspace_scope(&cwd)?;
987	    let mut n = if let Some(n) = args.n {
988	        n
989	    } else {
990	        let provider = args
991	            .planner_provider
992	            .as_deref()
993	            .or(args.provider.as_deref())
994	            .map(ToString::to_string)
995	            .or_else(|| goal_shape_provider_route(&paths, &defaults, None));
996	        let recommendation =
997	            classify_goal_shape_for_start(&paths, &cwd, &goal, provider.as_deref(), args.plain)
998	                .await;
999	        write_goal_shape_preview_record(&paths, &scope, &recommendation)?;
1000	        recommendation
1001	            .n
1002	            .unwrap_or_else(|| recommend_child_count_for_goal(&goal, CliPlanMode::FullPlan))
1003	    };
1004	    deadreckon_core::plan::validate_task_count(usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1005	
1006	    let lineage = campaign::lineage_from_env();
1007	    if lineage.depth + 1 >= campaign::CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
1008	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
1009	            code: 1,
1010	            surface: campaign_depth_refusal_surface(
1011	                &goal,
1012	                n,
1013	                lineage.depth,
1014	                args.planner_provider.as_deref(),
1015	                args.provider.as_deref(),
1016	            )
1017	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(args.no_hints)),
1018	        });
1019	    }
1020	
1021	    let providers = resolve_plan_providers(
1022	        &paths,
1023	        &defaults,
1024	        PlanMode::FullPlan,
1025	        args.planner_provider.clone(),
1026	        args.provider.clone(),
1027	        None,
1028	        None,
1029	    )?;
1030	    let overrides = BTreeMap::new();
1031	    let tasks = build_full_plan_tasks(
1032	        &paths,
1033	        &goal,
1034	        n,
1035	        &providers,
1036	        &overrides,
1037	        &cwd,
1038	        args.plain,
1039	        args.no_hints,
1040	        false,
1041	    )
1042	    .await?;
1043	    let sub_goal_strings: Vec<String> = tasks.iter().map(|task| task.goal.clone()).collect();
1044	    let sub_goals =
1045	        campaign::build_sub_goals(sub_goal_strings, usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1046	    let sub_keys: Vec<String> = sub_goals.iter().map(|sub| sub.task_key.clone()).collect();
1047	    campaign::guard(
1048	        lineage.depth,
1049	        &lineage.ancestor_task_keys,
1050	        &lineage.ancestor_scopes,
1051	        &sub_keys,
1052	        &[],
1053	    )?;
1054	
1055	    let mut campaign_obj = campaign::Campaign::new(
1056	        goal.clone(),
1057	        sub_goals,
1058	        providers.clone(),
1059	        lineage.depth,
1060	        args.max_spend,
1061	        args.max_wall_seconds,
1062	        env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
1063	    )
1064	    .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1065	    let campaign_id = campaign_obj.campaign_id.clone();
1066	    let campaign_dir = paths.plan_dir(&campaign_id);
1067	    fs::create_dir_all(&campaign_dir)?;
1068	    campaign::write_campaign(&campaign_dir, &campaign_obj)?;
1069	    let mut lineage_scopes = lineage.ancestor_scopes.clone();
1070	    lineage_scopes.push(scope.clone());
1071	    campaign::write_lineage(
1072	        &campaign_dir,
1073	        &campaign::Lineage {
1074	            schema_version: 1,
1075	            depth: lineage.depth,
1076	            campaign_root_id: Some(campaign_id.clone()),
1077	            ancestor_task_keys: lineage.ancestor_task_keys.clone(),
1078	            ancestor_scopes: lineage_scopes,
1079	        },
1080	    )?;
1081	    campaign::append_campaign_event(
1082	        &campaign_dir,
1083	        "campaign_created",
1084	        serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign_obj.n, "root_goal": campaign_obj.root_goal }),
1085	    )?;
1086	
1087	    if args.preview {
1088	        if !args.quiet {
1089	            print_campaign_preflight(&campaign_obj, args.sandbox.as_deref());
1090	        }
1091	        campaign::write_campaign(&campaign_dir, &campaign_obj)?;
1092	        return Ok(());
1093	    }
1094	    if !args.quiet {
1095	        print_campaign_preflight(&campaign_obj, args.sandbox.as_deref());
1096	    }
1097	    loop {
1098	        match prompt_campaign_preflight_actions(
1099	            &mut campaign_obj,
1100	            args.sandbox.as_deref(),
1101	            args.yes,
1102	            args.quiet,
1103	        )? {
1104	            CampaignPreflightAction::Launch => break,
1105	            CampaignPreflightAction::NeedsConfirmation => {
1106	                confirm_campaign_start(&campaign_obj, args.yes)?;
1107	                break;
1108	            }
1109	            CampaignPreflightAction::ChangeCount(new_n) => {
1110	                n = new_n;
1111	                let tasks = build_full_plan_tasks(
1112	                    &paths,
1113	                    &goal,
1114	                    n,
1115	                    &providers,
1116	                    &overrides,
1117	                    &cwd,
1118	                    args.plain,
1119	                    args.no_hints,
1120	                    false,
1121	                )
1122	                .await?;
1123	                let sub_goal_strings: Vec<String> =
1124	                    tasks.iter().map(|task| task.goal.clone()).collect();
1125	                let sub_goals = campaign::build_sub_goals(sub_goal_strings, usize::from(n))
1126	                    .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1127	                let sub_keys: Vec<String> =
1128	                    sub_goals.iter().map(|sub| sub.task_key.clone()).collect();
1129	                campaign::guard(
1130	                    lineage.depth,
1131	                    &lineage.ancestor_task_keys,
1132	                    &lineage.ancestor_scopes,
1133	                    &sub_keys,
1134	                    &[],
1135	                )?;
1136	                campaign_replace_sub_goals_before_launch(&mut campaign_obj, sub_goals)?;
1137	                campaign::append_campaign_event(
1138	                    &campaign_dir,
1139	                    "campaign_count_changed",
1140	                    serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign_obj.n }),
1141	                )?;
1142	                campaign::write_campaign(&campaign_dir, &campaign_obj)?;
1143	                if !args.quiet {
1144	                    print_campaign_preflight(&campaign_obj, args.sandbox.as_deref());
1145	                }
1146	            }
1147	        }
1148	    }
1149	    campaign::write_campaign(&campaign_dir, &campaign_obj)?;
1150	
1151	    let sandbox = args.sandbox.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
1152	    let per_sub = campaign_obj
1153	        .tree_budget_usd
1154	        .map(|budget| campaign::allocate_budget(budget, campaign_obj.sub_goals.len()));
1155	    let home = paths.home().to_path_buf();
1156	    let planner = providers.planner.clone();
1157	    let child_provider = providers.default_child.clone();
1158	    let plain = args.plain;
1159	    let final_sub_keys: Vec<String> = campaign_obj
1160	        .sub_goals
1161	        .iter()
1162	        .map(|sub| sub.task_key.clone())
1163	        .collect();
1164	    let mut ancestor_task_keys = lineage.ancestor_task_keys.clone();
1165	    ancestor_task_keys.extend(final_sub_keys.iter().cloned());
1166	    let mut ancestor_scopes = lineage.ancestor_scopes.clone();
1167	    ancestor_scopes.push(scope.clone());
1168	    let launch_paths = &paths;
1169	    let mut sub_index = 0usize;
1170	
1171	    run_campaign_fork(
1172	        &campaign_dir,
1173	        &mut campaign_obj,
1174	        |sub, launch_dir| {
1175	            let share = per_sub
1176	                .as_ref()
1177	                .and_then(|shares| shares.get(sub_index).copied());
1178	            sub_index += 1;
1179	            let mut command = build_sub_orchestrator_command(&CampaignSubLaunch {
1180	                home: &home,
1181	                source_dir: &cwd,
1182	                launch_dir,
1183	                campaign_id: &campaign_id,
1184	                sub_goal: &sub.goal,
1185	                sub_n: 2,
1186	                sandbox: &sandbox,
1187	                max_spend: share,
1188	                plain,
1189	                planner_provider: planner.as_deref(),
1190	                child_provider: child_provider.as_deref(),
1191	                ancestor_task_keys: &ancestor_task_keys,
1192	                ancestor_scopes: &ancestor_scopes,
1193	            })?;
1194	            let status = command.status()?;
1195	            if !status.success() {
1196	                return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1197	                    "sub-orchestrator {} exited with {status}",
1198	                    sub.sub_id
1199	                ))));
1200	            }
1201	            discover_sub_result(launch_dir)?.ok_or_else(|| {
1202	                CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1203	                    "sub-orchestrator {} produced no result",
1204	                    sub.sub_id
1205	                )))
1206	            })
1207	        },
1208	        |result| {
1209	            result
1210	                .result_run_id
1211	                .as_deref()
1212	                .and_then(|run_id| load_run(launch_paths, run_id).ok())
1213	                .map(|state| state.total_spend_usd)
1214	                .unwrap_or(0.0)
1215	        },
1216	    )?;
1217	
1218	    let rollup = campaign::build_rollup(&campaign_obj, |run_id| match load_run(&paths, run_id) {
1219	        Ok(state) => {
1220	            let tamper =
1221	                deadreckon_core::tamper::read_acceptance_tamper_for_run_root(&state.run_root)
1222	                    .ok()
1223	                    .flatten();
1224	            let verdict = tamper
1225	                .as_ref()
1226	                .map(|tamper| tamper.verdict)
1227	                .unwrap_or(deadreckon_core::tamper::AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Clean);
1228	            let caveats = tamper.map(|tamper| tamper.caveats).unwrap_or_default();
1229	            let gate = if deadreckon_core::gate::validate_acceptance_marker(&state).is_ok() {
1230	                "signed".to_string()
1231	            } else {
1232	                "refused".to_string()
1233	            };
1234	            (gate, verdict, caveats)
1235	        }
1236	        Err(_) => (
1237	            "missing".to_string(),
1238	            deadreckon_core::tamper::AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse,
1239	            Vec::new(),
1240	        ),
1241	    });
1242	    campaign::write_campaign_rollup(&campaign_dir, &rollup)?;
1243	
1244	    let result_state = repair_and_promote_campaign_result(CampaignRepairExecution {
1245	        paths: &paths,
1246	        campaign_dir: &campaign_dir,
1247	        campaign_obj: &mut campaign_obj,
1248	        rollup: &rollup,
1249	        parent_cwd: &cwd,
1250	        repair_provider: None,
1251	        repair_mode: MergeRepairMode::Auto,
1252	        repair_attempts: 1,
1253	        quiet: args.quiet,
1254	    })
1255	    .await?;
1256	    if !args.quiet {
1257	        print_campaign_completion(&campaign_obj, &rollup, &result_state, args.no_hints);
1258	    }
1259	    Ok(())
1260	}
1261	
1262	fn campaign_depth_refusal_surface(
1263	    goal: &str,
1264	    n: u8,
1265	    current_depth: u32,
1266	    planner_provider: Option<&str>,
1267	    child_provider: Option<&str>,
1268	) -> VerdictSurface {
1269	    let mut primary = format!(
1270	        "deadreckon orchestrate full-plan \"{}\" --n {}",
1271	        shell_display_quote(goal),
1272	        n
1273	    );
1274	    if let Some(provider) = planner_provider {
1275	        primary.push_str(&format!(" --planner-provider {provider}"));
1276	    }
1277	    if let Some(provider) = child_provider {
1278	        primary.push_str(&format!(" --provider {provider}"));
1279	    }
1280	
1281	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1282	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
1283	        "campaign",
1284	        None,
1285	        ExplanationPanel::new(
1286	            "DeadReckon refused to start a nested campaign because depth cap 2 reached.",
1287	            "This is a controlled recursion guard; use an orchestrated full-plan inside the sub-orchestrator instead of starting another campaign coordinator.",
1288	            [
1289	                ("goal", goal.to_string()),
1290	                ("current depth", current_depth.to_string()),
1291	                (
1292	                    "depth cap",
1293	                    deadreckon_core::campaign::CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH.to_string(),
1294	                ),
1295	                ("requested subs", n.to_string()),
1296	                ("reason", "sub-orchestrators cannot campaign again".to_string()),
1297	            ],
1298	        ),
1299	        [("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1300	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
1301	    )
1302	    .expect("campaign depth refusal must have one primary action")
1303	}
1304	
1305	fn campaign_repair_refusal_surface(
1306	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1307	    kind: VerdictKind,
1308	    what: impl Into<String>,
1309	    why: impl Into<String>,
1310	    primary: String,
1311	) -> VerdictSurface {
1312	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
1313	    let mut evidence = vec![
1314	        ("campaign".to_string(), id.clone()),
1315	        (
1316	            "status".to_string(),
1317	            campaign_status_text(campaign.status).to_string(),
1318	        ),
1319	        ("subs".to_string(), campaign.n.to_string()),
1320	    ];
1321	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
1322	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(result_run_id)));
1323	    }
1324	    let mut secondary = Vec::new();
1325	    for command in [
1326	        format!("deadreckon show {id}"),
1327	        format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
1328	        campaign
1329	            .merged_run_id
1330	            .as_deref()

264	pub(crate) fn recommend_orchestration_mode(goal: &str) -> CliPlanMode {
265	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
266	    let broad_product = [
267	        "make a full",
268	        "build a full",
269	        "create a full",
270	        "fully",
271	        "from scratch",
272	        "app",
273	        "game",
274	        "site",
275	        "multiplayer",
276	        "realtime",
277	        "real-time",
278	        "live",
279	        "server",
280	        "client",
281	    ]
282	    .iter()
283	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
284	    let focused_change = [
285	        "fix ", "bug", "change ", "refactor", "review", "audit", "explain", "docs", "rename",
286	    ]
287	    .iter()
288	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
289	    if broad_product && !focused_change {
290	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan
291	    } else {
292	        CliPlanMode::Review
293	    }
294	}

164	pub(crate) fn import_command(options: ImportCommandOptions) -> Result<()> {
165	    // Import is a read-only recovery bridge. It reads provider transcript roots
166	    // through descriptor [ingest] metadata and writes only deadreckon run state.
167	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
168	    let cwd = options
169	        .cwd
170	        .as_deref()
171	        .map(|path| fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf()))
172	        .unwrap_or(std::env::current_dir()?);
173	    let since = import_since(&options)?;
174	    let resolved = resolve_import_source(&paths, &options, &cwd)?;
175	    let candidates = discover_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &cwd, since);
176	
177	    if options.list {
178	        print_import_candidates(&resolved, &candidates, options.json, "import_candidates")?;
179	        return Ok(());
180	    }
181	
182	    if candidates.is_empty() {
183	        let stale = stale_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &cwd, since);
184	        if !stale.is_empty() {
185	            return Err(import_invalid(format!(
186	                "no fresh import candidates for {}; stale candidates were found\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --since 1d --preview",
187	                resolved.alias,
188	                import_candidate_table(&stale),
189	                resolved.alias
190	            )));
191	        }
192	    }
193	
194	    let (selected, mode) = select_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &candidates)?;
195	    if options.preview {
196	        print_import_selection(&resolved, &selected, mode, options.json)?;
197	        return Ok(());
198	    }
199	
200	    let (run_id, manifest) = normalize_import(&paths, &resolved, &selected, mode, &options, &cwd)?;
201	    let manifest_path = paths
202	        .run_root(&manifest_scope(&cwd)?, &run_id)
203	        .join("import.json");
204	    let surface = import_completed_surface(&resolved, &run_id, &manifest, &manifest_path, mode);
205	    if options.json {
206	        let primary = surface.primary_action.command.clone();
207	        let secondary = manifest.reimport_command.clone();
208	        println!(
209	            "{}",
210	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(serde_json::to_value(
211	                ImportCompletedJson {
212	                    kind: "import_completed",
213	                    run_id: &run_id,
214	                    manifest_path,
215	                    manifest: &manifest,
216	                    next_actions: vec![primary.clone(), secondary.clone()],
217	                    try_lines: vec![primary, secondary],
218	                },
219	            )?))?
220	        );
221	        return Ok(());
222	    }
223	
224	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
225	    Ok(())
226	}
