365	fn resolve_import_source(
366	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
367	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
368	    cwd: &Path,
369	) -> Result<ResolvedImportSource> {
370	    let source = options.source.trim();
371	    if source == "cursor" {
372	        let home = std::env::var_os("HOME")
373	            .map(PathBuf::from)
374	            .unwrap_or_else(|| paths.home().to_path_buf());
375	        let root = std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_IMPORT_CURSOR_ROOT")
376	            .map(PathBuf::from)
377	            .unwrap_or_else(|| home.join(".cursor/chats"));
378	        return Ok(ResolvedImportSource {
379	            alias: source.to_string(),
380	            source: "cursor".to_string(),
381	            schema: "cursor-sqlite".to_string(),
382	            storage: IngestStorage::Json,
383	            roots: vec![root],
384	            cwd_match: IngestCwdMatch::None,
385	            cwd_match_path: None,
386	            file_glob: Some("*.db".to_string()),
387	            id_prefix: Some("cursor:".to_string()),
388	            kind: ImportSourceKind::Cursor,
389	        });
390	    }
391	
392	    let descriptor_id = import_descriptor_id(source).ok_or_else(|| {
393	        import_invalid(format!(
394	            "unknown import source {source}; accepted sources: {}\ntry: deadreckon import codex --list",
395	            accepted_import_sources().join(", ")
396	        ))
397	    })?;
398	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
399	    let descriptor = registry.get(&descriptor_id).ok_or_else(|| {
400	        import_invalid(format!(
401	            "unknown import source {source}; accepted sources: {}\ntry: deadreckon import codex --list",
402	            accepted_import_sources().join(", ")
403	        ))
404	    })?;
405	    let ingest = descriptor.ingest.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
406	        import_invalid(format!(
407	            "{} has no importable descriptor [ingest]\ntry: deadreckon providers list --all",
408	            descriptor.id
409	        ))
410	    })?;
411	    let schema = ingest.schema.trim();
412	    if schema.is_empty() {
413	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
414	            "{} has an empty descriptor ingest schema\ntry: deadreckon providers list --all",
415	            descriptor.id
416	        )));
417	    }
418	    let home = std::env::var_os("HOME")
419	        .map(PathBuf::from)
420	        .unwrap_or_else(|| paths.home().to_path_buf());
421	    let working_dirs = vec![cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()];
422	    let roots = provider_ingest_roots_for_working_dirs(
423	        &ingest,
424	        &home,
425	        &working_dirs,
426	        options.all || options.session.is_some(),
427	    );
428	    let storage = ingest.storage.clone().unwrap_or(IngestStorage::Jsonl);
429	    Ok(ResolvedImportSource {
430	        alias: source.to_string(),
431	        source: descriptor.id.clone(),
432	        schema: schema.to_string(),
433	        storage,
434	        roots,
435	        cwd_match: ingest.cwd_match.clone(),
436	        cwd_match_path: ingest.cwd_match_path.clone(),
437	        file_glob: ingest.file_glob.clone(),
438	        id_prefix: ingest.id_prefix.clone(),
439	        kind: ImportSourceKind::Provider,
440	    })
441	}
442	
443	fn discover_import_candidates(
444	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
445	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
446	    cwd: &Path,
447	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
448	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
449	    let effective_since = if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
450	        import_long_ago()
451	    } else {
452	        since
453	    };
454	    let mut candidates = match &resolved.kind {
455	        ImportSourceKind::Provider => {
456	            discover_provider_import_candidates(resolved, cwd, effective_since)
457	        }
458	        ImportSourceKind::Cursor => discover_cursor_import_candidates(resolved, effective_since),
459	    };
460	    if let Some(session) = options.session.as_deref()
461	        && !candidates
462	            .iter()
463	            .any(|candidate| import_candidate_matches(candidate, session))
464	        && Path::new(session).exists()
465	    {
466	        candidates.push(candidate_from_explicit_path(resolved, Path::new(session)));
467	    }
468	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
469	        right
470	            .updated_at
471	            .cmp(&left.updated_at)
472	            .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))
473	    });
474	    candidates
475	}
476	
477	fn stale_import_candidates(
478	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
479	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
480	    cwd: &Path,
481	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
482	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
483	    if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
484	        return Vec::new();
485	    }
486	    let mut candidates = match &resolved.kind {
487	        ImportSourceKind::Provider => {
488	            discover_provider_import_candidates(resolved, cwd, import_long_ago())
489	        }
490	        ImportSourceKind::Cursor => discover_cursor_import_candidates(resolved, import_long_ago()),
491	    };
492	    candidates.retain(|candidate| candidate.updated_at < since);
493	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
494	        right
495	            .updated_at
496	            .cmp(&left.updated_at)
497	            .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))
498	    });
499	    candidates
500	}
501	
502	fn discover_provider_import_candidates(
503	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
504	    cwd: &Path,
505	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
506	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
507	    let spec = ProviderJsonlLogSpec {
508	        schema: resolved.schema.clone(),
509	        roots: resolved.roots.clone(),
510	        since,
511	        cwd_match: resolved.cwd_match.clone(),
512	        cwd_match_path: resolved.cwd_match_path.clone(),
513	        storage: resolved.storage.clone(),
514	        file_glob: resolved.file_glob.clone(),
515	    };
516	    let working_dirs = vec![cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()];
517	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
518	    for root in &resolved.roots {
519	        let mut files = Vec::new();
520	        collect_recent_provider_files(root, &spec, &mut files, 0);
521	        for (path, updated_at) in files {
522	            let matched_cwd = provider_jsonl_session_matches_run(&spec, &path, &working_dirs)
523	                .then(|| cwd.to_path_buf());
524	            let session_id = provider_import_session_id(resolved, &path);
525	            let id = import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path);
526	            candidates.push(ImportCandidate {
527	                id,
528	                session_id,
529	                paths: vec![path.clone()],
530	                root: root.clone(),
531	                updated_at,
532	                matched_cwd,
533	                row_count_hint: import_row_count_hint(resolved, &path),
534	            });
535	        }
536	    }
537	    candidates
538	}
539	
540	fn discover_cursor_import_candidates(
541	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
542	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
543	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
544	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
545	    for root in &resolved.roots {
546	        let Ok(files) = inventory_files(root) else {
547	            continue;
548	        };
549	        for path in files {
550	            let extension = path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
551	            if !matches!(extension, "sqlite" | "sqlite3" | "db") {
552	                continue;
553	            }
554	            let Some(updated_at) = fs::metadata(&path)
555	                .ok()
556	                .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified().ok())
557	                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
558	            else {
559	                continue;
560	            };
561	            if updated_at < since {
562	                continue;
563	            }
564	            let session_id = path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()).map(|stem| {
565	                let prefix = resolved.id_prefix.as_deref().unwrap_or("cursor:");
566	                format!("{prefix}{stem}")
567	            });
568	            let id = import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path);
569	            candidates.push(ImportCandidate {
570	                id,
571	                session_id,
572	                paths: vec![path],
573	                root: root.clone(),
574	                updated_at,
575	                matched_cwd: None,
576	                row_count_hint: None,
577	            });
578	        }
579	    }
580	    candidates
581	}
582	
583	fn candidate_from_explicit_path(resolved: &ResolvedImportSource, path: &Path) -> ImportCandidate {
584	    let path = fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf());
585	    let updated_at = fs::metadata(&path)
586	        .ok()
587	        .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified().ok())
588	        .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
589	        .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
590	    let root = resolved
591	        .roots
592	        .iter()
593	        .find(|root| path.starts_with(root))
594	        .cloned()
595	        .unwrap_or_else(|| explicit_import_root(resolved, &path));
596	    let session_id = provider_import_session_id(resolved, &path).or_else(|| {
597	        path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()).map(|stem| {
598	            let prefix = resolved.id_prefix.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
599	            format!("{prefix}{stem}")
600	        })
601	    });
602	    ImportCandidate {
603	        id: import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path),
604	        session_id,
605	        paths: vec![path.clone()],
606	        root,
607	        updated_at,
608	        matched_cwd: None,
609	        row_count_hint: import_row_count_hint(resolved, &path),
610	    }
611	}
612	
613	fn explicit_import_root(resolved: &ResolvedImportSource, path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
614	    if resolved.storage == IngestStorage::OpenCodeStorage
615	        && let Some(root) = path.ancestors().nth(4)
616	    {
617	        return root.to_path_buf();
618	    }
619	    path.parent()
620	        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
621	        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
622	}
623	
624	fn select_import_candidates(
625	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
626	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
627	    candidates: &[ImportCandidate],
628	) -> Result<(Vec<ImportCandidate>, ImportMode)> {
629	    if candidates.is_empty() {
630	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
631	            "no import candidates for {}\nresolved roots:\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --all --preview",
632	            resolved.alias,
633	            resolved_roots_lines(&resolved.roots),
634	            resolved.alias
635	        )));
636	    }
637	    if options.all {
638	        return Ok((candidates.to_vec(), ImportMode::All));
639	    }
640	    if let Some(session) = options.session.as_deref() {
641	        let selected = candidates
642	            .iter()
643	            .filter(|candidate| import_candidate_matches(candidate, session))
644	            .cloned()
645	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
646	        return match selected.len() {
647	            0 => Err(import_invalid(format!(
648	                "no import candidate matched session {session}\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --list",
649	                import_candidate_table(candidates),
650	                resolved.alias
651	            ))),
652	            1 => Ok((selected, ImportMode::Session)),
653	            _ => Err(import_invalid(format!(
654	                "session {session} matched multiple import candidates\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session {}",
655	                import_candidate_table(&selected),
656	                resolved.alias,
657	                shell_arg(session)
658	            ))),
659	        };
660	    }
661	
662	    let cwd_matched = candidates
663	        .iter()
664	        .filter(|candidate| {
665	            resolved.cwd_match == IngestCwdMatch::None || candidate.matched_cwd.is_some()
666	        })
667	        .cloned()
668	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
669	    if cwd_matched.len() == 1 {
670	        return Ok((cwd_matched, ImportMode::Session));
671	    }
672	    if cwd_matched.len() > 1 {
673	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
674	            "ambiguous import candidates for {}\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session <id-or-path>",
675	            resolved.alias,
676	            import_candidate_table(&cwd_matched),
677	            resolved.alias
678	        )));
679	    }
680	    if candidates.len() == 1 {
681	        return Ok((vec![candidates[0].clone()], ImportMode::Session));
682	    }
683	    Err(import_invalid(format!(
684	        "no cwd-matched import session for {}; {} recent candidates need an explicit session\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session <id-or-path>",
685	        resolved.alias,
686	        candidates.len(),
687	        import_candidate_table(candidates),
688	        resolved.alias
689	    )))
690	}
691	
692	fn parse_import_candidates(
693	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
694	    selected: &[ImportCandidate],
695	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
696	    let mut rows_seen = 0usize;
697	    let mut events = Vec::new();
698	    let mut source_started_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
699	    let mut source_updated_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
700	    for candidate in selected {
701	        let parsed = match &resolved.kind {
702	            ImportSourceKind::Provider => parse_provider_import_candidate(resolved, candidate)?,
703	            ImportSourceKind::Cursor => parse_cursor_import_candidate(candidate)?,
704	        };
705	        rows_seen += parsed.rows_seen;
706	        for timestamp in parsed
707	            .source_started_at
708	            .into_iter()
709	            .chain(parsed.source_updated_at)
710	        {
711	            source_started_at = Some(
712	                source_started_at
713	                    .map(|existing| existing.min(timestamp))
714	                    .unwrap_or(timestamp),
715	            );
716	            source_updated_at = Some(
717	                source_updated_at
718	                    .map(|existing| existing.max(timestamp))
719	                    .unwrap_or(timestamp),
720	            );
721	        }
722	        events.extend(parsed.events);
723	    }
724	    events.sort_by(|left, right| {
725	        left.timestamp
726	            .cmp(&right.timestamp)
727	            .then_with(|| left.source_path.cmp(&right.source_path))
728	            .then_with(|| left.source_line.cmp(&right.source_line))
729	    });
730	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
731	        rows_seen,
732	        events,
733	        source_started_at,
734	        source_updated_at,
735	    })
736	}
737	
738	fn parse_provider_import_candidate(
739	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
740	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
741	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
742	    if resolved.storage == IngestStorage::OpenCodeStorage {
743	        return parse_opencode_import_candidate(resolved, candidate);
744	    }
745	    let mut rows_seen = 0usize;
746	    let mut events = Vec::new();
747	    for path in &candidate.paths {
748	        if path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("json") {
749	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(path)?;
750	            let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw).map_err(|err| {
751	                import_invalid(format!(
752	                    "malformed JSON at {}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
753	                    path.display(),
754	                    path.display(),
755	                    resolved.alias,
756	                    shell_arg(&candidate.id)
757	                ))
758	            })?;
759	            rows_seen += import_json_value_row_count(&value);
760	            events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
761	                resolved, candidate, path, None, &value, &raw,
762	            ));
763	            continue;
764	        }
765	        for (line_idx, line) in fs::read_to_string(path)?.lines().enumerate() {
766	            if line.trim().is_empty() {
767	                continue;
768	            }
769	            rows_seen += 1;
770	            let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).map_err(|err| {
771	                import_invalid(format!(
772	                    "malformed JSONL at {}:{}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
773	                    path.display(),
774	                    line_idx + 1,
775	                    path.display(),
776	                    resolved.alias,
777	                    shell_arg(&candidate.id)
778	                ))
779	            })?;
780	            events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
781	                resolved,
782	                candidate,
783	                path,
784	                Some(line_idx + 1),
785	                &value,
786	                line,
787	            ));
788	        }
789	    }
790	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
791	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
792	        rows_seen,
793	        events,
794	        source_started_at,
795	        source_updated_at,
796	    })
797	}
798	
799	fn parse_cursor_import_candidate(candidate: &ImportCandidate) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
800	    let Some(path) = candidate.paths.first() else {
801	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
802	    };
803	    let output = std::process::Command::new("sqlite3")
804	        .arg("-json")
805	        .arg(path)
806	        .arg("select rowid as source_rowid, * from messages order by rowid")
807	        .output();
808	    let output = output.map_err(|err| {
809	        import_invalid(format!(
810	            "sqlite3 is required to import Cursor history from {}: {err}\ntry: install sqlite3 or pass a JSONL-capable provider source",
811	            path.display()
812	        ))
813	    })?;
814	    if !output.status.success() {
815	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
816	            "failed to query Cursor database {}: {}\ntry: install sqlite3 or pass a JSONL-capable provider source",
817	            path.display(),
818	            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
819	        )));
820	    }
821	    let values: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).map_err(|err| {
822	        import_invalid(format!(
823	            "sqlite3 returned invalid JSON for {}: {err}",
824	            path.display()
825	        ))
826	    })?;
827	    let mut events = Vec::new();
828	    for value in &values {
829	        let raw = serde_json::to_string(value)?;
830	        let mut event = generic_import_event(
831	            "cursor-sqlite",
832	            candidate,
833	            path,
834	            value
835	                .get("source_rowid")
836	                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
837	                .and_then(|row| usize::try_from(row).ok()),
838	            value,
839	            &raw,
840	        );
841	        event.source_event = "message".to_string();
842	        events.push(event);
843	    }
844	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
845	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
846	        rows_seen: values.len(),
847	        events,
848	        source_started_at,
849	        source_updated_at,
850	    })
851	}
852	
853	fn parse_opencode_import_candidate(
854	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
855	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
856	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
857	    let Some(session_path) = candidate.paths.first() else {
858	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
859	    };
860	    let session_raw = fs::read_to_string(session_path)?;
861	    let session = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&session_raw).map_err(|err| {
862	        import_invalid(format!(
863	            "malformed JSON at {}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
864	            session_path.display(),
865	            session_path.display(),
866	            resolved.alias,
867	            shell_arg(&candidate.id)
868	        ))
869	    })?;
870	    let Some(session_id) = session.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
871	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
872	    };
873	    let root = session_path
874	        .ancestors()
875	        .nth(4)
876	        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
877	        .unwrap_or_else(|| candidate.root.clone());
878	    let messages = read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/message").join(session_id));
879	    let mut rows_seen = 1usize;
880	    let mut events = Vec::new();
881	    events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
882	        resolved,
883	        candidate,
884	        session_path,
885	        None,
886	        &session,
887	        &session_raw,
888	    ));
889	    for (message_path, message, message_raw) in messages {
890	        rows_seen += 1;
891	        let role = message
892	            .get("role")
893	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
894	            .map(ToString::to_string);
895	        let timestamp = import_timestamp(&message);
896	        let message_id = message.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
897	        let parts = read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/part").join(message_id));
898	        if parts.is_empty() {
899	            let mut event = generic_import_event(
900	                &resolved.schema,
901	                candidate,
902	                &message_path,
903	                None,
904	                &message,
905	                &message_raw,
906	            );
907	            event.role = role.clone();
908	            event.timestamp = timestamp;
909	            events.push(event);
910	            continue;
911	        }
912	        for (part_path, part, part_raw) in parts {
913	            rows_seen += 1;
914	            let mut event =
915	                opencode_import_event(candidate, &part_path, &part, &part_raw, role.as_deref());
916	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(&part).or(timestamp);
917	            events.push(event);
918	        }
919	    }
920	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
921	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
922	        rows_seen,
923	        events,
924	        source_started_at,
925	        source_updated_at,
926	    })
927	}
928	
929	fn import_events_from_json_value(
930	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
931	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
932	    path: &Path,
933	    line: Option<usize>,
934	    value: &Value,
935	    raw: &str,
936	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
937	    match resolved.schema.as_str() {
938	        "codex-cli" => codex_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
939	        "claude-code" => claude_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
940	        "gemini" => gemini_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
941	        "copilot-cli" => copilot_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
942	        "pi" => pi_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
943	        "opencode" => vec![generic_import_event(
944	            &resolved.schema,
945	            candidate,
946	            path,
947	            line,
948	            value,
949	            raw,
950	        )],
951	        _ => vec![generic_import_event(
952	            &resolved.schema,
953	            candidate,
954	            path,
955	            line,
956	            value,
957	            raw,
958	        )],
959	    }
960	}
961	
962	fn codex_import_events(
963	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
964	    path: &Path,
965	    line: Option<usize>,
966	    value: &Value,
967	    raw: &str,
968	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
969	    let payload = value.get("payload").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
970	    let mut event = generic_import_event("codex-cli", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
971	    match (
972	        value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str),
973	        payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str),
974	    ) {
975	        (Some("session_meta"), _) => {
976	            event.source_event = "session_meta".to_string();
977	            event.summary = payload
978	                .get("cwd")
979	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
980	                .map(|cwd| format!("session cwd {cwd}"))
981	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "session metadata".to_string());
982	        }
983	        (Some("event_msg"), Some("agent_message")) => {
984	            event.source_event = "agent_message".to_string();
985	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
986	            if let Some(message) = payload.get("message").and_then(Value::as_str) {
987	                event.summary = one_line(message, 180);
988	            }
989	        }
990	        (Some("event_msg"), Some("token_count")) => {
991	            event.source_event = "usage".to_string();
992	            event.summary = "token count".to_string();
993	            event.usage = codex_usage(payload);
994	        }
995	        (Some("response_item"), Some("function_call")) => {
996	            let name = payload
997	                .get("name")
998	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
999	                .unwrap_or("tool");
1000	            let args = payload
1001	                .get("arguments")
1002	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1003	                .unwrap_or("");
1004	            let args_value =
1005	                serde_json::from_str::<Value>(args).unwrap_or(Value::String(args.to_string()));
1006	            event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1007	            event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1008	            event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1009	            event.tool_call_id = payload
1010	                .get("call_id")
1011	                .or_else(|| payload.get("id"))
1012	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1013	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1014	            event.summary = format!(
1015	                "tool {} {}",
1016	                provider_tool_label(name),
1017	                one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, &args_value), 160)
1018	            );
1019	            event.files = collect_import_paths(&args_value);
1020	        }
1021	        (Some("response_item"), Some("function_call_output")) => {
1022	            event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1023	            event.role = Some("tool".to_string());
1024	            event.tool_call_id = payload
1025	                .get("call_id")
1026	                .or_else(|| payload.get("id"))
1027	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1028	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1029	            event.summary = payload
1030	                .get("output")
1031	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1032	                .map(|output| format!("result {}", one_line(output, 160)))
1033	                .unwrap_or_else(|| event.summary.clone());
1034	        }
1035	        _ => {}
1036	    }
1037	    vec![event]
1038	}
1039	
1040	fn claude_import_events(
1041	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1042	    path: &Path,
1043	    line: Option<usize>,
1044	    value: &Value,
1045	    raw: &str,
1046	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1047	    let row_type = value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
1048	    let Some(message) = value.get("message") else {
1049	        return vec![generic_import_event(
1050	            "claude-code",
1051	            candidate,
1052	            path,
1053	            line,
1054	            value,
1055	            raw,
1056	        )];
1057	    };
1058	    let usage = message.get("usage").and_then(import_usage_from_value);
1059	    let Some(content) = message.get("content").and_then(Value::as_array) else {
1060	        let mut event = generic_import_event("claude-code", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
1061	        event.source_event = row_type.to_string();
1062	        event.usage = usage;
1063	        return vec![event];
1064	    };
1065	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1066	    for part in content {
1067	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1068	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1069	        event.role = Some(row_type.to_string());
1070	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1071	        match part.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
1072	            Some("text") => {
1073	                event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1074	                event.summary = part
1075	                    .get("text")
1076	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1077	                    .map(|text| one_line(text, 180))
1078	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "message".to_string());
1079	            }
1080	            Some("thinking") => {
1081	                event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1082	                event.summary = part
1083	                    .get("thinking")
1084	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1085	                    .map(|text| format!("thinking {}", one_line(text, 160)))
1086	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "thinking".to_string());
1087	            }
1088	            Some("tool_use") => {

1146	fn gemini_import_events(
1147	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1148	    path: &Path,
1149	    line: Option<usize>,
1150	    value: &Value,
1151	    raw: &str,
1152	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1153	    if let Some(messages) = value.get("messages").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1154	        let mut events = Vec::new();
1155	        for message in messages {
1156	            let raw = serde_json::to_string(message).unwrap_or_else(|_| raw.to_string());
1157	            events.extend(gemini_import_events(candidate, path, line, message, &raw));
1158	        }
1159	        return events;
1160	    }
1161	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1162	    let usage = gemini_usage(value);
1163	    for thought in value
1164	        .get("thoughts")
1165	        .and_then(Value::as_array)
1166	        .into_iter()
1167	        .flatten()
1168	    {
1169	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1170	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1171	        event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1172	        event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1173	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1174	        event.summary = format!("thinking {}", one_line(&json_value_text(thought), 160));
1175	        events.push(event);
1176	    }
1177	    for text in gemini_content_texts(value.get("content").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)) {
1178	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1179	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1180	        event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1181	        event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1182	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1183	        event.summary = one_line(&text, 180);
1184	        events.push(event);
1185	    }
1186	    if let Some(tool_calls) = value.get("toolCalls").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1187	        for tool_call in tool_calls {
1188	            let name = tool_call
1189	                .get("name")
1190	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1191	                .unwrap_or("tool");
1192	            let args = tool_call.get("args").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1193	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1194	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1195	            event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1196	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1197	            event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1198	            event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1199	            event.tool_call_id = tool_call
1200	                .get("id")
1201	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1202	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1203	            event.summary = format!(
1204	                "tool {} {}",
1205	                provider_tool_label(name),
1206	                one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, args), 160)
1207	            );
1208	            event.files = collect_import_paths(args);
1209	            events.push(event);
1210	        }
1211	    }
1212	    if events.is_empty() {
1213	        vec![generic_import_event(
1214	            "gemini", candidate, path, line, value, raw,
1215	        )]
1216	    } else {
1217	        events
1218	    }
1219	}

1245	                && !content.trim().is_empty()
1246	            {
1247	                let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1248	                event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1249	                event.source_event = "message".to_string();

1256	                for request in tool_requests {
1257	                    let name = request
1258	                        .get("name")
1259	                        .and_then(Value::as_str)

1266	                    event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1267	                    event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1268	                    event.tool_call_id = request
1269	                        .get("id")
1270	                        .or_else(|| request.get("toolCallId"))
1271	                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1272	                        .map(ToString::to_string);
1273	                    event.summary = format!(
1274	                        "tool {} {}",
1275	                        provider_tool_label(name),

1277	                    );
1278	                    event.files = collect_import_paths(&input);
1279	                    event.usage = usage.clone();
1280	                    events.push(event);
1281	                }
1282	            }
1283	        }
1284	        Some("assistant.reasoning") => {
1285	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1286	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1287	            event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1288	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());

1290	            event.summary = data
1291	                .get("text")
1292	                .or_else(|| data.get("content"))
1293	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1294	                .map(|text| format!("thinking {}", one_line(text, 160)))
1295	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "thinking".to_string());
1296	            events.push(event);
1297	        }
1298	        Some("tool.execution_complete") => {
1299	            let result = data.get("result").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1300	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1301	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1302	            event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1303	            event.role = Some("tool".to_string());
1304	            event.tool_call_id = data
1305	                .get("toolCallId")
1306	                .or_else(|| data.get("id"))
1307	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1308	                .map(ToString::to_string);

1310	            event.files = collect_import_paths(result);
1311	            event.usage = usage;
1312	            events.push(event);
1313	        }
1314	        Some("session.model_change") => {

1316	            event.source_event = "model_change".to_string();
1317	            events.push(event);

1319	        _ => {}

1335	fn pi_import_events(
1336	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1337	    path: &Path,
1338	    line: Option<usize>,
1339	    value: &Value,
1340	    raw: &str,
1341	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1342	    if value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("session") {
1343	        let mut event = generic_import_event("pi", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
1344	        event.source_event = "session".to_string();
1345	        event.summary = "session header".to_string();

1347	    }
1348	    let message = value.get("message").unwrap_or(value);
1349	    let usage = message.get("usage").and_then(import_usage_from_value);
1350	    let role = message
1351	        .get("role")
1352	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1353	        .map(ToString::to_string);
1354	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1355	    match role.as_deref() {
1356	        Some("assistant") => {
1357	            let content = message.get("content").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1358	            if let Some(text) = content.as_str()
1359	                && !text.trim().is_empty()
1360	            {
1361	                let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1362	                event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1363	                event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1364	                event.role = role.clone();
1365	                event.usage = usage.clone();
1366	                event.summary = one_line(text, 180);
1367	                events.push(event);
1368	            }
1369	            if let Some(blocks) = content.as_array() {
1370	                for block in blocks {
1371	                    let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1372	                    event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1373	                    event.role = role.clone();
1374	                    event.usage = usage.clone();
1375	                    match block.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
1376	                        Some("text") => {
1377	                            event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1378	                            event.summary = block
1379	                                .get("text")
1380	                                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1381	                                .map(|text| one_line(text, 180))
1382	                                .unwrap_or_else(|| "message".to_string());
1383	                        }
1384	                        Some("thinking") => {
1385	                            event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1386	                            event.summary = block
1387	                                .get("thinking")
1388	                                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1389	                                .map(|text| format!("thinking {}", one_line(text, 160)))
1390	                                .unwrap_or_else(|| "thinking".to_string());
1391	                        }
1392	                        Some("toolCall") => {
1393	                            let name = block.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("tool");
1394	                            let input = normalize_pi_tool_arguments(provider_arguments_value(
1395	                                block.get("arguments"),
1396	                            ));
1397	                            event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1398	                            event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1399	                            event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1400	                            event.tool_call_id = block
1401	                                .get("id")
1402	                                .or_else(|| block.get("toolCallId"))
1403	                                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1404	                                .map(ToString::to_string);
1405	                            event.summary = format!(
1406	                                "tool {} {}",
1407	                                provider_tool_label(name),
1408	                                one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, &input), 160)
1409	                            );
1410	                            event.files = collect_import_paths(&input);
1411	                        }
1412	                        Some(other) => {
1413	                            event.source_event = other.to_string();
1414	                            event.summary = one_line(&json_value_text(block), 180);
1415	                            event.files = collect_import_paths(block);
1416	                        }
1417	                        None => {
1418	                            event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1419	                            event.summary = one_line(&json_value_text(block), 180);
1420	                        }
1421	                    }
1422	                    events.push(event);
1423	                }
1424	            }
1425	        }
1426	        Some("toolResult") => {
1427	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1428	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1429	            event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1430	            event.role = role;
1431	            event.usage = usage;
1432	            event.summary = format!(
1433	                "result {}",
1434	                one_line(
1435	                    &json_value_text(message.get("content").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)),
1436	                    160
1437	                )
1438	            );
1439	            event.files = collect_import_paths(message);
1440	            events.push(event);
1441	        }
1442	        _ => {}
1443	    }
1444	    if events.is_empty() {
1445	        vec![generic_import_event(
1446	            "pi", candidate, path, line, value, raw,
1447	        )]
1448	    } else {
1449	        events
1450	    }
1451	}

1511	fn generic_import_event(
1512	    schema: &str,
1513	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1514	    path: &Path,
1515	    line: Option<usize>,
1516	    value: &Value,
1517	    raw: &str,
1518	) -> ImportedEvent {
1519	    let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1520	    event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1521	    event.source_event = import_source_event(value);
1522	    event.role = value
1523	        .get("role")
1524	        .or_else(|| value.pointer("/message/role"))
1525	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1526	        .map(ToString::to_string);
1527	    event.summary = import_summary(schema, value);
1528	    event.tool_name = import_tool_name(value);
1529	    event.tool_category = event
1530	        .tool_name
1531	        .as_deref()
1532	        .map(provider_tool_label)
1533	        .map(ToString::to_string);
1534	    event.tool_call_id = import_tool_call_id(value);
1535	    event.files = collect_import_paths(value);
1536	    event.usage = import_usage_for_schema(schema, value);
1537	    event
1538	}

1540	fn import_base_event(
1541	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1542	    path: &Path,
1543	    line: Option<usize>,
1544	    raw: &str,
1545	) -> ImportedEvent {
1546	    ImportedEvent {
1547	        timestamp: None,
1548	        source_event: "row".to_string(),
1549	        role: None,
1550	        summary: "imported row".to_string(),
1551	        tool_name: None,
1552	        tool_category: None,
1553	        tool_call_id: None,
1554	        files: Vec::new(),
1555	        usage: None,
1556	        source_path: path.to_path_buf(),
1557	        source_line: line,
1558	        raw_hash: sha256_for_str(raw),
1559	    }
1560	    .with_candidate_tool_id(candidate)
1561	}

1576	fn import_since(options: &ImportCommandOptions) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {
1577	    if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
1578	        return Ok(import_long_ago());
1579	    }
1580	    let Some(raw) = options.since.as_deref() else {
1581	        return Ok(Utc::now() - ChronoDuration::minutes(2));
1582	    };
1583	    let duration = parse_import_duration(raw).ok_or_else(|| {
1584	        import_invalid(format!(
1585	            "invalid import --since duration {raw}; use values like 10m, 2h, or 1d\ntry: deadreckon import {} --since 10m --list",
1586	            options.source
1587	        ))
1588	    })?;
1589	    Ok(Utc::now() - duration)
1590	}
1591	
1592	fn parse_import_duration(raw: &str) -> Option<ChronoDuration> {
1593	    let trimmed = raw.trim();
1594	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
1595	        return None;
1596	    }
1597	    let (number, unit) = trimmed.split_at(
1598	        trimmed
1599	            .find(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_digit())
1600	            .unwrap_or(trimmed.len()),
1601	    );
1602	    let value = number.parse::<i64>().ok()?;
1603	    match unit {
1604	        "" | "m" | "min" | "mins" | "minute" | "minutes" => Some(ChronoDuration::minutes(value)),
1605	        "h" | "hr" | "hrs" | "hour" | "hours" => Some(ChronoDuration::hours(value)),
1606	        "d" | "day" | "days" => Some(ChronoDuration::days(value)),
1607	        "s" | "sec" | "secs" | "second" | "seconds" => Some(ChronoDuration::seconds(value)),
1608	        _ => None,
1609	    }
1610	}
1611	
1612	fn import_long_ago() -> DateTime<Utc> {
1613	    Utc::now() - ChronoDuration::days(36_500)
1614	}

1634	fn import_descriptor_id(source: &str) -> Option<String> {
1635	    Some(
1636	        match source {
1637	            "codex" | "cli:codex" => "cli:codex",
1638	            "claude-code" | "cli:claude-code" => "cli:claude-code",
1639	            "gemini" | "cli:gemini" => "cli:gemini",
1640	            "opencode" | "cli:opencode" => "cli:opencode",
1641	            "copilot" | "cli:copilot" => "cli:copilot",
1642	            "pi" | "cli:pi" => "cli:pi",
1643	            _ if source.starts_with("cli:") => source,
1644	            _ => return None,
1645	        }
1646	        .to_string(),
1647	    )
1648	}

1650	fn import_invalid(message: String) -> CliError {
1651	    let mut body = Vec::new();
1652	    let mut primary_hint = None;
1653	    for line in message.lines() {
1654	        if let Some(hint) = line.trim_start().strip_prefix("try:") {
1655	            if primary_hint.is_none() {
1656	                primary_hint = Some(hint.trim().to_string());
1657	            }
1658	        } else {
1659	            body.push(line);
1660	        }
1661	    }
1662	    if let Some(hint) = primary_hint {
1663	        let reason = body
1664	            .first()
1665	            .map(|line| line.trim().to_string())
1666	            .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
1667	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "DeadReckon refused the import request.".to_string());
1668	        let detail = body
1669	            .iter()
1670	            .skip(1)
1671	            .map(|line| line.trim_end())
1672	            .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
1673	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()

62	async fn validate_seam_report(
63	    kind: SeamKind,
64	    config_path: &Path,
65	    fixture_path: Option<&Path>,
66	    sandbox_backend: SandboxBackend,
67	) -> Result<SeamValidationReport> {
68	    let fixture = fixture_path
69	        .map(PathBuf::from)
70	        .unwrap_or_else(|| default_fixture_path(kind, config_path));
71	    let fail_policy = seam_fail_policy_label(kind).to_string();
72	    let sandbox = resolve_backend(sandbox_backend)?.0.to_string();
73	
74	    if !config_path.exists() {
75	        return Ok(SeamValidationReport {
76	            kind: cli_kind_label(kind).to_string(),
77	            command: "-".to_string(),
78	            fixture: display_path(&fixture),
79	            sandbox,
80	            outcome: "failed".to_string(),
81	            fail_policy,
82	            source: "missing-config".to_string(),
83	            decision: None,
84	            detail: Some(format!("config not found: {}", config_path.display())),
85	            try_lines: vec![
86	                format!("create {}", config_path.display()),
87	                "deadreckon seams validate policy --config examples/seams/config.toml --sandbox none"
88	                    .to_string(),
89	            ],
90	            exit_success: false,
91	        });
92	    }
93	
94	    let seams = read_seams_config(config_path, false)?;
95	    let Some(command) = seams.command_for(kind).cloned() else {
96	        return Ok(SeamValidationReport {
97	            kind: cli_kind_label(kind).to_string(),
98	            command: "-".to_string(),

100	            sandbox,
101	            outcome: "failed".to_string(),

103	            source: "builtin".to_string(),

113	                    config_path.display()
114	                ),
115	                "deadreckon doctor".to_string(),
116	            ],
117	            exit_success: false,
118	        });
119	    };
120	
121	    let request = read_fixture(&fixture)?;
122	    let run_root = validation_run_root();
123	    fs::create_dir_all(run_root.join("gate"))?;
124	    fs::create_dir_all(run_root.join("proofs"))?;
125	    fs::create_dir_all(run_root.join("sandbox"))?;
126	    let ctx = SeamRunCtx {
127	        run_root: run_root.clone(),
128	        working_dir: std::env::current_dir()?,
129	        sandbox_backend,
130	    };
131	    let single = SeamsConfig::with_command(kind, command.clone())?;
132	    let outcome = dispatch_seam(kind, &request, &single, &ctx).await;
133	    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(run_root);
134	
135	    Ok(classify_validation_outcome(
136	        kind, &command, &fixture, sandbox, outcome,
137	    ))
138	}

140	fn classify_validation_outcome(
141	    kind: SeamKind,
142	    command: &SeamCommandConfig,
143	    fixture: &Path,
144	    sandbox: String,
145	    outcome: SeamOutcome,
146	) -> SeamValidationReport {
147	    let command_name = seam_command_basename(&command.command);
148	    let fail_policy = seam_fail_policy_label(kind).to_string();
149	    let base = |outcome: &str,
150	                decision: Option<String>,
151	                detail: Option<String>,
152	                try_lines: Vec<String>,
153	                exit_success| {
154	        SeamValidationReport {
155	            kind: cli_kind_label(kind).to_string(),
156	            command: command_name.clone(),
157	            fixture: display_path(fixture),
158	            sandbox: sandbox.clone(),
159	            outcome: outcome.to_string(),
160	            fail_policy: fail_policy.clone(),
161	            source: "external".to_string(),
162	            decision,
163	            detail,
164	            try_lines,
165	            exit_success,
166	        }
167	    };
168	
169	    match outcome {
170	        SeamOutcome::Ok(_) if kind == SeamKind::Policy => {
171	            base("passed", Some("allow".to_string()), None, Vec::new(), true)
172	        }
173	        SeamOutcome::Ok(value) if kind == SeamKind::Catalog => {
174	            match ModelCatalogOverride::from_value(value) {
175	                Ok(_) => base("passed", None, None, Vec::new(), true),
176	                Err(err) => base(
177	                    "failed",
178	                    None,
179	                    Some(format!("catalog response failed open: {err}")),
180	                    vec![
181	                        r#"return {"models":[{"id":"local-model","context_window":4000}]}"#
182	                            .to_string(),
183	                    ],
184	                    false,
185	                ),
186	            }
187	        }
188	        SeamOutcome::Ok(_) => base("passed", None, None, Vec::new(), true),
189	        SeamOutcome::Deny(reason)
190	            if kind == SeamKind::Policy && !reason.contains("failed closed") =>
191	        {
192	            base(
193	                "passed",
194	                Some("deny".to_string()),
195	                Some(reason),
196	                Vec::new(),
197	                true,
198	            )
199	        }
200	        SeamOutcome::Deny(reason) => base(
201	            "failed",
202	            None,
203	            Some(reason),
204	            vec![
205	                r#"return {"decision":"allow"} or {"decision":"deny","reason":"..."}"#.to_string(),
206	                "rerun the launch with --no-seams to force built-ins".to_string(),
207	            ],
208	            false,
209	        ),
210	        SeamOutcome::Fallback => base(
211	            "failed",
212	            None,
213	            Some("catalog worker failed open; runtime would use the built-in catalog".to_string()),
214	            vec![r#"return {"models":[{"id":"local-model","context_window":4000}]}"#.to_string()],
215	            false,
216	        ),
217	        SeamOutcome::Skipped(reason) => base(
218	            "non_fatal",
219	            None,
220	            Some(format!(
221	                "observer worker failed safe; runtime would continue: {reason}"
222	            )),
223	            vec!["inspect the worker command, timeout, and stderr".to_string()],
224	            true,
225	        ),
226	        SeamOutcome::Unconfigured => base(
227	            "failed",
228	            None,
229	            Some("no external worker configured".to_string()),
230	            vec![format!("add [seams.{}] to config", kind.config_key())],
231	            false,
232	        ),
233	    }
234	}

236	fn print_validation_report(surface: &VerdictSurface) {

240	fn seam_validation_surface(report: &SeamValidationReport) -> VerdictSurface {
241	    let kind = if report.exit_success {
242	        VerdictKind::Verified
243	    } else {
244	        VerdictKind::Failed
245	    };
246	    let primary = seam_validation_primary_action(report);
247	    let secondary = report
248	        .try_lines
249	        .iter()
250	        .filter_map(|line| {
251	            let line = line.trim();
252	            (line.starts_with("deadreckon ") && line != primary).then_some(("Secondary", line))
253	        })
254	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
255	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
256	        kind,
257	        "seam",
258	        Some(&report.kind),
259	        seam_validation_explanation(report),
260	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
261	        secondary,
262	    )
263	    .expect("seam validation verdict surface must be valid")
264	}
265	
266	fn seam_validation_primary_action(report: &SeamValidationReport) -> String {
267	    if !report.exit_success
268	        && let Some(command) = report
269	            .try_lines
270	            .iter()
271	            .map(|line| line.trim())
272	            .find(|line| line.starts_with("deadreckon "))
273	    {
274	        return command.to_string();
275	    }
276	    if report.exit_success {
277	        "deadreckon run \"goal\"".to_string()
278	    } else {
279	        "deadreckon doctor".to_string()
280	    }
281	}
282	
283	fn seam_validation_explanation(report: &SeamValidationReport) -> ExplanationPanel {
284	    let what = if report.exit_success {
285	        format!(
286	            "Seam validation completed for the {} worker with outcome {}.",
287	            report.kind, report.outcome
288	        )
289	    } else {
290	        format!(
291	            "Seam validation failed for the {} worker with outcome {}.",
292	            report.kind, report.outcome
293	        )
294	    };
295	    let why = report.detail.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
296	        if report.exit_success {
297	            format!(
298	                "The worker response satisfies the {} fail policy for this seam.",
299	                report.fail_policy
300	            )
301	        } else {
302	            format!(
303	                "The worker response does not satisfy the {} fail policy for this seam.",
304	                report.fail_policy
305	            )
306	        }
307	    });
308	    let mut evidence = vec![
309	        ("kind", report.kind.clone()),
310	        ("outcome", report.outcome.clone()),
311	        ("command", report.command.clone()),
312	        ("fixture", report.fixture.clone()),
313	        ("sandbox", report.sandbox.clone()),
314	        ("fail policy", report.fail_policy.clone()),
315	        ("source", report.source.clone()),
316	    ];
317	    if let Some(decision) = &report.decision {
318	        evidence.push(("decision", decision.clone()));
319	    }
320	    if let Some(detail) = &report.detail {
321	        evidence.push(("detail", detail.clone()));
322	    }
323	    ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence)
324	}

353	    let name = match kind {

355	        SeamKind::Catalog => "catalog-request.json",
356	        SeamKind::Hooks => "hook-event.json",
357	        SeamKind::EventSink => "event-sink-event.json",

90	fn init_completion_surface(
91	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
92	    provider: &str,
93	    sandbox: &str,
94	    completion_status: &str,
95	    doctor_summary: &super::doctor::DoctorSetupSummary,
96	) -> VerdictSurface {
97	    let (kind, why, primary, secondary) = if doctor_summary.has_blocking_issues() {
98	        (
99	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
100	            "Initialization wrote the config, but setup verification found blocking issues; run doctor before starting managed work.",
101	            "deadreckon doctor",
102	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon run \"describe the coding goal\"")],
103	        )
104	    } else {
105	        (
106	            VerdictKind::Completed,
107	            "Initialization completed; the next step is to start a managed run from this workspace.",
108	            "deadreckon run \"describe the coding goal\"",
109	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon doctor")],
110	        )
111	    };
112	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
113	        kind,
114	        "init",
115	        None,
116	        ExplanationPanel::new(
117	            "DeadReckon wrote the local configuration and checked the provider setup.",
118	            why,
119	            vec![
120	                ("config", paths.config_path().display().to_string()),
121	                ("provider", provider.to_string()),
122	                ("sandbox", sandbox.to_string()),
123	                ("doctor", doctor_summary.evidence_detail()),
124	                ("completion", completion_status.to_string()),
125	            ],
126	        ),
127	        vec![("Recommended", primary)],
128	        secondary,
129	    )
130	    .expect("init verdict surface must be valid")
131	}
132	
133	fn preferred_init_subscription_cli_provider(registry: &ProviderRegistry) -> Option<String> {
134	    registry
135	        .iter()
136	        .filter(|descriptor| {
137	            descriptor.kind == DescriptorKind::Cli
138	                && descriptor.subscription
139	                && descriptor
140	                    .default_binary
141	                    .as_deref()
142	                    .is_some_and(command_exists)
143	        })
144	        .map(|descriptor| descriptor.id.clone())
145	        .next()
146	}

443	pub(crate) fn estimate_doc_polish_spend(

1938	fn align_extended_run_with_parent(
1939	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1940	    state: &mut deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1941	    parent: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1942	) -> Result<()> {
1943	    let old_scope = state.scope.clone();
1944	    let old_task_key = state.task_key.clone();
1945	    let old_pointer = paths.current_pointer_path(&old_scope, &old_task_key);
1946	    let desired_root = paths.run_root(&parent.scope, &state.run_id);
1947	    if state.run_root != desired_root {
1948	        if let Some(parent_dir) = desired_root.parent() {
1949	            fs::create_dir_all(parent_dir)?;
1950	        }
1951	        fs::rename(&state.run_root, &desired_root)?;
1952	        state.run_root = desired_root;
1953	        state.working_dir = state.run_root.join("working");
1954	        state.scope = parent.scope.clone();
1955	    }
1956	    state.task_key = parent.task_key.clone();
1957	    state.cwd = parent.cwd.clone();
1958	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
1959	    let new_pointer = paths.current_pointer_path(&state.scope, &state.task_key);
1960	    if old_pointer != new_pointer {
1961	        remove_if_exists(&old_pointer)?;
1962	    }
1963	    save_state(state)?;
1964	    Ok(())
1965	}

2019	fn parent_summary(parent: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState, context_turns: Option<u32>) -> String {
2020	    let spend = read_jsonl::<SpendRecord>(&parent.run_root.join("spend.jsonl")).unwrap_or_default();
2021	    let traces =
2022	        read_jsonl::<TraceRecord>(&parent.run_root.join("traces.jsonl")).unwrap_or_default();
2023	    let spend_label = if spend.iter().any(|record| record.subscription)
2024	        || parent
2025	            .provider
2026	            .as_deref()
2027	            .is_some_and(|provider| provider.starts_with("cli:"))
2028	    {
2029	        "subscription".to_string()
2030	    } else {
2031	        format!("${:.6}", parent.total_spend_usd)
2032	    };
2033	    let acceptance = if parent.run_root.join("proofs/turn-acceptance.json").exists() {
2034	        "dr-gate accepted"
2035	    } else {
2036	        "not recorded"
2037	    };
2038	    let mut summary = format!(
2039	        "# Previous run summary ({})\n\n**Original goal.** {}\n**Completed.** {}\n**Total turns.** {}\n**Total spend.** {}\n**Acceptance.** {}\n",
2040	        parent.run_id,
2041	        parent.goal,
2042	        parent.updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
2043	        parent.turn,
2044	        spend_label,
2045	        acceptance
2046	    );
2047	    if let Some(max_turns) = context_turns {
2048	        let mut recent = traces
2049	            .iter()
2050	            .filter(|trace| trace.turn > 0)
2051	            .rev()
2052	            .take(max_turns as usize)
2053	            .map(trace_one_liner)
2054	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2055	        recent.reverse();
2056	        summary.push_str(&format!(
2057	            "\n## Recent activity (last {} turns)\n\n",
2058	            max_turns
2059	        ));
2060	        if recent.is_empty() {
2061	            summary.push_str("- no trace activity recorded\n");
2062	        } else {
2063	            for line in recent {
2064	                summary.push_str(&format!("- {line}\n"));
2065	            }
2066	        }
2067	    }
2068	    summary
2069	}

2071	fn trace_one_liner(trace: &TraceRecord) -> String {
2072	    let detail = trace
2073	        .detail
2074	        .get("tool_call_id")
2075	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
2076	        .or_else(|| trace.detail.get("summary").and_then(Value::as_str))
2077	        .unwrap_or("");
2078	    if detail.is_empty() {
2079	        format!("turn {}: {}", trace.turn, trace.event)
2080	    } else {
2081	        format!(
2082	            "turn {}: {} {}",
2083	            trace.turn,
2084	            trace.event,
2085	            one_line(detail, 90)
2086	        )
2087	    }
2088	}

1760	fn chain_verdict_surface(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain: &Chain) -> VerdictSurface {
1761	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
1762	    let failed_step = chain
1763	        .steps
1764	        .iter()
1765	        .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Failed || step.fail_reason.is_some());
1766	    let reason = chain
1767	        .failure_reason
1768	        .as_deref()
1769	        .or(chain.paused_reason.as_deref());
1770	    let (kind, what, why) = match chain.status {
1771	        ChainStatus::Completed => (
1772	            VerdictKind::Completed,
1773	            "The chain reached a terminal completed state.",
1774	            "All required chain steps are complete, so the safest next command is inspection.",
1775	        ),
1776	        ChainStatus::Failed => (
1777	            VerdictKind::Failed,
1778	            "The chain stopped before all required steps completed.",
1779	            "Failure inspection is the safest next command before resuming, skipping, or applying any step.",
1780	        ),
1781	        ChainStatus::Paused => (
1782	            VerdictKind::Paused,
1783	            chain_paused_what(reason),
1784	            chain_paused_why(reason),
1785	        ),
1786	        ChainStatus::Killed => (
1787	            VerdictKind::Killed,
1788	            "The chain was stopped before reaching a terminal result.",
1789	            "Killed chain state should be inspected before cleanup or relaunch.",
1790	        ),
1791	        ChainStatus::Running => (
1792	            VerdictKind::Paused,
1793	            "The chain is still running.",
1794	            "Attaching is the safest next command because active conductor state may still exist.",
1795	        ),
1796	        ChainStatus::Pending => (
1797	            VerdictKind::Preview,
1798	            "The chain has been planned but has not started running.",
1799	            "Resume starts or continues the stored chain state.",
1800	        ),
1801	        ChainStatus::Undone => (
1802	            VerdictKind::Noop,
1803	            "The chain has already been undone.",
1804	            "Inspection is the safest next command because there is no active chain work to advance.",
1805	        ),
1806	    };
1807	    let mut evidence = chain_base_evidence(paths, chain);
1808	    if let Some(reason) = reason {
1809	        evidence.push(("reason".to_string(), reason.to_string()));
1810	    }
1811	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Paused
1812	        && reason == Some("apply_mode_preview")

1814	    {
1815	        evidence.push(("diff summary".to_string(), diff_summary));

1818	        evidence.push((
1819	            "failed step".to_string(),
1820	            format!(
1821	                "{} {}",
1822	                step.index + 1,
1823	                chain_step_status_label(step.status)
1824	            ),
1825	        ));
1826	        if let Some(run_id) = step.run_id.as_deref() {
1827	            evidence.push(("failed run".to_string(), run_prefix(run_id)));
1828	        }
1829	        if let Some(reason) = step.fail_reason.as_deref() {
1830	            evidence.push(("step reason".to_string(), reason.to_string()));
1831	        }
1832	    }
1833	    let primary = chain_primary_action(chain);
1834	    let secondary = chain_secondary_actions(chain, &primary);
1835	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1836	        kind,
1837	        "chain",
1838	        Some(&id),
1839	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1840	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1841	        secondary
1842	            .iter()
1843	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1844	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1845	    )
1846	    .expect("chain verdict surface must have one primary action")

1849	fn latest_chain_preview_diff_summary(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain: &Chain) -> Option<String> {

1851	    raw.lines()

1872	fn compact_chain_diff_summary(summary: &str) -> String {
1873	    let mut lines = summary
1874	        .lines()
1875	        .map(str::trim)

1983	fn chain_paused_what(reason: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
1984	    if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
1985	        "The chain paused because the on-promote hook refused auto-apply."
1986	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_paused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
1987	        "The chain paused because the on-promote hook requested an operator pause."
1988	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_dirty_target")) {
1989	        "The chain paused because auto-apply found uncommitted target changes."
1990	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_outside_allowlist")) {
1991	        "The chain paused because auto-apply refused a file outside the apply allowlist."
1992	    } else {
1993	        "The chain is paused before reaching a terminal result."
1994	    }
1995	}
1996	
1997	fn chain_paused_why(reason: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
1998	    if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
1999	        "The hook policy blocked promotion, so inspecting configured chain hooks is the primary next command before resuming."
2000	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_paused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
2001	        "The hook requested a resumable pause, so resuming the chain is the primary next command after the operator check."
2002	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_dirty_target")) {
2003	        "The source repo has local changes, so inspecting the dirty state is the primary next command before stashing, committing, or resuming."
2004	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_outside_allowlist")) {
2005	        "Previewing the diff is the primary next command before widening the allowlist or manually applying the step."
2006	    } else {
2007	        "The chain still has resumable state, so resume is the primary next command."
2008	    }
2009	}

2011	fn chain_secondary_actions(chain: &Chain, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
2012	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2013	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
2014	    let mut candidates = vec![
2015	        format!("deadreckon chain attach {id}"),
2016	        format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2017	        format!("deadreckon chain show {id} --why-failed"),
2018	        format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2019	    ];
2020	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Paused {
2021	        candidates.push(format!("deadreckon chain resume {id} --apply-mode preview"));
2022	        candidates.push(format!("deadreckon chain undo {id}"));
2023	    }
2024	    for command in candidates {
2025	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
2026	            actions.push(command);
2027	        }
2028	    }
2029	    actions
2030	}

2147	fn chain_attach_tui(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
2148	    enable_raw_mode()?;
2149	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
2150	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
2151	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
2152	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
2153	    let mut tui_state = ChainAttachTuiState::default();
2154	    let mut event_tail = AttachJsonlTail::<ChainEvent>::new(paths.chain_events(chain_id));
2155	
2156	    let result = loop {
2157	        let budget = AttachTickBudget::default();
2158	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Chain, budget);
2159	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2160	        let chain = load_chain(paths, chain_id)?;
2161	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
2162	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2163	        event_tail.reset_to_path(paths.chain_events(chain_id));
2164	        let event_refresh_error = event_tail.refresh().err();
2165	        let event_read_elapsed = stage_started.elapsed();
2166	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ReadJsonl, stage_started);
2167	        tui_state.event_status_hint = chain_event_read_hint(
2168	            event_tail.rows().len(),
2169	            event_tail.last_appended_rows,
2170	            event_tail.partial_bytes,
2171	            event_read_elapsed,
2172	            budget,
2173	            event_refresh_error.as_ref(),
2174	        );
2175	        let events = event_tail.rows();
2176	        tui_state.clamp(&chain);
2177	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2178	        terminal.draw(|frame| render_chain_attach(frame, &chain, events, &tui_state))?;
2179	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
2180	
2181	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2182	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(200))?;
2183	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
2184	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
2185	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
2186	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
2187	        if input_ready {
2188	            match event::read()? {
2189	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),
2190	                Event::Key(key) => match key.code {
2191	                    KeyCode::Enter => {
2192	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2193	                        if let Some(run_id) = chain
2194	                            .steps
2195	                            .get(tui_state.selected_step)
2196	                            .and_then(|step| step.run_id.clone())
2197	                        {
2198	                            let _ = show_command(&run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None);
2199	                        } else {
2200	                            eprintln!("selected step has no run yet");
2201	                        }
2202	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2203	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2204	                    }
2205	                    KeyCode::Char('r') => {
2206	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2207	                        let action = chain_redo_command(
2208	                            paths,
2209	                            chain_id,
2210	                            Some(tui_state.selected_step as u32 + 1),
2211	                            None,
2212	                            false,
2213	                        );
2214	                        if let Err(err) = &action {
2215	                            print_error(err);
2216	                        }
2217	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2218	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2219	                    }
2220	                    KeyCode::Char('e') => {
2221	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2222	                        let goal = prompt::open("new chain step goal: ", None)?;
2223	                        if !goal.trim().is_empty() {
2224	                            let action = chain_extend_command(paths, chain_id, goal, None, None);
2225	                            if let Err(err) = &action {
2226	                                print_error(err);
2227	                            }
2228	                        }
2229	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2230	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2231	                    }
2232	                    KeyCode::Char('p') => {
2233	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2234	                        let action =
2235	                            chain_pause_command(paths, chain_id, Some("user_paused".to_string()));
2236	                        if let Err(err) = &action {
2237	                            print_error(err);
2238	                        }
2239	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2240	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2241	                    }
2242	                    KeyCode::Char('k') => {
2243	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2244	                        if prompt::confirm("kill chain?", false)?
2245	                            && let Err(err) = chain_kill_command(paths, chain_id, false)
2246	                        {
2247	                            print_error(&err);
2248	                        }
2249	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2250	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2251	                    }
2252	                    _ => tui_state.handle_key(key, &chain),
2253	                },
2254	                Event::Mouse(mouse) => match mouse.kind {
2255	                    MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => tui_state.scroll(1, &chain),
2256	                    MouseEventKind::ScrollUp => tui_state.scroll(-1, &chain),
2257	                    _ => {}
2258	                },
2259	                _ => {}
2260	            }
2261	        }
2262	    };
2263	
2264	    disable_raw_mode()?;
2265	    execute!(
2266	        terminal.backend_mut(),
2267	        DisableMouseCapture,
2268	        LeaveAlternateScreen
2269	    )?;
2270	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
2271	    result
2272	}

2274	fn chain_pause_command(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, reason: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {
2275	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2276	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2277	    if chain.status != ChainStatus::Running {
2278	        let status = chain_status_label(&chain).to_string();
2279	        let primary = format!("deadreckon chain status {}", chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id));
2280	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2281	            code: 1,
2282	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2283	                paths,
2284	                &chain,
2285	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2286	                &format!("DeadReckon did not pause the chain because cannot pause '{status}' chain."),
2287	                "Only a running chain can be paused; this chain is already outside the active conductor state.",
2288	                vec![
2289	                    ("requested transition".to_string(), "pause".to_string()),
2290	                    ("required status".to_string(), "running".to_string()),
2291	                ],
2292	                primary,
2293	                Vec::new(),
2294	            )
2295	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2296	        });
2297	    }
2298	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Paused;
2299	    chain.paused_reason = Some(reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "user_paused".to_string()));
2300	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2301	    append_chain_event(
2302	        paths,
2303	        &chain.chain_id,
2304	        ChainEventKind::ChainPaused,
2305	        None,
2306	        json!({ "reason": chain.paused_reason }),
2307	    )?;
2308	    print!(
2309	        "{}",
2310	        chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2311	    );
2312	    Ok(())
2313	}
