2315	pub(crate) fn chain_kill_command(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
2316	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2317	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2318	    let conductor = read_conductor_state(paths, &id)?;
2319	    let mut signaled_pids = BTreeSet::new();
2320	    if let Some(run_id) = conductor
2321	        .as_ref()
2322	        .and_then(|state| state.live_run_id.as_deref())
2323	        .map(ToString::to_string)
2324	        .or_else(|| {
2325	            chain
2326	                .steps
2327	                .iter()
2328	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Running)
2329	                .and_then(|step| step.run_id.clone())
2330	        })
2331	        && let Ok(mut state) = load_run(paths, &run_id)
2332	    {
2333	        kill_loaded_run(paths, &mut state, force)?;
2334	        signaled_pids.extend(supervised_pids(&state));
2335	    }
2336	    if let Some(pid) = conductor.as_ref().and_then(|state| state.live_child_pid) {
2337	        terminate_pid(pid, force)?;
2338	        signaled_pids.insert(pid);
2339	    }
2340	    if let Some(pid) = conductor
2341	        .as_ref()
2342	        .map(|state| state.conductor_pid)
2343	        .or(chain.conductor_pid)
2344	        && pid != std::process::id()
2345	    {
2346	        terminate_pid(pid, force)?;
2347	        signaled_pids.insert(pid);
2348	    }
2349	    if !force {
2350	        let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(2);
2351	        while signaled_pids
2352	            .iter()
2353	            .any(|pid| *pid != std::process::id() && pid_is_alive(*pid))
2354	            && std::time::Instant::now() < deadline
2355	        {
2356	            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
2357	        }
2358	        for pid in &signaled_pids {
2359	            if *pid != std::process::id() && pid_is_alive(*pid) {
2360	                terminate_pid(*pid, true)?;
2361	            }
2362	        }
2363	    }
2364	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Killed;
2365	    chain.failure_reason = Some("killed by user".to_string());
2366	    chain.conductor_pid = None;
2367	    for step in &mut chain.steps {
2368	        if step.status == ChainStepStatus::Running {
2369	            step.status = ChainStepStatus::Failed;
2370	            step.fail_reason = Some("killed by user".to_string());
2371	        }
2372	    }
2373	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2374	    append_chain_event(
2375	        paths,
2376	        &chain.chain_id,
2377	        ChainEventKind::ChainKilled,
2378	        None,
2379	        json!({ "force": force }),
2380	    )?;
2381	    let _ = fs::remove_file(paths.conductor_json(&chain.chain_id));
2382	    print!(
2383	        "{}",
2384	        chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2385	    );
2386	    Ok(())
2387	}
2388	
2389	fn chain_undo_command(
2390	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2391	    id: &str,
2392	    through_step: Option<u32>,
2393	    no_confirm: bool,
2394	) -> Result<()> {
2395	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2396	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2397	    let mut applied = chain
2398	        .steps
2399	        .iter()
2400	        .filter(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied)
2401	        .filter(|step| through_step.is_none_or(|limit| step.index < limit))
2402	        .filter_map(|step| {
2403	            step.applied_sha
2404	                .as_deref()
2405	                .map(|sha| (step.index, sha.to_string()))
2406	        })
2407	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2408	    if applied.is_empty() {
2409	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2410	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2411	            code: 1,
2412	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2413	                paths,
2414	                &chain,
2415	                VerdictKind::Noop,
2416	                "DeadReckon did not undo the chain because there is nothing to undo.",
2417	                "Undo only applies to chain steps with applied commits, so inspection is the safest next command.",
2418	                vec![("applied steps".to_string(), "0".to_string())],
2419	                format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2420	                Vec::new(),
2421	            )
2422	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2423	        });
2424	    }
2425	    if !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
2426	        if !prompt::confirm("undo applied chain commits?", false)? {
2427	            println!("cancelled");
2428	            return Ok(());
2429	        }
2430	    } else if !no_confirm {
2431	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2432	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2433	            code: 1,
2434	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2435	                paths,
2436	                &chain,
2437	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2438	                "DeadReckon did not undo the chain because non-interactive chain undo requires --no-confirm.",
2439	                "Undo reverts applied commits, and this session cannot ask for confirmation, so DeadReckon stopped before changing git state.",
2440	                vec![("stdin".to_string(), "non-interactive".to_string())],
2441	                format!("deadreckon chain undo {id} --no-confirm"),
2442	                Vec::new(),
2443	            )
2444	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2445	        });
2446	    }
2447	    append_chain_event(
2448	        paths,
2449	        &chain.chain_id,
2450	        ChainEventKind::ChainUndoStarted,
2451	        None,
2452	        json!({ "count": applied.len() }),
2453	    )?;
2454	    let undo_count = applied.len();
2455	    applied.reverse();
2456	    for (index, sha) in applied {
2457	        git_status(&chain.cwd, &["revert", "--no-edit", &sha])?;
2458	        if let Some(step) = chain.steps.iter_mut().find(|step| step.index == index) {
2459	            step.status = ChainStepStatus::Undone;
2460	        }
2461	        append_chain_event(
2462	            paths,
2463	            &chain.chain_id,
2464	            ChainEventKind::ChainUndoneStep,
2465	            Some(index),
2466	            json!({ "sha": sha }),
2467	        )?;
2468	    }
2469	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Undone;
2470	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2471	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2472	    print!(
2473	        "{}",
2474	        chain_transition_surface(
2475	            paths,
2476	            &chain,
2477	            VerdictKind::Noop,
2478	            "DeadReckon reverted the applied chain commits and marked the chain undone.",
2479	            "There is no active chain work to advance, so inspection is the safest next command.",
2480	            vec![("undone steps".to_string(), undo_count.to_string())],
2481	            format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2482	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain redo {id}")],
2483	        )
2484	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2485	    );
2486	    Ok(())
2487	}
2488	
2489	fn chain_extend_command(
2490	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2491	    id: &str,
2492	    step_goal: String,
2493	    insert_at: Option<u32>,
2494	    max_spend_add: Option<f64>,
2495	) -> Result<()> {
2496	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2497	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2498	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Completed && insert_at.is_none() {
2499	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2500	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2501	            code: 1,
2502	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2503	                paths,
2504	                &chain,
2505	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2506	                "DeadReckon did not extend the chain because it cannot extend completed chain at end.",
2507	                "A completed chain can only be reopened by inserting a step at a specific position, so DeadReckon refused before mutating chain state.",
2508	                vec![("insert-at".to_string(), "missing".to_string())],
2509	                format!("deadreckon chain extend {id} \"...\" --insert-at <N>"),
2510	                Vec::new(),
2511	            )
2512	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2513	        });
2514	    }
2515	    if let Some(add) = max_spend_add {
2516	        chain.max_spend_usd = Some(chain.max_spend_usd.unwrap_or(0.0) + add);
2517	    }
2518	    let insert = insert_at
2519	        .map(|value| value.saturating_sub(1) as usize)
2520	        .unwrap_or(chain.steps.len())
2521	        .min(chain.steps.len());
2522	    chain.steps.insert(
2523	        insert,
2524	        deadreckon_core::ChainStep::new(insert as u32, step_goal),
2525	    );
2526	    for (index, step) in chain.steps.iter_mut().enumerate() {
2527	        step.index = index as u32;
2528	    }
2529	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Completed {
2530	        chain.status = ChainStatus::Paused;
2531	        chain.paused_reason = Some("extended".to_string());
2532	    }
2533	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2534	    append_chain_event(
2535	        paths,
2536	        &chain.chain_id,
2537	        ChainEventKind::ChainStepExtended,
2538	        Some(insert as u32),
2539	        json!({ "insert_at": insert }),
2540	    )?;
2541	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2542	    print!(
2543	        "{}",
2544	        chain_transition_surface(
2545	            paths,
2546	            &chain,
2547	            VerdictKind::Preview,
2548	            "DeadReckon queued a new chain step.",
2549	            "The chain has stored work that has not run yet, so resume is the safest next command.",
2550	            vec![("inserted step".to_string(), (insert + 1).to_string())],
2551	            format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2552	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain show {id}")],
2553	        )
2554	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2555	    );
2556	    Ok(())
2557	}
2558	
2559	fn chain_redo_command(
2560	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2561	    id: &str,
2562	    step: Option<u32>,
2563	    extend: Option<String>,
2564	    reapply: bool,
2565	) -> Result<()> {
2566	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2567	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2568	    let index = step
2569	        .map(|step| step.saturating_sub(1))
2570	        .or_else(|| {
2571	            chain
2572	                .steps
2573	                .iter()
2574	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Failed)
2575	                .map(|step| step.index)
2576	        })
2577	        .or_else(|| {
2578	            chain
2579	                .steps
2580	                .iter()
2581	                .rev()
2582	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied)
2583	                .map(|step| step.index)
2584	        })
2585	        .ok_or_else(|| {
2586	            let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2587	            CliError::Surface {
2588	                code: 1,
2589	                surface: chain_transition_surface(
2590	                    paths,
2591	                    &chain,
2592	                    VerdictKind::Noop,
2593	                    "DeadReckon did not redo a chain step because no failed or applied step to redo.",
2594	                    "The default redo target is the first failed step or the latest applied step. This chain has no eligible redo candidate, so DeadReckon left chain state unchanged.",
2595	                    vec![("redo candidate".to_string(), "none".to_string())],
2596	                    format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2597	                    Vec::new(),
2598	                )
2599	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2600	            }
2601	        })? as usize;
2602	    let selected_step = chain.steps.get(index).ok_or_else(|| {
2603	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2604	        CliError::Surface {
2605	            code: 1,
2606	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2607	                paths,
2608	                &chain,
2609	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2610	                &format!("DeadReckon did not redo the step because step {} does not exist.", index + 1),
2611	                "The requested step is outside the chain's stored step list, so DeadReckon refused before mutating chain state.",
2612	                vec![
2613	                    ("requested step".to_string(), (index + 1).to_string()),
2614	                    ("step count".to_string(), chain.steps.len().to_string()),
2615	                ],
2616	                format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2617	                Vec::new(),
2618	            )
2619	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2620	        }
2621	    })?;
2622	    if selected_step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied && !reapply {
2623	        let step_number = index + 1;
2624	        let primary = format!(
2625	            "deadreckon chain redo {} --step {step_number} --reapply",
2626	            chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)
2627	        );
2628	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2629	            code: 1,
2630	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2631	                paths,
2632	                &chain,
2633	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2634	                &format!("DeadReckon did not redo the step because step '{step_number}' already applied; redo needs --reapply."),
2635	                "Redoing an applied step requires explicit reapply consent because DeadReckon may need to revert a previously applied commit before replaying the step.",
2636	                vec![
2637	                    ("requested step".to_string(), step_number.to_string()),
2638	                    (
2639	                        "step status".to_string(),
2640	                        chain_step_status_label(selected_step.status).to_string(),
2641	                    ),
2642	                ],
2643	                primary,
2644	                Vec::new(),
2645	            )
2646	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2647	        });
2648	    }
2649	    let step = chain.steps.get_mut(index).expect("validated step index");
2650	    if reapply && let Some(sha) = step.applied_sha.as_deref() {
2651	        git_status(&chain.cwd, &["revert", "--no-edit", sha])?;
2652	    }
2653	    let prior_goal = step.goal.clone();
2654	    if let Some(extend) = extend {
2655	        step.goal = extend;
2656	    }
2657	    step.status = ChainStepStatus::Pending;
2658	    step.run_id = None;
2659	    step.applied_at = None;
2660	    step.applied_sha = None;
2661	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2662	    append_chain_event(
2663	        paths,
2664	        &chain.chain_id,
2665	        ChainEventKind::ChainStepRedone,
2666	        Some(index as u32),
2667	        json!({ "prior_goal": prior_goal, "new_goal": chain.steps[index].goal }),
2668	    )?;
2669	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2670	    print!(
2671	        "{}",
2672	        chain_transition_surface(
2673	            paths,
2674	            &chain,
2675	            VerdictKind::Preview,
2676	            "DeadReckon reset a chain step for redo.",
2677	            "The selected step is pending again, so resume is the safest next command.",
2678	            vec![("redo step".to_string(), (index + 1).to_string())],
2679	            format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2680	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain show {id}")],
2681	        )
2682	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2683	    );
2684	    Ok(())
2685	}

2709	fn collect_chain_goals(
2710	    args: &[String],
2711	    from_file: Option<PathBuf>,
2712	    from_stdin: bool,
2713	    no_hints: bool,
2714	) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
2715	    let mut goals = Vec::new();
2716	    goals.extend(args.iter().cloned());
2717	    if let Some(path) = from_file {
2718	        goals.extend(parse_goal_lines(&fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(
2719	            |source| {
2720	                CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::Io {
2721	                    path: path.clone(),
2722	                    source,
2723	                })
2724	            },
2725	        )?));
2726	    }
2727	    if from_stdin {
2728	        if io::stdin().is_terminal() {
2729	            return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
2730	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2731	                None,
2732	                "DeadReckon did not read chain steps because --from-stdin needs a pipe.",
2733	                "The command requested stdin input, but stdin is an interactive terminal. DeadReckon refused before reading goals or writing chain state.",
2734	                [
2735	                    ("stdin".to_string(), "terminal".to_string()),
2736	                    ("from-stdin".to_string(), "true".to_string()),
2737	                ],
2738	                "printf 'g1\\ng2\\n' | deadreckon chain --from-stdin --yes".to_string(),
2739	                no_hints,
2740	            ));
2741	        }
2742	        let mut raw = String::new();
2743	        io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
2744	        goals.extend(parse_goal_lines(&raw));
2745	    }
2746	    Ok(goals
2747	        .into_iter()
2748	        .map(|goal| goal.trim().to_string())
2749	        .filter(|goal| !goal.is_empty())
2750	        .collect())
2751	}

2753	fn parse_goal_lines(raw: &str) -> Vec<String> {
2754	    raw.lines()
2755	        .map(str::trim)
2756	        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
2757	        .map(ToString::to_string)
2758	        .collect()
2759	}

2761	fn json_value_kind(value: &Value) -> &'static str {
2762	    match value {
2763	        Value::Null => "null",
2764	        Value::Bool(_) => "boolean",
2765	        Value::Number(_) => "number",
2766	        Value::String(_) => "string",
2767	        Value::Array(_) => "array",
2768	        Value::Object(_) => "object",
2769	    }

2772	fn chain_planner_prompt(goal: &str, n: u8) -> String {
2773	    format!(
2774	        "You are decomposing a coding goal into an ordered serial chain.\n\
2775	Output a JSON array of <= {n} strings, each <= 160 chars, each a concrete next step. \
2776	Each step builds on the previous step's result. No prose, no commentary. Goal: {goal:?}."
2777	    )

2779	
2780	fn parse_planner_goals(raw: &str, n: u8, root_goal: &str, no_hints: bool) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
2781	    let raw = raw.trim();
2782	    let json_text = if raw.starts_with("```") {
2783	        raw.lines()
2784	            .filter(|line| !line.trim_start().starts_with("```"))
2785	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
2786	            .join("\n")
2787	    } else {
2788	        raw.to_string()
2789	    };
2790	    let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(json_text.trim()).map_err(|err| {
2791	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
2792	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2793	            None,
2794	            &format!("chain plan returned invalid JSON: {err}"),
2795	            "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because the planner response could not be parsed as the required JSON step list.",
2796	            [
2797	                ("parse error".to_string(), err.to_string()),
2798	                ("response bytes".to_string(), json_text.len().to_string()),
2799	            ],
2800	            chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2801	            no_hints,
2802	        )
2803	    })?;
2804	    let array = value.as_array().ok_or_else(|| {
2805	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
2806	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2807	            None,
2808	            "chain plan must return a JSON array of strings",
2809	            "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because the planner response had the wrong JSON shape for ordered chain steps.",
2810	            [
2811	                ("expected".to_string(), "array".to_string()),
2812	                ("actual".to_string(), json_value_kind(&value).to_string()),
2813	            ],
2814	            chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2815	            no_hints,
2816	        )
2817	    })?;
2818	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
2819	    let mut goals = Vec::new();
2820	    for item in array.iter().take(usize::from(n)) {
2821	        let Some(goal) = item.as_str().map(str::trim).filter(|goal| !goal.is_empty()) else {
2822	            continue;
2823	        };
2824	        if goal.chars().count() > 160 {
2825	            return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
2826	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2827	                None,
2828	                "chain plan produced a step longer than 160 chars",
2829	                "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because one step is too large to review and recover as a chain step.",
2830	                [
2831	                    ("step chars".to_string(), goal.chars().count().to_string()),
2832	                    ("maximum chars".to_string(), "160".to_string()),
2833	                ],
2834	                chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2835	                no_hints,
2836	            ));
2837	        }
2838	        let key = goal
2839	            .split_whitespace()
2840	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
2841	            .join(" ")
2842	            .to_lowercase();
2843	        if !seen.insert(key.clone()) {
2844	            return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
2845	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2846	                None,
2847	                "chain plan produced duplicate steps",
2848	                "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because duplicate steps make chain progress and recovery ambiguous.",
2849	                [
2850	                    ("duplicate step".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
2851	                    ("normalized step".to_string(), key),
2852	                ],
2853	                chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2854	                no_hints,
2855	            ));
2856	        }
2857	        goals.push(goal.to_string());
2858	    }
2859	    deadreckon_core::validate_goal_count(goals.len()).map_err(|_| {
2860	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
2861	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2862	            None,
2863	            &format!("decomposition produced {} goals; need >= 2", goals.len()),
2864	            "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because a chain needs at least two ordered steps.",
2865	            [
2866	                ("produced goals".to_string(), goals.len().to_string()),
2867	                ("minimum goals".to_string(), "2".to_string()),
2868	            ],
2869	            chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2870	            no_hints,
2871	        )
2872	    })?;
2873	    Ok(goals)
2874	}

2978	// SAFETY: Chain list filters are owned clap values at the command boundary.
2979	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
2980	fn list_chain_records(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, scope: Option<String>) -> Result<Vec<Chain>> {
2981	    if !paths.chains_dir().exists() {
2982	        return Ok(Vec::new());
2983	    }
2984	    let mut chains = Vec::new();
2985	    for entry in fs::read_dir(paths.chains_dir())? {
2986	        let entry = entry?;
2987	        let path = entry.path().join("chain.json");
2988	        if !path.exists() {
2989	            continue;
2990	        }
2991	        let chain = serde_json::from_slice::<Chain>(&fs::read(&path)?)
2992	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source })?;
2993	        if scope.as_deref().is_some_and(|scope| chain.scope != scope) {
2994	            continue;
2995	        }
2996	        chains.push(chain);
2997	    }
2998	    chains.sort_by(|left, right| right.created_at.cmp(&left.created_at));
2999	    Ok(chains)
3000	}

3002	pub(crate) fn resolve_chain_id(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, all: bool) -> Result<String> {
3003	    let scope = if all { None } else { Some(current_scope()?) };
3004	    let chains = list_chain_records(paths, scope.clone())?;
3005	    if matches!(id, "latest" | "last") {
3006	        return chains
3007	            .first()
3008	            .map(|chain| chain.chain_id.clone())
3009	            .ok_or_else(|| chain_missing_scope_surface(scope.as_deref()));
3010	    }
3011	    let matches = chains
3012	        .iter()
3013	        .filter(|chain| chain.chain_id.starts_with(id))
3014	        .map(|chain| chain.chain_id.clone())
3015	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3016	    match matches.len() {
3017	        1 => Ok(matches[0].clone()),
3018	        0 => Err(chain_id_resolution_surface(
3019	            id,
3020	            &format!("DeadReckon could not resolve the chain because no chain '{id}' was found."),
3021	            "The command needs one concrete chain id, but no chain in the selected scope starts with the requested id.",
3022	            [
3023	                ("requested id".to_string(), id.to_string()),
3024	                (
3025	                    "scope".to_string(),
3026	                    scope.as_deref().unwrap_or("all").to_string(),
3027	                ),
3028	                ("matching chains".to_string(), "0".to_string()),
3029	            ],
3030	            "deadreckon chain list",
3031	        )),
3032	        _ => Err(chain_id_resolution_surface(
3033	            id,
3034	            &format!(
3035	                "DeadReckon could not resolve the chain because chain id prefix {id} is ambiguous."
3036	            ),
3037	            "The command needs one concrete chain id, but the requested prefix matches multiple chains.",
3038	            [
3039	                ("requested prefix".to_string(), id.to_string()),
3040	                (
3041	                    "scope".to_string(),
3042	                    scope.as_deref().unwrap_or("all").to_string(),
3043	                ),
3044	                ("matches".to_string(), matches.join(", ")),
3045	            ],
3046	            "deadreckon chain list --full",
3047	        )),
3048	    }
3049	}

3051	fn chain_id_resolution_surface<K, V>(
3052	    id: &str,
3053	    what_happened: impl Into<String>,
3054	    why_this_verdict: impl Into<String>,
3055	    evidence: impl IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>,
3056	    primary: &str,
3057	) -> CliError
3058	where
3059	    K: Into<String>,
3060	    V: Into<String>,
3061	{
3062	    CliError::Surface {
3063	        code: 1,
3064	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
3065	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
3066	            "chain",
3067	            Some(id),
3068	            ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, evidence),
3069	            [("Recommended", primary)],
3070	            Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
3071	        )
3072	        .expect("chain id resolution surface must have one primary action")
3073	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
3074	    }
3075	}
3076	
3077	fn chain_missing_scope_surface(scope: Option<&str>) -> CliError {
3078	    CliError::Surface {
3079	        code: 1,
3080	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
3081	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
3082	            "chain",
3083	            None,
3084	            ExplanationPanel::new(
3085	                "DeadReckon could not resolve a chain because no chains in scope.",
3086	                "The requested command needs an existing chain id or latest chain, but the current scope has no chain state to operate on.",
3087	                [
3088	                    ("scope".to_string(), scope.unwrap_or("all").to_string()),
3089	                    ("matching chains".to_string(), "0".to_string()),
3090	                ],
3091	            ),
3092	            [("Recommended", "deadreckon chain \"step one\" \"step two\"")],
3093	            Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
3094	        )
3095	        .expect("missing chain scope surface must have one primary action")
3096	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
3097	    }
3098	}

3100	fn chain_option_parse_surface(
3101	    flag: &str,
3102	    value: &str,
3103	    allowed: &str,
3104	    what_happened: String,
3105	    primary: &str,
3106	) -> CliError {
3107	    CliError::Surface {
3108	        code: 1,
3109	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(

1895	/// Resolve a campaign by id prefix: a plan dir whose `campaign.json` exists and
1896	/// whose id starts with `reference`. Returns the campaign dir and the campaign.
1897	pub(crate) fn resolve_campaign(
1898	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1899	    reference: &str,
1900	) -> Result<Option<(PathBuf, deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign)>> {
1901	    let plans = paths.home().join("plans");
1902	    if !plans.is_dir() {
1903	        return Ok(None);
1904	    }
1905	    let mut campaigns = Vec::new();
1906	    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&plans).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
1907	        path: plans.clone(),
1908	        source,
1909	    })? {
1910	        let dir = entry
1911	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
1912	                path: plans.clone(),
1913	                source,
1914	            })?
1915	            .path();
1916	        if !deadreckon_core::campaign::campaign_path_for_plan_dir(&dir).is_file() {
1917	            continue;
1918	        }
1919	        let campaign = deadreckon_core::campaign::read_campaign(&dir)?;
1920	        campaigns.push((dir, campaign));
1921	    }
1922	    if matches!(reference, "latest" | "last") {
1923	        campaigns.sort_by_key(|(_, campaign)| campaign.created_at);
1924	        return Ok(campaigns.pop());
1925	    }
1926	    let matches = campaigns
1927	        .into_iter()
1928	        .filter(|(_, campaign)| campaign.campaign_id.starts_with(reference))
1929	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1930	    match matches.len() {
1931	        0 => Ok(None),
1932	        1 => Ok(matches.into_iter().next()),
1933	        _ => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1934	            &format!(
1935	                "ambiguous campaign id prefix {reference}; matches {}",
1936	                matches
1937	                    .iter()
1938	                    .map(|(_, campaign)| campaign.campaign_id.as_str())
1939	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1940	                    .join(", ")
1941	            ),
1942	            "use a longer campaign id prefix",
1943	        ))),
1944	    }
1945	}

1947	/// Drive a campaign's sub-orchestrators sequentially, recording events and status
1948	/// transitions. Sequential (not concurrent like plan `fork`) is deliberate: the
1949	/// tree-budget ceiling (P5) must be checked *before* launching the next sub, which
1950	/// a concurrent batch cannot guarantee. The `launch` closure performs the actual
1951	/// spawn; tests inject a fake. A failed sub never aborts its siblings.
1952	#[allow(dead_code)] // reserved campaign-fork engine; command wiring and tests share this private seam
1953	pub(crate) fn run_campaign_fork<F, S>(
1954	    campaign_dir: &Path,
1955	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1956	    mut launch: F,
1957	    spend_of: S,
1958	) -> Result<()>
1959	where
1960	    F: FnMut(
1961	        &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal,
1962	        &Path,
1963	    ) -> Result<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult>,
1964	    S: Fn(&deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult) -> f64,
1965	{
1966	    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{
1967	        self, CampaignStatus, SubGoalStatus, append_campaign_event, tree_budget_exhausted,
1968	        write_campaign,
1969	    };
1970	
1971	    campaign.status = CampaignStatus::Forked;
1972	    campaign.forked_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
1973	    let tree_budget = campaign.tree_budget_usd;
1974	    write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
1975	    append_campaign_event(
1976	        campaign_dir,
1977	        "campaign_started",
1978	        serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign.n }),
1979	    )?;
1980	
1981	    let mut spent_usd = 0.0_f64;
1982	    for index in 0..campaign.sub_goals.len() {
1983	        if tree_budget_exhausted(tree_budget, spent_usd) {
1984	            append_campaign_event(
1985	                campaign_dir,
1986	                "budget_exhausted",
1987	                serde_json::json!({ "spent_usd": spent_usd, "tree_budget_usd": tree_budget }),
1988	            )?;
1989	            break;
1990	        }
1991	        let sub = campaign.sub_goals[index].clone();
1992	        let launch_dir = campaign_dir.join("launch").join(&sub.sub_id);
1993	        fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir)?;
1994	        append_campaign_event(
1995	            campaign_dir,
1996	            "sub_launched",
1997	            serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id }),
1998	        )?;
1999	        match launch(&sub, &launch_dir) {
2000	            Ok(result) => {
2001	                spent_usd += spend_of(&result);
2002	                let target = &mut campaign.sub_goals[index];
2003	                target.sub_plan_id = result.plan_id.clone();
2004	                target.result_run_id = result.result_run_id.clone();
2005	                target.status = if result.ok {
2006	                    SubGoalStatus::Merged
2007	                } else {
2008	                    SubGoalStatus::Failed
2009	                };
2010	                append_campaign_event(
2011	                    campaign_dir,
2012	                    if result.ok {
2013	                        "sub_merged"
2014	                    } else {
2015	                        "sub_failed"
2016	                    },
2017	                    serde_json::json!({
2018	                        "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
2019	                        "plan_id": result.plan_id,
2020	                        "result_run_id": result.result_run_id,
2021	                    }),
2022	                )?;
2023	            }
2024	            Err(err) => {
2025	                campaign.sub_goals[index].status = SubGoalStatus::Failed;
2026	                append_campaign_event(
2027	                    campaign_dir,
2028	                    "sub_failed",
2029	                    serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id, "reason": err.to_string() }),
2030	                )?;
2031	            }
2032	        }
2033	        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
2034	    }
2035	    Ok(())
2036	}

1950	fn plan_progress_summary(plan: &Plan) -> String {
1951	    let total = plan.tasks.len();
1952	    let completed = plan
1953	        .tasks
1954	        .iter()
1955	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1956	        .count();
1957	    let failed = plan
1958	        .tasks
1959	        .iter()
1960	        .filter(|task| matches!(task.status, PlanTaskStatus::Failed | PlanTaskStatus::Killed))
1961	        .count();
1962	    let pending = plan
1963	        .tasks
1964	        .iter()
1965	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Pending)
1966	        .count();
1967	    let running = plan
1968	        .tasks
1969	        .iter()
1970	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Running)
1971	        .map(|task| match task.child_run_id.as_deref() {
1972	            Some(run_id) => format!("{}:{}", task.task_id, run_prefix(run_id)),
1973	            None => task.task_id.clone(),
1974	        })
1975	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1976	    let running = if running.is_empty() {
1977	        "-".to_string()
1978	    } else {
1979	        running.join(",")
1980	    };
1981	    format!("done={completed}/{total} running={running} pending={pending} failed={failed}")
1982	}

2000	            for (index, provider) in overrides {

2003	                    CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(

2082	        ))
2083	    })?;

2086	}

2138	async fn plan_child_source_dir(
2139	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2140	    plan: &Plan,
2141	    task_index: usize,
2142	    parent_cwd: &Path,
2143	    repair: DependencyComposeRepair<'_>,
2144	) -> Result<PathBuf> {
2145	    let task = &plan.tasks[task_index];
2146	    let plan_cwd = plan.parent_cwd.as_deref().unwrap_or(parent_cwd);
2147	    if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
2148	        return Ok(plan_cwd.to_path_buf());
2149	    }
2150	
2151	    let dependencies = plan_dependency_artifacts(paths, plan, task)?;
2152	    if task.role == PlanRole::Reviewer && dependencies.len() == 1 {
2153	        Ok(dependencies[0].root.clone())
2154	    } else {
2155	        compose_dependency_source_dir(paths, plan, task, &dependencies, repair).await
2156	    }
2157	}

2159	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
2160	struct PlanDependencyArtifact {
2161	    task_id: String,
2162	    index: u32,
2163	    run_id: String,
2164	    root: PathBuf,
2165	}
2166	
2167	fn plan_dependency_artifacts(
2168	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2169	    plan: &Plan,
2170	    task: &PlanTask,
2171	) -> Result<Vec<PlanDependencyArtifact>> {
2172	    let mut dependencies = Vec::new();
2173	    for dependency in &task.depends_on {
2174	        let dependency_task = plan.task_by_id(dependency).ok_or_else(|| {
2175	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2176	                &format!("task {} depends on unknown {dependency}", task.task_id),
2177	                "edit the plan so depends_on references earlier task ids",
2178	            ))
2179	        })?;
2180	        if dependency_task.status != PlanTaskStatus::Completed {
2181	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2182	                &format!(
2183	                    "task {} dependency {} is {}",
2184	                    task.task_id,
2185	                    dependency_task.task_id,
2186	                    task_status_label(dependency_task.status)
2187	                ),
2188	                "wait for dependencies to complete before forking dependent children",
2189	            )));
2190	        }
2191	        let run_id = dependency_task.child_run_id.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
2192	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2193	                &format!(
2194	                    "task {} dependency {} has no run id",
2195	                    task.task_id, dependency
2196	                ),
2197	                "deadreckon fork <plan-id>",
2198	            ))
2199	        })?;
2200	        let state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
2201	        dependencies.push(PlanDependencyArtifact {
2202	            task_id: dependency_task.task_id.clone(),
2203	            index: dependency_task.index,
2204	            run_id: run_id.to_string(),
2205	            root: child_artifact_root(paths, &state),
2206	        });
2207	    }
2208	    dependencies.sort_by_key(|dependency| dependency.index);
2209	    Ok(dependencies)
2210	}
2211	
2212	async fn compose_dependency_source_dir(
2213	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2214	    plan: &Plan,
2215	    task: &PlanTask,
2216	    dependencies: &[PlanDependencyArtifact],
2217	    repair: DependencyComposeRepair<'_>,
2218	) -> Result<PathBuf> {
2219	    let source_dir = paths
2220	        .plan_dir(&plan.plan_id)
2221	        .join("launch")
2222	        .join(&task.task_id)
2223	        .join("source");
2224	    let sources = dependencies
2225	        .iter()
2226	        .map(|dependency| ComposeFileSource {
2227	            root: dependency.root.clone(),
2228	            data: dependency.clone(),
2229	            prefix_error: "dependency source prefix error",
2230	        })
2231	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2232	    let conflicts = compose_merge_sources(
2233	        &source_dir,
2234	        &sources,
2235	        |dependency, _relative, file, hash| PlanMergeSeenFile {
2236	            task_id: dependency.task_id.clone(),
2237	            task_index: dependency.index,
2238	            run_id: dependency.run_id.clone(),
2239	            artifact_root: dependency.root.clone(),
2240	            artifact_path: file.to_path_buf(),
2241	            hash,
2242	        },
2243	        |relative, previous, current| {
2244	            if plan_task_depends_on(plan, &current.task_id, &previous.task_id) {
2245	                ComposeMergeDecision::UseCurrent
2246	            } else if plan_task_depends_on(plan, &previous.task_id, &current.task_id) {
2247	                ComposeMergeDecision::KeepExisting
2248	            } else {
2249	                ComposeMergeDecision::RecordConflict {
2250	                    conflict: plan_merge_conflict(plan, relative, previous, current, None),
2251	                    use_current: false,
2252	                }
2253	            }
2254	        },
2255	    )?;
2256	    if !conflicts.is_empty() {
2257	        repair_dependency_source_conflicts(
2258	            paths,
2259	            plan,
2260	            task,
2261	            repair,
2262	            source_dir.clone(),
2263	            conflicts,
2264	        )
2265	        .await?;
2266	    }
2267	    Ok(source_dir)
2268	}
2269	
2270	async fn repair_dependency_source_conflicts(
2271	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2272	    plan: &Plan,
2273	    task: &PlanTask,
2274	    repair: DependencyComposeRepair<'_>,
2275	    source_dir: PathBuf,
2276	    conflicts: Vec<PlanMergeConflict>,
2277	) -> Result<()> {
2278	    let mut merge = PlanMergeOutcome {
2279	        working_dir: source_dir,
2280	        conflicts,
2281	    };
2282	    let unresolved_conflicts = merge.unresolved_conflicts();
2283	    let context = MergeRepairContext::dependency(paths, plan, task);
2284	    write_plan_merge_conflicts_to(
2285	        &context.proof_dir,
2286	        plan,
2287	        "dependency-compose",
2288	        &unresolved_conflicts,
2289	    )?;
2290	    let worker_spec = render_launch_worker_spec(paths, plan, task);
2291	    write_worker_spec(paths, &plan.plan_id, &task.task_id, &worker_spec)?;
2292	    let provider = if repair.disabled {
2293	        None
2294	    } else {
2295	        resolve_merge_repair_provider(paths, plan, repair.provider)?
2296	    };
2297	    write_merge_repair_request(
2298	        paths,
2299	        plan,
2300	        &context,
2301	        provider.as_deref(),
2302	        &unresolved_conflicts,
2303	    )?;
2304	    if repair.disabled {
2305	        return Err(dependency_source_conflict_error(
2306	            task,
2307	            &unresolved_conflicts,
2308	            &format!(
2309	                "automatic repair disabled; inspect {}",
2310	                context.proof_dir.join("conflicts.json").display()
2311	            ),
2312	        ));
2313	    }
2314	    append_plan_event(
2315	        paths,
2316	        &plan.plan_id,
2317	        PlanEventKind::MergeConflict {
2318	            conflict_count: unresolved_conflicts.len(),
2319	        },
2320	    )?;
2321	    append_plan_event(
2322	        paths,
2323	        &plan.plan_id,
2324	        PlanEventKind::MergeRepairPlanned {
2325	            conflict_count: unresolved_conflicts.len(),
2326	            provider: provider.clone(),
2327	        },
2328	    )?;
2329	    let Some(provider) = provider else {
2330	        let reason = format!(
2331	            "dependency merge repair for {} needs a configured provider",
2332	            task.task_id
2333	        );
2334	        append_plan_event(
2335	            paths,
2336	            &plan.plan_id,
2337	            PlanEventKind::MergeRepairFailed {
2338	                reason: reason.clone(),
2339	            },
2340	        )?;
2341	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2342	            &format!("{reason}; conflicts remain"),
2343	            "deadreckon providers list --all",
2344	        )));
2345	    };
2346	    append_plan_event(
2347	        paths,
2348	        &plan.plan_id,
2349	        PlanEventKind::MergeRepairStarted {
2350	            mode: MergeRepairMode::Auto.as_str().to_string(),
2351	        },
2352	    )?;
2353	    match run_merge_repair(
2354	        paths,
2355	        plan,
2356	        &context,
2357	        &MergeRepairOptions {
2358	            provider: &provider,
2359	            mode: MergeRepairMode::Auto,
2360	            attempts: 1,
2361	            quiet: repair.quiet,
2362	        },
2363	        &mut merge,
2364	    )
2365	    .await
2366	    {
2367	        Ok(repaired) => {
2368	            append_plan_event(
2369	                paths,
2370	                &plan.plan_id,
2371	                PlanEventKind::MergeRepaired {
2372	                    strategy: format!("dependency-{}", repaired.strategy),
2373	                    repair_run_id: repaired.repair_run_id,
2374	                },
2375	            )?;
2376	            write_plan_merge_conflicts_to(
2377	                &context.proof_dir,
2378	                plan,
2379	                "dependency-compose",
2380	                &merge.conflicts,
2381	            )?;
2382	            Ok(())
2383	        }
2384	        Err(error) => {
2385	            let reason = error.to_string();
2386	            append_plan_event(
2387	                paths,
2388	                &plan.plan_id,
2389	                PlanEventKind::MergeRepairFailed { reason },
2390	            )?;
2391	            Err(error)
2392	        }
2393	    }
2394	}

2405	        .join(", ");

2415	pub(crate) fn plan_task_depends_on(plan: &Plan, task_id: &str, dependency_id: &str) -> bool {
2416	    let mut stack = vec![task_id.to_string()];
2417	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
2418	    while let Some(next) = stack.pop() {
2419	        if !seen.insert(next.clone()) {
2420	            continue;
2421	        }
2422	        let Some(task) = plan.task_by_id(&next) else {
2423	            continue;
2424	        };
2425	        if task
2426	            .depends_on
2427	            .iter()
2428	            .any(|dependency| dependency == dependency_id)
2429	        {
2430	            return true;
2431	        }
2432	        stack.extend(task.depends_on.iter().cloned());
2433	    }
2434	    false
2435	}

2437	struct PlanChildLaunch<'a> {
2438	    paths: &'a DeadreckonPaths,
2439	    plan: &'a Plan,
2440	    task_index: usize,
2441	    source_dir: &'a Path,
2442	    sandbox: &'a str,
2443	    max_spend: Option<f64>,
2444	    max_wall_seconds: Option<f64>,
2445	    quiet: bool,
2446	    plain: bool,
2447	    forward_output: bool,
2448	    signal_sender: Option<std::sync::mpsc::Sender<PlanChildSignal>>,
2449	}
2450	
2451	fn run_plan_child(launch: PlanChildLaunch<'_>) -> Result<String> {
2452	    let PlanChildLaunch {
2453	        paths,
2454	        plan,
2455	        task_index,
2456	        source_dir,
2457	        sandbox,
2458	        max_spend,
2459	        max_wall_seconds,
2460	        quiet,
2461	        plain,
2462	        forward_output,
2463	        signal_sender,
2464	    } = launch;
2465	    let task = &plan.tasks[task_index];
2466	    let worker_spec_path = paths.worker_spec(&plan.plan_id, &task.task_id);
2467	    let worker_spec = render_launch_worker_spec(paths, plan, task);
2468	    write_worker_spec(paths, &plan.plan_id, &task.task_id, &worker_spec)?;
2469	    let prompt = plan_child_prompt(plan, task, &worker_spec, &worker_spec_path);
2470	    let launch_dir = paths
2471	        .plan_dir(&plan.plan_id)
2472	        .join("launch")
2473	        .join(&task.task_id);
2474	    fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir)?;
2475	
2476	    let mut command = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe()?);
2477	    command
2478	        .current_dir(source_dir)
2479	        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", paths.home())
2480	        .env("DEADRECKON_HINTS", "0")
2481	        .env("DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT", &launch_dir);
2482	    let review_parent_run_id = review_parent_run_id(plan, task);
2483	    if let Some(parent_run_id) = review_parent_run_id.as_deref() {
2484	        command
2485	            .arg("extend")
2486	            .arg(parent_run_id)
2487	            .arg(prompt)
2488	            .arg("--no-docs");
2489	    } else {
2490	        command
2491	            .arg("run")
2492	            .arg(prompt)
2493	            .arg("--from")
2494	            .arg(source_dir)
2495	            .arg("--yes")
2496	            .arg("--no-confirm")
2497	            .arg("--no-hints")
2498	            .arg("--no-docs");
2499	        if plain {
2500	            command.arg("--plain");
2501	        }
2502	        if let Some(acceptance_path) = plan.acceptance_path.as_deref() {
2503	            command.arg("--acceptance").arg(acceptance_path);
2504	        }
2505	    }
2506	    command.arg("--sandbox").arg(sandbox);
2507	    if let Some(max_spend) = max_spend {
2508	        command.arg("--max-spend").arg(format!("{max_spend:.6}"));
2509	    }
2510	    if let Some(max_wall_seconds) = max_wall_seconds {
2511	        command
2512	            .arg("--max-wall-seconds")
2513	            .arg(max_wall_seconds.to_string());
2514	    }
2515	    if task
2516	        .provider
2517	        .as_deref()
2518	        .is_some_and(|provider| provider == "smoke" || provider.starts_with("smoke:"))
2519	    {
2520	        if review_parent_run_id.is_some() {
2521	            command.arg("--provider").arg("smoke");
2522	        } else {
2523	            command.arg("--smoke");
2524	        }
2525	    } else if let Some(provider) = task.provider.as_deref() {
2526	        command.arg("--provider").arg(provider);
2527	    }
2528	    command
2529	        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
2530	        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped());
2531	    let mut child = command.spawn()?;
2532	    if let Some(sender) = signal_sender.as_ref() {
2533	        let _ = sender.send(PlanChildSignal::Pid {
2534	            task_index,
2535	            pid: child.id(),
2536	        });
2537	    } else {
2538	        write_coordinator_snapshot(paths, plan, Some((task_index, child.id())))?;
2539	    }
2540	    let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or_else(|| {
2541	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
2542	            "failed to capture child stdout".to_string(),
2543	        ))
2544	    })?;
2545	    let stderr = child.stderr.take().ok_or_else(|| {
2546	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
2547	            "failed to capture child stderr".to_string(),
2548	        ))
2549	    })?;
2550	    let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<(bool, String)>();
2551	    let stdout_thread = commands::chain::spawn_chain_step_reader(stdout, true, tx.clone());
2552	    let stderr_thread = commands::chain::spawn_chain_step_reader(stderr, false, tx);
2553	    let mut stdout_text = String::new();
2554	    let mut stderr_text = String::new();
2555	    let mut live_run_id = None;
2556	    let suppress_child_output = quiet || !forward_output;
2557	    let status = loop {
2558	        while let Ok((is_stdout, line)) = rx.try_recv() {
2559	            if let Some(run_id) = commands::chain::capture_chain_step_output(
2560	                is_stdout,
2561	                &line,
2562	                &mut stdout_text,
2563	                &mut stderr_text,
2564	                suppress_child_output,
2565	            )? {
2566	                note_plan_child_run_id(
2567	                    &launch_dir,
2568	                    signal_sender.as_ref(),
2569	                    task_index,
2570	                    &mut live_run_id,
2571	                    run_id,
2572	                );
2573	            }
2574	        }
2575	        if let Some(status) = child.try_wait()? {
2576	            break status;
2577	        }
2578	        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
2579	    };
2580	    let _ = stdout_thread.join();
2581	    let _ = stderr_thread.join();
2582	    while let Ok((is_stdout, line)) = rx.try_recv() {
2583	        if let Some(run_id) = commands::chain::capture_chain_step_output(
2584	            is_stdout,
2585	            &line,
2586	            &mut stdout_text,
2587	            &mut stderr_text,
2588	            suppress_child_output,
2589	        )? {
2590	            note_plan_child_run_id(
2591	                &launch_dir,
2592	                signal_sender.as_ref(),
2593	                task_index,
2594	                &mut live_run_id,
2595	                run_id,
2596	            );
2597	        }
2598	    }
2599	    let run_id = live_run_id.or_else(|| commands::chain::parse_started_run_id(&stdout_text));
2600	    if let Some(run_id) = run_id.as_ref() {
2601	        let _ = fs::write(launch_dir.join("run-id"), run_id);
2602	        if let Some(sender) = signal_sender.as_ref() {
2603	            let _ = sender.send(PlanChildSignal::RunId {
2604	                task_index,
2605	                run_id: run_id.clone(),
2606	            });
2607	        }
2608	    }
2609	    if !status.success() {
2610	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
2611	            "child {} failed: {}{}",
2612	            task.task_id, stdout_text, stderr_text
2613	        ))));
2614	    }
2615	    run_id.ok_or_else(|| {
2616	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2617	            &format!("could not find run id for child {}", task.task_id),
2618	            "deadreckon list",
2619	        ))
2620	    })
2621	}
2622	
2623	fn note_plan_child_run_id(
2624	    launch_dir: &Path,
2625	    sender: Option<&std::sync::mpsc::Sender<PlanChildSignal>>,
2626	    task_index: usize,
2627	    live_run_id: &mut Option<String>,
2628	    run_id: String,
2629	) {
2630	    if live_run_id.as_deref() == Some(run_id.as_str()) {
2631	        return;
2632	    }
2633	    let _ = fs::write(launch_dir.join("run-id"), &run_id);
2634	    if let Some(sender) = sender {
2635	        let _ = sender.send(PlanChildSignal::RunId {
2636	            task_index,
2637	            run_id: run_id.clone(),
2638	        });
2639	    }
2640	    *live_run_id = Some(run_id);
2641	}

2643	fn review_parent_run_id(plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> Option<String> {
2644	    if task.role != PlanRole::Reviewer {
2645	        return None;
2646	    }
2647	    task.depends_on
2648	        .first()
2649	        .and_then(|dependency| plan.task_by_id(dependency))
2650	        .and_then(|parent_task| parent_task.child_run_id.clone())
2651	}

2653	fn plan_child_prompt(plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask, spec: &str, spec_path: &Path) -> String {

2655	        PlanRole::Reviewer => {

2657	        }

2660	    };

2665	        task.task_id,

2667	        spec

2680	fn summarize_child_run(

2740	fn mark_blocked_pending_tasks(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &mut Plan) -> Result<()> {
2741	    let completed = plan
2742	        .tasks
2743	        .iter()
2744	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
2745	        .map(|task| task.task_id.clone())
2746	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
2747	    let blockers = plan
2748	        .tasks
2749	        .iter()
2750	        .filter(|task| task.status != PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
2751	        .map(|task| task.task_id.clone())
2752	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
2753	    let pending = plan
2754	        .tasks
2755	        .iter()
2756	        .enumerate()
2757	        .filter(|(_, task)| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Pending)
2758	        .map(|(index, _)| index)
2759	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2760	    for index in pending {
2761	        let missing = plan.tasks[index]
2762	            .depends_on
2763	            .iter()
2764	            .filter(|dependency| !completed.contains(*dependency))
2765	            .cloned()
2766	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2767	        let blocked_by = missing
2768	            .iter()
2769	            .filter(|dependency| blockers.contains(*dependency))
2770	            .cloned()
2771	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2772	        let task_id = plan.tasks[index].task_id.clone();
2773	        plan.tasks[index].status = PlanTaskStatus::Failed;
2774	        append_plan_event(
2775	            paths,
2776	            &plan.plan_id,
2777	            PlanEventKind::TaskBlocked {
2778	                task_id: task_id.clone(),
2779	                task_index: index,
2780	                reason: format!(
2781	                    "missing dependencies: {}",
2782	                    if missing.is_empty() {
2783	                        "unknown".to_string()
2784	                    } else {
2785	                        missing.join(", ")
2786	                    }
2787	                ),
2788	            },
2789	        )?;
2790	        append_plan_message(
2791	            paths,
2792	            &plan.plan_id,
2793	            &PlanMessage::new(
2794	                "coordinator",
2795	                &task_id,
2796	                PlanMessageKind::Blocker,
2797	                format!("{task_id} blocked"),
2798	                json!({ "missing_dependencies": missing, "blocked_by": blocked_by }),
2799	            )?,
2800	        )?;
2801	    }
2802	    Ok(())
2803	}

2805	fn mark_failed_fork_plan_terminal(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &mut Plan) -> Result<()> {
2806	    let all_terminal = plan.tasks.iter().all(|task| {
2807	        !matches!(
2808	            task.status,
2809	            PlanTaskStatus::Pending | PlanTaskStatus::Running
2810	        )
2811	    });
2812	    let has_failure = plan
2813	        .tasks
2814	        .iter()
2815	        .any(|task| matches!(task.status, PlanTaskStatus::Failed | PlanTaskStatus::Killed));
2816	    if all_terminal && has_failure && plan.status != PlanStatus::Failed {
2817	        plan.status = PlanStatus::Failed;
2818	        append_plan_event(
2819	            paths,
2820	            &plan.plan_id,
2821	            PlanEventKind::PlanFailed {
2822	                reason: "one or more child tasks failed or were blocked".to_string(),
2823	            },
2824	        )?;
2825	    }

2025	                    decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Worktree;
2026	                    decision.source_mode_label = format!("worktree from {}", source_path.display());
2027	                    decision.source_worktree = flags.worktree;
2028	                    decision.source_allow_dirty = request.allow_dirty;
2029	                }
2030	                Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message))
2031	                    if message.contains("working tree has uncommitted changes") =>
2032	                {
2033	                    if let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut() {
2034	                        match prompt_start_dirty_worktree(&mut **prompter)? {
2035	                            StartDirtyGitChoice::AllowDirty => {
2036	                                if !matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::Run) {
2037	                                    set_start_recovery(
2038	                                        decision,
2039	                                        "allow-dirty source mode is only supported by start --mode run",
2040	                                        vec![format!(
2041	                                            "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode run --allow-dirty",
2042	                                            shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2043	                                        )],
2044	                                    );
2045	                                    return Ok(());
2046	                                }
2047	                                prepare_worktree_record(
2048	                                    paths,
2049	                                    WorktreeOptions {
2050	                                        run_id: Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string(),
2051	                                        task_key: deadreckon_core::paths::task_key(&decision.goal),
2052	                                        source_path: source_path.clone(),
2053	                                        base_ref: None,
2054	                                        branch_name: None,
2055	                                        allow_dirty: true,
2056	                                    },
2057	                                )?;
2058	                                decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Worktree;
2059	                                decision.source_mode_label = format!(
2060	                                    "worktree from {} with dirty files",
2061	                                    source_path.display()
2062	                                );
2063	                                decision.source_worktree = flags.worktree;
2064	                                decision.source_allow_dirty = true;
2065	                            }
2066	                            StartDirtyGitChoice::Cancel => set_start_recovery(
2067	                                decision,
2068	                                "guided start cancelled before choosing dirty-worktree handling",
2069	                                vec![format!(
2070	                                    "deadreckon start \"{}\"",
2071	                                    shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2072	                                )],
2073	                            ),
2074	                            StartDirtyGitChoice::Stop => set_start_recovery(
2075	                                decision,
2076	                                message.lines().next().unwrap_or("working tree is dirty"),
2077	                                vec![
2078	                                    format!(
2079	                                        "git stash && deadreckon start \"{}\"",
2080	                                        shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2081	                                    ),
2082	                                    format!(
2083	                                        "deadreckon start \"{}\" --allow-dirty",
2084	                                        shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2085	                                    ),
2086	                                ],
2087	                            ),
2088	                        }
2089	                    } else {
2090	                        decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Worktree;
2091	                        decision.source_mode_label = "dirty worktree".to_string();
2092	                        set_start_recovery(
2093	                            decision,
2094	                            message.lines().next().unwrap_or("working tree is dirty"),
2095	                            vec![
2096	                                format!(
2097	                                    "git stash && deadreckon start \"{}\"",
2098	                                    shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2099	                                ),
2100	                                format!(
2101	                                    "deadreckon start \"{}\" --allow-dirty",
2102	                                    shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
2103	                                ),
2104	                            ],
2105	                        );
2106	                    }
2107	                }
2108	                Err(err) => return Err(CliError::Core(err)),
2109	            }
2110	        }
2111	        ResolvedMode::Copy { source_path } => {
2112	            decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Copy;
2113	            decision.source_mode_label = format!("copy from {}", source_path.display());
2114	            decision.source_from = Some(source_path);
2115	        }
2116	        ResolvedMode::Fresh => {
2117	            decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Fresh;
2118	            decision.source_mode_label = "fresh".to_string();
2119	            decision.source_fresh = true;
2120	        }
2121	        ResolvedMode::InPlace { source_path } => {
2122	            decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::Copy;
2123	            decision.source_mode_label = format!("in-place from {}", source_path.display());
2124	            decision.source_from = Some(source_path);
2125	        }
2126	    }
2127	    Ok(())
2128	}

2247	fn start_preview_primary_action(decision: &StartLaunchDecision) -> String {

2250	            .try_lines
2251	            .first()

2293	fn start_preview_surface(
2294	    decision: &StartLaunchDecision,
2295	    args: &StartCommandArgs,
2296	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2297	) -> Result<VerdictSurface> {
2298	    let rows = start_launch_preview_rows(decision, args, paths)?;
2299	    let mut evidence = rows
2300	        .into_iter()
2301	        .filter(|(key, _)| !matches!(key.as_str(), "watch" | "stop" | "finish"))
2302	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2303	    evidence.push(("will start".to_string(), "false".to_string()));
2304	    let primary = start_preview_primary_action(decision);
2305	    let secondary = start_preview_secondary_actions(decision);
2306	    let (kind, what, why) = if let Some(recovery) = decision.recovery.as_ref() {
2307	        (
2308	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2309	            recovery.message.clone(),
2310	            "The selected path cannot start until the recommended recovery command resolves the missing setup.".to_string(),
2311	        )
2312	    } else {
2313	        (
2314	            VerdictKind::Preview,
2315	            "DeadReckon classified the goal and is ready to launch, but no run, plan, or campaign id exists yet.".to_string(),
2316	            "This is a preview; post-launch commands become real only after the launch creates an id.".to_string(),
2317	        )
2318	    };
2319	    let secondary_label = if decision.recovery.is_some() {
2320	        "Secondary"
2321	    } else {
2322	        "After start"
2323	    };
2324	    let secondary = secondary
2325	        .iter()
2326	        .map(|command| (secondary_label, command.as_str()))
2327	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2328	    Ok(VerdictSurface::try_new(
2329	        kind,
2330	        "start",
2331	        None,
2332	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
2333	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
2334	        secondary,
2335	    )
2336	    .expect("start preview verdict surface must be valid"))
2337	}

2352	#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
2353	pub(crate) enum StartGoalPlan {
2354	    Provided(String),
2355	    Prompt,
2356	    Notice(String),
2357	}
2358	
2359	/// Decide how to obtain the start goal: use a provided non-empty goal, prompt
2360	/// interactively when prompts are allowed (a TTY without --yes/--json/--plain/
2361	/// --quiet), or emit a notice when prompts are suppressed.
2362	pub(crate) fn start_goal_plan(provided: Option<&str>, allows_prompts: bool) -> StartGoalPlan {
2363	    match provided.map(str::trim) {
2364	        Some(goal) if !goal.is_empty() => StartGoalPlan::Provided(goal.to_string()),
2365	        _ if allows_prompts => StartGoalPlan::Prompt,
2366	        _ => StartGoalPlan::Notice(
2367	            "no goal given and prompts are off; pass a goal: deadreckon start \"<goal>\""
2368	                .to_string(),
2369	        ),
2370	    }
2371	}
2372	
2373	/// Resolve the start goal, prompting interactively for it when none was given and
2374	/// prompts are allowed. Returns a friendly error (after a one-line notice) when
2375	/// no goal is available and prompts are suppressed.
2376	pub(crate) fn resolve_start_goal(provided: Option<String>, allows_prompts: bool) -> Result<String> {
2377	    match start_goal_plan(provided.as_deref(), allows_prompts) {
2378	        StartGoalPlan::Provided(goal) => Ok(goal),
2379	        StartGoalPlan::Prompt => {
2380	            let entered = crate::prompt::open("goal: ", None)?;
2381	            let goal = entered.trim().to_string();
2382	            if goal.is_empty() {
2383	                return Err(start_goal_required_error());
2384	            }
2385	            Ok(goal)
2386	        }
2387	        StartGoalPlan::Notice(message) => {
2388	            let _ = ui::writeln(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Note, &message);
2389	            Err(start_goal_required_error())
2390	        }
2391	    }
2392	}
2393	
2394	fn start_goal_required_error() -> CliError {
2395	    CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2396	        "start goal required",
2397	        "deadreckon start \"<goal>\"",
2398	    ))
2399	}

2401	pub(crate) async fn start_command(args: StartCommandArgs) -> Result<()> {
2402	    let stdin_is_tty = io::stdin().is_terminal();
2403	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
2404	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
2405	    let latest_extendable_run = start_latest_extendable_run(&paths, &cwd)?;
2406	    let mut decision = start_launch_decision(StartLaunchInput {
2407	        goal: &args.goal,
2408	        requested_mode: args.mode,
2409	        stdin_is_tty,
2410	    });
2411	    add_start_history_actions(&mut decision, latest_extendable_run.as_ref());
2412	    let eligibility = StartPromptEligibility::from_args(&args, stdin_is_tty);
2413	    if start_goal_shape_should_classify(&args, eligibility) {
2414	        let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
2415	        let provider = start_goal_shape_provider_route(&paths, &defaults, &args);
2416	        let recommendation = classify_goal_shape_for_start(
2417	            &paths,
2418	            &cwd,
2419	            &args.goal,
2420	            provider.as_deref(),
2421	            args.plain,
2422	        )
2423	        .await;
2424	        let scope = workspace_scope(&cwd)?;
2425	        write_goal_shape_preview_record(&paths, &scope, &recommendation)?;
2426	        apply_goal_shape_recommendation(&mut decision, recommendation);
2427	    }
2428	    let mut terminal_prompter = TerminalStartPrompter;
2429	    if eligibility.allows_prompts() {
2430	        maybe_prompt_start_mode(
2431	            &mut decision,
2432	            &args,
2433	            latest_extendable_run.as_ref(),
2434	            &mut terminal_prompter,
2435	        )?;
2436	        if decision.recovery.is_none() {
2437	            resolve_start_setup(
2438	                &mut decision,
2439	                &args,
2440	                Some(&mut terminal_prompter),
2441	                stdin_is_tty,
2442	            )?;
2443	        }
2444	    } else if decision.recovery.is_none() {
2445	        resolve_start_setup(&mut decision, &args, None, stdin_is_tty)?;
2446	    }
2447	    if args.json {
2448	        let surface = start_preview_surface(&decision, &args, &paths)?;
2449	        let mut next_actions = vec![surface.primary_action.command.clone()];
2450	        next_actions.extend(start_preview_secondary_actions(&decision));
2451	        if decision.recovery.is_none()
2452	            && !matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::Extend)
2453	        {
2454	            for action in &decision.history_next_actions {
2455	                if !next_actions.iter().any(|existing| existing == action) {
2456	                    next_actions.push(action.clone());
2457	                }
2458	            }
2459	        }
2460	        let payload = surface.add_to_json(json!({
2461	            "kind": "start",
2462	            "goal": decision.goal,
2463	            "selected_mode": decision.selected_mode.label(),
2464	            "selection_source": decision.selection_source.label(),
2465	            "reason": decision.reason,
2466	            "provider": decision.provider_label,
2467	            "provider_source": decision.provider_source.label(),
2468	            "done_criteria": decision.done_criteria_label,
2469	            "done_criteria_source": decision.done_criteria_source.label(),
2470	            "source_mode": decision.source_mode.label(),
2471	            "goal_shape": &decision.goal_shape,
2472	            "requires_confirmation": decision.requires_confirmation,
2473	            "will_start": false,
2474	            "history_actions": decision.history_next_actions,
2475	            "next_actions": next_actions,
2476	            "try_lines": decision.try_lines
2477	        }));
2478	        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)?);
2479	        return Ok(());
2480	    }
2481	    if args.preview {
2482	        if !args.quiet {
2483	            print_start_preview_surface(&decision, &args, &paths)?;
2484	        }
2485	        return Ok(());
2486	    }
2487	    if decision.recovery.is_none() && eligibility.allows_prompts() {
2488	        prompt_start_launch_confirmation(&mut decision, &args, &paths, &mut terminal_prompter)?;
2489	    }
2490	    if !args.quiet && decision.recovery.is_none() {
2491	        println!("{}", ui_heading("guided start"));
2492	        let seam_label =
2493	            seam_preview_label(&read_seams_config(&paths.config_path(), args.no_seams)?);
2494	        let mode = decision.selected_mode.label();
2495	        let suggestion = decision.goal_shape.as_ref().map(|recommendation| {
2496	            format!(
2497	                "{} via {}: {}",
2498	                recommendation.shape.label(),
2499	                recommendation.source.label(),
2500	                recommendation.rationale
2501	            )
2502	        });
2503	        let mut rows: Vec<(&str, &str)> = vec![
2504	            ("goal", decision.goal.as_str()),
2505	            ("mode", mode),
2506	            ("selection", decision.selection_source.label()),
2507	            ("reason", decision.reason.as_str()),
2508	        ];
2509	        if let Some(suggestion) = suggestion.as_ref() {
2510	            rows.push(("suggestion", suggestion.as_str()));
2511	        }
2512	        rows.extend([
2513	            ("provider", decision.provider_label.as_str()),
2514	            ("done", decision.done_criteria_label.as_str()),
2515	            ("workspace", decision.source_mode_label.as_str()),
2516	            ("seams", seam_label.as_str()),
2517	            (
2518	                "confirmation",
2519	                if decision.requires_confirmation {
2520	                    "required"
2521	                } else {
2522	                    "not required"
2523	                },
2524	            ),
2525	            ("preview", if args.preview { "yes" } else { "no" }),
2526	            (
2527	                "confirmed",
2528	                if args.yes || decision.confirmed_by_start_picker {
2529	                    "yes"
2530	                } else {
2531	                    "no"
2532	                },
2533	            ),
2534	            ("plain", if args.plain { "yes" } else { "no" }),
2535	        ]);
2536	        print_kv_block(&rows);
2537	    }
2538	    if decision.recovery.is_some() {
2539	        let surface = start_preview_surface(&decision, &args, &paths)?
2540	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false));
2541	        return Err(CliError::Surface { code: 1, surface });
2542	    }
2543	    materialize_start_done_criteria(&mut decision).await?;
2544	    dispatch_start_command(args, &decision).await
2545	}

2547	async fn dispatch_start_command(
2548	    args: StartCommandArgs,
2549	    decision: &StartLaunchDecision,
2550	) -> Result<()> {
2551	    match decision.selected_mode {
2552	        StartSelectedMode::Run => {
2553	            let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
2554	            let before = start_run_ids(&paths)?;
2555	            let goal = args.goal.clone();
2556	            let quiet = args.quiet;
2557	            let auto_confirm = args.yes || args.quiet || decision.confirmed_by_start_picker;
2558	            let result = commands::run::run_command(RunCommandArgs {
2559	                goal: args.goal,
2560	                fresh: args.fresh || decision.source_fresh,
2561	                worktree: args.worktree || decision.source_worktree,
2562	                from: args.from.or_else(|| decision.source_from.clone()),
2563	                in_place: false,
2564	                base: None,
2565	                branch: None,
2566	                allow_dirty: args.allow_dirty || decision.source_allow_dirty,
2567	                init_git: decision.source_init_git,
2568	                yes: auto_confirm,
2569	                preview: false,
2570	                brief: false,
2571	                no_seams: args.no_seams,
2572	                plain: args.plain,
2573	                prevent_sleep: None,
2574	                quiet: args.quiet,
2575	                max_spend: None,
2576	                max_wall_seconds: None,
2577	                sandbox: None,
2578	                provider: decision.provider_route.clone(),
2579	                model: None,
2580	                doc_provider: None,
2581	                acceptance: None,
2582	                skill: "deadreckon".to_string(),
2583	                smoke: false,
2584	                i_know_its_a_lot: false,
2585	                no_confirm: auto_confirm
2586	                    || matches!(decision.done_action, StartDoneAction::DefaultGate),
2587	                no_hints: args.quiet,
2588	                no_docs: false,
2589	                doc_skill: None,
2590	            })
2591	            .await;
2592	            if result.is_ok()
2593	                && !quiet
2594	                && let Some(run) = newest_start_run(&paths, &before, &goal)?
2595	            {
2596	                print_start_lifecycle_footer("run", &run.run_id);
2597	            }
2598	            result

2815	fn newest_start_run(

2819	) -> Result<Option<RunListEntry>> {

1947	fn opencode_related_paths(session_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {
1948	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(session_path)?;
1949	    let session = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw)?;
1950	    let Some(session_id) = session.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
1951	        return Ok(vec![session_path.to_path_buf()]);
1952	    };
1953	    let root = session_path
1954	        .ancestors()
1955	        .nth(4)
1956	        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
1957	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
1958	            session_path
1959	                .parent()
1960	                .map(Path::to_path_buf)
1961	                .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
1962	        });
1963	    let mut paths = BTreeSet::new();
1964	    paths.insert(session_path.to_path_buf());
1965	    for (message_path, message, _) in
1966	        read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/message").join(session_id))
1967	    {
1968	        let message_id = message
1969	            .get("id")
1970	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
1971	            .map(ToString::to_string);
1972	        paths.insert(message_path);
1973	        if let Some(message_id) = message_id {
1974	            for (part_path, _, _) in
1975	                read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/part").join(message_id))
1976	            {
1977	                paths.insert(part_path);
1978	            }
1979	        }
1980	    }
1981	    Ok(paths.into_iter().collect())
1982	}

1984	fn sha256_for_paths(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<String> {
1985	    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
1986	    for path in paths {
1987	        hasher.update(fs::read(path)?);
1988	        hasher.update([0xff]);
1989	    }
1990	    Ok(format!(
1991	        "sha256:{}",
1992	        hex_digest(hasher.finalize().as_slice())
1993	    ))
1994	}
1995	
1996	fn sha256_for_str(raw: &str) -> String {
1997	    let digest = Sha256::digest(raw.as_bytes());
1998	    format!("sha256:{}", hex_digest(digest.as_slice()))
1999	}
2000	
2001	fn hex_digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
2002	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
2003	    for byte in bytes {
2004	        out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
2005	    }
2006	    out
2007	}
