```text
2104	fn provider_import_session_id(resolved: &ResolvedImportSource, path: &Path) -> Option<String> {
2105	    let raw_id = match resolved.storage {
2106	        IngestStorage::OpenCodeStorage | IngestStorage::Json => fs::read_to_string(path)
2107	            .ok()
2108	            .and_then(|raw| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw).ok())
2109	            .and_then(|value| session_id_from_value(&resolved.schema, &value)),
2110	        IngestStorage::Jsonl | IngestStorage::JsonOrJsonl => {
2111	            if path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("json") {
2112	                fs::read_to_string(path)
2113	                    .ok()
2114	                    .and_then(|raw| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw).ok())
2115	                    .and_then(|value| session_id_from_value(&resolved.schema, &value))
2116	            } else {
2117	                jsonl_session_id(path, &resolved.schema)
2118	            }
2119	        }
2120	    }
2121	    .or_else(|| {
2122	        path.file_stem()
2123	            .and_then(|stem| stem.to_str())
2124	            .map(ToString::to_string)
2125	    })?;
2126	    let prefix = resolved.id_prefix.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
2127	    if prefix.is_empty() || raw_id.starts_with(prefix) {
2128	        Some(raw_id)
2129	    } else {
2130	        Some(format!("{prefix}{raw_id}"))
2131	    }
2132	}

2134	fn jsonl_session_id(path: &Path, schema: &str) -> Option<String> {
2135	    let file = fs::File::open(path).ok()?;
2136	    let reader = io::BufReader::new(file);
2137	    for line in reader.lines().map_while(std::result::Result::ok).take(80) {
2138	        let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&line).ok()?;
2139	        if let Some(id) = session_id_from_value(schema, &value) {
2140	            return Some(id);
2141	        }
2142	    }
2143	    None
2144	}

2146	fn session_id_from_value(schema: &str, value: &Value) -> Option<String> {
2147	    for pointer in [
2148	        "/session_id",
2149	        "/sessionId",
2150	        "/conversation_id",
2151	        "/conversationId",
2152	        "/id",
2153	        "/payload/session_id",
2154	        "/payload/sessionId",
2155	        "/payload/id",
2156	        "/data/session_id",
2157	        "/data/sessionId",
2158	        "/data/conversationId",
2159	        "/message/session_id",
2160	    ] {
2161	        if let Some(id) = value.pointer(pointer).and_then(Value::as_str)
2162	            && !id.trim().is_empty()
2163	        {
2164	            return Some(id.to_string());
2165	        }
2166	    }
2167	    if schema == "codex-cli"
2168	        && value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("session_meta")
2169	        && let Some(cwd) = value.pointer("/payload/cwd").and_then(Value::as_str)
2170	    {
2171	        return Some(format!("cwd-{:016x}", stable_hash(cwd)));
2172	    }
2173	    None
2174	}

2214	fn import_candidate_matches(candidate: &ImportCandidate, query: &str) -> bool {
2215	    let query = query.trim();
2216	    if query.is_empty() {
2217	        return false;
2218	    }
2219	    let query_path = Path::new(query);
2220	    let canonical_query = query_path.canonicalize().ok();
2221	    if candidate.id == query
2222	        || candidate.session_id.as_deref().is_some_and(|session_id| {
2223	            session_id == query || strip_import_id_prefix(session_id) == query
2224	        })
2225	        || strip_import_id_prefix(&candidate.id) == query
2226	    {
2227	        return true;
2228	    }
2229	    candidate.paths.iter().any(|path| {
2230	        path.display().to_string() == query
2231	            || path.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()) == Some(query)
2232	            || path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()) == Some(query)
2233	            || canonical_query
2234	                .as_ref()
2235	                .is_some_and(|canonical| path.canonicalize().ok().as_ref() == Some(canonical))
2236	    })
2237	}

2239	fn strip_import_id_prefix(id: &str) -> &str {
2240	    id.split_once(':').map(|(_, rest)| rest).unwrap_or(id)
2241	}

2243	fn import_candidate_table(candidates: &[ImportCandidate]) -> String {
2244	    let mut out = String::new();
2245	    for candidate in candidates {
2246	        let rows = candidate
2247	            .row_count_hint
2248	            .map(|count| count.to_string())
2249	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
2250	        let cwd = candidate
2251	            .matched_cwd
2252	            .as_ref()
2253	            .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
2254	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
2255	        let first_path = candidate
2256	            .paths
2257	            .first()
2258	            .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
2259	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
2260	        out.push_str(&format!(
2261	            "  {}  updated={}  rows={}  cwd={}  path={}\n",
2262	            candidate.id,
2263	            candidate.updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
2264	            rows,
2265	            cwd,
2266	            first_path
2267	        ));
2268	    }

2283	fn read_json_entries_sorted(dir: &Path) -> Vec<(PathBuf, Value, String)> {
2284	    let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) else {
2285	        return Vec::new();
2286	    };
2287	    let mut values = entries
2288	        .flatten()
2289	        .filter_map(|entry| {
2290	            let path = entry.path();
2291	            if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) != Some("json") {
2292	                return None;
2293	            }
2294	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
2295	            let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw).ok()?;
2296	            Some((path, value, raw))
2297	        })
2298	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2299	    values.sort_by_key(|(_, value, _)| opencode_time_value(value));
2300	    values
2301	}

2312	fn source_time_bounds(
2313	    events: &[ImportedEvent],
2314	    fallback_updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
2315	) -> (Option<DateTime<Utc>>, Option<DateTime<Utc>>) {
2316	    let mut timestamps = events.iter().filter_map(|event| event.timestamp);
2317	    let Some(first) = timestamps.next() else {
2318	        return (None, Some(fallback_updated_at));
2319	    };
2320	    let mut min = first;
2321	    let mut max = first;
2322	    for timestamp in timestamps {
2323	        min = min.min(timestamp);
2324	        max = max.max(timestamp);
2325	    }
2326	    (Some(min), Some(max.max(fallback_updated_at)))
2327	}

2329	fn import_timestamp(value: &Value) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
2330	    for pointer in [
2331	        "/timestamp",
2332	        "/created_at",

2362	    None

2365	fn timestamp_from_value(value: &Value) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {

2401	fn gemini_usage(value: &Value) -> Option<ImportedUsage> {
2402	    let tokens = value.get("tokens")?;
2403	    let input = tokens.get("input").and_then(Value::as_u64);
2404	    let output = tokens.get("output").and_then(Value::as_u64);

2407	        return None;
2408	    }
2409	    Some(ImportedUsage {
2410	        input_tokens: input,
2411	        output_tokens: output,

2413	        context_window: Some(1_000_000),

2417	fn import_usage_from_value(value: &Value) -> Option<ImportedUsage> {
2418	    let input = number_field_any(
2419	        value,
2420	        &[
2421	            "inputTokens",
2422	            "input_tokens",
2423	            "input",
2424	            "prompt_tokens",
2425	            "promptTokens",
2426	        ],
2427	    );
2428	    let output = number_field_any(
2429	        value,
2430	        &[
2431	            "outputTokens",
2432	            "output_tokens",
2433	            "output",
2434	            "completion_tokens",
2435	            "completionTokens",
2436	        ],
2437	    );
2438	    let cache_read = number_field_any(
2439	        value,
2440	        &[
2441	            "cacheReadTokens",
2442	            "cache_read_tokens",
2443	            "cache_read_input_tokens",
2444	            "cacheRead",
2445	            "cache.read",
2446	        ],
2447	    )
2448	    .unwrap_or(0);
2449	    let cache_write = number_field_any(
2450	        value,
2451	        &[
2452	            "cacheCreationTokens",
2453	            "cacheWriteTokens",
2454	            "cache_creation_tokens",

2458	            "cacheWrite",
2459	            "cache.write",
2460	        ],
2461	    )
2462	    .unwrap_or(0);
2463	    let cache = (cache_read + cache_write > 0).then_some(cache_read + cache_write);
2464	    if input.is_none() && output.is_none() && cache.is_none() {
2465	        return None;
2466	    }
2467	    Some(ImportedUsage {

2469	        output_tokens: output,

2473	}

2565	fn collect_import_paths_inner(value: &Value, key: Option<&str>, paths: &mut BTreeSet<PathBuf>) {
2566	    match value {
2567	        Value::String(text) => {
2568	            if key.is_some_and(import_path_key) && looks_like_import_path(text) {
2569	                paths.insert(PathBuf::from(text));
```

1. **Fixed-width table *cells*** — the id/status columns inside `{:<N}` pads in the list/chain/providers tables.
```text
=== ui::wrap_words full body ===
pub(crate) fn wrap_words(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar;
    let width = width.max(1);
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut current = String::new();
    for word in text.split_whitespace() {
        if display_width(word) > width {
            if !current.is_empty() {
                lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
            }
            // Break a too-long word into width-sized chunks.
            let mut chunk = String::new();
            let mut chunk_width = 0usize;
            for ch in word.chars() {
                let ch_width = UnicodeWidthChar::width(ch).unwrap_or(0);
                if chunk_width + ch_width > width {
                    lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut chunk));
                    chunk_width = 0;
                }
                chunk.push(ch);
                chunk_width += ch_width;
            }
            current = chunk;
            continue;
        }
        let next = if current.is_empty() {
            display_width(word)
        } else {
            display_width(&current) + 1 + display_width(word)
        };
        if next <= width {
            if !current.is_empty() {
                current.push(' ');
            }
            current.push_str(word);
        } else {
            lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
            current.push_str(word);
        }
    }
    if !current.is_empty() || lines.is_empty() {
        lines.push(current);
    }
    lines
}
```

```text
+/// Color the leading status token of `value` (e.g. `PASSED` in `PASSED 1/1`,
+/// `completed` in `completed -> done`) by its status tone, leaving the rest
+/// plain. A value whose leading token is not a recognized status is returned
+/// unchanged. Safe for an unpadded (last-column / kv) value.
+#[allow(dead_code)]
+pub(crate) fn color_status_word(value: &str) -> String {
+    let mut parts = value.splitn(2, ' ');
+    let Some(first) = parts.next() else {
+        return value.to_string();
+    };
+    let tone = status_tone(first);
+    if tone == Tone::Plain {
+        return value.to_string();
+    }
+    match parts.next() {
+        Some(rest) => format!("{} {}", render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first), rest),
+        None => render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first),
+    }
+}
+
 pub(crate) fn render_status(stream: Stream, status: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
     let status = status.as_ref();
     render(stream, status_tone(status), status)
```

Done. The final piece is committed to local `main` (`c17cbef`), working tree clean, binary rebuilt.

## What shipped (final piece)

The last plain spots are now colorized — **golden-safe** (color only on a real TTY; piped output stays byte-identical; all padding measured by display-width so columns stay aligned under ANSI):

- **`list`** — status column color-coded (`pad_rendered`)
- **`chain` table** — id + status columns tinted (`pad_visible`)

## Verification

| Guard | Result |
|---|---|
| lib tests | **12 passed** |
| bin tests | **337 passed** |
| `cargo fmt --check` | clean |
| `cargo build --release --workspace --locked` | green (2m17s) |
| ANSI-leak scan (non-TTY) | **0 escapes** in all output |

## The 2 red characterization goldens — diagnosed, *not* my regression

I traced `plan_draft` and `attach_off_tty` to the bottom. They are **not** caused by the colorization (0 ANSI escapes in their output). They're a **pre-existing non-hermetic test**: the goldens bake in the length of the system temp dir.

- Here `TMPDIR=/tmp/claude-501` → temp path ~27 chars → plan.json path = 81 chars → fits → no wrap.
- The goldens were generated on stock macOS (`/var/folders/...` ~59 chars) → path 113 chars → wraps at width 104.

That length leaks into the asserted path **wrap point** (plan_draft), the TUI-frame **truncation** (`<HEX>...` vs full id, attach), and even the input **token count** (1628 vs 1603 — the prompt embeds the paths). All three stem from one root: temp-dir length. They were already red on `main` before this work, and they're part of the macOS-coupled suite CI doesn't run.

I also checked the workflow's earlier `plan.rs`/`attach.rs` color edits for the ANSI-padding bug — all land in plain `{}` slots, so they're TTY-safe too.

## Your call on next steps

1. **Push `main`** (`c17cbef` + the earlier colorization commits) to the remote — I've held off per the no-push-unless-asked rule.
2. **Make those 2 goldens hermetic** as a separate follow-up — the real fix is harness-level (normalize temp-dir length / token count / soft-wraps); regenerating alone would just move the failure to macOS. Happy to do it, but it's its own task, not colorization.

```text
179	            _ => format!("  {marker} [{ordinal}] {}", choice.label),
180	        };
181	        write_select_menu_line(&mut stdout, &truncate_menu_line(&line, width))?;
182	    }
```

```bash
The launch-path picker (deadreckon start) and other select prompts
```

<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Precise scan for plain print-macro calls

```bash
cd /Users/gdc/deadreckon
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, os, glob

HELPERS = ('ui::', 'ui_id', 'ui_status', 'ui_heading', 'ui_ok', 'ui_warn',
           'ui_command', 'render_status', 'color_status', 'pad_rendered',
           'pad_visible', 'render_plain', 'VerdictSurface', '\\x1b', 'ansi')
MACROS = ('println!', 'print!', 'eprintln!', 'eprint!')

def calls(text):
    # yield (start_line, snippet) for each balanced print-macro call
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(e?print(?:ln)?!)\s*\(', text):
        i = m.end()-1; depth=0
        while i < len(text):
            c = text[i]
            if c=='(' : depth+=1
            elif c==')':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0: break
            i+=1
        call = text[m.start():i+1]
        line = text.count('\n', 0, m.start())+1
        yield line, call

files = sorted(glob.glob('crates/deadreckon/src/commands/**/*.rs', recursive=True))
files += ['crates/deadreckon/src/commands/chain/mod.rs']
files = sorted(set(files))

for f in files:
    text = open(f).read()
    plains=[]
    for line, call in calls(text):
        if any(h in call for h in HELPERS):      # routed through a color helper
            continue
        if 'json!' in call or 'serde' in call or 'to_string_pretty' in call:
            continue
        # must contain a quoted string with at least one letter (literal user text)
        if not re.search(r'"[^"]*[A-Za-z][^"]*"', call):
            continue
        # skip pure machine/debug markers
        snippet = ' '.join(call.split())[:90]
        plains.append((line, snippet))
    if plains:
        print(f"\n### {f}  ({len(plains)} plain)")
        for line, s in plains[:8]:
            print(f"  {line}: {s}")
        if len(plains) > 8:
            print(f"  ... +{len(plains)-8} more")
PY
```

GOLDEN-SAFE COLORIZATION INVARIANTS — follow EXACTLY:

Color is applied ONLY through existing helpers, every one of which is gated on a TTY
(crate::ui::enabled). In non-TTY/piped output they return PLAIN text, so byte-for-byte
output is unchanged — that is what keeps the golden tests green. NEVER hand-write ANSI.

Helpers (all in crate::ui::, already imported in command files as bare names):
- status words (pending/running/done/queued/passed/failed/blocked/killed/paused/
  completed/verified/cancelled/applied/etc): ui::color_status_word(&value) colors the
  LEADING status token of a string; render_status(ui::Stream::Stdout, label) or
  ui_status(label) color a whole status label.
- section headings: ui_heading("text")
- kv keys / labels (the "key:" part): ui_muted("label:")
- run/plan/chain ids, run-prefixes, SHAs, hashes: ui_id(text)
- command suggestions ("deadreckon ..."): ui_command(text)
- success word/glyph: ui_ok(text); warning: ui_warn(text)
- errors to stderr: ui::render(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Negative, text)

FIXED-WIDTH COLUMNS — the one true hazard:
- NEVER place colored text inside a {:<N} / {:>N} format pad. ANSI bytes count toward
  the pad width and shatter column alignment on a TTY.
- Instead drop the pad to {} and wrap with ui::pad_visible(colored_text, N), which pads
  by DISPLAY width (ANSI stripped). Right-aligned numeric {:>N} stays as-is (numbers
  are not colored).
- Reference implementations to mirror: commands/chain/mod.rs print_chain_table uses
  ui::pad_visible(&ui_id(&id), 9) and ui::pad_visible(&ui_status(label), 10);
  commands/inspection.rs append_list_row uses pad_rendered(value, WIDTH, Some(ui_status)).
  For table HEADER rows, color each header cell with ui_muted(...) wrapped in pad_visible.

DO NOT color (leave exactly plain):
- file paths and directories
- raw git output (diff --stat, git log passthrough)
- machine/JSON/tab-separated/porcelain/export/--plain formats
- a value that is a pre-built string already colored upstream, e.g. println!("{line}")
  where line was built with ui:: — verify the source before touching
- descriptive prose VALUES that follow a colored label (color the label only)

```text
191	            vec![

194	                ("state".to_string(), "no matching runstate entries".to_string()),
195	            ],
196	        ),
197	        vec![("Recommended", primary)],
198	        secondary,

200	    .expect("empty list verdict surface must be valid")

255	fn append_list_row(output: &mut String, row: &ListRow) {
256	    let first_prefix = format!(
257	        "{}  {}  {}  {}  {}  {}  {}  ",
258	        pad_rendered(&row.id, LIST_ID_WIDTH, Some(ui_id)),
259	        pad_rendered(&row.status, LIST_STATUS_WIDTH, Some(ui_status)),
260	        pad_plain(&row.age, LIST_AGE_WIDTH),
261	        pad_plain(&row.scope, LIST_SCOPE_WIDTH),
262	        pad_rendered(
263	            &row.kind,
264	            LIST_KIND_WIDTH,
265	            row.orchestration.then_some(ui_warn),
266	        ),
267	        pad_plain(&row.mode, LIST_MODE_WIDTH),
268	        pad_plain(&row.action, LIST_ACTION_WIDTH)
269	    );
270	    let continuation_prefix = " ".repeat(list_prefix_width());
271	    let goal_lines = wrap_list_goal(&row.goal, row.goal_width);
272	    for (index, line) in goal_lines.iter().enumerate() {
273	        if index == 0 {
274	            output.push_str(&first_prefix);
275	            output.push_str(line);
276	        } else {
277	            output.push_str(&continuation_prefix);
278	            output.push_str(line);
279	        }
280	        output.push('\n');
281	    }
282	}

284	fn list_prefix_width() -> usize {
285	    LIST_ID_WIDTH
286	        + LIST_STATUS_WIDTH
287	        + LIST_AGE_WIDTH
288	        + LIST_SCOPE_WIDTH
289	        + LIST_KIND_WIDTH
290	        + LIST_MODE_WIDTH
291	        + LIST_ACTION_WIDTH
292	        + 14

295	fn list_goal_width() -> usize {
296	    if !io::stdout().is_terminal() {
297	        return 72;
298	    }
299	    let terminal_width = crossterm::terminal::size()
300	        .map(|(width, _)| width as usize)
301	        .unwrap_or(180);
302	    terminal_width.saturating_sub(list_prefix_width()).max(24)
303	}
304	
305	fn pad_plain(value: &str, width: usize) -> String {
306	    let plain = truncate_text(value, width);
307	    let padding = width.saturating_sub(crate::ui::display_width(&plain));
308	    format!("{plain}{}", " ".repeat(padding))
309	}
310	
311	fn pad_rendered(value: &str, width: usize, render: Option<fn(String) -> String>) -> String {
312	    let plain = truncate_text(value, width);
313	    let padding = width.saturating_sub(crate::ui::display_width(&plain));
314	    let rendered = render.map_or_else(|| plain.clone(), |render| render(plain.clone()));
315	    format!("{rendered}{}", " ".repeat(padding))
316	}

318	fn wrap_list_goal(value: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
319	    let compact = compact_whitespace(value);
320	    if compact.is_empty() {
321	        return vec![String::new()];
322	    }
323	    let mut lines = wrap_words(&compact, width.max(8));
324	    let truncated = lines.len() > LIST_GOAL_MAX_LINES;
325	    if truncated {
326	        lines.truncate(LIST_GOAL_MAX_LINES);
327	        if let Some(last) = lines.last_mut() {
328	            *last = ellipsize_goal_line(last, width);
329	        }
330	    }
331	    lines
332	}
333	
334	fn ellipsize_goal_line(value: &str, width: usize) -> String {
335	    if width <= 3 {
336	        return ".".repeat(width);
337	    }
338	    let prefix = width - 3;
339	    format!("{}...", value.chars().take(prefix).collect::<String>())
340	}

342	fn wrap_words(value: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
343	    crate::ui::wrap_words(value, width)
344	}

346	#[derive(Debug)]
347	enum ListEntry {
348	    Run(RunListEntry),
349	    Plan(PlanListEntry),
350	}
351	
352	impl ListEntry {
353	    fn updated_at(&self) -> DateTime<Utc> {
354	        match self {
355	            Self::Run(run) => run.updated_at,
356	            Self::Plan(plan) => plan.updated_at,
357	        }
358	    }

361	#[derive(Debug)]
362	pub(crate) struct PlanListEntry {
363	    pub(crate) plan_id: String,
364	    pub(crate) merged_run_id: Option<String>,
365	    pub(crate) scope: String,
366	    pub(crate) goal: String,
367	    pub(crate) status: PlanStatus,
368	    pub(crate) mode: PlanMode,
369	    pub(crate) updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
370	    pub(crate) plan_path: PathBuf,
371	    pub(crate) completed_children: usize,
372	    pub(crate) total_children: usize,
373	}
374	
375	pub(crate) fn list_plan_entries(
376	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
377	    scope_filter: Option<&str>,
378	) -> Result<Vec<PlanListEntry>> {
379	    let root = paths.plans_dir();
380	    if !root.exists() {
381	        return Ok(Vec::new());
382	    }
383	    let mut plans = Vec::new();
384	    for entry in fs::read_dir(&root).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
385	        path: root.clone(),
386	        source,
387	    })? {
388	        let entry = entry?;
389	        let plan_path = entry.path().join("plan.json");
390	        if !plan_path.is_file() {
391	            continue;
392	        }
393	        let Some(plan_id) = entry.file_name().to_str().map(str::to_string) else {
394	            continue;
395	        };
396	        let plan = load_plan(paths, &plan_id)?;
397	        if scope_filter.is_some_and(|scope| plan.parent_scope.as_deref() != Some(scope)) {
398	            continue;
399	        }
400	        let updated_at = fs::metadata(&plan_path)
401	            .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified())
402	            .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
403	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| plan.merged_at.or(plan.forked_at).unwrap_or(plan.created_at));
404	        let completed_children = plan
405	            .tasks
406	            .iter()
407	            .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
408	            .count();
409	        let total_children = plan.tasks.len();
410	        plans.push(PlanListEntry {
411	            plan_id: plan.plan_id,
412	            merged_run_id: plan.merged_run_id,
413	            scope: plan.parent_scope.unwrap_or_else(|| "global".to_string()),
414	            goal: plan.root_goal,
415	            status: plan.status,
416	            mode: plan.mode,
417	            updated_at,
418	            plan_path,
419	            completed_children,
420	            total_children,
421	        });
422	    }
423	    plans.sort_by_key(|plan| Reverse(plan.updated_at));
424	    Ok(plans)
425	}
426	
427	fn plan_action_label(plan: &PlanListEntry) -> String {
428	    match plan.status {
429	        PlanStatus::Pending => "fork".to_string(),
430	        PlanStatus::Forked if plan.completed_children == plan.total_children => {
431	            format!("merge {}/{}", plan.completed_children, plan.total_children)
432	        }
433	        PlanStatus::Forked => format!("attach {}/{}", plan.completed_children, plan.total_children),
434	        PlanStatus::Merged if plan.merged_run_id.is_some() => "finish".to_string(),
435	        PlanStatus::Merged => "show".to_string(),
436	        PlanStatus::Failed => "show failure".to_string(),
437	    }
438	}

440	enum HistoryMatcher {
441	    Substring(String),
442	    Regex(Regex),
443	}
444	
445	impl HistoryMatcher {
446	    fn new(pattern: String, regex: bool) -> Result<Self> {
447	        if regex {
448	            let compiled = Regex::new(&pattern)
449	                .map_err(|err| invalid_history_regex_error(&pattern, &err.to_string()))?;
450	            Ok(Self::Regex(compiled))
451	        } else {
452	            Ok(Self::Substring(pattern))
453	        }
454	    }
455	
456	    fn is_match(&self, line: &str) -> bool {
457	        match self {
458	            Self::Substring(pattern) => line.contains(pattern),
459	            Self::Regex(pattern) => pattern.is_match(line),
460	        }
461	    }
462	}

522	pub(crate) fn history_command(command: HistoryCommand) -> Result<()> {
523	    match command {
524	        HistoryCommand::Grep {
525	            pattern,
526	            plan,
527	            scope,
528	            all,
529	            since,
530	            kind,
531	            limit,
532	            regex,
533	        } => history_grep_command(HistoryGrepRequest {
534	            pattern,
535	            plan,
536	            scope,
537	            all,
538	            since,
539	            kind,
540	            limit,
541	            regex,
542	        }),
543	    }

545	
546	struct HistoryGrepRequest {
547	    pattern: String,
548	    plan: Option<String>,
549	    scope: Option<String>,
550	    all: bool,
551	    since: Option<String>,
552	    kind: HistoryKind,
553	    limit: usize,
554	    regex: bool,
555	}
556	
557	fn history_grep_command(args: HistoryGrepRequest) -> Result<()> {
558	    let HistoryGrepRequest {
559	        pattern,
560	        plan,
561	        scope,
562	        all,
563	        since,
564	        kind,
565	        limit,
566	        regex,
567	    } = args;
568	    if limit == 0 {
569	        return Err(invalid_history_limit_error(&pattern, limit));
570	    }
571	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
572	    let matcher = HistoryMatcher::new(pattern.clone(), regex)?;
573	    let cutoff = parse_history_since(&pattern, since)?;
574	    let plan_children = plan
575	        .as_deref()
576	        .map(|plan_id| history_plan_children(&paths, plan_id))
577	        .transpose()?;
578	    let effective_scope = if plan_children.is_some() || all {
579	        scope
580	    } else {
581	        Some(scope.unwrap_or(current_scope()?))
582	    };
583	    let runs = list_runs(&paths, effective_scope.as_deref())?;
584	    let mut printed = 0usize;
585	    let mut total_matches = 0usize;
586	    println!(
587	        "{} {} {}",
588	        ui_heading("history grep"),
589	        ui_muted(history_kind_label(kind)),
590	        ui_muted(if regex { "regex" } else { "substring" })
591	    );
592	    if let Some(plan_id) = plan.as_deref() {
593	        let plan_id = resolve_plan_id(&paths, plan_id)?;
594	        for event in read_plan_events_lossy(&paths, &plan_id) {
595	            if let Some(cutoff) = cutoff
596	                && event.timestamp < cutoff
597	            {
598	                continue;
599	            }
600	            let line = plan_event_line(&event);
601	            if !matcher.is_match(&line) {
602	                continue;
603	            }
604	            total_matches += 1;
605	            if printed >= limit {
606	                continue;
607	            }
608	            println!(
609	                "{} {} plan-events | {}",
610	                ui_id(run_prefix(&plan_id)),
611	                ui_muted(event.timestamp.to_rfc3339()),
612	                one_line(&line, 220)
613	            );
614	            printed += 1;
615	        }
616	    }
617	    for run in runs {
618	        if let Some(children) = plan_children.as_ref()
619	            && !children.contains(&run.run_id)
620	        {
621	            continue;
622	        }
623	        let state = load_run(&paths, &run.run_id)?;
624	        let path = state.run_root.join(history_kind_file(kind));
625	        if !path.exists() || !history_file_within_cutoff(&path, cutoff)? {
626	            continue;
627	        }
628	        let fallback_timestamp = history_file_timestamp(&path)?;
629	        for line in fs::read_to_string(&path)?.lines() {
630	            if !matcher.is_match(line) {
631	                continue;
632	            }
633	            total_matches += 1;
634	            if printed >= limit {
635	                continue;
636	            }
637	            let timestamp = history_line_timestamp(kind, line).unwrap_or(fallback_timestamp);
638	            println!(
639	                "{} {} {} | {}",
640	                ui_id(run_prefix(&run.run_id)),
641	                ui_muted(timestamp.to_rfc3339()),
642	                run.scope,
643	                one_line(line.trim(), 220)
644	            );
645	            printed += 1;
646	        }
647	    }
648	    if total_matches == 0 {
649	        print_history_grep_no_matches_surface(
650	            &pattern,
651	            kind,
652	            regex,
653	            plan.as_deref(),
654	            effective_scope.as_deref(),
655	            all,
656	        );
657	    } else if total_matches > printed {
658	        println!(
659	            "{}",
660	            ui_muted(format!("... ({} more)", total_matches - printed))
661	        );
662	    }
663	    Ok(())
664	}

666	fn print_history_grep_no_matches_surface(
667	    pattern: &str,
668	    kind: HistoryKind,
669	    regex: bool,
670	    plan: Option<&str>,
671	    scope: Option<&str>,
672	    all: bool,
673	) {
674	    let primary = format!("deadreckon history grep {} --all", command_literal(pattern));
675	    let search_scope = if let Some(plan) = plan {
676	        format!("plan {plan}")
677	    } else if all {
678	        "all scopes".to_string()
679	    } else if let Some(scope) = scope {
680	        format!("scope {scope}")
681	    } else {
682	        "current scope".to_string()
683	    };
684	    let surface = VerdictSurface::try_new(
685	        VerdictKind::Noop,
686	        "history grep",
687	        Some(pattern),
688	        ExplanationPanel::new(
689	            format!("History grep scanned {search_scope} and found no matches for {pattern:?}."),
690	            "This is a no-op because no trace/provenance lines matched; broadening the search to all scopes is the safest next check.",
691	            vec![
692	                ("pattern".to_string(), pattern.to_string()),
693	                ("scope".to_string(), search_scope),
694	                ("kind".to_string(), history_kind_label(kind).to_string()),
695	                (
696	                    "matcher".to_string(),
697	                    if regex { "regex" } else { "substring" }.to_string(),
698	                ),
699	            ],
700	        ),
701	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
702	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon show <run-id>")],
703	    )
704	    .expect("history grep no-match verdict surface must be valid");
705	    print!(
706	        "{}",
707	        surface.render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false))
708	    );
709	}

735	fn parse_history_since(pattern: &str, value: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {
736	    let Some(value) = value else {
737	        return Ok(None);
738	    };
739	    let value = value.trim();
740	    if value.len() < 2 {
741	        return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value));
742	    }
743	    let (amount, unit) = value.split_at(value.len() - 1);
744	    let amount = amount
745	        .parse::<i64>()
746	        .map_err(|_| invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value))?;
747	    if amount < 0 {
748	        return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value));
749	    }
750	    let duration = match unit {
751	        "d" => ChronoDuration::days(amount),
752	        "h" => ChronoDuration::hours(amount),
753	        "m" => ChronoDuration::minutes(amount),
754	        _ => return Err(invalid_history_since_error(pattern, value)),
755	    };
756	    Ok(Some(Utc::now() - duration))
757	}
758	
759	fn invalid_history_since_error(pattern: &str, value: &str) -> CliError {
760	    let primary = format!(
761	        "deadreckon history grep {} --since 7d",
762	        command_literal(pattern)
763	    );
764	    let secondary = format!("deadreckon history grep {} --all", command_literal(pattern));
765	    CliError::Surface {
766	        code: 2,
767	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
768	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
769	            "history grep",
770	            Some("--since"),
771	            ExplanationPanel::new(
772	                format!("History grep could not parse --since duration {value:?}."),
773	                "The command stopped before scanning history because --since must be a positive duration ending in d, h, or m.",
774	                vec![
775	                    ("filter".to_string(), "--since".to_string()),
776	                    ("value".to_string(), value.to_string()),
777	                    ("accepted duration".to_string(), "7d, 24h, or 30m".to_string()),
778	                ],
779	            ),
780	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
781	            vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
782	        )
783	        .expect("invalid history since verdict surface must be valid")
784	        .render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false)),
785	    }
786	}

788	fn history_file_within_cutoff(path: &Path, cutoff: Option<DateTime<Utc>>) -> Result<bool> {

791	    };
792	    Ok(history_file_timestamp(path)? >= cutoff)

795	fn history_file_timestamp(path: &Path) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {
796	    let modified = fs::metadata(path)?.modified()?;
797	    Ok(DateTime::<Utc>::from(modified))
798	}

800	fn history_line_timestamp(kind: HistoryKind, line: &str) -> Option<DateTime<Utc>> {
801	    match kind {
802	        HistoryKind::Trace => serde_json::from_str::<TraceRecord>(line)
803	            .ok()
804	            .map(|record| record.timestamp),
805	        HistoryKind::Provenance => serde_json::from_str::<ProvenanceRecord>(line)
806	            .ok()
807	            .map(|record| record.timestamp),
808	    }
809	}

876	                .into_iter()

923	fn command_literal(value: &str) -> String {
924	    if !value.is_empty()
925	        && value.chars().all(|ch| {
926	            ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
927	                || matches!(
928	                    ch,
929	                    '_' | '-' | '.' | '/' | ':' | '@' | '%' | '+' | '=' | ','
930	                )
931	        })
932	    {
933	        return value.to_string();
934	    }
935	    format!("'{}'", value.replace('\'', "'\\''"))
936	}

938	struct LibraryFilter {
939	    goal: Option<String>,
940	    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
941	    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
942	}
943	
944	impl LibraryFilter {
945	    fn new(goal: Option<String>, since: Option<String>, until: Option<String>) -> Result<Self> {
946	        Ok(Self {
947	            goal: goal.map(|goal| goal.to_lowercase()),
948	            since: parse_library_date_filter("--since", since)?,
949	            until: parse_library_date_filter("--until", until)?,
950	        })
951	    }
952	}

954	fn filter_library_entries(entries: Vec<LibraryEntry>, filter: &LibraryFilter) -> Vec<LibraryEntry> {
955	    entries
956	        .into_iter()
957	        .filter(|entry| {
958	            let manifest = &entry.manifest;
959	            filter
960	                .goal
961	                .as_ref()
962	                .is_none_or(|goal| manifest.goal.to_lowercase().contains(goal))
963	                && filter
964	                    .since
965	                    .is_none_or(|since| manifest.promoted_at >= since)
966	                && filter
967	                    .until
968	                    .is_none_or(|until| manifest.promoted_at <= until)
969	        })
970	        .collect()
971	}

973	fn library_entry_matches_query(entry: &LibraryEntry, needle: &str) -> bool {
974	    let manifest = &entry.manifest;
975	    manifest.run_id.to_lowercase().contains(needle)
976	        || manifest.scope.to_lowercase().contains(needle)
977	        || manifest.goal.to_lowercase().contains(needle)
978	        || library_docs_contain(&entry.path, needle)
979	}
980	
981	fn library_docs_contain(path: &Path, needle: &str) -> bool {
982	    inventory_files(path)
983	        .unwrap_or_default()
984	        .into_iter()
985	        .filter(|file| {
986	            matches!(
987	                file.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()),
988	                Some("md" | "txt" | "json" | "jsonl" | "toml")
989	            )
990	        })
991	        .any(|file| {
992	            fs::read_to_string(file)
993	                .ok()
994	                .is_some_and(|raw| raw.to_lowercase().contains(needle))
995	        })
996	}

998	fn parse_library_date_filter(label: &str, value: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {
999	    let Some(value) = value else {
1000	        return Ok(None);
1001	    };
1002	    if let Ok(date_time) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&value) {
1003	        return Ok(Some(date_time.with_timezone(&Utc)));
1004	    }
1005	    if let Ok(date) = chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(&value, "%Y-%m-%d") {
1006	        let date_time = if label == "--until" {
1007	            date.and_hms_nano_opt(23, 59, 59, 999_999_999)
1008	        } else {
1009	            date.and_hms_opt(0, 0, 0)
1010	        };
1011	        let Some(date_time) = date_time else {
1012	            return Err(invalid_library_date_error(label, &value));
1013	        };
1014	        return Ok(Some(date_time.and_utc()));
1015	    }
1016	    Err(invalid_library_date_error(label, &value))
1017	}

1022	        code: 2,
1023	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(

1025	            "library list",
1026	            Some(label),
1027	            ExplanationPanel::new(
1028	                format!("Library list could not parse {label} date {value:?}."),
1029	                "The command stopped before reading artifacts because date filters must be RFC3339 timestamps or YYYY-MM-DD dates.",
1030	                vec![
1031	                    ("filter".to_string(), label.to_string()),
1032	                    ("value".to_string(), value.to_string()),
1033	                    ("accepted format".to_string(), "YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339".to_string()),
1034	                ],
1035	            ),
1036	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1037	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon library list --all")],
1038	        )
1039	        .expect("invalid library date verdict surface must be valid")
1040	        .render_plain(!crate::completion_hints_enabled(false)),
1041	    }
1042	}

1044	pub(crate) fn library_entries(
1045	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1046	    scope: Option<String>,
1047	    all: bool,
1048	) -> Result<Vec<LibraryEntry>> {
1049	    let mut entries = Vec::new();
1050	    let library_root = paths.home().join("library");
1051	    if let Some(scope) = scope {
1052	        scan_library_scope(paths, &scope, &mut entries)?;
1053	    } else if all {
1054	        if library_root.exists() {
1055	            for scope_entry in fs::read_dir(&library_root)? {
1056	                let scope_entry = scope_entry?;
1057	                if !scope_entry.file_type()?.is_dir() {
1058	                    continue;
1059	                }
1060	                let scope_name = scope_entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
1061	                if scope_name.starts_with('.') {
1062	                    continue;
1063	                }
1064	                scan_library_scope(paths, &scope_name, &mut entries)?;
1065	            }
1066	        }
1067	    } else {
1068	        scan_library_scope(paths, &current_scope()?, &mut entries)?;
1069	    }
1070	    entries.sort_by(|left, right| {
1071	        right
1072	            .manifest
1073	            .promoted_at
1074	            .cmp(&left.manifest.promoted_at)
1075	            .then_with(|| left.manifest.run_id.cmp(&right.manifest.run_id))
1076	    });
1077	    Ok(entries)
1078	}

1080	fn scan_library_scope(
1081	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1082	    scope: &str,
1083	    entries: &mut Vec<LibraryEntry>,
1084	) -> Result<()> {
1085	    let scope_dir = paths.home().join("library").join(scope);
1086	    if !scope_dir.exists() {
1087	        return Ok(());
1088	    }
1089	    for run_entry in fs::read_dir(scope_dir)? {
1090	        let run_entry = run_entry?;
1091	        if !run_entry.file_type()?.is_dir() {
1092	            continue;
1093	        }
1094	        let path = run_entry.path();
1095	        let manifest_path = path.join("manifest.json");
1096	        if !manifest_path.exists() {
1097	            continue;
1098	        }
1099	        let manifest: PromotionManifest = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&manifest_path)?)?;
1100	        entries.push(LibraryEntry {
1101	            materialized_count: materialized_marker_count(&path),
1102	            manifest,
1103	            path,
1104	        });
1105	    }
1106	    Ok(())
1107	}
```

```text
177	pub(crate) fn materialize_completed_run(
178	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
179	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
180	    dest: Option<PathBuf>,
181	    force: bool,
182	    include_manifest: bool,
183	) -> Result<MaterializedRun> {
184	    ensure_completed_run(state, "materialize")?;
185	    if let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) {
186	        match record.mode {
187	            CodebaseMode::Worktree => {
188	                return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
189	                    "materialize",
190	                    state,
191	                    record.mode,
192	                    "export is for copy/fresh runs; run was worktree",
193	                    format!("deadreckon apply {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
194	                    "Materialize exports copy/fresh artifacts, while this run already has a worktree branch that should be applied instead.",
195	                ));
196	            }
197	            CodebaseMode::InPlace => {
198	                return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
199	                    "materialize",
200	                    state,
201	                    record.mode,
202	                    "export is not needed; run edited the source in-place",
203	                    format!("deadreckon undo --run {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
204	                    "Materialize would duplicate work already written in place; use undo only if those edits need to be reverted.",
205	                ));
206	            }
207	            CodebaseMode::Copy | CodebaseMode::Fresh => {}
208	        }
209	    }
210	    let library_dir = paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id);
211	    if !library_dir.is_dir() {
212	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!(
213	            "library missing for run {}; was promotion successful?",
214	            state.run_id
215	        ))));
216	    }
217	
218	    let dest = absolute_dest(dest.unwrap_or_else(|| {
219	        std::env::current_dir()
220	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."))
221	            .join(run_prefix(&state.run_id))
222	    }))?;
223	    refuse_dest_inside_home(paths, &dest, "export")?;
224	    prepare_empty_dest(&dest, force)?;
225	
226	    copy_tree(&library_dir, &dest)?;
227	    if !include_manifest {
228	        remove_if_exists(&dest.join("manifest.json"))?;
229	    }
230	    remove_if_exists(&dest.join(".materialized-to"))?;
231	    write_parent_marker(
232	        &dest.join(".deadreckon").join("parent.json"),
233	        &materialized_parent_marker(state),
234	    )?;
235	    normalize_permissions(&dest)?;
236	    append_materialized_marker(&library_dir, &dest)?;
237	
238	    Ok(MaterializedRun {
239	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
240	        source: library_dir,
241	        dest,
242	    })
243	}

333	    _plain: bool,
334	) -> Result<()> {
335	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
336	    let mut state = match load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id) {
337	        Ok(state) => state,
338	        Err(run_error) => match resolve_plan_result_run(&paths, &run_id, "apply")? {
339	            Some(result) => {
340	                if !quiet {
341	                    print_plan_result_context(&result.plan, &result.state);
342	                }
343	                prepare_plan_result_apply_state(&paths, &result.plan, &result.state)?
344	            }
345	            None => return Err(run_error),
346	        },
347	    };
348	    ensure_completed_run(&state, "apply")?;
349	    let record = match read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) {
350	        Ok(record) => record,
351	        Err(source) => match prepare_result_run_apply_state(&paths, &state, quiet)? {
352	            Some(prepared) => {
353	                state = prepared;
354	                read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir)?
355	            }
356	            None => return Err(apply_missing_codebase_error(&paths, &state, source)),
357	        },
358	    };
359	    if record.mode != CodebaseMode::Worktree {
360	        return Err(apply_mode_error(&state, record.mode));
361	    }
362	    let git_root = record.source_git_root.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
363	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
364	            "missing source_git_root".to_string(),
365	        ))
366	    })?;
367	    let branch = record.branch_name.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
368	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
369	            "missing branch_name".to_string(),
370	        ))
371	    })?;
372	    let target =
373	        target_branch.unwrap_or(git_stdout(git_root, &["symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD"])?);
374	    let diff_stat = git_stdout(
375	        git_root,
376	        &["diff", "--stat", &format!("{target}..{branch}")],
377	    )
378	    .unwrap_or_default();
379	    if diff_stat.trim().is_empty() {
380	        if !quiet {
381	            print_already_applied(&state, branch, &target);
382	        }
383	        let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
384	        if !quiet {
385	            print!(
386	                "{}",
387	                apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
388	                    .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
389	            );
390	        }
391	        return Ok(());
392	    }
393	    if !quiet {
394	        eprintln!(
395	            "{}",
396	            ui::render(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Heading, "changes to apply:")
397	        );
398	        eprintln!("{diff_stat}");
399	    }
400	
401	    if !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
402	        if !prompt::confirm("apply these changes?", true)? {
403	            println!("{}", ui_muted("cancelled"));
404	            return Ok(());
405	        }
406	    } else if !no_confirm && !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
407	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
408	            "non-interactive apply requires --no-confirm",
409	            &format!("deadreckon apply {} --no-confirm", state.run_id),
410	        )));
411	    }
412	
413	    let autostash = prepare_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, autostash, no_confirm)?;
414	
415	    let (commit_subject, commit_body) = match message {
416	        Some(message) => (message, None),
417	        None => (
418	            format!(
419	                "{} (deadreckon run {})",
420	                state.goal.lines().next().unwrap_or("deadreckon run"),
421	                state.run_id.chars().take(8).collect::<String>()
422	            ),
423	            Some(apply_commit_body(&state)),
424	        ),
425	    };
426	    let full_merge_message = commit_body
427	        .as_ref()
428	        .map(|body| format!("{commit_subject}\n\n{body}"))
429	        .unwrap_or_else(|| commit_subject.clone());
430	    match strategy.as_str() {
431	        "merge" => git_status(
432	            git_root,
433	            &["merge", "--no-ff", branch, "-m", &full_merge_message],
434	        )
435	        .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?,
436	        "squash" => {
437	            git_status(git_root, &["merge", "--squash", branch])
438	                .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?;
439	            let staged_stat = git_stdout(git_root, &["diff", "--cached", "--stat"])?;
440	            if staged_stat.trim().is_empty() {
441	                if let Some(stash) = autostash.as_ref() {
442	                    restore_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, stash)?;
443	                }
444	                if !quiet {
445	                    print_already_applied(&state, branch, &target);
446	                }
447	                let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
448	                if !quiet {
449	                    print!(
450	                        "{}",
451	                        apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
452	                            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
453	                    );
454	                }
455	                return Ok(());
456	            }
457	            if let Some(body) = commit_body.as_deref() {
458	                git_status(git_root, &["commit", "-m", &commit_subject, "-m", body])?;
459	            } else {
460	                git_status(git_root, &["commit", "-m", &commit_subject])?;
461	            }
462	        }
463	        "cherry-pick" => {
464	            let base = record.base_sha.as_deref().unwrap_or("HEAD");
465	            git_status(git_root, &["cherry-pick", &format!("{base}..{branch}")])
466	                .map_err(|err| apply_merge_error(&state.run_id, &autostash, &err))?;
467	        }
468	        other => {
469	            return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
470	                "unknown git apply strategy {other}"
471	            ))));
472	        }
473	    }
474	    if let Some(stash) = autostash.as_ref() {
475	        restore_apply_autostash(git_root, &state.run_id, stash)?;
476	    }
477	    if !quiet {
478	        println!(
479	            "{} {} into {}",
480	            ui_ok("applied"),
481	            ui_id(&state.run_id),
482	            target
483	        );
484	        println!("{}", git_stdout(git_root, &["log", "-1", "--stat"])?);
485	    }
486	    let cleaned = finish_apply_cleanup(&state, &record, cleanup, no_confirm)?;
487	    if !quiet {
488	        print!(
489	            "{}",
490	            apply_completed_surface(&state, &record, &target, cleaned)
491	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
492	        );
493	    }
494	    Ok(())
495	}

497	fn prepare_result_run_apply_state(
498	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
499	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
500	    quiet: bool,
501	) -> Result<Option<deadreckon_core::PipelineState>> {
502	    let Some(plan_id) = result_plan_id(paths, state)? else {
503	        return Ok(None);
504	    };
505	    if let Ok(plan) = load_plan(paths, &plan_id) {
506	        if !quiet {
507	            print_plan_result_context(&plan, state);
508	        }
509	        return prepare_plan_result_apply_state(paths, &plan, state).map(Some);
510	    }
511	    if let Some((campaign_dir, campaign)) =
512	        crate::commands::campaign::resolve_campaign(paths, &plan_id)?
513	    {
514	        let plan = crate::commands::campaign::campaign_as_apply_plan(
515	            paths,
516	            &campaign_dir,
517	            &campaign,
518	            &state.cwd,
519	        )?;
520	        if plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() != Some(state.run_id.as_str()) {
521	            return Ok(None);
522	        }
523	        if !quiet {
524	            print_plan_result_context(&plan, state);
525	        }
526	        return prepare_plan_result_apply_state(paths, &plan, state).map(Some);
527	    }
528	    Ok(None)
529	}

531	fn result_plan_id(
532	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
533	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
534	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
535	    let library = paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id);
536	    if let Some(plan_id) =
537	        result_manifest_id(&library.join("deadreckon-plan-manifest.json"), "plan_id")?
538	    {
539	        return Ok(Some(plan_id));
540	    }
541	    result_manifest_id(
542	        &library.join("deadreckon-campaign-manifest.json"),
543	        "campaign_id",
544	    )

547	fn result_manifest_id(path: &Path, key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
548	    match fs::read(&path) {
549	        Ok(bytes) => {
550	            let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
551	            Ok(value.get(key).and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_string))
552	        }
553	        Err(source) if source.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
554	        Err(source) => Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::Io {
555	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
556	            source,
557	        })),
558	    }
559	}

564	    source: DeadreckonError,
565	) -> CliError {
566	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);

568	    CliError::Surface {
569	        code: 1,

572	            "apply",
573	            Some(&id),
574	            ExplanationPanel::new(
575	                "DeadReckon could not find a worktree record for this completed run.",
576	                "Apply only merges worktree-backed runs or completed plan/campaign results with recoverable source metadata; use finish/export to copy this library result.",
577	                [
578	                    ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
579	                    ("status".to_string(), run_status_label(state.status).to_string()),
580	                    ("library".to_string(), library.display().to_string()),
581	                    ("missing".to_string(), source.to_string()),
582	                ],
583	            ),
584	            vec![("Recommended", format!("deadreckon finish {id}"))],
585	            vec![("Secondary", format!("deadreckon export {id} --dest <path>"))],
586	        )
587	        .expect("apply missing-codebase refusal surface must be valid")
588	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),

607	fn apply_completed_surface(
608	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
609	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
610	    target: &str,
611	    cleaned: bool,
612	) -> VerdictSurface {
613	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
614	    let primary = if cleaned {
615	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
616	    } else {
617	        format!("deadreckon cleanup {id}")
618	    };
619	    let secondary = if cleaned {
620	        "deadreckon status".to_string()
621	    } else {
622	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
623	    };
624	    let mut evidence = vec![
625	        ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
626	        ("target branch".to_string(), target.to_string()),
627	        (
628	            "run branch".to_string(),
629	            record
630	                .branch_name
631	                .clone()
632	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string()),
633	        ),
634	        ("mode".to_string(), record.mode.to_string()),
635	        (
636	            "cleanup".to_string(),
637	            if cleaned {
638	                "completed".to_string()
639	            } else {
640	                "pending".to_string()
641	            },
642	        ),
643	    ];
644	    if let Some(worktree) = record.worktree_path.as_ref() {
645	        evidence.push(("worktree".to_string(), worktree.display().to_string()));
646	    }
647	    if let Some(source) = record.source_git_root.as_ref() {
648	        evidence.push(("source git root".to_string(), source.display().to_string()));
649	    }
650	    let why = if cleaned {
651	        "The apply transition is complete and temporary resources were removed; inspect the run record before further cleanup or recovery."
652	    } else {
653	        "The apply transition is complete, but the temporary worktree resources remain; cleanup is the safest next command."
654	    };
655	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
656	        VerdictKind::Completed,
657	        "apply",
658	        Some(&id),
659	        ExplanationPanel::new(
660	            "DeadReckon applied or confirmed the run branch in the target checkout.",
661	            why,
662	            evidence,
663	        ),
664	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
665	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
666	    )
667	    .expect("apply completion verdict surface must be valid")
668	}

670	fn finish_apply_cleanup(
671	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
672	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
673	    cleanup: bool,
674	    no_confirm: bool,
675	) -> Result<bool> {
676	    let cleanup_now = cleanup || should_prompt_cleanup(no_confirm)?;
677	    if cleanup_now {
678	        cleanup_worktree_run(state, record, false, false, CleanupReason::Applied)?;
679	    }
680	    Ok(cleanup_now)
681	}

683	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
684	struct ApplyAutoStash {
685	    refname: String,
686	}
687	
688	fn prepare_apply_autostash(
689	    git_root: &Path,
690	    run_id: &str,
691	    requested: bool,
692	    no_confirm: bool,
693	) -> Result<Option<ApplyAutoStash>> {
694	    let dirty = git_stdout(git_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?;
695	    if dirty.trim().is_empty() {
696	        return Ok(None);
697	    }
698	
699	    eprintln!(
700	        "{}",
701	        ui::render(
702	            ui::Stream::Stderr,
703	            ui::Tone::Warn,
704	            "working tree has uncommitted changes:",
705	        )
706	    );
707	    for line in dirty.lines().take(30) {
708	        eprintln!("  {line}");
709	    }
710	    if dirty.lines().count() > 30 {
711	        eprintln!("  ...");
712	    }
713	
714	    let mut should_stash = requested;
715	    if !should_stash && !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
716	        should_stash =
717	            prompt::confirm("stash these changes during apply and restore after?", true)?;
718	    }
719	
720	    if !should_stash {
721	        return Err(apply_dirty_error(
722	            git_root,
723	            run_id,
724	            no_confirm,
725	            dirty.as_str(),
726	        ));
727	    }
728	
729	    let marker = format!(
730	        "deadreckon apply {} autostash {}",
731	        run_prefix(run_id),
732	        Utc::now().timestamp_millis()
733	    );
734	    git_status(git_root, &["stash", "push", "-u", "-m", &marker])?;
735	    let refname = find_stash_by_marker(git_root, &marker)?.ok_or_else(|| {
736	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
737	            "git stash succeeded but the new stash could not be found".to_string(),
738	        ))
739	    })?;
740	    eprintln!(
741	        "stashed local changes as {}",
742	        ui::render(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Id, &refname)
743	    );
744	    Ok(Some(ApplyAutoStash { refname }))
745	}
746	
747	fn apply_dirty_hint(run_id: &str, no_confirm: bool) -> String {
748	    let mut hint = format!("deadreckon apply {} --autostash", run_prefix(run_id));
749	    if no_confirm {
750	        hint.push_str(" --no-confirm");
751	    }
752	    hint
753	}
754	
755	fn apply_dirty_error(git_root: &Path, run_id: &str, no_confirm: bool, dirty: &str) -> CliError {
756	    let id = run_prefix(run_id);
757	    let dirty_count = dirty.lines().count();
758	    let primary = apply_dirty_hint(run_id, no_confirm);
759	    CliError::Surface {
760	        code: 1,
761	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
762	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
763	            "apply",
764	            Some(&id),
765	            ExplanationPanel::new(
766	                "your working tree has uncommitted changes",
767	                "Apply would merge a run branch into a checkout that already has local changes; autostash is required to preserve and restore those changes around the merge.",
768	                [
769	                    ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
770	                    ("working".to_string(), git_root.display().to_string()),
771	                    ("dirty paths".to_string(), dirty_count.to_string()),
772	                ],
773	            ),
774	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
775	            Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
776	        )
777	        .expect("apply dirty refusal verdict surface must be valid")
778	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
779	    }
780	}
781	
782	fn find_stash_by_marker(git_root: &Path, marker: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
783	    let output = git_stdout(git_root, &["stash", "list", "--format=%gd%x00%s"])?;
784	    for line in output.lines() {
785	        if let Some((refname, subject)) = line.split_once('\0')
786	            && subject.contains(marker)
787	        {
788	            return Ok(Some(refname.to_string()));
789	        }
790	    }
791	    Ok(None)
792	}
793	
794	fn restore_apply_autostash(git_root: &Path, run_id: &str, stash: &ApplyAutoStash) -> Result<()> {
795	    git_status(git_root, &["stash", "pop", &stash.refname]).map_err(|err| {
796	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
797	            &format!("applied {run_id}, but restoring autostash produced conflicts: {err}"),
798	            &format!(
799	                "resolve conflicts, then inspect `git stash list` before dropping {}",
800	                stash.refname
801	            ),
802	        ))
803	    })
804	}
805	
806	fn apply_merge_error(run_id: &str, autostash: &Option<ApplyAutoStash>, err: &CliError) -> CliError {
807	    let id = run_prefix(run_id);
808	    let cleanup = format!("deadreckon cleanup {id}");
809	    let mut secondary = vec![("Secondary", cleanup.as_str())];
810	    let stash_hint;
811	    if let Some(stash) = autostash {
812	        stash_hint = format!("git stash pop {}", stash.refname);
813	        secondary.push(("Secondary", stash_hint.as_str()));
814	    }
815	    CliError::Surface {
816	        code: 1,
817	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
818	            VerdictKind::Failed,
819	            "apply",
820	            Some(&id),
821	            ExplanationPanel::new(
822	                format!("merge produced conflicts: {err}"),
823	                "Git stopped during apply with conflict markers in the target checkout; inspect the conflicted paths, resolve them, commit the result, then clean up the run worktree.",
824	                [
825	                    ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
826	                    ("primary evidence".to_string(), "git merge failed".to_string()),
827	                    (
828	                        "autostash".to_string(),
829	                        autostash
830	                            .as_ref()
831	                            .map(|stash| stash.refname.clone())
832	                            .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string()),
833	                    ),
834	                ],
835	            ),
836	            vec![("Recommended", "git status")],
837	            secondary,
838	        )
839	        .expect("apply conflict verdict surface must be valid")
840	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
841	    }
842	}

844	fn should_prompt_cleanup(no_confirm: bool) -> Result<bool> {
845	    if no_confirm || !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
846	        return Ok(false);
847	    }
848	    prompt::confirm("remove deadreckon worktree and temporary branch now?", true)
849	}

851	// SAFETY: Abandon arguments are owned clap values at the command boundary.
852	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
853	pub(crate) fn abandon_command(run_id: String, keep_branch: bool, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
854	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
855	    let mut state = load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id)?;
856	    let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) else {
857	        print!(
858	            "{}",
859	            cleanup_noop_surface(
860	                "abandon",
861	                Some(&run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
862	                "DeadReckon did not find a temporary worktree record for this run.",
863	                "There is no worktree or temporary branch for abandon to remove; inspect the run before choosing another cleanup command.",
864	                vec![
865	                    ("run".to_string(), run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
866	                    ("status".to_string(), run_status_label(state.status).to_string()),
867	                    (
868	                        "workspace".to_string(),
869	                        state.working_dir.display().to_string(),
870	                    ),
871	                ],
872	                format!("deadreckon show {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
873	                Vec::<String>::new(),
874	            )
875	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
876	        );
877	        return Ok(());
878	    };
879	    if record.mode == CodebaseMode::InPlace {
880	        return Err(codebase_mode_refusal_error(
881	            "abandon",
882	            &state,
883	            record.mode,
884	            "cannot abandon in-place edits",
885	            format!("deadreckon undo --run {}", run_prefix(&state.run_id)),
886	            "Abandon removes temporary worktrees; this run changed the source checkout directly, so undo is the safe recovery command.",
887	        ));
888	    }
889	    if state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
890	        if !force {
891	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
892	                &format!("run {} is {}", state.run_id, run_status_label(state.status)),
893	                &format!("deadreckon kill {} --escalate", state.run_id),
894	            )));
895	        }
896	        let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut state, true);
897	    }
898	    let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
899	        &state,
900	        &record,
901	        keep_branch,
902	        force,
903	        CleanupReason::Abandoned,
904	    )?;
905	    print_cleanup_results(&[result]);
906	    Ok(())
907	}

909	pub(crate) struct CleanupCommandRequest {
910	    pub(crate) run_id: Option<String>,
911	    pub(crate) all: bool,
912	    pub(crate) completed: bool,
913	    pub(crate) stale: bool,
914	    pub(crate) no_confirm: bool,
915	    pub(crate) escalate: bool,
916	    pub(crate) overwrite: bool,
917	    pub(crate) keep_branch: bool,
918	}
919	
920	pub(crate) fn cleanup_command(args: CleanupCommandRequest) -> Result<()> {
921	    let CleanupCommandRequest {
922	        run_id,
923	        all,
924	        completed,
925	        stale,
926	        no_confirm,
927	        escalate,
928	        overwrite,
929	        keep_branch,
930	    } = args;
931	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
932	    if let Some(run_id) = run_id {
933	        let mut state = load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id)?;
934	        if state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
935	            if !escalate {
936	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
937	                    &format!("run {} is {}", state.run_id, run_status_label(state.status)),
938	                    &format!("deadreckon cleanup {} --escalate", state.run_id),
939	                )));
940	            }
941	            let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut state, escalate);
942	        }
943	        let record = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir)?;
944	        let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
945	            &state,
946	            &record,
947	            keep_branch,
948	            overwrite,
949	            CleanupReason::Cleaned,
950	        )?;
951	        print_cleanup_results(&[result]);
952	        return Ok(());
953	    }
954	
955	    let candidates = cleanup_candidates(&paths, all, completed, stale)?;
956	    if candidates.is_empty() {
957	        print!(
958	            "{}",
959	            cleanup_no_candidates_surface(completed, all)
960	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
961	        );
962	        return Ok(());
963	    }
964	
965	    println!("{}", ui_heading("cleanup candidates:"));
966	    for candidate in &candidates {
967	        println!(
968	            "  {:<8} {:<10} {:<16} {}",
969	            run_prefix(&candidate.state.run_id),
970	            candidate.state.status,
971	            candidate.reason,
972	            one_line(&candidate.state.goal, 72)
973	        );
974	    }
975	    if !no_confirm {
976	        if !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
977	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
978	                "non-interactive cleanup requires --no-confirm",
979	                "deadreckon cleanup --no-confirm",
980	            )));
981	        }
982	        if !prompt::confirm("clean these runs?", false)? {
983	            println!("{}", ui_muted("cancelled"));
984	            return Ok(());
985	        }
986	    }
987	
988	    let mut results = Vec::new();
989	    for mut candidate in candidates {
990	        if candidate.state.status == RunStatus::Executing {
991	            let _ = kill_loaded_run(&paths, &mut candidate.state, escalate);
992	        }
993	        let result = cleanup_worktree_run(
994	            &candidate.state,
995	            &candidate.record,
996	            keep_branch,
997	            overwrite,
998	            CleanupReason::Cleaned,
999	        )?;
1000	        results.push(result);
1001	    }
1002	    print_cleanup_results(&results);
1003	    Ok(())
1004	}

1006	#[derive(Debug)]
1007	struct CleanupCandidate {
1008	    state: deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1009	    record: CodebaseRecord,
1010	    reason: String,
1011	}
1012	
1013	fn cleanup_candidates(
1014	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1015	    all: bool,
1016	    include_completed: bool,
1017	    include_stale: bool,
1018	) -> Result<Vec<CleanupCandidate>> {
1019	    let scope = if all { None } else { Some(current_scope()?) };
1020	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
1021	    for run in list_runs(paths, scope.as_deref())? {
1022	        let Ok(state) = load_run(paths, &run.run_id) else {
1023	            continue;
1024	        };
1025	        let Ok(record) = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir) else {
1026	            continue;
1027	        };
1028	        if record.mode != CodebaseMode::Worktree {
1029	            continue;
1030	        }
1031	        let abandoned = state.run_root.join("abandoned.json").exists();
1032	        let stale = include_stale && is_stale_executing(&state);
1033	        let completed = include_completed && state.status == RunStatus::Completed && !abandoned;
1034	        if abandoned || stale || completed {
1035	            let reason = if abandoned {
1036	                "cleaned".to_string()
1037	            } else if stale {
1038	                "stale".to_string()
1039	            } else {
1040	                "completed".to_string()
1041	            };
1042	            candidates.push(CleanupCandidate {
1043	                state,
1044	                record,
1045	                reason,
1046	            });
1047	        }
1048	    }
1049	    Ok(candidates)
1050	}

1052	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
1053	enum CleanupReason {
1054	    Abandoned,
1055	    Applied,
1056	    Cleaned,
1057	}
1058	
1059	impl CleanupReason {
1060	    fn marker(self) -> &'static str {
1061	        match self {
1062	            Self::Abandoned => "abandoned",
1063	            Self::Applied => "applied",
1064	            Self::Cleaned => "cleaned",
1065	        }
1066	    }
1067	
1068	    fn subject(self) -> &'static str {
1069	        match self {
1070	            Self::Abandoned => "abandon",
1071	            Self::Applied | Self::Cleaned => "cleanup",
1072	        }
1073	    }
1074	}
```
