1076	#[derive(Debug)]
1077	struct CleanupRunResult {
1078	    run_id: String,
1079	    status: RunStatus,
1080	    mode: CodebaseMode,
1081	    removed: Vec<String>,
1082	    keep_branch: bool,
1083	    force: bool,
1084	    reason: CleanupReason,
1085	}
1086	
1087	fn cleanup_worktree_run(
1088	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1089	    record: &CodebaseRecord,
1090	    keep_branch: bool,
1091	    force: bool,
1092	    reason: CleanupReason,
1093	) -> Result<CleanupRunResult> {
1094	    let mut removed = Vec::new();
1095	    if record.mode == CodebaseMode::Worktree
1096	        && let (Some(git_root), Some(worktree)) = (
1097	            record.source_git_root.as_ref(),
1098	            record.worktree_path.as_ref(),
1099	        )
1100	    {
1101	        if worktree.exists() {
1102	            let mut args = vec!["worktree", "remove"];
1103	            if force {
1104	                args.push("--force");
1105	            }
1106	            args.push(path_to_str(worktree)?);
1107	            let _ = git_status(git_root, &args);
1108	            removed.push(worktree.display().to_string());
1109	        }
1110	        if !keep_branch
1111	            && let Some(branch) = record.branch_name.as_deref()
1112	            && git_stdout(git_root, &["rev-parse", "--verify", branch]).is_ok()
1113	        {
1114	            let _ = git_status(git_root, &["branch", "-D", branch]);
1115	            removed.push(format!("branch {branch}"));
1116	        }
1117	    }
1118	    write_abandoned_marker(state, reason)?;
1119	    Ok(CleanupRunResult {
1120	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
1121	        status: state.status,
1122	        mode: record.mode,
1123	        removed,
1124	        keep_branch,
1125	        force,
1126	        reason,
1127	    })
1128	}
1129	
1130	fn print_cleanup_results(results: &[CleanupRunResult]) {
1131	    if results.len() == 1 {
1132	        print!(
1133	            "{}",
1134	            cleanup_result_surface(&results[0]).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1135	        );
1136	        return;
1137	    }
1138	    let removed_count = results
1139	        .iter()
1140	        .map(|result| result.removed.len())
1141	        .sum::<usize>();
1142	    let subject = format!("{} runs", results.len());
1143	    let primary = "deadreckon status".to_string();
1144	    let secondary = "deadreckon list --all".to_string();
1145	    let mut evidence = vec![
1146	        ("runs".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
1147	        ("removed entries".to_string(), removed_count.to_string()),
1148	    ];
1149	    for result in results.iter().take(5) {
1150	        evidence.push((
1151	            format!("run {}", run_prefix(&result.run_id)),
1152	            format!("{} removed", result.removed.len()),
1153	        ));
1154	    }
1155	    print!(
1156	        "{}",
1157	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
1158	            VerdictKind::Completed,
1159	            "cleanup",
1160	            Some(&subject),
1161	            ExplanationPanel::new(
1162	                "DeadReckon removed the selected temporary run worktrees and branches.",
1163	                "Cleanup completed across multiple runs; inspect status before starting another destructive cleanup.",
1164	                evidence,
1165	            ),
1166	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1167	            vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
1168	        )
1169	        .expect("aggregate cleanup verdict surface must be valid")
1170	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1171	    );
1172	}
1173	
1174	fn cleanup_result_surface(result: &CleanupRunResult) -> VerdictSurface {
1175	    let id = run_prefix(&result.run_id);
1176	    let primary = format!("deadreckon show {id}");
1177	    let secondary = "deadreckon status".to_string();
1178	    let mut evidence = vec![
1179	        ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
1180	        (
1181	            "status".to_string(),
1182	            run_status_label(result.status).to_string(),
1183	        ),
1184	        ("mode".to_string(), result.mode.to_string()),
1185	        (
1186	            "removed entries".to_string(),
1187	            result.removed.len().to_string(),
1188	        ),
1189	        (
1190	            "branch".to_string(),
1191	            if result.keep_branch {
1192	                "kept".to_string()
1193	            } else {
1194	                "removed when present".to_string()
1195	            },
1196	        ),
1197	    ];
1198	    if result.force {
1199	        evidence.push(("force".to_string(), "true".to_string()));
1200	    }
1201	    for (index, item) in result.removed.iter().take(5).enumerate() {
1202	        evidence.push((format!("removed {}", index + 1), item.clone()));
1203	    }
1204	    if result.removed.len() > 5 {
1205	        evidence.push((
1206	            "additional removed entries".to_string(),
1207	            (result.removed.len() - 5).to_string(),
1208	        ));
1209	    }
1210	    let what = match result.reason {
1211	        CleanupReason::Abandoned => {
1212	            "DeadReckon marked the run abandoned and removed its temporary worktree resources."
1213	        }
1214	        CleanupReason::Applied => {
1215	            "DeadReckon removed temporary worktree resources after applying the run."
1216	        }
1217	        CleanupReason::Cleaned => {
1218	            "DeadReckon removed the selected temporary run worktree resources."
1219	        }
1220	    };
1221	    let why = match result.reason {
1222	        CleanupReason::Abandoned => {
1223	            "This is completed abandon cleanup; inspect the run record if you need provenance or docs."
1224	        }
1225	        CleanupReason::Applied | CleanupReason::Cleaned => {
1226	            "This is completed cleanup; inspect the run record before further recovery or deletion."
1227	        }
1228	    };
1229	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1230	        VerdictKind::Completed,
1231	        result.reason.subject(),
1232	        Some(&id),
1233	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1234	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1235	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
1236	    )
1237	    .expect("cleanup verdict surface must be valid")
1238	}
1239	
1240	fn cleanup_no_candidates_surface(completed: bool, all: bool) -> VerdictSurface {
1241	    let mut secondary = Vec::new();
1242	    let primary = if !completed {
1243	        if !all {
1244	            secondary.push("deadreckon cleanup --all-scopes".to_string());
1245	        }
1246	        "deadreckon cleanup --completed".to_string()
1247	    } else if !all {
1248	        "deadreckon cleanup --all-scopes".to_string()
1249	    } else {
1250	        "deadreckon status".to_string()
1251	    };
1252	    cleanup_noop_surface(
1253	        "cleanup",
1254	        None,
1255	        "DeadReckon did not find any temporary run worktrees or branches matching this cleanup filter.",
1256	        "No cleanup mutation was made; broaden the safe filter if you expected completed or cross-scope candidates.",
1257	        vec![
1258	            ("completed filter".to_string(), completed.to_string()),
1259	            ("all scopes".to_string(), all.to_string()),
1260	        ],
1261	        primary,
1262	        secondary,
1263	    )
1264	}
1265	
1266	fn cleanup_noop_surface(
1267	    subject_kind: &str,
1268	    subject: Option<&str>,
1269	    what: impl Into<String>,
1270	    why: impl Into<String>,
1271	    evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
1272	    primary: String,
1273	    secondary: Vec<String>,
1274	) -> VerdictSurface {
1275	    let secondary = secondary
1276	        .iter()
1277	        .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1278	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1279	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1280	        VerdictKind::Noop,
1281	        subject_kind,
1282	        subject,
1283	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1284	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1285	        secondary,
1286	    )
1287	    .expect("cleanup no-op verdict surface must be valid")
1288	}

1290	fn codebase_mode_refusal_error(
1291	    subject_kind: &str,
1292	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1293	    mode: CodebaseMode,
1294	    what: &str,
1295	    primary: String,
1296	    why: &str,
1297	) -> CliError {
1298	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
1299	    CliError::Surface {
1300	        code: 1,
1301	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
1302	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
1303	            subject_kind,
1304	            Some(&id),
1305	            ExplanationPanel::new(
1306	                what,
1307	                why,
1308	                [
1309	                    ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
1310	                    (
1311	                        "status".to_string(),
1312	                        run_status_label(state.status).to_string(),
1313	                    ),
1314	                    ("mode".to_string(), mode.to_string()),
1315	                    (
1316	                        "working".to_string(),
1317	                        state.working_dir.display().to_string(),
1318	                    ),
1319	                ],
1320	            ),
1321	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1322	            Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
1323	        )
1324	        .expect("codebase mode refusal verdict surface must be valid")
1325	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
1326	    }
1327	}

1329	fn apply_mode_error(state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState, mode: CodebaseMode) -> CliError {
1330	    let run_id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
1331	    let primary = match mode {
1332	        CodebaseMode::Copy | CodebaseMode::Fresh => {
1333	            format!("deadreckon export {run_id} --dest <path>")
1334	        }
1335	        CodebaseMode::InPlace => format!("deadreckon undo --run {run_id}"),
1336	        CodebaseMode::Worktree => format!("deadreckon apply {run_id}"),
1337	    };
1338	    codebase_mode_refusal_error(
1339	        "apply",
1340	        state,
1341	        mode,
1342	        &format!("apply requires worktree mode; run was {mode}"),
1343	        primary,
1344	        "Apply only lands isolated worktree branches; choose the recovery command that matches this run's source mode.",
1345	    )
1346	}

1348	pub(crate) async fn extend_command(args: ExtendCommandArgs) -> Result<()> {
1349	    let ExtendCommandArgs {
1350	        parent_run_id,
1351	        new_goal,
1352	        dest,
1353	        max_context_turns,
1354	        no_context,
1355	        max_spend,
1356	        max_wall_seconds,
1357	        provider,
1358	        model,
1359	        sandbox,
1360	        no_docs,
1361	        doc_skill,
1362	        post_actions,
1363	    } = args;
1364	    let new_goal = new_goal.trim().to_string();
1365	    if new_goal.is_empty() {
1366	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1367	            "--goal must be non-empty".to_string(),
1368	        )));
1369	    }
1370	
1371	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
1372	    let parent = load_cli_run(&paths, &parent_run_id)?;
1373	    if parent.status != RunStatus::Completed {
1374	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
1375	            code: 1,
1376	            surface: incomplete_parent_extend_surface(&parent)
1377	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
1378	        });
1379	    }
1380	    let parent_codebase = read_run_codebase_record(&paths, &parent).ok();
1381	    if parent_codebase
1382	        .as_ref()
1383	        .is_some_and(|record| record.mode == CodebaseMode::InPlace)
1384	    {
1385	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
1386	            code: 1,
1387	            surface: in_place_parent_extend_surface(&parent, &new_goal)
1388	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
1389	        });
1390	    }
1391	    let parent_library = paths.library_dir(&parent.scope, &parent.run_id);
1392	    if !parent_library.is_dir() {
1393	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::NotFound(
1394	            "parent library missing; cannot extend".to_string(),
1395	        )));
1396	    }
1397	
1398	    let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
1399	    let primary_setup = provider_setup_selection(
1400	        &paths,
1401	        setup::ProviderSetupRequest {
1402	            role: setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::PrimaryRun,
1403	            explicit_provider: provider.as_deref(),
1404	            explicit_model: model.as_deref(),
1405	            config_default_provider: defaults.provider.as_deref(),
1406	            config_doc_provider: defaults.doc_provider.as_deref(),
1407	            run_provider: None,
1408	            auto_subscription_provider: None,
1409	            built_in_default_provider: None,
1410	            use_router_default: true,
1411	            allow_auto_subscription: false,
1412	            require_usable_route: false,
1413	        },
1414	    )?;
1415	    let provider_override = provider_override_from_setup(&primary_setup);
1416	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path_with_model(
1417	        &paths.config_path(),
1418	        provider_override.as_deref(),
1419	        model.as_deref(),
1420	    )?;
1421	    let selected_route = router.selected_route_info();
1422	    let effective_provider = selected_route
1423	        .as_ref()
1424	        .map(|route| route.name.clone())
1425	        .or(primary_setup.provider.clone());
1426	    let effective_max_spend = max_spend.or(defaults.max_spend).or(Some(10.0));
1427	    let effective_max_wall_seconds = max_wall_seconds
1428	        .or(defaults.cli_max_wall_seconds)
1429	        .or(Some(3600.0));
1430	    let effective_doc_skill = doc_skill
1431	        .or(defaults.doc_skill.clone())
1432	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "run-narrator".to_string());
1433	    let doc_provider_selection = doc_provider_selection_from_setup(&doc_provider_setup_selection(
1434	        &paths,
1435	        &defaults,
1436	        None,
1437	        effective_provider.as_deref(),
1438	        false,
1439	    )?);
1440	    let doc_subskills = effective_doc_subskills(&defaults);
1441	    let doc_token_budget = defaults
1442	        .doc_polish_token_budget
1443	        .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_DOC_POLISH_TOKEN_BUDGET);
1444	    let doc_budget_cap = defaults.doc_polish_budget_cap_usd;
1445	    let sandbox = sandbox
1446	        .or(defaults.sandbox.clone())
1447	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());
1448	    let backend: SandboxBackend = sandbox.parse()?;
1449	    let cwd = if parent.cwd.exists() {
1450	        parent.cwd.clone()
1451	    } else {
1452	        std::env::current_dir()?
1453	    };
1454	    let context_turns = context_turns(max_context_turns, no_context);
1455	    if let Some(parent_record) = parent_codebase
1456	        .as_ref()
1457	        .filter(|record| record.mode == CodebaseMode::Worktree)
1458	    {
1459	        return extend_worktree_command(ExtendWorktreeArgs {
1460	            paths,
1461	            parent,
1462	            parent_record: parent_record.clone(),
1463	            new_goal,
1464	            effective_provider,
1465	            effective_max_spend,
1466	            effective_max_wall_seconds,
1467	            doc_provider: doc_provider_selection.provider.clone(),
1468	            doc_provider_source: Some(doc_provider_selection.source.as_str().to_string()),
1469	            doc_subskills: doc_subskills.clone(),
1470	            doc_token_budget,
1471	            doc_budget_cap,
1472	            doc_skill: effective_doc_skill,
1473	            no_docs,
1474	            backend,
1475	            provider_override: provider_override.clone(),
1476	            model: model.clone(),
1477	            provider_source: primary_setup.source.as_str().to_string(),
1478	            post_actions,
1479	            context_turns,
1480	        })
1481	        .await;
1482	    }
1483	    let mut state = create_run(
1484	        &paths,
1485	        RunOptions {
1486	            goal: new_goal.clone(),
1487	            cwd,
1488	            sandbox: backend.to_string(),
1489	            provider: effective_provider.clone(),
1490	            skill_name: parent.skill_name.clone(),
1491	            max_spend_usd: effective_max_spend,
1492	            max_wall_seconds: effective_max_wall_seconds,
1493	            run_id: None,
1494	            codebase: None,
1495	        },
1496	    )?;
1497	    align_extended_run_with_parent(&paths, &mut state, &parent)?;
1498	
1499	    let mut lock = match acquire_lock(
1500	        &paths,
1501	        &parent.task_key,
1502	        &state.run_id,
1503	        &parent.scope,
1504	        "extend",
1505	        deadreckon_core::lock::DEFAULT_STALE_AFTER,
1506	    ) {
1507	        Ok(lock) => lock,
1508	        Err(error) => {
1509	            cleanup_new_run(&state);
1510	            return Err(error.into());
1511	        }
1512	    };
1513	    deadreckon_core::state::write_current_pointer(&paths, &state)?;
1514	
1515	    if let Some(dest) = dest {
1516	        let dest = absolute_dest(dest)?;
1517	        refuse_dest_inside_home(&paths, &dest, "extend")?;
1518	        prepare_empty_dest(&dest, false)?;
1519	        remove_if_exists(&state.working_dir)?;
1520	        state.working_dir = dest;
1521	    }
1522	    seed_working_from_library(&parent_library, &state.working_dir)?;
1523	    write_parent_marker(
1524	        &state.working_dir.join(".deadreckon").join("parent.json"),
1525	        &extended_parent_marker(&parent, &new_goal, context_turns),
1526	    )?;
1527	    write_parent_history(&state, &parent, context_turns)?;
1528	    commands::acceptance::copy_existing_acceptance_into_run(
1529	        &state,
1530	        &[&state.cwd, &state.working_dir],
1531	    )?;
1532	    append_trace(
1533	        &state,
1534	        &TraceRecord {
1535	            timestamp: Utc::now(),
1536	            run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
1537	            turn: 0,

35	pub(crate) fn build_sub_orchestrator_command(
36	    launch: &CampaignSubLaunch<'_>,

38	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
39	    let mut command = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe()?);
40	    command
41	        .current_dir(launch.source_dir)
42	        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", launch.home)
43	        .env("DEADRECKON_HINTS", "0")
44	        .env("DEADRECKON_SCOPE_ROOT", launch.launch_dir)
45	        .env(campaign::ENV_DEPTH, "1")
46	        .env(campaign::ENV_ROOT, launch.campaign_id)
47	        .env(campaign::ENV_SUB_RESULT, launch.launch_dir);
48	    if !launch.ancestor_task_keys.is_empty() {
49	        command.env(
50	            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS,
51	            launch.ancestor_task_keys.join(","),
52	        );
53	    }
54	    if !launch.ancestor_scopes.is_empty() {
55	        command.env(
56	            campaign::ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES,
57	            launch.ancestor_scopes.join(","),
58	        );
59	    }
60	    command
61	        .arg("orchestrate")
62	        .arg("full-plan")
63	        .arg(launch.sub_goal)
64	        .arg("--n")
65	        .arg(launch.sub_n.to_string())
66	        .arg("--yes")
67	        .arg("--no-hints")
68	        .arg("--sandbox")
69	        .arg(launch.sandbox);
70	    if launch.plain {
71	        command.arg("--plain");
72	    }
73	    if let Some(max_spend) = launch.max_spend {
74	        command.arg("--max-spend").arg(format!("{max_spend:.6}"));
75	    }
76	    if let Some(planner) = launch.planner_provider {
77	        command.arg("--planner-provider").arg(planner);
78	    }
79	    if let Some(provider) = launch.child_provider {
80	        command.arg("--provider").arg(provider);
81	    }
82	    Ok(command)
83	}

92	/// Write a sub-orchestrator's result sidecar. Called at the end of
93	/// `orchestrate full-plan` when launched by a campaign (DEADRECKON_CAMPAIGN_SUB_RESULT
94	/// is set): records the plan id and its merged result run for the meta-coordinator.
95	pub(crate) fn record_sub_orchestrator_result(plan_id: &str, launch_dir: &Path, ok: bool) {
96	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
97	    let result_run_id = deadreckon_core::plan::load_plan(&paths, plan_id)
98	        .ok()
99	        .and_then(|plan| plan.merged_run_id);
100	    let sub_id = launch_dir
101	        .file_name()
102	        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
103	        .unwrap_or("sub")
104	        .to_string();
105	    let result = deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult {
106	        schema_version: 1,
107	        sub_id,
108	        plan_id: Some(plan_id.to_string()),
109	        result_run_id,
110	        ok,
111	    };
112	    let _ = deadreckon_core::campaign::write_sub_result(launch_dir, &result);
113	}

483	/// Create a promoted result run from the composed campaign tree, binding the
484	/// roll-up into the marker signature. Mirrors `create_merged_plan_run`.
485	fn promote_campaign_result(
486	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
487	    campaign_id: &str,
488	    merge_dir: &Path,
489	    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
490	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::PipelineState> {
491	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
492	    let mut state = create_run(
493	        paths,
494	        RunOptions {
495	            goal: format!("campaign {}", run_prefix(campaign_id)),
496	            cwd,
497	            sandbox: "none".to_string(),
498	            provider: Some("deadreckon:campaign".to_string()),
499	            skill_name: "default-coding".to_string(),
500	            max_spend_usd: None,
501	            max_wall_seconds: None,
502	            run_id: None,
503	            codebase: None,
504	        },
505	    )?;
506	    remove_if_exists(&state.working_dir)?;
507	    copy_tree(merge_dir, &state.working_dir)?;
508	    deadreckon_core::campaign::write_campaign_rollup_at_run_root(&state.run_root, rollup)?;
509	    write_acceptance_marker(
510	        &state.run_root,
511	        state.run_id.clone(),
512	        state.working_dir.clone(),
513	        1,
514	    )?;
515	    state.set_phase_status(PhaseId(60), PhaseStatus::Completed)?;
516	    save_state(&state)?;
517	    promote_completed_run(paths, &mut state)?;
518	    Ok(state)
519	}

521	fn write_campaign_manifest(
522	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
523	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
524	    result_state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
525	    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
526	) -> Result<()> {
527	    let library_dir = paths.library_dir(&result_state.scope, &result_state.run_id);
528	    let manifest = serde_json::json!({
529	        "schema_version": 1,
530	        "campaign_id": campaign.campaign_id,
531	        "root_goal": campaign.root_goal,
532	        "n": campaign.n,
533	        "depth": campaign.depth,
534	        "subs": campaign.sub_goals.iter().map(|sub| serde_json::json!({
535	            "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
536	            "goal": sub.goal,
537	            "sub_plan_id": sub.sub_plan_id,
538	            "result_run_id": sub.result_run_id,
539	        })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
540	        "result_run_id": result_state.run_id,
541	        "rollup_verdict": rollup.rollup_verdict,
542	        "refused_subs": rollup.refused_subs,
543	        "caveat_subs": rollup.caveat_subs,
544	    });
545	    let path = library_dir.join("deadreckon-campaign-manifest.json");
546	    fs::create_dir_all(&library_dir)?;
547	    fs::write(
548	        &path,
549	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
550	            path: path.clone(),
551	            source,
552	        })?,
553	    )?;
554	    Ok(())
555	}

589	fn campaign_as_merge_repair_plan(
590	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
591	    campaign_dir: &Path,
592	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
593	    parent_cwd: &Path,
594	) -> Result<Plan> {
595	    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
596	    for (index, sub) in campaign.sub_goals.iter().enumerate() {
597	        let Some(run_id) = sub.result_run_id.clone() else {
598	            continue;
599	        };
600	        let mut task = PlanTask::new(
601	            index as u32,
602	            format!("{} {}", sub.sub_id, sub.goal),
603	            sub.goal.clone(),
604	            PlanRole::Child,
605	            campaign.providers.default_child.clone(),
606	        );
607	        task.task_id = sub.sub_id.clone();
608	        task.active_form = sub.goal.clone();
609	        task.worker_spec = campaign_sub_context_path(paths, campaign_dir, sub);
610	        task.summary_path = campaign_sub_summary_path(paths, sub);
611	        task.child_run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
612	        task.child_scope = sub
613	            .scope
614	            .clone()
615	            .or_else(|| load_run(paths, &run_id).ok().map(|state| state.scope));
616	        task.status = PlanTaskStatus::Completed;
617	        tasks.push(task);
618	    }
619	    let mut plan = Plan::new(
620	        campaign.root_goal.clone(),
621	        PlanMode::FullPlan,
622	        tasks,
623	        campaign.providers.clone(),
624	        None,
625	        campaign.deadreckon_version.clone(),
626	    )
627	    .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
628	    plan.plan_id = campaign.campaign_id.clone();
629	    plan.status = PlanStatus::Forked;
630	    plan.forked_at = campaign.forked_at;
631	    plan.parent_cwd = Some(parent_cwd.to_path_buf());
632	    Ok(plan)
633	}

642	    plan.status = PlanStatus::Merged;
643	    plan.merged_at = campaign.merged_at;
644	    plan.merged_run_id = campaign.merged_run_id.clone();
645	    Ok(plan)

661	fn campaign_rollup_refusal_message(rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup) -> String {
662	    if rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
663	        "campaign failed: one or more sub-orchestrators did not merge".to_string()
664	    } else {
665	        format!(
666	            "campaign failed: refused sub(s) {}",
667	            rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")
668	        )
669	    }

672	struct CampaignRepairExecution<'a> {
673	    paths: &'a DeadreckonPaths,
674	    campaign_dir: &'a Path,
675	    campaign_obj: &'a mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
676	    rollup: &'a deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
677	    parent_cwd: &'a Path,
678	    repair_provider: Option<&'a str>,
679	    repair_mode: MergeRepairMode,
680	    repair_attempts: u32,
681	    quiet: bool,
682	}
683	
684	async fn repair_and_promote_campaign_result(
685	    request: CampaignRepairExecution<'_>,
686	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::PipelineState> {
687	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
688	
689	    let CampaignRepairExecution {
690	        paths,
691	        campaign_dir,
692	        campaign_obj,
693	        rollup,
694	        parent_cwd,
695	        repair_provider,
696	        repair_mode,
697	        repair_attempts,
698	        quiet,
699	    } = request;
700	
701	    if !campaign::campaign_can_complete(campaign_obj, rollup) {
702	        campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
703	        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
704	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
705	            campaign_dir,
706	            "rollup_refused",
707	            serde_json::json!({ "refused_subs": rollup.refused_subs }),
708	        )?;
709	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
710	            &campaign_rollup_refusal_message(rollup),
711	            "deadreckon show <campaign-id> --why-failed",
712	        )));
713	    }
714	
715	    let campaign_id = campaign_obj.campaign_id.clone();
716	    let merge_plan = campaign_as_merge_repair_plan(paths, campaign_dir, campaign_obj, parent_cwd)?;
717	    let mut merge = compose_plan_merge_working(paths, &merge_plan, PlanMergeStrategy::DagAware)?;
718	    let unresolved_conflicts = merge.unresolved_conflicts();
719	    if !unresolved_conflicts.is_empty() {
720	        let repair_context = MergeRepairContext::final_merge(paths, &merge_plan);
721	        let provider = resolve_merge_repair_provider(paths, &merge_plan, repair_provider)?;
722	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
723	            campaign_dir,
724	            "campaign_merge_conflict",
725	            serde_json::json!({
726	                "conflicts": unresolved_conflicts.len(),
727	                "provider": provider,
728	            }),
729	        )?;
730	        write_merge_repair_request(
731	            paths,
732	            &merge_plan,
733	            &repair_context,
734	            provider.as_deref(),
735	            &unresolved_conflicts,
736	        )?;
737	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
738	            campaign_dir,
739	            "campaign_repair_planned",
740	            serde_json::json!({
741	                "conflicts": unresolved_conflicts.len(),
742	                "provider": provider,
743	            }),
744	        )?;
745	        let Some(provider) = provider else {
746	            campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
747	            campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
748	            campaign::append_campaign_event(
749	                campaign_dir,
750	                "campaign_repair_failed",
751	                serde_json::json!({ "reason": "campaign merge repair needs a configured provider" }),
752	            )?;
753	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
754	                "campaign failed: cross-sub file conflict; repair needs a configured provider",
755	                "deadreckon providers list --all",
756	            )));
757	        };
758	        campaign::append_campaign_event(
759	            campaign_dir,
760	            "campaign_repair_started",
761	            serde_json::json!({ "mode": repair_mode.as_str(), "provider": provider }),
762	        )?;
763	        match run_merge_repair(
764	            paths,
765	            &merge_plan,
766	            &repair_context,
767	            &MergeRepairOptions {
768	                provider: &provider,
769	                mode: repair_mode,
770	                attempts: repair_attempts,
771	                quiet,
772	            },
773	            &mut merge,
774	        )
775	        .await
776	        {
777	            Ok(repaired) => {
778	                campaign::append_campaign_event(
779	                    campaign_dir,
780	                    "campaign_repaired",
781	                    serde_json::json!({
782	                        "strategy": repaired.strategy,
783	                        "repair_run_id": repaired.repair_run_id,
784	                    }),
785	                )?;
786	                write_plan_merge_conflicts(
787	                    paths,
788	                    &merge_plan,
789	                    PlanMergeStrategy::DagAware,
790	                    &merge.conflicts,
791	                )?;
792	            }
793	            Err(error) => {
794	                let reason = error.to_string();
795	                campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
796	                campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
797	                campaign::append_campaign_event(
798	                    campaign_dir,
799	                    "campaign_repair_failed",
800	                    serde_json::json!({ "reason": reason }),
801	                )?;
802	                return Err(error);
803	            }
804	        }
805	    }
806	
807	    let merge_dir = paths.merge_working(&campaign_id);
808	    let result_state = promote_campaign_result(paths, &campaign_id, &merge_dir, rollup)?;
809	    campaign_obj.merged_run_id = Some(result_state.run_id.clone());
810	    campaign_obj.merged_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
811	    campaign_obj.status = campaign::CampaignStatus::Merged;
812	    campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign_obj)?;
813	    write_campaign_manifest(paths, campaign_obj, &result_state, rollup)?;
814	    campaign::append_campaign_event(
815	        campaign_dir,
816	        "campaign_completed",
817	        serde_json::json!({ "merged_run_id": result_state.run_id }),
818	    )?;
819	    Ok(result_state)
820	}

838	
839	pub(crate) fn campaign_verdict_surface(
840	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
841	    rollup: Option<&deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup>,
842	) -> VerdictSurface {
843	    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{CampaignStatus, RollupVerdict, SubGoalStatus};
844	
845	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
846	    let merged_subs = campaign
847	        .sub_goals
848	        .iter()
849	        .filter(|sub| sub.status == SubGoalStatus::Merged)
850	        .count();
851	    let repairable = campaign.status == CampaignStatus::Failed
852	        && rollup.is_some_and(|rollup| rollup.rollup_verdict != RollupVerdict::Clean);
853	    let (kind, what, why) = match campaign.status {
854	        CampaignStatus::Merged => (
855	            VerdictKind::Completed,
856	            "The campaign assembled its sub-orchestrator results into one result run.",
857	            "DeadReckon has a campaign artifact; the recommended command lands or inspects that result.",
858	        ),
859	        CampaignStatus::Failed if repairable => (
860	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
861	            "The campaign stopped after sub-orchestrator work produced a refused roll-up.",
862	            "This is a deterministic campaign-level refusal, not a provider crash; repair can inspect the sub-results and produce a consolidated artifact.",
863	        ),
864	        CampaignStatus::Failed => (
865	            VerdictKind::Failed,
866	            "The campaign stopped before producing a merged result.",
867	            "No repairable roll-up evidence is available, so failure inspection is the safest next command.",
868	        ),
869	        CampaignStatus::Killed => (
870	            VerdictKind::Killed,
871	            "The campaign was stopped before all sub-orchestrators could finish.",
872	            "Killed campaign state should be inspected before cleanup or relaunch.",
873	        ),
874	        CampaignStatus::Forked => (
875	            VerdictKind::Paused,
876	            "The campaign has launched sub-orchestrators and is not merged yet.",
877	            "Attach is the safest next command because sub-plan state may still be active.",
878	        ),
879	        CampaignStatus::Pending => (
880	            VerdictKind::Preview,
881	            "The campaign record exists, but no sub-orchestrator has started yet.",
882	            "Attaching or launching the stored campaign state is the next non-destructive step.",
883	        ),
884	    };
885	    let primary = campaign_primary_action(campaign, repairable);
886	    let mut evidence = vec![
887	        ("campaign".to_string(), id.clone()),
888	        (
889	            "status".to_string(),
890	            campaign_status_text(campaign.status).to_string(),
891	        ),
892	        (
893	            "subs".to_string(),
894	            format!("{merged_subs}/{} merged", campaign.n),
895	        ),
896	    ];
897	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
898	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(result_run_id)));
899	    }
900	    if let Some(rollup) = rollup {
901	        evidence.push((
902	            "roll-up".to_string(),
903	            rollup_verdict_text(rollup.rollup_verdict).to_string(),
904	        ));
905	        if !rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
906	            evidence.push(("refused subs".to_string(), rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")));
907	        }
908	        if !rollup.caveat_subs.is_empty() {
909	            evidence.push(("caveat subs".to_string(), rollup.caveat_subs.join(", ")));
910	        }
911	    }
912	    let secondary = campaign_secondary_actions(campaign, &primary);
913	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
914	        kind,
915	        "campaign",
916	        Some(&id),
917	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
918	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
919	        secondary
920	            .iter()
921	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
922	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
923	    )
924	    .expect("campaign verdict surface must have one primary action")
925	}
926	
927	fn campaign_primary_action(
928	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
929	    repairable: bool,
930	) -> String {
931	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
932	    if repairable {
933	        return format!("deadreckon campaign repair {id}");
934	    }
935	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
936	        return format!("deadreckon apply {}", run_prefix(result_run_id));
937	    }
938	    match campaign.status {
939	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed => {
940	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
941	        }
942	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Killed => {
943	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
944	        }
945	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Forked
946	        | deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Pending => format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
947	        deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Merged => format!("deadreckon show {id}"),
948	    }
949	}
950	
951	fn campaign_secondary_actions(
952	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
953	    primary: &str,
954	) -> Vec<String> {
955	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
956	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
957	    for command in [
958	        format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
959	        format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed"),
960	        campaign
961	            .merged_run_id
962	            .as_deref()
963	            .map(|run_id| format!("deadreckon show {}", run_prefix(run_id)))
964	            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}")),
965	    ] {
966	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
967	            actions.push(command);
968	        }
969	    }
970	    actions
971	}

973	pub(crate) async fn campaign_command(args: CampaignArgs) -> Result<()> {
974	    use deadreckon_core::campaign;
975	
976	    let goal = args.goal.trim().to_string();
977	    if goal.is_empty() {
978	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
979	            "campaign goal must be non-empty",
980	            "deadreckon campaign \"your goal\"",
981	        )));
982	    }
983	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
984	    let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
985	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
986	    let scope = workspace_scope(&cwd)?;
987	    let mut n = if let Some(n) = args.n {
988	        n
989	    } else {
990	        let provider = args
991	            .planner_provider
992	            .as_deref()
993	            .or(args.provider.as_deref())
994	            .map(ToString::to_string)
995	            .or_else(|| goal_shape_provider_route(&paths, &defaults, None));
996	        let recommendation =
997	            classify_goal_shape_for_start(&paths, &cwd, &goal, provider.as_deref(), args.plain)
998	                .await;
999	        write_goal_shape_preview_record(&paths, &scope, &recommendation)?;
1000	        recommendation
1001	            .n
1002	            .unwrap_or_else(|| recommend_child_count_for_goal(&goal, CliPlanMode::FullPlan))
1003	    };
1004	    deadreckon_core::plan::validate_task_count(usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1005	
1006	    let lineage = campaign::lineage_from_env();
1007	    if lineage.depth + 1 >= campaign::CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
1008	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
1009	            code: 1,
1010	            surface: campaign_depth_refusal_surface(
1011	                &goal,
1012	                n,
1013	                lineage.depth,
1014	                args.planner_provider.as_deref(),
1015	                args.provider.as_deref(),
1016	            )
1017	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(args.no_hints)),
1018	        });
1019	    }
1020	
1021	    let providers = resolve_plan_providers(
1022	        &paths,
1023	        &defaults,
1024	        PlanMode::FullPlan,
1025	        args.planner_provider.clone(),
1026	        args.provider.clone(),
1027	        None,
1028	        None,
1029	    )?;
1030	    let overrides = BTreeMap::new();
1031	    let tasks = build_full_plan_tasks(
1032	        &paths,
1033	        &goal,
1034	        n,
1035	        &providers,
1036	        &overrides,
1037	        &cwd,
1038	        args.plain,
1039	        args.no_hints,
1040	        false,
1041	    )
1042	    .await?;
1043	    let sub_goal_strings: Vec<String> = tasks.iter().map(|task| task.goal.clone()).collect();
1044	    let sub_goals =
1045	        campaign::build_sub_goals(sub_goal_strings, usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1046	    let sub_keys: Vec<String> = sub_goals.iter().map(|sub| sub.task_key.clone()).collect();
1047	    campaign::guard(
1048	        lineage.depth,
1049	        &lineage.ancestor_task_keys,
1050	        &lineage.ancestor_scopes,
1051	        &sub_keys,
1052	        &[],
1053	    )?;
1054	
1055	    let mut campaign_obj = campaign::Campaign::new(
1056	        goal.clone(),
1057	        sub_goals,
1058	        providers.clone(),
1059	        lineage.depth,
1060	        args.max_spend,
1061	        args.max_wall_seconds,

1262	fn campaign_depth_refusal_surface(
1263	    goal: &str,
1264	    n: u8,
1265	    current_depth: u32,
1266	    planner_provider: Option<&str>,
1267	    child_provider: Option<&str>,
1268	) -> VerdictSurface {
1269	    let mut primary = format!(
1270	        "deadreckon orchestrate full-plan \"{}\" --n {}",
1271	        shell_display_quote(goal),
1272	        n
1273	    );
1274	    if let Some(provider) = planner_provider {
1275	        primary.push_str(&format!(" --planner-provider {provider}"));
1276	    }
1277	    if let Some(provider) = child_provider {
1278	        primary.push_str(&format!(" --provider {provider}"));
1279	    }
1280	
1281	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1282	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
1283	        "campaign",
1284	        None,
1285	        ExplanationPanel::new(
1286	            "DeadReckon refused to start a nested campaign because depth cap 2 reached.",
1287	            "This is a controlled recursion guard; use an orchestrated full-plan inside the sub-orchestrator instead of starting another campaign coordinator.",
1288	            [
1289	                ("goal", goal.to_string()),
1290	                ("current depth", current_depth.to_string()),
1291	                (
1292	                    "depth cap",
1293	                    deadreckon_core::campaign::CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH.to_string(),
1294	                ),
1295	                ("requested subs", n.to_string()),
1296	                ("reason", "sub-orchestrators cannot campaign again".to_string()),
1297	            ],
1298	        ),
1299	        [("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1300	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
1301	    )
1302	    .expect("campaign depth refusal must have one primary action")
1303	}

1305	fn campaign_repair_refusal_surface(
1306	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1307	    kind: VerdictKind,
1308	    what: impl Into<String>,
1309	    why: impl Into<String>,
1310	    primary: String,
1311	) -> VerdictSurface {
1312	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);
1313	    let mut evidence = vec![
1314	        ("campaign".to_string(), id.clone()),
1315	        (
1316	            "status".to_string(),
1317	            campaign_status_text(campaign.status).to_string(),
1318	        ),
1319	        ("subs".to_string(), campaign.n.to_string()),
1320	    ];
1321	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
1322	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(result_run_id)));
1323	    }
1324	    let mut secondary = Vec::new();
1325	    for command in [
1326	        format!("deadreckon show {id}"),
1327	        format!("deadreckon attach {id}"),
1328	        campaign
1329	            .merged_run_id
1330	            .as_deref()
1331	            .map(|run_id| format!("deadreckon show {}", run_prefix(run_id)))
1332	            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")),
1333	    ] {
1334	        if command != primary && !secondary.contains(&command) {
1335	            secondary.push(command);
1336	        }
1337	    }
1338	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1339	        kind,
1340	        "campaign",
1341	        Some(&id),
1342	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1343	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1344	        secondary
1345	            .iter()
1346	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1347	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1348	    )
1349	    .expect("campaign repair refusal surface must have one primary action")
1350	}

146	        from_step,
147	        max_spend_add,
148	        reset_breaker,
149	        force,
150	        step,
151	        extend,
152	        reapply,
153	        insert_at,
154	        no_confirm,
155	        full,
156	        all,
157	        why_failed,
158	        json,
159	    } = args;
160	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
161	    if args.first().is_some_and(|arg| arg == "help") {
162	        print_chain_help(args.get(1).map(String::as_str));
163	        return Ok(());
164	    }
165	    let Some(first) = args.first().map(String::as_str) else {
166	        if from_file.is_some() || from_stdin {
167	            let goals = collect_chain_goals(&[], from_file, from_stdin, no_hints)?;
168	            return chain_create_command(ChainCreateOptions {
169	                paths,
170	                root_goal: format!("manual: {} steps", goals.len()),
171	                goals,
172	                from_file: None,
173	                from_stdin: false,
174	                draft,
175	                yes,
176	                detach,
177	                branch_policy,
178	                apply_mode,
179	                apply_strategy,
180	                apply_allowlist,
181	                on_fail,
182	                circuit_breaker_threshold,
183	                max_spend,
184	                max_wall_seconds,
185	                provider,
186	                model,
187	                sandbox,
188	                base,
189	                n,
190	                no_hints,
191	                quiet,
192	                plain,
193	            })
194	            .await
195	            .map(|_| ());
196	        }
197	        return chain_status_command(None, all, full, plain, json);
198	    };
199	
200	    match first {
201	        "plan" | "expand" => {
202	            let root_goal = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
203	                chain_create_refusal_surface(
204	                    VerdictKind::Blocked,
205	                    None,
206	                    "DeadReckon did not plan the chain because chain plan needs a goal.",
207	                    "The planner needs a root goal before it can decompose work into ordered chain steps.",
208	                    [
209	                        ("command".to_string(), "chain plan".to_string()),
210	                        ("goal".to_string(), "missing".to_string()),
211	                    ],
212	                    "deadreckon chain plan \"build the app\" --n 4".to_string(),
213	                    no_hints,
214	                )
215	            })?;
216	            chain_plan_command(ChainCreateOptions {
217	                paths,
218	                root_goal,
219	                goals: Vec::new(),
220	                from_file,
221	                from_stdin,
222	                draft,
223	                yes,
224	                detach,
225	                branch_policy,
226	                apply_mode,
227	                apply_strategy,
228	                apply_allowlist,
229	                on_fail,
230	                circuit_breaker_threshold,
231	                max_spend,
232	                max_wall_seconds,
233	                provider,
234	                model,
235	                sandbox,
236	                base,
237	                n,
238	                no_hints,
239	                quiet,
240	                plain,
241	            })
242	            .await
243	        }
244	        "run" => {
245	            let id = args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest");
246	            if id == "latest" || id == "last" {
247	                let latest = resolve_chain_id(&paths, id, all)?;
248	                return chain_run_command(
249	                    &paths,
250	                    &latest,
251	                    ChainRunOptions {
252	                        detach,
253	                        quiet,
254	                        plain,
255	                        from_step,
256	                        max_spend_add,
257	                        reset_breaker,
258	                        apply_mode: Some(apply_mode),
259	                        skip_acceptance_prompt: yes,
260	                    },
261	                )
262	                .await;
263	            }
264	            let id = resolve_chain_id(&paths, id, all)?;
265	            chain_run_command(
266	                &paths,
267	                &id,
268	                ChainRunOptions {
269	                    detach,
270	                    quiet,
271	                    plain,
272	                    from_step,
273	                    max_spend_add,
274	                    reset_breaker,
275	                    apply_mode: Some(apply_mode),
276	                    skip_acceptance_prompt: yes,
277	                },
278	            )
279	            .await
280	        }
281	        "resume" => {
282	            let id = resolve_chain_id(
283	                &paths,
284	                args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
285	                all,
286	            )?;
287	            chain_run_command(
288	                &paths,
289	                &id,
290	                ChainRunOptions {
291	                    detach,
292	                    quiet,
293	                    plain,
294	                    from_step,
295	                    max_spend_add,
296	                    reset_breaker,
297	                    apply_mode: Some(apply_mode),
298	                    skip_acceptance_prompt: yes,
299	                },
300	            )
301	            .await
302	        }
303	        "status" => chain_status_command(args.get(1).map(String::as_str), all, full, plain, json),
304	        "list" => chain_list_command(all, full, json),
305	        "show" => chain_show_command(
306	            &paths,
307	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
308	            why_failed,
309	            json,
310	        ),
311	        "attach" => chain_attach_command(
312	            &paths,
313	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
314	            plain,
315	        ),
316	        "pause" => chain_pause_command(
317	            &paths,
318	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
319	            reason,
320	        ),
321	        "kill" => chain_kill_command(
322	            &paths,
323	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
324	            force,
325	        ),
326	        "undo" => chain_undo_command(
327	            &paths,
328	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
329	            step,
330	            no_confirm,
331	        ),
332	        "extend" => {
333	            let id = args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest");
334	            let step_goal = args.get(2).cloned().or(extend).ok_or_else(|| {
335	                chain_create_refusal_surface(
336	                    VerdictKind::Blocked,
337	                    None,
338	                    "DeadReckon did not extend the chain because chain extend needs a step goal.",
339	                    "Extending a chain mutates ordered chain state, so DeadReckon needs the new step goal before it can preview or write that change.",
340	                    [
341	                        ("command".to_string(), "chain extend".to_string()),
342	                        ("chain".to_string(), id.to_string()),
343	                        ("step goal".to_string(), "missing".to_string()),
344	                    ],
345	                    format!("deadreckon chain extend {id} \"add tests\""),
346	                    no_hints,
347	                )
348	            })?;
349	            chain_extend_command(&paths, id, step_goal, insert_at, max_spend_add)
350	        }
351	        "redo" => chain_redo_command(
352	            &paths,
353	            args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("latest"),
354	            step,
355	            extend,
356	            reapply,
357	        ),
358	        "hooks" if args.get(1).is_some_and(|arg| arg == "list") => chain_hooks_list_command(),
359	        maybe_id if args.len() == 1 && looks_like_chain_id(maybe_id) => {
360	            Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
361	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
362	                Some(maybe_id),
363	                "DeadReckon did not run the chain because chain <id> is ambiguous.",
364	                "A chain id without an explicit verb could mean run, show, attach, pause, or another action, so DeadReckon refused before changing chain state.",
365	                [
366	                    ("command".to_string(), "chain <id>".to_string()),
367	                    ("chain".to_string(), maybe_id.to_string()),
368	                    ("verb".to_string(), "missing".to_string()),
369	                ],
370	                format!("deadreckon chain run {maybe_id}"),
371	                no_hints,
372	            ))
373	        }
374	        _ => {
375	            let goals = collect_chain_goals(&args, from_file, from_stdin, no_hints)?;
376	            chain_create_command(ChainCreateOptions {
377	                paths,
378	                root_goal: format!("manual: {} steps", goals.len()),
379	                goals,
380	                from_file: None,
381	                from_stdin: false,
382	                draft,
383	                yes,
384	                detach,
385	                branch_policy,
386	                apply_mode,
387	                apply_strategy,
388	                apply_allowlist,
389	                on_fail,
390	                circuit_breaker_threshold,
391	                max_spend,
392	                max_wall_seconds,
393	                provider,
394	                model,
395	                sandbox,
396	                base,
397	                n,
398	                no_hints,
399	                quiet,
400	                plain,
401	            })
402	            .await
403	            .map(|_| ())
404	        }
405	    }
406	}
