446	async fn chain_plan_command(options: ChainCreateOptions) -> Result<()> {
447	    let n = options.n.clamp(2, 12);
448	    let paths = options.paths.clone();
449	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path_with_model(
450	        &paths.config_path(),
451	        options.provider.as_deref(),
452	        options.model.as_deref(),
453	    )?;
454	    let prompt = chain_planner_prompt(&options.root_goal, n);
455	    let response = with_cli_wait_status(
456	        "drafting chain plan",
457	        router.complete(&ProviderRequest {
458	            prompt,
459	            max_output_tokens: u32::from(n) * 96,
460	            cwd: Some(std::env::current_dir()?),
461	            output_path: None,
462	            sandbox_backend: None,
463	            pid_file: None,
464	            cancellation_token: None,
465	        }),
466	    )
467	    .await
468	    .map_err(|err| {
469	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
470	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
471	            None,
472	            &format!("chain planner provider failed: {err}"),
473	            "DeadReckon could not get a valid decomposition from the configured provider, so it refused before writing chain state.",
474	            [
475	                ("goal".to_string(), options.root_goal.clone()),
476	                (
477	                    "provider".to_string(),
478	                    options.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("default").to_string(),
479	                ),
480	            ],
481	            "deadreckon chain \"step one\" \"step two\"".to_string(),
482	            options.no_hints,
483	        )
484	    })?;
485	    let goals = parse_planner_goals(&response.content, n, &options.root_goal, options.no_hints)?;
486	    let chain_id = chain_create_command(ChainCreateOptions { goals, ..options }).await?;
487	    append_chain_planner_spend(&paths, &chain_id, &response)?;
488	    Ok(())
489	}
490	
491	async fn chain_create_command(options: ChainCreateOptions) -> Result<String> {
492	    let ChainCreateOptions {
493	        paths,
494	        root_goal,
495	        mut goals,
496	        from_file,
497	        from_stdin,
498	        draft,
499	        yes,
500	        detach,
501	        branch_policy,
502	        apply_mode,
503	        apply_strategy,
504	        apply_allowlist,
505	        on_fail,
506	        circuit_breaker_threshold,
507	        max_spend,
508	        max_wall_seconds,
509	        provider,
510	        model,
511	        sandbox,
512	        base,
513	        n: _,
514	        no_hints,
515	        quiet,
516	        plain,
517	    } = options;
518	    if goals.is_empty() {
519	        goals = collect_chain_goals(&[], from_file, from_stdin, no_hints)?;
520	    }
521	    if goals.len() < 2 {
522	        let primary = goals
523	            .first()
524	            .map(|goal| format!("deadreckon run {}", quote_chain_goal_arg(goal)))
525	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "deadreckon run \"<goal>\"".to_string());
526	        return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
527	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
528	            None,
529	            "DeadReckon did not create the chain because chain must have >= 2 steps.",
530	            "A single goal should run as a normal run; chain state is only for ordered multi-step work.",
531	            [
532	                ("requested steps".to_string(), goals.len().to_string()),
533	                ("minimum steps".to_string(), "2".to_string()),
534	            ],
535	            primary,
536	            no_hints,
537	        ));
538	    }
539	    if goals.len() > 12 {
540	        return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
541	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
542	            None,
543	            "DeadReckon did not create the chain because chain capped at 12 steps.",
544	            "Longer step lists need to be split into multiple chains or replanned so one chain stays reviewable and recoverable.",
545	            [
546	                ("requested steps".to_string(), goals.len().to_string()),
547	                ("maximum steps".to_string(), "12".to_string()),
548	            ],
549	            "deadreckon chain plan \"<larger goal>\" --n 12".to_string(),
550	            no_hints,
551	        ));
552	    }
553	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
554	    let git_root = deadreckon_core::find_git_root(&cwd)?.ok_or_else(|| {
555	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
556	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
557	            None,
558	            "DeadReckon did not create the chain because chains require a git repo.",
559	            "Chain runs coordinate branches, checkpoints, and step application against a git repository, so DeadReckon refused before writing chain state.",
560	            [
561	                ("cwd".to_string(), cwd.display().to_string()),
562	                ("git root".to_string(), "not found".to_string()),
563	            ],
564	            "git init".to_string(),
565	            no_hints,
566	        )
567	    })?;
568	    let scope = workspace_scope(&cwd).map_err(CliError::from)?;
569	    let base_ref = base.unwrap_or_else(|| "HEAD".to_string());
570	    let base_sha = git_stdout(&git_root, &["rev-parse", &base_ref])?;
571	    let base_branch = git_stdout(&git_root, &["symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD"])
572	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| base_ref.clone());
573	    let chain = Chain::new(ChainNewOptions {
574	        root_goal,
575	        goals,
576	        scope,
577	        base_branch,
578	        base_sha,
579	        cwd: git_root.clone(),
580	        provider,
581	        model,
582	        sandbox,
583	        branch_policy: parse_branch_policy(&branch_policy)?,
584	        apply_mode: parse_apply_mode(&apply_mode)?,
585	        apply_strategy: parse_apply_strategy(&apply_strategy)?,
586	        apply_allowlist,
587	        on_fail: parse_on_fail(&on_fail)?,
588	        circuit_breaker_threshold,
589	        max_spend_usd: max_spend,
590	        max_wall_seconds,
591	        deadreckon_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
592	    })
593	    .map_err(CliError::from)?;
594	    save_chain(&paths, &chain)?;
595	    append_chain_event(
596	        &paths,
597	        &chain.chain_id,
598	        ChainEventKind::ChainCreated,
599	        None,
600	        json!({ "steps": chain.steps.len(), "draft": draft }),
601	    )?;
602	    if !quiet && (draft || !yes) {
603	        println!("{}", chain_preview(&chain));
604	    }
605	    if draft {
606	        if completion_hints_enabled(no_hints) && !quiet {
607	            println!(
608	                "{} {} with {} steps",
609	                ui_muted("drafted:"),
610	                ui_id(&chain.chain_id),
611	                chain.steps.len()
612	            );
613	            println!(
614	                "{}    {}",
615	                ui_muted("edit:"),
616	                ui_command(format!(
617	                    "vim {}",
618	                    paths.chain_json(&chain.chain_id).display()
619	                ))
620	            );
621	            println!(
622	                "{}     {}",
623	                ui_muted("run:"),
624	                ui_command(format!(
625	                    "deadreckon chain run {}",
626	                    chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)
627	                ))
628	            );
629	        }
630	        return Ok(chain.chain_id);
631	    }
632	    if !yes {
633	        if !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
634	            return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
635	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
636	                Some(&chain.chain_id),
637	                "DeadReckon did not start the chain because non-interactive chain start requires --yes.",
638	                "The chain was drafted, but this session cannot ask for launch confirmation, so DeadReckon stopped before starting the conductor.",
639	                [
640	                    ("chain".to_string(), chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)),
641	                    ("steps".to_string(), chain.steps.len().to_string()),
642	                    ("stdin".to_string(), "non-interactive".to_string()),
643	                ],
644	                "deadreckon chain --yes \"step one\" \"step two\"".to_string(),
645	                no_hints,
646	            ));
647	        }
648	        if !prompt::confirm("start the chain?", true)? {
649	            println!("{}", ui_status("cancelled"));
650	            return Ok(chain.chain_id);
651	        }
652	    }
653	    let chain_id = chain.chain_id.clone();
654	    let auto_attach = chain_should_auto_attach(io::stdout().is_terminal(), detach, quiet, plain);
655	    chain_run_command(
656	        &paths,
657	        &chain_id,
658	        ChainRunOptions {
659	            detach: detach || auto_attach,
660	            quiet,
661	            plain,
662	            from_step: None,
663	            max_spend_add: None,
664	            reset_breaker: false,
665	            apply_mode: None,
666	            skip_acceptance_prompt: yes,
667	        },
668	    )
669	    .await?;
670	    if auto_attach {
671	        chain_attach_command(&paths, &chain_id, false)?;
672	    }
673	    Ok(chain_id)
674	}
675	
676	fn chain_create_refusal_surface<K, V>(
677	    kind: VerdictKind,
678	    chain_id: Option<&str>,
679	    what_happened: impl Into<String>,
680	    why_this_verdict: impl Into<String>,
681	    evidence: impl IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>,
682	    primary: String,
683	    no_hints: bool,
684	) -> CliError
685	where
686	    K: Into<String>,
687	    V: Into<String>,
688	{
689	    let subject = chain_id.map(chain_prefix);
690	    CliError::Surface {
691	        code: 1,
692	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
693	            kind,
694	            "chain",
695	            subject.as_deref(),
696	            ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, evidence),
697	            [("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
698	            Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
699	        )
700	        .expect("chain creation refusal surface must have one primary action")
701	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
702	    }
703	}
704	
705	fn quote_chain_goal_arg(goal: &str) -> String {
706	    format!("\"{}\"", goal.replace('\\', "\\\\").replace('"', "\\\""))
707	}
708	
709	async fn chain_run_command(
710	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
711	    chain_id: &str,
712	    options: ChainRunOptions,
713	) -> Result<()> {
714	    let chain_id = resolve_chain_id(paths, chain_id, false)?;
715	    ensure_chain_acceptance_before_start(paths, &chain_id, &options).await?;
716	    if options.detach {
717	        return detach_chain_conductor(paths, &chain_id, &options);
718	    }
719	    run_chain_conductor(paths, &chain_id, options).await
720	}
721	
722	async fn ensure_chain_acceptance_before_start(
723	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
724	    chain_id: &str,
725	    options: &ChainRunOptions,
726	) -> Result<()> {
727	    if options.skip_acceptance_prompt || options.quiet || !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
728	        return Ok(());
729	    }
730	    let chain = load_chain(paths, chain_id)?;
731	    let _ = ensure_acceptance_before_start(
732	        &chain.cwd,
733	        None,
734	        &chain.root_goal,
735	        chain.provider.clone(),
736	        chain.model.clone(),
737	        false,
738	        "chain",
739	    )
740	    .await?;
741	    Ok(())
742	}
743	
744	async fn run_chain_conductor(
745	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
746	    chain_id: &str,
747	    options: ChainRunOptions,
748	) -> Result<()> {
749	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, chain_id)?;
750	    if let Some(add) = options.max_spend_add {
751	        chain.max_spend_usd = Some(chain.max_spend_usd.unwrap_or(0.0) + add);
752	    }
753	    if options.reset_breaker {
754	        chain.circuit_breaker_consecutive_failures = 0;
755	    }
756	    if let Some(mode) = options.apply_mode.as_deref()
757	        && mode != "auto"
758	    {
759	        chain.apply_mode = parse_apply_mode(mode)?;
760	    }
761	    match chain.status {
762	        ChainStatus::Completed => {
763	            let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
764	            return Err(CliError::Surface {
765	                code: 1,
766	                surface: chain_transition_surface(
767	                    paths,
768	                    &chain,
769	                    VerdictKind::Blocked,
770	                    "DeadReckon did not run the chain because the chain is completed.",
771	                    "Completed chain state is terminal, so inspection is the safest next command before redo or extension.",
772	                    vec![("requested action".to_string(), "chain run".to_string())],
773	                    format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
774	                    Vec::new(),
775	                )
776	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
777	            });
778	        }
779	        ChainStatus::Running if chain.conductor_pid.is_some_and(pid_is_alive) => {
780	            let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
781	            let pid = chain.conductor_pid.unwrap_or_default();
782	            return Err(CliError::Surface {
783	                code: 1,
784	                surface: chain_transition_surface(
785	                    paths,
786	                    &chain,
787	                    VerdictKind::Blocked,
788	                    "DeadReckon did not start another conductor because the chain is already running.",
789	                    "Starting a second conductor would race the live chain state, so attaching to the existing run is the safest next command.",
790	                    vec![
791	                        ("requested action".to_string(), "chain run".to_string()),
792	                        ("conductor pid".to_string(), pid.to_string()),
793	                    ],
794	                    format!("deadreckon chain attach {id}"),
795	                    Vec::new(),
796	                )
797	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
798	            });
799	        }
800	        _ => {}
801	    }
802	    let mut lock = acquire_lock(
803	        paths,
804	        &chain.task_key(),
805	        &chain.chain_id,
806	        &chain.scope,
807	        "chain",
808	        deadreckon_core::lock::DEFAULT_STALE_AFTER,
809	    )?;
810	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Running;
811	    chain.started_at.get_or_insert_with(Utc::now);
812	    chain.paused_reason = None;
813	    chain.conductor_pid = Some(std::process::id());
814	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
815	    let conductor = ConductorState {
816	        schema_version: 1,
817	        chain_id: chain.chain_id.clone(),
818	        conductor_pid: std::process::id(),
819	        started_at: Utc::now(),
820	        live_step: None,
821	        live_run_id: None,
822	        live_child_pid: None,
823	    };
824	    fs::create_dir_all(paths.chain_dir(&chain.chain_id))?;
825	    fs::write(
826	        paths.conductor_json(&chain.chain_id),
827	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&conductor)?,
828	    )?;
829	
830	    let start_index = options.from_step.unwrap_or(0);
831	    let mut completed = true;
832	    for index in 0..chain.steps.len() {
833	        if (index as u32) < start_index {
834	            continue;
835	        }
836	        if matches!(
837	            chain.steps[index].status,
838	            ChainStepStatus::Applied | ChainStepStatus::Skipped
839	        ) {
840	            continue;
841	        }
842	        lock.heartbeat(format!("step-{index}"))?;
843	        let step_cap = per_step_spend_cap(&chain, index);
844	        let step_wall_cap = per_step_wall_cap(&chain, index);
845	        let base_ref = chain_step_base_ref(&chain)?;
846	        match invoke_chain_hook(
847	            paths,
848	            &chain,
849	            "pre-step",
850	            Some(index as u32),
851	            json!({
852	                "chain_id": chain.chain_id,
853	                "step_index": index,
854	                "step_goal": chain.steps[index].goal,
855	                "base_ref": base_ref
856	            }),
857	        )? {
858	            1 => {
859	                chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Skipped;
860	                append_chain_event(
861	                    paths,
862	                    &chain.chain_id,
863	                    ChainEventKind::ChainStepFailed,
864	                    Some(index as u32),
865	                    json!({ "reason": "skipped_by_pre_step_hook" }),
866	                )?;
867	                save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
868	                continue;
869	            }
870	            2 => {
871	                pause_chain_at_step(
872	                    paths,
873	                    &mut chain,
874	                    index,
875	                    "paused_by_pre_step_hook".to_string(),
876	                )?;
877	                completed = false;
878	                break;
879	            }
880	            _ => {}
881	        }
882	        let state = if chain.steps[index].status == ChainStepStatus::Completed {
883	            let run_id = chain.steps[index].run_id.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
884	                let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
885	                let step_number = index + 1;
886	                CliError::Surface {
887	                    code: 1,
888	                    surface: chain_transition_surface(
889	                        paths,
890	                        &chain,
891	                        VerdictKind::Blocked,
892	                        &format!(
893	                            "DeadReckon did not run the chain because step {step_number} is completed but has no run id."
894	                        ),
895	                        "Completed chain steps must point at a recorded run before they can be replayed or applied. DeadReckon refused before continuing from inconsistent chain state.",
896	                        vec![
897	                            ("step".to_string(), step_number.to_string()),
898	                            ("step status".to_string(), "completed".to_string()),
899	                            ("run id".to_string(), "missing".to_string()),
900	                        ],
901	                        format!("deadreckon chain redo {id} --step {step_number}"),
902	                        Vec::new(),
903	                    )
904	                    .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
905	                }
906	            })?;
907	            load_run(paths, &run_id)?
908	        } else {
909	            chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Running;
910	            append_chain_event(
911	                paths,
912	                &chain.chain_id,
913	                ChainEventKind::ChainStepStarted,
914	                Some(index as u32),
915	                json!({ "goal": chain.steps[index].goal, "base": base_ref, "max_spend": step_cap, "max_wall_seconds": step_wall_cap }),
916	            )?;
917	            save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
918	            let run_id = match run_chain_step(
919	                paths,
920	                &chain,
921	                index,
922	                &base_ref,
923	                step_cap,
924	                step_wall_cap,
925	                options.quiet,
926	            )
927	            .await
928	            {
929	                Ok(run_id) => run_id,
930	                Err(err) => {
931	                    completed =
932	                        handle_chain_step_failure(paths, &mut chain, index, err.to_string())?;
933	                    if !completed {
934	                        break;
935	                    }
936	                    continue;
937	                }
938	            };
939	            chain.steps[index].run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
940	            let state = load_run(paths, &run_id)?;
941	            chain.steps[index].spend_usd = state.total_spend_usd;
942	            chain.total_spend_usd += state.total_spend_usd;
943	            chain.total_wall_seconds += state.total_wall_seconds;
944	            write_chain_step_marker(
945	                &state.working_dir,
946	                &ChainStepMarker::new(
947	                    &chain,
948	                    &chain.steps[index],
949	                    latest_applied_sha_before(&chain, index),
950	                ),
951	            )?;
952	            append_chain_event(
953	                paths,
954	                &chain.chain_id,
955	                ChainEventKind::ChainRunCompleted,
956	                Some(index as u32),
957	                json!({ "run_id": run_id, "status": state.status.to_string() }),
958	            )?;
959	            if state.status != RunStatus::Completed {
960	                completed = handle_chain_step_failure(
961	                    paths,
962	                    &mut chain,
963	                    index,
964	                    format!("inner run {} ended {}", state.run_id, state.status),
965	                )?;
966	                if !completed {
967	                    break;
968	                }
969	                continue;
970	            }
971	            match invoke_chain_hook(
972	                paths,
973	                &chain,
974	                "post-step",
975	                Some(index as u32),
976	                json!({
977	                    "chain_id": chain.chain_id,
978	                    "step_index": index,
979	                    "run_id": state.run_id,
980	                    "status": state.status.to_string(),
981	                    "library_dir": state.promoted_library_dir
982	                }),
983	            )? {
984	                1 => {
985	                    pause_chain_at_step(
986	                        paths,
987	                        &mut chain,
988	                        index,
989	                        "paused_by_post_step_hook".to_string(),
990	                    )?;
991	                    completed = false;
992	                    break;
993	                }
994	                2 => {
995	                    completed = handle_chain_step_failure(
996	                        paths,
997	                        &mut chain,
998	                        index,
999	                        "refused_by_post_step_hook".to_string(),
1000	                    )?;
1001	                    if !completed {
1002	                        break;
1003	                    }
1004	                    continue;
1005	                }
1006	                _ => {}
1007	            }
1008	            chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Completed;
1009	            save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
1010	            state
1011	        };
1012	        match chain.apply_mode {
1013	            ApplyMode::Auto => {
1014	                if let Err(err) =
1015	                    auto_apply_chain_step(paths, &mut chain, index, &state.run_id, options.quiet)
1016	                {
1017	                    pause_chain_at_step(
1018	                        paths,
1019	                        &mut chain,
1020	                        index,
1021	                        chain_apply_refusal_pause_reason(&err.to_string()),
1022	                    )?;
1023	                    completed = false;
1024	                    break;
1025	                }
1026	            }
1027	            ApplyMode::Preview => {
1028	                let diff_summary = preview_diff_summary_for_run(&state).unwrap_or_default();
1029	                append_chain_event(
1030	                    paths,
1031	                    &chain.chain_id,
1032	                    ChainEventKind::ChainApplyRefused,
1033	                    Some(index as u32),
1034	                    json!({ "reason": "apply_mode_preview", "diff_summary": diff_summary }),
1035	                )?;
1036	                pause_chain_at_step(paths, &mut chain, index, "apply_mode_preview".to_string())?;
1037	                completed = false;
1038	                break;
1039	            }
1040	            ApplyMode::Manual => {
1041	                pause_chain_at_step(paths, &mut chain, index, "apply_mode_manual".to_string())?;
1042	                completed = false;
1043	                break;
1044	            }
1045	        }
1046	        if chain_spend_cap_hit(&chain) {
1047	            pause_chain_at_step(paths, &mut chain, index, "cap".to_string())?;
1048	            completed = false;
1049	            break;
1050	        }
1051	        if chain_wall_cap_hit(&chain) {
1052	            pause_chain_at_step(paths, &mut chain, index, "wall_clock_cap".to_string())?;
1053	            completed = false;
1054	            break;
1055	        }
1056	    }
1057	    if completed {
1058	        let hook_status = invoke_chain_hook(
1059	            paths,
1060	            &chain,
1061	            "on-chain-end",
1062	            None,
1063	            json!({
1064	                "chain_id": chain.chain_id,
1065	                "status": "completed",
1066	                "steps_completed": chain.steps.iter().filter(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied).count(),
1067	                "total_spend_usd": chain.total_spend_usd
1068	            }),
1069	        )
1070	        .unwrap_or_default();
1071	        chain.status = ChainStatus::Completed;
1072	        chain.completed_at = Some(Utc::now());
1073	        chain.conductor_pid = None;
1074	        append_chain_event(
1075	            paths,
1076	            &chain.chain_id,
1077	            ChainEventKind::ChainCompleted,
1078	            None,
1079	            json!({ "steps_completed": chain.steps.iter().filter(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied).count(), "total_spend_usd": chain.total_spend_usd, "on_chain_end_status": hook_status }),
1080	        )?;
1081	        save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
1082	        if !options.quiet {
1083	            print!(
1084	                "{}",
1085	                chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1086	            );
1087	        }
1088	    } else if !options.quiet {
1089	        print_chain_paused_footer(paths, &chain);
1090	    }
1091	    let _ = fs::remove_file(paths.conductor_json(&chain.chain_id));
1092	    let _ = lock.release();
1093	    Ok(())
1094	}

1096	async fn run_chain_step(
1097	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1098	    chain: &Chain,
1099	    index: usize,
1100	    base_ref: &str,
1101	    step_cap: Option<f64>,
1102	    step_wall_cap: Option<f64>,
1103	    quiet: bool,
1104	) -> Result<String> {
1105	    let step = &chain.steps[index];
1106	    let mut command = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe()?);
1107	    command
1108	        .current_dir(&chain.cwd)
1109	        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", paths.home())
1110	        .arg("run")
1111	        .arg(&step.goal)
1112	        .arg("--worktree")
1113	        .arg("--base")
1114	        .arg(base_ref)
1115	        .arg("--yes")
1116	        .arg("--no-confirm")
1117	        .arg("--no-hints")
1118	        .arg("--sandbox")
1119	        .arg(&chain.sandbox);
1120	    if let Some(provider) = chain.provider.as_deref() {
1121	        command.arg("--provider").arg(provider);
1122	    }
1123	    if let Some(model) = chain.model.as_deref() {
1124	        command.arg("--model").arg(model);
1125	    }
1126	    if let Some(max_wall) = step_wall_cap {
1127	        command.arg("--max-wall-seconds").arg(max_wall.to_string());
1128	    }
1129	    if let Some(step_cap) = step_cap {
1130	        command.arg("--max-spend").arg(format!("{step_cap:.6}"));
1131	    }
1132	    command
1133	        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
1134	        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped());
1135	    let mut child = command.spawn()?;
1136	    let child_pid = child.id();
1137	    update_conductor_live(paths, chain, Some(index as u32), None, Some(child_pid))?;
1138	
1139	    let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or_else(|| {
1140	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1141	            "failed to capture chain step stdout".to_string(),
1142	        ))
1143	    })?;
1144	    let stderr = child.stderr.take().ok_or_else(|| {
1145	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1146	            "failed to capture chain step stderr".to_string(),
1147	        ))
1148	    })?;
1149	    let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<(bool, String)>();
1150	    let stdout_thread = spawn_chain_step_reader(stdout, true, tx.clone());
1151	    let stderr_thread = spawn_chain_step_reader(stderr, false, tx);
1152	    let mut stdout_text = String::new();
1153	    let mut stderr_text = String::new();
1154	    let mut live_run_id: Option<String> = None;
1155	    let status = loop {
1156	        while let Ok((is_stdout, line)) = rx.try_recv() {
1157	            if let Some(run_id) = capture_chain_step_output(
1158	                is_stdout,
1159	                &line,
1160	                &mut stdout_text,
1161	                &mut stderr_text,
1162	                quiet,
1163	            )? && live_run_id.as_deref() != Some(run_id.as_str())
1164	            {
1165	                update_conductor_live(
1166	                    paths,
1167	                    chain,
1168	                    Some(index as u32),
1169	                    Some(run_id.clone()),
1170	                    Some(child_pid),
1171	                )?;
1172	                live_run_id = Some(run_id);
1173	            }
1174	        }
1175	        if let Some(status) = child.try_wait()? {
1176	            break status;
1177	        }
1178	        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
1179	    };
1180	    let _ = stdout_thread.join();
1181	    let _ = stderr_thread.join();
1182	    while let Ok((is_stdout, line)) = rx.try_recv() {
1183	        if let Some(run_id) =
1184	            capture_chain_step_output(is_stdout, &line, &mut stdout_text, &mut stderr_text, quiet)?
1185	            && live_run_id.as_deref() != Some(run_id.as_str())
1186	        {
1187	            update_conductor_live(
1188	                paths,
1189	                chain,
1190	                Some(index as u32),
1191	                Some(run_id.clone()),
1192	                Some(child_pid),
1193	            )?;
1194	            live_run_id = Some(run_id);
1195	        }
1196	    }
1197	    update_conductor_live(paths, chain, None, None, None)?;
1198	    if !status.success() {
1199	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1200	            "step {} run failed: {}{}",
1201	            index + 1,
1202	            stdout_text,
1203	            stderr_text
1204	        ))));
1205	    }
1206	    live_run_id
1207	        .or_else(|| parse_started_run_id(&stdout_text))
1208	        .ok_or_else(missing_inner_run_id_error)
1209	}
1210	
1211	fn missing_inner_run_id_error() -> CliError {
1212	    CliError::Exit {
1213	        code: 1,
1214	        message: "could not find inner run id in run output".to_string(),
1215	        hint: "deadreckon list".to_string(),
1216	    }
1217	}
1218	
1219	pub(crate) fn spawn_chain_step_reader<R: Read + Send + 'static>(
1220	    reader: R,
1221	    is_stdout: bool,
1222	    tx: std::sync::mpsc::Sender<(bool, String)>,
1223	) -> std::thread::JoinHandle<()> {
1224	    std::thread::spawn(move || {
1225	        let mut reader = io::BufReader::new(reader);
1226	        loop {
1227	            let mut line = String::new();
1228	            match reader.read_line(&mut line) {
1229	                Ok(0) => break,
1230	                Ok(_) => {
1231	                    if tx.send((is_stdout, line)).is_err() {
1232	                        break;
1233	                    }
1234	                }
1235	                Err(_) => break,
1236	            }
1237	        }
1238	    })
1239	}
1240	
1241	pub(crate) fn capture_chain_step_output(
1242	    is_stdout: bool,
1243	    line: &str,
1244	    stdout_text: &mut String,
1245	    stderr_text: &mut String,
1246	    quiet: bool,
1247	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
1248	    if is_stdout {
1249	        stdout_text.push_str(line);
1250	        if !quiet {
1251	            print!("{line}");
1252	            io::stdout().flush()?;
1253	        }
1254	        Ok(parse_started_run_id(stdout_text))
1255	    } else {
1256	        stderr_text.push_str(line);
1257	        if !quiet {
1258	            eprint!("{line}");
1259	            io::stderr().flush()?;
1260	        }
1261	        Ok(None)
1262	    }
1263	}

1265	fn auto_apply_chain_step(
1266	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1267	    chain: &mut Chain,
1268	    index: usize,
1269	    run_id: &str,
1270	    quiet: bool,
1271	) -> Result<()> {
1272	    let state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
1273	    validate_acceptance_marker(&state)?;
1274	    let record = read_codebase_record(&state.working_dir)?;
1275	    let git_root = record.source_git_root.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
1276	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1277	            "missing source_git_root".to_string(),
1278	        ))
1279	    })?;
1280	    if !git_stdout(git_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?
1281	        .trim()
1282	        .is_empty()
1283	    {
1284	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1285	            &format!("step '{}' refused auto-apply (dirty target)", index + 1),
1286	            &format!(
1287	                "git -C {} stash && deadreckon chain resume {}",
1288	                git_root.display(),
1289	                chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)
1290	            ),
1291	        )));
1292	    }
1293	    if !chain.apply_allowlist.is_empty() {
1294	        let branch = record.branch_name.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
1295	            CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1296	                "missing branch_name".to_string(),
1297	            ))
1298	        })?;
1299	        let files = git_stdout(
1300	            git_root,
1301	            &["diff", "--name-only", &format!("HEAD..{branch}")],
1302	        )?;
1303	        for file in files.lines().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
1304	            if !chain
1305	                .apply_allowlist
1306	                .iter()
1307	                .any(|pattern| allowlist_matches(pattern, file))
1308	            {
1309	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1310	                    &format!(
1311	                        "step '{}' refused auto-apply (outside_allowlist {file})",
1312	                        index + 1
1313	                    ),
1314	                    &format!(
1315	                        "deadreckon chain resume {} --apply-mode preview",
1316	                        chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)
1317	                    ),
1318	                )));
1319	            }
1320	        }
1321	    }
1322	    let branch = record.branch_name.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
1323	        CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1324	            "missing branch_name".to_string(),
1325	        ))
1326	    })?;
1327	    let files_changed = git_stdout(
1328	        git_root,
1329	        &["diff", "--name-only", &format!("HEAD..{branch}")],
1330	    )?
1331	    .lines()
1332	    .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
1333	    .map(ToString::to_string)
1334	    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1335	    let diff_stat =
1336	        git_stdout(git_root, &["diff", "--stat", &format!("HEAD..{branch}")]).unwrap_or_default();
1337	    match invoke_chain_hook(
1338	        paths,
1339	        chain,
1340	        "on-promote",
1341	        Some(index as u32),
1342	        json!({
1343	            "chain_id": chain.chain_id,
1344	            "step_index": index,
1345	            "run_id": run_id,
1346	            "diff_stat": diff_stat,
1347	            "files_changed": files_changed
1348	        }),
1349	    )? {
1350	        1 => {
1351	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1352	                &format!("step '{}' paused by hook on-promote", index + 1),
1353	                &format!("deadreckon chain resume {}", chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)),
1354	            )));
1355	        }
1356	        2 => {
1357	            append_chain_event(
1358	                paths,
1359	                &chain.chain_id,
1360	                ChainEventKind::ChainApplyRefused,
1361	                Some(index as u32),
1362	                json!({ "reason": "refused_by_hook_on_promote" }),
1363	            )?;
1364	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1365	                &format!("step '{}' refused by hook on-promote", index + 1),
1366	                "inspect ~/.deadreckon/hooks/chain/on-promote",
1367	            )));
1368	        }
1369	        _ => {}
1370	    }
1371	    append_chain_event(
1372	        paths,
1373	        &chain.chain_id,
1374	        ChainEventKind::ChainApplyStarted,
1375	        Some(index as u32),
1376	        json!({ "run_id": run_id }),
1377	    )?;
1378	    if quiet {
1379	        super::lifecycle::apply_command_quiet(
1380	            run_id.to_string(),
1381	            apply_strategy_label(chain_apply_strategy(chain)).to_string(),
1382	            None,
1383	            true,
1384	            true,
1385	            false,
1386	            None,
1387	        )?;
1388	    } else {
1389	        super::lifecycle::apply_command(
1390	            run_id.to_string(),
1391	            apply_strategy_label(chain_apply_strategy(chain)).to_string(),
1392	            None,
1393	            true,
1394	            true,
1395	            false,
1396	            None,
1397	            false,
1398	        )?;
1399	    }
1400	    let applied_sha = git_stdout(git_root, &["rev-parse", "HEAD"])?;
1401	    chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Applied;
1402	    chain.steps[index].applied_at = Some(Utc::now());
1403	    chain.steps[index].applied_sha = Some(applied_sha.clone());
1404	    append_chain_event(
1405	        paths,
1406	        &chain.chain_id,
1407	        ChainEventKind::ChainApplied,
1408	        Some(index as u32),

1415	// SAFETY: Chain failure reasons are owned when they are persisted and emitted as JSON.
1416	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
1417	fn handle_chain_step_failure(
1418	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1419	    chain: &mut Chain,
1420	    index: usize,
1421	    reason: String,
1422	) -> Result<bool> {
1423	    chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Failed;
1424	    chain.steps[index].fail_reason = Some(reason.clone());
1425	    append_chain_event(
1426	        paths,
1427	        &chain.chain_id,
1428	        ChainEventKind::ChainStepFailed,
1429	        Some(index as u32),
1430	        json!({ "reason": reason }),
1431	    )?;
1432	    match chain.on_fail {
1433	        OnFail::Stop => {
1434	            pause_chain_at_step(paths, chain, index, "step_failed".to_string())?;
1435	            Ok(false)
1436	        }
1437	        OnFail::Skip => {
1438	            chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Skipped;
1439	            chain.circuit_breaker_consecutive_failures += 1;
1440	            if chain.circuit_breaker_consecutive_failures >= chain.circuit_breaker_threshold {
1441	                pause_chain_at_step(paths, chain, index, "circuit_breaker_open".to_string())?;
1442	                return Ok(false);
1443	            }
1444	            save_chain(paths, chain)?;
1445	            Ok(true)
1446	        }
1447	        OnFail::Continue => {
1448	            chain.steps[index].status = ChainStepStatus::Skipped;
1449	            save_chain(paths, chain)?;
1450	            Ok(true)
1451	        }
1452	    }
1453	}

1492	        .stdout(stdout)
1493	        .stderr(stderr)
1494	        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null());
1495	    if options.plain {

260	fn unique_shell_backup_dir(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
261	    let stamp = Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%3f").to_string();
262	    let mut candidate = root.join(&stamp);
263	    let mut suffix = 1_u32;
264	    while candidate.exists() {
265	        candidate = root.join(format!("{stamp}-{suffix}"));
266	        suffix += 1;
267	    }
268	    candidate
269	}

333	fn prune_shell_backups(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<()> {
334	    let root = shell_backup_root(paths);
335	    let mut backups = fs::read_dir(&root)?
336	        .filter_map(|entry| {
337	            let entry = entry.ok()?;
338	            entry.path().is_dir().then_some(entry.path())
339	        })
340	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
341	    backups.sort();
342	    let remove_count = backups.len().saturating_sub(3);
343	    for backup in backups.into_iter().take(remove_count) {
344	        fs::remove_dir_all(backup)?;
345	    }
346	    Ok(())
347	}

360	        code: 2,
361	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
362	            VerdictKind::Failed,
363	            "update",
364	            Some("shell"),
365	            ExplanationPanel::new(
366	                "DeadReckon could not replace the shell-installed binary.",
367	                "The update failed after creating a rollback backup, so restoring the preserved binary is the safest next step.",
368	                vec![
369	                    ("channel".to_string(), "shell".to_string()),
370	                    ("source".to_string(), source.to_string()),
371	                    ("backup".to_string(), backup_dir.display().to_string()),
372	                    ("updated".to_string(), receipt.binary_path.display().to_string()),
373	                ],
374	            ),
375	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
376	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon update --check")],

383	pub(crate) fn update_receipt_for_current_binary(
384	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
385	    persist_detected: bool,
386	) -> Result<deadreckon_core::install_receipt::Receipt> {
387	    if let Some(receipt) = read_receipt(paths)? {
388	        return Ok(receipt);
389	    }
390	    let binary = std::env::current_exe()?;
391	    let receipt = detect_receipt(&binary);
392	    if persist_detected {

394	    }
395	    Ok(receipt)

416	fn update_check_surface(channel: Channel, current: &str, latest: &LatestUpdate) -> VerdictSurface {
417	    let evidence = vec![
418	        ("channel", channel.as_str().to_string()),
419	        ("current", current.to_string()),
420	        ("latest", latest.version.clone()),
421	        ("release", latest.release_url.clone()),
422	    ];
423	    if latest.update_available {
424	        return VerdictSurface::try_new(
425	            VerdictKind::Preview,
426	            "update",
427	            Some(channel.as_str()),
428	            ExplanationPanel::new(
429	                "DeadReckon found a newer release for this install channel.",
430	                "The check is read-only; run the channel update command to apply the available release.",
431	                evidence,
432	            ),
433	            vec![("Recommended", channel_native_update_command(channel))],
434	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon doctor")],
435	        )
436	        .expect("update-check preview verdict surface must be valid");
437	    }
438	
439	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
440	        VerdictKind::Noop,
441	        "update",
442	        Some(channel.as_str()),
443	        ExplanationPanel::new(
444	            "DeadReckon did not find a newer release for this install channel.",
445	            "The installed version is already current, or the check fell back to cached/current release metadata.",
446	            evidence,
447	        ),
448	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon doctor")],
449	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
450	    )
451	    .expect("update-check no-op verdict surface must be valid")
452	}

454	fn update_source_surface(current: &str) -> VerdictSurface {

460	            "DeadReckon cannot replace a source-built binary in place.",
461	            "Source installs do not have a managed package channel for self-update; reinstall from the checkout so Cargo rebuilds the binary.",
462	            vec![
463	                ("channel".to_string(), "source".to_string()),
464	                ("current".to_string(), current.to_string()),
465	                ("managed swap".to_string(), "unsupported".to_string()),
466	            ],
467	        ),
468	        vec![("Recommended", "cargo install --path crates/deadreckon")],

508	pub(crate) async fn resolve_latest_update(
509	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
510	    current: &str,
511	    allow_prerelease: bool,
512	) -> Result<LatestUpdate> {
513	    let now = Utc::now();
514	    let cache = read_cache(paths)?;
515	    if let Some(cache) = cache.as_ref()
516	        && !cache.is_stale(now)
517	    {
518	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
519	            version: cache.latest_version.clone(),
520	            release_url: cache.release_url.clone(),
521	            archive_url: None,
522	            sha256: None,
523	            update_available: cache.update_available,
524	        });
525	    }
526	
527	    match fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease).await {
528	        Ok(mut latest) => {
529	            latest.update_available = version_is_newer(current, &latest.version);
530	            write_cache(
531	                paths,
532	                &deadreckon_core::update_cache::Cache {
533	                    checked_at: now,
534	                    latest_version: latest.version.clone(),
535	                    current_version: current.to_string(),
536	                    release_url: latest.release_url.clone(),
537	                    update_available: latest.update_available,
538	                },
539	            )?;
540	            Ok(latest)
541	        }
542	        Err(_) => Ok(cache.map_or_else(
543	            || LatestUpdate {
544	                version: current.to_string(),
545	                release_url: "https://github.com/gdc/deadreckon/releases".to_string(),
546	                archive_url: None,
547	                sha256: None,
548	                update_available: false,
549	            },
550	            |cache| LatestUpdate {
551	                version: cache.latest_version,
552	                release_url: cache.release_url,
553	                archive_url: None,
554	                sha256: None,
555	                update_available: cache.update_available,
556	            },
557	        )),
558	    }
559	}
560	
561	async fn fetch_latest_update(allow_prerelease: bool) -> std::result::Result<LatestUpdate, String> {
562	    if let Ok(delay_ms) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_FETCH_DELAY_MS")
563	        && let Ok(delay_ms) = delay_ms.parse::<u64>()
564	    {
565	        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay_ms)).await;
566	    }
567	    if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_OFFLINE").is_some() {
568	        return Err("offline test mode".to_string());
569	    }
570	    if let Ok(version) = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_LATEST_VERSION") {
571	        let release_url =
572	            std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_RELEASE_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
573	                format!("https://github.com/gdc/deadreckon/releases/tag/v{version}")
574	            });
575	        return Ok(LatestUpdate {
576	            version,
577	            release_url,
578	            archive_url: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_ARCHIVE_URL").ok(),
579	            sha256: std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_TEST_SHA256").ok(),
580	            update_available: false,
581	        });
582	    }
583	
584	    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
585	        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3))
586	        .build()
587	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
588	    if allow_prerelease {
589	        let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL")
590	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://api.github.com/repos/gdc/deadreckon/releases".to_string());
591	        let releases = client
592	            .get(url)
593	            .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
594	            .send()
595	            .await
596	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
597	            .error_for_status()
598	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
599	            .json::<Vec<GithubRelease>>()
600	            .await
601	            .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
602	        let Some(release) = releases.into_iter().next() else {
603	            return Err("no releases found".to_string());
604	        };
605	        return Ok(release.into_latest_update());
606	    }
607	
608	    let url = std::env::var("DEADRECKON_UPDATE_RELEASES_URL").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
609	        "https://api.github.com/repos/gdc/deadreckon/releases/latest".to_string()
610	    });
611	    client
612	        .get(url)
613	        .header(reqwest::header::USER_AGENT, "deadreckon-update")
614	        .send()
615	        .await
616	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
617	        .error_for_status()
618	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?
619	        .json::<GithubRelease>()
620	        .await
621	        .map(GithubRelease::into_latest_update)
622	        .map_err(|err| err.to_string())
623	}

643	fn version_is_newer(current: &str, latest: &str) -> bool {
644	    let current = current.trim_start_matches('v');
645	    let latest = latest.trim_start_matches('v');
646	    match (
647	        semver::Version::parse(current),
648	        semver::Version::parse(latest),
649	    ) {
650	        (Ok(current), Ok(latest)) => latest > current,
651	        _ => latest != current,
652	    }
653	}

655	async fn providers_list_command(
656	    models: bool,
657	    all: bool,
658	    full: bool,
659	    json_output: bool,
660	) -> Result<()> {
661	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
662	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
663	    let active = read_config(&paths.config_path())?.default_provider;
664	    let ids = if all {
665	        registry.ids()
666	    } else {
667	        configured_provider_ids(&paths)?
668	    };
669	    let mut results = Vec::new();
670	    let mut missing = Vec::new();
671	    for id in ids {
672	        if let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&id) {
673	            results.push(descriptor.probe(ProviderProbeOptions { ping: false }).await);
674	        } else {
675	            missing.push(id);
676	        }
677	    }
678	    let surface = providers_list_verdict_surface(&results, &missing, all);
679	    if json_output {
680	        let primary_action = surface.primary_action.command.clone();
681	        println!(
682	            "{}",
683	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
684	                "kind": "providers",
685	                "id": if all { "all" } else { "configured" },
686	                "status": "ok",
687	                "next_actions": [primary_action],
688	                "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
689	                "paths": {
690	                    "home": paths.home(),
691	                    "config": paths.config_path(),
692	                },
693	                "providers": results,
694	                "missing_providers": missing,
695	                "active": active,
696	            })))?
697	        );
698	        return Ok(());
699	    }
700	    println!("{}", ui_heading("provider registry"));
701	    if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
702	        println!("{} no configured providers", ui_muted("-"));
703	        println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
704	        return Ok(());
705	    }
706	    for id in &missing {
707	        let marker = if active.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str()) {
708	            "*"
709	        } else {
710	            " "
711	        };
712	        println!(
713	            "{marker} {} {} {} | {}",
714	            ui_warn("✗"),
715	            ui_id(id),
716	            ui_warn("not registered"),
717	            ui_command("deadreckon providers list --all")
718	        );
719	    }
720	    for result in &results {
721	        let Some(descriptor) = registry.get(&result.id) else {
722	            continue;
723	        };
724	        print_provider_list_row(&result, descriptor, active.as_deref(), full);
725	        if models {
726	            print_provider_models(descriptor);
727	        }
728	    }
729	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
730	    Ok(())
731	}

733	fn providers_list_verdict_surface(
734	    results: &[ProviderProbeResult],
735	    missing: &[String],
736	    all: bool,
737	) -> VerdictSurface {
738	    let failed = results
739	        .iter()
740	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Failed)
741	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
742	    let ok = results
743	        .iter()
744	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Ok)
745	        .count();
746	    let skipped = results
747	        .iter()
748	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Skipped)
749	        .count();
750	    let subject = if all { "all" } else { "configured" };
751	    let kind = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
752	        VerdictKind::Noop
753	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
754	        VerdictKind::Verified
755	    } else {
756	        VerdictKind::Blocked
757	    };
758	    let primary = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
759	        format!("deadreckon detect {}", first.id)
760	    } else if !missing.is_empty() || results.is_empty() {
761	        "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
762	    } else {
763	        "deadreckon detect".to_string()
764	    };
765	    let what = if results.is_empty() && missing.is_empty() {
766	        "DeadReckon found no configured provider routes.".to_string()
767	    } else if missing.is_empty() && failed.is_empty() {
768	        format!("DeadReckon listed {ok} usable provider route(s).")
769	    } else {
770	        format!(
771	            "DeadReckon listed provider routes and found {} issue(s).",
772	            failed.len() + missing.len()
773	        )
774	    };
775	    let why = if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
776	        format!(
777	            "{} is not ready; inspect that provider before using it for a run.",
778	            first.id
779	        )
780	    } else if !missing.is_empty() {
781	        "At least one configured provider is not registered; list all routes or change the configured provider."
782	            .to_string()
783	    } else if results.is_empty() {
784	        "There is no configured provider inventory yet; listing all routes is the safest discovery step."
785	            .to_string()
786	    } else {
787	        "The configured provider inventory is readable; a detect pass can refresh setup diagnostics."
788	            .to_string()
789	    };
790	    let mut evidence = vec![
791	        ("scope".to_string(), subject.to_string()),
792	        ("providers".to_string(), results.len().to_string()),
793	        ("ok".to_string(), ok.to_string()),
794	        ("failed".to_string(), failed.len().to_string()),
795	        ("skipped".to_string(), skipped.to_string()),
796	        ("missing".to_string(), missing.len().to_string()),
797	    ];
798	    if let Some(first) = failed.first() {
799	        evidence.push(("first failed".to_string(), first.id.clone()));
800	        if let Some(message) = &first.message {
801	            evidence.push(("reason".to_string(), message.clone()));
802	        }
803	    }
804	    if let Some(first) = missing.first() {
805	        evidence.push(("first missing".to_string(), first.clone()));
806	    }
807	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
808	        kind,
809	        "providers",
810	        Some(subject),
811	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
812	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
813	        vec![
814	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon detect"),
815	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon providers list --all"),
816	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon config provider cli:codex"),
817	        ],
818	    )
819	    .expect("providers list verdict surface must be valid")
820	}

925	fn detect_verdict_surface(
926	    results: &[ProviderProbeResult],
927	    requested_id: Option<&str>,
928	) -> VerdictSurface {
929	    let failed = results
930	        .iter()
931	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Failed)
932	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
933	    let skipped = results
934	        .iter()
935	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Skipped)
936	        .count();
937	    let ok = results
938	        .iter()
939	        .filter(|result| result.status == ProbeStatus::Ok)
940	        .count();
941	    let subject = requested_id.unwrap_or("all");
942	    let kind = if failed.is_empty() {
943	        VerdictKind::Verified
944	    } else {
945	        VerdictKind::Blocked
946	    };
947	    let primary = failed
948	        .first()
949	        .and_then(|result| result.try_lines.first())
950	        .cloned()
951	        .or_else(|| {
952	            requested_id.map(|id| {
953	                if failed.is_empty() {
954	                    format!("deadreckon config provider {id}")
955	                } else {
956	                    "deadreckon providers list".to_string()
957	                }
958	            })
959	        })
960	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
961	            if failed.is_empty() {
962	                "deadreckon providers list".to_string()
963	            } else {
964	                "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()
965	            }
966	        });
967	    let what = if failed.is_empty() {
968	        match requested_id {
969	            Some(id) => format!("DeadReckon verified provider probe {id}."),
970	            None => "DeadReckon completed provider detection without failed probes.".to_string(),
971	        }
972	    } else if failed.len() == 1 {
973	        format!("DeadReckon found provider {} is not ready.", failed[0].id)
974	    } else {
975	        format!(

516	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
517	    dry_run: &PrDryRun,
518	) -> VerdictSurface {

522	    } else {
523	        VerdictKind::Blocked
524	    };
525	    let primary = if eligible {
526	        format!("deadreckon improve self {} --open-pr", proposal.proposal_id)
527	    } else if candidate.status == "verified" {
528	        format!("deadreckon improve self {} --yes", proposal.proposal_id)
529	    } else {
530	        format!("deadreckon show {} --why-failed", candidate.run_id)
531	    };
532	    let why = if eligible {
533	        "The evidence gate passed in dry-run mode; opening the PR remains an explicit opt-in command."
534	    } else {
535	        "The PR gate blocked live opening; the recommended command is the safest recovery path for the current candidate state."
536	    };
537	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
538	        kind,
539	        "improve",
540	        Some("self"),
541	        ExplanationPanel::new(
542	            "DeadReckon prepared the self-improvement PR body without pushing or opening a PR.",
543	            why,
544	            vec![
545	                ("proposal", proposal.proposal_id.clone()),
546	                ("candidate", candidate.candidate_id.clone()),
547	                ("branch", dry_run.branch.clone()),
548	                ("body", dry_run.body_path.display().to_string()),
549	                ("eligible", if eligible { "yes" } else { "no" }.to_string()),
550	                ("gate reasons", dry_run.decision.reasons.len().to_string()),
551	            ],
552	        ),
553	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
554	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon status")],
555	    )
556	    .expect("improve self PR dry-run verdict surface must be valid")
557	}

636	async fn run_self_improve_candidate(
637	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
638	    proposal: &LearningProposal,
639	    json_output: bool,
640	) -> Result<()> {
641	    let source_root = git_stdout(&std::env::current_dir()?, &["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])?;
642	    let source_root = PathBuf::from(source_root);
643	    let status = git_stdout(&source_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?;
644	    if !status.trim().is_empty() {
645	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
646	            "base worktree is dirty",
647	            "git status --short",
648	        )));
649	    }
650	    let policy = load_learning_policy(paths)?;
651	    let defaults = config_defaults(paths)?;
652	    if defaults.sandbox.as_deref() == Some("none") && !policy.self_run.allow_sandbox_none {
653	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
654	            "self-improve refuses sandbox none",
655	            "deadreckon config sandbox auto",
656	        )));
657	    }
658	    let base_commit = git_stdout(&source_root, &["rev-parse", "HEAD"])?;
659	    let candidate_id = format!("cand-{}", Uuid::new_v4().simple());
660	    let branch = format!("deadreckon/self/{candidate_id}");
661	    let candidate_dir = paths.learning_candidate_dir(&candidate_id);
662	    let worktree = candidate_dir.join("worktree");
663	    fs::create_dir_all(&candidate_dir)?;
664	    run_git(
665	        &source_root,
666	        &[
667	            "worktree",
668	            "add",
669	            "-b",
670	            branch.as_str(),
671	            path_to_str(&worktree)?,
672	            "HEAD",
673	        ],
674	    )?;
675	    let goal_file = candidate_dir.join("goal.md");
676	    fs::write(&goal_file, &proposal.goal_text)?;
677	    let acceptance = candidate_dir.join("acceptance.yaml");
678	    fs::write(
679	        &acceptance,
680	        r#"
681	name: self-improvement-focused
682	checks:
683	  - kind: shell
684	    command: "cargo test -p deadreckon-core learning --lib"
685	"#,
686	    )?;
687	
688	    let before_runs = list_runs(paths, None)?
689	        .into_iter()
690	        .map(|run| run.run_id)
691	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
692	    let exe = std::env::current_exe()?;
693	    let status = std::process::Command::new(exe)
694	        .current_dir(&worktree)
695	        .env("DEADRECKON_HOME", paths.home())
696	        .arg("run")
697	        .arg(&proposal.goal_text)
698	        .arg("--in-place")
699	        .arg("--i-know-its-a-lot")
700	        .arg("--yes")
701	        .arg("--acceptance")
702	        .arg(&acceptance)
703	        .status()?;
704	    let run_id = newest_created_run_id(paths, &before_runs)?;
705	    run_git(&worktree, &["add", "-A"])?;
706	    let staged = git_stdout(&worktree, &["diff", "--cached", "--name-only"])?;
707	    if !staged.trim().is_empty() {
708	        let message = format!("self-improve: {}", one_line(&proposal.title, 64));
709	        run_git(
710	            &worktree,
711	            &[
712	                "-c",
713	                "user.name=deadreckon",
714	                "-c",
715	                "user.email=deadreckon@example.invalid",
716	                "commit",
717	                "-m",
718	                message.as_str(),
719	            ],
720	        )?;
721	    }
722	    let head_commit = git_stdout(&worktree, &["rev-parse", "HEAD"])?;
723	    let changed_files = git_stdout(&worktree, &["diff", "--name-only", "HEAD~1..HEAD"])
724	        .unwrap_or_default()
725	        .lines()
726	        .map(ToString::to_string)
727	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
728	    let diff = diff_summary(&worktree, "HEAD~1..HEAD").unwrap_or_default();
729	    let diff_text = git_stdout(&worktree, &["diff", "HEAD~1..HEAD"]).unwrap_or_default();
730	    let risk = classify_candidate_risk(&changed_files);
731	    let mut candidate = LearningCandidate {
732	        version: 1,
733	        candidate_id: candidate_id.clone(),
734	        proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id.clone(),
735	        branch,
736	        base_commit,
737	        head_commit,
738	        run_id,
739	        worktree: worktree.clone(),
740	        diff: LearningCandidateDiff {
741	            files: changed_files.len() as u32,
742	            insertions: diff.0,
743	            deletions: diff.1,
744	            changed_files,
745	        },
746	        risk,
747	        status: if status.success() {

749	        } else {
750	            "rejected"
751	        }
752	        .to_string(),
753	        evidence_packet: "evidence.json".to_string(),
754	    };
755	    let verify_status = std::process::Command::new("cargo")
756	        .current_dir(&worktree)

758	        .status()?;
759	    let mut eval = LearningEval {
760	        version: 1,
761	        candidate_id: candidate_id.clone(),
762	        evaluated_at: Utc::now(),
763	        accepted_run: status.success(),
764	        commands: vec![LearningEvalCommand {
765	            cmd: "cargo test -p deadreckon-core learning --lib".to_string(),
766	            status: verify_status.code().unwrap_or(1),
767	        }],

769	            .diff
770	            .changed_files
771	            .iter()
772	            .any(|file| file.starts_with("docs/") || file == "CHANGELOG.md"),
773	        redaction_passed: !learning_text_has_sensitive(&diff_text, paths),
774	        evidence_score: 0.0,
775	        auto_pr: LearningAutoPrStatus {
776	            eligible: false,
777	            reasons: Vec::new(),
778	        },
779	    };
780	    eval.evidence_score = evidence_score(proposal, &candidate, &eval);
781	    let decision = evaluate_auto_pr(proposal, &candidate, &eval, &policy, false);
782	    eval.auto_pr.eligible = decision.eligible;
783	    eval.auto_pr.reasons = decision.reasons;
784	    if eval.evidence_score < policy.pr.min_evidence_score {
785	        candidate.status = "rejected".to_string();
786	    }
787	    write_candidate(paths, &candidate)?;
788	    write_eval(paths, &eval)?;
789	    let evidence_path = paths
790	        .learning_candidate_dir(&candidate_id)
791	        .join("evidence.json");
792	    fs::write(
793	        &evidence_path,
794	        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({
795	            "proposal": proposal,
796	            "candidate": candidate,
797	            "eval": eval,
798	            "rollback": format!("git branch -D {} && git worktree remove {}", candidate.branch, candidate.worktree.display())
799	        }))?,
800	    )?;
801	    let surface = improve_self_candidate_surface(proposal, &candidate, &eval, &evidence_path);
802	    if json_output {
803	        println!(
804	            "{}",
805	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
806	                "candidate_id": candidate_id,
807	                "candidate": candidate,
808	                "eval": eval,
809	                "evidence": evidence_path,
810	            })))?
811	        );
812	    } else {

814	    }
815	    Ok(())
816	}

890	fn latest_candidate_for_proposal(
891	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
892	    proposal_id: &str,
893	) -> Result<LearningCandidate> {
894	    let dir = paths.learning_candidates_dir();
895	    if !dir.exists() {
896	        return Err(missing_self_improve_candidate_error(
897	            paths,
898	            proposal_id,
899	            "candidate store missing",
900	        ));
901	    }
902	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
903	    for entry in fs::read_dir(&dir)? {
904	        let entry = entry?;
905	        let path = entry.path().join("candidate.json");
906	        if !path.exists() {
907	            continue;
908	        }
909	        let candidate: LearningCandidate = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path)?)?;
910	        if candidate.proposal_id == proposal_id {
911	            let updated = fs::metadata(&path)?.modified().ok();
912	            candidates.push((updated, candidate));
913	        }
914	    }
915	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| right.0.cmp(&left.0));
916	    candidates
917	        .into_iter()
918	        .map(|(_, candidate)| candidate)
919	        .next()
920	        .ok_or_else(|| {
921	            missing_self_improve_candidate_error(
922	                paths,
923	                proposal_id,
924	                "no candidate matched this proposal",
925	            )
926	        })
927	}

980	fn diff_summary(worktree: &Path, range: &str) -> Result<(u32, u32)> {
981	    let raw = git_stdout(worktree, &["diff", "--numstat", range])?;
982	    let mut insertions = 0u32;
983	    let mut deletions = 0u32;
984	    for line in raw.lines() {
985	        let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
986	        let added = parts.next().and_then(|value| value.parse::<u32>().ok());
987	        let removed = parts.next().and_then(|value| value.parse::<u32>().ok());
988	        insertions = insertions.saturating_add(added.unwrap_or(0));
989	        deletions = deletions.saturating_add(removed.unwrap_or(0));
990	    }
991	    Ok((insertions, deletions))
992	}

994	fn learning_text_has_sensitive(value: &str, paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> bool {
995	    let lower = value.to_ascii_lowercase();
996	    lower.contains("ghp_")
997	        || lower.contains("github_pat_")
998	        || lower.contains("sk-")
999	        || lower.contains("api_key")
1000	        || lower.contains("api-key")
1001	        || lower.contains("begin openssh private key")
1002	        || lower.contains("begin private key")
1003	        || value.contains(paths.home().to_string_lossy().as_ref())
1004	        || std::env::var("HOME").is_ok_and(|home| !home.is_empty() && value.contains(&home))
1005	}

1011	struct GhSelfImprovePrAdapter;

1013	impl SelfImprovePrAdapter for GhSelfImprovePrAdapter {
1014	    fn open_pr(&self, candidate: &LearningCandidate, dry_run: &PrDryRun) -> Result<String> {
1015	        run_git(
1016	            &candidate.worktree,
1017	            &["push", "-u", "origin", candidate.branch.as_str()],
1018	        )?;
1019	        let output = std::process::Command::new("gh")
1020	            .current_dir(&candidate.worktree)
1021	            .arg("pr")
1022	            .arg("create")
1023	            .arg("--title")
1024	            .arg(&dry_run.title)
1025	            .arg("--body-file")
1026	            .arg(&dry_run.body_path)
1027	            .arg("--head")
1028	            .arg(&candidate.branch)
1029	            .output()?;
1030	        if !output.status.success() {
1031	            return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1032	                "gh pr create failed: {}{}",
1033	                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
1034	                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
1035	            ))));
1036	        }
1037	        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
1038	    }
1039	}

1041	pub(crate) fn open_self_improve_pr_if_eligible(
1042	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1043	    proposal_id: &str,
1044	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
1045	    dry_run: &PrDryRun,
1046	    adapter: &dyn SelfImprovePrAdapter,
1047	) -> Result<String> {
1048	    if !dry_run.decision.eligible {
1049	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1050	            &format!("PR gate failed: {}", dry_run.decision.reasons.join("; ")),
1051	            &format!("deadreckon improve self {proposal_id} --pr-dry-run"),
1052	        )));
1053	    }
1054	    let pr_url = adapter.open_pr(candidate, dry_run)?;
1055	    record_pr_event(

1061	            mode: "open".to_string(),
1062	            status: "opened".to_string(),
1063	            branch: candidate.branch.clone(),
1064	            pr_url: Some(pr_url.clone()),
1065	            body_path: dry_run.body_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1066	            reason: None,
1067	        },
1068	    )?;

25	pub(crate) async fn doc_command(args: DocCommandArgs) -> Result<()> {
26	    let DocCommandArgs {
27	        run_id,
28	        kind,
29	        export,
30	        polish,
31	        no_confirm,
32	        force,
33	        doc_skill,
34	        doc_provider,
35	        budget_cap,
36	    } = args;
37	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
38	    let loaded_state = load_cli_run(&paths, &run_id);
39	    if let Some(target) = match loaded_state.as_ref() {
40	        Ok(state) => resolve_plan_doc_target(&paths, &run_id, Some(state))?,
41	        Err(_) => resolve_plan_doc_target(&paths, &run_id, None)?,
42	    } {
43	        return doc_plan_command(
44	            &paths,
45	            DocPlanCommandArgs {
46	                target,
47	                kind,
48	                export,
49	                polish,
50	                force,
51	                doc_provider,
52	                budget_cap,
53	            },
54	        )
55	        .await;
56	    }
57	    let mut state = loaded_state?;
58	    let kind_arg = cli_doc_kind_arg(kind);
59	    let kind = run_doc_kind(kind)?;
60	    if polish {
61	        if state.status != RunStatus::Completed {
62	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
63	                &format!(
64	                    "run {} is {}; docs are not yet polished",
65	                    state.run_id, state.status
66	                ),
67	                &format!("deadreckon resume {} or omit --polish", state.run_id),
68	            )));
69	        }
70	        let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
71	        let setup_selection = doc_provider_setup_selection(
72	            &paths,
73	            &defaults,
74	            doc_provider.as_deref(),
75	            state.provider.as_deref(),
76	            false,
77	        )?;
78	        let selection = doc_provider_selection_from_setup(&setup_selection);
79	        let Some(provider) = selection.provider.clone() else {
80	            return Err(missing_doc_provider_error(
81	                &paths,
82	                state.provider.as_deref(),
83	                &setup_selection,
84	            ));
85	        };
86	        let subskills = effective_doc_subskills(&defaults);
87	        let token_budget = defaults
88	            .doc_polish_token_budget
89	            .unwrap_or(DEFAULT_DOC_POLISH_TOKEN_BUDGET);
90	        let budget_cap = budget_cap.or(defaults.doc_polish_budget_cap_usd);
91	        let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), Some(&provider))?;
92	        let estimated_spend =
93	            estimate_doc_polish_spend(&router, &provider, token_budget, subskills.len())?;
94	        if let Some(cap) = budget_cap
95	            && estimated_spend.cost_usd > cap
96	        {
97	            return Err(doc_polish_budget_cap_error(
98	                &state,
99	                &provider,
100	                selection.source.as_str(),
101	                &estimated_spend,
102	                cap,
103	            ));
104	        }
105	        if !no_confirm && completion_hints_enabled(false) && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
106	            print_doc_polish_preview(
107	                &state,
108	                &provider,
109	                selection.source.as_str(),
110	                &subskills,
111	                token_budget,
112	                budget_cap,
113	                &estimated_spend,
114	            )?;
115	            if !prompt::confirm("polish docs now?", true)? {
116	                println!("cancelled");
117	                return Ok(());
118	            }
119	        } else if !no_confirm && !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
120	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
121	                "non-interactive doc polish requires --no-confirm",
122	                &format!("deadreckon doc {} --polish --no-confirm", state.run_id),
123	            )));
124	        }
125	        with_cli_wait_status(
126	            "polishing run docs",
127	            polish_run_docs(
128	                &mut state,
129	                &router,
130	                &PolishConfig {
131	                    home: paths.home().to_path_buf(),
132	                    doc_skill: doc_skill
133	                        .or(defaults.doc_skill)
134	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "run-narrator".to_string()),
135	                    doc_provider: Some(provider),
136	                    doc_provider_source: Some(selection.source.as_str().to_string()),
137	                    doc_subskills: subskills,
138	                    token_budget,
139	                    budget_cap_usd: budget_cap,
140	                    no_llm: false,
141	                    force,
142	                },
143	            ),
144	        )
145	        .await?;
146	        if completion_hints_enabled(false)
147	            && let Some(record) = deadreckon_runtime::read_polish_record(&state)?
148	        {
149	            print_doc_polish_summary(&state, &record);
150	        }
151	        save_state(&state)?;
152	    }
153	    let Some(path) = doc_path_for_kind(&state.working_dir, kind) else {
154	        if kind == DocKind::Delta {
155	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
156	                "no delta produced; this run did not affect a project AS-BUILT",
157	                "deadreckon doc <run-id> --kind narrative",
158	            )));
159	        }
160	        return Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!(
161	            "{} for run {}",
162	            kind.file_name(),
163	            state.run_id
164	        ))));
165	    };
166	    if let Some(dest) = export {
167	        if dest.exists() && !force {
168	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
169	                &format!("dest {} exists", dest.display()),
170	                "--overwrite or pick a fresh path",
171	            )));
172	        }
173	        if let Some(parent) = dest.parent() {
174	            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
175	        }
176	        fs::copy(&path, &dest)?;
177	        print_doc_export_surface(
178	            "run",
179	            &state.run_id,
180	            kind_arg,
181	            kind.file_name(),
182	            &path,
183	            &dest,
184	        );
185	    } else {
186	        print!("{}", fs::read_to_string(&path)?);
187	    }
188	    Ok(())
189	}

336	    let primary = "deadreckon config set defaults.doc_provider cli:codex";

408	pub(crate) fn doc_polish_preview_text(
409	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
410	    provider: &str,
411	    provider_source: &str,
412	    subskills: &[String],
413	    token_budget: u32,
414	    budget_cap: Option<f64>,
415	    estimated_spend: &SpendEstimate,
416	) -> Result<String> {
417	    let hash = deadreckon_runtime::inputs_hash(state)?;
418	    let mut out = String::new();
419	    out.push_str(&format!("{}\n", ui_heading("polish preview:")));
420	    out.push_str(&format!(
421	        "  {}  {} ({provider_source})\n",
422	        ui_muted("provider:"),
423	        ui_id(provider)
424	    ));
425	    out.push_str(&format!(
426	        "  {} {}\n",
427	        ui_muted("subskills:"),
428	        subskills.join(", ")
429	    ));
430	    out.push_str(&format!(
431	        "  {}    {} tokens per subcall\n",
432	        ui_muted("budget:"),
433	        token_budget
434	    ));
435	    out.push_str(&format!(
436	        "  {}  {}\n",
437	        ui_muted("estimate:"),
438	        doc_polish_cost_label(estimated_spend)
439	    ));
440	    out.push_str(&format!(
441	        "  {}  {}\n",
442	        ui_muted("cost cap:"),
443	        budget_cap
444	            .map(|cap| format!("${cap:.2}"))
445	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "provider/account default".to_string())
446	    ));
447	    out.push_str(&format!(
448	        "  {}    {}\n",
449	        ui_muted("inputs:"),
450	        &hash[..hash.len().min(12)]
451	    ));
452	    Ok(out)
453	}

455	pub(crate) fn estimate_doc_polish_spend(
456	    router: &ProviderRouter,
457	    provider: &str,
458	    token_budget: u32,
459	    subskill_count: usize,
460	) -> Result<SpendEstimate> {
461	    let calls = subskill_count.max(1) as u64;
462	    router
463	        .estimate_for_route(
464	            Some(provider),
465	            ProviderUsage {
466	                input_tokens: 0,
467	                output_tokens: u64::from(token_budget) * calls,
468	            },
469	        )
470	        .map_err(CliError::from)
471	}

473	fn doc_polish_cost_label(estimate: &SpendEstimate) -> String {
474	    if estimate.subscription {
475	        format!(
476	            "not metered (subscription) for up to {} output tokens",
477	            estimate.output_tokens
478	        )
479	    } else {
480	        format!(
481	            "${:.6} for up to {} output tokens",
482	            estimate.cost_usd, estimate.output_tokens
483	        )
484	    }
485	}
