487	fn print_doc_polish_summary(
488	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
489	    record: &deadreckon_runtime::PolishRecord,
490	) {
491	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
492	    let successful = record.status == "polished";
493	    let kind = if successful {
494	        VerdictKind::Completed
495	    } else {
496	        VerdictKind::Failed
497	    };
498	    let what = if successful {
499	        "DeadReckon polished the run documentation."
500	    } else {
501	        "Doc polish did not complete cleanly."
502	    };
503	    let why = if successful {
504	        "The polish record completed successfully; the recommended command opens the refreshed narrative through DeadReckon."
505	    } else {
506	        "The polish record contains an error, so rerunning polish is the primary recovery command while fallback docs remain available."
507	    };
508	    let primary = if successful {
509	        format!("deadreckon doc {id} --kind narrative")
510	    } else {
511	        format!("deadreckon doc {id} --polish --no-confirm --force")
512	    };
513	    let mut evidence = vec![
514	        ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
515	        ("status".to_string(), record.status.clone()),
516	        ("cost".to_string(), polish_record_cost_label(record)),
517	        ("completed".to_string(), record.completed_at.clone()),
518	    ];
519	    if let Some(provider) = record.provider.as_deref() {
520	        evidence.push(("provider".to_string(), provider.to_string()));
521	    }
522	    if let Some(source) = record.doc_provider_source.as_deref() {
523	        evidence.push(("provider source".to_string(), source.to_string()));
524	    }
525	    if let Some(error) = record.error.as_deref() {
526	        evidence.push(("error".to_string(), error.to_string()));
527	    }
528	    for subcall in &record.subcalls {
529	        evidence.push((
530	            format!("subcall {}", subcall.skill),
531	            format!(
532	                "{} {} in / {} out {}",
533	                subcall.status,
534	                subcall.tokens_in,
535	                subcall.tokens_out,
536	                polish_subcall_cost_label(record, subcall)
537	            ),
538	        ));
539	    }
540	    print!(
541	        "{}",
542	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
543	            kind,
544	            "doc",
545	            Some(&id),
546	            ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
547	            vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
548	            vec![
549	                ("Secondary", format!("deadreckon doc {id} --kind as-built")),
550	                ("Secondary", format!("deadreckon doc {id} --kind decisions")),
551	            ],
552	        )
553	        .expect("doc polish verdict surface must have one primary action")
554	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
555	    );
556	}
557	
558	fn polish_record_cost_label(record: &deadreckon_runtime::PolishRecord) -> String {
559	    if record.doc_provider_source.as_deref() == Some("auto_subscription") && record.cost_usd == 0.0
560	    {
561	        "not metered (subscription)".to_string()
562	    } else {
563	        format!("${:.6}", record.cost_usd)
564	    }
565	}

572	    {

574	    } else {
575	        format!("${:.6}", subcall.cost_usd)
576	    }

429	fn run_confirmation_refusal_error(goal: &str, run_id: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
430	    let primary = format!("deadreckon run {} --yes", run_goal_argument(goal));
431	    CliError::Surface {
432	        code: 1,
433	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
434	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
435	            "run",
436	            None,
437	            ExplanationPanel::new(
438	                "non-interactive without --yes",
439	                "DeadReckon printed the launch preview, then refused to create run state because this shell cannot answer the confirmation prompt.",
440	                [
441	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
442	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
443	                    ("preview run".to_string(), run_id.to_string()),
444	                ],
445	            ),
446	            [("Recommended", primary)],
447	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
448	        )
449	        .expect("run confirmation refusal verdict surface must be valid")
450	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
451	    }
452	}
453	
454	fn run_codebase_refusal_error(err: DeadreckonError, goal: &str, no_hints: bool) -> CliError {
455	    let DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message) = err else {
456	        return CliError::Core(err);
457	    };
458	    let Some((primary, why)) = run_codebase_refusal_primary(&message, goal) else {
459	        return CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(message));
460	    };
461	    let first_reason_line = message.lines().next().unwrap_or(message.as_str());
462	    let evidence_reason = run_codebase_refusal_reason(&message);
463	    CliError::Surface {
464	        code: 1,
465	        surface: VerdictSurface::try_new(
466	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
467	            "run",
468	            None,
469	            ExplanationPanel::new(
470	                first_reason_line.to_string(),
471	                why.to_string(),
472	                [
473	                    ("command".to_string(), "run".to_string()),
474	                    ("goal".to_string(), goal.to_string()),
475	                    ("reason".to_string(), evidence_reason),
476	                ],
477	            ),
478	            [("Recommended", primary)],
479	            std::iter::empty::<(&str, String)>(),
480	        )
481	        .expect("run codebase refusal verdict surface must be valid")
482	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints)),
483	    }
484	}
485	
486	fn run_codebase_refusal_primary(message: &str, goal: &str) -> Option<(String, &'static str)> {
487	    let quoted_goal = run_goal_argument(goal);
488	    if message.contains("working tree has uncommitted changes") {
489	        return Some((
490	            format!("git stash && deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --yes"),
491	            "DeadReckon refused to create a worktree from a dirty source because the run would not have a clean base to apply or clean up from.",
492	        ));
493	    }
494	    if message.contains("git repo has no commits") {
495	        return Some((
496	            "git commit -m initial".to_string(),
497	            "DeadReckon needs a committed Git base before it can create an isolated worktree branch.",
498	        ));
499	    }
500	    if message.contains("HEAD is detached") {
501	        return Some((
502	            "git switch -c <branch>".to_string(),
503	            "DeadReckon needs a named source branch so the run branch has an unambiguous base.",
504	        ));
505	    }
506	    if message.contains("git is in the middle of a merge") {
507	        return Some((
508	            "git merge --abort".to_string(),
509	            "DeadReckon will not start a run while Git has an unresolved merge state.",
510	        ));
511	    }
512	    if message.contains("git is in the middle of a rebase") {
513	        return Some((
514	            "git rebase --abort".to_string(),
515	            "DeadReckon will not start a run while Git has an unresolved rebase state.",
516	        ));
517	    }
518	    if message.contains("branch ") && message.contains(" already exists") {
519	        return Some((
520	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --branch-name <other-name> --yes"),
521	            "DeadReckon refused to reuse an existing branch name because that would blur this run's provenance.",
522	        ));
523	    }
524	    if message.contains("non-interactive without a mode flag") {
525	        return Some((
526	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --from . --yes"),
527	            "DeadReckon cannot ask for a source-mode choice in non-interactive output, so one explicit source mode is required.",
528	        ));
529	    }
530	    if message.contains("--in-place requires --i-know-its-a-lot") {
531	        return Some((
532	            format!("deadreckon run {quoted_goal} --in-place --i-know-its-a-lot --yes"),
533	            "In-place runs can mutate the current checkout, so DeadReckon requires the stronger acknowledgement before launching.",
534	        ));
535	    }
536	    if message.contains(" is not a git repo") {
537	        return Some((
538	            "git init".to_string(),
539	            "Worktree mode requires a Git repository; initialize Git or choose an explicit copy/fresh source mode.",
540	        ));
541	    }
542	    None
543	}
544	
545	fn run_goal_argument(goal: &str) -> String {
546	    format!("\"{}\"", shell_display_quote(goal))
547	}
548	
549	fn run_codebase_refusal_reason(message: &str) -> String {
550	    message
551	        .lines()
552	        .filter(|line| !line.trim_start().starts_with("try:"))
553	        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
554	        .join("\n")
555	}
556	
557	fn run_cancelled_before_turn_loop(
558	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
559	    state: &mut deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
560	) -> Result<bool> {
561	    if !cancel_marker_present(state) {
562	        return Ok(false);
563	    }
564	    if let Ok(latest) = load_run(paths, &state.run_id)
565	        && latest.status == RunStatus::Killed
566	    {
567	        *state = latest;
568	        return Ok(true);
569	    }
570	    state.status = RunStatus::Killed;
571	    state.failure_reason = Some("run cancelled before provider turn".to_string());
572	    state.killed_at = Some(Utc::now());
573	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
574	    save_state(state)?;
575	    emit_event(
576	        state,
577	        None,
578	        deadreckon_core::RunEventKind::RunCompleted {
579	            status: "killed".to_string(),
580	        },
581	    )?;
582	    Ok(true)
583	}

585	/// A cancel outcome rendered through the shared verdict surface (one verdict,
586	/// one Recommended next step) instead of a bare `println!("cancelled")`.
587	fn cancelled_run_surface() -> VerdictSurface {
588	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
589	        VerdictKind::Noop,
590	        "run",
591	        Some("cancelled"),
592	        ExplanationPanel::new(
593	            "Run cancelled before launch.",
594	            "This is a no-op because you declined to continue; no run state was created.",
595	            [("state".to_string(), "no run started".to_string())],
596	        ),
597	        [("Recommended", "deadreckon run \"<goal>\"")],
598	        [("Secondary", "deadreckon start \"<goal>\"")],
599	    )
600	    .expect("cancelled run verdict surface must be valid")
601	}
602	
603	#[cfg(test)]
604	mod cancel_tests {
605	    use super::cancelled_run_surface;
606	
607	    #[test]
608	    fn cancelled_run_renders_surface_with_next_step() {
609	        let rendered = cancelled_run_surface().render_plain(true);
610	        assert!(rendered.contains("cancelled"), "{rendered}");
611	        assert!(rendered.contains("Recommended"), "{rendered}");
612	        assert!(rendered.contains("deadreckon run"), "{rendered}");
613	        // It is a full surface, not a bare "cancelled" line.
614	        assert!(rendered.contains("Explanation"), "{rendered}");
615	    }

57	        }
58	        AcceptanceCommand::Explain { spec } => acceptance_explain_command(spec),
59	        AcceptanceCommand::Check { spec, against } => acceptance_check_command(spec, against),
60	    }
61	}
62	
63	pub(crate) async fn done_command(
64	    args: Vec<String>,
65	    provider: Option<String>,
66	    model: Option<String>,
67	    force: bool,
68	    spec: Option<PathBuf>,
69	    against: Option<PathBuf>,
70	) -> Result<()> {
71	    let Some(first) = args.first().map(String::as_str) else {
72	        return acceptance_explain_command(spec);
73	    };
74	    match first {
75	        "add" => {
76	            let request = args.iter().skip(1).cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
77	            if request.is_empty() {
78	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
79	                    "done add needs a criterion",
80	                    "deadreckon def-done add \"users can save drawings\"",
81	                )));
82	            }
83	            acceptance_add_command(request, provider, model, force).await
84	        }
85	        "check" => acceptance_check_command(spec, against),
86	        "show" | "explain" => acceptance_explain_command(spec),
87	        "edit" | "refine" => {
88	            let request = args.iter().skip(1).cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
89	            if request.is_empty() {
90	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
91	                    "done edit needs a requested change",
92	                    "deadreckon def-done edit \"also require the gallery to persist\"",
93	                )));
94	            }
95	            acceptance_agent_command(AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine, request, provider, model, force)
96	                .await
97	        }
98	        "help" => {
99	            print_done_help();
100	            Ok(())
101	        }
102	        _ => {
103	            acceptance_agent_command(AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft, args, provider, model, true).await
104	        }
105	    }
106	}

114	    );

118	    );

152	pub(crate) async fn acceptance_agent_command_in_dir(
153	    cwd: &Path,
154	    mode: AcceptanceAgentMode,
155	    request: Vec<String>,
156	    provider: Option<String>,
157	    model: Option<String>,
158	    force: bool,
159	) -> Result<()> {
160	    let yaml_path = project_acceptance_yaml(cwd);
161	    let md_path = project_acceptance_md(cwd);
162	    let existing_yaml = read_optional_text(&yaml_path)?;
163	    let existing_md = read_optional_text(&md_path)?;
164	    if matches!(mode, AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine) && existing_yaml.is_none() {
165	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
166	            "no project done criteria found",
167	            "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"",
168	        )));
169	    }
170	    let request = acceptance_request_text(&request, mode)?;
171	    if !force && yaml_path.exists() && matches!(mode, AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft) {
172	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
173	            ".deadreckon/acceptance.yaml already exists",
174	            "deadreckon def-done add \"one more criterion\" or rerun with --overwrite",
175	        )));
176	    }
177	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
178	    let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
179	    let selected_provider = provider.or(defaults.doc_provider).or(defaults.provider);
180	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path_with_model(
181	        &paths.config_path(),
182	        selected_provider.as_deref(),
183	        model.as_deref(),
184	    )?;
185	    let route = router.selected_route_info();
186	    let prompt = acceptance_agent_prompt(
187	        mode,
188	        &request,
189	        cwd,
190	        existing_yaml.as_deref(),
191	        existing_md.as_deref(),
192	    )?;
193	    let response = with_cli_wait_status(
194	        match mode {
195	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => "compiling done criteria",
196	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => "refining done criteria",
197	        },
198	        router.complete(&ProviderRequest {
199	            prompt,
200	            max_output_tokens: 6_000,
201	            cwd: Some(cwd.to_path_buf()),
202	            output_path: None,
203	            sandbox_backend: None,
204	            pid_file: None,
205	            cancellation_token: None,
206	        }),
207	    )
208	    .await
209	    .map_err(|err| {
210	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
211	            &format!("done criteria provider failed: {err}"),
212	            "deadreckon def-done \"builds and passes tests\"",
213	        ))
214	    })?;
215	    let draft = parse_acceptance_agent_response(&response.content)?;
216	    acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?;
217	    write_project_acceptance(cwd, &draft, true, true)?;
218	    let route_label = route
219	        .map(|route| format!("{} / {}", route.name, route.model))
220	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "configured provider".to_string());
221	    print_acceptance_written(
222	        cwd,
223	        &format!("agent draft via {route_label}"),
224	        acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?,
225	    );
226	    Ok(())
227	}

229	async fn acceptance_add_command(
230	    request: Vec<String>,
231	    provider: Option<String>,
232	    model: Option<String>,
233	    force: bool,
234	) -> Result<()> {
235	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
236	    let joined = request.join(" ");
237	    if let Some(pack) = AcceptancePack::from_request(&joined) {
238	        return acceptance_add_pack_command(&cwd, pack, force);
239	    }
240	    let mode = if project_acceptance_yaml(&cwd).exists() {
241	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine
242	    } else {

248	fn acceptance_add_pack_command(cwd: &Path, pack: AcceptancePack, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
249	    let mut draft = if project_acceptance_yaml(cwd).exists() {
250	        let yaml = fs::read_to_string(project_acceptance_yaml(cwd))?;
251	        let markdown = read_optional_text(&project_acceptance_md(cwd))?
252	            .unwrap_or_else(|| acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(&yaml));
253	        AcceptanceDraft {
254	            yaml,
255	            markdown,
256	            files: BTreeMap::new(),
257	        }
258	    } else {
259	        AcceptanceDraft {
260	            yaml: "name: project acceptance\nchecks: []\n".to_string(),
261	            markdown: "# Done Criteria\n\n".to_string(),
262	            files: BTreeMap::new(),
263	        }
264	    };
265	    let pack_draft = acceptance_pack_draft(pack, cwd);
266	    draft.yaml = append_acceptance_checks(&draft.yaml, &pack_draft.yaml)?;
267	    if !draft.markdown.ends_with('\n') {
268	        draft.markdown.push('\n');
269	    }
270	    draft.markdown.push('\n');
271	    draft.markdown.push_str(pack_draft.markdown.trim());
272	    draft.markdown.push('\n');
273	    draft.files.extend(pack_draft.files);
274	    write_project_acceptance(cwd, &draft, force, true)?;
275	    print_acceptance_written(
276	        cwd,
277	        &format!("{} pack", pack.name()),
278	        acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?,
279	    );
280	    Ok(())
281	}

339	fn acceptance_explain_command(spec: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {

345	        println!("{}", ui_heading("done criteria"));
346	        println!("  {}   {}", ui_muted("spec:"), path.display());
347	        println!("  {} {count}", ui_muted("checks:"));
348	        if path == project_acceptance_yaml(&cwd)
349	            && let Some(markdown) = read_optional_text(&project_acceptance_md(&cwd))?
350	        {
351	            println!();
352	            println!("{}", markdown.trim());
353	        }
354	        println!();
355	        print_acceptance_yaml_summary(&raw)?;
356	    } else {
357	        println!("{}", ui_heading("done criteria"));
358	        println!("  {}   default dr-gate behavior", ui_muted("spec:"));
359	        println!(
360	            "  {} working directory exists, or cargo test when Cargo.toml is present",
361	            ui_muted("checks:")
362	        );
363	        println!();
364	        println!(
365	            "{}",
366	            ui_command("deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"")
367	        );
368	    }
369	    Ok(())
370	}

372	// SAFETY: Acceptance check paths are owned clap values at the command boundary.
373	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
374	fn acceptance_check_command(spec: Option<PathBuf>, against: Option<PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
375	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
376	    let working_dir = against.unwrap_or(cwd.clone());
377	    let spec_path = resolve_acceptance_path_for_command(&cwd, spec.as_deref())?;
378	    let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
379	        "deadreckon-acceptance-check-{}",
380	        Uuid::new_v4().simple()
381	    ));
382	    fs::create_dir_all(&temp_root)?;
383	    if let Some(spec_path) = spec_path.as_ref() {
384	        let raw = fs::read_to_string(spec_path)?;
385	        validate_acceptance_yaml_integrity(&raw)?;
386	        fs::copy(spec_path, acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&temp_root))?;
387	    }
388	    let result = evaluate_acceptance_checks(&temp_root, &working_dir);
389	    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&temp_root);
390	    match result {
391	        Ok(results) => {
392	            let failed_required = results
393	                .iter()
394	                .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed);
395	            if failed_required {
396	                println!("{} {}", ui_muted("working"), working_dir.display());
397	                if let Some(spec_path) = spec_path.as_ref() {
398	                    println!("{}    {}", ui_muted("spec"), spec_path.display());
399	                } else {
400	                    println!("{}    default dr-gate behavior", ui_muted("spec"));
401	                }
402	                print_acceptance_results(&results);
403	                if let Some(failed) = results
404	                    .iter()
405	                    .find(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed)
406	                {
407	                    return Err(CliError::Surface {
408	                        code: 1,
409	                        surface: acceptance_check_failure_surface(
410	                            &working_dir,
411	                            spec_path.as_ref(),
412	                            failed,
413	                        )
414	                        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
415	                    });
416	                }
417	            } else {
418	                print!(
419	                    "{}",
420	                    acceptance_check_success_surface(&working_dir, spec_path.as_ref(), &results)
421	                        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
422	                );
423	            }
424	            Ok(())
425	        }
426	        Err(err) => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
427	            &format!("done criteria check failed: {err}"),
428	            "fix the project or edit .deadreckon/acceptance.yaml, then rerun `deadreckon def-done check`",
429	        ))),
430	    }
431	}
432	
433	fn acceptance_check_success_surface(
434	    working_dir: &Path,
435	    spec_path: Option<&PathBuf>,
436	    results: &[deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult],
437	) -> VerdictSurface {
438	    let required = results.iter().filter(|result| result.must_pass).count();
439	    let passed = results.iter().filter(|result| result.passed).count();
440	    let failed_optional = results
441	        .iter()
442	        .filter(|result| !result.must_pass && !result.passed)
443	        .count();
444	    let mut evidence = vec![
445	        ("working", working_dir.display().to_string()),
446	        (
447	            "spec",
448	            spec_path
449	                .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
450	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "default dr-gate behavior".to_string()),
451	        ),
452	        ("checks", results.len().to_string()),
453	        ("required", required.to_string()),
454	        ("passed", passed.to_string()),
455	    ];
456	    if failed_optional > 0 {
457	        evidence.push(("optional failed", failed_optional.to_string()));
458	    }
459	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
460	        VerdictKind::Verified,
461	        "def-done",
462	        Some("check"),
463	        ExplanationPanel::new(
464	            "DeadReckon dry-ran the done criteria successfully.",
465	            "All required checks passed, so the done contract is ready to gate a run.",
466	            evidence,
467	        ),
468	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon run \"goal\"")],
469	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon def-done show")],
470	    )
471	    .expect("acceptance check success surface must be valid")
472	}
473	
474	fn acceptance_check_failure_surface(
475	    working_dir: &Path,
476	    spec_path: Option<&PathBuf>,
477	    failed: &deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult,
478	) -> VerdictSurface {
479	    let mut evidence = vec![
480	        ("working", working_dir.display().to_string()),
481	        (
482	            "spec",
483	            spec_path
484	                .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
485	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "default dr-gate behavior".to_string()),
486	        ),
487	        ("check", failed.kind.clone()),
488	        ("detail", one_line(&failed.detail, 140)),
489	    ];
490	    if let Some(command) = failed.command.as_ref() {
491	        evidence.push(("command", command.clone()));
492	    }
493	    if let Some(stderr) = failed.stderr.as_ref() {
494	        evidence.push(("stderr", one_line(stderr, 140)));
495	    }
496	    if let Some(stdout) = failed.stdout.as_ref() {
497	        evidence.push(("stdout", one_line(stdout, 140)));
498	    }
499	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
500	        VerdictKind::Failed,
501	        "def-done",
502	        Some("check"),
503	        ExplanationPanel::new(
504	            "A required done criterion failed during a dry-run check.",
505	            "DeadReckon cannot treat the done contract as verified until the project passes the required check or the criteria are corrected.",
506	            evidence,
507	        ),
508	        vec![(
509	            "Recommended",
510	            "deadreckon def-done edit \"tighten or correct the checks\"",
511	        )],
512	        vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon def-done check")],
513	    )
514	    .expect("acceptance check failure surface must be valid")
515	}
516	
517	pub(crate) fn print_acceptance_results(results: &[deadreckon_core::AcceptanceCheckResult]) {
518	    for result in results {
519	        let mark = if result.passed {
520	            ui_ok("✓")
521	        } else if result.must_pass {
522	            ui::render(ui::Stream::Stdout, ui::Tone::Negative, "✗")
523	        } else {
524	            ui_warn("!")
525	        };
526	        let requirement = if result.must_pass {
527	            "required"
528	        } else {
529	            "optional"
530	        };
531	        let elapsed = result
532	            .duration_ms
533	            .map(|ms| format!(" ({:.1}s)", ms as f64 / 1000.0))
534	            .unwrap_or_default();
535	        println!(
536	            "  {mark} {:<13} {:<8} {}{}",
537	            result.kind, requirement, result.detail, elapsed
538	        );
539	        if !result.passed {
540	            if let Some(command) = result.command.as_deref() {
541	                println!("      {} {}", ui_muted("command:"), ui_command(command));
542	            }
543	            if let Some(stderr) = result.stderr.as_deref() {
544	                println!("      {}  {}", ui_muted("stderr:"), one_line(stderr, 140));
545	            }
546	            if let Some(stdout) = result.stdout.as_deref() {
547	                println!("      {}  {}", ui_muted("stdout:"), one_line(stdout, 140));
548	            }
549	        }
550	    }
551	}

553	fn acceptance_request_text(request: &[String], mode: AcceptanceAgentMode) -> Result<String> {
554	    let joined = request.join(" ").trim().to_string();
555	    if !joined.is_empty() {
556	        return Ok(joined);
557	    }
558	    if io::stdin().is_terminal() {
559	        let prompt_text = match mode {
560	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => "what should count as done? ",
561	            AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => "how should done criteria change? ",
562	        };
563	        let answer = prompt::open(prompt_text, None)?;
564	        if !answer.trim().is_empty() {
565	            return Ok(answer.trim().to_string());
566	        }
567	    }
568	    match mode {
569	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => Ok(
570	            "Draft practical acceptance criteria for this project and its likely build/test flow."
571	                .to_string(),
572	        ),
573	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
574	            "refine needs a requested change",
575	            "deadreckon def-done add \"also require tests for the gallery\"",
576	        ))),
577	    }
578	}
579	
580	fn acceptance_agent_prompt(
581	    mode: AcceptanceAgentMode,
582	    request: &str,
583	    cwd: &Path,
584	    existing_yaml: Option<&str>,
585	    existing_md: Option<&str>,
586	) -> Result<String> {
587	    let mode_label = match mode {
588	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft => "draft",
589	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Refine => "refine",
590	    };
591	    let project = acceptance_project_summary(cwd)?;
592	    Ok(format!(
593	        "\
594	You are helping configure deadreckon acceptance criteria for an unattended coding run.
595	The user writes acceptance in plain English. Convert it into executable checks that dr-gate can run.
596	
597	Return JSON only, with exactly these keys:
598	{{\"acceptance_yaml\":\"...\",\"acceptance_md\":\"...\",\"files\":{{}}}}
599	
600	The YAML must be valid deadreckon acceptance.yaml. Use only these check kinds:
601	- file_exists with path
602	- content_match with path and pattern
603	- shell with command and optional cwd
604	- cargo_test
605	
606	Use {{working_dir}} for paths inside the run. Prefer stable, automatable checks over subjective claims.
607	Do not include self-attestation checks, provider-output checks, or instructions that the agent can satisfy by writing a marker.
608	For Node projects, prefer `npm run build --if-present` and `npm test --if-present` shell checks.
609	For static apps, require the main HTML/CSS/JS files and one or two content_match checks for requested behavior.
610	If a criterion needs a helper script, include it in files under `.deadreckon/acceptance/` and call it from a shell check.
611	The acceptance_md must restate the user's criteria in readable English before listing the executable checks.
612	Keep the YAML concise and include at least one required check.
613	
614	Mode: {mode_label}
615	User request: {request}
616	
617	Project summary:
618	{project}
619	
620	Existing acceptance.yaml:
621	{existing_yaml}
622	
623	Existing acceptance.md:
624	{existing_md}
625	",
626	        existing_yaml = existing_yaml.unwrap_or("(none)"),
627	        existing_md = existing_md.unwrap_or("(none)")
628	    ))
629	}
630	
631	fn acceptance_project_summary(cwd: &Path) -> Result<String> {
632	    let mut lines = vec![format!("root: {}", cwd.display())];
633	    if cwd.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
634	        lines.push("stack: rust".to_string());
635	    }
636	    if cwd.join("package.json").exists() {
637	        lines.push("stack: node".to_string());
638	        if let Ok(package) = fs::read_to_string(cwd.join("package.json"))
639	            && let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&package)
640	            && let Some(scripts) = value.get("scripts").and_then(Value::as_object)
641	        {
642	            let mut script_names = scripts.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
643	            script_names.sort();
644	            lines.push(format!("package scripts: {}", script_names.join(", ")));
645	        }
646	    }
647	    let files = project_file_sample(cwd, 80)?;
648	    lines.push("files:".to_string());
649	    for file in files {
650	        lines.push(format!("  - {}", file.display()));
651	    }
652	    Ok(lines.join("\n"))
653	}
654	
655	fn project_file_sample(cwd: &Path, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {
656	    fn walk(
657	        root: &Path,
658	        current: &Path,
659	        depth: usize,
660	        out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
661	        limit: usize,
662	    ) -> io::Result<()> {
663	        if depth > 3 || out.len() >= limit {
664	            return Ok(());
665	        }
666	        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)?.collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
667	        entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
668	        for entry in entries {
669	            if out.len() >= limit {
670	                break;
671	            }
672	            let path = entry.path();
673	            let name = entry.file_name();
674	            let name = name.to_string_lossy();
675	            if matches!(
676	                name.as_ref(),
677	                ".git" | "target" | "node_modules" | ".deadreckon" | "dist" | "build"
678	            ) {
679	                continue;
680	            }
681	            if path.is_dir() {
682	                walk(root, &path, depth + 1, out, limit)?;
683	            } else if let Ok(relative) = path.strip_prefix(root) {
684	                out.push(relative.to_path_buf());
685	            }
686	        }
687	        Ok(())
688	    }
689	    let mut files = Vec::new();
690	    walk(cwd, cwd, 0, &mut files, limit)?;
691	    Ok(files)
692	}
693	
694	fn parse_acceptance_agent_response(content: &str) -> Result<AcceptanceDraft> {
695	    let cleaned = strip_code_fence(content.trim());
696	    if let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&cleaned)
697	        && let Some(parsed) = acceptance_json_payload(&value)?
698	    {
699	        return Ok(parsed);
700	    }
701	    if let Some(json) = extract_json_object(&cleaned)
702	        && let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&json)
703	        && let Some(parsed) = acceptance_json_payload(&value)?
704	    {
705	        return Ok(parsed);
706	    }
707	    if let Some(yaml) = extract_fenced_block(&cleaned, &["yaml", "yml"]).or_else(|| {
708	        if cleaned.contains("checks:") {
709	            Some(cleaned.clone())
710	        } else {
711	            None
712	        }
713	    }) {
714	        let markdown = extract_fenced_block(&cleaned, &["markdown", "md"])
715	            .unwrap_or_else(|| acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(&yaml));
716	        acceptance_check_count(&yaml)?;
717	        return Ok(AcceptanceDraft {
718	            yaml,
719	            markdown,
720	            files: BTreeMap::new(),
721	        });
722	    }
723	    Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
724	        "provider did not return acceptance JSON or YAML",
725	        "rerun `deadreckon def-done ...` or use `deadreckon def-done check` after editing criteria",
726	    )))
727	}
728	
729	fn acceptance_json_payload(value: &Value) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceDraft>> {
730	    let Some(object) = value.as_object() else {
731	        return Ok(None);
732	    };
733	    let yaml = object
734	        .get("acceptance_yaml")
735	        .or_else(|| object.get("yaml"))
736	        .and_then(Value::as_str);
737	    let Some(yaml) = yaml else {
738	        return Ok(None);
739	    };
740	    let markdown = object
741	        .get("acceptance_md")
742	        .or_else(|| object.get("markdown"))
743	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
744	        .map(ToString::to_string)
745	        .unwrap_or_else(|| acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(yaml));
746	    acceptance_check_count(yaml)?;
747	    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
748	    if let Some(file_map) = object.get("files").and_then(Value::as_object) {
749	        for (path, body) in file_map {
750	            let Some(body) = body.as_str() else {
751	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
752	                    &format!("acceptance helper {path} must be a string"),
753	                    "return files as {\".deadreckon/acceptance/name\": \"contents\"}",
754	                )));
755	            };
756	            let path = PathBuf::from(path);
757	            validate_acceptance_helper_path(&path)?;
758	            files.insert(path, body.to_string());
759	        }
760	    }
761	    Ok(Some(AcceptanceDraft {
762	        yaml: yaml.to_string(),
763	        markdown,
764	        files,
765	    }))
766	}
767	
768	fn strip_code_fence(value: &str) -> String {
769	    let trimmed = value.trim();
770	    if !trimmed.starts_with("```") {
771	        return trimmed.to_string();
772	    }
773	    let mut lines = trimmed.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
774	    if lines.len() >= 2 && lines.last().is_some_and(|line| line.trim() == "```") {
775	        lines.remove(0);
776	        lines.pop();
777	        return lines.join("\n");
778	    }
779	    trimmed.to_string()
780	}
781	
782	fn extract_json_object(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
783	    let start = value.find('{')?;
784	    let end = value.rfind('}')?;
785	    if end <= start {
786	        return None;
787	    }
788	    Some(value[start..=end].to_string())
789	}
790	
791	fn extract_fenced_block(value: &str, languages: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
792	    let mut in_block = false;
793	    let mut capture = false;
794	    let mut lines = Vec::new();
795	    for line in value.lines() {
796	        let trimmed = line.trim();
797	        if let Some(rest) = trimmed.strip_prefix("```") {
798	            if in_block {
799	                if capture {
800	                    return Some(lines.join("\n"));
801	                }
802	                in_block = false;
803	                continue;
804	            }
805	            in_block = true;
806	            capture = languages
807	                .iter()
808	                .any(|language| rest.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case(language));
809	            lines.clear();
810	            continue;
811	        }
812	        if in_block && capture {
813	            lines.push(line);
814	        }
815	    }
816	    None
817	}

819	pub(crate) async fn ensure_acceptance_before_start(
820	    cwd: &Path,
821	    override_path: Option<&Path>,
822	    goal: &str,
823	    provider: Option<String>,
824	    model: Option<String>,
825	    skip_prompt: bool,
826	    noun: &str,
827	) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceSource>> {
828	    let existing = resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, override_path)?;
829	    if existing.is_some() || override_path.is_some() || skip_prompt || !io::stdin().is_terminal() {
830	        return Ok(existing);
831	    }
832	    println!("{}", ui_heading("done criteria"));
833	    println!("No done criteria found.");
834	    println!("Write the definition of done in English; deadreckon will compile it for dr-gate.");
835	    if !prompt::confirm(&format!("write done criteria before this {noun}?"), true)? {
836	        println!("using default gate: working directory exists, or cargo test for Rust projects");
837	        return Ok(existing);
838	    }
839	    let request = prompt::open("definition of done (Enter for a practical default): ", None)?;
840	    let request = if request.trim().is_empty() {
841	        format!("For this {noun}, define practical acceptance checks for: {goal}")
842	    } else {
843	        request.trim().to_string()
844	    };
845	    match acceptance_agent_command_in_dir(
846	        cwd,
847	        AcceptanceAgentMode::Draft,
848	        vec![request],
849	        provider,
850	        model,
851	        false,
852	    )
853	    .await
854	    {
855	        Ok(()) => resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, None).map(mark_generated_done_criteria),
856	        Err(err) => {
857	            println!("{}", ui_status("done criteria draft failed"));
858	            println!("  {err}");
859	            if !prompt::confirm("use a detected local check template instead?", true)? {
860	                return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
861	                    "done criteria were requested but not configured",
862	                    "rerun `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"` or answer yes to the detected template fallback",
863	                )));
864	            }
865	            let preset = detect_acceptance_preset(cwd);
866	            let draft = acceptance_template_for_preset(preset, cwd);
867	            write_project_acceptance(cwd, &draft, false, false)?;
868	            print_acceptance_written(
869	                cwd,
870	                "detected template",
871	                acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?,
872	            );
873	            resolve_acceptance_source(cwd, None).map(mark_generated_done_criteria)
874	        }
875	    }
876	}

878	pub(crate) fn resolve_acceptance_source(
879	    cwd: &Path,
880	    override_path: Option<&Path>,
881	) -> Result<Option<AcceptanceSource>> {
882	    if let Some(path) = override_path {
883	        let path = absolute_from(cwd, path);
884	        if !path.is_file() {
885	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
886	                &format!("done criteria file not found: {}", path.display()),
887	                "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"",
888	            )));
889	        }
890	        return Ok(Some(AcceptanceSource {
891	            path,
892	            source: setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ExplicitPath,
893	            companion_doc: None,
894	        }));
895	    }
896	    let project_yaml = project_acceptance_yaml(cwd);
897	    if project_yaml.is_file() {
898	        let project_md = project_acceptance_md(cwd);
899	        return Ok(Some(AcceptanceSource {
900	            path: project_yaml,
901	            source: setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ProjectFile,
902	            companion_doc: project_md.is_file().then_some(project_md),
903	        }));
904	    }
905	    Ok(None)
906	}

918	    source: &Option<AcceptanceSource>,
919	) -> Result<setup::DoneCriteriaSelection> {

921	        Some(source) => {

924	            Ok(match source.source {
925	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ExplicitPath => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::explicit(

928	                    checks,
929	                ),
930	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::ProjectFile => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::project(
931	                    source.path.clone(),

935	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::Generated => setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::generated(
936	                    source.path.clone(),
937	                    source.companion_doc.clone(),
938	                    checks,
939	                ),
940	                setup::DoneCriteriaSource::DefaultGate => {

949	pub(crate) fn copy_acceptance_into_run(
950	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
951	    source: &Option<AcceptanceSource>,
952	) -> Result<()> {
953	    let Some(source) = source else {
954	        return Ok(());
955	    };
956	    fs::copy(
957	        &source.path,
958	        acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&state.run_root),
959	    )?;
960	    if let Some(doc) = source.companion_doc.as_ref() {
961	        fs::copy(doc, state.run_root.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_MD))?;
962	    }
963	    let Some(project_dir) = source.path.parent() else {
964	        return Ok(());
965	    };
966	    let helper_source = project_dir.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
967	    if helper_source.is_dir() {
968	        let helper_dest = state
969	            .working_dir
970	            .join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR)
971	            .join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
972	        if !same_path_best_effort(&helper_source, &helper_dest) {
973	            copy_tree(&helper_source, &helper_dest)?;
974	        }
975	    }
976	    Ok(())
977	}

998	fn same_path_best_effort(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> bool {
999	    if left == right {
1000	        return true;
1001	    }
1002	    match (left.canonicalize(), right.canonicalize()) {
1003	        (Ok(left), Ok(right)) => left == right,
1004	        _ => false,
1005	    }
1006	}

1040	pub(crate) fn write_project_acceptance(
1041	    cwd: &Path,
1042	    draft: &AcceptanceDraft,
1043	    force: bool,
1044	    allow_existing: bool,
1045	) -> Result<()> {
1046	    acceptance_check_count(&draft.yaml)?;
1047	    validate_acceptance_yaml_integrity(&draft.yaml)?;
1048	    let dir = cwd.join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR);
1049	    let yaml_path = project_acceptance_yaml(cwd);
1050	    let md_path = project_acceptance_md(cwd);
1051	    if !allow_existing && !force && (yaml_path.exists() || md_path.exists()) {
1052	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1053	            ".deadreckon/acceptance files already exist",
1054	            "deadreckon def-done add \"one more criterion\" or rerun with --overwrite",
1055	        )));
1056	    }
1057	    fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
1058	    fs::write(&yaml_path, ensure_trailing_newline(&draft.yaml))?;
1059	    fs::write(&md_path, ensure_trailing_newline(&draft.markdown))?;
1060	    for (relative_path, body) in &draft.files {
1061	        let path = validate_acceptance_helper_path(relative_path)?;
1062	        let absolute = cwd.join(path);
1063	        if !force && absolute.exists() {
1064	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1065	                &format!("acceptance helper already exists: {}", absolute.display()),
1066	                "rerun with --overwrite or edit the helper manually",
1067	            )));
1068	        }
1069	        if let Some(parent) = absolute.parent() {
1070	            fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
1071	        }
1072	        fs::write(absolute, ensure_trailing_newline(body))?;
1073	    }
1074	    Ok(())
1075	}
1076	
1077	fn validate_acceptance_helper_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
1078	    if path.is_absolute()
1079	        || path
1080	            .components()
1081	            .any(|component| matches!(component, std::path::Component::ParentDir))
1082	    {
1083	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1084	            &format!("invalid acceptance helper path: {}", path.display()),
1085	            "helper files must live under .deadreckon/acceptance/",
1086	        )));
1087	    }
1088	    let required_prefix = Path::new(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_DIR).join(PROJECT_ACCEPTANCE_HELPERS);
1089	    if !path.starts_with(&required_prefix) {
1090	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1091	            &format!("invalid acceptance helper path: {}", path.display()),
1092	            "helper files must live under .deadreckon/acceptance/",
1093	        )));
1094	    }
1095	    Ok(path.to_path_buf())
1096	}

1101	    let primary = "deadreckon def-done check";

1110	                "The criteria are configured; check them once before launching a long run.",

1112	                    ("source", source.to_string()),
1113	                    ("checks", checks.to_string()),
1114	                    ("yaml", yaml_path.display().to_string()),
1115	                    ("notes", notes_path.display().to_string()),
1116	                ],
1117	            ),
1118	            vec![("Recommended", primary)],
1119	            vec![("Secondary", "deadreckon run \"goal\"")],

1124	}

1126	fn detect_acceptance_preset(cwd: &Path) -> AcceptancePreset {
1127	    if cwd.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
1128	        AcceptancePreset::Rust
1129	    } else if cwd.join("package.json").exists() {
1130	        AcceptancePreset::Node
1131	    } else if cwd.join("index.html").exists() || cwd.join("public/index.html").exists() {
1132	        AcceptancePreset::StaticSite
1133	    } else {
1134	        AcceptancePreset::Basic
1135	    }

1138	pub(crate) fn acceptance_template_for_preset(
1139	    preset: AcceptancePreset,
1140	    cwd: &Path,
1141	) -> AcceptanceDraft {
1142	    let yaml = match preset {
1143	        AcceptancePreset::Auto => unreachable!("auto is resolved before template generation"),
1144	        AcceptancePreset::Rust => {
1145	            "\
1146	name: rust project acceptance
1147	checks:
1148	  - kind: file_exists
1149	    path: \"{working_dir}/Cargo.toml\"
1150	  - kind: cargo_test
1151	"
1152	        }
1153	        AcceptancePreset::Node => {
1154	            "\
1155	name: node project acceptance
1156	checks:
1157	  - kind: file_exists
1158	    path: \"{working_dir}/package.json\"
1159	  - kind: shell
1160	    command: \"npm run build --if-present\"
1161	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1162	  - kind: shell
1163	    command: \"npm test --if-present\"
1164	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1165	    must_pass: false
1166	"
1167	        }
1168	        AcceptancePreset::StaticSite => {
1169	            if cwd.join("public/index.html").exists() && !cwd.join("index.html").exists() {
1170	                "\
1171	name: static site acceptance
1172	checks:
1173	  - kind: file_exists
1174	    path: \"{working_dir}/public/index.html\"
1175	  - kind: shell
1176	    command: \"test -s public/index.html\"
1177	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1178	"
1179	            } else {
1180	                "\
1181	name: static site acceptance
1182	checks:
1183	  - kind: file_exists
1184	    path: \"{working_dir}/index.html\"
1185	  - kind: shell
1186	    command: \"test -s index.html\"
1187	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1188	"
1189	            }
1190	        }
1191	        AcceptancePreset::Basic => {
1192	            "\
1193	name: basic project acceptance
1194	checks:
1195	  - kind: shell
1196	    command: \"test -d .\"
1197	    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"
1198	"
1199	        }
1200	    }
1201	    .to_string();
1202	    let markdown = format!(
1203	        "\
1204	# Done Criteria
1205	
1206	These checks define what `deadreckon` should verify before promoting a completed run.
1207	
1208	{}
1209	",
1210	        acceptance_markdown_from_yaml(&yaml)
1211	    );
1212	    AcceptanceDraft {
1213	        yaml,
1214	        markdown,
1215	        files: BTreeMap::new(),
1216	    }
1217	}

1219	fn acceptance_pack_draft(pack: AcceptancePack, cwd: &Path) -> AcceptanceDraft {
1220	    let pack = match pack {
1221	        AcceptancePack::Auto => match detect_acceptance_preset(cwd) {
1222	            AcceptancePreset::Rust => AcceptancePack::Rust,
1223	            AcceptancePreset::Node => AcceptancePack::Node,
1224	            AcceptancePreset::StaticSite => AcceptancePack::StaticSite,
1225	            AcceptancePreset::Basic | AcceptancePreset::Auto => AcceptancePack::Basic,
1226	        },
1227	        other => other,
1228	    };
1229	    let yaml = match pack {
1230	        AcceptancePack::Basic => {
1231	            "name: basic acceptance pack\nchecks:\n  - kind: shell\n    command: \"test -d .\"\n    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"\n"
1232	        }
1233	        AcceptancePack::Build => {
1234	            if cwd.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
1235	                "name: build acceptance pack\nchecks:\n  - kind: build_success\n    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"\n"
1236	            } else if cwd.join("package.json").exists() {
1237	                "name: build acceptance pack\nchecks:\n  - kind: shell\n    command: \"npm run build --if-present\"\n    cwd: \"{working_dir}\"\n"
1238	            } else if cwd.join("pyproject.toml").exists() || cwd.join("requirements.txt").exists() {

1312	fn append_acceptance_checks(existing_raw: &str, addition_raw: &str) -> Result<String> {
1313	    let mut existing = acceptance_yaml_value(existing_raw)?;
1314	    let addition = acceptance_yaml_value(addition_raw)?;
1315	    let mut checks = yaml_mapping_get(&addition, "checks")
1316	        .map(yaml_items)
1317	        .unwrap_or_default()
1318	        .into_iter()
1319	        .cloned()
1320	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1321	    if checks.is_empty() {
1322	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1323	            "acceptance pack did not contain checks",
1324	            "try `deadreckon def-done add browser` or `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"`",
1325	        )));
1326	    }
1327	    let mapping = existing.as_mapping_mut().ok_or_else(|| {
1328	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1329	            "acceptance.yaml must be a mapping",
1330	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" --overwrite`",
1331	        ))
1332	    })?;
1333	    let key = serde_yaml::Value::String("checks".to_string());
1334	    let entry = mapping
1335	        .entry(key)
1336	        .or_insert_with(|| serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(Vec::new()));
1337	    match entry {
1338	        serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(existing_checks) => existing_checks.append(&mut checks),
1339	        other => {
1340	            let mut merged = yaml_items(other).into_iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1341	            merged.append(&mut checks);
1342	            *other = serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(merged);
1343	        }
1344	    }
1345	    serde_yaml::to_string(&existing).map_err(|source| {
1346	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1347	            &format!("failed to write acceptance.yaml: {source}"),
1348	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" --overwrite`",
1349	        ))
1350	    })
1351	}

1353	fn browser_smoke_script() -> &'static str {
1354	    r#"#!/usr/bin/env node
1355	const fs = require('fs');
1356	const http = require('http');
1357	const path = require('path');
1358	
1359	const requestedRoot = process.argv[2];
1360	const candidates = [requestedRoot, 'dist', 'build', 'public', '.'].filter(Boolean);
1361	const root = candidates.find((candidate) => fs.existsSync(path.join(candidate, 'index.html')));
1362	if (!root) {
1363	  console.error('No index.html found in dist, build, public, or project root.');
1364	  process.exit(1);
1365	}
1366	
1367	const mime = new Map([
1368	  ['.html', 'text/html'],
1369	  ['.js', 'text/javascript'],
1370	  ['.css', 'text/css'],
1371	  ['.json', 'application/json'],
1372	  ['.svg', 'image/svg+xml'],
1373	]);
1374	
1375	const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
1376	  const urlPath = decodeURIComponent((req.url || '/').split('?')[0]);
1377	  const safePath = path.normalize(urlPath === '/' ? '/index.html' : urlPath).replace(/^(\.\.[/\\])+/, '');
1378	  const file = path.join(root, safePath);
1379	  if (!file.startsWith(path.resolve(root)) && path.isAbsolute(file)) {
1380	    res.writeHead(403);
1381	    res.end('forbidden');
1382	    return;
1383	  }
1384	  fs.readFile(file, (err, body) => {
1385	    if (err) {
1386	      res.writeHead(404);
1387	      res.end('missing');
1388	      return;
1389	    }
1390	    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': mime.get(path.extname(file)) || 'application/octet-stream' });
1391	    res.end(body);
1392	  });
1393	});
1394	
1395	server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', async () => {
1396	  const { port } = server.address();
1397	  try {
1398	    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`);
1399	    const body = await response.text();
1400	    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
1401	    if (!/<html[\s>]/i.test(body)) throw new Error('index response did not look like HTML');
1402	    console.log(`loaded ${root}/index.html over HTTP`);
1403	  } catch (error) {
1404	    console.error(error.message || String(error));
1405	    process.exitCode = 1;
1406	  } finally {
1407	    server.close();
1408	  }
1409	});
1410	"#
1411	}

1415	
1416	test('app loads without browser console errors', async ({ page }) => {
1417	  const errors = [];
1418	  page.on('console', (message) => {
1419	    if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(message.text());
1420	  });
1421	  page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
1422	  await page.goto(process.env.DEADRECKON_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:4173/', {
1423	    waitUntil: 'networkidle',
1424	  });
1425	  await expect(page.locator('body')).toBeVisible();
1426	  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
1427	});
1428	"#
1429	}

1472	fn describe_acceptance_item(group: &str, item: &serde_yaml::Value) -> String {
1473	    if let Some(command) = item.as_str() {
1474	        return format!("{group}: shell {}", one_line(command, 96));
1475	    }
1476	    let Some(mapping) = item.as_mapping() else {
1477	        return format!("{group}: {}", one_line(&format!("{item:?}"), 120));
1478	    };
1479	    let kind = yaml_mapping_get(item, "kind")
1480	        .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1481	        .map(ToString::to_string)
1482	        .or_else(|| {
1483	            if mapping.len() == 1 {
1484	                mapping
1485	                    .keys()
1486	                    .next()
1487	                    .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1488	                    .map(ToString::to_string)
1489	            } else {
1490	                None
1491	            }
1492	        })
1493	        .unwrap_or_else(|| group.to_string());
1494	    let path = yaml_mapping_get(item, "path")
1495	        .and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str)
1496	        .or_else(|| yaml_mapping_get(item, "cwd").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str));
1497	    let command = yaml_mapping_get(item, "command").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str);
1498	    let pattern = yaml_mapping_get(item, "pattern").and_then(serde_yaml::Value::as_str);
1499	    let detail = command
1500	        .or(path)
1501	        .or(pattern)
1502	        .map(|value| one_line(value, 96))
1503	        .unwrap_or_else(|| one_line(&format!("{item:?}"), 96));
1504	    format!("{group}: {kind} {detail}")
1505	}

1507	pub(crate) fn acceptance_check_count(raw: &str) -> Result<usize> {
1508	    let root = acceptance_yaml_value(raw)?;
1509	    let mut count = 0;
1510	    for key in [
1511	        "checks",
1512	        "required",
1513	        "optional",
1514	        "tests",
1515	        "file-exists",
1516	        "content-match",
1517	        "build-success",
1518	    ] {
1519	        if let Some(value) = yaml_mapping_get(&root, key) {
1520	            count += yaml_items(value).len();
1521	        }
1522	    }
1523	    if count == 0 {
1524	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1525	            "acceptance.yaml does not contain any recognized checks",
1526	            "run `deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"`",
1527	        )));
1528	    }
1529	    Ok(count)
1530	}

1532	fn validate_acceptance_yaml_integrity(raw: &str) -> Result<()> {
1533	    let checks = deadreckon_core::gate::acceptance_checks_from_yaml(raw)?;
1534	    let findings = deadreckon_core::tamper::lint_checks(&checks);
1535	    if let Some(finding) = findings.first() {
1536	        return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1537	            &format!(
1538	                "done criteria rejected: suppression pattern '{}' in {} check",
1539	                finding.pattern, finding.check_kind
1540	            ),
1541	            "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" and remove the suppression; checks must fail honestly",
1542	        )));
1543	    }
1544	    Ok(())
1545	}

1556	fn yaml_mapping_get<'a>(value: &'a serde_yaml::Value, key: &str) -> Option<&'a serde_yaml::Value> {
1557	    value
1558	        .as_mapping()?
1559	        .get(serde_yaml::Value::String(key.to_string()))
1560	}

1562	fn yaml_items(value: &serde_yaml::Value) -> Vec<&serde_yaml::Value> {
1563	    match value {
1564	        serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(items) => items.iter().collect(),
1565	        serde_yaml::Value::Null => Vec::new(),
1566	        value => vec![value],
1567	    }
1568	}

162	// SAFETY: Import options are owned clap values at the command boundary.
163	#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value)]
164	pub(crate) fn import_command(options: ImportCommandOptions) -> Result<()> {
165	    // Import is a read-only recovery bridge. It reads provider transcript roots
166	    // through descriptor [ingest] metadata and writes only deadreckon run state.
167	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
168	    let cwd = options
169	        .cwd
170	        .as_deref()
171	        .map(|path| fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf()))
172	        .unwrap_or(std::env::current_dir()?);
173	    let since = import_since(&options)?;
174	    let resolved = resolve_import_source(&paths, &options, &cwd)?;
175	    let candidates = discover_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &cwd, since);
176	
177	    if options.list {
178	        print_import_candidates(&resolved, &candidates, options.json, "import_candidates")?;
179	        return Ok(());
180	    }
181	
182	    if candidates.is_empty() {
183	        let stale = stale_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &cwd, since);
184	        if !stale.is_empty() {
185	            return Err(import_invalid(format!(
186	                "no fresh import candidates for {}; stale candidates were found\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --since 1d --preview",
187	                resolved.alias,
188	                import_candidate_table(&stale),
189	                resolved.alias
190	            )));
191	        }
192	    }
193	
194	    let (selected, mode) = select_import_candidates(&resolved, &options, &candidates)?;
195	    if options.preview {
196	        print_import_selection(&resolved, &selected, mode, options.json)?;
197	        return Ok(());
198	    }
199	
200	    let (run_id, manifest) = normalize_import(&paths, &resolved, &selected, mode, &options, &cwd)?;
201	    let manifest_path = paths
202	        .run_root(&manifest_scope(&cwd)?, &run_id)
203	        .join("import.json");
204	    let surface = import_completed_surface(&resolved, &run_id, &manifest, &manifest_path, mode);
205	    if options.json {
206	        let primary = surface.primary_action.command.clone();
207	        let secondary = manifest.reimport_command.clone();
208	        println!(
209	            "{}",
210	            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(serde_json::to_value(
211	                ImportCompletedJson {
212	                    kind: "import_completed",
213	                    run_id: &run_id,
214	                    manifest_path,
215	                    manifest: &manifest,
216	                    next_actions: vec![primary.clone(), secondary.clone()],
217	                    try_lines: vec![primary, secondary],
218	                },
219	            )?))?
220	        );
221	        return Ok(());
222	    }
223	
224	    println!("{}", surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)));
225	    Ok(())
226	}

228	fn manifest_scope(cwd: &Path) -> Result<String> {
229	    workspace_scope(cwd).map_err(CliError::from)
230	}
231	
232	fn normalize_import(
233	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
234	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
235	    selected: &[ImportCandidate],
236	    mode: ImportMode,
237	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
238	    cwd: &Path,
239	) -> Result<(String, ImportManifest)> {
240	    let source_paths = import_source_paths(resolved, selected)?;
241	    let content_hash = sha256_for_paths(&source_paths)?;
242	    let imported_id = import_run_id(resolved, selected, mode);
243	    let scope = workspace_scope(cwd).map_err(CliError::from)?;
244	    let existing_root = paths.run_root(&scope, &imported_id);
245	    if existing_root.exists() {
246	        if let Some(previous) = read_import_manifest(&existing_root)?
247	            && previous.content_hash != content_hash
248	            && !options.replace
249	        {
250	            return Err(import_invalid(format!(
251	                "existing import run {} has changed content\nold {}\nnew {}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session {} --replace",
252	                imported_id,
253	                previous.content_hash,
254	                content_hash,
255	                resolved.alias,
256	                shell_arg(&selected_session_arg(selected))
257	            )));
258	        }
259	        fs::remove_dir_all(&existing_root)?;
260	    }
261	
262	    let imported_at = Utc::now();
263	    let parsed = parse_import_candidates(resolved, selected)?;
264	    let mut state = create_run(
265	        paths,
266	        RunOptions {
267	            goal: format!(
268	                "imported {} {}",
269	                import_display_source(&resolved.source),
270	                import_mode_label(mode)
271	            ),
272	            cwd: cwd.to_path_buf(),
273	            sandbox: "none".to_string(),
274	            provider: Some(format!("import:{}", resolved.source)),
275	            skill_name: "default-coding".to_string(),
276	            max_spend_usd: None,
277	            max_wall_seconds: None,
278	            run_id: Some(imported_id.clone()),
279	            codebase: None,
280	        },
281	    )?;
282	
283	    let session_id = import_session_id(selected, mode);
284	    let mut provenance_records = 0usize;
285	    for (idx, event) in parsed.events.iter().enumerate() {
286	        let turn = (idx + 1) as u32;
287	        append_trace(
288	            &state,
289	            &TraceRecord {
290	                timestamp: event.timestamp.unwrap_or(imported_at),
291	                run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
292	                turn,
293	                event: format!("import.{}", import_display_source(&resolved.source)),
294	                latency_ms: None,
295	                detail: serde_json::to_value(ImportedTraceDetail {
296	                    import_version: 1,
297	                    source: &resolved.source,
298	                    schema: &resolved.schema,
299	                    session_id: session_id.as_deref(),
300	                    source_path: &event.source_path,
301	                    source_line: event.source_line,
302	                    source_event: &event.source_event,
303	                    role: event.role.as_deref(),
304	                    summary: &event.summary,
305	                    tool_name: event.tool_name.as_deref(),
306	                    tool_category: event.tool_category.as_deref(),
307	                    tool_call_id: event.tool_call_id.as_deref(),
308	                    files: &event.files,
309	                    usage: event.usage.as_ref(),
310	                    raw_hash: &event.raw_hash,
311	                })?,
312	            },
313	        )?;
314	        if !event.files.is_empty() {
315	            provenance_records += 1;
316	            append_provenance(
317	                &state,
318	                &ProvenanceRecord {
319	                    timestamp: event.timestamp.unwrap_or(imported_at),
320	                    prompt_id: format!("turn-{turn}"),
321	                    model: format!("import:{}", resolved.source),
322	                    tool_call_id: event
323	                        .tool_call_id
324	                        .clone()
325	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("imported-{turn}")),
326	                    session_id: state.run_id.clone(),
327	                    files: event.files.clone(),
328	                },
329	            )?;
330	        }
331	    }
332	
333	    state.turn = parsed.events.len() as u32;
334	    state.status = RunStatus::Completed;
335	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
336	    save_state(&state)?;
337	
338	    let manifest = ImportManifest {
339	        version: 1,
340	        source: resolved.source.clone(),
341	        source_alias: resolved.alias.clone(),
342	        schema: resolved.schema.clone(),
343	        storage: ingest_storage_label(&resolved.storage).to_string(),
344	        cwd: cwd.to_path_buf(),
345	        mode: import_mode_label(mode).to_string(),
346	        session_id,
347	        session_paths: source_paths,
348	        content_hash,
349	        imported_at,
350	        source_started_at: parsed.source_started_at,
351	        source_updated_at: parsed.source_updated_at,
352	        rows_seen: parsed.rows_seen,
353	        events_imported: parsed.events.len(),
354	        provenance_records,
355	        raw_rows_stored: false,
356	        reimport_command: reimport_command(resolved, selected, mode),
357	    };
358	    fs::write(
359	        state.run_root.join("import.json"),
360	        format!("{}\n", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&manifest)?),
361	    )?;
362	    Ok((imported_id, manifest))
363	}
