365	fn resolve_import_source(
366	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
367	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
368	    cwd: &Path,
369	) -> Result<ResolvedImportSource> {
370	    let source = options.source.trim();
371	    if source == "cursor" {
372	        let home = std::env::var_os("HOME")
373	            .map(PathBuf::from)
374	            .unwrap_or_else(|| paths.home().to_path_buf());
375	        let root = std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_IMPORT_CURSOR_ROOT")
376	            .map(PathBuf::from)
377	            .unwrap_or_else(|| home.join(".cursor/chats"));
378	        return Ok(ResolvedImportSource {
379	            alias: source.to_string(),
380	            source: "cursor".to_string(),
381	            schema: "cursor-sqlite".to_string(),
382	            storage: IngestStorage::Json,
383	            roots: vec![root],
384	            cwd_match: IngestCwdMatch::None,
385	            cwd_match_path: None,
386	            file_glob: Some("*.db".to_string()),
387	            id_prefix: Some("cursor:".to_string()),
388	            kind: ImportSourceKind::Cursor,
389	        });
390	    }
391	
392	    let descriptor_id = import_descriptor_id(source).ok_or_else(|| {
393	        import_invalid(format!(
394	            "unknown import source {source}; accepted sources: {}\ntry: deadreckon import codex --list",
395	            accepted_import_sources().join(", ")
396	        ))
397	    })?;
398	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
399	    let descriptor = registry.get(&descriptor_id).ok_or_else(|| {
400	        import_invalid(format!(
401	            "unknown import source {source}; accepted sources: {}\ntry: deadreckon import codex --list",
402	            accepted_import_sources().join(", ")
403	        ))
404	    })?;
405	    let ingest = descriptor.ingest.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
406	        import_invalid(format!(
407	            "{} has no importable descriptor [ingest]\ntry: deadreckon providers list --all",
408	            descriptor.id
409	        ))
410	    })?;
411	    let schema = ingest.schema.trim();
412	    if schema.is_empty() {
413	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
414	            "{} has an empty descriptor ingest schema\ntry: deadreckon providers list --all",
415	            descriptor.id
416	        )));
417	    }
418	    let home = std::env::var_os("HOME")
419	        .map(PathBuf::from)
420	        .unwrap_or_else(|| paths.home().to_path_buf());
421	    let working_dirs = vec![cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()];
422	    let roots = provider_ingest_roots_for_working_dirs(
423	        &ingest,
424	        &home,
425	        &working_dirs,
426	        options.all || options.session.is_some(),
427	    );
428	    let storage = ingest.storage.clone().unwrap_or(IngestStorage::Jsonl);
429	    Ok(ResolvedImportSource {
430	        alias: source.to_string(),
431	        source: descriptor.id.clone(),
432	        schema: schema.to_string(),
433	        storage,
434	        roots,
435	        cwd_match: ingest.cwd_match.clone(),
436	        cwd_match_path: ingest.cwd_match_path.clone(),
437	        file_glob: ingest.file_glob.clone(),
438	        id_prefix: ingest.id_prefix.clone(),
439	        kind: ImportSourceKind::Provider,
440	    })
441	}
442	
443	fn discover_import_candidates(
444	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
445	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
446	    cwd: &Path,
447	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
448	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
449	    let effective_since = if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
450	        import_long_ago()
451	    } else {
452	        since
453	    };
454	    let mut candidates = match &resolved.kind {
455	        ImportSourceKind::Provider => {
456	            discover_provider_import_candidates(resolved, cwd, effective_since)
457	        }
458	        ImportSourceKind::Cursor => discover_cursor_import_candidates(resolved, effective_since),
459	    };
460	    if let Some(session) = options.session.as_deref()
461	        && !candidates
462	            .iter()
463	            .any(|candidate| import_candidate_matches(candidate, session))
464	        && Path::new(session).exists()
465	    {
466	        candidates.push(candidate_from_explicit_path(resolved, Path::new(session)));
467	    }
468	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
469	        right
470	            .updated_at
471	            .cmp(&left.updated_at)
472	            .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))
473	    });
474	    candidates
475	}
476	
477	fn stale_import_candidates(
478	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
479	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
480	    cwd: &Path,
481	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
482	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
483	    if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
484	        return Vec::new();
485	    }
486	    let mut candidates = match &resolved.kind {
487	        ImportSourceKind::Provider => {
488	            discover_provider_import_candidates(resolved, cwd, import_long_ago())
489	        }
490	        ImportSourceKind::Cursor => discover_cursor_import_candidates(resolved, import_long_ago()),
491	    };
492	    candidates.retain(|candidate| candidate.updated_at < since);
493	    candidates.sort_by(|left, right| {
494	        right
495	            .updated_at
496	            .cmp(&left.updated_at)
497	            .then_with(|| left.id.cmp(&right.id))
498	    });
499	    candidates
500	}
501	
502	fn discover_provider_import_candidates(
503	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
504	    cwd: &Path,
505	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
506	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
507	    let spec = ProviderJsonlLogSpec {
508	        schema: resolved.schema.clone(),
509	        roots: resolved.roots.clone(),
510	        since,
511	        cwd_match: resolved.cwd_match.clone(),
512	        cwd_match_path: resolved.cwd_match_path.clone(),
513	        storage: resolved.storage.clone(),
514	        file_glob: resolved.file_glob.clone(),
515	    };
516	    let working_dirs = vec![cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()];
517	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
518	    for root in &resolved.roots {
519	        let mut files = Vec::new();
520	        collect_recent_provider_files(root, &spec, &mut files, 0);
521	        for (path, updated_at) in files {
522	            let matched_cwd = provider_jsonl_session_matches_run(&spec, &path, &working_dirs)
523	                .then(|| cwd.to_path_buf());
524	            let session_id = provider_import_session_id(resolved, &path);
525	            let id = import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path);
526	            candidates.push(ImportCandidate {
527	                id,
528	                session_id,
529	                paths: vec![path.clone()],
530	                root: root.clone(),
531	                updated_at,
532	                matched_cwd,
533	                row_count_hint: import_row_count_hint(resolved, &path),
534	            });
535	        }
536	    }
537	    candidates
538	}
539	
540	fn discover_cursor_import_candidates(
541	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
542	    since: DateTime<Utc>,
543	) -> Vec<ImportCandidate> {
544	    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
545	    for root in &resolved.roots {
546	        let Ok(files) = inventory_files(root) else {
547	            continue;
548	        };
549	        for path in files {
550	            let extension = path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
551	            if !matches!(extension, "sqlite" | "sqlite3" | "db") {
552	                continue;
553	            }
554	            let Some(updated_at) = fs::metadata(&path)
555	                .ok()
556	                .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified().ok())
557	                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
558	            else {
559	                continue;
560	            };
561	            if updated_at < since {
562	                continue;
563	            }
564	            let session_id = path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()).map(|stem| {
565	                let prefix = resolved.id_prefix.as_deref().unwrap_or("cursor:");
566	                format!("{prefix}{stem}")
567	            });
568	            let id = import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path);
569	            candidates.push(ImportCandidate {
570	                id,
571	                session_id,
572	                paths: vec![path],
573	                root: root.clone(),
574	                updated_at,
575	                matched_cwd: None,
576	                row_count_hint: None,
577	            });
578	        }
579	    }
580	    candidates
581	}
582	
583	fn candidate_from_explicit_path(resolved: &ResolvedImportSource, path: &Path) -> ImportCandidate {
584	    let path = fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf());
585	    let updated_at = fs::metadata(&path)
586	        .ok()
587	        .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified().ok())
588	        .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
589	        .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
590	    let root = resolved
591	        .roots
592	        .iter()
593	        .find(|root| path.starts_with(root))
594	        .cloned()
595	        .unwrap_or_else(|| explicit_import_root(resolved, &path));
596	    let session_id = provider_import_session_id(resolved, &path).or_else(|| {
597	        path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()).map(|stem| {
598	            let prefix = resolved.id_prefix.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
599	            format!("{prefix}{stem}")
600	        })
601	    });
602	    ImportCandidate {
603	        id: import_candidate_id(resolved, session_id.as_deref(), &path),
604	        session_id,
605	        paths: vec![path.clone()],
606	        root,
607	        updated_at,
608	        matched_cwd: None,
609	        row_count_hint: import_row_count_hint(resolved, &path),
610	    }
611	}
612	
613	fn explicit_import_root(resolved: &ResolvedImportSource, path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
614	    if resolved.storage == IngestStorage::OpenCodeStorage
615	        && let Some(root) = path.ancestors().nth(4)
616	    {
617	        return root.to_path_buf();
618	    }
619	    path.parent()
620	        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
621	        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
622	}
623	
624	fn select_import_candidates(
625	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
626	    options: &ImportCommandOptions,
627	    candidates: &[ImportCandidate],
628	) -> Result<(Vec<ImportCandidate>, ImportMode)> {
629	    if candidates.is_empty() {
630	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
631	            "no import candidates for {}\nresolved roots:\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --all --preview",
632	            resolved.alias,
633	            resolved_roots_lines(&resolved.roots),
634	            resolved.alias
635	        )));
636	    }
637	    if options.all {
638	        return Ok((candidates.to_vec(), ImportMode::All));
639	    }
640	    if let Some(session) = options.session.as_deref() {
641	        let selected = candidates
642	            .iter()
643	            .filter(|candidate| import_candidate_matches(candidate, session))
644	            .cloned()
645	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
646	        return match selected.len() {
647	            0 => Err(import_invalid(format!(
648	                "no import candidate matched session {session}\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --list",
649	                import_candidate_table(candidates),
650	                resolved.alias
651	            ))),
652	            1 => Ok((selected, ImportMode::Session)),
653	            _ => Err(import_invalid(format!(
654	                "session {session} matched multiple import candidates\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session {}",
655	                import_candidate_table(&selected),
656	                resolved.alias,
657	                shell_arg(session)
658	            ))),
659	        };
660	    }
661	
662	    let cwd_matched = candidates
663	        .iter()
664	        .filter(|candidate| {
665	            resolved.cwd_match == IngestCwdMatch::None || candidate.matched_cwd.is_some()
666	        })
667	        .cloned()
668	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
669	    if cwd_matched.len() == 1 {
670	        return Ok((cwd_matched, ImportMode::Session));
671	    }
672	    if cwd_matched.len() > 1 {
673	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
674	            "ambiguous import candidates for {}\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session <id-or-path>",
675	            resolved.alias,
676	            import_candidate_table(&cwd_matched),
677	            resolved.alias
678	        )));
679	    }
680	    if candidates.len() == 1 {
681	        return Ok((vec![candidates[0].clone()], ImportMode::Session));
682	    }
683	    Err(import_invalid(format!(
684	        "no cwd-matched import session for {}; {} recent candidates need an explicit session\n{}\ntry: deadreckon import {} --session <id-or-path>",
685	        resolved.alias,
686	        candidates.len(),
687	        import_candidate_table(candidates),
688	        resolved.alias
689	    )))
690	}
691	
692	fn parse_import_candidates(
693	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
694	    selected: &[ImportCandidate],
695	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
696	    let mut rows_seen = 0usize;
697	    let mut events = Vec::new();
698	    let mut source_started_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
699	    let mut source_updated_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
700	    for candidate in selected {
701	        let parsed = match &resolved.kind {
702	            ImportSourceKind::Provider => parse_provider_import_candidate(resolved, candidate)?,
703	            ImportSourceKind::Cursor => parse_cursor_import_candidate(candidate)?,
704	        };
705	        rows_seen += parsed.rows_seen;
706	        for timestamp in parsed
707	            .source_started_at
708	            .into_iter()
709	            .chain(parsed.source_updated_at)
710	        {
711	            source_started_at = Some(
712	                source_started_at
713	                    .map(|existing| existing.min(timestamp))
714	                    .unwrap_or(timestamp),
715	            );
716	            source_updated_at = Some(
717	                source_updated_at
718	                    .map(|existing| existing.max(timestamp))
719	                    .unwrap_or(timestamp),
720	            );
721	        }
722	        events.extend(parsed.events);
723	    }
724	    events.sort_by(|left, right| {
725	        left.timestamp
726	            .cmp(&right.timestamp)
727	            .then_with(|| left.source_path.cmp(&right.source_path))
728	            .then_with(|| left.source_line.cmp(&right.source_line))
729	    });
730	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
731	        rows_seen,
732	        events,
733	        source_started_at,
734	        source_updated_at,
735	    })
736	}
737	
738	fn parse_provider_import_candidate(
739	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
740	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
741	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
742	    if resolved.storage == IngestStorage::OpenCodeStorage {
743	        return parse_opencode_import_candidate(resolved, candidate);
744	    }
745	    let mut rows_seen = 0usize;
746	    let mut events = Vec::new();
747	    for path in &candidate.paths {
748	        if path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("json") {
749	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(path)?;
750	            let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw).map_err(|err| {
751	                import_invalid(format!(
752	                    "malformed JSON at {}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
753	                    path.display(),
754	                    path.display(),
755	                    resolved.alias,
756	                    shell_arg(&candidate.id)
757	                ))
758	            })?;
759	            rows_seen += import_json_value_row_count(&value);
760	            events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
761	                resolved, candidate, path, None, &value, &raw,
762	            ));
763	            continue;
764	        }
765	        for (line_idx, line) in fs::read_to_string(path)?.lines().enumerate() {
766	            if line.trim().is_empty() {
767	                continue;
768	            }
769	            rows_seen += 1;
770	            let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).map_err(|err| {
771	                import_invalid(format!(
772	                    "malformed JSONL at {}:{}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
773	                    path.display(),
774	                    line_idx + 1,
775	                    path.display(),
776	                    resolved.alias,
777	                    shell_arg(&candidate.id)
778	                ))
779	            })?;
780	            events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
781	                resolved,
782	                candidate,
783	                path,
784	                Some(line_idx + 1),
785	                &value,
786	                line,
787	            ));
788	        }
789	    }
790	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
791	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
792	        rows_seen,
793	        events,
794	        source_started_at,
795	        source_updated_at,
796	    })
797	}
798	
799	fn parse_cursor_import_candidate(candidate: &ImportCandidate) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
800	    let Some(path) = candidate.paths.first() else {
801	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
802	    };
803	    let output = std::process::Command::new("sqlite3")
804	        .arg("-json")
805	        .arg(path)
806	        .arg("select rowid as source_rowid, * from messages order by rowid")
807	        .output();
808	    let output = output.map_err(|err| {
809	        import_invalid(format!(
810	            "sqlite3 is required to import Cursor history from {}: {err}\ntry: install sqlite3 or pass a JSONL-capable provider source",
811	            path.display()
812	        ))
813	    })?;
814	    if !output.status.success() {
815	        return Err(import_invalid(format!(
816	            "failed to query Cursor database {}: {}\ntry: install sqlite3 or pass a JSONL-capable provider source",
817	            path.display(),
818	            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
819	        )));
820	    }
821	    let values: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).map_err(|err| {
822	        import_invalid(format!(
823	            "sqlite3 returned invalid JSON for {}: {err}",
824	            path.display()
825	        ))
826	    })?;
827	    let mut events = Vec::new();
828	    for value in &values {
829	        let raw = serde_json::to_string(value)?;
830	        let mut event = generic_import_event(
831	            "cursor-sqlite",
832	            candidate,
833	            path,
834	            value
835	                .get("source_rowid")
836	                .and_then(Value::as_u64)
837	                .and_then(|row| usize::try_from(row).ok()),
838	            value,
839	            &raw,
840	        );
841	        event.source_event = "message".to_string();
842	        events.push(event);
843	    }
844	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
845	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
846	        rows_seen: values.len(),
847	        events,
848	        source_started_at,
849	        source_updated_at,
850	    })
851	}
852	
853	fn parse_opencode_import_candidate(
854	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
855	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
856	) -> Result<ImportParseResult> {
857	    let Some(session_path) = candidate.paths.first() else {
858	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
859	    };
860	    let session_raw = fs::read_to_string(session_path)?;
861	    let session = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&session_raw).map_err(|err| {
862	        import_invalid(format!(
863	            "malformed JSON at {}: {err}\ntry: fix or exclude {}; then rerun deadreckon import {} --session {}",
864	            session_path.display(),
865	            session_path.display(),
866	            resolved.alias,
867	            shell_arg(&candidate.id)
868	        ))
869	    })?;
870	    let Some(session_id) = session.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
871	        return Ok(empty_import_parse_result(candidate.updated_at));
872	    };
873	    let root = session_path
874	        .ancestors()
875	        .nth(4)
876	        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
877	        .unwrap_or_else(|| candidate.root.clone());
878	    let messages = read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/message").join(session_id));
879	    let mut rows_seen = 1usize;
880	    let mut events = Vec::new();
881	    events.extend(import_events_from_json_value(
882	        resolved,
883	        candidate,
884	        session_path,
885	        None,
886	        &session,
887	        &session_raw,
888	    ));
889	    for (message_path, message, message_raw) in messages {
890	        rows_seen += 1;
891	        let role = message
892	            .get("role")
893	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
894	            .map(ToString::to_string);
895	        let timestamp = import_timestamp(&message);
896	        let message_id = message.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
897	        let parts = read_json_entries_sorted(&root.join("storage/part").join(message_id));
898	        if parts.is_empty() {
899	            let mut event = generic_import_event(
900	                &resolved.schema,
901	                candidate,
902	                &message_path,
903	                None,
904	                &message,
905	                &message_raw,
906	            );
907	            event.role = role.clone();
908	            event.timestamp = timestamp;
909	            events.push(event);
910	            continue;
911	        }
912	        for (part_path, part, part_raw) in parts {
913	            rows_seen += 1;
914	            let mut event =
915	                opencode_import_event(candidate, &part_path, &part, &part_raw, role.as_deref());
916	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(&part).or(timestamp);
917	            events.push(event);
918	        }
919	    }
920	    let (source_started_at, source_updated_at) = source_time_bounds(&events, candidate.updated_at);
921	    Ok(ImportParseResult {
922	        rows_seen,
923	        events,
924	        source_started_at,
925	        source_updated_at,
926	    })
927	}

929	fn import_events_from_json_value(
930	    resolved: &ResolvedImportSource,
931	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
932	    path: &Path,
933	    line: Option<usize>,
934	    value: &Value,
935	    raw: &str,
936	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
937	    match resolved.schema.as_str() {
938	        "codex-cli" => codex_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
939	        "claude-code" => claude_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
940	        "gemini" => gemini_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
941	        "copilot-cli" => copilot_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
942	        "pi" => pi_import_events(candidate, path, line, value, raw),
943	        "opencode" => vec![generic_import_event(
944	            &resolved.schema,
945	            candidate,
946	            path,
947	            line,
948	            value,
949	            raw,
950	        )],
951	        _ => vec![generic_import_event(
952	            &resolved.schema,
953	            candidate,
954	            path,
955	            line,
956	            value,
957	            raw,
958	        )],
959	    }
960	}

962	fn codex_import_events(
963	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
964	    path: &Path,
965	    line: Option<usize>,
966	    value: &Value,
967	    raw: &str,
968	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
969	    let payload = value.get("payload").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
970	    let mut event = generic_import_event("codex-cli", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
971	    match (
972	        value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str),
973	        payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str),
974	    ) {
975	        (Some("session_meta"), _) => {
976	            event.source_event = "session_meta".to_string();
977	            event.summary = payload
978	                .get("cwd")
979	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
980	                .map(|cwd| format!("session cwd {cwd}"))
981	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "session metadata".to_string());
982	        }
983	        (Some("event_msg"), Some("agent_message")) => {
984	            event.source_event = "agent_message".to_string();
985	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
986	            if let Some(message) = payload.get("message").and_then(Value::as_str) {
987	                event.summary = one_line(message, 180);
988	            }
989	        }
990	        (Some("event_msg"), Some("token_count")) => {
991	            event.source_event = "usage".to_string();
992	            event.summary = "token count".to_string();
993	            event.usage = codex_usage(payload);
994	        }
995	        (Some("response_item"), Some("function_call")) => {
996	            let name = payload
997	                .get("name")
998	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
999	                .unwrap_or("tool");
1000	            let args = payload
1001	                .get("arguments")
1002	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1003	                .unwrap_or("");
1004	            let args_value =
1005	                serde_json::from_str::<Value>(args).unwrap_or(Value::String(args.to_string()));
1006	            event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1007	            event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1008	            event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1009	            event.tool_call_id = payload
1010	                .get("call_id")
1011	                .or_else(|| payload.get("id"))
1012	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1013	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1014	            event.summary = format!(
1015	                "tool {} {}",
1016	                provider_tool_label(name),
1017	                one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, &args_value), 160)
1018	            );
1019	            event.files = collect_import_paths(&args_value);
1020	        }
1021	        (Some("response_item"), Some("function_call_output")) => {
1022	            event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1023	            event.role = Some("tool".to_string());
1024	            event.tool_call_id = payload
1025	                .get("call_id")
1026	                .or_else(|| payload.get("id"))
1027	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1028	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1029	            event.summary = payload
1030	                .get("output")
1031	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1032	                .map(|output| format!("result {}", one_line(output, 160)))
1033	                .unwrap_or_else(|| event.summary.clone());
1034	        }
1035	        _ => {}
1036	    }
1037	    vec![event]
1038	}

1040	fn claude_import_events(
1041	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1042	    path: &Path,
1043	    line: Option<usize>,
1044	    value: &Value,
1045	    raw: &str,
1046	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1047	    let row_type = value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
1048	    let Some(message) = value.get("message") else {
1049	        return vec![generic_import_event(
1050	            "claude-code",
1051	            candidate,
1052	            path,
1053	            line,
1054	            value,
1055	            raw,
1056	        )];
1057	    };
1058	    let usage = message.get("usage").and_then(import_usage_from_value);
1059	    let Some(content) = message.get("content").and_then(Value::as_array) else {
1060	        let mut event = generic_import_event("claude-code", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
1061	        event.source_event = row_type.to_string();
1062	        event.usage = usage;
1063	        return vec![event];
1064	    };
1065	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1066	    for part in content {
1067	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1068	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1069	        event.role = Some(row_type.to_string());
1070	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1071	        match part.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
1072	            Some("text") => {
1073	                event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1074	                event.summary = part
1075	                    .get("text")
1076	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1077	                    .map(|text| one_line(text, 180))
1078	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "message".to_string());
1079	            }
1080	            Some("thinking") => {
1081	                event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1082	                event.summary = part
1083	                    .get("thinking")
1084	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1085	                    .map(|text| format!("thinking {}", one_line(text, 160)))
1086	                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "thinking".to_string());
1087	            }
1088	            Some("tool_use") => {
1089	                let name = part.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("tool");
1090	                let input = part.get("input").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1091	                event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1092	                event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1093	                event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1094	                event.tool_call_id = part
1095	                    .get("id")
1096	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1097	                    .map(ToString::to_string);
1098	                event.summary = format!(
1099	                    "tool {} {}",
1100	                    provider_tool_label(name),
1101	                    one_line(&claude_tool_summary(name, input), 160)
1102	                );
1103	                event.files = collect_import_paths(input);
1104	            }
1105	            Some("tool_result") => {
1106	                event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1107	                event.tool_call_id = part
1108	                    .get("tool_use_id")
1109	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
1110	                    .map(ToString::to_string);
1111	                event.summary = format!(
1112	                    "result {}",
1113	                    one_line(
1114	                        &claude_content_text(part.get("content").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)),
1115	                        160
1116	                    )
1117	                );
1118	                event.files = collect_import_paths(part);
1119	            }
1120	            Some(other) => {
1121	                event.source_event = other.to_string();
1122	                event.summary = one_line(&json_value_text(part), 180);
1123	                event.files = collect_import_paths(part);
1124	            }
1125	            None => {
1126	                event.source_event = row_type.to_string();
1127	                event.summary = one_line(&json_value_text(part), 180);
1128	            }
1129	        }
1130	        events.push(event);
1131	    }
1132	    if events.is_empty() {
1133	        vec![generic_import_event(
1134	            "claude-code",
1135	            candidate,
1136	            path,
1137	            line,
1138	            value,
1139	            raw,
1140	        )]
1141	    } else {
1142	        events
1143	    }
1144	}

1146	fn gemini_import_events(
1147	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1148	    path: &Path,
1149	    line: Option<usize>,
1150	    value: &Value,
1151	    raw: &str,
1152	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1153	    if let Some(messages) = value.get("messages").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1154	        let mut events = Vec::new();
1155	        for message in messages {
1156	            let raw = serde_json::to_string(message).unwrap_or_else(|_| raw.to_string());
1157	            events.extend(gemini_import_events(candidate, path, line, message, &raw));
1158	        }
1159	        return events;
1160	    }
1161	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1162	    let usage = gemini_usage(value);
1163	    for thought in value
1164	        .get("thoughts")
1165	        .and_then(Value::as_array)
1166	        .into_iter()
1167	        .flatten()
1168	    {
1169	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1170	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1171	        event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1172	        event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1173	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1174	        event.summary = format!("thinking {}", one_line(&json_value_text(thought), 160));
1175	        events.push(event);
1176	    }
1177	    for text in gemini_content_texts(value.get("content").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)) {
1178	        let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1179	        event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1180	        event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1181	        event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1182	        event.usage = usage.clone();
1183	        event.summary = one_line(&text, 180);
1184	        events.push(event);
1185	    }
1186	    if let Some(tool_calls) = value.get("toolCalls").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1187	        for tool_call in tool_calls {
1188	            let name = tool_call
1189	                .get("name")
1190	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1191	                .unwrap_or("tool");
1192	            let args = tool_call.get("args").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1193	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1194	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1195	            event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1196	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1197	            event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1198	            event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1199	            event.tool_call_id = tool_call
1200	                .get("id")
1201	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1202	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1203	            event.summary = format!(
1204	                "tool {} {}",
1205	                provider_tool_label(name),
1206	                one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, args), 160)
1207	            );
1208	            event.files = collect_import_paths(args);
1209	            events.push(event);
1210	        }
1211	    }
1212	    if events.is_empty() {
1213	        vec![generic_import_event(
1214	            "gemini", candidate, path, line, value, raw,
1215	        )]
1216	    } else {
1217	        events
1218	    }
1219	}

1221	fn copilot_import_events(
1222	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1223	    path: &Path,
1224	    line: Option<usize>,
1225	    value: &Value,
1226	    raw: &str,
1227	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1228	    let data = value.get("data").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1229	    let usage = value.get("usage").and_then(import_usage_from_value);
1230	    let mut events = Vec::new();
1231	    match value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
1232	        Some("assistant.message") => {
1233	            if let Some(reasoning) = data.get("reasoningText").and_then(Value::as_str)
1234	                && !reasoning.trim().is_empty()
1235	            {
1236	                let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1237	                event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1238	                event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1239	                event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1240	                event.usage = usage.clone();
1241	                event.summary = format!("thinking {}", one_line(reasoning, 160));
1242	                events.push(event);
1243	            }
1244	            if let Some(content) = data.get("content").and_then(Value::as_str)
1245	                && !content.trim().is_empty()
1246	            {
1247	                let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1248	                event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1249	                event.source_event = "message".to_string();
1250	                event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1251	                event.usage = usage.clone();
1252	                event.summary = one_line(content, 180);
1253	                events.push(event);
1254	            }
1255	            if let Some(tool_requests) = data.get("toolRequests").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1256	                for request in tool_requests {
1257	                    let name = request
1258	                        .get("name")
1259	                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1260	                        .unwrap_or("tool");
1261	                    let input = provider_arguments_value(request.get("arguments"));
1262	                    let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1263	                    event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1264	                    event.source_event = "tool_call".to_string();
1265	                    event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1266	                    event.tool_name = Some(name.to_string());
1267	                    event.tool_category = Some(provider_tool_label(name).to_string());
1268	                    event.tool_call_id = request
1269	                        .get("id")
1270	                        .or_else(|| request.get("toolCallId"))
1271	                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1272	                        .map(ToString::to_string);
1273	                    event.summary = format!(
1274	                        "tool {} {}",
1275	                        provider_tool_label(name),
1276	                        one_line(&json_tool_summary(name, &input), 160)
1277	                    );
1278	                    event.files = collect_import_paths(&input);
1279	                    event.usage = usage.clone();
1280	                    events.push(event);
1281	                }
1282	            }
1283	        }
1284	        Some("assistant.reasoning") => {
1285	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1286	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1287	            event.source_event = "thinking".to_string();
1288	            event.role = Some("assistant".to_string());
1289	            event.usage = usage;
1290	            event.summary = data
1291	                .get("text")
1292	                .or_else(|| data.get("content"))
1293	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1294	                .map(|text| format!("thinking {}", one_line(text, 160)))
1295	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "thinking".to_string());
1296	            events.push(event);
1297	        }
1298	        Some("tool.execution_complete") => {
1299	            let result = data.get("result").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
1300	            let mut event = import_base_event(candidate, path, line, raw);
1301	            event.timestamp = import_timestamp(value);
1302	            event.source_event = "tool_result".to_string();
1303	            event.role = Some("tool".to_string());
1304	            event.tool_call_id = data
1305	                .get("toolCallId")
1306	                .or_else(|| data.get("id"))
1307	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
1308	                .map(ToString::to_string);
1309	            event.summary = format!("result {}", one_line(&json_value_text(result), 160));
1310	            event.files = collect_import_paths(result);
1311	            event.usage = usage;
1312	            events.push(event);
1313	        }
1314	        Some("session.model_change") => {
1315	            let mut event = generic_import_event("copilot-cli", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
1316	            event.source_event = "model_change".to_string();
1317	            events.push(event);
1318	        }
1319	        _ => {}
1320	    }
1321	    if events.is_empty() {
1322	        vec![generic_import_event(
1323	            "copilot-cli",
1324	            candidate,
1325	            path,
1326	            line,
1327	            value,
1328	            raw,
1329	        )]
1330	    } else {
1331	        events
1332	    }
1333	}

1335	fn pi_import_events(
1336	    candidate: &ImportCandidate,
1337	    path: &Path,
1338	    line: Option<usize>,
1339	    value: &Value,
1340	    raw: &str,
1341	) -> Vec<ImportedEvent> {
1342	    if value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("session") {
1343	        let mut event = generic_import_event("pi", candidate, path, line, value, raw);
1344	        event.source_event = "session".to_string();
1345	        event.summary = "session header".to_string();
1346	        return vec![event];
1347	    }
1348	    let message = value.get("message").unwrap_or(value);
1349	    let usage = message.get("usage").and_then(import_usage_from_value);
1350	    let role = message
1351	        .get("role")
1352	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
1353	        .map(ToString::to_string);
1354	    let mut events = Vec::new();

1576	fn import_since(options: &ImportCommandOptions) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {
1577	    if options.all || options.session.is_some() {
1578	        return Ok(import_long_ago());
1579	    }
1580	    let Some(raw) = options.since.as_deref() else {
1581	        return Ok(Utc::now() - ChronoDuration::minutes(2));
1582	    };
1583	    let duration = parse_import_duration(raw).ok_or_else(|| {
1584	        import_invalid(format!(
1585	            "invalid import --since duration {raw}; use values like 10m, 2h, or 1d\ntry: deadreckon import {} --since 10m --list",
1586	            options.source
1587	        ))
1588	    })?;
1589	    Ok(Utc::now() - duration)
1590	}
1591	
1592	fn parse_import_duration(raw: &str) -> Option<ChronoDuration> {
1593	    let trimmed = raw.trim();
1594	    if trimmed.is_empty() {
1595	        return None;
1596	    }
1597	    let (number, unit) = trimmed.split_at(
1598	        trimmed
1599	            .find(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_digit())
1600	            .unwrap_or(trimmed.len()),
1601	    );
1602	    let value = number.parse::<i64>().ok()?;
1603	    match unit {
1604	        "" | "m" | "min" | "mins" | "minute" | "minutes" => Some(ChronoDuration::minutes(value)),
1605	        "h" | "hr" | "hrs" | "hour" | "hours" => Some(ChronoDuration::hours(value)),
1606	        "d" | "day" | "days" => Some(ChronoDuration::days(value)),
1607	        "s" | "sec" | "secs" | "second" | "seconds" => Some(ChronoDuration::seconds(value)),
1608	        _ => None,
1609	    }
1610	}
1611	
1612	fn import_long_ago() -> DateTime<Utc> {
1613	    Utc::now() - ChronoDuration::days(36_500)
1614	}

1653	    for line in message.lines() {

1655	            if primary_hint.is_none() {
1656	                primary_hint = Some(hint.trim().to_string());
1657	            }

1665	            .map(|line| line.trim().to_string())

1668	        let detail = body

250	    let goal = format!("\"{}\"", shell_display_quote(goal));
251	    match mode {
252	        CliPlanMode::Review => {
253	            format!(
254	                "deadreckon orchestrate review {goal} --coder-provider cli:claude-code --reviewer-provider cli:codex --yes"
255	            )
256	        }
257	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => format!(
258	            "deadreckon orchestrate full-plan {goal} --planner-provider cli:codex --provider cli:claude-code --n {} --yes",
259	            recommend_child_count_for_goal(raw_goal, CliPlanMode::FullPlan)
260	        ),
261	    }
262	}

264	pub(crate) fn recommend_orchestration_mode(goal: &str) -> CliPlanMode {
265	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
266	    let broad_product = [
267	        "make a full",
268	        "build a full",
269	        "create a full",
270	        "fully",
271	        "from scratch",
272	        "app",
273	        "game",
274	        "site",
275	        "multiplayer",
276	        "realtime",
277	        "real-time",
278	        "live",
279	        "server",
280	        "client",
281	    ]
282	    .iter()
283	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
284	    let focused_change = [
285	        "fix ", "bug", "change ", "refactor", "review", "audit", "explain", "docs", "rename",
286	    ]
287	    .iter()
288	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
289	    if broad_product && !focused_change {
290	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan
291	    } else {
292	        CliPlanMode::Review
293	    }
294	}

296	fn orchestration_mode_recommendation_reason(goal: &str, mode: CliPlanMode) -> &'static str {
297	    match mode {
298	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => {
299	            if goal.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("multiplayer") {
300	                "goal looks like broad product work with separable implementation slices"
301	            } else {
302	                "goal looks broad enough to decompose before execution"
303	            }
304	        }
305	        CliPlanMode::Review => "goal looks focused enough for coder plus reviewer",
306	    }
307	}

309	pub(crate) fn recommend_child_count_for_goal(goal: &str, mode: CliPlanMode) -> u8 {
310	    if mode == CliPlanMode::Review {
311	        return 2;
312	    }
313	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
314	    let complexity = [
315	        "multiplayer",
316	        "realtime",
317	        "real-time",
318	        "live",
319	        "physics",
320	        "terrain",
321	        "server",
322	        "database",
323	        "auth",
324	        "deploy",
325	        "mobile",
326	        "game",
327	    ]
328	    .iter()
329	    .filter(|needle| lower.contains(*needle))
330	    .count();
331	    match complexity {
332	        0 | 1 => 3,
333	        2 | 3 => 4,
334	        _ => 5,
335	    }
336	}

338	fn prompt_orchestration_mode(default: CliPlanMode) -> Result<CliPlanMode> {
339	    let default_label = match default {
340	        CliPlanMode::Review => "review",
341	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => "full-plan",

343	    let answer = prompt::open(&format!("mode [{default_label}]: "), None)?;
344	    match answer.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
345	        "" => Ok(default),

347	        "f" | "full" | "full-plan" | "full_plan" | "plan" => Ok(CliPlanMode::FullPlan),

361	fn prompt_child_provider_overrides(n: u8) -> Result<Vec<String>> {

364	        n.saturating_sub(1)

374	        .map(ToString::to_string)
375	        .collect())

402	fn orchestrate_provider_choice_lines(

405	) -> Vec<String> {
406	    let mut lines = vec![
407	        ui_heading("Providers"),

411	                .map(ui_command)
412	                .unwrap_or_else(|| ui_muted("none configured"))
413	        ),
414	    ];
415	    if configured.is_empty() {
416	        lines.push("  configured: none".to_string());
417	        lines.push(format!(
418	            "  {} {}",
419	            ui_command("setup:"),
420	            ui_command("deadreckon providers list --all")
421	        ));
422	    } else {
423	        lines.push(format!("  configured: {}", configured.join(", ")));
424	    }
425	    lines.push(
426	        "  planner creates the child graph; child/coder/reviewer providers execute work."
427	            .to_string(),
428	    );
429	    lines

432	pub(crate) async fn orchestrate_command(args: OrchestrateRunArgs) -> Result<()> {
433	    let quiet = args.plan.quiet;
434	    let plain = args.plan.plain;
435	    let no_hints = args.plan.no_hints;
436	    let max_spend = args.plan.max_spend;
437	    let max_wall_seconds = args.plan.max_wall_seconds;
438	    let sandbox = args.plan.sandbox.clone();
439	    if !commands::plan::prepare_orchestration_source(args.plan.init_git, quiet)? {
440	        return Ok(());
441	    }
442	    let plan = commands::plan::create_orchestration_plan(args.plan).await?;
443	    let plan_id = plan.plan_id.clone();
444	    if !quiet {
445	        commands::plan::print_orchestrate_preflight(
446	            &plan,
447	            max_spend,
448	            max_wall_seconds,
449	            sandbox.as_deref(),
450	            args.no_repair,
451	        );
452	    }
453	    if args.preview {
454	        return Ok(());
455	    }
456	    commands::plan::confirm_orchestration_start(&plan, args.yes, no_hints)?;
457	    if !quiet {
458	        commands::plan::print_orchestrate_started(
459	            &plan,
460	            max_spend,
461	            max_wall_seconds,
462	            sandbox.as_deref(),
463	            args.no_repair,
464	        );
465	    }
466	    commands::plan::fork_command(ForkCommandArgs {
467	        plan_id: plan_id.clone(),
468	        max_spend,
469	        max_wall_seconds,
470	        sandbox,
471	        provider: None,
472	        child_provider: Vec::new(),
473	        coder_provider: None,
474	        reviewer_provider: None,
475	        no_repair: args.no_repair,
476	        repair_provider: None,
477	        no_hints,
478	        quiet,
479	        plain,
480	        completion_surface: false,
481	    })
482	    .await?;
483	    let sub_result_launch_dir = std::env::var(deadreckon_core::campaign::ENV_SUB_RESULT).ok();
484	    let merge_result = commands::merge::merge_command(MergeCommandArgs {
485	        plan_id: plan_id.clone(),
486	        strategy: "dag-aware".to_string(),
487	        prefer_child: None,
488	        no_repair: args.no_repair,
489	        repair_provider: None,
490	        repair_mode: "auto".to_string(),
491	        repair_attempts: 1,
492	        yes: true,
493	        no_gate: false,
494	        no_hints,
495	        quiet,
496	        plain,
497	        completion_surface: args.completion_surface,
498	    })
499	    .await;
500	    if let Some(launch_dir) = sub_result_launch_dir {
501	        commands::campaign::record_sub_orchestrator_result(
502	            &plan_id,
503	            std::path::Path::new(&launch_dir),
504	            merge_result.is_ok(),
505	        );
506	    }
507	    merge_result
508	}

330	fn start_auto_mode_decision(
331	    goal: &str,
332	    stdin_is_tty: bool,
333	) -> (StartSelectedMode, StartSelectionSource, String) {
334	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
335	    if start_goal_recommends_review(&lower) {
336	        return (
337	            StartSelectedMode::Review,
338	            StartSelectionSource::Heuristic,
339	            "goal asks for review, hardening, validation, or a second pass".to_string(),
340	        );
341	    }
342	    if start_goal_recommends_full_plan(&lower) {
343	        return (
344	            StartSelectedMode::FullPlan,
345	            StartSelectionSource::Heuristic,
346	            "goal names parallel or separable workstreams that fit full-plan orchestration"
347	                .to_string(),
348	        );
349	    }
350	    if !stdin_is_tty {
351	        return (
352	            StartSelectedMode::Run,
353	            StartSelectionSource::Default,
354	            "non-interactive auto mode uses the conservative single supervised run".to_string(),
355	        );
356	    }
357	    (
358	        StartSelectedMode::Run,
359	        StartSelectionSource::Default,
360	        "goal looks focused enough for a single supervised run".to_string(),
361	    )
362	}

417	pub(crate) async fn classify_goal_shape_for_start(
418	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,

435	async fn provider_goal_shape_recommendation(
436	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
437	    cwd: &Path,
438	    goal: &str,
439	    provider: &str,
440	    plain: bool,
441	) -> Option<GoalShapeRecommendation> {
442	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), Some(provider)).ok()?;
443	    let request = ProviderRequest {
444	        prompt: goal_shape_prompt(goal),
445	        max_output_tokens: 512,
446	        cwd: Some(cwd.to_path_buf()),
447	        output_path: None,
448	        sandbox_backend: None,
449	        pid_file: None,
450	        cancellation_token: None,
451	    };
452	    let response = tokio::time::timeout(
453	        Duration::from_secs(5),
454	        maybe_with_cli_wait_status(!plain, "classifying goal shape", router.complete(&request)),
455	    )
456	    .await
457	    .ok()?
458	    .ok()?;
459	    parse_provider_goal_shape(goal, &response.provider, &response.content)
460	}
461	
462	fn goal_shape_prompt(goal: &str) -> String {
463	    format!(
464	        "You are a read-only goal-shape classifier for deadreckon. Do not write files, create temporary files, install packages, commit, delete, move, or mutate state.\n\nReturn JSON only: {{\"shape\":\"single|orchestrate|campaign\",\"n\":2,\"rationale\":\"one short line\"}}.\n\nRubric:\n- single: one cohesive change a single supervised run handles.\n- orchestrate: one project with parallelizable subtasks.\n- campaign: several independent projects, each warranting its own coordination.\n\nIf shape is orchestrate or campaign, include n from 2 through 6. Keep rationale short. Goal: {goal}"
465	    )
466	}
467	
468	pub(crate) fn parse_provider_goal_shape(
469	    goal: &str,
470	    provider: &str,
471	    content: &str,
472	) -> Option<GoalShapeRecommendation> {
473	    let parsed = serde_json::from_str::<ProviderGoalShapeDraft>(content)
474	        .ok()
475	        .or_else(|| {
476	            commands::plan::json_slice(content, '{', '}')
477	                .and_then(|slice| serde_json::from_str::<ProviderGoalShapeDraft>(slice).ok())
478	        })?;
479	    let shape = parse_goal_shape(&parsed.shape)?;
480	    let rationale = parsed.rationale.unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
481	    if rationale.is_empty() {
482	        return None;
483	    }
484	    let n = goal_shape_count(shape, parsed.n);
485	    Some(GoalShapeRecommendation {
486	        schema_version: 1,
487	        goal: goal.to_string(),
488	        shape,
489	        n,
490	        rationale,
491	        source: GoalShapeSource::Provider,
492	        provider: Some(provider.to_string()),
493	    })
494	}
495	
496	fn parse_goal_shape(value: &str) -> Option<GoalShape> {
497	    match value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
498	        "single" | "run" => Some(GoalShape::Single),
499	        "orchestrate" | "orchestration" | "full-plan" | "full_plan" => Some(GoalShape::Orchestrate),
500	        "campaign" => Some(GoalShape::Campaign),
501	        _ => None,
502	    }
503	}
504	
505	fn goal_shape_count(shape: GoalShape, n: Option<u8>) -> Option<u8> {
506	    match shape {
507	        GoalShape::Single => None,
508	        GoalShape::Orchestrate | GoalShape::Campaign => Some(n.unwrap_or(3).clamp(2, 6)),
509	    }
510	}
511	
512	pub(crate) fn fallback_goal_shape_recommendation(goal: &str) -> GoalShapeRecommendation {
513	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
514	    let (shape, n, rationale) = if start_goal_recommends_full_plan(&lower) {
515	        (
516	            GoalShape::Orchestrate,
517	            Some(commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
518	                goal,
519	                CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
520	            )),
521	            "goal names parallel or separable workstreams".to_string(),
522	        )
523	    } else {
524	        let clauses = deterministic_campaign_clause_count(goal);
525	        if clauses >= 2 {
526	            (
527	                GoalShape::Campaign,
528	                Some((clauses as u8).clamp(2, 6)),
529	                format!("goal reads as {clauses} independent clauses"),
530	            )
531	        } else {
532	            (
533	                GoalShape::Single,
534	                None,
535	                format!("goal looks focused enough for one {NOUN_VERIFIED_RUN}"),
536	            )
537	        }
538	    };
539	    GoalShapeRecommendation {
540	        schema_version: 1,
541	        goal: goal.to_string(),
542	        shape,
543	        n,
544	        rationale,
545	        source: GoalShapeSource::Fallback,
546	        provider: None,
547	    }
548	}
549	
550	fn deterministic_campaign_clause_count(goal: &str) -> usize {
551	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
552	    let normalized = lower
553	        .replace(", and ", "|")
554	        .replace(" and ", "|")
555	        .replace(" then ", "|")
556	        .replace([';', ','], "|");
557	    normalized
558	        .split('|')
559	        .map(str::trim)
560	        .filter(|clause| goal_shape_clause_is_nounish(clause))
561	        .count()
562	}
563	
564	fn goal_shape_clause_is_nounish(clause: &str) -> bool {
565	    const STOP: &[&str] = &[
566	        "a", "an", "and", "as", "build", "create", "do", "fix", "for", "make", "the", "then", "to",
567	        "with",
568	    ];
569	    clause
570	        .split(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
571	        .filter(|word| word.len() >= 3)
572	        .any(|word| !STOP.contains(&word))
573	}
574	
575	fn goal_shape_to_start_mode(shape: GoalShape) -> StartSelectedMode {
576	    match shape {
577	        GoalShape::Single => StartSelectedMode::Run,
578	        GoalShape::Orchestrate => StartSelectedMode::FullPlan,
579	        GoalShape::Campaign => StartSelectedMode::Campaign,
580	    }
581	}
582	
583	pub(crate) fn apply_goal_shape_recommendation(
584	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
585	    recommendation: GoalShapeRecommendation,
586	) {
587	    if matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::Review) {
588	        decision.goal_shape = Some(recommendation);
589	        return;
590	    }
591	    decision.selected_mode = goal_shape_to_start_mode(recommendation.shape);
592	    decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::GoalShape;
593	    decision.reason = format!(
594	        "{} suggested {}: {}",
595	        recommendation.source.label(),
596	        recommendation.shape.label(),
597	        recommendation.rationale
598	    );
599	    if matches!(
600	        recommendation.shape,
601	        GoalShape::Orchestrate | GoalShape::Campaign
602	    ) {
603	        decision.child_count = recommendation.n;
604	    }
605	    decision.goal_shape = Some(recommendation);
606	}

633	
634	fn start_goal_recommends_review(lower_goal: &str) -> bool {
635	    let words = [
636	        "review",
637	        "audit",
638	        "critique",
639	        "validate",
640	        "validation",
641	        "verify",
642	        "verification",
643	        "hardening",
644	        "harden",
645	        "cleanup",
646	    ];
647	    let phrases = ["second pass", "second-pass", "clean up"];
648	    words
649	        .iter()
650	        .any(|word| start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal, word))
651	        || phrases.iter().any(|phrase| lower_goal.contains(phrase))
652	}
653	
654	fn start_goal_recommends_full_plan(lower_goal: &str) -> bool {
655	    let words = [
656	        "parallel",
657	        "parallelize",
658	        "workstream",
659	        "workstreams",
660	        "separable",
661	    ];
662	    let phrases = [
663	        "multiple independent",
664	        "many modules",
665	        "several modules",
666	        "frontend, docs",
667	        "api, frontend",
668	    ];
669	    words
670	        .iter()
671	        .any(|word| start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal, word))
672	        || phrases.iter().any(|phrase| lower_goal.contains(phrase))
673	}
674	
675	fn start_goal_contains_word(lower_goal: &str, needle: &str) -> bool {
676	    lower_goal
677	        .split(|ch: char| !ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
678	        .any(|word| word == needle)
679	}

681	pub(crate) fn maybe_prompt_start_mode(
682	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
683	    args: &StartCommandArgs,
684	    latest_completed_run: Option<&RunListEntry>,
685	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
686	) -> Result<()> {
687	    if !matches!(args.mode, crate::cli::CliStartMode::Auto) || decision.recovery.is_some() {
688	        return Ok(());
689	    }
690	    let recommended = decision.selected_mode;
691	    let mut choices = vec![
692	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
693	            "recommended",
694	            format!("Recommended: {}", recommended.path_label()),
695	            decision.reason.clone(),
696	        ),
697	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
698	            "run",
699	            "New single supervised run",
700	            "equivalent to --mode run",
701	        ),
702	    ];
703	    if let Some(run) = latest_completed_run {
704	        choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
705	            format!("extend:{}", run.run_id),
706	            format!("Follow up from {}", run_prefix(&run.run_id)),
707	            format!("extends completed run: {}", run.goal),
708	        ));
709	    }
710	    choices.extend([
711	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
712	            "review",
713	            "New coder/reviewer pass",
714	            "equivalent to --mode review",
715	        ),
716	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
717	            "full-plan",
718	            "New full-plan pass",
719	            "equivalent to --mode full-plan",
720	        ),
721	        prompt::SelectChoice::with_detail(
722	            "campaign",
723	            "New campaign pass",
724	            "split independent projects into sub-orchestrators",
725	        ),
726	        prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"),
727	    ]);
728	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
729	        title: "Choose launch path".to_string(),
730	        help: Some("Pick how DeadReckon should shape this goal.".to_string()),
731	        choices,
732	        default_index: 0,
733	    })?;
734	    match choice.id.as_str() {
735	        "recommended" => {
736	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
737	        }
738	        "run" => {
739	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Run;
740	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
741	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected one supervised coding run".to_string();
742	        }
743	        choice if choice.starts_with("extend:") => {
744	            let run_id = choice["extend:".len()..].to_string();
745	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Extend;
746	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
747	            decision.reason =
748	                "interactive picker selected a follow-up from prior history".to_string();
749	            decision.base_run_label = Some(format!("run {}", run_prefix(&run_id)));
750	            decision.base_run_id = Some(run_id);
751	            decision.source_mode = StartSourceMode::ParentArtifact;
752	            decision.source_mode_label = "parent artifact".to_string();
753	        }
754	        "review" => {
755	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Review;
756	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
757	            decision.reason =
758	                "interactive picker selected coder/reviewer orchestration".to_string();
759	        }
760	        "full-plan" => {
761	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::FullPlan;
762	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
763	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected full-plan orchestration".to_string();
764	        }
765	        "campaign" => {
766	            decision.selected_mode = StartSelectedMode::Campaign;
767	            decision.selection_source = StartSelectionSource::InteractiveChoice;
768	            decision.reason = "interactive picker selected campaign orchestration".to_string();
769	        }
770	        _ => set_start_recovery(
771	            decision,
772	            "guided start cancelled before choosing a launch path",
773	            vec![format!(
774	                "deadreckon start \"{}\"",
775	                shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
776	            )],
777	        ),
778	    }
779	    Ok(())
780	}

782	fn start_detected_cli_provider_ids(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
783	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
784	    let mut ids = Vec::new();
785	    for descriptor in registry.iter() {
786	        if descriptor.kind == DescriptorKind::Cli
787	            && descriptor.subscription
788	            && descriptor
789	                .default_binary
790	                .as_deref()
791	                .is_some_and(command_exists)
792	        {
793	            push_unique(&mut ids, descriptor.id.clone());
794	        }
795	    }
796	    Ok(ids)
797	}
798	
799	fn start_configured_provider_ids(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Vec<String> {
800	    let Ok(config) = read_config(&paths.config_path()) else {
801	        return Vec::new();
802	    };
803	    let mut ids = Vec::new();
804	    if let Some(default_provider) = config.default_provider {
805	        push_unique(&mut ids, default_provider);
806	    }
807	    if let Some(fallback) = config.fallback {
808	        for provider in fallback {
809	            push_unique(&mut ids, provider);
810	        }
811	    }
812	    for provider in config.providers.into_keys() {
813	        push_unique(&mut ids, provider);
814	    }
815	    ids
816	}

818	fn start_latest_extendable_run(
819	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
820	    cwd: &Path,
821	) -> Result<Option<RunListEntry>> {
822	    let scope = workspace_scope(cwd).map_err(CliError::from)?;
823	    let mut runs = list_runs(paths, Some(scope.as_str()))?
824	        .into_iter()
825	        .filter(|run| run.status == RunStatus::Completed)
826	        .filter(|run| start_run_is_extendable(paths, run))
827	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
828	    runs.sort_by_key(|run| run.updated_at);
829	    Ok(runs.pop())
830	}

832	fn start_run_is_extendable(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run: &RunListEntry) -> bool {
833	    let Ok(state) = load_run(paths, &run.run_id) else {
834	        return false;
835	    };
836	    if !paths.library_dir(&state.scope, &state.run_id).is_dir() {
837	        return false;
838	    }
839	    !read_run_codebase_record(paths, &state)
840	        .ok()
841	        .is_some_and(|record| record.mode == CodebaseMode::InPlace)
842	}

844	pub(crate) fn add_start_history_actions(
845	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
846	    run: Option<&RunListEntry>,
847	) {
848	    let Some(run) = run else {

852	    let goal = shell_display_quote(&decision.goal);

862	fn start_provider_picker_choices(
863	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
864	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
865	    current: Option<&str>,
866	) -> Result<Vec<prompt::SelectChoice>> {
867	    let mut choices = Vec::new();
868	    let mut seen = Vec::new();
869	    if let Some(provider) = current {
870	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.to_string());
871	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
872	            format!("route:{provider}"),
873	            format!("Use current route {provider}"),
874	            "selected for this guided start",
875	        ));
876	    }
877	    if let Some(provider) = defaults.provider.as_deref() {
878	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == provider) {
879	            // The current route row is more specific than the config row.
880	        } else {
881	            push_unique(&mut seen, provider.to_string());
882	            choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
883	                format!("route:{provider}"),
884	                format!("Use configured default {provider}"),
885	                "current DeadReckon default provider",
886	            ));
887	        }
888	    }
889	    for provider in start_detected_cli_provider_ids(paths)? {
890	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == &provider) {
891	            continue;
892	        }
893	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.clone());
894	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
895	            format!("route:{provider}"),
896	            format!("Use detected CLI {provider}"),
897	            "ephemeral for this launch; config is not changed",
898	        ));
899	    }
900	    for provider in start_configured_provider_ids(paths) {
901	        if seen.iter().any(|seen| seen == &provider) {
902	            continue;
903	        }
904	        push_unique(&mut seen, provider.clone());
905	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
906	            format!("route:{provider}"),
907	            format!("Use configured route {provider}"),
908	            "ephemeral for this launch",
909	        ));
910	    }
911	    choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
912	        "typed",
913	        "Type another provider route",
914	        "advanced escape hatch",
915	    ));
916	    choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::new(
917	        "cancel",
918	        "Cancel and show setup commands",
919	    ));
920	    Ok(choices)
921	}

923	fn prompt_start_provider(
924	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
925	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
926	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
927	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
928	) -> Result<()> {
929	    let previous_route = decision.provider_route.clone();
930	    let previous_source = decision.provider_source;
931	    let Some(provider) = prompt_start_provider_route(
932	        decision,
933	        paths,
934	        defaults,
935	        setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::PrimaryRun,
936	        "Choose provider",
937	        "Pick the provider route for this launch. Defaults are not changed.",
938	        prompter,
939	    )?
940	    else {
941	        return Ok(());
942	    };
943	
944	    decision.provider_source = if previous_route.as_deref() == Some(provider.as_str())
945	        && !matches!(previous_source, StartProviderSource::Detected)
946	    {
947	        previous_source
948	    } else {
949	        StartProviderSource::Interactive
950	    };
951	    decision.provider_route = Some(provider.clone());
952	    decision.provider_label = format!("{provider} ({})", decision.provider_source.label());
953	    Ok(())
954	}
955	
956	fn prompt_start_provider_route(
957	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
958	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
959	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
960	    role: setup::SetupProviderRoleRef,
961	    title: &str,
962	    help: &str,
963	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
964	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
965	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
966	        title: title.to_string(),
967	        help: Some(help.to_string()),
968	        choices: start_provider_picker_choices(
969	            paths,
970	            defaults,
971	            decision.provider_route.as_deref(),
972	        )?,
973	        default_index: 0,
974	    })?;
975	    let route = if let Some(route) = choice.id.strip_prefix("route:") {
976	        route.to_string()
977	    } else if choice.id == "typed" {
978	        let route = prompter.input("provider route: ", None)?;
979	        if route.trim().is_empty() {
980	            set_start_recovery(
981	                decision,
982	                "no provider route selected",
983	                vec!["deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()],
984	            );
985	            return Ok(None);
986	        }
987	        route.trim().to_string()
988	    } else {
989	        set_start_recovery(
990	            decision,
991	            "provider setup is incomplete",
992	            vec![
993	                "deadreckon init".to_string(),
994	                "deadreckon detect".to_string(),
995	                "deadreckon providers list --all".to_string(),
996	            ],
997	        );
998	        return Ok(None);
999	    };
1000	
1001	    let selection = provider_setup_selection(
1002	        paths,
1003	        setup::ProviderSetupRequest {
1004	            role,
1005	            explicit_provider: Some(&route),
1006	            explicit_model: None,
1007	            config_default_provider: defaults.provider.as_deref(),
1008	            config_doc_provider: defaults.doc_provider.as_deref(),
1009	            run_provider: None,
1010	            auto_subscription_provider: None,
1011	            built_in_default_provider: None,
1012	            use_router_default: false,
1013	            allow_auto_subscription: false,
1014	            require_usable_route: true,
1015	        },
1016	    )?;
1017	    Ok(Some(selection.provider.unwrap_or(route)))
1018	}

1059	fn prompt_start_child_count(
1060	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1061	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
1062	) -> Result<()> {
1063	    let recommended = commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
1064	        &decision.goal,
1065	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
1066	    );
1067	    let mut choices = vec![start_prompt_choice(
1068	        format!("n:{recommended}"),
1069	        format!("Recommended: {recommended} children"),
1070	        "based on goal complexity",
1071	    )];
1072	    for n in 2..=6 {
1073	        choices.push(start_prompt_choice(
1074	            format!("n:{n}"),
1075	            format!("{n} children"),
1076	            "full-plan child count",
1077	        ));
1078	    }
1079	    choices.push(prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"));
1080	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
1081	        title: "Choose child count".to_string(),
1082	        help: Some(
1083	            "Pick how many implementation children the full-plan planner should create."
1084	                .to_string(),
1085	        ),
1086	        choices,
1087	        default_index: 0,
1088	    })?;
1089	    let Some(raw) = choice.id.strip_prefix("n:") else {
1090	        set_start_recovery(
1091	            decision,
1092	            "guided start cancelled before choosing child count",
1093	            vec![format!(
1094	                "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode full-plan --children {recommended}",
1095	                shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1096	            )],
1097	        );
1098	        return Ok(());
1099	    };
1100	    let n = raw.parse::<u8>().map_err(|_| {
1101	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1102	            &format!("child count is not a number: {raw}"),
1103	            "enter a value from 2 through 6",
1104	        ))
1105	    })?;
1106	    validate_task_count(usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1107	    decision.child_count = Some(n);
1108	    Ok(())
1109	}

1111	fn prompt_start_child_provider_overrides(
1112	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1113	    n: u8,
1114	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
1115	) -> Result<()> {
1116	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
1117	        title: "Choose child provider overrides".to_string(),
1118	        help: Some(format!(
1119	            "Optional per-child routes. Child indexes are 0 through {}.",
1120	            n.saturating_sub(1)
1121	        )),
1122	        choices: vec![
1123	            start_prompt_choice(
1124	                "none",
1125	                "No per-child overrides",
1126	                "all children use the default child provider",
1127	            ),
1128	            start_prompt_choice(
1129	                "typed",
1130	                "Type overrides",
1131	                "comma-separated IDX=PROVIDER entries, for example 1=cli:codex",
1132	            ),
1133	            prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel"),
1134	        ],
1135	        default_index: 0,
1136	    })?;
1137	    match choice.id.as_str() {
1138	        "none" => {
1139	            decision.child_provider_overrides.clear();
1140	            Ok(())
1141	        }
1142	        "typed" => {
1143	            let answer = prompter.input("child provider overrides: ", None)?;
1144	            let overrides = answer
1145	                .split(',')
1146	                .map(str::trim)
1147	                .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1148	                .map(ToString::to_string)
1149	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1150	            commands::plan::parse_child_provider_overrides(&overrides, n)?;
1151	            decision.child_provider_overrides = overrides;
1152	            Ok(())
1153	        }
1154	        _ => {
1155	            set_start_recovery(
1156	                decision,
1157	                "guided start cancelled before choosing child provider overrides",
1158	                vec![format!(
1159	                    "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode full-plan --yes",
1160	                    shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1161	                )],
1162	            );
1163	            Ok(())
1164	        }
1165	    }
1166	}
