1168	pub(crate) fn resolve_start_orchestration_options(
1169	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1170	    args: &StartCommandArgs,
1171	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1172	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
1173	    mut prompter: Option<&mut dyn StartPrompter>,
1174	) -> Result<()> {
1175	    if matches!(
1176	        decision.selected_mode,
1177	        StartSelectedMode::Run | StartSelectedMode::Extend
1178	    ) {
1179	        if start_orchestration_flags_present(args) {
1180	            set_start_recovery(
1181	                decision,
1182	                "orchestration options require start --mode review or --mode full-plan",
1183	                vec![format!(
1184	                    "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode full-plan --preview",
1185	                    shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1186	                )],
1187	            );
1188	        }
1189	        return Ok(());
1190	    }
1191	
1192	    match decision.selected_mode {
1193	        StartSelectedMode::FullPlan | StartSelectedMode::Campaign => {
1194	            if let Some(n) = args.children {
1195	                validate_task_count(usize::from(n)).map_err(CliError::Core)?;
1196	                decision.child_count = Some(n);
1197	            } else if decision.child_count.is_none() {
1198	                if let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut() {
1199	                    prompt_start_child_count(decision, &mut **prompter)?;
1200	                    if decision.recovery.is_some() {
1201	                        return Ok(());
1202	                    }
1203	                } else {
1204	                    decision.child_count =
1205	                        Some(commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
1206	                            &decision.goal,
1207	                            CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
1208	                        ));
1209	                }
1210	            }
1211	
1212	            if let Some(route) = args.planner_provider.as_deref() {
1213	                decision.planner_provider_route = Some(resolve_explicit_start_provider(
1214	                    paths,
1215	                    defaults,
1216	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Planner,
1217	                    route,
1218	                )?);
1219	            } else if args.provider.is_none()
1220	                && let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut()
1221	            {
1222	                decision.planner_provider_route = prompt_start_role_provider(
1223	                    decision,
1224	                    paths,
1225	                    defaults,
1226	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Planner,
1227	                    "planner",
1228	                    &mut **prompter,
1229	                )?;
1230	                if decision.recovery.is_some() {
1231	                    return Ok(());
1232	                }
1233	            }
1234	
1235	            if args.provider.is_none()
1236	                && let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut()
1237	            {
1238	                decision.child_provider_route = prompt_start_role_provider(
1239	                    decision,
1240	                    paths,
1241	                    defaults,
1242	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::DefaultChild,
1243	                    "default child",
1244	                    &mut **prompter,
1245	                )?;
1246	                if decision.recovery.is_some() {
1247	                    return Ok(());
1248	                }
1249	            }
1250	
1251	            if matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::Campaign)
1252	                && !args.child_provider.is_empty()
1253	            {
1254	                set_start_recovery(
1255	                    decision,
1256	                    "per-child provider overrides are only supported by start --mode full-plan",
1257	                    vec![format!(
1258	                        "deadreckon campaign \"{}\" --provider <provider>",
1259	                        shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1260	                    )],
1261	                );
1262	                return Ok(());
1263	            }
1264	
1265	            if matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::FullPlan)
1266	                && !args.child_provider.is_empty()
1267	            {
1268	                let n = decision.child_count.unwrap_or_else(|| {
1269	                    commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
1270	                        &decision.goal,
1271	                        CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
1272	                    )
1273	                });
1274	                commands::plan::parse_child_provider_overrides(&args.child_provider, n)?;
1275	                decision.child_provider_overrides = args.child_provider.clone();
1276	            } else if matches!(decision.selected_mode, StartSelectedMode::FullPlan)
1277	                && let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut()
1278	            {
1279	                let n = decision.child_count.unwrap_or_else(|| {
1280	                    commands::orchestrate::recommend_child_count_for_goal(
1281	                        &decision.goal,
1282	                        CliPlanMode::FullPlan,
1283	                    )
1284	                });
1285	                prompt_start_child_provider_overrides(decision, n, &mut **prompter)?;
1286	            }
1287	        }
1288	        StartSelectedMode::Review => {
1289	            if args.children.is_some()
1290	                || args.planner_provider.is_some()
1291	                || !args.child_provider.is_empty()
1292	            {
1293	                set_start_recovery(
1294	                    decision,
1295	                    "full-plan options cannot be used with start --mode review",
1296	                    vec![format!(
1297	                        "deadreckon start \"{}\" --mode full-plan --preview",
1298	                        shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1299	                    )],
1300	                );
1301	                return Ok(());
1302	            }
1303	            if let Some(route) = args.coder_provider.as_deref() {
1304	                decision.coder_provider_route = Some(resolve_explicit_start_provider(
1305	                    paths,
1306	                    defaults,
1307	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Coder,
1308	                    route,
1309	                )?);
1310	            } else if args.provider.is_none()
1311	                && let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut()
1312	            {
1313	                decision.coder_provider_route = prompt_start_role_provider(
1314	                    decision,
1315	                    paths,
1316	                    defaults,
1317	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Coder,
1318	                    "coder",
1319	                    &mut **prompter,
1320	                )?;
1321	                if decision.recovery.is_some() {
1322	                    return Ok(());
1323	                }
1324	            }
1325	            if let Some(route) = args.reviewer_provider.as_deref() {
1326	                decision.reviewer_provider_route = Some(resolve_explicit_start_provider(
1327	                    paths,
1328	                    defaults,
1329	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Reviewer,
1330	                    route,
1331	                )?);
1332	            } else if args.provider.is_none()
1333	                && let Some(prompter) = prompter.as_mut()
1334	            {
1335	                decision.reviewer_provider_route = prompt_start_role_provider(
1336	                    decision,
1337	                    paths,
1338	                    defaults,
1339	                    setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Reviewer,
1340	                    "reviewer",
1341	                    &mut **prompter,
1342	                )?;
1343	            }
1344	        }
1345	        StartSelectedMode::Extend | StartSelectedMode::Run => {}
1346	    }
1347	    Ok(())
1348	}

1350	pub(crate) fn prompt_start_done_criteria(
1351	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1352	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
1353	) -> Result<()> {
1354	    let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
1355	        title: format!("Choose {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT}"),
1356	        help: Some(format!("No project {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} was found.")),
1357	        choices: vec![
1358	            start_prompt_choice(
1359	                "default",
1360	                "Use the default gate for this launch",
1361	                "working directory exists, or cargo test for Rust projects",
1362	            ),
1363	            start_prompt_choice(
1364	                "generate",
1365	                "Create from the goal before launch",
1366	                "uses the existing def-done compiler after final confirmation",
1367	            ),
1368	            start_prompt_choice(
1369	                "manual",
1370	                "Write criteria in English",
1371	                "compiled through the existing def-done flow after confirmation",
1372	            ),
1373	            prompt::SelectChoice::new("cancel", "Cancel and show def-done command"),
1374	        ],
1375	        default_index: 0,
1376	    })?;
1377	    match choice.id.as_str() {
1378	        "default" => {
1379	            decision.done_criteria_source = StartDoneCriteriaSource::DefaultGate;
1380	            decision.done_action = StartDoneAction::DefaultGate;
1381	            decision.done_criteria_label = "default dr-gate behavior".to_string();
1382	        }
1383	        "generate" => {
1384	            decision.done_criteria_source = StartDoneCriteriaSource::Generated;
1385	            decision.done_action = StartDoneAction::GenerateFromGoal;
1386	            decision.done_criteria_label = "create from goal before launch".to_string();
1387	        }
1388	        "manual" => {
1389	            let text = prompter.input("definition of done: ", None)?;
1390	            if text.trim().is_empty() {
1391	                set_start_recovery(
1392	                    decision,
1393	                    format!("empty {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} was not saved"),
1394	                    vec![format!(
1395	                        "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" && deadreckon start \"{}\"",
1396	                        shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1397	                    )],
1398	                );
1399	                return Ok(());
1400	            }
1401	            decision.done_criteria_source = StartDoneCriteriaSource::Manual;
1402	            decision.done_action = StartDoneAction::ManualText {
1403	                text: text.trim().to_string(),
1404	                overwrite_existing: false,
1405	            };
1406	            decision.done_criteria_label = "write manual criteria before launch".to_string();
1407	        }
1408	        _ => set_start_recovery(
1409	            decision,
1410	            format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} is missing for this repo"),
1411	            vec![format!(
1412	                "deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\" && deadreckon start \"{}\"",
1413	                shell_display_quote(&decision.goal)
1414	            )],
1415	        ),
1416	    }
1417	    Ok(())
1418	}

1427	        lines.push(format!(

1435	    lines.push("deadreckon def-done \"what should count as done\"".to_string());

1466	fn check_start_done_criteria(cwd: &Path, selection: &setup::DoneCriteriaSelection) -> Result<()> {
1467	    let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
1468	        "deadreckon-start-done-check-{}",
1469	        Uuid::new_v4().simple()
1470	    ));
1471	    fs::create_dir_all(&temp_root)?;
1472	    if let Some(path) = selection.path.as_ref() {
1473	        fs::copy(path, acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&temp_root))?;
1474	    }
1475	    let result = evaluate_acceptance_checks(&temp_root, cwd);
1476	    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&temp_root);
1477	    println!("{}", ui_heading(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} check")));
1478	    match result {
1479	        Ok(results) => {
1480	            let failed_required = results
1481	                .iter()
1482	                .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed);
1483	            if failed_required {
1484	                println!("{}", ui_status(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} failed")));
1485	            } else {
1486	                println!("{}", ui_ok(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} passed")));
1487	            }
1488	            commands::acceptance::print_acceptance_results(&results);
1489	        }
1490	        Err(err) => {
1491	            println!(
1492	                "{}",
1493	                ui_warn(format!("{NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} check could not run: {err}"))
1494	            );
1495	        }
1496	    }
1497	    Ok(())
1498	}

1500	pub(crate) fn prompt_start_existing_done_criteria(
1501	    decision: &mut StartLaunchDecision,
1502	    cwd: &Path,
1503	    selection: &setup::DoneCriteriaSelection,
1504	    prompter: &mut dyn StartPrompter,
1505	) -> Result<()> {
1506	    loop {
1507	        let choice = prompter.select_one(prompt::SelectPrompt {
1508	            title: format!("Review {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT}"),
1509	            help: Some(format!(
1510	                "Current {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT}: {}. You can view, check, update, keep, or cancel before launch.",
1511	                done_criteria_prompt_detail(selection)
1512	            )),
1513	            choices: vec![
1514	                start_prompt_choice(
1515	                    "keep",
1516	                    format!("Keep current {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT}"),
1517	                    done_criteria_prompt_detail(selection),
1518	                ),
1519	                start_prompt_choice(
1520	                    "view",
1521	                    "View current contract summary",
1522	                    "prints source, path/check count, and manual commands",
1523	                ),
1524	                start_prompt_choice(
1525	                    "check",
1526	                    "Check current contract now",
1527	                    "dry-runs the configured checks against this working tree",
1528	                ),
1529	                start_prompt_choice(
1530	                    "update",
1531	                    "Update contract before launch",
1532	                    "writes new plain-English criteria through the def-done flow",
1533	                ),
1534	                prompt::SelectChoice::new(
1535	                    "cancel",
1536	                    format!("Cancel and show {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} commands"),
1537	                ),
1538	            ],
1539	            default_index: 0,
1540	        })?;
1541	
1542	        match choice.id.as_str() {
1543	            "keep" => {
1544	                decision.done_criteria_source = StartDoneCriteriaSource::Project;
1545	                decision.done_action = StartDoneAction::Existing;
1546	                decision.done_criteria_label = selection.full_label();
1547	                return Ok(());
1548	            }
1549	            "view" => print_start_done_criteria_summary(selection),
1550	            "check" => check_start_done_criteria(cwd, selection)?,
1551	            "update" => {
1552	                let text = prompter.input("updated definition of done: ", None)?;
1553	                if text.trim().is_empty() {
1554	                    set_start_recovery(
1555	                        decision,
1556	                        format!("empty {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} was not saved"),
1557	                        done_criteria_inspection_try_lines(selection),
1558	                    );
1559	                    return Ok(());
1560	                }
1561	                decision.done_criteria_source = StartDoneCriteriaSource::Manual;
1562	                decision.done_action = StartDoneAction::ManualText {
1563	                    text: text.trim().to_string(),
1564	                    overwrite_existing: true,
1565	                };
1566	                decision.done_criteria_label = format!("update {NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT} before launch");
1567	                return Ok(());
1568	            }

414	async fn attach_plan_tui(
415	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,

443	        let now = Utc::now();

445	        let new_feed_events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
446	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
447	        let event_refresh = plan_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_feed_events);
448	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
449	        for event in new_feed_events {

453	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event });

456	                    plan = (*snapshot).clone();
457	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot });
458	                }
459	                other => feed_events.push(other),
460	            }
461	        }
462	        if plan_events.len() > 1_000 {
463	            let drain = plan_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
464	            plan_events.drain(0..drain);
465	        }
466	        if feed_events.len() > 1_000 {
467	            let drain = feed_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
468	            feed_events.drain(0..drain);
469	        }

478	            selected = plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1);
479	        }

481	            if view.is_narrative() {

483	                    plan.status == PlanStatus::Forked,

485	                    now,
486	                )
487	            } else {
488	                None
489	            }
490	        });

492	            && view.is_narrative()
493	        {
494	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
495	            let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
496	                paths,
497	                plan: &plan,
498	                messages: &messages,
499	                plan_events: &plan_events,
500	                feed_events: &feed_events,
501	                selected,
502	                config: &narrative_config,

504	            narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
505	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
506	                plan_narrative_refresh_request(&refresh_input, kind),
507	                now,
508	            ));
509	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
510	        }
511	        let narrative_projection = if view.is_narrative() {
512	            let input = narrative::PlanNarrativeInput {
513	                paths,
514	                plan: &plan,
515	                messages: &messages,
516	                plan_events: &plan_events,
517	                feed_events: &feed_events,
518	                selected,
519	            };
520	            narrative_projection_cache
521	                .refresh_plan(&input)

523	                .ok()
524	        } else {
525	            None

925	async fn handle_tui_completion_key(
926	    terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,
927	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
928	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
929	    key: KeyEvent,
930	) -> Result<Option<AttachActionNotice>> {
931	    let action = match key.code {
932	        KeyCode::Char('m') => CompletionAction::Materialize,
933	        KeyCode::Char('e') => CompletionAction::Extend,
934	        KeyCode::Char('a') => CompletionAction::Apply,
935	        KeyCode::Char('b') => CompletionAction::Abandon,
936	        KeyCode::Char('d') => CompletionAction::Docs,
937	        KeyCode::Char('s') => CompletionAction::Show,
938	        _ => return Ok(None),
939	    };
940	
941	    suspend_tui(terminal)?;
942	    let action_result = match action {
943	        CompletionAction::Materialize => prompt_materialize_action(paths, state),
944	        CompletionAction::Extend => prompt_extend_action(state).await,
945	        CompletionAction::Apply => super::lifecycle::apply_command(
946	            state.run_id.clone(),
947	            "squash".to_string(),
948	            None,
949	            false,
950	            false,
951	            false,
952	            None,
953	            false,
954	        ),
955	        CompletionAction::Abandon => {
956	            super::lifecycle::abandon_command(state.run_id.clone(), false, false)
957	        }
958	        CompletionAction::Docs => {
959	            Box::pin(super::doc::doc_command(super::doc::DocCommandArgs {
960	                run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
961	                kind: CliDocKind::Narrative,
962	                export: None,
963	                polish: false,
964	                no_confirm: true,
965	                force: false,
966	                doc_skill: None,
967	                doc_provider: None,
968	                budget_cap: None,
969	            }))
970	            .await
971	        }
972	        CompletionAction::Show => {
973	            show_command(&state.run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None)
974	        }
975	        CompletionAction::Quit => Ok(()),
976	    };
977	    if let Err(err) = &action_result {
978	        print_error(err);
979	        print_error_hint(err);
980	    }
981	    let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to attach...", None);
982	    resume_tui(terminal)?;
983	    Ok(Some(AttachActionNotice {
984	        action,
985	        success: action_result.is_ok(),
986	    }))
987	}

989	pub(crate) fn suspend_tui(terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> Result<()> {

991	    execute!(

993	        DisableMouseCapture,

1021	pub(crate) fn attach_should_quit(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1022	    matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc)
1023	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL))
1024	}
1025	
1026	pub(crate) fn attach_should_return_to_plan(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1027	    attach_should_quit(key)
1028	        || matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Backspace)
1029	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('b') && key.modifiers.is_empty())
1030	}

1705	                ("scope", scope.to_string()),
1706	                ("chains", "0".to_string()),
1707	            ],
1708	        ),
1709	        vec![("Recommended", "deadreckon chain \"step one\" \"step two\"")],
1710	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
1711	    )
1712	    .expect("empty chain verdict surface must have one primary action")
1713	}

1715	fn chain_show_command(
1716	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1717	    id: &str,
1718	    why_failed: bool,
1719	    json_output: bool,
1720	) -> Result<()> {
1721	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
1722	    let chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
1723	    if json_output {
1724	        let surface = chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain);
1725	        let value = surface.add_to_json(json!({
1726	            "kind": "chain",
1727	            "id": &chain.chain_id,
1728	            "status": chain_status_label(&chain),
1729	            "next_actions": [surface.primary_action.command.clone()],
1730	            "try_lines": Vec::<String>::new(),
1731	            "paths": {
1732	                "chain": paths.chain_json(&chain.chain_id),
1733	            },
1734	            "chain": chain,
1735	        }));
1736	        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&value)?);
1737	        return Ok(());
1738	    }
1739	    if why_failed {
1740	        print!(
1741	            "{}",
1742	            chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1743	        );
1744	        return Ok(());
1745	    }
1746	    print!(
1747	        "{}",
1748	        chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
1749	    );
1750	    println!();
1751	    println!("{}", ui_heading("Steps"));
1752	    print_chain_header(paths, &chain);
1753	    for step in &chain.steps {
1754	        println!(
1755	            "{} step {} {:<9} {}{}",
1756	            chain_step_dot_for_output(step.status),
1757	            step.index + 1,
1758	            chain_step_status_label(step.status),
1759	            truncate_text(&step.goal, 72),
1760	            step.run_id
1761	                .as_deref()
1762	                .map(|run_id| format!(" run={}", ui_id(run_prefix(run_id))))
1763	                .unwrap_or_default()
1764	        );
1765	    }
1766	    Ok(())
1767	}

1769	fn chain_verdict_surface(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain: &Chain) -> VerdictSurface {
1770	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
1771	    let failed_step = chain
1772	        .steps
1773	        .iter()
1774	        .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Failed || step.fail_reason.is_some());
1775	    let reason = chain
1776	        .failure_reason
1777	        .as_deref()
1778	        .or(chain.paused_reason.as_deref());
1779	    let (kind, what, why) = match chain.status {
1780	        ChainStatus::Completed => (
1781	            VerdictKind::Completed,
1782	            "The chain reached a terminal completed state.",
1783	            "All required chain steps are complete, so the safest next command is inspection.",
1784	        ),
1785	        ChainStatus::Failed => (
1786	            VerdictKind::Failed,
1787	            "The chain stopped before all required steps completed.",
1788	            "Failure inspection is the safest next command before resuming, skipping, or applying any step.",
1789	        ),
1790	        ChainStatus::Paused => (
1791	            VerdictKind::Paused,
1792	            chain_paused_what(reason),
1793	            chain_paused_why(reason),
1794	        ),
1795	        ChainStatus::Killed => (
1796	            VerdictKind::Killed,
1797	            "The chain was stopped before reaching a terminal result.",
1798	            "Killed chain state should be inspected before cleanup or relaunch.",
1799	        ),
1800	        ChainStatus::Running => (
1801	            VerdictKind::Paused,
1802	            "The chain is still running.",
1803	            "Attaching is the safest next command because active conductor state may still exist.",
1804	        ),
1805	        ChainStatus::Pending => (
1806	            VerdictKind::Preview,
1807	            "The chain has been planned but has not started running.",
1808	            "Resume starts or continues the stored chain state.",
1809	        ),
1810	        ChainStatus::Undone => (
1811	            VerdictKind::Noop,
1812	            "The chain has already been undone.",
1813	            "Inspection is the safest next command because there is no active chain work to advance.",
1814	        ),
1815	    };
1816	    let mut evidence = chain_base_evidence(paths, chain);
1817	    if let Some(reason) = reason {
1818	        evidence.push(("reason".to_string(), reason.to_string()));
1819	    }
1820	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Paused
1821	        && reason == Some("apply_mode_preview")
1822	        && let Some(diff_summary) = latest_chain_preview_diff_summary(paths, chain)
1823	    {
1824	        evidence.push(("diff summary".to_string(), diff_summary));
1825	    }
1826	    if let Some(step) = failed_step {
1827	        evidence.push((
1828	            "failed step".to_string(),
1829	            format!(
1830	                "{} {}",
1831	                step.index + 1,
1832	                chain_step_status_label(step.status)
1833	            ),
1834	        ));
1835	        if let Some(run_id) = step.run_id.as_deref() {
1836	            evidence.push(("failed run".to_string(), run_prefix(run_id)));
1837	        }
1838	        if let Some(reason) = step.fail_reason.as_deref() {
1839	            evidence.push(("step reason".to_string(), reason.to_string()));
1840	        }
1841	    }
1842	    let primary = chain_primary_action(chain);
1843	    let secondary = chain_secondary_actions(chain, &primary);
1844	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1845	        kind,
1846	        "chain",
1847	        Some(&id),
1848	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
1849	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1850	        secondary
1851	            .iter()
1852	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1853	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1854	    )
1855	    .expect("chain verdict surface must have one primary action")
1856	}
1857	
1858	fn latest_chain_preview_diff_summary(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain: &Chain) -> Option<String> {
1859	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(paths.chain_events(&chain.chain_id)).ok()?;
1860	    raw.lines()
1861	        .rev()
1862	        .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<ChainEvent>(line).ok())
1863	        .find(|event| {
1864	            event.event == ChainEventKind::ChainApplyRefused
1865	                && event
1866	                    .detail
1867	                    .get("reason")
1868	                    .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
1869	                    == Some("apply_mode_preview")
1870	        })
1871	        .map(|event| {
1872	            event
1873	                .detail
1874	                .get("diff_summary")
1875	                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
1876	                .map(compact_chain_diff_summary)
1877	                .unwrap_or_else(|| "no diff".to_string())
1878	        })
1879	}
1880	
1881	fn compact_chain_diff_summary(summary: &str) -> String {
1882	    let mut lines = summary
1883	        .lines()
1884	        .map(str::trim)
1885	        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
1886	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1887	    if lines.is_empty() {
1888	        return "no diff".to_string();
1889	    }
1890	    if let Some(index) = lines
1891	        .iter()
1892	        .rposition(|line| line.contains("file changed") || line.contains("files changed"))
1893	    {
1894	        return lines.swap_remove(index).to_string();
1895	    }
1896	    lines[0].to_string()
1897	}

1899	fn chain_transition_surface(
1900	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1901	    chain: &Chain,
1902	    kind: VerdictKind,
1903	    what: &str,
1904	    why: &str,
1905	    mut evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
1906	    primary: String,
1907	    secondary: Vec<String>,
1908	) -> VerdictSurface {
1909	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
1910	    let mut all_evidence = chain_base_evidence(paths, chain);
1911	    all_evidence.append(&mut evidence);
1912	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1913	        kind,
1914	        "chain",
1915	        Some(&id),
1916	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, all_evidence),
1917	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1918	        secondary
1919	            .iter()
1920	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
1921	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1922	    )
1923	    .expect("chain transition verdict surface must have one primary action")
1924	}

1926	fn chain_base_evidence(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain: &Chain) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
1927	    let completed = chain
1928	        .steps
1929	        .iter()
1930	        .filter(|step| {
1931	            matches!(
1932	                step.status,
1933	                ChainStepStatus::Completed | ChainStepStatus::Applied
1934	            )
1935	        })
1936	        .count();
1937	    vec![
1938	        ("chain".to_string(), chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)),
1939	        ("status".to_string(), chain_status_label(chain).to_string()),
1940	        (
1941	            "steps".to_string(),
1942	            format!("{completed}/{} complete", chain.steps.len()),
1943	        ),
1944	        (
1945	            "state".to_string(),
1946	            paths.chain_json(&chain.chain_id).display().to_string(),
1947	        ),
1948	    ]
1949	}

1951	fn chain_primary_action(chain: &Chain) -> String {
1952	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
1953	    match chain.status {
1954	        ChainStatus::Failed => format!("deadreckon chain show {id} --why-failed"),
1955	        ChainStatus::Paused if chain_paused_for_dirty_target(chain) => {
1956	            format!("git -C {} status --short", chain.cwd.display())
1957	        }
1958	        ChainStatus::Paused if chain_paused_for_hook_refusal(chain) => {
1959	            "deadreckon chain hooks list".to_string()
1960	        }
1961	        ChainStatus::Paused if chain_paused_for_outside_allowlist(chain) => {
1962	            format!("deadreckon chain resume {id} --apply-mode preview")
1963	        }
1964	        ChainStatus::Paused | ChainStatus::Pending => format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
1965	        ChainStatus::Running => format!("deadreckon chain attach {id}"),
1966	        ChainStatus::Completed | ChainStatus::Undone => format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
1967	        ChainStatus::Killed => format!("deadreckon chain show {id} --why-failed"),
1968	    }
1969	}

1971	fn chain_paused_for_dirty_target(chain: &Chain) -> bool {
1972	    chain
1973	        .paused_reason
1974	        .as_deref()
1975	        .is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_dirty_target"))
1976	}

1978	fn chain_paused_for_hook_refusal(chain: &Chain) -> bool {
1979	    chain
1980	        .paused_reason
1981	        .as_deref()
1982	        .is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_by_hook_on_promote"))
1983	}
1984	
1985	fn chain_paused_for_outside_allowlist(chain: &Chain) -> bool {
1986	    chain
1987	        .paused_reason
1988	        .as_deref()
1989	        .is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_outside_allowlist"))
1990	}
1991	
1992	fn chain_paused_what(reason: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
1993	    if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
1994	        "The chain paused because the on-promote hook refused auto-apply."
1995	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_paused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
1996	        "The chain paused because the on-promote hook requested an operator pause."
1997	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_dirty_target")) {
1998	        "The chain paused because auto-apply found uncommitted target changes."
1999	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_outside_allowlist")) {
2000	        "The chain paused because auto-apply refused a file outside the apply allowlist."
2001	    } else {
2002	        "The chain is paused before reaching a terminal result."
2003	    }
2004	}
2005	
2006	fn chain_paused_why(reason: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
2007	    if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
2008	        "The hook policy blocked promotion, so inspecting configured chain hooks is the primary next command before resuming."
2009	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_paused_by_hook_on_promote")) {
2010	        "The hook requested a resumable pause, so resuming the chain is the primary next command after the operator check."
2011	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_dirty_target")) {
2012	        "The source repo has local changes, so inspecting the dirty state is the primary next command before stashing, committing, or resuming."
2013	    } else if reason.is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with("apply_refused_outside_allowlist")) {
2014	        "Previewing the diff is the primary next command before widening the allowlist or manually applying the step."
2015	    } else {
2016	        "The chain still has resumable state, so resume is the primary next command."
2017	    }
2018	}
2019	
2020	fn chain_secondary_actions(chain: &Chain, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
2021	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2022	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
2023	    let mut candidates = vec![
2024	        format!("deadreckon chain attach {id}"),
2025	        format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2026	        format!("deadreckon chain show {id} --why-failed"),
2027	        format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2028	    ];
2029	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Paused {
2030	        candidates.push(format!("deadreckon chain resume {id} --apply-mode preview"));
2031	        candidates.push(format!("deadreckon chain undo {id}"));
2032	    }
2033	    for command in candidates {
2034	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
2035	            actions.push(command);
2036	        }
2037	    }
2038	    actions
2039	}

2156	fn chain_attach_tui(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, chain_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
2157	    enable_raw_mode()?;
2158	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
2159	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
2160	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
2161	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
2162	    let mut tui_state = ChainAttachTuiState::default();
2163	    let mut event_tail = AttachJsonlTail::<ChainEvent>::new(paths.chain_events(chain_id));
2164	
2165	    let result = loop {
2166	        let budget = AttachTickBudget::default();
2167	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Chain, budget);
2168	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2169	        let chain = load_chain(paths, chain_id)?;
2170	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
2171	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2172	        event_tail.reset_to_path(paths.chain_events(chain_id));
2173	        let event_refresh_error = event_tail.refresh().err();
2174	        let event_read_elapsed = stage_started.elapsed();
2175	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ReadJsonl, stage_started);
2176	        tui_state.event_status_hint = chain_event_read_hint(
2177	            event_tail.rows().len(),
2178	            event_tail.last_appended_rows,
2179	            event_tail.partial_bytes,
2180	            event_read_elapsed,
2181	            budget,
2182	            event_refresh_error.as_ref(),
2183	        );
2184	        let events = event_tail.rows();
2185	        tui_state.clamp(&chain);
2186	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2187	        terminal.draw(|frame| render_chain_attach(frame, &chain, events, &tui_state))?;
2188	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
2189	
2190	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
2191	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(200))?;
2192	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
2193	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
2194	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
2195	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
2196	        if input_ready {
2197	            match event::read()? {
2198	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),
2199	                Event::Key(key) => match key.code {
2200	                    KeyCode::Enter => {
2201	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2202	                        if let Some(run_id) = chain
2203	                            .steps
2204	                            .get(tui_state.selected_step)
2205	                            .and_then(|step| step.run_id.clone())
2206	                        {
2207	                            let _ = show_command(&run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None);
2208	                        } else {
2209	                            eprintln!("selected step has no run yet");
2210	                        }
2211	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2212	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2213	                    }
2214	                    KeyCode::Char('r') => {
2215	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2216	                        let action = chain_redo_command(
2217	                            paths,
2218	                            chain_id,
2219	                            Some(tui_state.selected_step as u32 + 1),
2220	                            None,
2221	                            false,
2222	                        );
2223	                        if let Err(err) = &action {
2224	                            print_error(err);
2225	                        }
2226	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2227	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2228	                    }
2229	                    KeyCode::Char('e') => {
2230	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2231	                        let goal = prompt::open("new chain step goal: ", None)?;
2232	                        if !goal.trim().is_empty() {
2233	                            let action = chain_extend_command(paths, chain_id, goal, None, None);
2234	                            if let Err(err) = &action {
2235	                                print_error(err);
2236	                            }
2237	                        }
2238	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2239	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2240	                    }
2241	                    KeyCode::Char('p') => {
2242	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2243	                        let action =
2244	                            chain_pause_command(paths, chain_id, Some("user_paused".to_string()));
2245	                        if let Err(err) = &action {
2246	                            print_error(err);
2247	                        }
2248	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2249	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2250	                    }
2251	                    KeyCode::Char('k') => {
2252	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2253	                        if prompt::confirm("kill chain?", false)?
2254	                            && let Err(err) = chain_kill_command(paths, chain_id, false)
2255	                        {
2256	                            print_error(&err);
2257	                        }
2258	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to chain attach...", None);
2259	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
2260	                    }
2261	                    _ => tui_state.handle_key(key, &chain),
2262	                },
2263	                Event::Mouse(mouse) => match mouse.kind {
2264	                    MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => tui_state.scroll(1, &chain),
2265	                    MouseEventKind::ScrollUp => tui_state.scroll(-1, &chain),
2266	                    _ => {}
2267	                },
2268	                _ => {}
2269	            }
2270	        }
2271	    };
2272	
2273	    disable_raw_mode()?;
2274	    execute!(
2275	        terminal.backend_mut(),
2276	        DisableMouseCapture,
2277	        LeaveAlternateScreen
2278	    )?;
2279	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
2280	    result
2281	}

2283	fn chain_pause_command(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, reason: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {
2284	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2285	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2286	    if chain.status != ChainStatus::Running {
2287	        let status = chain_status_label(&chain).to_string();
2288	        let primary = format!("deadreckon chain status {}", chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id));
2289	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2290	            code: 1,
2291	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2292	                paths,
2293	                &chain,
2294	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2295	                &format!("DeadReckon did not pause the chain because cannot pause '{status}' chain."),
2296	                "Only a running chain can be paused; this chain is already outside the active conductor state.",
2297	                vec![
2298	                    ("requested transition".to_string(), "pause".to_string()),
2299	                    ("required status".to_string(), "running".to_string()),
2300	                ],
2301	                primary,
2302	                Vec::new(),
2303	            )
2304	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2305	        });
2306	    }
2307	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Paused;
2308	    chain.paused_reason = Some(reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "user_paused".to_string()));
2309	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2310	    append_chain_event(
2311	        paths,
2312	        &chain.chain_id,
2313	        ChainEventKind::ChainPaused,
2314	        None,
2315	        json!({ "reason": chain.paused_reason }),
2316	    )?;
2317	    print!(
2318	        "{}",
2319	        chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2320	    );
2321	    Ok(())
2322	}

2324	pub(crate) fn chain_kill_command(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, force: bool) -> Result<()> {
2325	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2326	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2327	    let conductor = read_conductor_state(paths, &id)?;
2328	    let mut signaled_pids = BTreeSet::new();
2329	    if let Some(run_id) = conductor
2330	        .as_ref()
2331	        .and_then(|state| state.live_run_id.as_deref())
2332	        .map(ToString::to_string)
2333	        .or_else(|| {
2334	            chain
2335	                .steps
2336	                .iter()
2337	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Running)
2338	                .and_then(|step| step.run_id.clone())
2339	        })
2340	        && let Ok(mut state) = load_run(paths, &run_id)
2341	    {
2342	        kill_loaded_run(paths, &mut state, force)?;
2343	        signaled_pids.extend(supervised_pids(&state));
2344	    }
2345	    if let Some(pid) = conductor.as_ref().and_then(|state| state.live_child_pid) {
2346	        terminate_pid(pid, force)?;
2347	        signaled_pids.insert(pid);
2348	    }
2349	    if let Some(pid) = conductor
2350	        .as_ref()
2351	        .map(|state| state.conductor_pid)
2352	        .or(chain.conductor_pid)
2353	        && pid != std::process::id()
2354	    {
2355	        terminate_pid(pid, force)?;
2356	        signaled_pids.insert(pid);
2357	    }
2358	    if !force {
2359	        let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(2);
2360	        while signaled_pids
2361	            .iter()
2362	            .any(|pid| *pid != std::process::id() && pid_is_alive(*pid))
2363	            && std::time::Instant::now() < deadline
2364	        {
2365	            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
2366	        }
2367	        for pid in &signaled_pids {
2368	            if *pid != std::process::id() && pid_is_alive(*pid) {
2369	                terminate_pid(*pid, true)?;
2370	            }
2371	        }
2372	    }
2373	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Killed;
2374	    chain.failure_reason = Some("killed by user".to_string());
2375	    chain.conductor_pid = None;
2376	    for step in &mut chain.steps {
2377	        if step.status == ChainStepStatus::Running {
2378	            step.status = ChainStepStatus::Failed;
2379	            step.fail_reason = Some("killed by user".to_string());
2380	        }
2381	    }
2382	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2383	    append_chain_event(
2384	        paths,
2385	        &chain.chain_id,
2386	        ChainEventKind::ChainKilled,
2387	        None,
2388	        json!({ "force": force }),
2389	    )?;
2390	    let _ = fs::remove_file(paths.conductor_json(&chain.chain_id));
2391	    print!(
2392	        "{}",
2393	        chain_verdict_surface(paths, &chain).render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2394	    );
2395	    Ok(())
2396	}

2398	fn chain_undo_command(
2399	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2400	    id: &str,
2401	    through_step: Option<u32>,
2402	    no_confirm: bool,
2403	) -> Result<()> {
2404	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2405	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2406	    let mut applied = chain
2407	        .steps
2408	        .iter()
2409	        .filter(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied)
2410	        .filter(|step| through_step.is_none_or(|limit| step.index < limit))
2411	        .filter_map(|step| {
2412	            step.applied_sha
2413	                .as_deref()
2414	                .map(|sha| (step.index, sha.to_string()))
2415	        })
2416	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2417	    if applied.is_empty() {
2418	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2419	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2420	            code: 1,
2421	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2422	                paths,
2423	                &chain,
2424	                VerdictKind::Noop,
2425	                "DeadReckon did not undo the chain because there is nothing to undo.",
2426	                "Undo only applies to chain steps with applied commits, so inspection is the safest next command.",
2427	                vec![("applied steps".to_string(), "0".to_string())],
2428	                format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2429	                Vec::new(),
2430	            )
2431	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2432	        });
2433	    }
2434	    if !no_confirm && io::stdin().is_terminal() {
2435	        if !prompt::confirm("undo applied chain commits?", false)? {
2436	            println!("{}", ui_status("cancelled"));
2437	            return Ok(());
2438	        }
2439	    } else if !no_confirm {
2440	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2441	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2442	            code: 1,
2443	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2444	                paths,
2445	                &chain,
2446	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2447	                "DeadReckon did not undo the chain because non-interactive chain undo requires --no-confirm.",
2448	                "Undo reverts applied commits, and this session cannot ask for confirmation, so DeadReckon stopped before changing git state.",
2449	                vec![("stdin".to_string(), "non-interactive".to_string())],
2450	                format!("deadreckon chain undo {id} --no-confirm"),
2451	                Vec::new(),
2452	            )
2453	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2454	        });
2455	    }
2456	    append_chain_event(
2457	        paths,
2458	        &chain.chain_id,
2459	        ChainEventKind::ChainUndoStarted,
2460	        None,
2461	        json!({ "count": applied.len() }),
2462	    )?;
2463	    let undo_count = applied.len();
2464	    applied.reverse();
2465	    for (index, sha) in applied {
2466	        git_status(&chain.cwd, &["revert", "--no-edit", &sha])?;
2467	        if let Some(step) = chain.steps.iter_mut().find(|step| step.index == index) {
2468	            step.status = ChainStepStatus::Undone;
2469	        }
2470	        append_chain_event(
2471	            paths,
2472	            &chain.chain_id,
2473	            ChainEventKind::ChainUndoneStep,
2474	            Some(index),
2475	            json!({ "sha": sha }),
2476	        )?;
2477	    }
2478	    chain.status = ChainStatus::Undone;
2479	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2480	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2481	    print!(
2482	        "{}",
2483	        chain_transition_surface(
2484	            paths,
2485	            &chain,
2486	            VerdictKind::Noop,
2487	            "DeadReckon reverted the applied chain commits and marked the chain undone.",
2488	            "There is no active chain work to advance, so inspection is the safest next command.",
2489	            vec![("undone steps".to_string(), undo_count.to_string())],
2490	            format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2491	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain redo {id}")],
2492	        )
2493	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2494	    );
2495	    Ok(())
2496	}

2498	fn chain_extend_command(
2499	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2500	    id: &str,
2501	    step_goal: String,
2502	    insert_at: Option<u32>,
2503	    max_spend_add: Option<f64>,
2504	) -> Result<()> {
2505	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2506	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2507	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Completed && insert_at.is_none() {
2508	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2509	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2510	            code: 1,
2511	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2512	                paths,
2513	                &chain,
2514	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2515	                "DeadReckon did not extend the chain because it cannot extend completed chain at end.",
2516	                "A completed chain can only be reopened by inserting a step at a specific position, so DeadReckon refused before mutating chain state.",
2517	                vec![("insert-at".to_string(), "missing".to_string())],
2518	                format!("deadreckon chain extend {id} \"...\" --insert-at <N>"),
2519	                Vec::new(),
2520	            )
2521	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2522	        });
2523	    }
2524	    if let Some(add) = max_spend_add {
2525	        chain.max_spend_usd = Some(chain.max_spend_usd.unwrap_or(0.0) + add);
2526	    }
2527	    let insert = insert_at
2528	        .map(|value| value.saturating_sub(1) as usize)
2529	        .unwrap_or(chain.steps.len())
2530	        .min(chain.steps.len());
2531	    chain.steps.insert(
2532	        insert,
2533	        deadreckon_core::ChainStep::new(insert as u32, step_goal),
2534	    );
2535	    for (index, step) in chain.steps.iter_mut().enumerate() {
2536	        step.index = index as u32;
2537	    }
2538	    if chain.status == ChainStatus::Completed {
2539	        chain.status = ChainStatus::Paused;
2540	        chain.paused_reason = Some("extended".to_string());
2541	    }
2542	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2543	    append_chain_event(
2544	        paths,
2545	        &chain.chain_id,
2546	        ChainEventKind::ChainStepExtended,
2547	        Some(insert as u32),
2548	        json!({ "insert_at": insert }),
2549	    )?;
2550	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2551	    print!(
2552	        "{}",
2553	        chain_transition_surface(
2554	            paths,
2555	            &chain,
2556	            VerdictKind::Preview,
2557	            "DeadReckon queued a new chain step.",
2558	            "The chain has stored work that has not run yet, so resume is the safest next command.",
2559	            vec![("inserted step".to_string(), (insert + 1).to_string())],
2560	            format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2561	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain show {id}")],
2562	        )
2563	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2564	    );
2565	    Ok(())
2566	}

2568	fn chain_redo_command(
2569	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2570	    id: &str,
2571	    step: Option<u32>,
2572	    extend: Option<String>,
2573	    reapply: bool,
2574	) -> Result<()> {
2575	    let id = resolve_chain_id(paths, id, false)?;
2576	    let mut chain = load_chain(paths, &id)?;
2577	    let index = step
2578	        .map(|step| step.saturating_sub(1))
2579	        .or_else(|| {
2580	            chain
2581	                .steps
2582	                .iter()
2583	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Failed)
2584	                .map(|step| step.index)
2585	        })
2586	        .or_else(|| {
2587	            chain
2588	                .steps
2589	                .iter()
2590	                .rev()
2591	                .find(|step| step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied)
2592	                .map(|step| step.index)
2593	        })
2594	        .ok_or_else(|| {
2595	            let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2596	            CliError::Surface {
2597	                code: 1,
2598	                surface: chain_transition_surface(
2599	                    paths,
2600	                    &chain,
2601	                    VerdictKind::Noop,
2602	                    "DeadReckon did not redo a chain step because no failed or applied step to redo.",
2603	                    "The default redo target is the first failed step or the latest applied step. This chain has no eligible redo candidate, so DeadReckon left chain state unchanged.",
2604	                    vec![("redo candidate".to_string(), "none".to_string())],
2605	                    format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2606	                    Vec::new(),
2607	                )
2608	                .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2609	            }
2610	        })? as usize;
2611	    let selected_step = chain.steps.get(index).ok_or_else(|| {
2612	        let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2613	        CliError::Surface {
2614	            code: 1,
2615	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2616	                paths,
2617	                &chain,
2618	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2619	                &format!("DeadReckon did not redo the step because step {} does not exist.", index + 1),
2620	                "The requested step is outside the chain's stored step list, so DeadReckon refused before mutating chain state.",
2621	                vec![
2622	                    ("requested step".to_string(), (index + 1).to_string()),
2623	                    ("step count".to_string(), chain.steps.len().to_string()),
2624	                ],
2625	                format!("deadreckon chain show {id}"),
2626	                Vec::new(),
2627	            )
2628	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2629	        }
2630	    })?;
2631	    if selected_step.status == ChainStepStatus::Applied && !reapply {
2632	        let step_number = index + 1;
2633	        let primary = format!(
2634	            "deadreckon chain redo {} --step {step_number} --reapply",
2635	            chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id)
2636	        );
2637	        return Err(CliError::Surface {
2638	            code: 1,
2639	            surface: chain_transition_surface(
2640	                paths,
2641	                &chain,
2642	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2643	                &format!("DeadReckon did not redo the step because step '{step_number}' already applied; redo needs --reapply."),
2644	                "Redoing an applied step requires explicit reapply consent because DeadReckon may need to revert a previously applied commit before replaying the step.",
2645	                vec![
2646	                    ("requested step".to_string(), step_number.to_string()),
2647	                    (
2648	                        "step status".to_string(),
2649	                        chain_step_status_label(selected_step.status).to_string(),
2650	                    ),
2651	                ],
2652	                primary,
2653	                Vec::new(),
2654	            )
2655	            .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false)),
2656	        });
2657	    }
2658	    let step = chain.steps.get_mut(index).expect("validated step index");
2659	    if reapply && let Some(sha) = step.applied_sha.as_deref() {
2660	        git_status(&chain.cwd, &["revert", "--no-edit", sha])?;
2661	    }
2662	    let prior_goal = step.goal.clone();
2663	    if let Some(extend) = extend {
2664	        step.goal = extend;
2665	    }
2666	    step.status = ChainStepStatus::Pending;
2667	    step.run_id = None;
2668	    step.applied_at = None;
2669	    step.applied_sha = None;
2670	    save_chain(paths, &chain)?;
2671	    append_chain_event(
2672	        paths,
2673	        &chain.chain_id,
2674	        ChainEventKind::ChainStepRedone,
2675	        Some(index as u32),
2676	        json!({ "prior_goal": prior_goal, "new_goal": chain.steps[index].goal }),
2677	    )?;
2678	    let id = chain_prefix(&chain.chain_id);
2679	    print!(
2680	        "{}",
2681	        chain_transition_surface(
2682	            paths,
2683	            &chain,
2684	            VerdictKind::Preview,
2685	            "DeadReckon reset a chain step for redo.",
2686	            "The selected step is pending again, so resume is the safest next command.",
2687	            vec![("redo step".to_string(), (index + 1).to_string())],
2688	            format!("deadreckon chain resume {id}"),
2689	            vec![format!("deadreckon chain show {id}")],
2690	        )
2691	        .render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(false))
2692	    );
2693	    Ok(())
2694	}

2718	fn collect_chain_goals(
2719	    args: &[String],
2720	    from_file: Option<PathBuf>,
2721	    from_stdin: bool,
2722	    no_hints: bool,
2723	) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
2724	    let mut goals = Vec::new();
2725	    goals.extend(args.iter().cloned());
2726	    if let Some(path) = from_file {
2727	        goals.extend(parse_goal_lines(&fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(
2728	            |source| {
2729	                CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::Io {
2730	                    path: path.clone(),
2731	                    source,
2732	                })
2733	            },
2734	        )?));
2735	    }
2736	    if from_stdin {
2737	        if io::stdin().is_terminal() {
2738	            return Err(chain_create_refusal_surface(
2739	                VerdictKind::Blocked,
2740	                None,
2741	                "DeadReckon did not read chain steps because --from-stdin needs a pipe.",
2742	                "The command requested stdin input, but stdin is an interactive terminal. DeadReckon refused before reading goals or writing chain state.",
2743	                [
2744	                    ("stdin".to_string(), "terminal".to_string()),
2745	                    ("from-stdin".to_string(), "true".to_string()),
2746	                ],
2747	                "printf 'g1\\ng2\\n' | deadreckon chain --from-stdin --yes".to_string(),
2748	                no_hints,
2749	            ));
2750	        }
2751	        let mut raw = String::new();
2752	        io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
2753	        goals.extend(parse_goal_lines(&raw));
2754	    }
2755	    Ok(goals
2756	        .into_iter()
2757	        .map(|goal| goal.trim().to_string())
2758	        .filter(|goal| !goal.is_empty())
2759	        .collect())
2760	}

2762	fn parse_goal_lines(raw: &str) -> Vec<String> {

2764	        .map(str::trim)
2765	        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty() && !line.starts_with('#'))
2766	        .map(ToString::to_string)
2767	        .collect()
2768	}

2770	fn json_value_kind(value: &Value) -> &'static str {
2771	    match value {
2772	        Value::Null => "null",
2773	        Value::Bool(_) => "boolean",
2774	        Value::Number(_) => "number",
2775	        Value::String(_) => "string",
2776	        Value::Array(_) => "array",
2777	        Value::Object(_) => "object",
2778	    }

2781	fn chain_planner_prompt(goal: &str, n: u8) -> String {
2782	    format!(
2783	        "You are decomposing a coding goal into an ordered serial chain.\n\
2784	Output a JSON array of <= {n} strings, each <= 160 chars, each a concrete next step. \
2785	Each step builds on the previous step's result. No prose, no commentary. Goal: {goal:?}."

2789	fn parse_planner_goals(raw: &str, n: u8, root_goal: &str, no_hints: bool) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
2790	    let raw = raw.trim();
2791	    let json_text = if raw.starts_with("```") {
2792	        raw.lines()
2793	            .filter(|line| !line.trim_start().starts_with("```"))
2794	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
2795	            .join("\n")
2796	    } else {
2797	        raw.to_string()
2798	    };
2799	    let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(json_text.trim()).map_err(|err| {
2800	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
2801	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2802	            None,
2803	            &format!("chain plan returned invalid JSON: {err}"),
2804	            "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because the planner response could not be parsed as the required JSON step list.",
2805	            [
2806	                ("parse error".to_string(), err.to_string()),
2807	                ("response bytes".to_string(), json_text.len().to_string()),
2808	            ],
2809	            chain_plan_retry_command(root_goal),
2810	            no_hints,
2811	        )
2812	    })?;
2813	    let array = value.as_array().ok_or_else(|| {
2814	        chain_create_refusal_surface(
2815	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
2816	            None,
2817	            "chain plan must return a JSON array of strings",
2818	            "DeadReckon refused the provider-produced plan because the planner response had the wrong JSON shape for ordered chain steps.",
2819	            [

2992	fn list_chain_records(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, scope: Option<String>) -> Result<Vec<Chain>> {
2993	    if !paths.chains_dir().exists() {
2994	        return Ok(Vec::new());
2995	    }
2996	    let mut chains = Vec::new();
2997	    for entry in fs::read_dir(paths.chains_dir())? {
2998	        let entry = entry?;
2999	        let path = entry.path().join("chain.json");
3000	        if !path.exists() {
3001	            continue;
3002	        }
3003	        let chain = serde_json::from_slice::<Chain>(&fs::read(&path)?)
3004	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source })?;
3005	        if scope.as_deref().is_some_and(|scope| chain.scope != scope) {
3006	            continue;
3007	        }
3008	        chains.push(chain);
3009	    }
3010	    chains.sort_by(|left, right| right.created_at.cmp(&left.created_at));
3011	    Ok(chains)
3012	}

3014	pub(crate) fn resolve_chain_id(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, id: &str, all: bool) -> Result<String> {
3015	    let scope = if all { None } else { Some(current_scope()?) };
3016	    let chains = list_chain_records(paths, scope.clone())?;
3017	    if matches!(id, "latest" | "last") {
3018	        return chains
3019	            .first()
3020	            .map(|chain| chain.chain_id.clone())
3021	            .ok_or_else(|| chain_missing_scope_surface(scope.as_deref()));
3022	    }
3023	    let matches = chains
3024	        .iter()
3025	        .filter(|chain| chain.chain_id.starts_with(id))
3026	        .map(|chain| chain.chain_id.clone())
3027	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
3028	    match matches.len() {
3029	        1 => Ok(matches[0].clone()),
3030	        0 => Err(chain_id_resolution_surface(
3031	            id,
3032	            &format!("DeadReckon could not resolve the chain because no chain '{id}' was found."),
3033	            "The command needs one concrete chain id, but no chain in the selected scope starts with the requested id.",
3034	            [
3035	                ("requested id".to_string(), id.to_string()),
3036	                (
3037	                    "scope".to_string(),
3038	                    scope.as_deref().unwrap_or("all").to_string(),
3039	                ),
3040	                ("matching chains".to_string(), "0".to_string()),
3041	            ],
3042	            "deadreckon chain list",
3043	        )),
3044	        _ => Err(chain_id_resolution_surface(
3045	            id,
3046	            &format!(
3047	                "DeadReckon could not resolve the chain because chain id prefix {id} is ambiguous."
3048	            ),
3049	            "The command needs one concrete chain id, but the requested prefix matches multiple chains.",
3050	            [
3051	                ("requested prefix".to_string(), id.to_string()),
3052	                (
3053	                    "scope".to_string(),
3054	                    scope.as_deref().unwrap_or("all").to_string(),
3055	                ),
3056	                ("matches".to_string(), matches.join(", ")),
3057	            ],
3058	            "deadreckon chain list --full",
3059	        )),
3060	    }
3061	}

3063	fn chain_id_resolution_surface<K, V>(
3064	    id: &str,

1895	pub(crate) async fn fire_lifecycle_notification(
1896	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,

1899	) {
1900	    let Some(transition) = notify_transition_for_outcome(outcome) else {

1911	        return;

1916	        verdict: notification_verdict(state, outcome),
1917	        spend: run_spend_label(state, false),
1918	        narrative_path: doc_path_for_kind(&state.working_dir, DocKind::Narrative),
1919	    };
1920	    let _attempts = notify_run(state, &config, &context, &channels).await;

1944	fn align_extended_run_with_parent(
1945	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1946	    state: &mut deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1947	    parent: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1948	) -> Result<()> {
1949	    let old_scope = state.scope.clone();
1950	    let old_task_key = state.task_key.clone();
1951	    let old_pointer = paths.current_pointer_path(&old_scope, &old_task_key);
1952	    let desired_root = paths.run_root(&parent.scope, &state.run_id);
1953	    if state.run_root != desired_root {
1954	        if let Some(parent_dir) = desired_root.parent() {
1955	            fs::create_dir_all(parent_dir)?;
1956	        }
1957	        fs::rename(&state.run_root, &desired_root)?;
1958	        state.run_root = desired_root;
1959	        state.working_dir = state.run_root.join("working");
1960	        state.scope = parent.scope.clone();
1961	    }
1962	    state.task_key = parent.task_key.clone();
1963	    state.cwd = parent.cwd.clone();
1964	    state.updated_at = Utc::now();
1965	    let new_pointer = paths.current_pointer_path(&state.scope, &state.task_key);
1966	    if old_pointer != new_pointer {
1967	        remove_if_exists(&old_pointer)?;
1968	    }
1969	    save_state(state)?;
1970	    Ok(())
1971	}

2025	fn parent_summary(parent: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState, context_turns: Option<u32>) -> String {
2026	    let spend = read_jsonl::<SpendRecord>(&parent.run_root.join("spend.jsonl")).unwrap_or_default();
2027	    let traces =
2028	        read_jsonl::<TraceRecord>(&parent.run_root.join("traces.jsonl")).unwrap_or_default();
2029	    let spend_label = if spend.iter().any(|record| record.subscription)
2030	        || parent
2031	            .provider
2032	            .as_deref()
2033	            .is_some_and(|provider| provider.starts_with("cli:"))
2034	    {
2035	        "subscription".to_string()
2036	    } else {
2037	        format!("${:.6}", parent.total_spend_usd)
2038	    };
2039	    let acceptance = if parent.run_root.join("proofs/turn-acceptance.json").exists() {
2040	        "dr-gate accepted"
2041	    } else {
2042	        "not recorded"
2043	    };
2044	    let mut summary = format!(
2045	        "# Previous run summary ({})\n\n**Original goal.** {}\n**Completed.** {}\n**Total turns.** {}\n**Total spend.** {}\n**Acceptance.** {}\n",
2046	        parent.run_id,
2047	        parent.goal,
2048	        parent.updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
2049	        parent.turn,
2050	        spend_label,
2051	        acceptance
2052	    );
2053	    if let Some(max_turns) = context_turns {
2054	        let mut recent = traces
2055	            .iter()
2056	            .filter(|trace| trace.turn > 0)
2057	            .rev()
2058	            .take(max_turns as usize)
2059	            .map(trace_one_liner)
2060	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
2061	        recent.reverse();
2062	        summary.push_str(&format!(
2063	            "\n## Recent activity (last {} turns)\n\n",
2064	            max_turns
2065	        ));
2066	        if recent.is_empty() {
2067	            summary.push_str("- no trace activity recorded\n");
2068	        } else {
2069	            for line in recent {
2070	                summary.push_str(&format!("- {line}\n"));
2071	            }
2072	        }
2073	    }
2074	    summary
2075	}
2076	
2077	fn trace_one_liner(trace: &TraceRecord) -> String {
2078	    let detail = trace
2079	        .detail
2080	        .get("tool_call_id")
2081	        .and_then(Value::as_str)
2082	        .or_else(|| trace.detail.get("summary").and_then(Value::as_str))
2083	        .unwrap_or("");
2084	    if detail.is_empty() {
2085	        format!("turn {}: {}", trace.turn, trace.event)
2086	    } else {
2087	        format!(
2088	            "turn {}: {} {}",
2089	            trace.turn,
2090	            trace.event,
2091	            one_line(detail, 90)
2092	        )
2093	    }
2094	}

2107	fn incomplete_run_required_surface(
2108	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
2109	    verb: &str,
2110	) -> VerdictSurface {
2111	    let id = run_prefix(&state.run_id);
2112	    let primary = format!("deadreckon resume {id}");
2113	    let secondary = format!("deadreckon show {id}");
2114	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
2115	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
2116	        verb,
2117	        Some(&id),
2118	        ExplanationPanel::new(
2119	            format!("{verb} requires a completed run, but run {id} is {}.", state.status),
2120	            "This command needs stable completed artifacts; an incomplete run may still change if it is resumed.",
2121	            vec![
2122	                ("run".to_string(), id.clone()),
2123	                ("status".to_string(), state.status.to_string()),
2124	                ("state".to_string(), state.state_path().display().to_string()),
2125	            ],
2126	        ),
2127	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
2128	        vec![("Secondary", secondary.as_str())],
2129	    )
2130	    .expect("incomplete run requirement verdict surface must be valid")
2131	}
