66	        return Err(plan_refusal_error(
67	            "--goal must be non-empty",
68	            "DeadReckon did not create a plan because the plan command needs a non-empty goal.",
69	            "Planning without a goal would create misleading orchestration state, so DeadReckon refused before writing any plan files.",
70	            vec![
71	                ("command".to_string(), "plan".to_string()),
72	                ("goal".to_string(), "empty".to_string()),
73	            ],
74	            "deadreckon plan \"your goal\"".to_string(),
75	            Vec::new(),
76	            no_hints,
77	            json_output,
78	        ));
79	    }
80	    validate_plan_task_count(&goal, n, no_hints, json_output)?;
81	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
82	    let defaults = config_defaults(&paths)?;
83	    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
84	    let scope = workspace_scope(&cwd)?;
85	    let plan_cwd = cwd.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| cwd.clone());
86	    let plan_mode = match mode {
87	        CliPlanMode::FullPlan => PlanMode::FullPlan,
88	        CliPlanMode::Review => PlanMode::Review,
89	    };
90	    let mut providers = resolve_plan_providers(
91	        &paths,
92	        &defaults,
93	        plan_mode,
94	        planner_provider,
95	        provider,
96	        coder_provider,
97	        reviewer_provider,
98	    )?;
99	    let acceptance_provider = match plan_mode {
100	        PlanMode::FullPlan => providers
101	            .planner
102	            .clone()
103	            .or_else(|| providers.default_child.clone()),
104	        PlanMode::Review => providers
105	            .coder
106	            .clone()
107	            .or_else(|| providers.reviewer.clone())
108	            .or_else(|| providers.default_child.clone()),
109	    };
110	    let acceptance_source = commands::acceptance::ensure_acceptance_before_start(
111	        &cwd,
112	        acceptance.as_deref(),
113	        &goal,
114	        acceptance_provider,
115	        None,
116	        skip_acceptance_prompt || quiet,
117	        "orchestration",
118	    )
119	    .await?;
120	    let mut tasks = match plan_mode {
121	        PlanMode::FullPlan => {
122	            let overrides = parse_child_provider_overrides(&child_provider, n)?;
123	            providers.children = overrides.clone();
124	            build_full_plan_tasks(
125	                &paths,
126	                &goal,
127	                n,
128	                &providers,
129	                &overrides,
130	                &cwd,
131	                plain,
132	                no_hints,
133	                json_output,
134	            )
135	            .await?
136	        }
137	        PlanMode::Review => build_review_plan_tasks(&goal, &providers),
138	    };
139	    for task in &mut tasks {
140	        task.worker_spec = deadreckon_core::worker_spec_relative_path(&task.task_id);
141	    }
142	    let mut plan = Plan::new(
143	        goal,
144	        plan_mode,
145	        tasks,
146	        providers,
147	        Some(scope),
148	        env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
149	    )
150	    .map_err(CliError::Core)?;
151	    plan.parent_cwd = Some(plan_cwd);
152	    plan.acceptance_path = acceptance_source.as_ref().map(|source| source.path.clone());
153	    plan.capability_preview = infer_capability_preview(&plan.root_goal);
154	    for task in &plan.tasks {
155	        let spec = render_worker_spec(&plan, task);
156	        write_worker_spec(&paths, &plan.plan_id, &task.task_id, &spec)?;
157	    }
158	    save_plan(&paths, &plan)?;
159	    append_plan_event(
160	        &paths,
161	        &plan.plan_id,
162	        PlanEventKind::PlanCreated {
163	            mode: plan.mode,
164	            task_count: plan.tasks.len(),
165	        },
166	    )?;
167	    Ok(plan)
168	}
169	
170	pub(crate) fn resolve_plan_providers(
171	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
172	    defaults: &ConfigDefaults,
173	    mode: PlanMode,
174	    planner_provider: Option<String>,
175	    provider: Option<String>,
176	    coder_provider: Option<String>,
177	    reviewer_provider: Option<String>,
178	) -> Result<PlanProviders> {
179	    let default_child = resolve_provider_name(
180	        paths,
181	        setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::DefaultChild,
182	        provider.or(defaults.provider.clone()),
183	    )?;
184	    let planner = match mode {
185	        PlanMode::FullPlan => resolve_provider_name(
186	            paths,
187	            setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Planner,
188	            planner_provider
189	                .or(default_child.clone())
190	                .or(defaults.provider.clone()),
191	        )?,
192	        PlanMode::Review => None,
193	    };
194	    let coder = match mode {
195	        PlanMode::Review => resolve_provider_name(
196	            paths,
197	            setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Coder,
198	            coder_provider
199	                .or(default_child.clone())
200	                .or(defaults.provider.clone()),
201	        )?,
202	        PlanMode::FullPlan => None,
203	    };
204	    let reviewer = match mode {
205	        PlanMode::Review => resolve_provider_name(
206	            paths,
207	            setup::SetupProviderRoleRef::Reviewer,
208	            reviewer_provider
209	                .or(default_child.clone())
210	                .or(defaults.provider.clone()),
211	        )?,
212	        PlanMode::FullPlan => None,
213	    };
214	    Ok(PlanProviders {
215	        planner,
216	        default_child,
217	        coder,
218	        reviewer,
219	        children: BTreeMap::new(),
220	    })
221	}
222	
223	pub(crate) fn resolve_provider_name(
224	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
225	    role: setup::SetupProviderRoleRef,
226	    provider: Option<String>,
227	) -> Result<Option<String>> {
228	    if provider
229	        .as_deref()
230	        .is_some_and(|provider| provider == "smoke" || provider.starts_with("smoke:"))
231	    {
232	        return Ok(provider);
233	    }
234	    let selection = provider_setup_selection(
235	        paths,
236	        setup::ProviderSetupRequest {
237	            role,
238	            explicit_provider: provider.as_deref(),
239	            explicit_model: None,
240	            config_default_provider: None,
241	            config_doc_provider: None,
242	            run_provider: None,
243	            auto_subscription_provider: None,
244	            built_in_default_provider: None,
245	            use_router_default: true,
246	            allow_auto_subscription: false,
247	            require_usable_route: false,
248	        },
249	    )?;
250	    Ok(selection.provider.or(provider))
251	}
252	
253	pub(crate) fn parse_child_provider_overrides(
254	    values: &[String],
255	    n: u8,
256	) -> Result<BTreeMap<u32, String>> {
257	    let mut overrides = BTreeMap::new();
258	    for value in values {
259	        let Some((idx, provider)) = value.split_once('=') else {
260	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
261	                &format!("child provider override must be IDX=PROVIDER: {value}"),
262	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
263	            )));
264	        };
265	        let index = idx.trim().parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| {
266	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
267	                &format!("child provider index is not a number: {idx}"),
268	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
269	            ))
270	        })?;
271	        if index >= u32::from(n) {
272	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
273	                &format!("child provider index {index} outside 0..{n}"),
274	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
275	            )));
276	        }
277	        let provider = provider.trim();
278	        if provider.is_empty() {
279	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
280	                "child provider must be non-empty",
281	                "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
282	            )));
283	        }
284	        overrides.insert(index, provider.to_string());
285	    }
286	    Ok(overrides)
287	}
288	
289	pub(crate) async fn build_full_plan_tasks(
290	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
291	    goal: &str,
292	    n: u8,
293	    providers: &PlanProviders,
294	    overrides: &BTreeMap<u32, String>,
295	    cwd: &Path,
296	    plain: bool,
297	    no_hints: bool,
298	    json_output: bool,
299	) -> Result<Vec<PlanTask>> {
300	    let drafts = if providers
301	        .planner
302	        .as_deref()
303	        .is_some_and(|provider| provider == "smoke" || provider.starts_with("smoke:"))
304	    {
305	        deterministic_plan_drafts(goal, n)
306	    } else {
307	        provider_plan_drafts(paths, goal, n, providers.planner.as_deref(), cwd, plain).await?
308	    };
309	    if drafts.len() != usize::from(n) {
310	        return Err(plan_refusal_error(
311	            &format!("provider returned {} children; need {n}", drafts.len()),
312	            "DeadReckon did not save the plan because the planner returned the wrong number of child tasks.",
313	            "The requested child count is part of the orchestration contract; saving a partial graph would make later fork/merge state misleading.",
314	            vec![
315	                ("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string()),
316	                ("returned children".to_string(), drafts.len().to_string()),
317	                (
318	                    "planner".to_string(),
319	                    providers
320	                        .planner
321	                        .as_deref()
322	                        .unwrap_or("default planner")
323	                        .to_string(),
324	                ),
325	            ],
326	            "deadreckon plan ... --provider <other>".to_string(),
327	            vec!["deadreckon providers list --all".to_string()],
328	            no_hints,
329	            json_output,
330	        ));
331	    }
332	    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
333	    for (index, draft) in drafts.into_iter().enumerate() {
334	        let index = index as u32;
335	        let provider = overrides
336	            .get(&index)
337	            .cloned()
338	            .or_else(|| providers.default_child.clone());
339	        let mut task = PlanTask::new(index, draft.subject, draft.goal, PlanRole::Child, provider);
340	        task.active_form = draft.active_form.unwrap_or_else(|| task.subject.clone());
341	        task.depends_on = draft.depends_on;
342	        tasks.push(task);
343	    }
344	    Ok(tasks)
345	}
346	
347	fn validate_plan_task_count(goal: &str, n: u8, no_hints: bool, json_output: bool) -> Result<()> {
348	    match usize::from(n) {
349	        0 | 1 => Err(plan_refusal_error(
350	            "plan must have >= 2 children",
351	            "DeadReckon did not create a plan because the requested child count is too small.",
352	            "A full plan needs at least two child tasks; for one task, a direct run is the truthful execution shape.",
353	            vec![("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string())],
354	            "deadreckon run \"<the only child>\"".to_string(),
355	            vec![format!(
356	                "deadreckon plan {} --n 2",
357	                plan_goal_argument(goal)
358	            )],
359	            no_hints,
360	            json_output,
361	        )),
362	        2..=6 => Ok(()),
363	        count => Err(plan_refusal_error(
364	            &format!("plan capped at 6 children; got {count}"),
365	            "DeadReckon did not create a plan because the requested child count is above the full-plan cap.",
366	            "Full-plan orchestration is capped at six parallel children; a sequential chain is the safer shape for larger decompositions.",
367	            vec![("requested children".to_string(), n.to_string())],
368	            format!("deadreckon chain plan {} --n {n}", plan_goal_argument(goal)),
369	            vec![format!(
370	                "deadreckon plan {} --n 6",
371	                plan_goal_argument(goal)
372	            )],
373	            no_hints,
374	            json_output,
375	        )),
376	    }
377	}
378	
379	fn plan_refusal_error(
380	    message: impl Into<String>,
381	    what_happened: impl Into<String>,
382	    why_this_verdict: impl Into<String>,
383	    evidence: Vec<(String, String)>,
384	    primary: String,
385	    secondary: Vec<String>,
386	    no_hints: bool,
387	    json_output: bool,
388	) -> CliError {
389	    let message = message.into();
390	    let mut all_evidence = vec![("reason".to_string(), message)];
391	    all_evidence.extend(evidence);
392	    let secondary = secondary
393	        .iter()
394	        .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
395	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
396	    let surface = VerdictSurface::try_new(
397	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
398	        "plan",
399	        None,
400	        ExplanationPanel::new(what_happened, why_this_verdict, all_evidence),
401	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
402	        secondary,
403	    )
404	    .expect("plan refusal verdict surface must be valid");
405	    let rendered = if json_output {
406	        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&surface.add_to_json(json!({
407	            "kind": "plan_refusal",
408	            "error": surface.explanation.evidence[0].1.clone(),
409	            "next_actions": [surface.primary_action.command.clone()],
410	        })))
411	        .expect("plan refusal verdict json must serialize")
412	    } else {
413	        surface.render_plain(!completion_hints_enabled(no_hints))
414	    };
415	    CliError::Surface {
416	        code: 1,
417	        surface: rendered,
418	    }
419	}

425	fn build_review_plan_tasks(goal: &str, providers: &PlanProviders) -> Vec<PlanTask> {
426	    let mut coder = PlanTask::new(
427	        0,
428	        "Implement requested change",
429	        goal,
430	        PlanRole::Coder,
431	        providers.coder.clone(),
432	    );
433	    coder.active_form = "Coding implementation".to_string();
434	    let mut reviewer = PlanTask::new(
435	        1,
436	        "Review and fix implementation",
437	        format!(
438	            "Review the completed implementation for: {goal}. Write .deadreckon/REVIEW.md first, then apply only fixes tied to findings and acceptance."
439	        ),
440	        PlanRole::Reviewer,
441	        providers.reviewer.clone(),
442	    );
443	    reviewer.active_form = "Reviewing implementation".to_string();
444	    reviewer.depends_on = vec![coder.task_id.clone()];
445	    vec![coder, reviewer]
446	}

448	#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
449	struct PlannerDraft {
450	    subject: String,
451	    goal: String,
452	    #[serde(default)]
453	    active_form: Option<String>,
454	    #[serde(default)]
455	    depends_on: Vec<String>,

463	async fn provider_plan_drafts(
464	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
465	    goal: &str,
466	    n: u8,
467	    planner_provider: Option<&str>,
468	    cwd: &Path,
469	    plain: bool,
470	) -> Result<Vec<PlannerDraft>> {
471	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), planner_provider)?;
472	    let prompt = planner_prompt(goal, n);
473	    let request = ProviderRequest {
474	        prompt,
475	        max_output_tokens: 4096,
476	        cwd: Some(cwd.to_path_buf()),
477	        output_path: None,
478	        sandbox_backend: None,
479	        pid_file: None,
480	        cancellation_token: None,
481	    };
482	    let response =
483	        maybe_with_cli_wait_status(!plain, "planning child graph", router.complete(&request))
484	            .await?;
485	    parse_planner_response(&response.content)
486	}
487	
488	fn planner_prompt(goal: &str, n: u8) -> String {
489	    format!(
490	        "You are a read-only planning agent for deadreckon. Do not write files, create temporary files, install packages, commit, delete, move, or mutate state. Inspect only if your provider supports read-only tools.\n\nReturn JSON only. Shape: {{\"tasks\":[{{\"subject\":\"imperative label\",\"goal\":\"self-contained child goal\",\"active_form\":\"present-progress text\",\"depends_on\":[\"task-0\"]}}]}}. Return exactly {n} child entries in the tasks array. Dependencies must refer to earlier child ids task-0..task-{} and form a DAG.\n\nChild hygiene:\n- Prefer child ids in execution order; earlier children should unblock later children.\n- For build/product goals, child goals must be implementation or verification slices that create or edit project files and move toward runnable behavior.\n- Do not return research-only, sourcing-only, architecture-only, or roadmap-only children unless the user explicitly asked for planning or research documentation.\n- Split independent implementation work into separate children; use research only as a dependency that directly unblocks concrete implementation.\n- Give each child enough context to run without seeing the user conversation, including likely files/modules/features and acceptance checks.\n- Never write \"based on the other worker\"; include the concrete dependency output the child will need.\n\nGoal: {goal}",
491	        n.saturating_sub(1)
492	    )
493	}
494	
495	fn parse_planner_response(content: &str) -> Result<Vec<PlannerDraft>> {
496	    if let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(content) {
497	        return Ok(object.tasks);
498	    }
499	    if let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(content) {
500	        return Ok(tasks);
501	    }
502	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '{', '}')
503	        && let Ok(object) = serde_json::from_str::<PlannerObjectDraft>(slice)
504	    {
505	        return Ok(object.tasks);
506	    }
507	    if let Some(slice) = json_slice(content, '[', ']')
508	        && let Ok(tasks) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<PlannerDraft>>(slice)
509	    {
510	        return Ok(tasks);
511	    }
512	    Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
513	        "planner provider did not return a valid child JSON object",
514	        "deadreckon plan ... --planner-provider <other>",
515	    )))
516	}
517	
518	pub(crate) fn json_slice(content: &str, open: char, close: char) -> Option<&str> {
519	    let start = content.find(open)?;
520	    let end = content.rfind(close)?;
521	    (end >= start).then_some(&content[start..=end])
522	}

524	fn deterministic_plan_drafts(goal: &str, n: u8) -> Vec<PlannerDraft> {
525	    (0..n)
526	        .map(|index| PlannerDraft {
527	            subject: match index {
528	                0 => "Create foundation".to_string(),
529	                1 => "Add behavior".to_string(),
530	                _ => format!("Complete slice {}", index + 1),
531	            },
532	            goal: format!("{goal} (child {} of {n})", index + 1),
533	            active_form: Some(match index {
534	                0 => "Creating foundation".to_string(),
535	                1 => "Adding behavior".to_string(),
536	                _ => format!("Completing slice {}", index + 1),
537	            }),
538	            depends_on: Vec::new(),
539	        })
540	        .collect()
541	}

543	fn infer_capability_preview(goal: &str) -> deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
544	    let lower = goal.to_ascii_lowercase();
545	    let deploy = ["deploy", "vercel", "netlify", "production"]
546	        .iter()
547	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
548	    let global_install = ["install globally", "global install", "npm -g"]
549	        .iter()
550	        .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
551	    let networked = [
552	        "api",
553	        "websocket",
554	        "web socket",
555	        "multiplayer",
556	        "online",
557	        "networked",
558	        "real-time",
559	        "real time",
560	        "realtime",
561	        "live",
562	        "server",
563	        "client/server",
564	        "asset source",
565	        "asset sourcing",
566	        "terrain data",
567	        "mapbox",
568	        "cesium",
569	    ]
570	    .iter()
571	    .any(|needle| lower.contains(needle));
572	    let network = if deploy || networked {
573	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Allowlist
574	    } else {
575	        deadreckon_core::NetworkCapability::Deny
576	    };
577	    let mut notes = Vec::new();
578	    if deploy {
579	        notes.push(
580	            "goal mentions deployment; require explicit capability before deploy".to_string(),
581	        );
582	    }
583	    if global_install {
584	        notes.push("goal mentions global install; require explicit capability".to_string());
585	    }
586	    deadreckon_core::CapabilityPreview {
587	        network,
588	        deploy,
589	        global_install,
590	        filesystem: vec!["working directory".to_string()],
591	        notes,
592	    }
593	}
594	
595	fn render_worker_spec(plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
596	    let dependencies = if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
597	        "none".to_string()
598	    } else {
599	        task.depends_on.join(", ")
600	    };
601	    let acceptance_line = plan
602	        .acceptance_path
603	        .as_ref()
604	        .map(|path| {
605	            format!(
606	                "- dr-gate will enforce configured done criteria from {}.",
607	                path.display()
608	            )
609	        })
610	        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
611	            "- dr-gate will use the default local gate if no project done criteria exist."
612	                .to_string()
613	        });
614	    format!(
615	        "# deadreckon worker spec: {}\n\nRoot goal: {}\nChild id: {}\nRole: {:?}\nProvider: {}\nDependencies satisfied before start: {}\n\n## Scope\n{}\n\n## Capability constraints\n- network: {:?}\n- deploy: {}\n- global install: {}\n- filesystem: {}\n\n## Coordination rules\n- Treat this file as the complete brief; do not assume access to the parent conversation.\n- Do not inspect, tail, or summarize sibling child transcripts; wait for dependency summaries included below.\n- If correcting your own failed check, keep the same context and fix the root cause.\n- If acting as reviewer, approach the artifact with fresh assumptions and verify independently.\n- Report blockers as concrete file paths, command output, or acceptance failures.\n\n## Done criteria\n{}\n- Stay within this child's scope.\n- Verify relevant behavior before reporting done.\n- Do not spawn subagents or orchestrate more children.\n- Do not editorialize between tool calls.\n- Report scope, result, key files, files changed, and issues.\n",
616	        task.subject,
617	        plan.root_goal,
618	        task.task_id,
619	        task.role,
620	        task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("config default"),
621	        dependencies,
622	        task.goal,
623	        plan.capability_preview.network,
624	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
625	        plan.capability_preview.global_install,
626	        plan.capability_preview.filesystem.join(", "),
627	        acceptance_line
628	    )
629	}
630	
631	fn render_launch_worker_spec(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, task: &PlanTask) -> String {
632	    let mut spec = render_worker_spec(plan, task);
633	    let dependency_summaries = task
634	        .depends_on
635	        .iter()
636	        .filter_map(|dependency| plan.task_by_id(dependency))
637	        .filter_map(|dependency| {
638	            let summary_path = dependency.summary_path.as_ref()?;
639	            let absolute = paths.plan_dir(&plan.plan_id).join(summary_path);
640	            let raw = fs::read_to_string(&absolute).ok()?;
641	            Some((dependency, absolute, truncate_for_worker_spec(&raw)))
642	        })
643	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
644	    if dependency_summaries.is_empty() {
645	        return spec;
646	    }
647	    spec.push_str("\n## Dependency summaries\n");
648	    for (dependency, absolute, summary) in dependency_summaries {
649	        spec.push_str(&format!(
650	            "\n### {} - {}\n\nSummary path: {}\n\n{}\n",
651	            dependency.task_id,
652	            dependency.subject,
653	            absolute.display(),
654	            summary.trim()
655	        ));
656	    }
657	    spec
658	}
659	
660	fn truncate_for_worker_spec(raw: &str) -> String {
661	    const MAX_CHARS: usize = 4_000;
662	    let mut chars = raw.chars();
663	    let truncated = chars.by_ref().take(MAX_CHARS).collect::<String>();
664	    if chars.next().is_some() {
665	        format!("{truncated}\n\n... truncated ...")
666	    } else {
667	        truncated
668	    }
669	}

671	fn plan_source_label(plan: &Plan) -> String {
672	    let Some(cwd) = plan.parent_cwd.as_ref() else {
673	        return "current directory at fork time".to_string();
674	    };
675	    let git_label = match preview_git_state(cwd) {
676	        Ok(Some(git)) => format!("git branch={} @ {}", git.branch, git.head_sha),
677	        _ => "not git; child runs use copy mode".to_string(),
678	    };
679	    format!("{} ({git_label})", cwd.display())
680	}

682	fn plan_acceptance_label(plan: &Plan) -> String {
683	    let Some(path) = plan.acceptance_path.as_ref() else {
684	        return setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::default_gate().full_label();
685	    };
686	    let checks = fs::read_to_string(path)
687	        .ok()
688	        .and_then(|raw| commands::acceptance::acceptance_check_count(&raw).ok());
689	    setup::DoneCriteriaSelection::project(path.clone(), None, checks).full_label()
690	}

692	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
693	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
694	    match plan.status {
695	        PlanStatus::Pending => vec![format!("deadreckon fork {id}")],
696	        PlanStatus::Forked => {
697	            if plan
698	                .tasks
699	                .iter()
700	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
701	            {
702	                vec![format!("deadreckon merge {id}")]
703	            } else {
704	                vec![format!("deadreckon attach {id}")]
705	            }
706	        }
707	        PlanStatus::Merged => vec![format!("deadreckon finish {id}")],
708	        PlanStatus::Failed => vec![format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")],
709	    }
710	}
711	
712	pub(crate) fn plan_next_actions_with_context(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
713	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
714	    match plan.status {
715	        PlanStatus::Failed if plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan) => vec![
716	            format!("deadreckon merge {id}"),
717	            format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed"),
718	        ],
719	        _ => plan_next_actions(plan),
720	    }
721	}

723	pub(crate) fn plan_verdict_surface(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> VerdictSurface {
724	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
725	    let completed = plan
726	        .tasks
727	        .iter()
728	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
729	        .count();
730	    let total = plan.tasks.len();
731	    let repairable = plan_has_repair_evidence(paths, plan);
732	    let (kind, what, why) = match plan.status {
733	        PlanStatus::Pending => (
734	            VerdictKind::Preview,
735	            "DeadReckon wrote the plan graph, but no child run has started yet.",
736	            "This is a pre-fork plan state; forking is the one command that advances it.",
737	        ),
738	        PlanStatus::Forked
739	            if plan
740	                .tasks
741	                .iter()
742	                .all(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed) =>
743	        {
744	            (
745	                VerdictKind::Completed,
746	                "All child runs completed and the plan is ready to merge.",
747	                "The next state-changing command composes the child artifacts into one result.",
748	            )
749	        }
750	        PlanStatus::Forked => (
751	            VerdictKind::Paused,
752	            "The plan has launched child work and is not merged yet.",
753	            "Attaching is the safest next command because the plan still has active or pending child state.",
754	        ),
755	        PlanStatus::Merged => (
756	            VerdictKind::Completed,
757	            "The plan merged its child results into a promoted result run.",
758	            "DeadReckon has a merged artifact; the recommended command lands or exports that result.",
759	        ),
760	        PlanStatus::Failed if repairable => (
761	            VerdictKind::Failed,
762	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
763	            "Merge-repair evidence exists, so rerunning merge is the safest recovery path before inspection-only commands.",
764	        ),
765	        PlanStatus::Failed => (
766	            VerdictKind::Failed,
767	            "The plan stopped before producing a merged result.",
768	            "No repair evidence is available, so the why-failed view is the safest next inspection command.",
769	        ),
770	    };
771	    let mut evidence = vec![
772	        ("plan".to_string(), id.clone()),
773	        (
774	            "status".to_string(),
775	            plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string(),
776	        ),
777	        (
778	            "tasks".to_string(),
779	            format!("{completed}/{total} completed"),
780	        ),
781	        (
782	            "events".to_string(),
783	            paths.plan_events(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
784	        ),
785	    ];
786	    if let Some(merged_run_id) = plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
787	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(merged_run_id)));
788	    }
789	    if repairable {
790	        evidence.push((
791	            "repair evidence".to_string(),
792	            paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id).display().to_string(),
793	        ));
794	    }
795	    let primary = plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan)
796	        .into_iter()
797	        .next()
798	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}"));
799	    let secondary = plan_secondary_actions(paths, plan, &primary);
800	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
801	        kind,
802	        "plan",
803	        Some(&id),
804	        ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
805	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
806	        secondary
807	            .iter()
808	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str()))
809	            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
810	    )
811	    .expect("plan verdict surface must have one primary action")
812	}
813	
814	fn plan_secondary_actions(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan, primary: &str) -> Vec<String> {
815	    let id = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
816	    let mut actions = Vec::new();
817	    for command in plan_next_actions_with_context(paths, plan) {
818	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
819	            actions.push(command);
820	        }
821	    }
822	    let inspection = if plan.status == PlanStatus::Failed {
823	        format!("deadreckon show {id} --why-failed")
824	    } else {
825	        format!("deadreckon show {id}")
826	    };
827	    for command in [format!("deadreckon attach {id}"), inspection] {
828	        if command != primary && !actions.contains(&command) {
829	            actions.push(command);
830	        }
831	    }
832	    actions
833	}

835	fn plan_has_repair_evidence(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> bool {
836	    let proofs = paths.merge_proofs(&plan.plan_id);
837	    [
838	        "conflicts.json",
839	        "repair-request.json",
840	        "repair-plan.json",
841	        "repair-run.json",
842	    ]
843	    .iter()
844	    .any(|name| proofs.join(name).is_file())
845	}

866	    }));

868	    Ok(())

889	pub(crate) fn orchestration_provider_role_rows(
890	    plan: &Plan,
891	    repair_enabled: bool,
892	    repair_provider: Option<&str>,
893	) -> Vec<OrchestrationRoleRow> {
894	    let mut rows = Vec::new();
895	    match plan.mode {
896	        PlanMode::FullPlan => {
897	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
898	                "planner",
899	                plan.providers.planner.as_deref(),
900	                "plan",
901	                "writes child graph",
902	            ));
903	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
904	                "default child",
905	                plan.providers.default_child.as_deref(),
906	                "plan",
907	                "runs ready children",
908	            ));
909	            let mut seen_overrides = BTreeSet::new();
910	            for (index, route) in &plan.providers.children {
911	                seen_overrides.insert(*index);
912	                rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
913	                    format!("child task-{index}"),
914	                    Some(route.as_str()),
915	                    "override",
916	                    "per-child route",
917	                ));
918	            }
919	            for task in &plan.tasks {
920	                let default_route = plan.providers.default_child.as_deref();
921	                if task.provider.as_deref().is_some()
922	                    && task.provider.as_deref() != default_route
923	                    && !seen_overrides.contains(&task.index)
924	                {
925	                    rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
926	                        format!("child {}", task.task_id),
927	                        task.provider.as_deref(),
928	                        "task",
929	                        one_line(&task.subject, 30),
930	                    ));
931	                }
932	            }
933	        }
934	        PlanMode::Review => {
935	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
936	                "coder",
937	                plan.providers.coder.as_deref(),
938	                "plan",
939	                "implementation pass",
940	            ));
941	            rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
942	                "reviewer",
943	                plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref(),
944	                "plan",
945	                "independent review",
946	            ));
947	        }
948	    }
949	    if repair_enabled {
950	        let derived = repair_provider
951	            .or(plan.providers.planner.as_deref())
952	            .or(plan.providers.default_child.as_deref())
953	            .or(plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref())
954	            .or(plan.providers.coder.as_deref());
955	        rows.push(orchestration_role_row(
956	            "repair",
957	            derived,
958	            if repair_provider.is_some() {
959	                "flag"
960	            } else {
961	                "derived"
962	            },
963	            "merge repair planning",
964	        ));
965	    } else {
966	        rows.push(OrchestrationRoleRow {
967	            role: "repair".to_string(),
968	            route: "disabled".to_string(),
969	            model: "-".to_string(),
970	            source: "--no-repair".to_string(),
971	            notes: "raw conflict refusal".to_string(),
972	        });
973	    }
974	    rows
975	}

1025	pub(crate) fn orchestration_dependency_rows(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<OrchestrationDependencyRow> {
1026	    let completed = plan
1027	        .tasks
1028	        .iter()
1029	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1030	        .map(|task| task.task_id.as_str())
1031	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1032	    plan.tasks
1033	        .iter()
1034	        .map(|task| {
1035	            let blockers = task
1036	                .depends_on
1037	                .iter()
1038	                .filter(|dependency| !completed.contains(dependency.as_str()))
1039	                .cloned()
1040	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1041	            let starts = match task.status {
1042	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending if blockers.is_empty() => "now".to_string(),
1043	                PlanTaskStatus::Pending => format!("after {}", blockers.join(",")),
1044	                PlanTaskStatus::Running => "already running".to_string(),
1045	                PlanTaskStatus::Completed => "done".to_string(),
1046	                PlanTaskStatus::Failed => "failed".to_string(),
1047	                PlanTaskStatus::Killed => "killed".to_string(),
1048	            };
1049	            let unblocks = plan
1050	                .tasks
1051	                .iter()
1052	                .filter(|candidate| candidate.depends_on.iter().any(|dep| dep == &task.task_id))
1053	                .map(|candidate| candidate.task_id.clone())
1054	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1055	            OrchestrationDependencyRow {
1056	                child: task.task_id.clone(),
1057	                status: task_status_label(task.status).to_string(),
1058	                starts,
1059	                waits_for: if blockers.is_empty() {
1060	                    "-".to_string()
1061	                } else {
1062	                    blockers.join(",")
1063	                },
1064	                unblocks: if unblocks.is_empty() {
1065	                    "-".to_string()
1066	                } else {
1067	                    unblocks.join(",")
1068	                },
1069	            }
1070	        })
1071	        .collect()
1072	}

1074	pub(crate) fn orchestration_parallelism_lines(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {
1075	    let rows = orchestration_dependency_rows(plan);
1076	    let starts_now = rows
1077	        .iter()
1078	        .filter(|row| row.starts == "now")
1079	        .map(|row| row.child.clone())
1080	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1081	    let waits = rows
1082	        .iter()
1083	        .filter(|row| row.waits_for != "-")
1084	        .map(|row| format!("{} after {}", row.child, row.waits_for))
1085	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1086	    vec![
1087	        format!(
1088	            "starts now: {}",
1089	            if starts_now.is_empty() {
1090	                "-".to_string()
1091	            } else {
1092	                starts_now.join(", ")
1093	            }
1094	        ),
1095	        format!(
1096	            "waits: {}",
1097	            if waits.is_empty() {
1098	                "-".to_string()
1099	            } else {
1100	                waits.join("; ")
1101	            }
1102	        ),
1103	    ]
1104	}

1124	fn print_plan_created(plan: &Plan, no_hints: bool) {
1125	    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::discover();
1126	    println!(
1127	        "{}",

1129	    );
1130	    let ready = plan.ready_pending_task_indices().len();

1132	        .tasks

1134	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Pending)
1135	        .count();
1136	    let blocked = pending.saturating_sub(ready);
1137	    let children = format!(

1148	        ),

1150	            "coder={} reviewer={}",
1151	            plan.providers.coder.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1152	            plan.providers.reviewer.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
1153	        ),
1154	    };
1155	    let capabilities = format!(
1156	        "network={:?} deploy={} install={}",
1157	        plan.capability_preview.network,
1158	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
1159	        plan.capability_preview.global_install
1160	    );
1161	    let source = plan_source_label(plan);
1162	    let gate = plan_acceptance_label(plan);
1163	    let plan_path = paths.plan_json(&plan.plan_id);
1164	    let plan_path_display = plan_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
1165	    let items = [
1166	        ("status", plan_status_label(plan.status)),
1167	        ("mode", plan_mode_label(plan.mode)),
1168	        ("children", children.as_str()),
1169	        ("providers", providers.as_str()),
1170	        ("source", source.as_str()),
1171	        (NOUN_DONE_CONTRACT, gate.as_str()),
1172	        ("capabilities", capabilities.as_str()),
1173	        ("plan", plan_path_display.as_str()),
1174	    ];
1175	    print_kv_block(&items);
1176	    print_orchestration_role_table(plan, true, None);
1177	    print_orchestration_dependency_summary(plan);
1178	    for task in &plan.tasks {

1180	            "-".to_string()
1181	        } else {
1182	            task.depends_on.join(",")
1183	        };
1184	        println!(
1185	            "  {} {} [{}] provider={} deps={}",
1186	            ui_id(&task.task_id),
1187	            task.subject,
1188	            format!("{:?}", task.role).to_ascii_lowercase(),
1189	            task.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
1190	            deps

1195	pub(crate) fn print_orchestrate_preflight(
1196	    plan: &Plan,
1197	    max_spend: Option<f64>,
1198	    max_wall_seconds: Option<f64>,
1199	    sandbox: Option<&str>,
1200	    no_repair: bool,
1201	) {
1202	    println!(
1203	        "{} {} ({})",
1204	        ui_heading("orchestrate preflight"),
1205	        ui_id(run_prefix(&plan.plan_id)),
1206	        plan.plan_id
1207	    );
1208	    let children = format!(
1209	        "{} ({})",
1210	        plan.tasks.len(),
1211	        orchestration_mode_summary(plan)
1212	    );
1213	    let spend = max_spend
1214	        .map(|value| format!("${value:.2} per child"))
1215	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "config default".to_string());
1216	    let wall = max_wall_seconds
1217	        .map(|value| format!("{value:.0}s per child"))
1218	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "config default".to_string());
1219	    let sandbox = sandbox.unwrap_or("config default").to_string();
1220	    let capabilities = format!(
1221	        "network={:?} deploy={} install={}",
1222	        plan.capability_preview.network,
1223	        plan.capability_preview.deploy,
1224	        plan.capability_preview.global_install
1225	    );
1226	    let providers = plan_provider_summary(plan);
1227	    let source = plan_source_label(plan);
1228	    let gate = plan_acceptance_label(plan);
1229	    let repair = plan_repair_label(plan, no_repair);
1230	    let plan_ref = run_prefix(&plan.plan_id);
1231	    let path = orchestration_path_label(plan.mode);
1232	    let launch_rows = launch_preview_rows(&LaunchPreviewFacts {
1233	        goal: &plan.root_goal,
1234	        path,
1235	        suggestion: None,
1236	        provider: &providers,
1237	        roles: None,
1238	        base: None,
1239	        history: None,
1240	        done: &gate,
1241	        workspace: &source,
1242	        watch: format!("deadreckon attach {plan_ref}"),
1243	        stop: format!("deadreckon kill {plan_ref}"),
1244	        finish: format!("deadreckon finish {plan_ref}"),
1245	        override_command: Some("deadreckon start <goal> --mode run".to_string()),
1246	    });
1247	    let mut items = vec![
1248	        ("goal".to_string(), plan.root_goal.clone()),
1249	        ("path".to_string(), path.to_string()),
1250	        ("mode".to_string(), plan_mode_label(plan.mode).to_string()),
1251	        ("children".to_string(), children),

1371	pub(crate) fn implementation_plan_warnings(plan: &Plan) -> Vec<String> {

1406	        "roadmap",
1407	        "document",
1408	        "decision record",

1415	        "create",
1416	        "add",
1417	        "wire",
1418	        "test",
1419	        "verify",
1420	        "fix",
1421	        "scaffold",
1422	    ]
1423	    .iter()

1686	        self.aggregate_spend_usd = aggregate_spend_usd;
1687	        self.sub_spend_usd = sub_spend_usd;
1688	        self.clamp_selection();
1689	        Ok(())
1690	    }

1692	    pub(crate) fn apply_feed_events(&mut self, events: Vec<CampaignFeedEvent>) {
1693	        for event in events {
1694	            if let CampaignFeedEvent::Snapshot { campaign } = &event {
1695	                self.campaign = (**campaign).clone();
1696	            }
1697	            self.feed.push_back(event);
1698	        }
1699	        while self.feed.len() > 1_000 {
1700	            self.feed.pop_front();
1701	        }
1702	        self.clamp_selection();
1703	    }
1704	
1705	    pub(crate) fn clamp_selection(&mut self) {
1706	        if self.campaign.sub_goals.is_empty() {
1707	            self.selected = 0;
1708	        } else {
1709	            self.selected = self.selected.min(self.campaign.sub_goals.len() - 1);
1710	        }
1711	    }

1713	    pub(crate) fn selected_sub_plan(&self) -> Option<(String, String)> {
1714	        self.campaign.sub_goals.get(self.selected).and_then(|sub| {
1715	            sub.sub_plan_id
1716	                .as_ref()
1717	                .map(|plan_id| (sub.sub_id.clone(), plan_id.clone()))
1718	        })
1719	    }

1731	fn campaign_spend(
1732	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1733	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1734	) -> (f64, BTreeMap<String, f64>) {
1735	    let mut total = 0.0_f64;
1736	    let mut by_sub = BTreeMap::new();
1737	    for sub in &campaign.sub_goals {
1738	        let spend = sub
1739	            .result_run_id
1740	            .as_deref()
1741	            .and_then(|run_id| load_run(paths, run_id).ok())
1742	            .map(|state| state.total_spend_usd)
1743	            .unwrap_or(0.0);
1744	        total += spend;
1745	        by_sub.insert(sub.sub_id.clone(), spend);
1746	    }
1747	    (total, by_sub)
1748	}

1781	pub(crate) fn campaign_attach_summary(
1782	    paths: Option<&DeadreckonPaths>,
1783	    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1784	    rollup: Option<&deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup>,
1785	) -> String {

1789	        out,

1792	    );
1793	    let _ = writeln!(out);
1794	    let _ = writeln!(out, "{}", ui_heading("Details"));
1795	    let _ = writeln!(
1796	        out,
1797	        "{} {} ({})",
1798	        ui_muted("campaign:"),
1799	        campaign.root_goal,
1800	        ui_status(campaign_status_text(campaign.status))
1801	    );
1802	    if let Some(rollup) = rollup {
1803	        let _ = writeln!(
1804	            out,
1805	            "roll-up {}",
1806	            ui_status(rollup_verdict_text(rollup.rollup_verdict))
1807	        );
1808	    }
1809	    for sub in &campaign.sub_goals {
1810	        let result = sub
1811	            .result_run_id
1812	            .as_deref()
1813	            .map(run_prefix)
1814	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
1815	        let _ = writeln!(
1816	            out,
1817	            "  {} {} result={} {}",
1818	            ui_id(&sub.sub_id),
1819	            ui_status(sub_status_text(sub.status)),
1820	            ui_id(&result),
1821	            sub.goal
1822	        );
1823	        if let Some(paths) = paths
1824	            && let Some(run_id) = sub.result_run_id.as_deref()
1825	            && let Ok(state) = load_run(paths, run_id)
1826	        {
1827	            let _ = writeln!(out, "    spend {}", run_spend_label(&state, false));
1828	            let _ = writeln!(
1829	                out,
1830	                "    {} {}",
1831	                ui_muted("gate:"),
1832	                ui_status(acceptance_status_value(&state))
1833	            );
1834	        }
1835	    }
1836	    let _ = writeln!(
1837	        out,
1838	        "(each sub is its own plan; deadreckon attach <sub-plan-id> drills in)"
1839	    );
1840	    out
1841	}

1911	/// Resolve a campaign by id prefix: a plan dir whose `campaign.json` exists and
1912	/// whose id starts with `reference`. Returns the campaign dir and the campaign.
1913	pub(crate) fn resolve_campaign(
1914	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1915	    reference: &str,
1916	) -> Result<Option<(PathBuf, deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign)>> {
1917	    let plans = paths.home().join("plans");
1918	    if !plans.is_dir() {
1919	        return Ok(None);
1920	    }
1921	    let mut campaigns = Vec::new();
1922	    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&plans).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
1923	        path: plans.clone(),
1924	        source,
1925	    })? {
1926	        let dir = entry
1927	            .map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
1928	                path: plans.clone(),
1929	                source,
1930	            })?
1931	            .path();
1932	        if !deadreckon_core::campaign::campaign_path_for_plan_dir(&dir).is_file() {
1933	            continue;
1934	        }
1935	        let campaign = deadreckon_core::campaign::read_campaign(&dir)?;
1936	        campaigns.push((dir, campaign));
1937	    }
1938	    if matches!(reference, "latest" | "last") {
1939	        campaigns.sort_by_key(|(_, campaign)| campaign.created_at);
1940	        return Ok(campaigns.pop());
1941	    }
1942	    let matches = campaigns
1943	        .into_iter()
1944	        .filter(|(_, campaign)| campaign.campaign_id.starts_with(reference))
1945	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1946	    match matches.len() {
1947	        0 => Ok(None),
1948	        1 => Ok(matches.into_iter().next()),
1949	        _ => Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
1950	            &format!(
1951	                "ambiguous campaign id prefix {reference}; matches {}",
1952	                matches
1953	                    .iter()
1954	                    .map(|(_, campaign)| campaign.campaign_id.as_str())
1955	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1956	                    .join(", ")
1957	            ),
1958	            "use a longer campaign id prefix",
1959	        ))),
1960	    }
1961	}
1962	
1963	/// Drive a campaign's sub-orchestrators sequentially, recording events and status
1964	/// transitions. Sequential (not concurrent like plan `fork`) is deliberate: the
1965	/// tree-budget ceiling (P5) must be checked *before* launching the next sub, which
1966	/// a concurrent batch cannot guarantee. The `launch` closure performs the actual
1967	/// spawn; tests inject a fake. A failed sub never aborts its siblings.
1968	#[allow(dead_code)] // reserved campaign-fork engine; command wiring and tests share this private seam
1969	pub(crate) fn run_campaign_fork<F, S>(
1970	    campaign_dir: &Path,
1971	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
1972	    mut launch: F,
1973	    spend_of: S,
1974	) -> Result<()>
1975	where
1976	    F: FnMut(
1977	        &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal,
1978	        &Path,
1979	    ) -> Result<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult>,
1980	    S: Fn(&deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult) -> f64,
1981	{
1982	    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{
1983	        self, CampaignStatus, SubGoalStatus, append_campaign_event, tree_budget_exhausted,
1984	        write_campaign,
1985	    };
1986	
1987	    campaign.status = CampaignStatus::Forked;
1988	    campaign.forked_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
1989	    let tree_budget = campaign.tree_budget_usd;
1990	    write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
1991	    append_campaign_event(
1992	        campaign_dir,
1993	        "campaign_started",
1994	        serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign.n }),
1995	    )?;
1996	
1997	    let mut spent_usd = 0.0_f64;
1998	    for index in 0..campaign.sub_goals.len() {
1999	        if tree_budget_exhausted(tree_budget, spent_usd) {
2000	            append_campaign_event(
2001	                campaign_dir,
2002	                "budget_exhausted",
2003	                serde_json::json!({ "spent_usd": spent_usd, "tree_budget_usd": tree_budget }),
2004	            )?;
2005	            break;
2006	        }
2007	        let sub = campaign.sub_goals[index].clone();
2008	        let launch_dir = campaign_dir.join("launch").join(&sub.sub_id);
2009	        fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir)?;
2010	        append_campaign_event(
2011	            campaign_dir,
2012	            "sub_launched",
2013	            serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id }),
2014	        )?;
2015	        match launch(&sub, &launch_dir) {
2016	            Ok(result) => {
2017	                spent_usd += spend_of(&result);
2018	                let target = &mut campaign.sub_goals[index];
2019	                target.sub_plan_id = result.plan_id.clone();
2020	                target.result_run_id = result.result_run_id.clone();
2021	                target.status = if result.ok {
2022	                    SubGoalStatus::Merged
2023	                } else {
2024	                    SubGoalStatus::Failed
2025	                };
2026	                append_campaign_event(
2027	                    campaign_dir,
2028	                    if result.ok {
2029	                        "sub_merged"
2030	                    } else {
2031	                        "sub_failed"
2032	                    },
2033	                    serde_json::json!({
2034	                        "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
2035	                        "plan_id": result.plan_id,
2036	                        "result_run_id": result.result_run_id,
2037	                    }),
2038	                )?;
2039	            }
2040	            Err(err) => {
2041	                campaign.sub_goals[index].status = SubGoalStatus::Failed;
2042	                append_campaign_event(
2043	                    campaign_dir,
2044	                    "sub_failed",
2045	                    serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id, "reason": err.to_string() }),
2046	                )?;
2047	            }
2048	        }
2049	        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
2050	    }
2051	    Ok(())
2052	}

use std::io::{self, IsTerminal, Write as _};
use std::iter::Peekable;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

use ratatui::style::Color;

static PLAIN_OUTPUT: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
#[allow(dead_code)]
const ANSI_ESC: char = '\u{1b}';
const ANSI_RESET: &str = "\x1b[0m";

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Stream {
    Stdout,
    Stderr,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Tone {
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    Plain,
    Heading,
    Muted,
    Id,
    Command,
    Ok,
    Warn,
    Paused,
    Note,
    Negative,
    Prompt,
    Hint,
}

impl Tone {
    /// The single tone->ANSI SGR-parameter table for line output. `None` means
    /// the tone carries no color (plain text).
    pub(crate) const fn to_ansi(self) -> Option<&'static str> {
        match self {
            Tone::Plain => None,
            Tone::Heading => Some("1;36"),
            Tone::Muted => Some("2"),
            Tone::Id => Some("1;35"),
            Tone::Command => Some("1;34"),
            Tone::Ok => Some("1;32"),
            Tone::Warn => Some("1;33"),
            Tone::Paused => Some("1;33"),
            Tone::Note => Some("2"),
            Tone::Negative => Some("1;31"),
            Tone::Prompt => Some("1;36"),
            Tone::Hint => Some("1;34"),
        }
    }

    /// The single tone->ratatui::Color table for the TUI, derived from the same
    /// Tone enum so a status renders the same color on a line and in a frame.
    pub(crate) const fn to_tui_color(self) -> Color {
        match self {
            Tone::Plain => Color::Reset,
            Tone::Heading | Tone::Prompt => Color::Cyan,
            Tone::Muted | Tone::Note => Color::DarkGray,
            Tone::Id => Color::Magenta,
            Tone::Command | Tone::Hint => Color::Blue,
            Tone::Ok => Color::Green,
            Tone::Warn | Tone::Paused => Color::Yellow,
            Tone::Negative => Color::Red,
        }
    }
}

/// The closed set of lifecycle status classes. `status_tone` resolves a free-form
/// status string into exactly one of these — including an explicit `Unknown` —
/// so an unrecognized status renders in a visible default tone rather than being
/// silently folded into a dim catch-all, and so adding a class is a compile error.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Status {
    Ok,
    Running,
    Paused,
    Warn,
    Negative,
    Note,
    Unknown,
}

impl Status {
    pub(crate) fn classify(status: &str) -> Status {
        let status = status.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
        if status.contains("failed")
            || status.contains("killed")
            || status.contains("error")
            || status.contains("missing")
            || status.contains("refused")
        {
            return Status::Negative;
        }
        if status.contains("paused") {
            return Status::Paused;
        }
        if status.contains("warning") || status.contains("warn") {
            return Status::Warn;
        }
        match status.as_str() {
            "ok" | "ready" | "set" | "wrote" | "updated" | "installed" | "completed" | "passed"
            | "polished" | "applied" | "cleaned" | "exported" => Status::Ok,
            "running" => Status::Running,
            "pending" | "planned" | "skipped" | "undone" | "recorded" | "note" => Status::Note,
            _ => Status::Unknown,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) const fn tone(self) -> Tone {
        match self {
            Status::Ok => Tone::Ok,
            Status::Running => Tone::Heading,
            Status::Paused => Tone::Paused,
            Status::Warn => Tone::Warn,
            Status::Negative => Tone::Negative,
            Status::Note => Tone::Note,
            // Unknown stays a visible default rather than a dim that hides it.
            Status::Unknown => Tone::Plain,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct TuiPalette {
    pub(crate) border_focused: Color,
    pub(crate) border_idle: Color,
    pub(crate) status_running: Color,
    pub(crate) status_completed: Color,
    pub(crate) status_failed: Color,
    pub(crate) acceptance_default: Color,
    pub(crate) acceptance_configured: Color,
    pub(crate) acceptance_running: Color,
    pub(crate) acceptance_passed: Color,
    pub(crate) acceptance_failed: Color,
    pub(crate) spend_low: Color,
    pub(crate) spend_mid: Color,
    pub(crate) spend_high: Color,
    pub(crate) spend_pause_cap: Color,
}

pub(crate) const TUI_PALETTE: TuiPalette = TuiPalette {
    border_focused: Color::Cyan,
    border_idle: Color::Reset,
    // Derived from the shared Tone so line and TUI status colors cannot drift.
    status_running: Status::Running.tone().to_tui_color(),
    status_completed: Status::Ok.tone().to_tui_color(),
    status_failed: Status::Negative.tone().to_tui_color(),
    acceptance_default: Color::DarkGray,
    acceptance_configured: Color::Yellow,
    acceptance_running: Color::Cyan,
    acceptance_passed: Color::Green,
    acceptance_failed: Color::Red,
    spend_low: Color::Green,
    spend_mid: Color::Yellow,
    spend_high: Color::Red,
    spend_pause_cap: Color::Magenta,
};

pub(crate) fn set_plain_output(plain: bool) {
    PLAIN_OUTPUT.store(plain, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub(crate) fn enabled(stream: Stream) -> bool {
    if PLAIN_OUTPUT.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return false;
    }
    if std::env::var_os("NO_COLOR").is_some() {
        return false;
    }
    if std::env::var("TERM").is_ok_and(|term| term == "dumb") {
        return false;
    }
    stream_is_terminal(stream)
}

pub(crate) fn render(stream: Stream, tone: Tone, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    let text = text.as_ref();
    let Some(code) = tone.to_ansi() else {
        return text.to_string();
    };
    if enabled(stream) {
        ansi_wrap(code, text)
    } else {
        text.to_string()
    }
}

pub(crate) fn ansi_wrap(code: &str, text: &str) -> String {
    format!("\x1b[{code}m{text}{ANSI_RESET}")
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn ansi_reset() -> &'static str {
    ANSI_RESET
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn strip_ansi(text: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());
    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
        if read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars).is_some() {
            continue;
        }
        out.push(ch);
    }
    out
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn read_ansi_sequence<I>(first: char, chars: &mut Peekable<I>) -> Option<(String, bool)>
where
    I: Iterator<Item = char>,
{
    if first != ANSI_ESC || chars.peek() != Some(&'[') {
        return None;
    }
    let mut sequence = String::from(first);
    if let Some(bracket) = chars.next() {
        sequence.push(bracket);
    }
    for code in chars.by_ref() {
        sequence.push(code);
        if code.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
            let active = sequence != ANSI_RESET;
            return Some((sequence, active));
        }
    }
    Some((sequence, false))
}

/// Display width of `text` in terminal columns: ANSI escape sequences are
/// stripped first, then each glyph is measured by its Unicode display width so
/// wide (CJK / full-width) glyphs count as two columns and zero-width / combining
/// marks count as zero. This is the single width function behind every pad,
/// truncate, and column-alignment site.
#[allow(dead_code)] // used by ui_card today; kv_block/columns/prompt sites adopt it in later phases.
pub(crate) fn display_width(text: &str) -> usize {
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;
    UnicodeWidthStr::width(strip_ansi(text).as_str())
}

/// Right-pad `text` with spaces to `width` DISPLAY columns (ANSI-aware). Use this
/// for column alignment instead of `{:<N}`: a `{:<N}` format-pad counts the ANSI
/// escape bytes of a styled cell, so a colored column ends up short and misaligns
/// against its plain header.
#[allow(dead_code)] // call sites adopt it across P3/P5/P6.
pub(crate) fn pad_visible(text: &str, width: usize) -> String {
    let used = display_width(text);
    if used >= width {
        text.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{text}{}", " ".repeat(width - used))
    }
}

/// Word-wrap `text` to `width` display columns, breaking words longer than the
/// width. This is the single wrap engine behind the kv block, run list, and
/// campaign facts. Wrap RAW (unstyled) text — it is ANSI-naive.
#[allow(dead_code)] // call sites adopt it across P10.
pub(crate) fn wrap_words(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar;
    let width = width.max(1);
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut current = String::new();
    for word in text.split_whitespace() {
        if display_width(word) > width {
            if !current.is_empty() {
                lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
            }
            // Break a too-long word into width-sized chunks.
            let mut chunk = String::new();
            let mut chunk_width = 0usize;
            for ch in word.chars() {
                let ch_width = UnicodeWidthChar::width(ch).unwrap_or(0);
                if chunk_width + ch_width > width {
                    lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut chunk));
                    chunk_width = 0;
                }
                chunk.push(ch);
                chunk_width += ch_width;
            }
            current = chunk;
            continue;
        }
        let next = if current.is_empty() {
            display_width(word)
        } else {
            display_width(&current) + 1 + display_width(word)
        };
        if next <= width {
            if !current.is_empty() {
                current.push(' ');
            }
            current.push_str(word);
        } else {
            lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut current));
            current.push_str(word);
        }
    }
    if !current.is_empty() || lines.is_empty() {
        lines.push(current);
    }
    lines
}

pub(crate) fn status_tone(status: impl AsRef<str>) -> Tone {
    Status::classify(status.as_ref()).tone()
}

/// Color the leading status token of `value` (e.g. `PASSED` in `PASSED 1/1`,
/// `completed` in `completed -> done`) by its status tone, leaving the rest
/// plain. A value whose leading token is not a recognized status is returned
/// unchanged. Safe for an unpadded (last-column / kv) value.
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub(crate) fn color_status_word(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut parts = value.splitn(2, ' ');
    let Some(first) = parts.next() else {
        return value.to_string();
    };
    let tone = status_tone(first);
    if tone == Tone::Plain {
        return value.to_string();
    }
    match parts.next() {
        Some(rest) => format!("{} {}", render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first), rest),
        None => render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn render_status(stream: Stream, status: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    let status = status.as_ref();
    render(stream, status_tone(status), status)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_heading(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Heading, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_muted(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Muted, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_id(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Id, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_command(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Command, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_ok(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Ok, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_warn(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stdout, Tone::Warn, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_status(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render_status(Stream::Stdout, text)
}

pub(crate) fn ui_error(text: impl AsRef<str>) -> String {
    render(Stream::Stderr, Tone::Negative, text)
}

pub(crate) fn writeln(stream: Stream, tone: Tone, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> io::Result<()> {
    let rendered = render(stream, tone, text);
    match stream {
        Stream::Stdout => {
            println!("{rendered}");
            io::stdout().flush()
        }
        Stream::Stderr => {
            eprintln!("{rendered}");
            io::stderr().flush()
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn hint(stream: Stream, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> io::Result<()> {
    writeln(
        stream,
        Tone::Hint,
        format!("  hint: {}", text.as_ref().trim()),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn clear_current_line(stream: Stream) -> io::Result<()> {
    if !stream_is_terminal(stream) {
        return Ok(());

    match stream {

1789	        .into_iter()
1790	        .next()
1791	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("deadreckon show {id}"));
1792	    let completed = plan
1793	        .tasks
1794	        .iter()
1795	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1796	        .count();
1797	    VerdictSurface::try_new(
1798	        VerdictKind::Noop,
1799	        "plan",
1800	        Some(&id),
1801	        ExplanationPanel::new(
1802	            format!("DeadReckon did not fork the plan because it is already {}.", plan_status_label(plan.status)),
1803	            "Fork only starts pending plans; the recommended command follows the current plan state instead.",
1804	            [
1805	                ("plan".to_string(), id.clone()),
1806	                (
1807	                    "status".to_string(),
1808	                    plan_status_label(plan.status).to_string(),
1809	                ),
1810	                (
1811	                    "tasks".to_string(),
1812	                    format!("{completed}/{} completed", plan.tasks.len()),
1813	                ),
1814	            ],
1815	        ),
1816	        [("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
1817	        Vec::<(&str, &str)>::new(),
1818	    )
1819	    .expect("fork refusal surface must have one primary action")
1820	}

1823	enum PlanChildSignal {
1824	    Pid { task_index: usize, pid: u32 },
1825	    RunId { task_index: usize, run_id: String },

1828	fn drain_plan_child_signals(
1829	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1830	    plan: &mut Plan,
1831	    signal_rx: &std::sync::mpsc::Receiver<PlanChildSignal>,
1832	    live_children: &mut BTreeMap<usize, u32>,
1833	    quiet: bool,
1834	    plain: bool,
1835	) -> Result<()> {
1836	    while let Ok(signal) = signal_rx.try_recv() {
1837	        match signal {
1838	            PlanChildSignal::Pid { task_index, pid } => {
1839	                live_children.insert(task_index, pid);
1840	                if let Some(task) = plan.tasks.get(task_index) {
1841	                    append_plan_event(
1842	                        paths,
1843	                        &plan.plan_id,
1844	                        PlanEventKind::TaskRunDiscovered {
1845	                            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
1846	                            task_index,
1847	                            run_id: task.child_run_id.clone(),
1848	                            pid: Some(pid),
1849	                        },
1850	                    )?;
1851	                }
1852	                write_coordinator_snapshot_live(paths, plan, live_children)?;
1853	            }
1854	            PlanChildSignal::RunId { task_index, run_id } => {
1855	                let mut newly_discovered = false;
1856	                if let Some(task) = plan.tasks.get_mut(task_index)
1857	                    && task.child_run_id.as_deref() != Some(run_id.as_str())
1858	                {
1859	                    task.child_run_id = Some(run_id.clone());
1860	                    newly_discovered = true;
1861	                }
1862	                if let Some(task) = plan.tasks.get(task_index) {
1863	                    append_plan_event(
1864	                        paths,
1865	                        &plan.plan_id,
1866	                        PlanEventKind::TaskRunDiscovered {
1867	                            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
1868	                            task_index,
1869	                            run_id: Some(run_id.clone()),
1870	                            pid: live_children.get(&task_index).copied(),
1871	                        },
1872	                    )?;
1873	                }
1874	                save_plan(paths, plan)?;
1875	                write_coordinator_snapshot_live(paths, plan, live_children)?;
1876	                if newly_discovered && !quiet {
1877	                    print_plan_child_run_line(plan, task_index, &run_id, plain);
1878	                }
1879	            }
1880	        }
1881	    }
1882	    Ok(())
1883	}

1950	fn plan_progress_summary(plan: &Plan) -> String {
1951	    let total = plan.tasks.len();
1952	    let completed = plan
1953	        .tasks
1954	        .iter()
1955	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
1956	        .count();
1957	    let failed = plan
1958	        .tasks
1959	        .iter()
1960	        .filter(|task| matches!(task.status, PlanTaskStatus::Failed | PlanTaskStatus::Killed))
1961	        .count();
1962	    let pending = plan
1963	        .tasks
1964	        .iter()
1965	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Pending)
1966	        .count();
1967	    let running = plan
1968	        .tasks
1969	        .iter()
1970	        .filter(|task| task.status == PlanTaskStatus::Running)
1971	        .map(|task| match task.child_run_id.as_deref() {
1972	            Some(run_id) => format!("{}:{}", task.task_id, run_prefix(run_id)),
1973	            None => task.task_id.clone(),
1974	        })
1975	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1976	    let running = if running.is_empty() {
1977	        "-".to_string()
1978	    } else {
1979	        running.join(",")
1980	    };
1981	    format!("done={completed}/{total} running={running} pending={pending} failed={failed}")
1982	}

1984	fn apply_fork_provider_overrides(
1985	    plan: &mut Plan,
1986	    provider: Option<String>,
1987	    child_provider: &[String],
1988	    coder_provider: Option<String>,
1989	    reviewer_provider: Option<String>,
1990	) -> Result<()> {
1991	    match plan.mode {
1992	        PlanMode::FullPlan => {
1993	            if let Some(provider) = provider {
1994	                plan.providers.default_child = Some(provider.clone());
1995	                for task in &mut plan.tasks {
1996	                    task.provider = Some(provider.clone());
1997	                }
1998	            }
1999	            let overrides = parse_child_provider_overrides(child_provider, plan.n as u8)?;
2000	            for (index, provider) in overrides {
2001	                plan.providers.children.insert(index, provider.clone());
2002	                let task = plan.tasks.get_mut(index as usize).ok_or_else(|| {
2003	                    CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2004	                        &format!("child provider index {index} outside 0..{}", plan.n),
2005	                        "--child-provider 1=cli:codex",
2006	                    ))
2007	                })?;
2008	                task.provider = Some(provider);
2009	            }
2010	        }
2011	        PlanMode::Review => {
2012	            if let Some(provider) = coder_provider {
2013	                plan.providers.coder = Some(provider.clone());
2014	                if let Some(task) = plan
2015	                    .tasks
2016	                    .iter_mut()
2017	                    .find(|task| task.role == PlanRole::Coder)
2018	                {
2019	                    task.provider = Some(provider);
2020	                }
2021	            }
2022	            if let Some(provider) = reviewer_provider {
2023	                plan.providers.reviewer = Some(provider.clone());
2024	                if let Some(task) = plan
2025	                    .tasks
2026	                    .iter_mut()
2027	                    .find(|task| task.role == PlanRole::Reviewer)
2028	                {
2029	                    task.provider = Some(provider);
2030	                }
2031	            }
2032	        }
2033	    }
2034	    Ok(())
2035	}

2037	fn append_task_terminal_plan_event(
2038	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2039	    plan: &Plan,
2040	    task_index: usize,
2041	    status: PlanTaskStatus,
2042	    run_id: &str,
2043	) -> Result<()> {
2044	    let task = plan.tasks.get(task_index).ok_or_else(|| {
2045	        CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2046	            &format!("no child index {task_index}"),
2047	            "deadreckon plan \"your goal\"",
2048	        ))
2049	    })?;
2050	    let event = match status {
2051	        PlanTaskStatus::Completed => PlanEventKind::TaskCompleted {
2052	            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
2053	            task_index,
2054	            run_id: Some(run_id.to_string()),
2055	            status: "completed".to_string(),
2056	        },
2057	        PlanTaskStatus::Failed => PlanEventKind::TaskFailed {
2058	            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
2059	            task_index,
2060	            reason: format!("run {run_id} failed"),
2061	        },
2062	        PlanTaskStatus::Killed => PlanEventKind::TaskKilled {
2063	            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
2064	            task_index,
2065	            run_id: Some(run_id.to_string()),
2066	        },
2067	        PlanTaskStatus::Pending | PlanTaskStatus::Running => PlanEventKind::TaskBlocked {
2068	            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
2069	            task_index,
2070	            reason: format!("run {run_id} ended {}", task_status_label(status)),
2071	        },
2072	    };
2073	    append_plan_event(paths, &plan.plan_id, event)?;
2074	    Ok(())
2075	}

2097	fn write_coordinator_snapshot_live(

2138	async fn plan_child_source_dir(
2139	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2140	    plan: &Plan,
2141	    task_index: usize,
2142	    parent_cwd: &Path,
2143	    repair: DependencyComposeRepair<'_>,
2144	) -> Result<PathBuf> {
2145	    let task = &plan.tasks[task_index];
2146	    let plan_cwd = plan.parent_cwd.as_deref().unwrap_or(parent_cwd);
2147	    if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
2148	        return Ok(plan_cwd.to_path_buf());
2149	    }
2150	
2151	    let dependencies = plan_dependency_artifacts(paths, plan, task)?;
2152	    if task.role == PlanRole::Reviewer && dependencies.len() == 1 {
2153	        Ok(dependencies[0].root.clone())
2154	    } else {
2155	        compose_dependency_source_dir(paths, plan, task, &dependencies, repair).await
2156	    }
2157	}

2160	struct PlanDependencyArtifact {
2161	    task_id: String,
2162	    index: u32,
2163	    run_id: String,
2164	    root: PathBuf,
2165	}

2167	fn plan_dependency_artifacts(
2168	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
2169	    plan: &Plan,
2170	    task: &PlanTask,
2171	) -> Result<Vec<PlanDependencyArtifact>> {
2172	    let mut dependencies = Vec::new();
2173	    for dependency in &task.depends_on {
2174	        let dependency_task = plan.task_by_id(dependency).ok_or_else(|| {
2175	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2176	                &format!("task {} depends on unknown {dependency}", task.task_id),
2177	                "edit the plan so depends_on references earlier task ids",
2178	            ))
2179	        })?;
2180	        if dependency_task.status != PlanTaskStatus::Completed {
2181	            return Err(CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2182	                &format!(
2183	                    "task {} dependency {} is {}",
2184	                    task.task_id,
2185	                    dependency_task.task_id,
2186	                    task_status_label(dependency_task.status)
2187	                ),
2188	                "wait for dependencies to complete before forking dependent children",
2189	            )));
2190	        }
2191	        let run_id = dependency_task.child_run_id.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
2192	            CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
2193	                &format!(
2194	                    "task {} dependency {} has no run id",
2195	                    task.task_id, dependency
2196	                ),
2197	                "deadreckon fork <plan-id>",
2198	            ))
2199	        })?;
2200	        let state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
2201	        dependencies.push(PlanDependencyArtifact {
2202	            task_id: dependency_task.task_id.clone(),
2203	            index: dependency_task.index,
2204	            run_id: run_id.to_string(),
2205	            root: child_artifact_root(paths, &state),
2206	        });
2207	    }
2208	    dependencies.sort_by_key(|dependency| dependency.index);
2209	    Ok(dependencies)
2210	}
