319	async fn attach_campaign_tui(
320	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
321	    mut state: commands::campaign::CampaignAttachState,
322	    show_hints: bool,
323	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
324	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
325	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
326	) -> Result<()> {
327	    enable_raw_mode()?;
328	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
329	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
330	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
331	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
332	    let mut feed = commands::campaign::CampaignEventFeed::new(
333	        paths.clone(),
334	        state.campaign_dir.clone(),
335	        state.campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
336	    );
337	
338	    let result = loop {
339	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Campaign, AttachTickBudget::default());
340	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
341	        let events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
342	        state.apply_feed_events(events);
343	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
344	
345	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
346	        if let Err(error) = state.refresh(paths) {
347	            state
348	                .feed
349	                .push_back(commands::campaign::CampaignFeedEvent::Warning {
350	                    message: format!("campaign refresh failed: {error}"),
351	                });
352	        }
353	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
354	
355	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
356	        terminal.draw(|frame| render_campaign_attach(frame, &state))?;
357	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
358	
359	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
360	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(250))?;
361	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
362	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
363	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
364	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
365	
366	        if input_ready && let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? {
367	            match handle_campaign_key(&mut state, key) {
368	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::None | CampaignAttachKeyAction::Refresh => {}
369	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back | CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit => break Ok(()),
370	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::DrillInto { sub_id, plan_id } => {
371	                    if load_plan(paths, &plan_id).is_err() {
372	                        state
373	                            .feed
374	                            .push_back(commands::campaign::CampaignFeedEvent::Warning {
375	                                message: format!("sub-plan {sub_id} unavailable: {plan_id}"),
376	                            });
377	                        continue;
378	                    }
379	                    suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
380	                    let parent_campaign = AttachCampaignParent {
381	                        campaign_id: state.campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
382	                        sub_id,
383	                    };
384	                    let child_result = attach_plan_tui(
385	                        paths,
386	                        &plan_id,
387	                        show_hints,
388	                        initial_view,
389	                        initial_visual,
390	                        narrative_config.clone(),
391	                        Some(parent_campaign),
392	                    )
393	                    .await;
394	                    if let Err(err) = &child_result {
395	                        print_error(err);
396	                        let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to campaign attach...", None);
397	                    }
398	                    resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
399	                }
400	            }
401	        }
402	    };
403	
404	    disable_raw_mode()?;
405	    execute!(
406	        terminal.backend_mut(),
407	        DisableMouseCapture,
408	        LeaveAlternateScreen
409	    )?;
410	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
411	    result
412	}
413	
414	async fn attach_plan_tui(
415	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
416	    plan_id: &str,
417	    show_hints: bool,
418	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
419	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
420	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
421	    parent_campaign: Option<AttachCampaignParent>,
422	) -> Result<()> {
423	    enable_raw_mode()?;
424	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
425	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
426	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
427	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
428	    let mut selected = 0_usize;
429	    let mut plan = load_plan(paths, plan_id)?;
430	    let mut messages: Vec<PlanMessage>;
431	    let mut plan_events = Vec::<PlanEvent>::new();
432	    let mut feed_events = Vec::<PlanFeedEvent>::new();
433	    let mut feed = PlanEventBus::file_tail(paths.clone(), plan_id.to_string());
434	    let mut view = initial_view;
435	    let mut visual = initial_visual;
436	    let mut narrative_notice = None;
437	    let mut quiet_tracker = NarrativeQuietRefreshTracker::new(Utc::now());
438	    let mut narrative_refresh_job: Option<AttachPlanNarrativeRefreshJob> = None;
439	    let mut narrative_projection_cache = AttachNarrativeProjectionCache::default();
440	
441	    let result = loop {
442	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Plan, AttachTickBudget::default());
443	        let now = Utc::now();
444	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
445	        let new_feed_events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
446	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
447	        let event_refresh = plan_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_feed_events);
448	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
449	        for event in new_feed_events {
450	            match event {
451	                PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event } => {
452	                    plan_events.push(event.clone());
453	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event });
454	                }
455	                PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot } => {
456	                    plan = (*snapshot).clone();
457	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot });
458	                }
459	                other => feed_events.push(other),
460	            }
461	        }
462	        if plan_events.len() > 1_000 {
463	            let drain = plan_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
464	            plan_events.drain(0..drain);
465	        }
466	        if feed_events.len() > 1_000 {
467	            let drain = feed_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
468	            feed_events.drain(0..drain);
469	        }
470	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
471	        messages = read_plan_messages(paths, plan_id).unwrap_or_default();
472	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::PlanMessages, stage_started);
473	        if let Some(notice) = poll_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job).await {
474	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();
475	            narrative_notice = Some(notice);
476	        }
477	        if selected >= plan.tasks.len() {
478	            selected = plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1);
479	        }
480	        let auto_refresh = event_refresh.or_else(|| {
481	            if view.is_narrative() {
482	                quiet_tracker.maybe_trigger(
483	                    plan.status == PlanStatus::Forked,
484	                    narrative::NarrativeCadence::default().quiet_seconds,
485	                    now,
486	                )
487	            } else {
488	                None
489	            }
490	        });
491	        if let Some(kind) = auto_refresh
492	            && view.is_narrative()
493	        {
494	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
495	            let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
496	                paths,
497	                plan: &plan,
498	                messages: &messages,
499	                plan_events: &plan_events,
500	                feed_events: &feed_events,
501	                selected,
502	                config: &narrative_config,
503	            };
504	            narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
505	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
506	                plan_narrative_refresh_request(&refresh_input, kind),
507	                now,
508	            ));
509	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
510	        }
511	        let narrative_projection = if view.is_narrative() {
512	            let input = narrative::PlanNarrativeInput {
513	                paths,
514	                plan: &plan,
515	                messages: &messages,
516	                plan_events: &plan_events,
517	                feed_events: &feed_events,
518	                selected,
519	            };
520	            narrative_projection_cache
521	                .refresh_plan(&input)
522	                .or_else(|_| Ok::<_, CliError>(narrative::build_plan_projection(&input)))
523	                .ok()
524	        } else {
525	            None
526	        };
527	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
528	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
529	            render_plan_attach(
530	                frame,
531	                paths,
532	                &plan,
533	                &PlanAttachRenderState {
534	                    messages: &messages,
535	                    plan_events: &plan_events,
536	                    feed_events: &feed_events,
537	                    selected,
538	                    show_hints,
539	                    view,
540	                    visual,
541	                    campaign_parent: parent_campaign.as_ref(),
542	                    narrative_notice: narrative_notice.as_deref(),
543	                    narrative_projection: narrative_projection.as_ref(),
544	                },
545	            )
546	        })?;
547	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
548	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
549	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(250))?;
550	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
551	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
552	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
553	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
554	        if input_ready {
555	            match event::read()? {
556	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),
557	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('n') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
558	                    view = toggle_attach_view(view);
559	                }
560	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
561	                    visual = visual.next();
562	                }
563	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
564	                    view = AttachViewMode::Narrative;
565	                    let stage_started = Instant::now();
566	                    let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
567	                        paths,
568	                        plan: &plan,
569	                        messages: &messages,
570	                        plan_events: &plan_events,
571	                        feed_events: &feed_events,
572	                        selected,
573	                        config: &narrative_config,
574	                    };
575	                    narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
576	                        &mut narrative_refresh_job,
577	                        plan_narrative_refresh_request(
578	                            &refresh_input,
579	                            NarrativeRefreshKind::Manual,
580	                        ),
581	                        Utc::now(),
582	                    ));
583	                    tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
584	                    let stage_started = Instant::now();
585	                    terminal.draw(|frame| {
586	                        render_plan_attach(
587	                            frame,
588	                            paths,
589	                            &plan,
590	                            &PlanAttachRenderState {
591	                                messages: &messages,
592	                                plan_events: &plan_events,
593	                                feed_events: &feed_events,
594	                                selected,
595	                                show_hints,
596	                                view,
597	                                visual,
598	                                campaign_parent: parent_campaign.as_ref(),
599	                                narrative_notice: narrative_notice.as_deref(),
600	                                narrative_projection: narrative_projection.as_ref(),
601	                            },
602	                        )
603	                    })?;
604	                    tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
605	                }
606	                Event::Key(key)
607	                    if matches!(
608	                        key.code,
609	                        KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Tab | KeyCode::Char('j')
610	                    ) =>
611	                {
612	                    selected = (selected + 1).min(plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1));
613	                }
614	                Event::Key(key)
615	                    if matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Left | KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k')) =>
616	                {
617	                    selected = selected.saturating_sub(1);
618	                }
619	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Enter => {
620	                    if let Some(run_id) = plan
621	                        .tasks
622	                        .get(selected)
623	                        .and_then(|task| task.child_run_id.as_deref())
624	                    {
625	                        if load_run(paths, run_id).is_err() {
626	                            continue;
627	                        }
628	                        let parent_plan = plan.tasks.get(selected).map(|task| AttachParentPlan {
629	                            plan_id: plan.plan_id.clone(),
630	                            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
631	                            campaign_parent: parent_campaign.clone(),
632	                        });
633	                        if cancel_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job) {
634	                            narrative_notice = Some(
635	                                "plan refresh cancelled while opening child attach".to_string(),
636	                            );
637	                        }
638	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
639	                        let child_result = attach_tui_with_parent(
640	                            paths,
641	                            run_id,
642	                            show_hints,
643	                            parent_plan,
644	                            view,
645	                            visual,
646	                            narrative_config.clone(),
647	                        )
648	                        .await;
649	                        if let Err(err) = &child_result {
650	                            print_error(err);
651	                            let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to plan attach...", None);
652	                        }
653	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
654	                    }
655	                }
656	                _ => {}
657	            }
658	        }
659	    };
660	
661	    cancel_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job);
662	    disable_raw_mode()?;
663	    execute!(
664	        terminal.backend_mut(),
665	        DisableMouseCapture,
666	        LeaveAlternateScreen
667	    )?;
668	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
669	    result
670	}
671	
672	async fn attach_tui(
673	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
674	    run_id: &str,
675	    show_completion_actions: bool,
676	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
677	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
678	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
679	) -> Result<()> {

681	        paths,
682	        run_id,
683	        show_completion_actions,
684	        None,

691	
692	async fn attach_tui_with_parent(
693	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
694	    run_id: &str,
695	    show_completion_actions: bool,
696	    parent_plan: Option<AttachParentPlan>,
697	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
698	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
699	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
700	) -> Result<()> {
701	    let initial_state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
702	    let mut event_feed =
703	        tui_events::TuiEventFeed::file_tail(initial_state.run_root.join(RUN_EVENTS_JSONL));
704	    let mut events = event_feed.refresh(std::time::Duration::ZERO).await?;
705	    enable_raw_mode()?;
706	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
707	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
708	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
709	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
710	    let mut tui_state = AttachTuiState {
711	        show_completion_actions,
712	        parent_plan,
713	        view: initial_view,
714	        visual: initial_visual,
715	        ..AttachTuiState::default()
716	    };
717	    let mut quiet_tracker = NarrativeQuietRefreshTracker::new(Utc::now());
718	    let mut acceptance_tracker = NarrativeAcceptanceRefreshTracker::default();
719	    let mut narrative_refresh_job: Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob> = None;
720	    let mut spend_tail =
721	        AttachJsonlTail::<SpendRecord>::new(initial_state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl"));
722	    let mut trace_tail =
723	        AttachJsonlTail::<TraceRecord>::new(initial_state.run_root.join("traces.jsonl"));
724	    let mut provider_activity_cache = AttachProviderActivityCache::new(&initial_state);
725	    let mut narrative_projection_cache = AttachNarrativeProjectionCache::default();
726	
727	    let result = loop {
728	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Run, AttachTickBudget::default());
729	        let now = Utc::now();
730	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
731	        let state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
732	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
733	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
734	        spend_tail.reset_to_path(state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl"));
735	        trace_tail.reset_to_path(state.run_root.join("traces.jsonl"));
736	        let spend = spend_tail.refresh()?;
737	        let traces = trace_tail.refresh()?;
738	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ReadJsonl, stage_started);
739	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
740	        let new_events = event_feed.refresh(std::time::Duration::ZERO).await?;
741	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
742	        let run_event_refresh = run_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_events);
743	        events.extend(new_events);
744	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
745	        let provider_activity = provider_activity_cache.refresh(&state);
746	        let live = collect_attach_live_with_provider_activity(&state, provider_activity);
747	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LiveCollect, stage_started);
748	        let event_refresh =
749	            run_event_refresh.or_else(|| acceptance_tracker.observe(&live.acceptance));
750	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
751	        if let Some(notice) = poll_run_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job).await {
752	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();
753	            tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
754	        }
755	        tui_state.narrative_projection = if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
756	            let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
757	                state: &state,
758	                spend,
759	                traces,
760	                events: &events,
761	                live: &live,
762	                tui_state: &tui_state,
763	            };
764	            narrative_projection_cache
765	                .refresh_run(&input)
766	                .or_else(|_| Ok::<_, CliError>(build_run_narrative_projection(&input)))
767	                .ok()
768	        } else {
769	            None
770	        };
771	        let terminal_size = terminal.size()?;
772	        let terminal_area =
773	            ratatui::layout::Rect::new(0, 0, terminal_size.width, terminal_size.height);
774	        let panel_layout = attach_panel_layout(terminal_area);
775	        let panel_counts = attach_panel_counts(&state, spend, traces, &events, &live, &tui_state);
776	        tui_state.clamp(panel_counts, panel_layout.rows);
777	        let auto_refresh = event_refresh.or_else(|| {
778	            if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
779	                quiet_tracker.maybe_trigger(
780	                    state.status == RunStatus::Executing,
781	                    narrative::NarrativeCadence::default().quiet_seconds,
782	                    now,
783	                )
784	            } else {
785	                None
786	            }
787	        });
788	        if let Some(kind) = auto_refresh
789	            && tui_state.view.is_narrative()
790	        {
791	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
792	            let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
793	                state: &state,
794	                spend,
795	                traces,
796	                events: &events,
797	                live: &live,
798	                tui_state: &tui_state,
799	            };
800	            let notice = start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
801	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
802	                run_narrative_refresh_request(paths, &input, &narrative_config, kind),
803	                now,
804	            );
805	            tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
806	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
807	        }
808	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
809	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
810	            render_attach(frame, &state, spend, traces, &events, &live, &tui_state)
811	        })?;
812	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
813	
814	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
815	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(200))?;
816	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
817	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
818	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
819	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
820	        if input_ready {
821	            match event::read()? {
822	                Event::Key(key)
823	                    if tui_state.parent_plan.is_some() && attach_should_return_to_plan(key) =>
824	                {
825	                    break Ok(());
826	                }
827	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),
828	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('n') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
829	                    tui_state.toggle_view();
830	                }
831	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
832	                    tui_state.cycle_visual();
833	                }
834	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
835	                    let provider_stage_started = Instant::now();
836	                    let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
837	                        state: &state,
838	                        spend,
839	                        traces,
840	                        events: &events,
841	                        live: &live,
842	                        tui_state: &tui_state,
843	                    };
844	                    let notice = start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
845	                        &mut narrative_refresh_job,
846	                        run_narrative_refresh_request(
847	                            paths,
848	                            &input,
849	                            &narrative_config,
850	                            NarrativeRefreshKind::Manual,
851	                        ),
852	                        Utc::now(),
853	                    );
854	                    tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
855	                    tick.record_since(
856	                        AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh,
857	                        provider_stage_started,
858	                    );
859	                    let stage_started = Instant::now();
860	                    terminal.draw(|frame| {
861	                        render_attach(frame, &state, spend, traces, &events, &live, &tui_state)
862	                    })?;
863	                    tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
864	                }
865	                Event::Key(key)
866	                    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('c')
867	                        && key.modifiers.is_empty()
868	                        && read_chain_step_marker(&state.working_dir)?.is_some() =>
869	                {
870	                    if let Some(marker) = read_chain_step_marker(&state.working_dir)? {
871	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
872	                        let action =
873	                            commands::chain::chain_attach_command(paths, &marker.chain_id, false);
874	                        if let Err(err) = &action {
875	                            print_error(err);
876	                        }
877	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
878	                    }
879	                }
880	                Event::Key(key)
881	                    if tui_state.show_completion_actions
882	                        && state.status == RunStatus::Completed =>
883	                {
884	                    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers.is_empty() {
885	                        tui_state.toggle_docs();
886	                    } else if let Some(notice) =
887	                        handle_tui_completion_key(&mut terminal, paths, &state, key).await?
888	                    {
889	                        tui_state.record_post_action(notice);
890	                    } else {
891	                        tui_state.handle_key(key, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows);
892	                    }
893	                }
894	                Event::Key(key) => tui_state.handle_key(key, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows),
895	                Event::Mouse(mouse) => {
896	                    if let Some(panel) = panel_layout.panel_at(mouse.column, mouse.row) {
897	                        tui_state.focused_panel = panel;
898	                    }
899	                    match mouse.kind {
900	                        MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
901	                            tui_state.scroll_focused(3, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows)
902	                        }
903	                        MouseEventKind::ScrollUp => {
904	                            tui_state.scroll_focused(-3, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows)
905	                        }
906	                        _ => {}
907	                    }
908	                }
909	                _ => {}
910	            }
911	        }
912	    };
913	
914	    cancel_run_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job);
915	    disable_raw_mode()?;
916	    execute!(
917	        terminal.backend_mut(),
918	        DisableMouseCapture,
919	        LeaveAlternateScreen
920	    )?;
921	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
922	    result
923	}
924	
925	async fn handle_tui_completion_key(
926	    terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,
927	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
928	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
929	    key: KeyEvent,
930	) -> Result<Option<AttachActionNotice>> {
931	    let action = match key.code {
932	        KeyCode::Char('m') => CompletionAction::Materialize,
933	        KeyCode::Char('e') => CompletionAction::Extend,
934	        KeyCode::Char('a') => CompletionAction::Apply,
935	        KeyCode::Char('b') => CompletionAction::Abandon,
936	        KeyCode::Char('d') => CompletionAction::Docs,
937	        KeyCode::Char('s') => CompletionAction::Show,
938	        _ => return Ok(None),
939	    };
940	
941	    suspend_tui(terminal)?;
942	    let action_result = match action {
943	        CompletionAction::Materialize => prompt_materialize_action(paths, state),
944	        CompletionAction::Extend => prompt_extend_action(state).await,
945	        CompletionAction::Apply => super::lifecycle::apply_command(
946	            state.run_id.clone(),
947	            "squash".to_string(),
948	            None,
949	            false,
950	            false,
951	            false,
952	            None,
953	            false,
954	        ),
955	        CompletionAction::Abandon => {
956	            super::lifecycle::abandon_command(state.run_id.clone(), false, false)
957	        }
958	        CompletionAction::Docs => {
959	            Box::pin(super::doc::doc_command(super::doc::DocCommandArgs {
960	                run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
961	                kind: CliDocKind::Narrative,
962	                export: None,
963	                polish: false,
964	                no_confirm: true,
965	                force: false,
966	                doc_skill: None,
967	                doc_provider: None,
968	                budget_cap: None,
969	            }))
970	            .await
971	        }
972	        CompletionAction::Show => {
973	            show_command(&state.run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None)
974	        }
975	        CompletionAction::Quit => Ok(()),
976	    };
977	    if let Err(err) = &action_result {
978	        print_error(err);
979	        print_error_hint(err);
980	    }
981	    let _ = prompt::open("press Enter to return to attach...", None);
982	    resume_tui(terminal)?;
983	    Ok(Some(AttachActionNotice {
984	        action,
985	        success: action_result.is_ok(),
986	    }))
987	}
988	
989	pub(crate) fn suspend_tui(terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> Result<()> {
990	    disable_raw_mode()?;
991	    execute!(
992	        terminal.backend_mut(),
993	        DisableMouseCapture,
994	        LeaveAlternateScreen
995	    )?;
996	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
997	    note_tui_suspended();
998	    Ok(())
999	}
1000	
1001	pub(crate) fn resume_tui(terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> Result<()> {
1002	    enable_raw_mode()?;
1003	    execute!(
1004	        terminal.backend_mut(),
1005	        EnterAlternateScreen,
1006	        EnableMouseCapture
1007	    )?;
1008	    note_tui_resumed();
1009	    Ok(())
1010	}
1011	
1012	#[cfg(test)]
1013	pub(crate) fn simulate_campaign_drill_cycle() {
1014	    reset_tui_suspend_depth();
1015	    note_tui_suspended();
1016	    note_tui_suspended();
1017	    note_tui_resumed();
1018	    note_tui_resumed();
1019	}
1020	
1021	pub(crate) fn attach_should_quit(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1022	    matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc)
1023	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL))
1024	}
1025	
1026	pub(crate) fn attach_should_return_to_plan(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1027	    attach_should_quit(key)
1028	        || matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Backspace)
1029	        || (key.code == KeyCode::Char('b') && key.modifiers.is_empty())
1030	}

149	    Refresh,
150	    Back,
151	    Quit,

153	}
154	
155	pub(crate) fn handle_campaign_key(
156	    state: &mut CampaignAttachState,
157	    key: KeyEvent,
158	) -> CampaignAttachKeyAction {
159	    match key.code {
160	        KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => {
161	            state.selected = state.selected.saturating_sub(1);
162	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
163	        }
164	        KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') | KeyCode::Tab => {
165	            let max = state.campaign.sub_goals.len().saturating_sub(1);
166	            state.selected = (state.selected + 1).min(max);
167	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::None
168	        }
169	        KeyCode::Enter => state
170	            .selected_sub_plan()
171	            .map(|(sub_id, plan_id)| CampaignAttachKeyAction::DrillInto { sub_id, plan_id })
172	            .unwrap_or(CampaignAttachKeyAction::None),
173	        KeyCode::Char('r') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Refresh,
174	        KeyCode::Char('b') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
175	        KeyCode::Backspace | KeyCode::Esc => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back,
176	        KeyCode::Char('q') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit,
177	        KeyCode::Char('d') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
178	            CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit
179	        }
180	        _ => CampaignAttachKeyAction::None,
181	    }
182	}

184	pub(crate) fn note_tui_suspended() -> usize {
185	    TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1
186	}
187	
188	pub(crate) fn note_tui_resumed() -> usize {
189	    loop {
190	        let current = TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
191	        if current == 0 {
192	            return 0;
193	        }
194	        if TUI_SUSPEND_DEPTH
195	            .compare_exchange(current, current - 1, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)
196	            .is_ok()
197	        {
198	            return current - 1;
199	        }
200	    }
201	}

311	pub(crate) fn start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
312	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
313	    request: AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest,
314	    now: DateTime<Utc>,
315	) -> String {
316	    if let Some(active) = job.as_mut() {
317	        return active.state.coalesce(request.kind, now);
318	    }
319	
320	    let token = CancellationToken::new();
321	    let refresh_state = AttachNarrativeRefreshState::new(request.kind, now, token.clone());
322	    let notice = refresh_state.start_notice();
323	    let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
324	        let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshRequest {
325	            paths,
326	            state,
327	            spend,
328	            traces,
329	            events,
330	            live,
331	            tui_state,
332	            config,
333	            kind,
334	        } = request;
335	        refresh_run_narrative_with_provider_for_kind_with_token(
336	            &paths,
337	            &RunNarrativeRenderInput {
338	                state: &state,
339	                spend: &spend,
340	                traces: &traces,
341	                events: &events,
342	                live: &live,
343	                tui_state: &tui_state,
344	            },
345	            &config,
346	            kind,
347	            Some(token),
348	        )
349	        .await
350	        .unwrap_or_else(|err| {
351	            format!(
352	                "provider refresh failed: {}",
353	                one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
354	            )
355	        })
356	    });
357	    *job = Some(AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob {
358	        state: refresh_state,
359	        handle,
360	    });
361	    notice
362	}

418	pub(crate) async fn poll_run_narrative_refresh_job(
419	    job: &mut Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob>,
420	) -> Option<String> {
421	    if !job
422	        .as_ref()
423	        .is_some_and(|active| active.handle.is_finished())
424	    {
425	        return None;
426	    }
427	    let AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob { mut state, handle } = job.take()?;
428	    match handle.await {
429	        Ok(notice) => state.completion_notice_once(notice),
430	        Err(err) if err.is_cancelled() => None,
431	        Err(err) => Some(format!(
432	            "provider refresh failed: {}",
433	            one_line(&err.to_string(), 120)
434	        )),
435	    }
436	}

140	            self.view = AttachViewMode::Narrative;
141	        }
142	        self.narrative_notice = Some(notice);
143	        self.focused_panel = AttachPanel::Activity;
144	    }
145	
146	    pub(crate) fn record_post_action(&mut self, notice: AttachActionNotice) {
147	        self.docs_open = false;
148	        self.view = AttachViewMode::Activity;
149	        self.focused_panel = AttachPanel::Activity;
150	        self.activity_scroll = 0;
151	        self.docs_scroll = 0;
152	        self.narrative_scroll = 0;
153	        self.files_scroll = 0;
154	        self.processes_scroll = 0;
155	        self.post_action_notice = Some(notice);
156	        self.narrative_notice = None;
157	        self.narrative_projection = None;
158	    }
159	
160	    pub(crate) fn scroll_focused(
161	        &mut self,
162	        delta: isize,
163	        counts: AttachPanelCounts,
164	        rows: AttachPanelRows,
165	    ) {
166	        let current = self.focused_scroll();
167	        let max = max_panel_scroll(self.focused_panel, counts, rows);
168	        let next = if delta.is_negative() {
169	            current.saturating_sub(delta.unsigned_abs())
170	        } else {
171	            current.saturating_add(delta as usize)
172	        };
173	        self.set_focused_scroll(next.min(max));
174	    }
175	
176	    pub(crate) fn clamp(&mut self, counts: AttachPanelCounts, rows: AttachPanelRows) {
177	        self.activity_scroll =
178	            self.activity_scroll
179	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
180	        self.docs_scroll =
181	            self.docs_scroll
182	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
183	        self.narrative_scroll =
184	            self.narrative_scroll
185	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
186	        self.files_scroll =
187	            self.files_scroll
188	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Files, counts, rows));
189	        self.processes_scroll =
190	            self.processes_scroll
191	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Processes, counts, rows));
192	    }
193	
194	    fn focused_scroll(&self) -> usize {
195	        match self.focused_panel {
196	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.docs_open => self.docs_scroll,
197	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.view.is_narrative() => self.narrative_scroll,
198	            AttachPanel::Activity => self.activity_scroll,
199	            AttachPanel::Files => self.files_scroll,
200	            AttachPanel::Processes => self.processes_scroll,
201	        }
202	    }
203	
204	    fn set_focused_scroll(&mut self, offset: usize) {
205	        match self.focused_panel {
206	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.docs_open => self.docs_scroll = offset,
207	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.view.is_narrative() => self.narrative_scroll = offset,
208	            AttachPanel::Activity => self.activity_scroll = offset,
209	            AttachPanel::Files => self.files_scroll = offset,
210	            AttachPanel::Processes => self.processes_scroll = offset,
211	        }
212	    }
213	}

222	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
223	pub(crate) struct AttachActionNotice {
224	    pub(crate) action: CompletionAction,
225	    pub(crate) success: bool,
226	}
227	
228	impl AttachActionNotice {
229	    pub(crate) fn lines(&self) -> Vec<String> {
230	        let (kind, what, why, evidence, secondary) = if self.success {
231	            (
232	                VerdictKind::Completed,
233	                self.action.success_detail().to_string(),
234	                "The action completed inside attach, so detaching returns to the shell with the updated state available for inspection."
235	                    .to_string(),
236	                vec![
237	                    ("action".to_string(), self.action.label().to_string()),
238	                    ("result".to_string(), "succeeded".to_string()),
239	                ],
240	                vec![
241	                    ("Secondary", "deadreckon status"),
242	                    ("Secondary", "deadreckon list"),
243	                ],
244	            )
245	        } else {
246	            (
247	                VerdictKind::Failed,
248	                "The attach action failed before completing the requested state change."
249	                    .to_string(),
250	                "The terminal output above contains the concrete error; detaching is the safest next step before retrying after the error is fixed."
251	                    .to_string(),
252	                vec![
253	                    ("action".to_string(), self.action.label().to_string()),
254	                    ("result".to_string(), "failed".to_string()),
255	                ],
256	                vec![("Secondary", "retry the action after fixing the error")],
257	            )
258	        };
259	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
260	            kind,
261	            format!("{} action", self.action.label()),
262	            None,
263	            ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
264	            vec![("Recommended", "q detach")],
265	            secondary,
266	        )
267	        .expect("attach action notice must have one primary action")
268	        .render_plain(false)
269	        .lines()
270	        .map(ToString::to_string)
271	        .collect()
272	    }
273	}
274	
275	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
276	pub(crate) struct AttachPanelCounts {
277	    pub(crate) activity: usize,
278	    pub(crate) files: usize,
279	    pub(crate) processes: usize,
280	}
281	
282	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
283	pub(crate) struct AttachPanelRows {
284	    pub(crate) activity: usize,
285	    pub(crate) files: usize,
286	    pub(crate) processes: usize,
287	}
288	
289	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
290	pub(crate) struct AttachPanelLayout {
291	    pub(crate) header: ratatui::layout::Rect,
292	    pub(crate) activity: ratatui::layout::Rect,
293	    pub(crate) files: ratatui::layout::Rect,
294	    pub(crate) processes: ratatui::layout::Rect,
295	    pub(crate) footer: ratatui::layout::Rect,
296	    pub(crate) rows: AttachPanelRows,
297	}
298	
299	impl AttachPanelLayout {
300	    pub(crate) fn panel_at(&self, column: u16, row: u16) -> Option<AttachPanel> {
301	        if rect_contains(self.activity, column, row) {
302	            Some(AttachPanel::Activity)
303	        } else if rect_contains(self.files, column, row) {
304	            Some(AttachPanel::Files)
305	        } else if rect_contains(self.processes, column, row) {
306	            Some(AttachPanel::Processes)
307	        } else {
308	            None
309	        }
310	    }
311	}
312	
313	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_layout(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> AttachPanelLayout {
314	    let vertical = Layout::default()
315	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
316	        .constraints([
317	            Constraint::Length(5),
318	            Constraint::Min(10),
319	            Constraint::Length(4),
320	            Constraint::Length(2),
321	        ])
322	        .split(area);
323	    let center = Layout::default()
324	        .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
325	        .constraints([Constraint::Min(60), Constraint::Length(44)])
326	        .split(vertical[1]);
327	    AttachPanelLayout {
328	        header: vertical[0],
329	        activity: center[0],
330	        files: center[1],
331	        processes: vertical[2],
332	        footer: vertical[3],
333	        rows: AttachPanelRows {
334	            activity: panel_inner_rows(center[0]),
335	            files: panel_inner_rows(center[1]),
336	            processes: panel_inner_rows(vertical[2]),
337	        },
338	    }
339	}
340	
341	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_counts(
342	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
343	    spend: &[SpendRecord],
344	    traces: &[TraceRecord],
345	    events: &[RunEvent],
346	    live: &AttachLive,
347	    tui_state: &AttachTuiState,
348	) -> AttachPanelCounts {
349	    AttachPanelCounts {
350	        activity: if tui_state.docs_open && state.status == RunStatus::Completed {
351	            render_markdown_doc_lines(state).len()
352	        } else if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
353	            run_narrative_lines(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
354	        } else {
355	            attach_activity_lines_for_tui(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
356	        },
357	        files: live_file_lines(live).len(),
358	        processes: process_lines(live).len(),
359	    }
360	}
361	
362	fn panel_inner_rows(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> usize {
363	    area.height.saturating_sub(2) as usize
364	}
365	
366	fn rect_contains(rect: ratatui::layout::Rect, column: u16, row: u16) -> bool {
367	    column >= rect.x
368	        && column < rect.x.saturating_add(rect.width)
369	        && row >= rect.y
370	        && row < rect.y.saturating_add(rect.height)
371	}
372	
373	fn page_delta(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> isize {
374	    let rows = panel_rows(panel, rows).max(1);
375	    rows.saturating_sub(1).max(1) as isize
376	}
377	
378	pub(crate) fn max_panel_scroll(
379	    panel: AttachPanel,
380	    counts: AttachPanelCounts,
381	    rows: AttachPanelRows,
382	) -> usize {
383	    panel_count(panel, counts).saturating_sub(panel_rows(panel, rows))
384	}
385	
386	fn panel_count(panel: AttachPanel, counts: AttachPanelCounts) -> usize {
387	    match panel {
388	        AttachPanel::Activity => counts.activity,
389	        AttachPanel::Files => counts.files,
390	        AttachPanel::Processes => counts.processes,
391	    }
392	}
393	
394	fn panel_rows(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> usize {
395	    match panel {
396	        AttachPanel::Activity => rows.activity,
397	        AttachPanel::Files => rows.files,
398	        AttachPanel::Processes => rows.processes,
399	    }
400	}

11	impl AttachPanel {

81	impl AttachTuiState {
82	    pub(crate) fn handle_key(
83	        &mut self,
84	        key: KeyEvent,
85	        counts: AttachPanelCounts,
86	        rows: AttachPanelRows,
87	    ) {
88	        match key.code {
89	            KeyCode::Tab => self.focused_panel = self.focused_panel.next(),
90	            KeyCode::BackTab => self.focused_panel = self.focused_panel.previous(),
91	            KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Char('k') => self.scroll_focused(-1, counts, rows),
92	            KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => self.scroll_focused(1, counts, rows),
93	            KeyCode::PageUp => {
94	                self.scroll_focused(-page_delta(self.focused_panel, rows), counts, rows)
95	            }
96	            KeyCode::PageDown => {
97	                self.scroll_focused(page_delta(self.focused_panel, rows), counts, rows)
98	            }
99	            KeyCode::Home | KeyCode::Char('g') => self.set_focused_scroll(0),
100	            KeyCode::End | KeyCode::Char('G') => {
101	                self.set_focused_scroll(max_panel_scroll(self.focused_panel, counts, rows))
102	            }
103	            _ => {}
104	        }
105	        self.clamp(counts, rows);
106	    }

160	    pub(crate) fn scroll_focused(
161	        &mut self,
162	        delta: isize,
163	        counts: AttachPanelCounts,
164	        rows: AttachPanelRows,
165	    ) {
166	        let current = self.focused_scroll();
167	        let max = max_panel_scroll(self.focused_panel, counts, rows);
168	        let next = if delta.is_negative() {
169	            current.saturating_sub(delta.unsigned_abs())
170	        } else {
171	            current.saturating_add(delta as usize)
172	        };
173	        self.set_focused_scroll(next.min(max));
174	    }

176	    pub(crate) fn clamp(&mut self, counts: AttachPanelCounts, rows: AttachPanelRows) {
177	        self.activity_scroll =
178	            self.activity_scroll
179	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
180	        self.docs_scroll =
181	            self.docs_scroll
182	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
183	        self.narrative_scroll =
184	            self.narrative_scroll
185	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Activity, counts, rows));
186	        self.files_scroll =
187	            self.files_scroll
188	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Files, counts, rows));
189	        self.processes_scroll =
190	            self.processes_scroll
191	                .min(max_panel_scroll(AttachPanel::Processes, counts, rows));
192	    }

194	    fn focused_scroll(&self) -> usize {
195	        match self.focused_panel {
196	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.docs_open => self.docs_scroll,
197	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.view.is_narrative() => self.narrative_scroll,
198	            AttachPanel::Activity => self.activity_scroll,
199	            AttachPanel::Files => self.files_scroll,
200	            AttachPanel::Processes => self.processes_scroll,
201	        }
202	    }

207	            AttachPanel::Activity if self.view.is_narrative() => self.narrative_scroll = offset,
208	            AttachPanel::Activity => self.activity_scroll = offset,
209	            AttachPanel::Files => self.files_scroll = offset,
210	            AttachPanel::Processes => self.processes_scroll = offset,
211	        }
212	    }

229	    pub(crate) fn lines(&self) -> Vec<String> {
230	        let (kind, what, why, evidence, secondary) = if self.success {
231	            (
232	                VerdictKind::Completed,
233	                self.action.success_detail().to_string(),
234	                "The action completed inside attach, so detaching returns to the shell with the updated state available for inspection."
235	                    .to_string(),
236	                vec![
237	                    ("action".to_string(), self.action.label().to_string()),
238	                    ("result".to_string(), "succeeded".to_string()),
239	                ],
240	                vec![
241	                    ("Secondary", "deadreckon status"),
242	                    ("Secondary", "deadreckon list"),
243	                ],
244	            )
245	        } else {
246	            (
247	                VerdictKind::Failed,
248	                "The attach action failed before completing the requested state change."
249	                    .to_string(),
250	                "The terminal output above contains the concrete error; detaching is the safest next step before retrying after the error is fixed."
251	                    .to_string(),
252	                vec![
253	                    ("action".to_string(), self.action.label().to_string()),
254	                    ("result".to_string(), "failed".to_string()),
255	                ],
256	                vec![("Secondary", "retry the action after fixing the error")],
257	            )
258	        };
259	        VerdictSurface::try_new(
260	            kind,
261	            format!("{} action", self.action.label()),
262	            None,
263	            ExplanationPanel::new(what, why, evidence),
264	            vec![("Recommended", "q detach")],
265	            secondary,
266	        )
267	        .expect("attach action notice must have one primary action")
268	        .render_plain(false)
269	        .lines()
270	        .map(ToString::to_string)
271	        .collect()
272	    }
273	}

291	    pub(crate) header: ratatui::layout::Rect,
292	    pub(crate) activity: ratatui::layout::Rect,
293	    pub(crate) files: ratatui::layout::Rect,

299	impl AttachPanelLayout {
300	    pub(crate) fn panel_at(&self, column: u16, row: u16) -> Option<AttachPanel> {
301	        if rect_contains(self.activity, column, row) {
302	            Some(AttachPanel::Activity)
303	        } else if rect_contains(self.files, column, row) {
304	            Some(AttachPanel::Files)
305	        } else if rect_contains(self.processes, column, row) {
306	            Some(AttachPanel::Processes)
307	        } else {
308	            None
309	        }
310	    }

313	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_layout(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> AttachPanelLayout {
314	    let vertical = Layout::default()
315	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
316	        .constraints([
317	            Constraint::Length(5),
318	            Constraint::Min(10),
319	            Constraint::Length(4),
320	            Constraint::Length(2),
321	        ])
322	        .split(area);
323	    let center = Layout::default()
324	        .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
325	        .constraints([Constraint::Min(60), Constraint::Length(44)])
326	        .split(vertical[1]);
327	    AttachPanelLayout {
328	        header: vertical[0],
329	        activity: center[0],
330	        files: center[1],
331	        processes: vertical[2],
332	        footer: vertical[3],
333	        rows: AttachPanelRows {
334	            activity: panel_inner_rows(center[0]),
335	            files: panel_inner_rows(center[1]),
336	            processes: panel_inner_rows(vertical[2]),
337	        },
338	    }
339	}

341	pub(crate) fn attach_panel_counts(
342	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,

344	    traces: &[TraceRecord],
345	    events: &[RunEvent],
346	    live: &AttachLive,
347	    tui_state: &AttachTuiState,
348	) -> AttachPanelCounts {
349	    AttachPanelCounts {
350	        activity: if tui_state.docs_open && state.status == RunStatus::Completed {
351	            render_markdown_doc_lines(state).len()
352	        } else if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
353	            run_narrative_lines(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
354	        } else {
355	            attach_activity_lines_for_tui(state, spend, traces, events, live, tui_state).len()
356	        },

358	        processes: process_lines(live).len(),

361	
362	fn panel_inner_rows(area: ratatui::layout::Rect) -> usize {
363	    area.height.saturating_sub(2) as usize
364	}
365	
366	fn rect_contains(rect: ratatui::layout::Rect, column: u16, row: u16) -> bool {
367	    column >= rect.x
368	        && column < rect.x.saturating_add(rect.width)
369	        && row >= rect.y
370	        && row < rect.y.saturating_add(rect.height)
371	}
372	
373	fn page_delta(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> isize {
374	    let rows = panel_rows(panel, rows).max(1);
375	    rows.saturating_sub(1).max(1) as isize
376	}
377	
378	pub(crate) fn max_panel_scroll(
379	    panel: AttachPanel,
380	    counts: AttachPanelCounts,
381	    rows: AttachPanelRows,
382	) -> usize {
383	    panel_count(panel, counts).saturating_sub(panel_rows(panel, rows))
384	}
385	
386	fn panel_count(panel: AttachPanel, counts: AttachPanelCounts) -> usize {
387	    match panel {
388	        AttachPanel::Activity => counts.activity,
389	        AttachPanel::Files => counts.files,
390	        AttachPanel::Processes => counts.processes,
391	    }
392	}
393	
394	fn panel_rows(panel: AttachPanel, rows: AttachPanelRows) -> usize {
395	    match panel {
396	        AttachPanel::Activity => rows.activity,
397	        AttachPanel::Files => rows.files,
398	        AttachPanel::Processes => rows.processes,
399	    }
400	}

46	    pub(crate) async fn refresh(&mut self, wait: Duration) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
47	        let mut events = Vec::new();
48	        match &mut self.source {
49	            TuiEventSource::Broadcast { receiver, replay } => {
50	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
51	                if events.is_empty() && !wait.is_zero() {
52	                    match tokio::time::timeout(wait, receiver.recv()).await {
53	                        Ok(Ok(event)) => events.push(event),
54	                        Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)))
55	                        | Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed)) => {
56	                            events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
57	                        }
58	                        Err(_) => {}
59	                    }
60	                }
61	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
62	                if events.is_empty() {
63	                    events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
64	                } else {
65	                    replay.skip_to_end();
66	                }
67	            }
68	            TuiEventSource::FileTail(replay) => {
69	                events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
70	            }
71	        }

81	fn drain_receiver(receiver: &mut broadcast::Receiver<RunEvent>, events: &mut Vec<RunEvent>) {

86	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Empty)

99	                });

106	struct JsonlTail {
107	    path: PathBuf,
108	    offset: u64,
109	    partial: String,
110	}
111	
112	impl JsonlTail {
113	    fn new(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
114	        Self {
115	            path,
116	            offset: 0,
117	            partial: String::new(),
118	        }
119	    }
120	
121	    fn read_new(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
122	        let Some(mut file) = self.open_at_offset()? else {
123	            return Ok(Vec::new());
124	        };
125	        let mut raw = String::new();
126	        file.read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
127	        self.offset = file.stream_position()?;
128	        if raw.is_empty() {
129	            return Ok(Vec::new());
130	        }
131	        let mut buffer = String::new();
132	        std::mem::swap(&mut buffer, &mut self.partial);
133	        buffer.push_str(&raw);
134	        let complete = buffer.ends_with('\n');
135	        let mut lines = buffer.lines().map(str::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>();
136	        if !complete {
137	            self.partial = lines.pop().unwrap_or_default();
138	        }
139	        Ok(lines
140	            .into_iter()
141	            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
142	            .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<RunEvent>(&line).ok())
143	            .collect())
144	    }
145	
146	    fn skip_to_end(&mut self) {
147	        self.offset = fs::metadata(&self.path)
148	            .map(|metadata| metadata.len())
149	            .unwrap_or(0);
150	        self.partial.clear();
151	    }
152	
153	    fn open_at_offset(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Option<fs::File>> {
154	        if !self.path.exists() {
155	            self.offset = 0;
156	            self.partial.clear();
157	            return Ok(None);
158	        }
159	        let metadata = fs::metadata(&self.path)?;
160	        if metadata.len() < self.offset {
161	            self.offset = 0;
162	            self.partial.clear();
163	        }
164	        let mut file = fs::File::open(&self.path)?;
165	        file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(self.offset))?;
166	        Ok(Some(file))
167	    }
168	}

## What it's profiling

**Map** (4 parallel readers, read-only):

- **Per-frame render cost** — what each `terminal.draw()` rebuilds from scratch: O(history) iteration over all turns/steps, `format!`/`String` allocation churn, text re-wrapping, widget reconstruction
- **Projection I/O** — the big one: does each frame/tick **re-read and re-parse the event-log files** (`plan-events.jsonl`, etc.) from disk on the UI thread, or read-once + cache?
- **Bench harness** — the exact render entry points + fixture builders to drive headlessly

## Early read

Orientation already shows the loops use `event::poll(200–250ms)` then `draw()` — so **~4–5 fps idle, no CPU spin**. That means felt latency comes down to the cost of *one* frame: if the projection re-reads/re-parses the event log every draw, that's the likely culprit and scales with run length; if it's cached, the TUI is probably fine. 11090	struct AttachJsonlTail<T> {
11091	    path: PathBuf,
11092	    offset: u64,
11093	    rows: Vec<T>,
11094	    signature: Option<AttachJsonlSignature>,
11095	    refresh_count: usize,
11096	    last_read_bytes: usize,
11097	    last_appended_rows: usize,
11098	    partial_bytes: usize,
11099	}
11100	
11101	impl<T> AttachJsonlTail<T>
11102	where
11103	    T: DeserializeOwned,
11104	{
11105	    fn new(path: PathBuf) -> Self {
11106	        Self {
11107	            path,
11108	            offset: 0,
11109	            rows: Vec::new(),
11110	            signature: None,
11111	            refresh_count: 0,
11112	            last_read_bytes: 0,
11113	            last_appended_rows: 0,
11114	            partial_bytes: 0,
11115	        }
11116	    }
11117	
11118	    fn reset_to_path(&mut self, path: PathBuf) {
11119	        if self.path != path {
11120	            self.path = path;
11121	            self.offset = 0;
11122	            self.rows.clear();
11123	            self.signature = None;
11124	            self.refresh_count = 0;
11125	            self.last_read_bytes = 0;
11126	            self.last_appended_rows = 0;
11127	            self.partial_bytes = 0;
11128	        }
11129	    }
11130	
11131	    fn rows(&self) -> &[T] {
11132	        &self.rows
11133	    }
11134	
11135	    fn refresh(&mut self) -> Result<&[T]> {
11136	        self.last_read_bytes = 0;
11137	        self.last_appended_rows = 0;
11138	        let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(&self.path) else {
11139	            self.offset = 0;
11140	            self.rows.clear();
11141	            self.signature = None;
11142	            self.partial_bytes = 0;
11143	            return Ok(&self.rows);
11144	        };
11145	        let modified = metadata.modified().ok();
11146	        let len = metadata.len();
11147	        let current_signature = AttachJsonlSignature { len, modified };
11148	        if self.signature == Some(current_signature) {
11149	            return Ok(&self.rows);
11150	        }
11151	        if len < self.offset
11152	            || (len == self.offset
11153	                && self
11154	                    .signature
11155	                    .is_some_and(|previous| previous.modified != modified))
11156	        {
11157	            self.offset = 0;
11158	            self.rows.clear();
11159	            self.partial_bytes = 0;
11160	        }
11161	        if len == self.offset {
11162	            self.signature = Some(current_signature);
11163	            self.partial_bytes = 0;
11164	            return Ok(&self.rows);
11165	        }
11166	
11167	        let mut file = fs::File::open(&self.path)?;
11168	        file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(self.offset))?;
11169	        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
11170	        file.read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
11171	        self.refresh_count = self.refresh_count.saturating_add(1);
11172	        self.last_read_bytes = bytes.len();
11173	        let Some(complete_len) = bytes
11174	            .iter()
11175	            .rposition(|byte| *byte == b'\n')
11176	            .map(|index| index + 1)
11177	        else {
11178	            self.partial_bytes = bytes.len();
11179	            return Ok(&self.rows);
11180	        };
11181	        let complete = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..complete_len]);
11182	        let before_len = self.rows.len();
11183	        for line in complete.lines().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
11184	            if let Ok(row) = serde_json::from_str(line) {
11185	                self.rows.push(row);
11186	            }
11187	        }
11188	        self.last_appended_rows = self.rows.len().saturating_sub(before_len);
11189	        self.partial_bytes = bytes.len().saturating_sub(complete_len);
11190	        self.offset = self.offset.saturating_add(complete_len as u64);
11191	        self.signature = Some(AttachJsonlSignature {
11192	            len: self.offset,
11193	            modified,
11194	        });
11195	        Ok(&self.rows)
11196	    }
11197	}

46	    pub(crate) async fn refresh(&mut self, wait: Duration) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
47	        let mut events = Vec::new();
48	        match &mut self.source {
49	            TuiEventSource::Broadcast { receiver, replay } => {
50	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
51	                if events.is_empty() && !wait.is_zero() {
52	                    match tokio::time::timeout(wait, receiver.recv()).await {
53	                        Ok(Ok(event)) => events.push(event),
54	                        Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)))
55	                        | Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed)) => {
56	                            events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
57	                        }
58	                        Err(_) => {}
59	                    }
60	                }
61	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
62	                if events.is_empty() {
63	                    events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
64	                } else {
65	                    replay.skip_to_end();
66	                }
67	            }
68	            TuiEventSource::FileTail(replay) => {
69	                events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
70	            }
71	        }
72	        Ok(self.dedupe(events))
73	    }

86	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Empty)
87	            | Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Closed) => break,
88	        }

417	        .max_depth(4)

841	        .last()
842	        .map(|record| record.total_cost_usd.to_bits())
843	        .hash(&mut hasher);
844	    input.traces.len().hash(&mut hasher);
845	    input
846	        .traces
847	        .last()
848	        .map(|record| (&record.turn, &record.event))
849	        .hash(&mut hasher);
850	    input.events.len().hash(&mut hasher);
851	    input.live.file_count.hash(&mut hasher);
852	    input.live.total_bytes.hash(&mut hasher);
853	    input
854	        .live
855	        .files
856	        .first()
857	        .map(|file| {
858	            (
859	                &file.path,
860	                file.bytes,
861	                file.modified_at.map(|date| date.timestamp_millis()),
862	            )
863	        })
864	        .hash(&mut hasher);
865	    input.live.provider_activity.len().hash(&mut hasher);
866	    input.live.provider_activity.last().hash(&mut hasher);
867	    format!("{:?}", input.live.acceptance.status).hash(&mut hasher);
868	    input.live.acceptance.completed.hash(&mut hasher);
869	    input.live.acceptance.failed.hash(&mut hasher);
870	    input.live.acceptance.latest_detail.hash(&mut hasher);
871	    input
872	        .tui_state
873	        .parent_plan
874	        .as_ref()
875	        .map(|parent| (&parent.plan_id, &parent.task_id))
876	        .hash(&mut hasher);
877	    hasher.finish()
878	}

355	pub fn find_run_state_path(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run_id: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
356	    let run_id = run_id.trim();
357	    if run_id.is_empty() {
358	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
359	            "run id prefix cannot be empty".to_string(),
360	        ));
361	    }
362	    let root = paths.runstate_dir();
363	    if !root.exists() {
364	        return Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!("run {run_id}")));
365	    }
366	    let mut prefix_matches = Vec::new();
367	    for entry in WalkDir::new(&root)
368	        .into_iter()
369	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
370	    {
371	        if !entry.file_type().is_file() || entry.file_name() != "state.json" {
372	            continue;
373	        }
374	        let candidate = entry.path();
375	        let Some(candidate_run_id) = candidate
376	            .parent()
377	            .and_then(Path::file_name)
378	            .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
379	        else {
380	            continue;
381	        };
382	        if candidate_run_id == run_id {
383	            return Ok(candidate.to_path_buf());
384	        }
385	        if candidate_run_id.starts_with(run_id) {
386	            prefix_matches.push((candidate_run_id.to_string(), candidate.to_path_buf()));
387	        }
388	    }
389	    match prefix_matches.len() {
390	        1 => Ok(prefix_matches.remove(0).1),
391	        0 => Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!("run {run_id}"))),
392	        _ => {
393	            let matches = prefix_matches
394	                .into_iter()
395	                .map(|(id, _)| id)
396	                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
397	                .join(", ");
398	            Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
399	                "ambiguous run id prefix {run_id}; matches {matches}"
400	            )))
401	        }
402	    }
403	}

286	pub fn spend_summary(state: &PipelineState) -> Result<SpendSummary> {
287	    let path = state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl");
288	    let raw = match fs::read_to_string(&path) {
289	        Ok(raw) => raw,
290	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
291	            return Ok(SpendSummary {
292	                total_usd: state.total_spend_usd,
293	                wall_seconds: state.total_wall_seconds,
294	                ..SpendSummary::default()
295	            });
296	        }
297	        Err(source) => {
298	            return Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source });
299	        }
300	    };
301	    let mut summary = SpendSummary::default();
302	    for line in raw.lines().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
303	        let record: SpendRecord =
304	            serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
305	                path: path.clone(),
306	                source,
307	            })?;
308	        summary.total_usd = record.total_cost_usd;
309	        summary.input_tokens = summary.input_tokens.saturating_add(record.input_tokens);
310	        summary.output_tokens = summary.output_tokens.saturating_add(record.output_tokens);
311	        summary.wall_seconds += record.wall_time_seconds.unwrap_or(0.0);
312	        summary.turns = summary.turns.saturating_add(1);
313	        if record.subscription {
314	            summary.subscription_turns = summary.subscription_turns.saturating_add(1);
315	        }
316	        summary.any_subscription_turn |= record.subscription;
317	        summary.any_estimated_turn |= record.estimated;
318	    }
319	    if summary.wall_seconds == 0.0 {
320	        summary.wall_seconds = state.total_wall_seconds;
321	    }
322	    if summary.total_usd == 0.0 {
323	        summary.total_usd = state.total_spend_usd;
324	    }
325	    Ok(summary)
326	}

569	    area: ratatui::layout::Rect,
570	    sub_count: usize,
571	) -> Vec<ratatui::layout::Rect> {
572	    if sub_count == 0 {
573	        return Vec::new();
574	    }
575	    let rows = if sub_count <= 3 { 1 } else { 2 };
576	    let row_constraints =
577	        std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, rows as u32), rows).collect::<Vec<_>>();
578	    let row_chunks = Layout::default()
579	        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
580	        .constraints(row_constraints)
581	        .split(area);
582	    let mut rects = Vec::new();
583	    for row in 0..rows {
584	        let remaining = sub_count.saturating_sub(rects.len());
585	        let columns = remaining.min(if rows == 1 { sub_count } else { 3 }).max(1);
586	        let col_constraints =
587	            std::iter::repeat_n(Constraint::Ratio(1, columns as u32), columns).collect::<Vec<_>>();
588	        let cols = Layout::default()
589	            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
590	            .constraints(col_constraints)
591	            .split(row_chunks[row]);
592	        for col in cols.iter().copied().take(remaining) {
593	            rects.push(col);
594	            if rects.len() == sub_count {
595	                break;
596	            }
597	        }
598	    }
599	    rects
600	}

441	pub(crate) fn atomic_write_json<T: Serialize>(path: &Path, value: &T) -> Result<()> {
442	    let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
443	        DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!("path has no parent: {}", path.display()))
444	    })?;
445	    fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
446	    let mut temp = NamedTempFile::new_in(parent).with_path(parent)?;
447	    serde_json::to_writer_pretty(&mut temp, value).with_json_path(path)?;
448	    temp.write_all(b"\n").with_path(path)?;
449	    temp.as_file_mut().sync_all().with_path(path)?;
450	    persist_temp(temp, path)
451	}

458	            source: err.error,

355	pub fn find_run_state_path(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run_id: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
356	    let run_id = run_id.trim();
357	    if run_id.is_empty() {
358	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
359	            "run id prefix cannot be empty".to_string(),
360	        ));
361	    }
362	    let root = paths.runstate_dir();
363	    if !root.exists() {
364	        return Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!("run {run_id}")));
365	    }
366	    let mut prefix_matches = Vec::new();
367	    for entry in WalkDir::new(&root)
368	        .into_iter()
369	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
370	    {
371	        if !entry.file_type().is_file() || entry.file_name() != "state.json" {
372	            continue;
373	        }
374	        let candidate = entry.path();
375	        let Some(candidate_run_id) = candidate
376	            .parent()
377	            .and_then(Path::file_name)
378	            .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
379	        else {
380	            continue;
381	        };
382	        if candidate_run_id == run_id {
383	            return Ok(candidate.to_path_buf());
384	        }
385	        if candidate_run_id.starts_with(run_id) {
386	            prefix_matches.push((candidate_run_id.to_string(), candidate.to_path_buf()));
387	        }
388	    }
389	    match prefix_matches.len() {
390	        1 => Ok(prefix_matches.remove(0).1),
391	        0 => Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!("run {run_id}"))),
392	        _ => {
393	            let matches = prefix_matches
394	                .into_iter()
395	                .map(|(id, _)| id)
396	                .collect::<Vec<_>>()

_**Agent - sidechain (claude-opus-4-8 2026-06-05 20:57:01Z)**_

This is a key finding with nuance. There are TWO important facts:

1. **`find_run_state_path` does a full `WalkDir` of the runstate dir every call** (state.rs:367, unbounded depth, no `max_depth`), and `load_run` calls it every tick (attach.rs:731). This scales with the NUMBER of runs on disk, not run length — but it's a full filesystem walk + `state.json` read on every frame.

2. **`AttachJsonlTail::refresh` IS properly incremental** — it uses a signature (len + mtime) to early-return when unchanged (line 11148), and seeks to the saved offset to read only appended bytes (line 11168). So spend.jsonl/traces.jsonl/flight events are NOT re-parsed O(history) per frame. Good design.

But note: `spend_tail.reset_to_path(...)` is called every tick (attach.rs:734). Let me verify `reset_to_path` is a no-op when the path is unchanged (it is — line 11119 guards on `self.path != path`). Good.

Now the critical question: how does the narrative projection cache work, and does `read_plan_messages` (full O(messages) re-read every plan tick) feed an incremental cache or get fully reprocessed? Also need to check the `TuiEventFeed::file_tail` / `PlanEventBus::file_tail` refresh and the provider log scan cache. Let me look at these.

Summary of the five loops and the redraw model:

- **Run** (`attach_tui_with_parent`, attach.rs:727-912): poll 200ms, draws unconditionally every iteration (idle redraw ~5 fps).
- **Plan** (`attach_plan_tui`, attach.rs:441-659): poll 250ms, draws unconditionally (idle ~4 fps).
- **Campaign** (`attach_campaign_tui`, attach.rs:338-402): poll 250ms, draws unconditionally (idle ~4 fps).
- **Chain** (`chain_attach_tui`, chain/mod.rs:2181-2203): poll 200ms, draws unconditionally (idle ~5 fps), synchronous (no narrative).
- **Completion overlay**: not a separate loop — it's the run loop with `show_completion_actions`; the `'r'` manual-refresh paths add a second synchronous `terminal.draw` within one keypress (attach.rs:585, 860).

No busy-spin in the loops themselves (the 100ms/50ms sleeps in chain/mod.rs are in separate blocking helpers, not the TUI loop). The real cost is the synchronous per-draw work that precedes every frame.

355	pub fn find_run_state_path(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run_id: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
356	    let run_id = run_id.trim();
357	    if run_id.is_empty() {
358	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
359	            "run id prefix cannot be empty".to_string(),
360	        ));
361	    }
362	    let root = paths.runstate_dir();
363	    if !root.exists() {
364	        return Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!("run {run_id}")));
365	    }
366	    let mut prefix_matches = Vec::new();
367	    for entry in WalkDir::new(&root)
368	        .into_iter()
369	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
370	    {
371	        if !entry.file_type().is_file() || entry.file_name() != "state.json" {
372	            continue;
373	        }
374	        let candidate = entry.path();

_**Agent - sidechain (claude-opus-4-8 2026-06-05 20:57:52Z)**_

I've mapped all five attach event loops and identified the redraw model and the per-frame cost that actually drives keypress latency. Findings returned via StructuredOutput.

Key conclusions:

All five surfaces (run, plan, campaign, chain, plus the completion overlay which is the run loop with `show_completion_actions`) share one pattern: synchronous work, then `terminal.draw()` unconditionally every iteration, then `event::poll(200-250ms)`. The redraw model is poll-timeout-plus-per-keypress with no dirty gate and no coalescing. Idle redraw is ~5 fps (200ms: run attach.rs:815, chain chain/mod.rs:2207) and ~4 fps (250ms: plan attach.rs:549, campaign attach.rs:360). The loops do not busy-spin (poll blocks), but each idle wake wastefully re-runs the full per-frame I/O prelude.

The keypress latency the user feels is dominated not by the draw or micro-stuff but by the synchronous prelude before each draw. In the run loop the three high-severity, un-cached, every-tick offenders are:
- `load_run` at attach.rs:731 → core `find_run_state_path` (deadreckon-core/src/state.rs:355) does an unbounded `WalkDir` over the entire runstate tree every tick; cost is O(total runs on disk).
- `live_pid` at main.rs:11599 forks a `ps` subprocess per supervised PID every tick.
- `attach_live_inventory` at main.rs:11356 recursively walks the whole working dir every tick.

By contrast the spend/trace/flight JSONL tails and event feed are incrementally signature-gated, and the narrative projection is signature-cached with its provider call offloaded to a background tokio task — so those are cheap on idle ticks. The fix surface is gating the draw on actual change and caching/throttling those three synchronous walks, not micro-optimizing the render.

pub(crate) fn graph_ascii_lines(
    graph: &ArchitectureGraph,
    visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
) -> Vec<String> {
    if visual == NarrativeVisualMode::None {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    if graph.nodes.is_empty() {
        return vec!["[stale] not enough architecture evidence yet".to_string()];
    }
    match visual {
        NarrativeVisualMode::Agents => graph_agent_lines(graph),
        NarrativeVisualMode::Files => graph_file_lines(graph),
        NarrativeVisualMode::Evidence => graph_evidence_lines(graph),
        NarrativeVisualMode::Architecture => graph_architecture_lines(graph),
        NarrativeVisualMode::None => Vec::new(),
    }
}

pub(crate) fn validate_graph(graph: &ArchitectureGraph) -> bool {
    graph.nodes.iter().all(|node| !node.evidence.is_empty())
        && graph.edges.iter().all(|edge| !edge.evidence.is_empty())
}
